lessons.bodyText: Tefilah (Jewish prayer) in light of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This anthology of Rabbi Nachman's teachings about tefila (prayer) began as a small collection called Hishtapkhus Hanefesh ( Outpouring of the Soul ). It was compiled by Rabbi Moshe Yehoshua Bezhilianski (known as Reb Alter of Teplik) and first published in Jerusalem about 1904. The sefer explains Rabbi Nachman's re-introduction of hisbodedus – literally "seclusion" – (voluntary prayer in one's own words) in addition to the traditional mandatory prayers included in the siddur (Jewish prayer book).

lessons.bodyText: Sipurey Maasios - The Stories of Rebbe Nachman - Lesson 04 - King and Emperor - Part 2 - The Cripple - Part 1. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Story of The King and Emperor - Part 2. Review. 02:37 - The Ben Melech - prince - loses his way and is forced to become a servant. 03:45 - The emperor's daughter wanders along the seashore and at night takes shelter in a tree. 06:33 - Fruits of the trees represent the good deeds of the tzaddikim . 09:09 - NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal - guidelines in life priorities from a pirate's treasure. 14:59 - The meaning of wine in the story. 17:40 - Why the emperor's daughter disguised herself as a man. 18:45 - When a Jew prays, it's as if he is "giving" to HaShem . 19:31 - Closing summary, questions and responses. 23:23 - Story of The Cripple - Part 1. 24:11 - NOTE from Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal about what it means to "water trees": a person needs to stay fresh and constantly rejuvenated, approaching each day as a new adventure. 28:08 - One of the wise man's sons was a cripple who set out on a journey to make a living. 33:41 - Story of the origin of a band of thieves. 38:09 - NOTE from Rabbi Michel Dorfman about Teshuvah - return to HaShem, as illustrated through the story.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l

(Recorded in 1974.) The Battle of Yericho . The unusual faith of Rachav in protecting the People of Israel shows how a pe
lessons.bodyText: NACH 01 - Yehoshua 1-24 - Fall of Yericho - Yair Ben Menashe - Battle of Ai - Yehoshua Stills the Sun - Battle of Givon - Praying at the Grave of a Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1974.) The Battle of Yericho . The unusual faith of Rachav in protecting the People of Israel shows how a person who comes from the lowest depths can rise to the highest spiritual levels. “There’s no such thing as a person having passed the point of no return.” – Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Why didn’t Yehoshua have any sons? This was a punishment for having stated a Torah law in front of his teacher, Moshe Rabbeinu . The Zohar HaKodesh, however, says that Yehoshua did not sin because his intentions were pure. During the battle against the kingdom of Ai , a Jewish warrior was killed. Yair ben Menashe , the only casualty, was considered the equivalent of 36 members of the Sanhedrin. HaShem had assured Israel they would be completely victorious, so Moshe Rabbeinu asked HaShem about the meaning of this loss. HaShem commanded a lottery to be held to reveal the person who robbed spoils from the city of Yericho . "No matter how bad his behavior, a Jew still retains the holy title of Jew." - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . A lottery is arranged because HaShem refused to speak Loshon Hara (evil report) about a Jew. The culprit – Achan - is found and he confesses. The power of Viduy - confession. The strategy against the city of Ai that led to victory was used by the Israeli army in the war of 1967. How HaShem wages war. No mercy is shown to evil. NOTE about the importance of establishing and upholding effective judicial system to combat evil. Judges who are too liberal and show mercy to criminals when it’s not warranted are themselves criminal. The deception of the inhabitants of Givon in offering a false treaty of peace. Yehoshua commands the sun to silence itself and thereby causes time to stand still during the battle against Givon . The Torah teaches that the sun and all other elements in the universe are in motion while the earth is stationary. Everything in the universe, even natural objects that seem inanimate, has a consciousness of HaShem . Chevron was given to Calev ben Yefunah for his faith in the power of prayer at the grave sites of tzaddikim . The tremendous value of visiting kivrei tzaddikim . The Torah forbids seeking help from the dead, but Tzaddikim are considered alive even after their passing. When we stand at the gravesite of a tzaddik we align ourselves with his merit while praying only to HaShem . The parting legacy of Yehoshua . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Tefilah (Jewish prayer) in light of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This anthology of Rabbi Nachman's teachings about tefila (prayer) began as a small collection called Hishtapkhus Hanefesh ( Outpouring of the Soul ). It was compiled by Rabbi Moshe Yehoshua Bezhilianski (known as Reb Alter of Teplik) and first published in Jerusalem about 1904. The sefer explains Rabbi Nachman's re-introduction of hisbodedus – literally "seclusion" – (voluntary prayer in one's own words) to strengthen, enrich, and empower the individual's emotional connection with the traditional mandatory prayers included in the siddur (Jewish prayer book).

lessons.bodyText: Shoftim - Osniel ben Knaz - Ehud HaTzaddik vs. Eglon King of Moab - The Power of Responding to Kaddish - Devorah HaNaviah - Yael - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1975.) After the passing of Yehoshua at the age of 110, the first of Israel's judges, Osniel ben Knaz takes command. As the faith of the new generation weakens, enemies arise and Hashem warns Am Yisrael to be harsh with oppressors. After the passing of Osniel ben Knaz - Israel's first shofet (judge) - the nation of Moab rises up against Bnei Yisrael . "The rise and descent of the Jewish nation is repeated in the life of every individual Jew". Ehud HaTzaddik vs. Eglon King of Moab. Even though he was an enemy of the Jews, Eglon showed respect for HaShem . " Kaddish is the holiest of all the prayers we have." The power of responding to Kaddish . The importance of standing during Kaddish . The next oppression of Am Yisrael was by the Canaanites under the military leadership of Sisera . The new leader of Am Yisrael was Devorah HaNeviah . Yael assassinates Sisera . The Arizal reveals that Eli Kohen Gadol at the time of Shmuel HaNavi was a reincarnation of both Yael and Devorah HaNeviah . רחמנא ליבא בעי - HaShem desires a person's heart. Song of Devorah .

lessons.title: NACH 03 - Shoftim 6-10 - How the Army of Gidon Defeated Midian - HaShem Is Patient
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: NACH 03 - Shoftim 6-10 - How the Army of Gidon Defeated Midian - Kneeling Is Forbidden - HaShem's Patience Has No Limit - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Review of the beginning of Sefer Shoftim . *03:00 - "You cannot reach the limit of HaShem's patience and kindness" - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal .
lessons.bodyText: NACH 03 - Shoftim 6-10 - How the Army of Gidon Defeated Midian - Kneeling Is Forbidden - HaShem's Patience Has No Limit - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Review of the beginning of Sefer Shoftim . *03:00 - "You cannot reach the limit of HaShem's patience and kindness" - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 04:00 - An angel appeared to Gidon ben Yoash , from the tribe of Menashe . 11:20 - When HaShem commanded Gidon to destroy an altar to Baal , Gidon received an additional name: Yiru-Baal . He asked and received Divine proof that he should assemble an army against Midian. 18:00 - A selection of soldiers was made by testing how they drank water at a river. Only 300 of 10,000 soldiers didn't get down on their knees to drink. According to Torah Law, kneeling is forbidden. "At no time should a Jew get down on both knees." - Rabbi Rosenfeld. 23:00 - The meaning of a Midianite soldier's dream about a loaf of oat bread. 26:00 - In panic, the Midianite soldiers destroyed one another. Gidon pursued and killed the two kings of Midian. 30:00 - Gidon refused to accept kingship over Israel. His half-son Avimelech instigated a rebellion and killed 69 of Gidon's 70 sons. Only the youngest son, Yosam remained. 38:00 - Yosam told a parable about a thorn to the people of Shechem who had joined Avimelech's rebellion. ***40:00 - Avimelech was killed and Am Yisrael enjoyed relative peace until they fell away from HaShem again. "Each Jew can find himself in the words of Navi because he goes through these periods of elevation and descent" - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal .

lessons.title: NACH 06 - Shoftim 13-16 - Shimshon HaGibor - Trials - Reincarnation - Ultimate Victory
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: NACH 06 - Shoftim 13-16 - Shimshon HaGibor - Trials - Reincarnation - Ultimate Victory - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - Delilah attempted to find out the secret of Shimshon's strength. 09:15 - Shimshon revealed the truth about his supernatural powers and was captured by the Plisht
lessons.bodyText: NACH 06 - Shoftim 13-16 - Shimshon HaGibor - Trials - Reincarnation - Ultimate Victory - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - Delilah attempted to find out the secret of Shimshon's strength. 09:15 - Shimshon revealed the truth about his supernatural powers and was captured by the Plishtim - Philistines. Though he was blinded and endured many trials he remained a tzaddik . 15:58 - Through his death, Shimshon HaGibor brought down more enemies of Am Yisrael than he did in all his battles against them during his lifetime. 20:57 - Shimshon is a tzaddik and therefore continues to accomplish even more after his passing than he did in his life. There are two types of Gehinnam - one of fire and one of ice. Antidotes for the Gehinnam of of ice are hidden in the mitzvos done in pairs - e.g. Tefillin and two loaves of bread at each Shabbos meal. 27:30 - A tzaddik's ability to destroy the enemies of Am Yisrael becomes ever greater after his passing. 30:16 - The subsequent Gilgulim - reincarnations - of Shimshon HaGibor . Shimshon was a gilgul of Nadav and Avihu , the sons of Aharon HaKohen . 35:52 - *The lesson of Shimshon HaGibor's ultimate victory is that a person should strengthen his faith in tzaddikim and never give up.

lessons.title: NACH 04 - Shoftim 11-12 - Chavos Yair - Yiftach - Boaz - Rus - Origins of Moshiach - Shimshon
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: NACH 04 - Shoftim 11-12 - Chavos Yair - Yiftach - Boaz - Rus - Origins of Moshiach - Lineage of Shimshon HaGibor - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - There was peace in Israel under the leadership of Tolah ben Puah from the tribe of Yissachar . *00:40 - The next leader was Yair HaGila
lessons.bodyText: NACH 04 - Shoftim 11-12 - Chavos Yair - Yiftach - Boaz - Rus - Origins of Moshiach - Lineage of Shimshon HaGibor - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - There was peace in Israel under the leadership of Tolah ben Puah from the tribe of Yissachar . *00:40 - The next leader was Yair HaGiladi of Shevet Menashe (East). He called the villages of his sons " Chavos Yair " to commemorate Yair ben Menashe , who had no children. Why does the Torah mention this? The true offspring of tzaddikim are the Torah and maasim tovim (good deeds) they bring to the world. " Chavos Yair " is begematria 635: 613 mitzvos plus the 22 letters of the Torah. 05:56 - Am Yisrael's Emunah faltered and as a result HaShem allowed the nation of Ammon to oppress them. 07:31 - HaShem refused to help Israel because of their idol worship, but Am Yisrael continued to beg Him to protect them. 08:57 - The word " lam'natzeach " in Tehillim alludes to HaShem 's "defeat" through prayer, teaching us that no one should ever give up hope, no matter what the circumstances. 10:40 - Yiftach , arises from humble beginnings to become a fierce defender of Israel. The Jews are forbidden to make war against Moav because Rus would come from that land. 13:55 - Ammon declares war against the Jews. 17:00 - Sichon, king of Amori and Og, King of Bashan were supernatural giants. They had survived the flood of Noach . Yiftach refuses to give back trans-Jordan and the army of Israel was victorious even though they were greatly outnumbered. 19:52 - Yiftach's vow to sacrifice the first thing he meets after the battle if he is victorious. 23:14 - Did Yiftach actually sacrifice his only daughter? The Zohar says yes. Because of Yiftach 's refusal to meet with Pinchas , Kohen Gadol , his daughter lost her life. Both men were punished severely by HaShem for their stubbornness. 28:38 - Civil war with Ephraim . 30:03 - The origin of the term for a password: "shibboleth." 32:03 - Aftzon/Boaz, Rus, and the origin of Moshiach in spiritual purity. 35:36 - Lineage of Shimshon HaGibor (Samson). 37:34 - Elon and Avadon .

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 006a - Shabbat 32 - Vidui - Never Give Up Hope (First Lesson in Series)
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 32 - Vidui - Confession - Never Give Up Hope - Meilitz Yasher - A Mitzvah Is a Defending Angel - The Power of Speech - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal - Carob Tree - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-08-12.) Never lose hope. Vidui - confession. Speech impacts the soul. Misdeeds
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 32 - Vidui - Confession - Never Give Up Hope - Meilitz Yasher - A Mitzvah Is a Defending Angel - The Power of Speech - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal - Carob Tree - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-08-12.) Never lose hope. Vidui - confession. Speech impacts the soul. Misdeeds are etched into the bones but can be released through sincere vidui . Every mitzvah that a person does becomes a defending angel to protect him in this world and in the next. The concept of Meilitz Yasher - a defending angel. *The light of even one good deed can dispel infinite darkness. *Rebbe Nachman advises: don't be your own accusing angel. Search within yourself until you find a bit of good, and use it to pull yourself out of a pit of darkness. The power of speech and the four basic levels of creation: Domem (inanimate), Tzemach (plants), Chai (animals), Medaber - man (literally "speaker") *A person who guards his speech strengthens his defense in the Heavenly Court. An account of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal and his son, Rabbi Elazar zal , when they were hiding in a cave near Meron. Rabbi Chaim Vittal zal clarifies a question about Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair zal , the RaSHBi's father-in-law. Rabbeinu HaKadosh was the youngest student of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair wept over the open sores of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai . How Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal killed an evil person with a glance. A question about the carob tree that sustained Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal and his son. If a tree grows from rocks, it is exempt from the mitzvah of Orlah . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated by Yossi Segal: "To success and clarity in living our purpose for my son, בן ציון בן יוסף his mother, רחל חיה בת דבורה and myself, יוסף בן חנה דבורה. May the light of the Torah always illuminate our paths."

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 007 - Berakhot 3 - Vayechi - Eliyahu HaNavi - Moshiach - Demons
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Berakhot 3 - Vayechi - Vezos HaBerakha - Rabbi Yosei Meets Eliyahu HaNavi - Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol - Schedule of Moshiach - Sheidim - Demons - Wedding Customs - Power of Kaddish - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1970-08-26.) Rabbi Yosei meets Eliyahu HaNavi ( Berakhot 3a). During the givi
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Berakhot 3 - Vayechi - Vezos HaBerakha - Rabbi Yosei Meets Eliyahu HaNavi - Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol - Schedule of Moshiach - Sheidim - Demons - Wedding Customs - Power of Kaddish - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1970-08-26.) Rabbi Yosei meets Eliyahu HaNavi ( Berakhot 3a). During the giving of the Torah, HaShem showed Moshe Rabbeinu the future. Exchange of Torah between Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol and Rabbi Akiva . Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol cries bitterly and explains why. Schedule of Moshiach's Arrival. Six thousand years of the world's existence parallel the six days of Maaseh Bereishis (process of creation). First and second days of creation. Third and fourth days of creation. Fifth day of creation - Hod . Rabbi Eliezer was revealing the "schedule of Moshiach ". כָּל־הַיּוֹם דָּוָה - '...the entire day shall be a day of pain' ( Eicha 1:13). Rabbi Akiva begins to cry over the future loss of his teacher, Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol . Why is Rabbi Eliezer called "HaGadol" ? Where was Reuven when Yosef HaTzaddik was sold into captivity? Yaakov Avinu's rebuke to Reuven in Parshas Vayechi . Then, in Parshas VeZos HaBerakha, The blessing given to Reuven by Moshe Rabbeinu counteracts the negative influence of Yaakov's curse. Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol is a gilgul of Reuven. Rav Noson of Nemirov zal . Encounter between Rabbi Yosei and Eliyahu HaNavi ( Berakhot 3a). Description of sheidim - demons - and where they're found. Restrictions put on sheidim by great rabbis. Why the demons feared Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa and Rabbi Abaye . Sleep on Shabbat is a taanug - a pleasure. Source for the custom that a wedding should be held on Tuesday evening. The shofar of Moshiach . The power of Kaddish .

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 008a - Shabbat 55 - Why Do People Die?
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 55 - Why Do People Die? - Rabbi Yossi Ben Pazi - Strange Questions and Strange Creatures - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-02.) Why do people die? Sometimes Tzaddikim pass away even though they didn't commit any sin. 6 people who died only because of Adam's sin and not
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 55 - Why Do People Die? - Rabbi Yossi Ben Pazi - Strange Questions and Strange Creatures - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-02.) Why do people die? Sometimes Tzaddikim pass away even though they didn't commit any sin. 6 people who died only because of Adam's sin and not through any sin of their own. Angels ask HaShem why Adam received the punishment of death. Adam HaRishon did teshuvah for 130 years but it wasn’t sufficient to entirely correct his sin. Comparison between the mistakes of Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech . At this point in history, Amalek will can only be wiped out by HaShem Himself. Moshe Rabbeinu and Aharon HaKohen never sinned. Right and left side in the Torah: long life, wealth and honor. Rabbi Abba and Rabbi Yossi ben Pazi , a story about the study of Torah lishma - for its own sake - vs. the study of Torah lo lishma - for personal gain. Story about Rabbi Yossi ben Pazi and the Yanuka . There are different degrees in giving tzedakah and doing good deeds. Sometimes a loan or business partnership can be very high level of tzedakah . Reasons for the the existence of various strange creatures. Large creatures afraid of tiny ones: examples and explanation. Secrets of the Gemara are hidden inside strange questions and answers. For example: when flocks travel together, why do the goats go in advance of the sheep? Why is the tail of a camel short, while the tail of an ox is long? What is the purpose of insects? The Torah is a conduit of HaShem's life-giving energy, not food. Lessons learned from the fish, serpent, and pig - all three become stronger as they age.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 009 - Shabbat 127 - Words Create Angels - Gilgulim of Moshe Rabbeinu - Iyov
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 127 - Words of Torah Create Angels - Gilgulim - Reincarnations - of Moshe Rabbeinu - Who Was Iyov ? Speech on Shabbat - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-05.) Rebbe Nachman's words of Torah benefit the souls of his talmidim . Every word of Torah creates a malach - angel
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 127 - Words of Torah Create Angels - Gilgulim - Reincarnations - of Moshe Rabbeinu - Who Was Iyov ? Speech on Shabbat - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-05.) Rebbe Nachman's words of Torah benefit the souls of his talmidim . Every word of Torah creates a malach - angel - that benefits the speaker in this world and the next. There are different levels of tzedakah and different levels of Torah. For each different level different kinds of malachim are created. On Motzei Shabbat - hours following the close of Shabbat - there is a strong aura of kedushah - holiness. A person’s obligation in performing mitzvot during his many gilgulim . Yochanan Kohen Gadol was given the opportunity to repair his soul through his reincarnation as Elazar ben Durdaya . Elazar ben Durdaya : the power of tears and teshuvah . The three gilgulim of Moshe Rabbeinu . A comparison of Adam HaRishon , Noach HaTzaddik , and Avraham Avinu . Why Avraham Avinu is considered the greatest of the three, and even greater than malachim . Why Moshe Rabbeinu is considered the greatest of all tzaddikim - righteous men. *The unique holiness of a bechor - firstborn child. Hevel : Moshe Rabbeinu’s first gilgul . Cain’s jealousy of Hevel and his tikkun through Yisro and the Mitzri - Egyptian. Origin in the Torah of the concept of gilgul . *A woman does not have to return to this world through gilgul except if her husband has to return. Moshe Rabbeinu’s separation from his wife Tzippora . The three things Moshe Rabbeinu did of his own bechira - free will - without being told by HaShem . Who was the “maidservant” who saw more than Yechezkel the prophet at the time of the splitting of the Red Sea? The life of Iyov and his role in the splitting of the Red Sea. Moshe Rabbeinu’s life between the ages of 40 and 80 years, including his stay in Eretz Kush. The meaning of the word קושי. Moshe Rabbeinu’s “other” wife is an aspect of his previous gilgul as Hevel . *An aspect of Moshe Rabbeinu is present in the Tzaddik Emes of every generation. Bringing at least two children into the world fulfills the mitzvah of "be fruitful and multiply" according to Bais Shammai . Sometimes great rabbis remain childless, for example Rabbi Yochanan and Rabbi Chezkiyah . *Observing the mitzvot of Shabbat compensates for being childless. It is extremely important to begin Shabbat on time through candle-lighting and never hurry to ending Shabbat through havdalah after Shabbat . *Speech on Shabbat is different than speech during the weekdays. One aspect of observing Shabbat is to refrain from speaking about what is not permitted on Shabbat . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 010 - Shabbat 89 - Threefold Torah - Mastery Over the Angels
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 89 - Threefold Torah - Moshe Rabbeinu Achieves Mastery Over the Angels - Incense - Pachad Yitzchak - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1970-09-16.) The Torah is threefold. Eldad and Meidad . Why Yehoshua was punished for reporting Eldad and Meidad to Moshe Rabbeinu. When and why it
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 89 - Threefold Torah - Moshe Rabbeinu Achieves Mastery Over the Angels - Incense - Pachad Yitzchak - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1970-09-16.) The Torah is threefold. Eldad and Meidad . Why Yehoshua was punished for reporting Eldad and Meidad to Moshe Rabbeinu. When and why it is disrespectful to call a rabbi by his name. The Gemara provides answers to foolish questions. Eldad and Meidad were Yocheved's sons. Mishpatim. וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע - "All that HaShem said we shall do and we shall hear" ( Shemot 24:7, Mishpatim ). How is it possible to do something that hasn't first been heard? Why Am Yisrael was rewarded for saying these words and how this reward was taken away as a result of the Sin of the Golden Calf. Egel HaZahav - the Golden Calf. * HaShem's kindness is far greater than His measures of punishment. Hashem rewards a mitzvah for 2000 generations and punishes a sin for 4 generations. Naasey veNishma - Reference to Tosafot Bava Kama 17: Which statement is greater: "we shall do" or "we shall hear"? Why did every Jew receive two crowns at Matan Torah ? The importance of Torah study. Why are the People of Israel compared to an אתרוג - Esrog - citron? Moshe Rabbeinu’s debate with the angels at the time of Matan Torah . "The gate to teshuvah is always open." HaShem tells Moshe Rabbeinu to "hold onto His throne". The power of אחדות - unity. Every Jew can attain mastery over the angels through achdut . All souls originate from the Throne of HaShem - Kisey HaKavod . The secret of the קטורת - ketoret - incense offering - was given to Moshe Rabbeinu by the Angel of Death. Pachad Yitzchak. Of the three Avot , Yitzchak , who represents judgment, can best plead for HaShem's pity on Am Yisrael . Yaakov Avinu, Shimon and Levi . The future world is ruled by דין - judgment - as taught by Beit Shammai . At that time the Levi'im will become the Kohanim . The highest degree of חסד - kindness - is found within דין. Closing blessings.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 011a - Shabbat 113 - Behaalotekha - Honoring Shabbat - 7 Books of the Written Torah
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 011a - Shabbat 113 - Behaalotekha - Honoring Shabbat - Clothing and Speech - 7 Books of the Written Torah - Sayings of Rabbi Yossi - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-23.) Shabbat is honored through special food, special clothing, and special speech. Walking too quickly on Shabba
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 011a - Shabbat 113 - Behaalotekha - Honoring Shabbat - Clothing and Speech - 7 Books of the Written Torah - Sayings of Rabbi Yossi - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1970-09-23.) Shabbat is honored through special food, special clothing, and special speech. Walking too quickly on Shabbat is forbidden and is harmful to the eyes. This can be repaired on Friday night by looking at the Shabbat lights before and/or during the recital of the first part of Kiddush . Running to shul synagogue - quickly or to learn Torah is permissible and not harmful. Why it's important to clean the earth from produce grown in Bavel . On Shabbat it’s forbidden to save things from a fire, including papers on which HaShem’s Name is written. Therefore, one should not write HaShem's Name on paper. A story is told to illustrate. The meaning of the two inverted letters נ in Sefer Bamidbar, Behaalotekha . Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi: There are 7 books of the Written Torah. Writing HaShem's Name. What is the status of a Sefer Torah written by a heretic? Rebbe Eliezer HaGadol's life was in danger when he recited Tachanun . The story of Rabbi Gamliel and his sister. The importance of avoiding philosophy and philosophers. According to Torah Law, can a daughter inherit if she has a brother? *It's an obligation to eat three meals on Shabbat . The extra seudah - meal - of Rabbi Chizkiyah . All foods eaten on Shabbat contribute to kedushah - holiness. A person who eats three meals on Shabbat is assured protection from the suffering that accompanies the arrival of Moshiach . He will also be spared from Gehinnom and from harm during the war of Gog and Magog prior to the arrival of Moshiach . *Observing the laws of Shabbat brings a person special protection. There is a tradition that if Am Yisrael observes Shabbat twice in a row, Moshiach will be revealed. Sayings of Rabbi Yossi about the three Shabbat meals. Shacharit - morning prayers - at sunrise, mincha - afternoon prayers - just before sunset. Most tzaddikim die as a result of intestinal illness. Rabbi Yossi also said: "May it be my lot to begin Shabbat in Tiveria and end it in Tzipori , and may I be among those who collect tzedakah - charity - but not among those who distribute it." *When someone is suspected of wrongdoing but is innocent, his sins are forgiven. Rabbis of the Gemara speak about their credits. The Arizal says that if a person is particular about a certain mitzvah , he is repairing it from a previous gilgul - reincarnation. Closing blessing. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 011b - Shabbat 119 - Yissa'char and Zevulun - Melaveh Malkah
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 011b - Shabbat 119 - Yissa'char and Zevulun - Melaveh Malkah - Luz Bone - The Importance of Saying Amein - Kaddish - Berakhot - Respect for Torah Scholars - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1970.) Being particular about a specific mitzvah indicates a tikkun - rectification - was needed
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 011b - Shabbat 119 - Yissa'char and Zevulun - Melaveh Malkah - Luz Bone - The Importance of Saying Amein - Kaddish - Berakhot - Respect for Torah Scholars - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1970.) Being particular about a specific mitzvah indicates a tikkun - rectification - was needed in one’s life or in a previous lifetime. Rabbi Yosei said: "May it be my lot to cause students to sit in the beis midrash rather than cause them to stand up and leave". Alternative explanation: "May it be my lot to support Torah scholars,” referring to the partnership between Yissa’char and Zevulun . Kedushat haShabbat - holiness of the Sabbath: The prayer "VaYechulu HaShamayim VeHaAretz" - the heavens and the earth were completed by HaShem - is said three times on Friday night. These words express faith that the world was created by HaShem at the time revealed by the Torah, and not before. Then, when one says the word “la’asot ” - in order to complete - one becomes a partner with HaShem in the ongoing process of creation. Two angels accompany a man back to his home after Friday night prayers in the synagogue. Whenever a person does a mitzvah he creates for himself a protecting angel. The three Shabbat meals and the Melaveh Malkah meal after Shabbat nourish the luz bone which is an aspect of techiyat hameytim - resurrection of the dead. It's customary to light a candle on Motzei Shabbat without a berakha - blessing. The special benefits of Melaveh Malkah - the meal after Shabbat . Responding to Kaddish "Amen. Ye’hey sh’mey raba" nullifies negative decrees. The reward for saying “amein” and the punishment for neglecting to do so. HaShem is more particular about protecting the honor of His Shabbat Queen than He is with any other mitzvah . Why do fires occur in a home? Jerusalem was destroyed because respect was not shown to talmidei chakhamim - Torah scholars. The importance of respecting talmidei chakhamim and the punishment for disrespect. It's prohibited to extinguish a fire on Shabbat . When a person is careful to uphold a particular Shabbat mitzvah , HaShem Himself protects that person from harm.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 012a - Shabbat 127-147 - Beshalach - Judging Favorably - Marriage - Chava
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 012a - Shabbat 127-147 - Beshalach - Judging Favorably - Why Marriage Is Difficult - Chava and the Nachash - Rabbi Eliezer ben Arakh - Waters of Perugaita - Igeret HaRamban - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1970.) לדון לכף זכות - The mitzvah of judging favorably: two stories to illust
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 012a - Shabbat 127-147 - Beshalach - Judging Favorably - Why Marriage Is Difficult - Chava and the Nachash - Rabbi Eliezer ben Arakh - Waters of Perugaita - Igeret HaRamban - Speaker: Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1970.) לדון לכף זכות - The mitzvah of judging favorably: two stories to illustrate ( Shabbat 127b). Rabbi Yehoshua was regarded in a meritorious light by his students, no matter what appeared to be true. How Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev zal searched for the good in every Jew. To achieve humility and kedushah - holiness, a Jew needs to regard every fellow Jew as his superior ( Igeret HaRamban ). Rebbe Nachman’s advice about judging a rasha - a person who does evil - l'khaf zechut - on the scale of merit. Some mitzvot readily bring a person joy, such as a brit milah - circumcision, while some mitzvos require more effort to achieve joy: such as a marriage. Why? *** Parshath Beshalach. זה אלי ואנוהו– Zeh Keli ve’Anvehu - “This is my HaShem and I shall beautify Him” ( Shemot 15:2, Beshalach ). Beautifying the mitzvot means investing effort, care, and resources in performing them. The greater this investment, the richer the eternal reward. Another interpretation of זה אלי ואנוהו : ve’Anvehu hints “ve’ Ani ve’Hu ” - "I and Him", that is: one should emulate the attributes of HaShem . When the Serpent persuaded Chava to eat from the Tree of Knowledge he injected tumeh - impurity - and zohama - defilement - into her mind. This impurity was inherited by Chava’s descendants. The seduction of the Serpent was not physical, it was spiritual. There are different opinions as to when this impurity was removed. The children of a person who does evil can inherit his distorted way of thinking. The 10 Lost Tribes were harmed by the negative power of the wine and the waters of Perugaita and Deyomset - two ancient cities in the Land of Israel. Of the five students of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai , Rabbi Eliezer ben Arakh was considered the best. Even so, his memory was once harmed by the negative power of bathing in the waters of these cities. When the sages prayed for HaShem's mercy on him, Rabbi Eliezer's wisdom was restored ( Shabbat 147b). Rabbi Eliezer ben Arakh actually hid a Torah secret in his error. One who studies Torah alone has less understanding than one who studies with another. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Effective tefilah (prayer) depends on searching for the intelligence in all things. חן chein (grace) results from focusing on this hidden light. HaShem's Name אהיה אשר אהיה - Ekyeh Asher Ekyeh (I will be what I will be - Keser ) initiates the creative process of תשובה - Teshuvah - return to HaShem . Free will is the "Crown of Creation". Rabbah Bar Bar Channah said: "This wave that can sink a boat looks as if it's crowned by a spark of white flame – we strike it with a staff engraved with Ekyeh Asher Ekyeh."

Based on Likutey Moharan 1, Torah 282, " Azamra " – "I will sing." 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 01. Finding your good points to dispel sadness and anger. "I will sing to
lessons.bodyText: The therapy advised by Rebbe Nachman of Breslov to recover from depression through finding the good points in oneself and in others. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Based on Likutey Moharan 1, Torah 282, " Azamra " – "I will sing." 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 01. Finding your good points to dispel sadness and anger. "I will sing to Hashem as long as I live..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 146:2). " only a little while, the wicked will not be there..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 37:10). 09:55 – A prayer leader needs to see the good in everyone. 18:56 – PARAGRAPH 02. Recovering from depression and waking up from spiritual sleep. " Many enemies/opponents " insist " there is no hope " ( Tehillim /Psalms 3). 23:00 – A person is not allowed to give up on himself. 26:00 – "Taste and see that Hashem is good" ( Tehillim /Psalms 34:9). “Hashem is good to all” ( Tehillim /Psalms 145:9). 27:30 – The Name of Hashem equals 17 – tov (good). Gematria of Mispar Katan in Tikkunei Zohar . 32:42 – “I wake up and I'm still with You, Hashem” ( Tehillim /Psalms 139:18). 34:10 – Recovering from sadness – the therapy of self-awareness and self-love. “A little bit of light dispels much darkness.” 35:07 – PARAGRAPH 03. What does it mean to “Awaken the dawn” ? ( Tehillim /Psalms 57:9) 39:45 – The kabbalah of “I am black but beautiful” ( Medrash Rabba on Shemos /Exodus 49 and Shir HaShirim /Song of Songs 1:5). 42:00 - To achieve the beauty and harmony of the mishkan , each individual brought their own particular type of good. Moshe Rabbeinu could find the good in every member of Klal Yisrael (the People of Israel). 46:35 – The 13 Midos (character traits) of Rachamim – mercy, compassion, kindness ( Shemos /Exodus 24:6-7).

lessons.bodyText: Parshas Toldos - Bris Milah - Eretz Yisrael - Havdallah - 70 Nations - Kislev (Entire Shiur) - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Bris Milah - circumcision - Avraham Avinu received Eretz Yisrael as a gift. 08:52 - Free choice and opting for purity. 11:21 - Nevuah (prophecy) of Eliyahu HaNavi - four types of klippah (obstruction/impurity): storm wind, cloud, black fire, klippah noga (twilight). 12:30 - Havdallah - what is its significance? 13:14 - 70 Nations - seventy different types of Klippos . lessons.title: NACH 09 - Shmuel Aleph 3-8 - Shaul HaMelech - Parable of the Fourth Beggar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Shmuel Aleph - Story of the Fourth Beggar - Shaul Becomes King - Dovid HaMelech Defeats Golias - 7 Mitzvos Bnei Noach - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - *In the last story of the Sipurey Masiyos – Rabbi Nachman's story of The Seven Beggars – the fourth beggar (with a crooked neck) speaks about two birds
lessons.bodyText: Shmuel Aleph - Story of the Fourth Beggar - Shaul Becomes King - Dovid HaMelech Defeats Golias - 7 Mitzvos Bnei Noach - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - *In the last story of the Sipurey Masiyos – Rabbi Nachman's story of The Seven Beggars – the fourth beggar (with a crooked neck) speaks about two birds that have been distanced from one another. The beggar describes his talent as a ventriloquist - he is able to imitate the sound of each bird until the two are re-united. This alludes to the way HaShem used His "Voice" the first time He spoke to Shmuel HaNavi . 04:31 - The Aron Kodesh is captured by the Philistines. This incident relates to a later moment in Jewish history when Dovid Hamelech defeats the giant Golias . 08:46 - The heroism of Shaul even before he is made king. He risks his life, alone, to rescue the Luchos from the Aron Kodesh . 13:49 - The death of Eli HaKohen and his sons. 15:34 - The Philistines celebrate their victory in the city of Ashdod but their idol, Dagan (a kind of "merman" figure) is destroyed and a plague breaks out. The Aron Kodesh is moved to other locations but the trouble continues until the oxen pulling the wagon are permitted to return it to the Jews. 22:11 - Shmuel gives rebuke to Israel. The Philistines are defeated by HaShem through thunder. 25:08 - The People of Israel ask for a King and Shaul is anointed by Shmuel . 29:29 - Why was Shmuel HaNavi angry that the People of Israel asked for a king, when it's actually a mitzvah in the Torah? The response includes some of the Seven Mitzvos (commandments) of the Bnei Noach as listed in Sanhedrin 58b: 1) Do not murder. 2) Do not steal. 3) Do not worship false gods. 4) Do not commit adultery. 5) Do not eat the limb of a living animal. 6) Do not curse God. 7) Set up courts and bring offenders to justice. 38:32 - King Yeravam Ben Nevat threatens the prophet, his hand shrinks ( Melachim Aleph ). Moral of this incident for today: Emunas Chochomim . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Shmuel Aleph – The Reign of Shaul HaMelech - Teshuvah vs. Despair - Harp of Dovid HaMelech - Never Lose Hope - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - The special qualities of Shaul HaMelech were purity of mind and humility. In pursuit of lost donkeys, he met Shmuel HaNavi . 03:35 - In our day, it's customary
lessons.bodyText: Shmuel Aleph – The Reign of Shaul HaMelech - Teshuvah vs. Despair - Harp of Dovid HaMelech - Never Lose Hope - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - The special qualities of Shaul HaMelech were purity of mind and humility. In pursuit of lost donkeys, he met Shmuel HaNavi . 03:35 - In our day, it's customary to seek advice from a chassidic Rebbe and donating a gift as expression of respect (presentation of a " kvitel "). 07:00 - When Shaul was told that he will be king of Israel , Shmuel instructs him to look up at the sky to strengthen his yiras shemayaim (reverence for HaShem ). 10:00 - The meaning of the expression "Shaul is also among the prophets?" Shaul was anointed king. A king of Israel may not negate the honor due him. 13:00 - When Nachash King of Ammon threatened the Jewish community of Yavesh Gilad , Shaul destroyed the army of Ammon . 19:00 - Shmuel reprimanded Am Yisrael for having faith in a king rather than having faith in HaShem . Shaul led the People to do teshuvah by praying before defending themselves against the Philistines. An act of disrespect toward Shmuel HaNavi caused Shaul to lose the kingdom. 25:00 - Yonasan , the son of Shaul , succeeded in a valiant and shrewd attack on the enemy. *30:00 - Shaul HaMelech failed to wipe out the entire nation of Amalek because he allowed their king, Agog , to live, so Shmuel HaNavi executed Agog himself. 38:00 - The Gemara questions the strictness of Shmuel's judgment. Shaul HaMelech might have done teshuvah and been forgiven but he fell into despair and was therefore not able to do teshuvah . 43:00 - The music of Dovid HaMelech's harp soothed the despair of Shaul . Sipurey Maasios - Rebbe Nachman's Story of the Seventh Beggar : the princess and the castle of water. 45:00 - Never lose hope.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 1 - Para. 2 - Ekyeh Asher Ekyeh - I Will Become What I Will Become; Free Will is the Crown of Creation. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (lm1-lesson-002.) Effective tefilah (prayer) depends on searching for the intelligence in all things. חן chein (grace) results from focusing on this hidden light. Hashem’s Name אהיה אשר אהיה Ekyeh Asher Ekyeh ( "I will become what I will become" – Keser ) initiates the creative process of תשובה (return to Hashem). Free will is the “Crown of Creation”. Rabbah bar Bar Chanah said: “This wave that can sink a boat looks as if it’s crowned by a spark of white flame – we strike it with a staff engraved with Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh ".
lessons.dedication: Dedicated by Valerie Seidner and family l'iluy nishmas (for the elevation of the soul) of our dear husband, father, and grandfather, Shimon Beryl ben Yaacov ע"ה who passed away on the 21 st of Tammuz, 5768 (2008). May his memory be as a blessing. To dedicate a Torah shiur, click HERE.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: R' Nasan Maimon. During his 14 years as a student of Shem veEver, Yaakov Avinu didn't allow himself a single night's rest because he was immersed in Torah study ( Rashi on Bereishis 28:9-11). Yet when he arrived at the holiest place on earth and was about to receive one of the most significant prophecies of his life, he allowed himself fall asleep. Why?

lessons.bodyText: Daniel - Hitbodedut Can Save Your Life - The Four Worlds - Statue with Feet of Clay - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Nebuchadnezzar's dream about a statue with feet of clay. Recorded on 1975-05-05. Historical background of Sefer Daniel . Daniel, Mishael, Chananiah , and Azariah are renamed Belshezzar, Shadrach, Meshach , and Abednego . Nebuchadnezzar's dream. The hitbodedut (personal prayer) of Daniel. How and why hitbodedut can save your life. The elements of hitbodedut - gratitude, request, praise. Power over the rain and all other weather elements are reserved by HaShem Himself. The Four Worlds; the greatest perceivable light of HaShem is in Keser . Daniel offers to reveal the king's dream. Daniel' s interpretation of Nebuchadnezzar's dream: statue with feet of clay and head of gold (Babylonian empire), chest and arms of silver (Greek Empire), hips of bronze (Greek Empire), legs of iron (Roman Empire). ( Daniel 2:32-35). Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Daniel - Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah Are Unharmed in the Fiery Furnace - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. 00:00 - Brief review of previous Shiur in Sefer Daniel . 02:29 - Daniel's interpretation of Nebuchadnezzar 's dream. Daniel is elevated to the highest post in Bavel and the king recognizes and acknowledges the absolute supremacy of Hashem. 06:10 - Introduction to the miracle of Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah in the fiery furnace. Why did Nebuchadnezzar stop believing in Hashem ? This questions applies to all nations that attempt to harm Am Yisrael . Similarities between Hitler and Roosevelt יש"ו - both were against the Jewish People, but went about causing harm in different ways. 14:05 - The word Gematria means "numerical value". Refugees from Korea were accepted but the Jews during World War II were not. 16:53 - During the Sinai Campaign in 1956 the United States formed an alliance with Russia against Israel. *19:13 - Anti-semitism is a form of suicidal behavior. 22:09 - Nebuchadnezzar built a statue based on his dream and commanded everyone to bow down to it. By forcing the Jews to do this, his goal was to prevent the fulfillment of his dream, in which Moshiach ultimately triumphed over his kingdom. 28:37 - Hananiah, Mishael , and Azariah speak to the king about the self-sacrifice of the frogs during the ten plagues. 34:47 - Introduction to Nebuchadnezzar 's dream of the tree.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l, Sara Wurtzel

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. 00:00 - The second dream of Nebuchadnezzar. 03:31 - Daniel's response to hearing the vision of the tree. 05:08 - The meaning of the dream. 07:07 - Any type of yisurim (difficulties) can be redeemed through tzedakah (charity). 10:02 - Question of whether the State of Israel should accept reparations from Germany. How should these reparations been viewed? As nothing more than partial repayment for stolen property. 12:39 - Nebuchadnezzar is transformed into an animal for seven years. ( Daniel 4:25-35). This occurrence is the origin of the concept of a werewolf. The Gemara describes mermaids, mermen, and other strange beings that actually did (or still do) exist. 17:01 - Nebuchadnezzar is restored to human form and makes amends for his treatment of the Jews. 17:36 - The death of Nebuchadnezzar and the reign of his son, Belshazzar . 20:21 - The vessels of the Beis HaMikdash were used at the feast of Belshazzar . The handwriting on the wall appears. 27:44 - There are four opinions in the gemara on how the handwriting on the wall was encoded: 1) Rav : in the gematria form of AtBaSH . 29:10 - 2) Rabbi Yochanan's opinion: the words were written backwards. 3) Rav Ashi says the first two letters of each word were written order. 29:48 - 4) The Amora, Shmuel, says the letters were written in a different order than the code presented by Rav Ashi . 31:29 - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai ז"ל asks about the meaning of echoes in the mesifta in Shemayim . 32:29 - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai asks for a description of Gan Eden for women. 33:24 - The encoding of the handwriting on the wall as explained in the Zohar HaKodesh . 37:20 - The message for all generations in these accounts is that harm done to Am Yisrael is always punished.

Recorded in 5735 (1974/1975). 00:00 - Daniel's vision of four beasts rising from the depths of the Mediterranean Sea: a winged lion (the Babylonian empire), a bear (the Persian empire), a four-headed, winged leopard(the Greek empire), and a ten-horned creature with iron teeth (t
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l . Recorded in 5735 (1974/1975). 00:00 - Daniel's vision of four beasts rising from the depths of the Mediterranean Sea: a winged lion (the Babylonian empire), a bear (the Persian empire), a four-headed, winged leopard(the Greek empire), and a ten-horned creature with iron teeth (the Roman empire). Daniel then saw the image of an Ancient Patriarch, dressed in white, with a white beard, seated on a throne of fire. This Ancient Patriarch killed the beast of the Roman empire by throwing it into a river of fire. 12:42 - Daniel's vision contained clues to the process of Jewish redemption. Because hints about this process are difficult to understand, it's important to maintain faith with regard to the arrival of Moshiach . 15:28 - The second vision of Daniel concerns the Greek empire, headed by Alexander the Great, and its triumph over the Babylonian empire. This vision contained further clues about the arrival of Moshiach . 24:18 - A person cannot see Moshiach unless he believes in Moshiach . When Moshiach comes, many Jews will die, just as many died before Am Yisrael was freed from slavery in Egypt. 26:00 - Why the arrival of Moshiach is imminent. 30:19 - Daniel's tefilah pleading for the end of exile and his viduy - confession on behalf of his generation. 33:49 - The malach Gavriel speaks to Daniel about the length of the exile. 36:37 - Introduction to the final prediction heard from the malach Gavriel about the arrival of Moshiach . This will be the topic of the next shiur , which will also be the final lecture in this series, when Rabbi Rosenfeld will also introduce the beginning of his new series, Sichos HaRan .

lessons.bodyText: Daniel - Daniel's Final Vision - Moshiach - Solar and Lunar Calendar - Moshe Rabbeinu and Rebbe Nachman - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1975-06-09.) "Those who come to a Siyum receive the credit for having learned the entire writing." - Rabbi Rosenfeld The closing chapter of Sefer Daniel deals with the exile after the destruction of the first Beis HaMikdash and predictions about the history of Am Yisrael and the arrival of Moshiach . Daniel saw the Malach Gavriel while the three prophets of his time, Chaggai, Zachariah , and Malachi , did not see the malach . There are levels of prophecy, and of all the prophets, Moshe Rabbeinu was the only one who spoke with HaShem "face-to-face". The malach Gavriel explained that the reason Daniel could see him was because Daniel had fasted six days a week, from Shabbos to Shabbos, for 21 years (some say he fasted 21 days). The Malach Gavriel reveals the future of Am Yisrael . Alexander the Great was the first person to physically orbit the globe. ( Tosefos on Avoda Zara 41a). Description of the Greek King Antiochus and the destruction of Yerushalayim by King Titus. The Malach Gavriel does not describe the exile after the destruction of the Second Beis HaMikdash , but instead describes the arrival of Moshiach . There will be two Moshiachs , Moshiach ben Yosef (from Rochel Imenu ) and Moshiach ben Dovid (from Leah Imenu ). The Moshiach ben Yosef might be killed in battle by the evil leader, General Armilus . As brought in the Zohar HaKodesh and stressed by the Arizal : it is possible to save the life of the Moshiach ben Yosef through the suffering of Tzaddikim throughout the generations. It's possible to have this kavana - intention - during the eighth request in Shemoneh Esrei : השיבה שופטינו - "return our judges". The name of Moshiach is Menachem . There will be a period of time between the arrival of Moshiach and techiyas hameysim - the resurrection of the dead - when all souls, good and evil will be judged. It is a serious mistake to try to calculate the exact time of Moshiach's arrival because it could lead to loss of faith. HaShem's world will last 6000 years. These years are divided into three periods: 1) the 2000 years when there was no Torah on earth; 2) the 2000 years of Torah; and 3) the final 2000 years are called the "time of Moshiach ". Analysis of the numerical predictions about the arrival of Moshiach , based on the Tikkunei HaZohar . The nineteen-year cycle of the moon with relation to the sun, the Torah's intercalation of lunar and solar calendar. Yaakov Avinu's face is hinted in the appearance of the moon. "That Your way should be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations." - לָדַעַת בָּאָרֶץ דַּרְכֶּךָ בְּכָל־גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ - ( Tehillim 67:3). The significance of the birth of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov in the year 5532. Introduction to the next set of Shiurim : Shevachey HaRan and Sichos HaRan . Closing point of Sefer Daniel makes it impossible to calculate the Ketz - end of time - beginning of timeless era. "The primary requirement to merit seeing Moshiach is faith." It's customary, in making a Siyum , to connect the last words of the Sefer with its first words. One of the purposes of Moshiach is Kibbutz Galios - in-gathering of the exiles. The letters of the Alef Beis contain secrets. The connection between Moshe Rabbeinu and Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. The purposes of the Beis HaMikdash : Korbonos - sacrifices - and the implementation of Halakha - Torah Law - to establish peace between all Jews and thereby establish peace for all mankind. How every Jew can help bring Moshiach .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: NACH 12 - Shmuel Aleph 18-27 - Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech Were Both Tzaddikim - Michal - Yonasan - Achish - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1974-07-29.) 01:19 - Dovid HaMelech and Yonasan ben Shaul shared a devoted friendship. 02:14 - Michal bas Shaul HaMelech risked her life to help her husba
lessons.bodyText: NACH 12 - Shmuel Aleph 18-27 - Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech Were Both Tzaddikim - Michal - Yonasan - Achish - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1974-07-29.) 01:19 - Dovid HaMelech and Yonasan ben Shaul shared a devoted friendship. 02:14 - Michal bas Shaul HaMelech risked her life to help her husband Dovid HaMelech escape from her father. 03:40 - Dovid fled to Shmuel HaNavi . Based on the words of Shaul HaMelech during a Rosh Chodesh feast, Yonasan warned Dovid of impending danger. 04:35 - Dovid fled to Noveh , and then sought refuge with Achish of Gat , King of the Philistines. 06:46 - After a narrow escape from Achish , Dovid was advised by the prophet Gad to return to the wilderness of Yehudah . 07:41 - Doeg spoke against Dovid HaMelech . 10:58 - Dovid HaMelech consulted the Choshen Mishpat and fled to Ein Gedi . 15:55 - Shaul HaMelech and his son Yonasan die in battle. 16:51 - Naval and Avigail . 19:56 - Naval's heart became filled with panic. 22:37 - Avner, Yoav, and Avishai . 25:58 - Dovid HaMelech returned to the Philistines. 29:20 - Shaul HaMelech was a tzaddik . To this day, any conflict between Torah leaders serves as a trial for the emunas chochomim (faith in rabbis) of Am Yisrael . 34:39 - A person whose mind and faith are pure doesn't perceive these conflicts. 38:13 - Closing blessings about emunah - faith.

lessons.title: NACH 13 - Shmuel Aleph 28-31 - Shaul HaMelech - Witch of Endor - Shaul's Death Was Not Suicide
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: NACH 13 - Shmuel Aleph 28-31 - Shaul HaMelech - Witch of Endor - Shaul's Death Was Not Suicide - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 05:00 - Shaul HaMelech , desperate to know the outcome of an approaching battle, asked a sorceress to summon his teacher, Shmuel HaNavi back from the dead. 12:21 - Shmuel HaNavi told
lessons.bodyText: NACH 13 - Shmuel Aleph 28-31 - Shaul HaMelech - Witch of Endor - Shaul's Death Was Not Suicide - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 05:00 - Shaul HaMelech , desperate to know the outcome of an approaching battle, asked a sorceress to summon his teacher, Shmuel HaNavi back from the dead. 12:21 - Shmuel HaNavi told the king that he would die in the battle, but would be with Shmuel in Gan Eden , indicating the complete righteousness of Shaul HaMelech . *15:59 - Two questions: what gave this sorceress the power to accomplish what tzaddikim couldn't? And why was Shaul forced to receive the answer to his query through such strange circumstances? Rav Noson of Nemirov zal explains that this was to demonstrate the powerful concern of a teacher for his student. 18:16 - Even though in our time "sorcery" is nothing more than illusions created through fraud and trickery, in those days, authentic magic existed. HaShem allowed witchcraft to be effective to maintain the freedom of choice between good and evil at that time. 20:56 - Dovid HaMelech returned to Ziklag to find it in ruins. In addition, the wives and children of his 600 soldiers had been taken captive. After consulting the Urim veTumim - prophetic device of the Kohen Gadol - Dovid decided to track down the enemy and learned they are from the tribe of Amalek . 200 men stayed behind while Dovid and 400 of his men rescued the captives and took plunder. Dovid HaMelech insisted that the spoils of the battle should be shared equally with all 600 men, to show that the outcome was from HaShem, and not a result of the number of people fighting the battle. 25:05 - The three sons of Shaul , including Yonasan , were killed in the battle against the Philistines. Shaul was mortally wounded in battle and asked his servant to kill him, to prevent the chilul HaShem of a King of Israel being captured and tortured by the enemy. The servant refused so Shaul HaMelech fell upon his own sword and died. When his servant witnessed this, he too fell upon his own sword and died. 27:12 - The inhabitants of Yovesh-Gilad heroically rescues Shaul Hamelech's body from the enemy and gave him a fitting burial. 28:23 - When Dovid HaMelech heard the report of Shaul 's death he questioned the messenger carefully and then commanded the execution of this bearer of bad news. Dovid mourned Shaul HaMelech and, even more so, the death of his beloved friend, Yonason ben Shaul . 32:12 - Dovid returned to Eretz Yisrael to take over the kingdom, but encountered opposition from Shaul's general, Avner , who installed Shaul's remaining son as king. *33:45 - The death of Shaul HaMelech is not considered suicide because his act was purely on behalf of HaShem's honor. 38:18 - What is suicide? The answer to this question can be understood through contrasting the death of Shaul HaMelech with the execution of Rabbi Chanina ben Teradion (2nd century CE): “Since the scroll of the Torah is burning with me, the Power that will avenge this offense against the Torah will also avenge the offense against me.” ( Avodah Zarah 17b). 47:37 - Closing blessing.

lessons.title: NACH 14 - Shmuel Beis 2-6 - Dovid HaMelech Brings the Aron Kodesh to Yerushalayim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: NACH 14 - Shmuel Beis 2-6 - Dovid HaMelech Brings the Aron Kodesh to Yerushalayim - Michal Bas Shaul - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - Dovid HaMelech returned to Hevron to reign as king over the tribe of Yehudah . Ish Boshes , a remaining son of Shaul , was installed by Avner as ki
lessons.bodyText: NACH 14 - Shmuel Beis 2-6 - Dovid HaMelech Brings the Aron Kodesh to Yerushalayim - Michal Bas Shaul - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1974.) 00:00 - Dovid HaMelech returned to Hevron to reign as king over the tribe of Yehudah . Ish Boshes , a remaining son of Shaul , was installed by Avner as king over the other tribes. 00:39 - Strife erupted between the armies of Avner (who served Ish Boshes ) and Yoav (who served Dovid HaMelech ). 04:32 - Ish Boshesh insulted Avner, who then abandoned Ish Boshes and offered to serve Dovid HaMelech . Dovid demanded the release of his wife Michal bas Shaul from Paltiel ben Laish . 06:59 - Yoav killed Avner through deceit. 08:06 - Dovid HaMelech reclaimed Yerushalayim and attempted to return the Aron Kodesh there. This first attempt failed because the Aron was placed on a wagon, instead of on the shoulders of men, whereby "The carriers are carried" ( Yalkut Shimoni on 2 Shmuel 5:14-22). 13:23 - Dovid HaMelech finally succeeded in bringing the Aron Kodesh to Yerushalayim with great honor and joy. This triumphant moment in Jewish history is relived by each of us when we put all our energy into dancing with the Sifrei Torah on Simchos Torah . Here there is a description of how the Arizal would dance all night on Simchas Torah . 15:33 - From a window, Michal bas Shaul saw her husband Dovid HaMelech dancing with child-like abandon in the procession in front of the Aron Kodesh . 17:28 – Michal’s actions were always for the sake of kedushah . When Dovid HaMelech returned home she asked him why he hadn't upheld the dignity of a king of Israel. Dovid HaMelech responded by explaining his behavior as being only for the honor of Hashem. From this point on, וּלְמִיכַל֙ בַּת־שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא־הָ֥יָה לָ֖הּ יָ֑לֶד עַ֖ד י֥וֹם מוֹתָֽהּ - "And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child until the day of her death" (2 Shmuel 6:23). Chazal (the sages of the Gemara ) have differing opinions on what these words actually mean. 23:42 - The pain of shame and embarrassment over a sin can help remove the damage to the soul caused by committing the sin. 27:23 - The Tikkunei Zohar explains that above all, HaShem wants us to respect Him and to regret our mistakes. The first word of the Torah - בראשית - is made up of the letters that form the two words ירא (respect/fear/awe) and בשת (shame). There is tremendous reward for serving HaShem with humility. 29:02 - Rav Avrohom Kokhav-Lev zal brings: The time for the coming of Moshiach is from Rosh Chodesh Nissan through Pesach . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Shmuel 2 - Dovid HaMelech and Batsheva - 4 Levels of Understanding Torah - PaRDeS - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Although usually the Torah advises not getting involved in controversy, there are some disputes that we should enter to defend the truth. The dispute about the righteousness of Dovid HaMe
lessons.bodyText: Shmuel 2 - Dovid HaMelech and Batsheva - 4 Levels of Understanding Torah - PaRDeS - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Although usually the Torah advises not getting involved in controversy, there are some disputes that we should enter to defend the truth. The dispute about the righteousness of Dovid HaMelech (King David) is an example of a controversy we are obligated to enter to uphold the testaments of the Torah sages that his intentions and deeds with regard to Batsheva were pure. 01:37 - Everything in the Torah She'Be'Csa v (Written Torah) has 4 dimensions: Pshat (literal), Remez (hint, allusion), Drush (deeper explanation), and Sohd (secret). The initial letters of these four dimensions of Torah spell PaRDeS . 02:33 - The account of Dovid HaMelech and Batsheva on a literal level. 17:14 - The account of Dovid HaMelech and Batsheva according to the understanding of sages in the Talmud. 19:07 - The rebuke of Nasan HaNavi (Nathan the Prophet) - deeper implications. 21:48 - Shabbos 56a: Uriah divorced his wife Batsheva before going into battle. 25:20 - Shabbos 56a: Uriah committed two acts of rebellion against the king for which he incurred the death penalty. 27:32 - Sanhedrin 107a. 35:55 - Avoda Zara 4b-5a and the Zohar - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai's defense of Dovid HaMelech in the incident of Batsheva assures that Hashem can forgive no matter how far a person has fallen.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Lesson 174b - Avos DeRav Nasan 28 - Wisdom and Beauty of Eretz Yisrael - The Greatest Blessing Is Peace - Limud Torah with Derech Eretz - Torah Study Combined with Earning a Living - Who Is a True Friend? Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - "There is no wisdom like that of Eretz Yisrael ." 13:
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Lesson 174b - Avos DeRav Nasan 28 - Wisdom and Beauty of Eretz Yisrael - The Greatest Blessing Is Peace - Limud Torah with Derech Eretz - Torah Study Combined with Earning a Living - Who Is a True Friend? Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - "There is no wisdom like that of Eretz Yisrael ." 13:55 - "The greatest blessing possible is peace." Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel would say: Anyone who brings peace into his own home is regarded by the Torah as if he had brought peace to everyone in Israel. 18:12 - The importance of Torah study and its eternal blessings. Limud Torah requires effort. 21:17 - Reading secular books requires no effort but the result is worthless. 28:54 - The passing of Rabbi Yehudah HaNassi . 29:49 - Combining Limud Torah with Derech Eretz . Supporting one's Torah study through earning a living. Balancing time for parnassa and for Limud Torah . 36:39 - Expanding one's business ventures beyond one's own city can endanger business interests. 42:06 - Who is a true friend? One who gives mussar - honest and productive rebuke - and never flatters.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov - Lesson 106a - Bava Basra - Page 121 - The Twelve Sons of Yaakov Avinu - Allotment of Eretz Yisrael
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov -Bava Basra - Twelve Sons of Yaakov Avinu - Allotment of Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l . 00:00 - Giving honor to Torah scholars and the elderly. An overview of the overlapping generations of tzaddikim . 15:09 - The tribe of Levi and all the women of Klal Yisrael were exempt from the
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov -Bava Basra - Twelve Sons of Yaakov Avinu - Allotment of Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l . 00:00 - Giving honor to Torah scholars and the elderly. An overview of the overlapping generations of tzaddikim . 15:09 - The tribe of Levi and all the women of Klal Yisrael were exempt from the punishment of the generation of the meraglim (spies). In the merit of Jewish women, the People of Israel merited being rescued from slavery. *17:11 - The entrance of Klal Yisrael into Eretz Yisrael . In the future Eretz Yisrael will be allocated in a different way because every Jew will have part valley and part mountain, gardens, fields, and all will have equal. But the land will be divided into 13 parts instead of 12 as the original division – the thirteenth allotment will be for Moshiach . 20:09 - The Kohen Gadol must be wealthier than any other kohen. 20:48 - At the time of Yehoshua , the tribe of Levi was not given a portion of the Land, while Ephraim and Menasheh , the sons of Yosef HaTzadik , were considered one tribe each. Why? Because Yosef received the bochorah – the firstborn’s birthright – which is more than the others. When Mashiach comes, the tribe of Levi will be given a portion because Ephraim and Menashe will be combined to become Yosef . Why? Yosef was the opposing force to Esav . Yosef is the flame, Esav the straw. But after Esav is vanquished, Yosef will no longer need that extra power and so he will be equal with his brothers. *23:07 - The Yud Gimmel Midos of Hashem (the 13 Attributes of Kindness) correspond to these 13 future allotments of Eretz Yisrael . 23:40 - Yaakov Avinu and the power of tefilah (prayer). Moshiach will succeed through tefilah . 28:20 - Yaakov Avinu and the birthright of Yosef HaTzaddik . Rochel gave simanim (secret signs) to Leah. The kindness of her self-sacrifice – to give away her rights to marry the tzaddik – gave Rochel's firstborn ( Yosef ) the merit to be considered Yaakov Avinu's firstborn. 33:59 - Rochel's behavior teaches modesty to Jewish women. The sign of Shabbos is equalled during the week by the mitzvah of tefillin . What equals the mitzvah of tefillin for women? Tznius (modesty). The mitzvah of tznius is a privilege given to everyone in Am Yisrael . 39:23 - Tznius is more than how one dresses, and it applies to men as well as to women. It also applies to how one speaks and behaves. 42:24 - The Twelve Tribes correspond to the 12 months of the year. The two Adar s correspond to Yosef HaTzadik .

lessons.title: OC1 - Lesson 005 - Hashkamas HaBoker 1 - Para. 4-8 - Integrity of the Soul
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Good points relate to the colors of the Beis HaMikdash (the once and future Holy Temple in Jerusalem). 12:00 PARAGRAPH 5. "Wake up, my honor" - awakening the darkness. By being able to find the good point in the darkness, the soul is awakened. Songs are made from the go
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Good points relate to the colors of the Beis HaMikdash (the once and future Holy Temple in Jerusalem). 12:00 PARAGRAPH 5. "Wake up, my honor" - awakening the darkness. By being able to find the good point in the darkness, the soul is awakened. Songs are made from the good points, as in " ...Azamra l'Elokai beOhdi " - "I sing to Hashem with what is left." 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The ARIzal in Pri Etz Chaim , Chapter 2, Tikkun Chatzos , explains that the Shekhina (Divine Presence) goes into the darkness to retrieve light. This hints at what we're supposed to do when we find ourselves in darkness. Tehillim /Psalms 77 "I remembered my song in the night, I search for my holy spirit." What is a sacrifice in the Beis HaMikdash ? It's actually the spark of holiness that's brought through the animal. 32:00 - The meaning of the Chelbanah of the Ketores (Incense offering). In order for a tefilah (Jewish prayer) to be complete, it must include the prayers of all levels of people in the congregation. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. When we recite the sacrifices in prayer, it's as if we're actually bringing the sacrifices. The main accomplishment of these offerings is related to speech. By bringing these animals or products, we're elevated the good points within the sacrifice to a higher level. 38:00 - Similar to how a dove is always faithful, the good point within us will never allow our soul to be ripped apart from Hashem . The essence of the sacrifices is speech. 46:20 - PARAGRAPH 8. In the Beis HaMikdash there were three different types of service proceeding simultaneously - of the Kohanim (kindness), of the Leviim (song), and of the Yisraelim (learning/speech). 52:00 - Why Parshas HaAzinu is connected to Parshas Bereishis . Through the ruach (spirit) of Moshiach and Hashem’s use of speech – “ Ki Tov ” - at the time of Creation, the good points were removed from the darkness. The whole existence of the world is based on this principle of finding the good point. 56:00 - The shape and form of the Mishkan (tabernacle in the wilderness) corresponded to the creation of the world. Why Parshas HaAzinu was read during the sacrifices of the Beis HaMikdash .

Building "Holy Palaces" of the Mishkan (Tabernacle) and the Beis HaMikdash (the once and future Holy Temple in Jerusalem) through prayer. 15:55 - PARAGRAPH 10. T
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. The blessing before Kriyas Shema . 04:55 - Why we recite the korbonos (sacrificial offerings) before prayer. Building "Holy Palaces" of the Mishkan (Tabernacle) and the Beis HaMikdash (the once and future Holy Temple in Jerusalem) through prayer. 15:55 - PARAGRAPH 10. The importance of getting dressed in the morning. The principles of "right" and "left" in kabbalah. Clothing of the soul and the multi-colored gemstones of the Kohen's Choshen (chestplate). Parshas Mishpatim : Hashem is "clothed" with tefillin . 24:18 - PARAGRAPH 11. The morning blessings help us to find the good points, for example light, opening the eyes of the blind, the gift of sight. 31:30 - PARAGRAPH 12 - Short introduction to the Four Parshios (four special selections from Torah portions) read in the weeks leading up to Pesach (Passover): Shekalim, Zochor, Parah, and HaChodesh . Study of the text of PARAGRAPH 12 begins in the following shiur .

Parshas HaChodesh. Kiddush haChodesh - sanctification of the new month. Renewal of moon. Rosh Chodesh and the lunar cycle. 11:30 - Proclamation of the new m
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hashkamas HaBoker 1. Parshas HaChodesh ; finding the good points; music of King David's Harp. 01:00 - (Lesson 007a). The Four Parshios - contd. Parshas HaChodesh. Kiddush haChodesh - sanctification of the new month. Renewal of moon. Rosh Chodesh and the lunar cycle. 11:30 - Proclamation of the new moon as finding the good point. 14:00 - The stars are given to moon as compensation. Stars represent the good points in every person. 22:00 - (Lesson 007b). Daniel 12:3 - Those who find merit in the community are like stars. 32:00 - How Reb Michel Dorfman z"l honored IDF soldiers. 34:00 - Note on sheytls (wigs) used by married women to cover their hair. *38:30 - "Fifth Shulchan Aruch " - of common sense. Inspiring story about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfel z"l being honored by Rav Moshe Feinstein z"l . Shiva (mourning) on Shabbos ? 42:46 - "What's going to bring about the tikkun for the Jewish People? Their nekudos tovos (good points)." 45:00 - (Lesson 007c) Chatzos - (midnight prayer). Mourning the Beis HaMikdash . True meaning of King David's harp. North wind awakening him. Tzafon means "north" and also means "hidden." 46:30 - The good points hidden within every person's soul are playing "the music of King David's harp".

lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 30. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. The miracle of Chanukah took place through the kohanim . The light of Hashem 's "Face" is received at the Beis HaMikdash on the three main holidays ( Pesach, Shavuos, and Sukkos ), while on Chanukah the Shekhina comes into o
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 30. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. The miracle of Chanukah took place through the kohanim . The light of Hashem 's "Face" is received at the Beis HaMikdash on the three main holidays ( Pesach, Shavuos, and Sukkos ), while on Chanukah the Shekhina comes into our homes. 02:41 - PARAGRAPH 13. כי נר מצוה ותורה אור - "For a mitzvah is a candle and the Torah is light." ( Mishlei /Proverbs 6:23). The light of Chanukah results from the tochecha (rebuke) that reveals chessed (kindness). 08:59 - PARAGRAPH 14. The mitzvah of Bikur Cholim (visiting the sick). 16:31 - Chanukah and Purim are aspects of visiting the sick, because at those times the Shekhina (manifestation of Hashem ) comes into to our homes, where we are suffering from exile. 24:09 - On Purim we receive the Torah anew. *27:37 - PARAGRAPH 15. It is impossible to receive the light of Hashem's "Face" except through giving tzedakah (charity). 33:09 - PARAGRAPH 16. Dispute between followers of Shammai and followers of Hillel about the lights of Chanukah . 39:15 - The dispute between the sons of Yaakov Avinu was caused because Yosef haTzaddik associated with the sons of Zilpah and Bilhah . The light of Chanukah is the light of the tzaddik who gives over his soul to bringing the People of Israel back to Hashem .

lessons.title: lm1-039 - Likutey Moharan 9 - Para. 5-6 - Likutey Moharan 10 - Para. 1-4a - Purim - Dancing - Clapping Hands - Tefilah - Prayer for Recovery from Illness
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 9 - Likutey Moharan 10 - Purim - Dancing - Clapping Hands - Tefilah - Prayer for Recovery from Illness - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 039. Recorded 1989-06-11.) 00:00 - End of TORAH 9. 16:10 - Q&R about Avraham Avinu . 19:10 - LIKUTEY MOHARAN 10. Introduction. The teachings of the Likutey Mohara
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 9 - Likutey Moharan 10 - Purim - Dancing - Clapping Hands - Tefilah - Prayer for Recovery from Illness - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 039. Recorded 1989-06-11.) 00:00 - End of TORAH 9. 16:10 - Q&R about Avraham Avinu . 19:10 - LIKUTEY MOHARAN 10. Introduction. The teachings of the Likutey Moharan are not separate entities; they inform and flow into one another. PARAGRAPH 1. "Harsh decrees against the People of Israel can be mitigated through dancing and hand-clapping." 28:46 - PARAGRAPH 3. Avraham called the Presence of HaShem a har - mountain. Yitzchak called it a sadeh - field. Yaakov - called it a bayis - house. כי ביתי בית תפלה יקרא לכל העמים - "For My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations" ( Yishaya 56:7). 34:52 - Macheneh - encampment - is an aspect of how the Beis HaMikdash in Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) protects Israel. Shlomo HaMelech knew how to build each wall of the Holy Temple with respect to the machaneh which is begematria 103. First wall: machaneh of kedusha . Second wall: har of Avraham Aveinu , twice machaneh . Third wall: s adeh of Yitzchak Aveinu is three times machaneh . Fourth wall: bayis of Yaakov Aveinu is four times machaneh . And the roof is in the merit of Moshe Rabbeinu , the number of his tefilos alluded to in the word vaeschanan is begematria 515, which is five times machaneh . 40:12 - When HaShem is praised by lowly people, He is exalted the most. *45:58 - PARAGRAPH 4. Elevating tefilah to the level that its visible and accessible even to non-Jews is only achieved through the tzaddikim of the generation. "When someone has a person in their family who is ill, they should turn to a chakham (wise man) to pray for them." ( Bava Basra 116a) מי שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו, ילך אצל חכם ויבקש עליו רחמים: (בבא בתרא קטז)
