lessons.bodyText: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 65. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Chanuka and bitul (self-nullification, humility, selflessness). The power of being humble. 21:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. 23:20 - Rabeynu Yona describing being humiliated but saying it was the greatest achievement of his life. 38:40 - Rechev (chariot) is b'gematria 222. Pharaoh took " shesh " of his army. 222 minus 6 is 216 - gevurah (strength). The ARI HaKadosh says that Pharaoh took hold of Hashem's midah (attribute) of gevurah . 42:15 - PARAGRAPH 5. 55:08 - Chanukah : the selflessness of Matisyahu and his sons.

lessons.title: OC1 - Lesson 029 - Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Para. 7-10 - Pharaoh's Dream - Yosef HaTzaddik - Bitul - Account of Malach and Galuch - Tefillin - Tzitzis - Techeles
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Pharaoh's Dream - Yosef HaTzaddik - Bitul - Account of Malach and Galuch - Tefillin - Tzitzis - Techeles - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in 2011.) Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Pharaoh's dream - the seven cows and the sev
lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Pharaoh's Dream - Yosef HaTzaddik - Bitul - Account of Malach and Galuch - Tefillin - Tzitzis - Techeles - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in 2011.) Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Pharaoh's dream - the seven cows and the seven sheaves. What does it mean that Yosef HaTzaddik was "eye to eye" with Pharaoh? 26:15 - How to return to a lower, physically grounded level of consciousness after achieving bitul (spiritual self-nullification). 32:10 - PARAGRAPH 8. Our soul is constantly yearning for HaShem , whether we realize it or not. ***39:30 - Progress in serving HaShem means turmoil - a sense of humor helps! Rebbe Nachman attended a wedding where an entertainer dressed up first as a malach (angel) and then as a galuch (priest). Rebbe Nachman told his students, "That's us!" NOTE: "Bitul" - spiritual surrender. 40:54 - Tzitzis bring the same light that one can access while in the state of bitul . 44:00 - Techeles (dark sky blue). 47:06 - PARAGRAPH 9. Why do Tzitzis precede Tefillin ? 58:50 - PARAGRAPH 10. Tefillin and techeles enable us to visualize our tachlis (ultimate purpose) via the light of HaShem's Ohr Ayn Sof .

lessons.title: OC1 - Lesson 030 - Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Para. 11-12a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Shatnez - Wool and Linen - Clothing - Livush - Chashmal - Chava - Gan Eden - Bitul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. 15:20 - (Lesson 030b). 19:34 - There are four mystical worlds and the light of Hashem
lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 - Shatnez - Wool and Linen - Clothing - Livush - Chashmal - Chava - Gan Eden - Bitul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. 15:20 - (Lesson 030b). 19:34 - There are four mystical worlds and the light of Hashem reaches into even the lowest level of the lowest world. 23:00 - "Even in the valley of death I will not fear because You are with me" ( Tehillim 23). 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Wool and linen. Gan Eden and repairing the sin of Adam and Chava . The origin of all clothing we have in the world was the garments Hashem made for Adam and Chava after their sin. What is the deeper meaning of garments and clothing?* (through 49:00) 35:18 - Gan Eden is an aspect of bitul . 49:00 - (Lesson 030c). A person needs garments to be able to connect with Hashem . Forces of evil attack clothing. Yosef HaTzaddik and the wife of Potiphar . *54:47 - Yechezkel HaNavi : chashmal (spiritual light/energy) and klipas noga (twilight) – negative forces that can be transmuted to positive forces. The Arizal brings: chashmal is b'gematria livush (clothing). Clothing is the boundary between holiness and unholiness.

lessons.bodyText: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 65. This shiur was given on 11 Tishrei 5772 (9 October, 2011). 00:00 - Shatnez - the prohibition of mixing wool and linen in a garment. What are the spiritual attributes of tzemer (wool) and pishtan (linen)? Tehillim (Psalms) 118:5 - "From narrow straits I call out to You..." 22:24 - PARAGRAPH 13. (Lesson 031b). Cain raised linen and Hevel (Able) raised sheep for wool. Where did they go wrong? 31:30 - PARAGRAPH 14. 37:51 - (Lesson 031c). Tzitzis . 45:26 - Tikkun Chatzos - learning Torah after the midnight tefilos (prayers) locks in all that's gained. 46:24 - Tzitzis are a tremendous protection from the Yetzer Hara . 46:33 - Incident when Reb Michel Dorfman's son-in-law, Reb Yerachmiel Sher, was saved during the Holocaust by the fact that he was wearing tzitzis .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 12. oo:oo - " Ayeh makom cvodo " - " Where is the place of His glory ?" Because Hashem is hidden there's room in our heart for doubt. The korbon oleh (elevated offering) repairs errors made within the heart/imagination. 03:02 - Minhag (custom) of saying the Shirei HaMaa
lessons.bodyText: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 12. oo:oo - " Ayeh makom cvodo " - " Where is the place of His glory ?" Because Hashem is hidden there's room in our heart for doubt. The korbon oleh (elevated offering) repairs errors made within the heart/imagination. 03:02 - Minhag (custom) of saying the Shirei HaMaalos ( Tehillim/Psalms 120-134) on Shabbos afternoon in winter. 11:10 - Some Torah is revealed for all the world to hear, while some is nistar (hidden) and accessible through personal invitation by a teacher only. The word " halakha" is composed of the roshei teyvos of the phrase הריעו לאלקים כל-חארץ – " Praise Hashem, the entire world. " ( Tehillim/Psalms 66:1) 12:50 - השתחוו לה' בהדרת קדש, ר"ת קבלה The word " kabbala " is composed of the roshei teyvos of the phrase " Bow down to Hashem in His holy domain. " ( Tehillim/ Psalms 29:2) 17:00 - Bereishis (" In the beginning... ") alludes to the hidden aspects of creation that we need to seek out. The word sofeyk (doubt) is composed of the letters of the name "Amalek" - the antithesis of Hashem. 19:00 - When Avraham Aveinu was on his way to Akeidas Yitzchak (the binding of his son Isaac) the yetzer hara (evil inclination) tried to make him doubt. 24:12 - PARAGRAPH 2. (Lesson 034b). Why clothing needs to be protected.* 28:54 - The wool of sheep originates from a very high spiritual place, as in " The hair of His head was like pure, white wool. " (Daniel 7:9) 30:00 - " Ayeh " represents Keser (the "crown" of Hashem) - all that is beyond understanding so we don't investigate into it. 33:00 - Tzitzis are made of wool and repair/protect from doubts in our heart. *39:00 - Tzitzis on the four corners of a garment speak to the question ayeh : where is Hashem? Hashem is everywhere -- even if we'd search to "the four corners of the earth". 40:32 - (Lesson 034c) Why is it permitted to wear tzitzis in the bathroom? *45:00 - What's holy about Purim? 52:03 - PARAGRAPH 4. (Lesson 034d). Linen as a lowly fabric. Shatnez - prohibition of combining wool and linen. 1:06:00 - Yom Kippur. Hashem's forgiveness is found in ayeh - the place where He is most hidden.

lessons.bodyText: Halakhos 1 and 3 of Birkhas HaShachar are based on Likutey Moharan Torah 56. 00:00 - The "voice of the rooster" alludes to the power of waking up the world to service of Hashem. What is binah (discernment)? 17:45 - Note that Rav Nasan of Nemirov usually presents the first halakha of any topic in a short, concise way, and then opens up to more refinement in subsequent halakhas on that topic. 18:18 - Note that Halakha 2 of Birkhas HaShachar is included in Hashkamas HaBoker 1 and is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 282 (" Azamra "). 18:56 - HALAKHA 3 - PARAGRAPH 1. (Lesson 097b). Brief introduction to the Sipurey Masiyos (The 13 Stories of Rebbe Nachman) and in particular to story 11: "The Exchanged Children". 28:24 - PARAGRAPH 2. Heichal HaTemuros - The Hall of Exchanges. 40:25 - (Lesson 097c). Every Jew belongs to royalty. 51:16 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 ( Tinyana ) Torah 7: "The potential of a Jewish soul is much higher than that of any angel." 52:27 - PARAGRAPH 3. The conflict between Sarah Imeynu and Hagar was about the spiritual yerusha (inheritance) of their sons Yitzchak and Yishmael. 57:03 - Rivka Imeynu is told " two nations are inside of you... " 58:03 - The secret of reincarnation of souls originates in the Heichal HaTemuros - the Hall of Exchanges.* These exchanges take place in our lives every day, even many times a day. 58:56 - Account of Rebbe Nachman at a wedding where an entertainer dressed up as an angel, then as a priest. Rebbe Nachman said, "That's us ." *1:00:43 - The secret of reincarnation of souls, and our daily ups and downs, originates in the Heichal HaTemuros - the Hall of Exchanges.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaShachar 3. Rabbi Nasan Maimon: The origin of the soul of Dovid HaMelech. What is ShoVaViM TaT ? This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 56. 00:00 - (Lesson 098a) The Heichal HaTemuros (Hall of Exchanges) caused by Adam's exile from Gan Eden (the Garden of Eden) is the source for tempo
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaShachar 3. Rabbi Nasan Maimon: The origin of the soul of Dovid HaMelech. What is ShoVaViM TaT ? This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 56. 00:00 - (Lesson 098a) The Heichal HaTemuros (Hall of Exchanges) caused by Adam's exile from Gan Eden (the Garden of Eden) is the source for temporary switching of souls. 04:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan Torah 31. 06:43 - A person is assisted on the path that he chooses to follow. A person has free will even though this Heichal HaTemuros exists. 11:38 - " Save me from an evil person... " ( Tehillim /Psalms 140:2). 16:24 - (Lesson 098b). The last thing we say before going to sleep each night is " Into your hands I place my spirit... " ( Tehillim /Psalms 31:6). 38:10 - PARAGRAPH 4. (Lesson 098c). Why the souls of Avraham Aveinu and Dovid HaMelech had to be hidden and then extracted from impurity. *40:53 - Dovid HaMelech , Adam HaRishon , and Moshiach share one soul. Hashem had to take the soul of Dovid HaMelech away from the side of evil, through Lot and his daughters. Analogy of a raid against terrorists who are holding a hostage, with Hashem on the rescue mission. 41:42 - Iyov (Job) is a gilgul (incarnation) of Terach . 43:06 - Dovid HaMelech was supposed to be stillborn, but he received years from Adam HaRishon , Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov. *44:30 - Through learning about the life of Dovid HaMelech , we can learn how to fight the battles of our own life through tefila . 50:03 - " Sefer Tehillim is not a history book, it was written for me ." 50:23 - "ShOVaVIM TaT" - is a phrase constructed from the initial letters of the six parshios from Shemos through Tetzaveh . It's a time for introspection and teshuvah . The Sofei Teyvos (final letters) of the words ואלה שמות בני ישראל הבאים מצרימה איש וביתו באו spell " Tehillim " and " teshuvah ".

lessons.bodyText: This week's parsha shiur is based on Orach Chaim, Hilkhos Hodoah 6, Para. 57. Our sages teach that Hashem always sends the remedy before He sends the affliction. So before He sent us into exile, He prepared the way for us to leave through Yosef HaTzaddik . Because Yosef refused to give in to a slave mentality while in the service of Potifar, he made it possible for Bnei Yisroel to maintain faith in Hashem through centuries of slavery. Yosef HaTzadik was an unshakeable pillar of joy because he knew: " For you will be released from exile through joy ." ( Yishayahu /Isaiah 55:12)

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 018 - Pesachim 54 - Seven Secrets of the Universe - Baruch Shem Kevod - Life After the Final Redemption - Service of the Kohen Gadol - Beit HaMikdash - Anger Causes Forgetfulness
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 018 - Pesachim 54 - 7 Secrets of the Universe - Baruch Shem Kevod - Geulah - Life After the Final Redemption - Service of the Kohen Gadol - Beit HaMikdash - Remembering a Forgotten Halakha - Anger Causes Forgetfulness - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (ey-018. Recorded 1971-01.) 00:00 – HaShem keeps
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 018 - Pesachim 54 - 7 Secrets of the Universe - Baruch Shem Kevod - Geulah - Life After the Final Redemption - Service of the Kohen Gadol - Beit HaMikdash - Remembering a Forgotten Halakha - Anger Causes Forgetfulness - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (ey-018. Recorded 1971-01.) 00:00 – HaShem keeps seven secrets hidden from people so they can function in the world: 1) the day of death, 2) the day of the final redemption, 3) the reason for a mitzvah , 4) the profitability of merchandise, 5) the thoughts of another person, 6) when Malkhus Beis Dovid - the sovereignty of King David - will be restored, and 7) when the reign of evil will cease. 06:45 - Three things were created by HaShem to ensure that life can proceed: the odor of a decaying body, the ability to eventually forget the dead, and the spoilage of food. Some say that belief in money as legal tender is also in this category of creation. 08:26 - When Yaakov Avinu wanted to reveal the secret of the exact time of Moshiach's arrival this information was suddenly withheld from him. How the words of "Shema Yisrael" should be recited. 10:57 - *An allegory about a princess explains why we say the words "Baruch Shem Kevod Malchuso LeOlam Va'ed" quietly. 13:26 - *The Name of HaShem can only be said after two or more words are spoken. 16:09 – At the time of the Second Beit HaMikdash, the Kohen Gadol’s span of service was only about one year while in the First Beit HaMikdash it was longer. Accounts describing different Kohanim Gedolim who served faithfully or not, including an instance of a Kohen who wore gloves and was punished severely by HaShem . 21:00 – When the chief rabbis forgot a law regarding Korban Pesach , Hillel HaZaken reminded them and was then appointed head of the Sanhedrin. Description of an instance when a halakha was forgotten by the rabbis and verified through observing the custom of Am Yisrael . 25:16 – A conceited person will lose his wisdom. If he is a prophet, he will lose his prophecy. For example, Hillel forgot a halakha immediately after rebuking the Sanhedrin, and Devorah HaNeviya was told to "rise and sing", implying that she had fallen by speaking to Am Yisrael in a way that seemed haughty. 27:14 - A person who becomes angry loses his wisdom. A prophet who becomes angry loses his prophecy. For example, at one point Moshe Rabbeinu was unable to state a Torah law because he had been angered, and after speaking a word of anger Elisha HaNavi asked to hear music so his power of prophecy could be restored. 29:26 - Geulah. What life will be like after the final redemption. The sun and the moon will function differently than they do now. 32:57 - In contrast to the Zohar HaKadosh and opinions cited in the Gemara , Shmuel maintains that life will remain the same after the final redemption with only one major difference: Am Yisrael will no longer be subservient to other nations because it will reign over a peaceful world. 42:00 – A foundation of emunah - Jewish faith - is that HaShem will bring the dead back to life and that techiyat hameytim is in the Written Torah. Notes and Indexing by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 018b - Pesachim 75 - Death Penalties - Baal HaBayit - Repentance of Acher - Rav Huna and Laws of Hospitality - Hoshea HaNavi - Malaveh Malka - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1971.) 00:00 - Brief introduction to this series of shiurim . The 4 death penalties meted out by the Sanhedrin . 05:00 - Laws of hospitality: whatever the baal habayit - host - tells a guest to do, the guest must do - with one exception: if the guest is told to leave, he can refuse. Lessons in hospitality, respectful behavior of a guest, and the proper way to drink a full cup of wine are demonstrated through the behavior of Rav Huna . *11:30 - The repentance of Acher and its lesson for every Jew: returning to Hashem is always possible. 17:55 - Several principles of hospitality are illustrated through an account of Rabbi Elazar Bar Shimon Bar Yochai zal . 19:50 - Hoshea HaNavi : the prophet's response to HaShem 's displeasure with Am Yisrael leads to a corrective process. 21:42 - The mitzvah to be fruitful and multiply. 24:06 - Prophets are usually not required to separate from their wives. 26:15 - In what way is the global dispersion of Am Yisrael an example of kindness from HaShem ? 29:41 - Am Yisrael is like a defenseless sheep surrounded by seventy wolves. The sheep is protected by its all-powerful Shepherd - Hashem Yisborach . 30:22 - When a rodent fell into a pot of food in the palace of a king, advice from Rabban Gamliel saved a royal feast. 32:25 - Rabbi Akiva teaches that it's forbidden to eat or drink anything before saying the blessing on wine for havdallah after Shabbat . 36:13 - Enjoying a meal after Shabbat - Malaveh Malka - brings a person the blessing of long life. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 019a - Pesachim 109-112 - Joy on Yom Tov - Success in Life
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Pesachim - Joy on Yom Tov - Success in Life - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - How do we fulfill the mitzvah of rejoicing on a holiday? A man performs this mitzvah through drinking wine, while a woman performs it by wearing new clothing. Midrash about how meat lost its true flavor after the
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Pesachim - Joy on Yom Tov - Success in Life - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - How do we fulfill the mitzvah of rejoicing on a holiday? A man performs this mitzvah through drinking wine, while a woman performs it by wearing new clothing. Midrash about how meat lost its true flavor after the destruction of the Beit HaMikdash . 03:54 - Advice given by Rabbi Akiva to his son, Rabbi Yehoshua : study Torah in a Beit HaMidrash - study hall. Knock before entering a home, even your own home. Never go barefoot but do not wear shoes to bed. 07:45 - Pas shacharis : always eat breakfast. "Breakfast without bread is not considered breakfast." 09:10 - Meals on Shabbat should be at least a little better than weekday meals. Even if funds are limited, it's important to eat fish on Shabbat . 09:44 - Rabbi Akiva advised his son that when forming a business partnership, go into business with someone who is successful. 11:00 - "More than the calf wants to nurse, the cow wants to give milk." A rabbi wants to teach Torah more than the student wants to learn. 13:44 - When teaching Torah, it's best to quote the greatest Rabbi possible. 14:16 - Examine a Torah book carefully for misprints before giving it to your child. Do not marry a divorcee. 17:43 - Rabbi Yishmael and Rabbi Yossi taught Rebbi : do not cause a defect in yourself. Don't gaze at something that's for sale if you have no intention to buy it. The stringency of the laws of niddah - family purity. 20:27 - Do not go out alone at night. The account of how sheydim - demons - were banished from populated areas but can still cause harm in isolated places. 23:50 - Do not live in a city governed by either a talmid chakham or a doctor, or in an unprotected city. Do not marry two wives. If you want to marry more than one wife, marry three. 25:08 - Rav said to Rav Kahana : Do not turn your words inside out - that is: keep your word and speak with honesty. It's better to work at an honest trade, no matter how lowly it may be, than to make a living dishonestly or to beg. Always take food with you on a trip. 26:40 - Rav said to his son, Rabbi Chiya : Do not take any type of narcotics because they are habit forming and can lead to a life of crime. Do not take big steps. Try to save a tooth from being pulled. Avoid confrontation with non-Jews. 28:45 - Advice of Rabbeinu HaKadosh to his sons: don't live in a city where there's too much senseless joking. Don't go to sleep at night without saying Kriyas Shema al ha Mitah . 30:54 - Rabbeinu HaKadosh also advised to obey the laws of the land where one lives or travels through and to pay all taxes and import fees. 31:43 - Rav Papa advised being especially careful to wear shoes in a house where cats are found. Cats bring protection against snakes. 32:42 - Three types of young that should not be confronted: a young non-Jew, a young snake, and a young student. 33:54 - Business advice: sell merchandise as quickly as possible. Don't package the item sold until after you have received payment for it. 35:44 - Rabbi Yochanan said that when going out to battle, stay near the back. This is a reference to "Better to be the tail of a lion than the head of a fox" ( Pirkei Avot 4:15). Edited and Indexed by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 019b - Pesachim 113-119 - Using Money Wisely - 3 Treasures in Egypt
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Pesachim - Life Advice - What Kind of Person Does HaShem Favor? Existing vs. Living - Do Not Go Into Debt - Using Money Wisely - Yosef HaTzaddik Hid 3 Treasures in Egypt - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - A father's primary concern is to marry off his daughter as soon as possible. Life advi
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Pesachim - Life Advice - What Kind of Person Does HaShem Favor? Existing vs. Living - Do Not Go Into Debt - Using Money Wisely - Yosef HaTzaddik Hid 3 Treasures in Egypt - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - A father's primary concern is to marry off his daughter as soon as possible. Life advice: Do not leave town to earn extra money. 04:03 - Rabbi Yochanan said: 3 inherit Olam Haba : those who live in Eretz Israel , those who raise their children to learn Torah, and those who make Havdalah on wine. One who walks four steps in Eretz Yisrael becomes part of Gan Eden . 05:50 - Rabbi Yochanan taught: HaShem is proud of 3 kinds of people: an unmarried man who doesn't sin with women, a poor man who returns a lost item, and a rich man who gives his ma'aser - tithe - secretly. 09:39 - What kind of person does HaShem favor? One who never lose his temper, one who doesn't get drunk, and one who forgives easily. 3 kinds of people disliked by HaShem : those who are insincere, those who refuse to testify when they can defend or support a friend, and those who speak Loshon Hara about a friend by becoming a solitary witness. 12:47 - תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן, שְׁלֹשָׁה חַיֵּיהֶן אֵינָם חַיִּים: הָרַחְמָנִין, וְהָרַתְחָנִין, וַאֲנִינֵי הַדַּעַת. Three kinds of people whose lives are not considered their own: those who are too kindhearted, those who are temperamental, and those without peace of mind. 14:08 - 4 kinds of people are intolerable: a person who lacks wisdom but has conceit, a wealthy person who lies to make a small profit, an old man who sins with women, and a leader who is needlessly demanding on the community he leads. 17:05 - Those who are put in cherem - excommunication - by Heaven: a man who doesn't try to get married, a man who doesn't do whatever is in his power to have children, a man who doesn't provide his children with a Torah education, a man who doesn't put on tefillin or tzitzit , those who don't put mezuzot on their doors, and those who go barefoot. 20:03 – It's preferable to invest more in one's home than in food. פְּחוֹת מִמֵּיכְלָךְ וּמִמִּשְׁתְּיָךְ, וְתוֹסֵיף עַל דֵּירְתָךְ *23:02 - "It's better to be in debt to oneself for a luxury than to go into debt in order to indulge in a luxury." Stay out of debt. 23:32 - The difference between Mizmor l'Dovid and L'Dovid Mizmor . The Shekhina - Divine Presence - only rests on a person who wastes no words and who is happy. Rabbah would always begin a Torah shiur with a lighthearted comment. ( Pesachim 117a). 25:50 - Hodu Lashem ki tov . Examples of Hashem goodness. *27:05 – The challenge of parnassah - livelihood: Rabbi Yochanan said: קָשִׁין מְזוֹנוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם יוֹתֵר מִן הַגְּאוּלָּה ( Pesachim 118a). The word "oy" . Tehillim 20 has 70 words c'neged the 70 screams of a woman in childbirth. 29:23 - וֶאֱמֶת ה׳ לְעוֹלָם - "...and Hashem's Truth endures forever" ( Tehillim 117) was said by the malach Gavriel when we rescued Chananiah, Mishael, and Azariah from the fiery furnace. 31:55 - Lamenatzeach mizmor le’David. What is the meaning of "to the victor"? HaShem is happy to be defeated when a repentant person convinces Him to forgive. 34:34 - Yosef HaTzaddik hid three treasures in Mitzrayim . Korach’s wealth. ( Pesachim 119a). Wealth can destroy its owner, so it's important to use money wisely. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 020a Pesachim 119 - Yuma - Dovid HaMelech - Kos Shel Bracha of Moshiach - Tefillin - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1971.) 00:00 - Avraham Avinu, Yitzchak Avinu, Yaakov Avinu and Moshe Rabbeinu will each decline the Kos Shel Bracha in the time of Moshiach . Dovid Hamelech will accept the Kos Shel Bracha . 04:41 - The midrash describes a tunnel from the grave site of Moshe Rabbeinu to Kever HaMachpeleh , the grave site of the Avos in Eretz Yisrael . 06:22 - Four reasons why Dovid HaMelech accepted the honor of Kos Shel Bracha . 09:07 - The Zohar HaKadosh brings that the letters אדם - man - stand for Adam, Dovid , Moshiach . 17:35 - Kos is begematria Elokim . 18:58 - It's good to be silent, except for speaking words of Torah. 21:41 - A man must always be conscious of the tefilin when he wears them. This is similar to the commandment given to the Kohen Gadol when he is wearing the tzitz - head adornment engraved with HaShem's Name. 24:24 - Comparison of Am Yisrael during the First vs. the Second Beis HaMikdash . 27:18 - Rabbi Yochanan ben Torta - "Son of an Ox" - a story from the Gemara about the origin of his unusual name. 31:14 - Rabbi Shimon Reish Lakish and Rabba Bar Chana . 33:56 - The importance of simcha - joy. The Arizal told his students that the reason he was able to reach spiritual heights was his performance of mitzvot with joy. 34:42 - A man should not travel from his home.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l

(Recorded ca. 1971.) 00:00 - The importance of attributing a Torah concept to its originator. When the source is mention
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 020b - Yuma 19 - Halakha in the Name of its Source - Laws of Kriyat Shema - Amidah Is Said Silently - Voice of the Kohen Gadol - Sound of the Sun - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1971.) 00:00 - The importance of attributing a Torah concept to its originator. When the source is mentioned, the soul of the speaker is merged with the soul of the source. 02:50 - *A person must sit or stand in one place when saying the first paragraph of the Shema . 04:21 - Halakha - Torah Law - concerning the recitation of the Shema aloud. The obligation to say the words of the Shemoneh Esrei in absolute silence, but the lips must move. 07:12 - Why has Moshiach not already arrived, given the purity that Am Yisrael achieved through Yom Kippur ? 10:08 - The gematria of Satan is 364, illustrating that the Satan has no power over one day of the year: Yom Kippur . 13:41 - The procedure each day for announcing the time when the services in the Beit HaMikdash would begin. 19:03 - The voice of the Kohen Gadol was so powerful that it carried all the way from Yerushalayim to Yericho . 22:07 - *Sound be heard more clearly by night than by day because during the day, the sound of the sun interferes with all other sounds. 23:28 - *3 sounds heard throughout the world. 25:47 - The sound of the screams of childbirth also carry throughout the world. 26:32 - Miracles of the Beit HaMikdash . Five things that existed in the First Beit HaMikdash that did not exist in the Second. 27:47 - Keruvim means "like children". The miraculous dimensions of the Aron Kodesh , which existed above the concept of space. 29:49 - The miraculous aspects of the fire on the altar of the First Beit HaMikdash . 31:04 - 6 types of fire.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 021a - Yuma 22 - Shaul HaMelech - Avraham Avinu Kept All the Mitzvot - Teshuvah - Remorse for Deeds but Not for Actions
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 021a - Yuma 22 - Shaul HaMelech - Avraham Avinu Kept All the Mitzvot - How Could Yaakov Avinu Marry 2 Sisters? Imagining a Sin - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal (Recorded ca. 1971). 00:00 - Shaul HaMelech . 08:50 - Why was Shaul HaMelech punished for remaining silent instead of protecting his honor as
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 021a - Yuma 22 - Shaul HaMelech - Avraham Avinu Kept All the Mitzvot - How Could Yaakov Avinu Marry 2 Sisters? Imagining a Sin - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal (Recorded ca. 1971). 00:00 - Shaul HaMelech . 08:50 - Why was Shaul HaMelech punished for remaining silent instead of protecting his honor as King of Am Yisrael ? 18:26 - Avraham Avinu obeyed every mitzvah in the Torah. 24:30 - The moment of conversion to Judaism is like the moment of birth. A ger is no longer related to his family of origin. 25:50 - Amram and Yocheved . Moshe Rabbeinu and Miryam HaNaviyah . 30:45 - Teshuvah . Imagining committing a sin is even worse than committing it. When a person commits a sin, he is later moved to teshuvah through a sense of remorse. This yearning to return to HaShem and to correct one's errors does not occur after imagining a sin. 32:30 - The heat at the end of the summer is worse than the heat of the summer itself. 35:10 - There are 3 types of people who are judged in Gan Eden: a pauper who didn't learn Torah, a rich man who didn't learn Torah, and someone who commits sins of znus .

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 025b - Yuma 86 - Sukkah - No Sin Is Beyond the Power of Teshuvah
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 025b - Yuma 86 - Sukkah - No Sin Is Beyond the Power of Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - When a person returns to HaShem and His Torah, the mistakes of the past can be turned into mitzvot . 01:55 - When a person commits a sin, he creates an accusing angel. When a person regrets a s
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 025b - Yuma 86 - Sukkah - No Sin Is Beyond the Power of Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - When a person returns to HaShem and His Torah, the mistakes of the past can be turned into mitzvot . 01:55 - When a person commits a sin, he creates an accusing angel. When a person regrets a sin, the evil is removed from that angel. 03:46 - What is teshuvah ? 05:31 - The greatest leaders of Israel were Moshe Rabbeinu and Dovid HaMelech . Both made an error that caused them to be punished by HaShem . Even though these were not actual sins, each one's mistake in judgement teaches us about the nature of teshuvah . Why did Moshe ask HaShem to publicize his mistake, while Dovid asked HaShem to hide his? 11:32 - It's important to honor HaShem in private to at least the same degree that we honor Him in public. 12:41 - One who encourages others to Torah observance is protected from sin. In contrast, one who misleads others in their service of HaShem is not given the chance to repent. 14:55 - As Dovid HaMelech says: כִּי׀ לֹא־תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל לֹא־תִתֵּן חֲסִידְךָ לִרְאוֹת שָׁחַת - " You will not let Your follower(s) go down to the netherworld " ( Tehillim 16:10). Although in this phrase the word "follower" is written as plural, it is read as singular. This hidden meaning supports the concept that a teacher is protected by the good he instills in his students. 16:22 - Tosefot speaks about Acher , who was a great scholar yet turned away from the Torah and became an atheist. He was misled when he saw a boy climb a tree to fulfill the mitzvah of "sending away the mother bird" - a mitzvah which is rewarded by "length of days" yet the boy fell and was killed. 17:07 - There are two mitzvot for which the reward is longevity - Shiluach HaKen and Kibud Av VaEm . The most difficult mitzvah in the entire Torah is Kibud Av VaEm - respecting one's parents. The easiest: "sending away the mother bird." The reward for both of these mitzvot is the same: "length of days". 19:26 - Why was Acher punished in the next world if his student, Rabbi Meir , was a tzaddik ? Acher's mistake was to think that arichat yomim (length of days) means chronological time in the present material world, when it actually refers to spiritual reward in the next world, beyond the limits of time. "Long life" does not mean life on this earth. 23:25 - *A person who says "I will sin and then repent" and then repeats this sin is in danger of not being given the chance to repent. Similarly, a person who says "I will sin and Yom Kippur will atone" is not forgiven by means of Yom Kippur . Sins that are between man and man are not forgiven until the person seeks forgiveness from the person against whom he sinned. מַיִם־גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ - "Stolen waters are sweet..." ( Mishlei 9:17). 28:10 - No sin is beyond the power of teshuvah . The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh interprets the words of chazal in a positive light: that a person is always given the chance to repent, no matter how grave their wrongdoing. 30:03 - Resolving issues between man and man is debated by chazal . Rabbi Yirmiyahu seeks forgiveness from Rabbi Abba but endures disgrace. Rabbi Yirmiyahu prayed: "As is said Tehillim : 'HaShem elevates a poor person from a garbage heap...' so let this come true for me!" 34:25 - The Arizal says that Rav, the Chief Rabbi of Syria, was really Rabbi Abba , student of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . He served as the scribe who wrote down the Zohar Hakadosh as given over by Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai . When he tried to make peace with a a butcher who was disrespectful, he was insulted further. As a result, the butcher was suddenly killed in a work accident. 36:40 - Rav asks forgiveness of his student, Rabbi Chanina , 12 times over 12 years, but the student refused to make peace. Normally we only ask forgiveness 3 times. But Rav would not give up. It turned out that Rabbi Chanina was stubborn on this point in order to prolong his own life. 39:50 - Confessing a sin is not enough to atone, there must also be teshuvah . True teshuvah is accomplished through leaving the sin completely and not ever repeating it. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 028b - Beitzah 24 - Rosh Hashanah - Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 09:18 - Story of Shabtai bar Marinus - cruelty is a sign that a person is not a descendant of Avraham Avinu . 10:57 - Three types of lives that are not worth living: a person who has to ask to be a guest
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 028b - Beitzah 24 - Rosh Hashanah - Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 09:18 - Story of Shabtai bar Marinus - cruelty is a sign that a person is not a descendant of Avraham Avinu . 10:57 - Three types of lives that are not worth living: a person who has to ask to be a guest, a person who suffers a chronic illness, and a man whose wife dominates him. Through Torah study and tefilah a person can transform reality, no matter how difficult. 15:26 - תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר - "Sound the shofar at the New Moon..." ( Tehillim 81:4). Astronomical calculations of the lunar calendar. Why is Rosh Hashanah at the new moon? 27:26 - When was the world created, Tishrei or Nissan ? Debate between Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol and Rabbi Yehoshua . 32:22 - HaShem created man through one individual to show that one who saves just one life is considered as if he saved the entire world. Man is called Olam Katan . 37:12 - BIOGRAPHY - Rabbi Rosenfeld describes his first encounter with Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal , the great-grandson of Rav Noson of Nemirov zal and grandson of Rav Nachman Tscherin zal , author of Parpaorot leChochma . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 038b - Sefer HaMidot - Overview and Selected Topics
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 038b - Sefer HaMidot , also known as "The Aleph-Beit Book", is a collection of insights and segulot - Torah-based remedies - brought by Rebbe Nachman of Breslov from the Talmud and other traditional sources. lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 038b - Sefer HaMidot , also known as "The Aleph-Beit Book", is a collection of insights and segulot - Torah-based remedies - brought by Rebbe Nachman of Breslov from the Talmud and other traditional sources. Arranged alphabetically, it explores the hidden spiritual network underlying the physical world through which one action or element affects and/or activates another. Rebbe Nachman reveals some of these causes and effects to enable his students to come closer to HaShem and to serve Him through performance of His mitzvot . Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Introduction. 01:00 - A truthful person can detect honesty in others. 01:55 - The presence of many insects flying in a house indicates a lack of ahava in that house. 02:37 - A person should not say that something is "co-incidence" because this implies a lack of faith that all is through HaShem's providence. 02:56 - The words of a heretic are harmful to the soul. 03:33 - Moshiach will come suddenly and the joy will be so great that Am Yisrael will be shocked. 04:08 - Segulah to dispel insomnia: concentrate on techiyat hameitim - revival of the dead. 04:49 - A person should not worry about the future parnassah - livelihood - of his children. 05:11 - If a daughter is the first-born in a family, the Ayin Hara - evil eye/jealousy - will have no power over any of the children in that family. 05:53 - A person should not enter an uninhabited house because it might contain sheydim - destructive spirits. 06:59 - To assure good fortune, the first thing a person should bring into a new home is a knife or a sword. 07:23 - If a person must borrow and must put up an item for security, it's a sign that he misused this item in the past. 08:00 - It's a mitzvah to publicize the names of people who do evil. 08:23 - One who is accustomed to giving good news will never suffer pain in his feet or legs. 08:40 - Gazing up at the sky can help bring a person to tears, which originate in the separation of the upper waters from the lower waters at the time of creation. 09:50 - A person can reduce his arrogance by looking up at the sky. 10:20 - If a person benefits from theft, his misdeed will be revealed. 10:35 - The more physical strength a person has, the less his depth of wisdom. 10:57 - Taking long strides reduces concentration. 11:12 - A person's time and place of death is predestined. 12:26 - If a person falls, this nullifies a decree against him and saves his life. 12:46 - Harsh judgements can be mitigated through immersing in a mikveh . 13:32 - A person should listen carefully when a friend shares his troubles, because the listener can learn about how to improve his own midot - character traits. 13:52 - If a person can solve something through money rather than prayer, he should do so. 14:27 - Keeping a dog in one's house arouses harsh judgements, unless the dog serves a purpose. 15:17 - Two people with the same name should not live in the same house. 15:35 - Segulah for winning a court case: reading the section about the korbonot - sacrifices - brought on Shabbat and Yom Tovim in Parshat Pinchas ( Bamidbar 28:1-29:39, Pinchas ). 16:19 - Wearing the belt of a tzaddik helps eliminate bad thoughts. 16:30 - One who divorces his wife will not be successful in life. 17:04 - Segulah for a woman who is childless: 1) she should carry a small magnet with her, and 2) she should look at the blood on the knife used to perform a brit milah . 18:14 - The fact that two people meet and speak is an aspect of shidduch . 18:57 - Whenever a person tries to instill yirat shemayim through speaking with a friend, he becomes the author of a sefer that is written down in shemayim . 19:26 - Staring at an etrog is a cure for any pain in the eyes. 19:46 - Even if a government is run by non-Jews, the ruling power should be respected. 20:19 - Studying Torah, even if done when half asleep, is still beneficial. 21:32 - It's forbidden to teach a chiddush - Torah innovation - to a person who does evil. 24:50 - If an evil person speaks the truth, it's permissible to refute him. 26:10 - If a person has an itch, it's a sign he has enemies. 30:14 - Do not speak words of mussar - spiritual rebuke - to a Jew who has converted to another religion. 32:25 - By doing even a small favor for a tzaddik a person can gain Olam Haba - eternal reward. 35:01 - *** Tikkun haguf kodem latikkun hanefesh - healing the physical body precedes healing the soul. 35:54 - Clothing is called the honor of a person. A person should dress properly for tefilah in order to insure that his prayers will be accepted. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 040a - Taanit 26 - 17th of Tammuz - Bein HaMetzarim - Why Just 3 Weeks? Tisha B'Av
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 040a - Taanit 26 - 17th of Tammuz - Bein HaMetzarim - Why Just 3 Weeks? Tisha B'Av - Rabban Gamliel - Bar Kokhva - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Tammuz - Av - Introduction: Fast days - 17th of Tammuz , Tisha B’Av . 00:31 - The 3 Weeks - time of mourning for the destruction of the first and
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 040a - Taanit 26 - 17th of Tammuz - Bein HaMetzarim - Why Just 3 Weeks? Tisha B'Av - Rabban Gamliel - Bar Kokhva - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Tammuz - Av - Introduction: Fast days - 17th of Tammuz , Tisha B’Av . 00:31 - The 3 Weeks - time of mourning for the destruction of the first and second Beit HaMikdash . 00:44 - Bein HaMetzarim - Halakhos . Rebbe Nachman speaks about Bein HaMetzarim - 3 Weeks only. 04:12 - Fruit trees. The connection between an egg, the produce of a Luz tree, and Bein HaMetzarim . 05:44 - Word Luz means both "nut" and "bone" - alluding to Techiyat HaMeytim . 06:37 - Egg/death and Luz/Techiyat HaMeytim correspond to Bein HaMetzarim - a 21-day period. 06:58 - Bein HaMetzarim - reminder of life and hope. 08:26 - Five sad occurrences on the 17th of Tammuz . First: the Luchot were broken by Moshe Rabbeinu . The broken Luchot brought forgetfulness of Torah. 09:57 - Second tragedy of 17th of Tammuz - decree against the daily offering of the Korban Tamid . 10:35 - Siddur Course. Importance of Korban Tamid erasing sins because they are a crushing weight for the neshama to carry. 12:52 - Reasons for fasting on the 17th of Tammuz - third reason: Walls of Yerushalayim were breached by the enemy. Fourth reason: Greek leader Apostomus burned a Sefer Torah. Fifth reason: a Tzelem - idol - placed in the Heichal of the Beis HaMikdash . 14:12 - Tisha B’Av - the fast and its five commemorations. First occurrence: Decree of death in the desert after spies returned to Eretz Yisrael . Zohar HaKadosh : Sin of lashon hara against Eretz Yisrael includes speaking and listening. 16:17 - 40 days spying the Land and 40 years wandering in desert. On Tisha B’Av Am Yisrael received the decree of not entering Eretz Yisrael until after they wandered. Zohar HaKadosh : learn lesson from speaking lashon hara against the Land of earth and rocks. 17:57 - Tisha B’Av - Decree against entering Eretz Yisrael , destruction of first Beit HaMikdash and second Beit HaMikdash . 19:11 - Beitar as stronghold after destruction of second Beit HaMikdash . 19:57 - Bar Kokhva’s leadership and revolt against the Romans. Rabbi Akiva’s belief Bar Kokhva is the Moshiach . 21:35 - Tests to join Bar Kokhva army. Bar Kokhva’s fatal error and downfall. 24:50 - Bar Kokhva’s downfall. הֲלֹא אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ 26:43 - Bar Kokhva’s holy uncle, Rabbi Elazar HaModai . 27:03 - Tzaddik Course. Purity and greatness of Rabbi Elazar HaModai’s tefilah . 27:28 - Conspiracy against Rabbi Elazar HaModai by the Romans. 29:06 - False accusation against Rabbi Elazar HaModai . Bar Kokhva's punishment. 30:30 - Beitar - on Tu b’Av the dead of Beitar were brought to burial. Berakha HaTov v’haMeitiv in Birkat HaMazon instituted for burial of dead of Beitar. 32:34 - Fourth and fifth reasons for Tisha B’Av fast: Beitar’s fall, conquest and no burial for dead on this day. Destruction of Yerushalayim . 33:40 - Good messengers are sent to convey good news, bad messengers are sent to convey bad news. A messenger can be an angel or a person. Example. 36:27 - מגלגלין זכות על ידי זכאי וחוב על ידי חייב - “Something good … brought about through one who is pure … evil is done through an evil person”. Evil happens on a day of evil. Tisha B’Av was chosen as a messenger of sadness for many incidents. For example, the First World War began on Tisha B’Av . 38:17 - Destruction of second Holy Temple on Tisha B'Av . Day of fasting commemorated when suffering/punishment begins. Tenth day - half way through - mourning ends. 40:26 - Rabi Natan - no matter how severe the punishment, there's always hope. Moshiach born on Tisha B'Av , hope even at the darkest hour. Hisbodedus Course. When things seem darkest for Am Yisrael , real light will shine. Rabban Gamliel , Nasi , and Sanhedrin summoned for death. 41:38 - Roman officer calls Rabban Gamliel “The Master of the Nose” meaning leadership - nose leads body. Rabbi Gamliel promises Gan Eden to Roman officer who wanted to do something good. 44:54 - Kohanim believed they had failed as gatekeepers returned the keys of Heichal to HaShem . A Hand came down from Heaven and collected keys. Young Kohanim took their own lives by jumping into the flames of the burning Beit HaMikdash . 46:08 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by M.S. Berger and S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 36 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 135. Recorded 1992-05-31.) PARAGRAPH 3. When saying the first verse of the Kriyas Shema , we close our eyes to accept the Ohl Malchus Shemayim - Yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven. PARAGRAPH 4. New souls are created when a person arrives at a chiddush (new revelation of Torah).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 36 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 138. Recorded 1992-06-21.) PARAGRAPH 6. The light of HaShem is differentiated and perceived according to the capacity of the vessel receiving that light. Bilaam advised Balak to entice the People of Israel with immorality in order to to harm Israel's perception
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 36 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 138. Recorded 1992-06-21.) PARAGRAPH 6. The light of HaShem is differentiated and perceived according to the capacity of the vessel receiving that light. Bilaam advised Balak to entice the People of Israel with immorality in order to to harm Israel's perception of HaShem's light. PARAGRAPH 7. בִּקְרֹ֥ב עָלַ֨י | מְרֵעִים֘ לֶֽאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת־בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹֽיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֜֗מָּה כָּֽשְׁל֥וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ - "When evildoers approach to consume my flesh, they are the ones who stumble and fall." ( Tehillim 27:2) PARAGRAPH 8. Saying the Shema protects a person from thoughts of immorality, and crying out to HaShem 70 times enables him to perceive Torah that was previously hidden from him. Concept of " Tzaphnat-Paneyach " - the name given to Yosef HaTzaddik in Egypt.

Recorded 1992-12-13.) Review of Likutey Moharan 41 - Part 1. PARAGRAPH 3b. Filling the throats of Torah scholars with wine ( Yoma 71a). The word גרון
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 41 - Part 2 - Torah Scholars Promote Peace - Likutey Moharan 42 - Song Mitigates Dinim - Rainbow - Zechus Avos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 147. Recorded 1992-12-13.) Review of Likutey Moharan 41 - Part 1. PARAGRAPH 3b. Filling the throats of Torah scholars with wine ( Yoma 71a). The word גרון - throat - is begematria 3 times Elokim - Midas HaDin . Talmidei chokhomim are compared to Netzach and Hod . Wine given to Talmidei Chokhamim is an aspect of pouring a wine libation in the Beis HaMikdash . Q&R about the order of Likutey Tefilos . TORAH 42. PARAGRAPH 1. וַיַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֜שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם - "And He looked upon their distress when He heard their song..." ( Tehillim 106:44). Judgement is mitigated through song. When the Shekhina dresses in radiant garments, HaShem's judgement is abated. Q&R about the colors of the rainbow. Q&R about how the elements of creation correspond to the Avos . Back inside text: Rashi on "...when He heard their song..." . Zechus Avos . Q&R about why whistling is not considered song. PARAGRAPH 2. The rainbow and Zechus Avos . PARAGRAPH 3. PARAGRAPH 4. The letter Shin has 3 branches. PARAGRAPH 5. אֵ֣ין אֹ֖מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֜לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם - "There is neither speech nor words; their voice is not heard" ( Tehillim 19:4). Q&R about the colors of the rainbow and the kol shofar .

The song of the future is an aspect of the name Sarah, which signifies Malkhut (sovereignty). Sarah is also an aspect of Sukkah . 11:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Teshuvah - repentance - is related to Shabbos. Tishrei and Nissan are two beginnings . 25:06 - PARAGRAPH 7. Tzitzis and Tekheles - sky-blue - are aspects of Malkhus - sovereignty - and a Kallah (bride). lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 61 - Unworthy Leaders and Unfit Rabbis - The Connection between Smicha (Rabbinic Ordination) and Writing - Why the Wisdom of Astrology was Taken Away from Am Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 197. Recorded in 1980.) *05:03 - PARAGRAPH 2. "There are leaders who are called rabbi, whose teachi
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 61 - Unworthy Leaders and Unfit Rabbis - The Connection between Smicha (Rabbinic Ordination) and Writing - Why the Wisdom of Astrology was Taken Away from Am Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 197. Recorded in 1980.) *05:03 - PARAGRAPH 2. "There are leaders who are called rabbi, whose teachings are rooted in waste matter . Although they can't even guide themselves, as explained , and even more so are incapable of guiding others, nevertheless they assert themselves to lead others. One must be careful not confer authority on them, or strengthen and empower them... because by conferring authority on an unworthy rabbi, the writing of our hand is weakened and has no force.. Instead, we strengthen the writings of the 70 Nations..." 06:15 - These unworthy leaders simply have a desire for Kovod . Their teachers have the responsibility to keep them in check. 08:40 - Smicha and writing both originate from the same spiritual root. 19:48 - By conferring authority to an unworthy rabbi, Am Yisrael is driven out of Eretz Yisrael . 21:50 - The power of Csav Yad . Spiritual aspects of writing. 24:33 - PARAGRAPH 3. As a result of conferring authority on unworthy leaders, the wisdom of astrology was taken away from Am Yisrael .

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Moed Katan - The Mitzvah of Aveilut - Mourning - Parah Adumah - Sages Describe Death - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . It is sinful to make light of the mitzvah of aveilut - mourning the death of a close relative. Parah Adumah . Just before his passing, Rava asks his brother, Rav Sorum , to intercede with the Angel of Death. The Amora , Rav Nachman zal returned in a dream after his passing to describe his moment of death. Rav Sheshet and the Malach HaMavet . Rav Ashi saw the angel of death in the market place.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 042b - Moed Katan - Chagiga - Lech LeShalom vs. Lech BeShalom - Chezkiyah Melech Yehudah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - One says "Lech LeShalom" when bidding farewell to a living friend, and "Lech BeShalom" to bid farewell to a person who was niftar . "A wise person is he who remains silent." When Shaul HaMelech summoned Shmuel HaNavi back from the dead, Moshe Rabbeinu came with him. The tears of Rabbi Elazar - how the account applies to us today. Rav Yosef asks if a person can die before his time and the sages bring a case to show it can happen. Angels can make mistakes. Makhloket between Rabbi Akiva and the chokhamim about the case of Chezkiyah Melech Yehudah . Rabbi Akiva's question about Moshe Rabbeinu striking the rock. Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 044b - Chagiga 14 - The 5 Students of Rabbi Yochanan Ben Zakai - Kabbalah Study in Our Time - 4 Who Entered Pardes - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . - The 5 students of Rabbi Yochanan Ben Zakai . - Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananya was known as the greatest of all rabbis. - Heaven rejoices when the Kabbalah is studied properly. - The three primary colors of the rainbow represents the 3 Avos . - Story of the 4 Who Entered Pardes - Garden. - Truth is always one. - Why were the meraglim believed? lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 045b - Yerushalmi Shabbat 3 - Chronology of the Oral Torah from Rav Ashi Back to Moshe Rabbeinu - 3 Mitzvot Especially Entrusted to Women - 7 Earths
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 045b - Yerushalmi Shabbat 3 - Chronology of the Oral Torah from Rav Ashi Back to Moshe Rabbeinu - 3 Mitzvot Especially Entrusted to Women - 7 Earths - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . - 276 Tannaim and 1932 Amoraim are recorded in the Oral Torah. - Chronology of the Oral Torah from Rav Ashi back to M
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 045b - Yerushalmi Shabbat 3 - Chronology of the Oral Torah from Rav Ashi Back to Moshe Rabbeinu - 3 Mitzvot Especially Entrusted to Women - 7 Earths - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . - 276 Tannaim and 1932 Amoraim are recorded in the Oral Torah. - Chronology of the Oral Torah from Rav Ashi back to Moshe Rabbeinu . - The Talmud Yerushalmi was compiled by Rabbi Yochanan . - Achiya Shiloni's rabbi was Dovid HaMelech . - 3 mitzvot are especially entrusted to women. - The mitzvah of separating a portion from challah . - The second mitzvah entrusted to women is niddah . - The third mitzvah entrusted to women is lighting the Shabbat and Yom Tov lights. - Why were these mitzvot given to women? - How the mitzvah of separating challah is a tikkun for the sin of Adam and Chava. - Honoring Torah scholarship takes preference over honoring noble ancestry. - Reish Lakish . - כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי חָלֶד - "...inhabitants of the earth..." ( Tehillim 49:2). - There are 7 earths. The one where man lives is called "Tevel" . - The other earths in creation are also inhabited. - Why the earth where men live is also called חלד. - The word חולדה means weasel. - Every creature found on land has a counterpart in the sea - except for the weasel. The existence of mermen is mentioned in the Oral Torah . - The weasel hoards. - The grandson of Rabbi Yeshua ben Levi died after being cured through avoda zara . - בְּנֵי אִמִּי נִחֲרוּ־בִי שָׂמֻנִי נֹטֵרָה אֶת־הַכְּרָמִים כַּרְמִי שֶׁלִּי לֹא נָטָרְתִּי - "...my mother's sons were incensed against me; they made me a keeper of the vineyards; my own vineyard I did not keep" ( Shir HaShirim 1:6). - Second day Yom Tov observed outside Eretz Yisrael is a punishment. - When a man visits his rabbi it is as if he is visiting the Shekhina . - Eliyahu HaNavi said "I stood before HaShem ". - Serving a rabbi is more important than learning Torah from him. - Shmuel HaNavi served Eli . - Noach used a gemstone in the Teva to determine day and night. - The greatest charity is to pay the ransom of a Jewish captive. - Every person should have a monument over his grave. - The monuments of tzaddikim are their mitzvot . - The physical monuments for tzaddikim benefit those who visit their gravesites. - A tzaddik is considered alive even after he passes away. Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 63b - Gittin 56 - The 3 Weeks - Titus Was a Direct Descendant of Esav - Beit HaMikdash - Kamtza and Bar Kamtza
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Gittin - Bein HaMetzarim - The 3 Weeks - Tisha B'Av - Titus Was a Direct Descendant of Esav - Beis HaMikdash - Kamtza and Bar Kamtza - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Historical background for the mourning period of Bein HaMetzarim - The 3 Weeks - and the destruction of the second Beis HaMikdash .
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Gittin - Bein HaMetzarim - The 3 Weeks - Tisha B'Av - Titus Was a Direct Descendant of Esav - Beis HaMikdash - Kamtza and Bar Kamtza - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Historical background for the mourning period of Bein HaMetzarim - The 3 Weeks - and the destruction of the second Beis HaMikdash . 00:00 - *In his opening remarks, Rabbi Rosenfeld mentions that this lesson would be good to listen to on the Fast of Tisha b'Av . 00:36 - When Aspanyanus (Vespasian) became emperor and had to return to Rome, he assigned Titus HaRasha (the Evil Titus) to continue the siege of Yerushalayim . Titus was a direct descendant of Esav and began an attack against HaShem by profaning the Beis HaMikdash . When he later voyaged back to Rome, the sea all around his ship rose up, on its own, to defend the honor of HaShem . 04:33 - The greatness of Pinchas . 05:55 - Titus was punished by HaShem through a worm that entered his brain. As it grew, his suffering increased. 11:50 - Onkelus the Ger consults with three souls who are in Gehinnam , asking each of them "Who is considered the most worthy in Heaven?" 15:37 - Onkelus calls upon Bilaam . 20:17 - The process of the gradual revelation of the Zohar HaKadosh over generations. The ARIzal reveals that Bilaam was reincarnated as Naval . 22:24 - Onkelus brings up the soul of "the unmentionable one". 25:16 - The destruction of Yerushalayim followed as a result of the incident between Kamtza and Bar Kamtza . Embarrassing a person in public is a very great sin. 26:45 - The massacre of thousands of Jews in Tur Malka through the incident of a rooster and a hen. 28:52 - The sincere prayer of even an evil person is accepted by HaShem . 34:59 - *Why Eretz Yisrael is called Eretz HaTzvi (Land of the Deer). Miracles of the Beit HaMikdash - there was always room for everyone.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 64a - Gittin 57 - The 3 Weeks - Jewish Heroism
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Gittin - The 3 Weeks - Jewish Heroism - HaKol Kol Yaakov - Music in Olam HaBah - Music Course - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . The era of the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . Despite the fact that exile was decreed, many great men, women, and children willingly sacrificed their lives to remain
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Gittin - The 3 Weeks - Jewish Heroism - HaKol Kol Yaakov - Music in Olam HaBah - Music Course - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . The era of the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . Despite the fact that exile was decreed, many great men, women, and children willingly sacrificed their lives to remain loyal to HaShem and His Torah. 00:00 - *The blood of Zechariah HaNavi boiled up from the earth to be avenged. When the Roman general responsible for the murder of millions of Jews realized the horror of his actions, he abandoned his past and converted to Judaism. The fact that his repentance was accepted is a powerful lesson about never falling into despair. 10:52 - Three different dimensions of the concept HaKol Kol Yaakov - "The voice is the voice of Yaakov" with regard to the suffering of Am Yisroel throughout history. 15:07 - MUSIC COURSE. The central importance of music in Torah understanding and observance as described in Likutey Halakhos . A description of the "angel with a thousand tongues" and the beauty of the music in Olam HaBa . 22:23 - Jewish youths preserved their purity by jumping off the ships carrying them to slavery in Rome. Why was this not considered suicide? 24:37 - Chanah and her seven sons sacrifice their lives to uphold the honor of HaShem . 29:52 - The heroism of Rabbi Yishmael's son and daughter. 33:59 - The spark that ultimately led to the destruction and exile - a student who stole the wife of his teacher. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 066a - Sotah 2 - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Repairing anger and גַּאֲוָה - and ga'ava - arrogance/conceit/pride. 00:00 - HaShem as Matchmaker. When the Yam Suf was split, all the waters of earth were split from one into two. Creating a zivug - husband and wife - is as difficult as splitting Yam
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 066a - Sotah 2 - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Repairing anger and גַּאֲוָה - and ga'ava - arrogance/conceit/pride. 00:00 - HaShem as Matchmaker. When the Yam Suf was split, all the waters of earth were split from one into two. Creating a zivug - husband and wife - is as difficult as splitting Yam Suf . 06:52 - A husband and wife were originally one soul. Marriage unifies the soul because it was divided into two before birth. 07:51 - A man is given a wife who matches his spiritual level ( Sotah 2a) yet 40 days before the forming of a male child, his zivug is announced in Heaven. How is this seeming contradiction resolved in a way that recognizes free will? 11:28 - Another question arises concerning this announcement at the moment of his conception. Before a man marries he should have a home and a livelihood. 13:06 - The most important day in a man's life is the day of his marriage, because that's when he becomes a complete person. On his wedding day, a chatan - groom - receives a complete pardon for all the sins of his lifetime until then. 13:50 - No person commits a sin when he is in his right mind. 17:52 - * "Never give up hope!" - Rebbe Nachman. 20:07 - *Infidelity or anger destroys a home. A husband's anger vs. the anger of a wife - the Torah does not consider these two types of anger to be the same. 23:05 - If a man strikes his wife - the mandatory punishment is cherem . Beit Din is not permitted to be lenient. 23:32 - The punishment of cherem - excommunication - is a curse that penetrates all 248 parts of the body. Beis Din is obligated to put that man in cherem . 25:00 - Ga'ava - arrogance/conceit/pride is worse than worshiping idols because it is worship of self. 26:05 - A mitzvah is forever and acts as a person's defense in Olam HaBa . 27:19 - A sin becomes an accusing force in Olam HaBa'ah . Why a sin compared to a dog. 29:35 - *The mitzvah d'rabanan of netilat yadayim l'seudah - ritual washing before eating bread, which is also called mayim rishonim - "first waters". The first three letters of "al netilat yadayim" are ayin, noon, yud which spell oni - impoverished. One who is careful to wash his hands with a blessing before eating bread is protected from poverty. 32:00 - HaShem is more particular on the observance of mitzvot d'rabanan than on the observance of mitzvot d'oreisa . 32:23 - Mayim acharonim - washing the tips of the fingers after a meal, before bentching . This washing is done with the fingers pointing downwards. 34:02 - Ga'ava is the worst characteristic in a person. 34:46 - Humility is the key positive quality in a person. 34:58 - כִּי כֹה אָמַר רָם וְנִשָּׂא שֹׁכֵן עַד וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ אֶשְׁכּוֹן וְאֶת דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל רוּחַ לְהַחֲיוֹת רוּחַ שְׁפָלִים וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לֵב נִדְכָּאִים - "For so said the High and Exalted One, Who dwells for eternity, and His Name is Holy, 'With the lofty and the holy ones I dwell, and with the crushed and humble in spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble and to revive the heart of the crushed' " ( Yeshayahu 57:15). 37:05 - What is the highest degree of humility that a person can reach? When he can honestly say that he is humble. 38:34 - There are two kinds of Torah scholars: one who has a vast knowledge of Torah - he is called " Sinai" . The scholar who may have less knowledge of Torah but who has a very sharp mind is called "Okeyr Harim" - "uprooter of mountains".

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 067a - Sotah 8 - Parshas Shelach - Parshas Vayeishev - HaShem's Punishment Fits the Sin - Teshuvah - Shimshon HaGibor - Yehudah and Tamar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 067a - Sotah 8 - Shelach - Vayeishev - HaShem's Punishment Fits the Sin - Teshuvah - Shimshon HaGibor - Yehudah and Tamar - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Parshas Shelach . אֶרֶץ אֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ הִוא - "...a Land that consumes its inhabitants..." ( Bamidbar 13:32, Shelach ) כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִ
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 067a - Sotah 8 - Shelach - Vayeishev - HaShem's Punishment Fits the Sin - Teshuvah - Shimshon HaGibor - Yehudah and Tamar - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Parshas Shelach . אֶרֶץ אֹכֶלֶת יוֹשְׁבֶיהָ הִוא - "...a Land that consumes its inhabitants..." ( Bamidbar 13:32, Shelach ) כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִישׁ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ - "...for You repay a man according to his deed" ( Tehillim 62:13). A person's sins are punished by HaShem according to the nature of each particular sin. The four death penalties inflicted by the Sanhedrin: stoning, burning, beheading, and strangling Conversion - non-Jews have the right to convert to Judaism, but according to Torah Law, Egyptians only have that right after three generations of waiting. Why this halakha does not apply today. To prevent rebellion, Sancherev redistributed the population of lands he conquered. Egyptians today are not really Egyptians as a result of Sancherev's redistribution of population. The Torah prohibits a Jew from establishing permanent residence in Egypt because the land itself is impure. The Arizal explains that throughout the diaspora, holy sparks are hidden. When a Jew lives in the diaspora, he draws out these holy sparks and returns them to Eretz Yisrael . A deeper understanding of the statement: "The people of Israel were exiled amongst the nations only so that converts might be added to them" ( Bavli, Pesachim 87b). When Am Yisrael left Egypt, they extracted every last bit of holiness so there is no purpose in a Jew settling permanently in Egypt. The Rambam lived in Egypt for part of his life. Shimshon's punishment of blindness was another example of how HaShem repays a person measure for measure. An additional aspect of HaShem punishing according to the crime: double punishment. When a person steals, he not only loses what he steals, but he also loses what was originally his. Example: the nachash - the serpent - was originally intended to be King of Beasts and to walk upright. The same principle applied in the case of Cain and Hevel . During the mabul - flood - every last descendant of Cain was wiped out. More examples of double punishment - Korach . Gechazi - the servant/student of Elisha HaNavi - was also punished doubly. Haman. Summary - all these cases prove that a person should be happy with what he has. Shimshon HaGibor. Rav Noson of Nemirov explains that the final act of Shimshon - the destruction of the Plishtim - illustrates the concept that a tzaddik has even more power in after he passes away than he did during his physical lifetime. Shimshon stated that he "served Yisrael well for 20 years" . The word "well" alludes to the fact that he never asked a Jew for a favor. Shimshon's legs were crippled and he needed a cane to walk. The reason Shimshon was crippled in his legs - Delilah. The hospitality of Avraham Avinu . Parshas Vayeishev . Tamar and Yehudah : the 3 items Yehudah gave to Tamar as surety corresponded to Yehudah's words to Yaakov Avinu after Yosef HaTzaddik was thrown into the pit. Michtam LeDovid . 3 mitzvot for which a person should chose death rather than transgress: Avoda Zara, adultery, and murder. Yehudah's admission concerning his daughter-in-law, Tamar: צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי - "She is more righteous than I am" can also mean "She is correct - from Me " ( Bereishis 38:26, Vayeishev ). Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Sotah 3 - Birth of Moshe Rabbeinu - Secrets of Parah Adumah - Burial of Yaakov Avinu - Death of Esav - A Child's First Word Should Be Amein - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Yocheved and Miriam, the mother and sister of Moshe Rabbeinu , were rewarded for their mesiras nefesh to save Jewish children. Miriam gave three reasons her father, Amram , was mistaken to separate from his wife. The first word that parents should teach their child to say is "Amein" . If Tzaddikim suffer, it's not as a result of a curse. All but one of the maids who accompanied Batya Bat Pharaoh were killed by the malakh Gavriel . Batya's reward for saving Moshe Rabbeinu . Description of Gan Eden for women. Secrets of the process of the Parah Adumah . The Tzaddik Emet has the ability to purify souls. Miriam NaNaviya was called "sister of Aharon " because she was a prophetess even before Moshe Rabbeinu was born. Burial of Yaakov Avinu in the Maarat HaMachpela h. Death of Esav . lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 177a - Avos DeRav Nasan - Demons - Seven Earths - Extraterrestrials - Inter-Dimensional Travel - Spiritual Cause of Plagues - Wars - Liberal Judges - The 10 Martyrs - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded abt. 1970.) 00:00 - Demons exist but their ability to cause harm is limited by HaShem . The
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 177a - Avos DeRav Nasan - Demons - Seven Earths - Extraterrestrials - Inter-Dimensional Travel - Spiritual Cause of Plagues - Wars - Liberal Judges - The 10 Martyrs - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded abt. 1970.) 00:00 - Demons exist but their ability to cause harm is limited by HaShem . They resemble humans in three ways: they need nourishment, they have a life span, they reproduce. Demons resemble angels in that they have wings so they can travel quickly both in this world and upward into heavenly realms. Demons are aware of the future and can make themselves invisible. They can see but not be seen. They have the power of shape-shifting, transforming themselves into animals or even people. One identifying feature they can't change when they're in human form: they have webbed, bird-like feet. 08:36 - "The advice about sheidim is: steer clear. Don't get involved." - Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . 08:42 - Seven Earths. Intelligent life exists on planets other than the earth (Talmud and the Zohar HaKodesh ). Human-like beings live in other dimensions. HaShem created seven earths, but ours is the one where He formed Adam and Chava . According to several Torah sources, inhabitants of the other six "earths" are descendants of Cain, who was sent wandering in other dimensions as a punishment for killing his brother, Hevel . 17:17 – Spiritual cause of plagues and epidemics: failure to give the Torah’s three obligatory gifts to the poor from the field: Peyah, Leket, and Shikhekha . 19:20 – Peyah, Leket, and Shikhekha - Torah laws of agricultural tzedakah - charity. 20:18 - Story from the Gemara of a mother and two young sons who died of hunger. 22:43 – What is the spiritual cause of war? 24:08 - The cruelty of liberal courts fails to protect innocent victims by being lenient with criminals. 33:05 - War is caused by the failure of a country's laws and judicial system to protect victims of crime. 33:38 - The 10 Martyrs – the great rabbis killed by the Romans: Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel and Rabbi Shmuel Kohen Gadol .

Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 – " HaShem spoke to Moshe Rabbeinu saying 'I am HaShem '," using two different names of HaShem , one for midos haracham im (kindness), one for midos hadin (judgment). Rav Nosson ז"ל writes
lessons.bodyText: VaEira 5776 - Arba Loshonos Shel Geulah - The Four Expressions of Redemption - Why Ten Plagues? Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 – " HaShem spoke to Moshe Rabbeinu saying 'I am HaShem '," using two different names of HaShem , one for midos haracham im (kindness), one for midos hadin (judgment). Rav Nosson ז"ל writes in Likutey Halakhos : "If we would listen to the true tzaddikim and believe that everything HaShem does is for the good... we would have the final, complete redemption." 04:00 – Dasan and Aviram . 08:00 – Controversy and opposition can confuse even the most intelligent person and might cause him to falter. Thanking HaShem for what might seem negative is an antidote to losing heart and will lead to the Geulah Sheleyma . 10:45 - Arba Loshonos Shel Geulah (the four expressions of redemption). Pesach Haggadah . Midrash Yalkut HaReuveni – ילקוט ראובני הגדול – Katzar Ruach (impatience and false humility) interferes with faith in tzaddikim . Katnus deMochin – shortsightedness. 14:53 – At the end of Sotah we hear what the world will be like shortly before the coming of Moshiach . Things will get worse and worse and no one but HaShem will be able to save us. Rav Avrham b'Reb Nachman Tulchiner offers a message of profound hope, explaining that the five levels of worsening troubles described in the gemara show the dynamic ability of HaShem to pull us out of the even the worst situations. Therefore, when we see things getting darker and darker, we should know we're getting closer to the light of the final redemption. *21:20 – Why ten plagues? Why didn't HaShem destroy the enemy right away? The message for us today: the gradual process of Yetziyas Mitzrayim through the makos elevated Bnei Yisrael gradually to new levels of yira – awe and respect for HaShem . 27:00 – All the frightening things going on now, in our times, are designed to bring us to new levels of appreciation for HaShem's power and His love for us. The main thing for us to do is to keep begging HaShem for protection and aitza tova (good counsel).

lessons.bodyText: VaEira 5776. - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Why were there ten makos (plagues)? Why didn't Hashem finish off the Egyptians at once? What's the message, for us today, of this gradual process? The ten plagues elevated Bnei Yisrael to increasing levels of yirah – awe and respect for Hashem . lessons.bodyText: Shevachey HaRan – Praises of Rebbe Nachman – is a biography written by his closest student, Reb Noson of Nemirov zal . The Life of Rebbe Nachman - Speaking About Tzaddikim Removes Harsh Decrees - Rebbe Nachman's Childhood - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . This series of classes began shortly before Rosh Hashanah 5736 (late summer, 1975). Introduction to Breslov chassidus and to the writings of and about Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. Rebbe Nachman is known as both Rebbe Nachman ben Simcha (his father) and Rebbe Nachman ben Feige (his mother). Rebbe Nachman's paternal grandfather was Rebbe Nachman Horodenker zal . The traditional spelling of Rebbe Nachman’s mother’s name פיגא – Feigeh – is with one yud . Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . Rebbe Nachman ben Simcha begematria is exactly Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai zal . Rebbe Nachman established himself in the city of Breslov. There are 50 degrees of wisdom. “Fifty Gates of Understanding were created in the world, and they were all given, except for one” ( Rosh HaShanah 21b). Moshe Rabbeinu’s tefilah to enter Eretz Yisrael . VaEschanan is 515 b’gematria tefilah . He passed away on Har Nevo (‘ noon ’ is within ‘it’ – the 50th level of understanding). There is a tunnel between Har Nevo and Mearas HaMachpeleh , so the soul of Moshe Rabbeinu is in Chevron (Hebron). The name "Nachman" is MoaCH NooN – mind/wisdom of the 50th degree – he had the 50th degree of wisdom and Moshe Rabbeinu. The greatest desire of Moshe Rabbeinu was to get to Eretz Yisrael . The gematria of "Rebbe Nachman ben Feigeh" (with one Yud ) is 516 – indicating that he achieved the completion of Moshe Rabbeinu’s goal. It is important to speak and hear about the lives of tzaddikim . Reference to Likutey Moharan 234 . Rebbe Nachman was born in Medzhibozh, Ukraine, on Rosh Chodesh Nissan , 5532 “…just about 203 and a half years ago”. Rebbe Nachman began teaching at the time of his Bar Mitzvah and marriage. His first student was Reb Shimon, who is buried in Tzefas (Safed) near the Arizal . "We are going to start with the sefer Shevachey HaRan , followed by Sichos HaRan . Rabbi Rosenfeld addresses the question: why record these lessons even though the information is written in a sefer ? Because it is of infinite benefit to speak about the lives of tzaddikim . "Right now it's nighttime. But I state honestly, truthfully, that I believe much more that Rabbeinu zal is the Tzaddik Emes than I believe that it is nighttime now." Rebbe Nachman's early childhood, before the age of six years old.

Halakha 7 is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 8. 36:14 - (Lesson 049c). Tefilah (prayer) in the aspect of din (judgment). Gathering exiles from the corners of the earth. When a minyan (ten men) gathers to pray, the shechina (Divine Presence) is always with them. (Reference to Parshas Shelach ). Nations of the world will grasp onto the corners of Israel's four-cornered garment - tzitzis . 40:46 - PARAGRAPH 3. Tzitzis are an aspect of the חוט של חסד "thread of kindness" and tefila at חצות chatzos (midnight). The gathering of the People of Israel creates exponential numbers of relationships, unlike the gathering of the nations.* PARAGRAPH 4 - Refers to Even HaEzer, Hilkhos Periya Ureviya 5:12-13 and the exponential quality of the gathering of members of Clal Yisrael . 53:24 - (Lesson 049d). The importance of the ingathering of the exiles and the unification of Clal Yisrael . Tzitzis 600 corresponds to the 600,000 root souls of Israel who were present at Sinai.

Text: Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 1 , Tzitzis 7, Para. 9. On the Shabbos preceding (or falling on) Rosh Chodesh Adar we read Parshas Shekalim ( Shemos /Exodus 30:11-16). The reading commemorates th
lessons.bodyText: Shevat - Likutey Halakhos - How the Half-Shekel Offering Increases the Gathering of Souls - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 1 , Tzitzis 7, Para. 9. On the Shabbos preceding (or falling on) Rosh Chodesh Adar we read Parshas Shekalim ( Shemos /Exodus 30:11-16). The reading commemorates the half-shekel donation each Jew contributes during the month of Adar . This charity supported the public offerings in the Beis Hamikdash (Holy Temple). There's a factorial increase in the number of soul-connections generated through members of Klal Yisrael joining together to do a mitzvah . In light of Breslov chassidus , what is the deeper significance behind this mitzvah performed every Shevat/Adar , and how is this mitzvah done in our present generation?

An important part of emunah - faith in Hashem - is believing in one's own abilities, having self-confidence and faith in oneself. (Based on 2Likutey Moharan 86 ). *18:00 - SICHA 141. Tikkun HaKlali – The Ten Psalms recommended by Rebbe Nachman as a daily "general remedy" for the soul, especially for achieving Tikkun HaBris . (Based on Likutey Moharan 205 and 2Likutey Moharan 92 ). The Ten Psalms of Tikkun HaKlali are: 16, 32, 41, 42, 59, 77, 90, 105, 137, 150.
