lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. (Lesson 045a). 21:40 - (Lesson 045b). The shir shel chessed (song of kindness) and finding the good point as related to tzitzis . The ability to give constructive rebuke is only with great tzadikim . Most people aren't qualified to rebuke themselves properly, let alone others. Improper rebuke can harm a person's avodas Hashem. 40:30 - (Lesson 045c). Garments/clothing are the essence of a person's "fragrance" - their deeds and faith. Account of young boy in time of Rabbi Akiva who could "scent" that the rabbis visiting his home had not said Kriyas Shema that day. 47:12 - PARAGRAPH 8. Forgiveness on Yom Kippur is facilitated by tzitzis. The scent of Gan Eden was in Yaakov Aveinu's clothing.

lessons.title: OC1 - Lesson 046 - Tzitzis 5 - Para. 10-12
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Wine, song, dreams, prophecy, and the mystical aspects of clothing in the teachings of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 8. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Based on Pirkey D'Reb Eliezer 24: the kabbalistic meaning of clothing is hidden in the story of the gar
lessons.bodyText: Wine, song, dreams, prophecy, and the mystical aspects of clothing in the teachings of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 8. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Based on Pirkey D'Reb Eliezer 24: the kabbalistic meaning of clothing is hidden in the story of the garments made by Hashem for Adam and Chava (Eve) in Gan Eden . 20:52 - How did the nachash (serpent) deceive Chava ? Yaakov Avinu wore the garment of Adam when he received the blessing from Yitzchak Avinu . 28:22 - PARAGRAPH 11. Noach (Noah) and his sons, Shem, Cham (Ham) and Yafes (Japhet). The garment with which Shem and Yafes covered themselves was an aspect of tzitzis . 36:05 - (Lesson 046c). The flood is called Mei Noach (Waters of Noah) because Noach failed to pray for his generation. Wine had a negative effect on him because he didn't repair the sin of Adam. Avraham Avinu (Abraham) prayed for Sdom thereby began the repair of Adam's sin. Moshe Rabeynu (Moses) completed the process through מסירת נפש mesiras nefesh (offering his life) to protect Am Yisrael . This was an example of תפילה מבחינת דין tefilah m'bechinas din (the technique of "prayer through the side of judgment").* 49:35 - PARAGRAPH 12. (Lesson 046d). Wine, sleep, dreams, imagination. Some dreams are delivered through angels, some through demons, and some are an aspect of nevuah (prophecy). 1:03:00 - Account of the ARI z"l sleeping and his student saw that he was speaking in his sleep.The student later asked what his teacher had dreamed and the ARI z"l answered, "Even 80 years wouldn't be enough time to tell you all I just learned about Balak and Bilaam." 1:07:00 - The song of joy. The purpose and proper use of wine.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Rebbe Nachman describes the positive and negative aspects of wine on human consciousness. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Why was wine an offering in the Beis HaMikdash (Holy Temple)? Wine is an aspect of sleep. 06:45 - PARAGRAPH 15. Why is wine used for kiddush on Shabbos ? 19:35 - PARAGRAPH 16. Why
lessons.bodyText: Rebbe Nachman describes the positive and negative aspects of wine on human consciousness. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Why was wine an offering in the Beis HaMikdash (Holy Temple)? Wine is an aspect of sleep. 06:45 - PARAGRAPH 15. Why is wine used for kiddush on Shabbos ? 19:35 - PARAGRAPH 16. Why is wine used for kos shel bracha when benching (saying the blessings after a meal)? 28:55 - PARAGRAPH 17. Yaakov Avinu brought wine to his father and because of this, Yitzchak Avinu sensed the "fragrance of the garden". 30:45 - PARAGRAPH 18. Wine has a destructive aspect and resulted in the curse given by Noach to his grandson, Canaan . 37:20 - The holiness of Eretz Yisrael is based on the faith in the constant renewal of the world. 44:34 - PARAGRAPH 20. The Zohar explains that since they are an aspect of the חוט של חסד "the thread of kindness", tzitzis correspond to the Olam haYetzira and Psukei deZimra . 47:12 - PARAGRAPH 21. The four tzitzis correspond to the four letters of Hashem's name Yud-Hey-Vuv-Hey . 50:18 - PARAGRAPH 22. The 39 windings of the tzitzis correspond to " Hashem Echad " in the Shema ( b'gematria : 26 is Hashem's Name plus 13 for Echad ). 51:22 - PARAGRAPH 23. The 32 strings of the tzitzis correspond to the letters LEV when the first and last letters of the Torah are combined.

One of the meanings of moshiach (the ultimate redeemer). The three times we say "kadosh" (holy) in Kedusha parallel the three points of connection every Jew needs in order to serve Hashem: rabbi, chevrusa (friend), and oneself. These three points relate to the three aspects of tefillin: rosh (head), kesher (knot), and yad (hand/arm).

lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - HALAKHA 3. 11:03 - The purpose of tefillin is to elevate fear to its highest level: absolute respect for Hashem. 21:33 - (Lesson 056b). Chatzos (midnight prayer). 28:53 - HALAKHA 4. PARAGRAPH 1. (Lesson 056c). This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 5. Each person must see the world and everything in it, including tzaddikim , as if they were created for him alone. 41:38 - The sound of thunder straightens out the blockage in the heart that interferes with true respect for Hashem. 48:48 - (Lesson 056d). The fear instilled by the sound of the shofar . The meaning of Gavriel (Gabriel) planting a rod in the sea. ( Shabbos 56 and Sanhedrin 21). If a person hears about disputes between tzaddikim , it's a sign that he needs to repair something within himself. Seeing a person make a mistake is a mirror in which we can find our own mistakes.

Moshe Rabbeinu's question to Am Yisrael : "What does HaShem ask of you but to fear Him?" A soul is asked 6 questions immediately after his passing. "Ekev anava yirat HaShem”. Rebbe Nachman t
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 073b - Sotah 40 - Siddur Course - Kriyat Shema - Humility - Birkhat Kohanim - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Moshe Rabbeinu's question to Am Yisrael : "What does HaShem ask of you but to fear Him?" A soul is asked 6 questions immediately after his passing. "Ekev anava yirat HaShem”. Rebbe Nachman taught that the highest level of humility is the ability to state, without conceit, that one is humble. Rabbi Avahu praised the humility of Rabbi Abba. A Meturgamon repeats the words of a rabbi giving a shiur so they can be heard by everyone gathered. Rabbi Avahu was offered the position of Chief Rabbi of a city but turned it down, suggesting someone he said was more worthy. A person who recovers from serious illness is forgiven for his sins. The Gemara in Yuma says that charity saves from death. To perform acts of kindness is a much higher level than giving tzedakah . Rabbi Avahu consoled Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba with a parable. Aggadah is the "true diamond" of the Gemara . Birkhat Kohanim. The written Torah is said to contain 600,000 letters, but the number of letters written by a scribe on the parchment of a Sefer Torah is 305,804. Why is this so? In the name “Yisrael" the letters stand for "Yesh shishim rebu otiot laTorah" . The importance of answering "Amein" to a blessing. "It's greater to say 'Amein' than to say the blessing." HaShem's Name consists of two parts. When Moshiach is revealed, the two parts of HaShem's Name will be one. In the Beis HaMikdash , people did not respond "Amein" to a blessing, they said " Baruch Shem Kevod Malkhuso leOlam Vaed" . Although flattery is evil, to save a life, it is permitted. 4 types of people cannot receive the Shekhinah - Divine Presence of HaShem . Type 1 - someone who sits among people who joke about everything. Type 2 - liars. Type 3 - flatterers. Type 4 - someone who speaks loshon hara . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Kiddushin 49 - Torah Study - Parnassah - Marriage - 10 Measures of Wisdom - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - A person who doesn't engage in Torah study is not considered civilized. 00:52 - Someone who eats in the street is comparable to a dog. 03:08 - Livelihood: treading on bread crumbs in one's home can cause poverty. ( Pesachim 111b). 04:35 - The only thing anger achieves is illness for the one who's habitually angry. 05:32 - The validity of a conditional marriage vow: "You are hereby sanctified to me on condition that I am a complete tzaddik" ( Kiddushin 49b). 10:27 - Measures of characteristics distributed to the people of the world at the time of creation. 10 measures of wisdom were given to the world, Eretz Yisrael received nine. "The air of Eretz Yisrael makes a person wise." 12:04 - "Ten measures of beauty were given to the world; Jerusalem received nine while the rest of the world received one" ( Kiddushin 49b). 12:50 - 10 measures of wealth were given to the world, the Roman empire received nine. 14:35 - 10 measures of magic were given to the world, nine were give to Egypt. 14:53 - Nine tenths of the diseases that came to the world were given to the pig. 15:58 - Distribution of of speech: nine portions out of ten were given to women. When a man marries, he acquires his missing nine measures of speech. 17:19 - The distribution of drunkenness and sleep. 18:10 - The importance of being reserved, refined, and polite; not to reach out and grab food. 19:13 - Story of Rabbi Akiva inviting two of his students for a meal. One tried and failed to remove a cabbage leaf, so he left it. The other student was more aggressive and Rabbi Akiva scolded him. "Derech eretz (refinement of character) precedes Torah."

Specifically, it draws from the section about the first day of the sheva brochos and the story told by the blind beggar. 00:00 PARAGRAPH 1. (Lesson 059a). The first beggar wished
lessons.bodyText: Tefillin 5 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Tefillin 5 is based on the story of the Seven Beggars in Rebbe Nachman's Sipurey Masiyos . Specifically, it draws from the section about the first day of the sheva brochos and the story told by the blind beggar. 00:00 PARAGRAPH 1. (Lesson 059a). The first beggar wished the newlywed couple in the story חיים ארוכים - chayim aruchim - long life. The old men in the tower relate how long they've lived. The oldest one remembers "nothing at all". 19:40 - (Lesson 059b). Rebbe Nachman tells his students, "If I had only come into the world to tell this one story, it would still be a very great thing." 25:10 - PARAGRAPH 2. Each of the elders in the tower relates a story older than the previous one. These stories describe the nefesh , ruach , and neshoma - levels of the soul. 30:08 - PARAGRAPH 3. How the story of the first beggar relates to tefillin : ולזכרון בין עיניך "as a remembrance between your eyes..." The parchment in the tefillin shel rosh contain four sections of Torah and the tefillin shel yad contain four sections of Torah. 38:43 - (Lesson 059c). How the eight Torah sections written on the tefillin 's parchment correspond to the eight elders in the tower of the first beggar's story. 50:28 - The tefillin shel rosh correspond to מחין דדכורא - the "masculine mentalities" and the הדרת פני זקן.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: This halakha is based on Rebbe Nachman's Sipurey Masiyos – specifically on the account of the First Beggar in the story of the Seven Beggars . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. (Lesson 060a). Tefillin bring life, as wisdom brings life. They correspond to the words: אהיה ד' אהיה with the daled standing for the shem of yud-hey-vuv-an
lessons.bodyText: This halakha is based on Rebbe Nachman's Sipurey Masiyos – specifically on the account of the First Beggar in the story of the Seven Beggars . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. (Lesson 060a). Tefillin bring life, as wisdom brings life. They correspond to the words: אהיה ד' אהיה with the daled standing for the shem of yud-hey-vuv-and hey. ( 21 plus 26 plus 21) which equals חיים. An explanation of the concept of עתיק יומין – the Throne of Atik Yomin . 09:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. What is חיים ארכים – true long life? The blind beggar is simultaneously "very old and very young". The power of התחדשות – renewal. "Regard each day as the first day you've entered into the covenant." ( Berakhos 63) 21:42 - (Lesson 060b). Based on Likutey Moharan Torah 60 – the essence of true living is renewal. 34:52 - (Lesson 060c). Even if a person is a great tzaddik , the secret of his success is the ability to start all over again, from nothing at all. This is true "long life." 48:14 - Renewal is the essence of tefillin , which a person puts on every day, as if it's the very first time. Tefillin gives the power of renewal. lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 1-2 - Introduction - Tzaddik Emes - The 4 Worlds - Bitachon - Confidence - How to Begin Connecting with HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw11a. Recorded Feb. 1976.) INTRODUCTION. What and who is the Tzaddik Emes ? וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם - "...and the tzaddik is the foundation of the world" ( Mishlei 10:25). The 4 Worlds, from lowest to highest, are: 1) Olam HaAsiyah (the physical universe), 2) Olam HaYetzira (the realm of spiritual beings), 3) Olam HaBeriyah (Throne of HaShem , origin of souls), 4) Olam HaAtzilus (unknowable realm of HaShem ). Olam HaBeriyah . Olam HaAtzilus . The Tzaddik Emes can visit each of the higher spiritual realms. HaShem is infinite. SICHAH 1. כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה - "For I know that HaShem is great..." ( Tehillim 135:5). Each person's perception of HaShem is unique and impossible to communicate. No two people are on the same level. Mocking the Torah is extremely dangerous. SICHAH 2. Placing everything in HaShem's hands. How to begin connecting with HaShem .
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated by Tuvia Aharon Scher in honor of his family and all potential olim to Eretz Yisrael with a prayer to HaShem that regardless of the situation in the world we will be able to make aliya successfully as soon as possible.

SICHAH 5b. 00:49 - The meaning of the word דע as an introductory word in Rebbe Nachman's teachings. 02:26 - Every Jew has a portion in Olam HaBa - the Hereafter. 04:47 - Similarities between Moshe Rabbeinu and Rabbi Akiva . 04:58 - The name Akiva contains the number 71 (the sum of its first and last letter), alluding to the 71 members of the Sanhedrin. 05:15 - The middle letters of Rabbi Akiva's name allude to "Yabok" . 05:53 - The Names of HaShem Y - K - V - K plus - Elokim is begematria "Yabok" . 07:03 - It's important to speak about the dangers of philosophy. 07:57 - All inventions in technology or medicine originate from HaShem . He chooses as His emissary someone who has enough empty space in his head to accommodate the "discovery". 08:20 - The belief in science is a form of atheism. 09:11 - "The best of doctors goes to Gehinnam " ( Kiddushin 82a). 10:02 - Discovery of new weapons or new cures is not always a good thing. 11:13 - Throughout history, intelligence gradually has been decreasing. 13:59 - Klipah - negative spiritual force. Why famous innovators are often morally degenerate. 14:08 - Sefer Yetzira was written by Avraham Avinu . 17:05 - Torah revelations are from HaSem . *Story about Rabbi Yosef Cairo zal - the Beis Yosef . When a new Torah concept enters the world through the mesiras nefesh of a tzaddik , it becomes available to the minds of the generation. 18:41 - The greatest simcha is the resolution of doubt. 22:34 - The Arizal's dream on Shabbos . 24:24 - Vaccines cannot prevent further decrees of illness from Hashem . 26:24 - The best cure-all is to pray for the arrival of Moshiach . 26:40 - Inventions are not always helpful to mankind - gunpowder, for example. 27:10 - Surgeons do more harm than good. 28:33 - The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh on the life-long struggle against the Yetzer Hara . SICHAH 6. The purpose of the Yetzer HaRa - Evil Inclination - is to mislead people. 32:53 - The Parparaos LeChokhmah - Rav Nachman Tcherin zal . 33:46 - Rav Nachman Tcherin zal explains why a person can forfeit their entire spiritual standing in "a quarter of an hour" - 18 chalakim per minute x 15 minutes = 270 - gematria רע. 40:11 - Hisbodedus is the key to winning the battle against evil. 42:48 - The basic element necessary for all spiritual success is אמונה - faith.

lessons.bodyText: Money doesn't grow on trees – or does it? Parnassah (livelihood) depends on Hashem's ratzon (will) but we need to make an effort as well. lessons.description: Tefillin 5 - Shem Ekyeh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in 2011.) Hilkhos Tefillin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 and Sipurey Masiyos , The Seven Beggars , Story of the First Day – The Blind Beggar. Review of previous shiur , Halakha 5, Para. 23-25. PARAGRAPH 26. (Beginning of Clip for Parshos Shemos and for
lessons.bodyText: Tefillin 5 - Shem Ekyeh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in 2011.) Hilkhos Tefillin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 and Sipurey Masiyos , The Seven Beggars , Story of the First Day – The Blind Beggar. Review of previous shiur , Halakha 5, Para. 23-25. PARAGRAPH 26. (Beginning of Clip for Parshos Shemos and for Elul 01.) One of the names of HaShem is Alef - Hey - Yud - Hey - ("Shem Ekyeh") – "I will be." This relates to the power of potential and free will, and gives us the ability for teshuvah – return to HaShem . Until a person returns to HaShem he is not truly alive. Shabbos is the day of teshuvah for the entire week. (End of Clip for Parshos Shemos and for Elul 01). The Tzaddik is an aspect of Ekyeh because he is in a constant state of spiritual progress. Shem Adnus (the Name of HaShem Aleph - Daled - Noon - Yud ) is an aspect of Emunah (faith in HaShem ). In the phrase אהי-ה אשר אהי-ה - the word אשר has the same letters as ראש - head – alluding to the Name of HaShem Yud - Hey - Vuv - Hey . The Gematria of חיים - life is 68. Moshe Rabbeinu questioned HaShem about Rabbi Akiva's torture and death. Why do the righteous suffer? Like flax that is beaten to improve its quality, HaShem entrusts tzaddikim to serve Him faithfully even through Midas HaDin . "Crossing the Yabbok ."

lessons.bodyText: Tefillin 5 - Rabbeinu Tam Tefillin - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of the Hilkhos Tefillin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 64 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. The חלל הפנוי - the Chalal Hapanui (vacated space) made by Hashem to facilitate creation. The reasons for wearing Rabbeinu Tam Tefillin in addition to Rashi Tefillin . 07:19 - Account of how Reb Avraham Sternhartz ז"ל presented Likutey Moharan 64 as his "Farheyr" - test interview - for the post of Rabbi of Lublin. 11:22 - The spiritual difference between Rabbeinu Tam Tefillin and Rashi Tefillin . 13:54 - Account of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai ז"ל and his son fleeing from the Romans and finding a carob tree and spring of water. ( Shabbos 31). The Ben Ish Chai ז"ל explains that Hashem provided Rabbi Shimon with these two items in particular because they allude to the Tzaddik's task of sweetening Dinim which originate from the Chalal Hapanui . *22:00 - Rebbe Nachman strongly advises his students to wear Rabbeinu Tam Tefillin . 25:45 - PARAGRAPH 29. Why it is important to wear Rabbeinu Tam Tefillin in our present generation. 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 30. Account of Shmuel HaNavi , Shaul HaMelech , and Agog . Why was the King of Amalek cut into four pieces? 43:54 - Childbirth. Every time a Jewish woman gives birth it accomplishes Tikkun Haolam - it repairs the world in a very important way. 44:15 - Why we say Kaddish for someone who passes away. Yaakov Aveinu and the birthright. Why did he struggle so hard to claim the right of the firstborn?

Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - The fifteenth day of the month of Shevat is the New Year of trees, when their "re
lessons.bodyText: Tu BeShevat - the Rosh Hashanah for trees, is also the birthday of Rav Nasan of Nemirov. Mysteries of birth, the splitting of the Yam Suf (Red Sea) and Parshas Beshalach in light of Breslov chassidus . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - The fifteenth day of the month of Shevat is the New Year of trees, when their "rebirth" begins. Similarly, forty days before a birth, the child's destiny is proclaimed in heaven. Two opinions about when Adam was created: either Rosh Chodesh Nissan or Rosh Hashanah . Considering the first opinion: forty days before the 25th of Adar (the first of the six days of Bereishis ) is Tu BeShevat . 08:08 - Serach Bas Asher helps Moshe Rabeynu locate the coffin of Yosef HaTzaddik . The coffin is brought up from the depths of the Nile through the use of one of Hashem's Names. Moshe writes Alei Shor - " Rise up, ox ." on an earthenware shard. 09:26 - A child, Micha , watched Moshe Rabeynu use the Name of Hashem and retrieved the shard. He later threw it into the fire when the Golden Calf was formed. 12:56 - Likutey Moharan Torah 211: One of the main reasons we travel to the gravesites of tzaddikim before Rosh Hashanah is related to Moshe Rabeynu connecting to Yosef HaTzaddik at the time of the geulah (redemption). 21:00 - On Sotah 14, the BaCH says the reason the gravesite of Moshe Rabeynu is hidden is that if Bnei Yisrael would go there and ask him to pray for the exile to be over, Moshe Rabeynu would do that, even if it wasn't the right time for the end of exile. 23:47 - History of the gravesite of Rebbe Nachman in Uman. The Heidemack uprising, Count Potaki and his daughter, Sofia, the 30,000 martyrs of the Chmielnitsky massacre in Uman.* 26:36 - The Ten Martyrs - Rabbi Akiva, Rabbi Shmuel Kohen Gadol, Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel and how it relates to Rebbe Nachman's gravesite in Uman. *31:29 - The Bnei Yisrael at the Yam Suf (the Red Sea). Hashem asks, " Why are you screaming to Me? " Parnassa and finding one's zivug is as difficult as the splitting of the Yam Suf . It's the person's lack of faith that makes these things difficult. Mon hu? (" What is this? " when Bnei Yisrael asked about the manna) contains the same letters as emunah (faith in Hashem). 36:57 - Conclusion and review. 38:31 - Questions and responses. 41:23 - Best wishes for the New Year that begins on Tu BeShevat .

lessons.bodyText: Praises of Rebbe Nachman - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - Rav Nosson zal's journey back to the Ukraine from Eretz Yisrael , based on Yemey Moharnat II, 177-190. An account of the Rosh Hashanah gathering and the shiur given by Rav Avraham Sternhartz. Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld describes how his father, Reb Yisroel Abba Rosenfeld, endangered his life to attend this gathering for 19 consecutive years. A description of how Rav Nosson of Nemirov managed to do the customary ritual immersion of Erev Rosh Hashanah when he was on a ship during a storm. He lowered himself on a rope, hand over hand, to immerse while the ship was moving through the stormy sea. His mesiras nefesh (self sacrifice) conveys the importance of immersion in a mikveh on Erev Rosh Hashanah . 05:55 - Rav Nosson of Nemirov's Rosh Hashanah at sea.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 44 - 45 - 46- 47 - 48 - 49 - The Meaning of a Name - Warning About Gematria - Protecting the Mind - The Power of Renewal - Saying Possuk for Name - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw17b. Recorded in 1976.) SICHAH 44. Naming a child. A person's name is decided in shemayim - heaven. The tradition of saying a possuk that begins with the first letter of one's name and ends with the last letter of one's name. What is gematria ? A warning about its use: not everyone has the authority to innovate concepts from the numerical value of the Hebrew letters. SICHAH 45. How can a person tell if they've prayed with a broken heart? After true heartbreak comes joy. SICHAH 46. The higher a faculty, the further it can reach. A foot can only kick something so far, a hand can project something further, a person's speech can reach further, and a person can see even further. But the distance a mind can reach is infinitely farther than any other part of the body can access. Therefore, it's most important to guard the holiness of one's mind. A person's mind is under his control. Removing bad thoughts. SICHAH 47. The importance of making time to review one's life every day. The foolishness of desiring honor. Better to do a few mitzvos humbly than many mitzvos with arrogance. SICHAH 48. The power of renewal through beginning all over again, even many times each day. SICHAH 49. Chananya, Mishael, and Azaria were willing to give their lives for their faith. During the second plague in Egypt, the frogs gave their lives al kiddush HaShem .

How to protect oneself from the jealousy of angels by binding one's soul to the Kisey HaKavod - the "Throne" of HaShem - from which all souls emanate. 28:40 - ***The ARIzal teaches that if a person wants to be successful in prayer, he should bind his prayer to the community, through saying "I hereby accept upon myself the mitzvah to 'Love your neighbor as yourself'" . 36:23 - PARAGRAPH 3. To know is to connect. ***37:30 - We can also bind ourselves to all the souls of the generation through binding with the soul of the generation's tzaddik . 40:52 - Nusach of hiskashrus - in Breslov tradition, the statement said daily to do this is: הריני מקשר עצמי לכל הצדיקים האמתיים שבדורנו, ולכל הצדיקים האמתיים שוכני עפר קדושים אשר בארץ המה, ובפרט לרבינו הקדוש, צדיק יסוד עולם, נחל נובע מקור חכמה, רבינו נחמן בן פיגא, זכותו יגן עלינו ועל כל ישראל אמן "I am now attaching myself to all the true tzaddikim of our generation and to all the true tzaddikim who have passed away and are resting in the earth, and especially to our holy teacher, righteous foundation of the world, 'Flowing Stream, Source of Wisdom' Rabbeinu Nachman ben Feigeh, may his merit protect us, Amen." It's customary for men to say this when wrapping themselves in the Talis each morning. Women say this before Shacharis, after the statement "Hareini....'v'ahavta l'reyecha c'mocha..." - "I hereby accept upon myself the mitzvah to 'Love your neighbor as yourself'" . 43:33 - PARAGRAPH 4. How to discern true leaders from false through perfecting Yirah -respect for HaShem .

He says "There I saw the real Rosh HaShanah , and the real Yom Kippur , and the real Sukkos ."

lessons.description: Sichos HaRan 30 - 31 - 32 - The Importance of Shacharis - Morning Prayer - At Netz HaChama - Sunrise - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - SICHAH 30. It's not good to spend too much time in the bathroom. 05:50 - SICHAH 31. The importance of beginning the Shemoneh Esrei prayer of Shacharis at sunrise, as written in the
lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 30 - 31 - 32 - The Importance of Shacharis - Morning Prayer - At Netz HaChama - Sunrise - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - SICHAH 30. It's not good to spend too much time in the bathroom. 05:50 - SICHAH 31. The importance of beginning the Shemoneh Esrei prayer of Shacharis at sunrise, as written in the will of the Baal Shem Tov Hakodesh . 13:10 - Biographical description of davening Netz - praying at sunrise - with Reb Michel Dorfman zal in the Breslov Yeshiva in Meah Shaarim, Jerusalem. In Jerusalem, the earliest time to put on a talis is 52 minutes before sunrise. 17:56 - SICHAH 32. Simple emunah vs. theology. Avoiding philosophical questions about religion and Torah commentaries that draw on secular thought. When in doubt, stick with Rashi, the Ramban, the Ohr HaChaim . 23:46 - Chochmah (knowledge) vs. ratzon (a higher level, an aspect of Keser - crown/pure will -yearning for HaShem ). No matter how much we know, we need to hold onto the truth that we don't know. We believe. 30:50 - There are certain sins that inject doubt into the heart. But the antidote is shame and embarrassment at our material limitations. 34:22 - Emunah (faith in HaShem ) vs. "taking action" in the "shark tank" world. What is true strength?* 38:02 - Some very pure souls are not affected by philosophy.

When a person joins a gathering l'Shem Shemayim for a holy purpose, all the members of the gathering benefit. The number of relationships ( Binyanim /structures) within such a group is not additive, it's factorial. If two people interact, there are two Binyanim . If three, the number of Binyanim is 6 (3 times 2). If four people interact, the number of relationship is 24 (4 times 3 times 2). 19:32 - PARAGRAPH 7.

lessons.bodyText: 2Likutey Moharan 39 - Shabbos is the Purpose of Creation. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded on 1985-10-13.) 00:00 - Introduction. 02:06 - Sefer HaMidos 2 - Daas 1. The diversity in nature can be found in the letters that make up the names of the various creations. 06:38 - In Midrash Rabbah our sages explain that the Hebrew names of creatures describe each one's essence. 09:15 - PARAGRAPH 1. לכו הזו מפעלות ד - "Go and see the works of Hashem..." ( Tehillim 46:9). 20:30 - The purpose of creation was the establishment of the Children of Israel who would keep Shabbos . 21:37 - Everything created has a beginning and an end. 29:28 - "What would we give to have a true, trustworthy leader of Am Yisrael?" - Rebbe Nachman. 36:24 - " Sulam mutzav artzah " - "A ladder with its feet on the ground that reaches toward heaven" . Action in the material world is what accomplishes the most in spiritual realms. 38:07 - Moshiach ben Dovid will not appear until all souls have been born into this world. *41:36 - PARAGRAPH 2. Shabbos is the purpose of creation. Hashem created the first six days, but man's refraining from work on Shabbos creates the subsequent six days. In this way, we are partners with Hashem in the creation of time. (Clipped) 47:02 - PARAGRAPH 3. Would it have been better if a person weren't born? There's so much suffering in this world.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: 2Likutey Moharan 74 - Parshas Mishpatim - Preparation for Geulah Begins with Purim - Moshiach Arrives Erev Pesach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon (Lesson lm2-459. Recorded on 1987-01-25.) Purim and the deeper meaning of its root letters which equal 280 ( Peh and Reish ). Directly following Purim we read Parshas Parah (To
lessons.bodyText: 2Likutey Moharan 74 - Parshas Mishpatim - Preparation for Geulah Begins with Purim - Moshiach Arrives Erev Pesach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon (Lesson lm2-459. Recorded on 1987-01-25.) Purim and the deeper meaning of its root letters which equal 280 ( Peh and Reish ). Directly following Purim we read Parshas Parah (Torah section about the Red Heifer). שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּ֔ים נֹֽטְפ֖וֹת מ֥וֹר עֹבֵֽר - "...his lips are roses dripping with flowing myrrh" ( Shir HaShirim 5:13) alludes to Esther ( Shoshanim ) and Mordechai ( Mor d'Ror /myrrh). Parshas Mishpatim. The letters of the word Purim are hinted in the initial letters of the phrase in the written Torah מ מצדים ו לא י ראו פ ני ר יקם - " ...you left Egypt and you shall not appear in My presence empty-handed ." ( Shemos 23:15, Mishpatim ). Rebbe Nachman told students: "It used to be that "all beginnings were from Pesach , but now...." . Text from Kokhavei Ohr , Section Chochmah Binah, Page 125. " Geulah HaRishona ". *The yahrzeit of the RaSHbI (Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal ), the yahrzeit of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov, and the celebration of Purim are related. All three come out on the same day of the week in any given year. End of Kokhavei Ohr . Explanation Rosh Hashanah customs - why Ashkenazim don't eat nuts on Rosh HaShanah. Rebbe Nachman and the RaSHbI counteract the egoz /nut ( gematria cheyt /sin) on Rosh HaShanah . The RaSHbI zal proclaimed that the Torah will never be forgotten. Letter written by Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal . Letter #43 in She'aris Yisrael . Pesach , wiping out Amalek takes place on 3 levels - thought/word/deed/ for 30 days, for a total of 720 hours begematria 3 times Amalek . ( Bnei Yissa'char quoted in Rav Avrohom Sternhartz's letter.) It's brought in Sefer Chesed l'Avrohom (written by the father of the Chida zal ) that during the 30 days between Purim and Pesach , HaShem extends a special chesed to rescue every Jewish soul from impurities. He does this on condition that during these weeks the individual is careful not to waste time. *There is a tradition that Moshiach will arrive on Erev Pesach . Hilkhos Pesach. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: 2Likutey Moharan 74 - 75 - 76 - Preparing for Geulah Begins in Adar - Luach ATBaSH . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon (Lesson 460, recorded on 1987-02-01). To know what day of the week each holiday falls each year: the calendar "Luach ATBaSh" . ATBaSH is system of gematria in which the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet is replaced by the last, the second by the next to last, and so on. Thus Aleph is replaced by Sof , Beis is replaced by Shin , creating the acronym ATBaSH . Applied to the first six days of Pesach : Aleph - T of - The first day of Pesach will be the same day of the week as T isha B'Av Beis - S hin - Sh avuos Gimel - R esh - R osh Hashanah Daled - K uf - K rias Hatorah , i.e. Simchas Torah Heh - Tz adi - Yom Tz om Kippur , the Fast of Atonement Vav - P eh - P urim

PARAGRAPH 7. אין שום יאוש בעולם - Ain shum yi-ush b'olam - "There is no such thing as despair". To lose hope is to fall into a state of illusion. 30:53 - Even if a person doesn't have merit himself, he can access the free gifts of Hashem through connection to a tzaddik . Halakha states that a guest doesn't have to obey his host if the host asks him to leave. Hashem is the Master of the World, but if a person feels that Hashem is pushing him away, he doesn't have to "leave". *50:40 - PARAGRAPH 8. A person has to plead very much to be worthy of coming close to the true tzaddik . Fortunate is one who, while he's still alive, can be close to the true tzaddik . The Baal Davar tries to stop this process by causing disagreements between rabbis and by establishing false leaders.

lessons.bodyText: 2Likutey Moharan 82 - Order and Disorder - Adam and Chava Were Created Back-to-Back - Humility - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon (Lesson 470, recorded on 1987-05-03). In this teaching Rebbe Nachman presents the concepts fundamental to all his teachings: Seder (order) vs. Lo ceSeder (disorder). The purpose of man is to bring order to his world through the observance of mitzvos . For one of Rav Nosson of Nemirov's commentaries on this teaching, see: Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat 2, Chakirus veKablanus 2. See also: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 2 - Hilkhos Pidyon Bechor 3 .

lessons.bodyText: 2Likutey Moharan 82 - Seder veLo KaSeder - Order and Disorder - Dangers of Wealth - Blindness - Parshas Toldos - Meanings of Segol - Parshas Ki Sisa - Milchama - War - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 471. Recorded 1987-05-10.) 00:00 - Review of 2Likutey Moharan 82 thus far. 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. 13:00 - Difficulties arise when a child feels he has "outgrown" respect for his parents, or when a student feels he has "outgrown" respect for his teacher. ***14:00 - When a person is in need, feeling impoverished, he respects HaShem as being above him. But when a person is wealthy, financially or even in Torah learning, he is in danger of feeling that he doesn't need HaShem so much. 15:30 - אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֖מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ - "If I ascend to the heavens, there You are, and if I make my bed in the grave, behold, You are there" Tehillim 139:8. The four who entered Gan Eden . It might seem that the higher a person climbs in Torah, his respect for HaShem would be greater. But in fact, the opposite is true. Why? 20:45 - Sometimes a light blinds a person as in וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־זָקֵ֣ן יִצְחָ֔ק וַתִּכְהֶ֥יןָ עֵינָ֖יו מֵֽרְאֹ֑ת - "It came to pass when Yitzchak was old, and his eyes were too dim to see..." ( Bereishis 27:1, Toldos ). 23:00 - Meanings of the Segol . Shekhina is 600,000 Jewish souls. Three dots: the Shekhina is between the Two Hands of HaShem . וְשַׂכֹּתִ֥י כַפִּ֛י עָלֶ֖יךָ עַד־עָבְרִֽי - "...I will place you into the cleft of the rock, and I will cover you with My hand until I have passed by" ( Shemos 33:23, Ki Sisa ). ***29:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu was the wealthiest Jew alive, but his humility was so great that HaShem's Shekhina protected him. . 30:20 - PARAGRAPH 4. Seder veLo KaSeder is an aspect of milchama - war. Communism vs. Democracy. ***34:10 - NOTE - Account of the Chofetz Chaim zal about false achdus - Sheker presents itself as " Achdus" - the three letters are close to one another, while in Emes the letters are dispersed. 38:00 - Parshas Ki Sisa.

(Lesson 493. Recorded 1988-03-27.) 00:00 - TORAH 105. Chiddushei Torah - Torah innovation. The importance of verifying a chiddush with a Torah authority. 14:25 - QUESTIONS and RESPONSES. 20:44 - TORAH 106. Thoughts of Torah during conception of a child. 28:05 - QUESTIONS and RESPONSES. 29:49 - TORAH 108. 31:42 - Reference to Parparaos LeChochmah . 33:27 - Calculation of time, according to the Torah: 1080 chelakim in an hour. One quarter of an hour is 270, which is the gematria of Ra - evil. 35:54 - The kabbalah of time. *38:09 - TORAH 109. The benefits of visiting the grave site of a tzaddik and praying to HaShem there. The burial place of a tzaddik has the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . Eretz Yisrael has the power to release a person from sins. 40:15 - NOTE about the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh and the Arizal . 41:47 - TORAH 110. Concerning free will, Rebbe Nachman explained it's simplicity: "If you want, you do. If you don't want, you don't." 46:51 - Reference to Sipurey Masiyos , the story of "The Rabbi's Only Son." The enormous contrast between the passing and burial of Moshe Rabbeinu and those of Rabbi Akiva . 04:07 - Account of
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - The Greatness of Rabbi Akiva - The Mystical Connection Between Pinchas and Eliyahu HaNavi - Elisha's Request - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 00:00 - The greatness of Rabbi Akiva . The enormous contrast between the passing and burial of Moshe Rabbeinu and those of Rabbi Akiva . 04:07 - Account of Rabbi Akiva when he was a student of Rabban Gamliel and mistakenly carried a dead body away from the place it should have been buried. 07:21 - The mystical connection between Nadav, Avihu, Pinchas , and Eliyahu HaNavi . 12:32 - * Elisha HaNavi requests and receives "Pi Shneyim" - a double portion - of Eliyahus HaNavi's powers. The Hebrew word נא - please - in Elisha's request hints at the names Nadav and Avihu . 13:35 - Rabbah Bar Abuha asks Eliyahu HaNavi if he is a Kohen . Eliyahu HaNavi's response includes a review of Mishnah . 20:15 - Tosefos questions how Eliyahu HaNavi , as the soul of a Kohen , could revive a dead child. 27:31 - Tosefos brings a third aspect of Eliyahu HaNavi's response to Rabbah Bar Abuha . That the account actually speaks of Eliyahu HaNavi carrying the dead body of Rabbi Akiva , because the body of a tzaddik who passes away does not have the impurity of death. Proof brought from Kasubos , the death of Rabbeinu HaKadosh, Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi . 29:10 - *Visiting the grave sites of certain tzaddikim (such as those of Rochel Imeinu , Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal or Rebbe Nachman of Breslov) does not convey impurity. 30:35 - A deeper explanation: Eliyahu HaNavi was actually hinting about his arrival preceding the arrival of Moshiach ben Yosef . The child who he brought back to life was the prophet Yonah . 33:44 - Is the wife of Eliyahu HaNavi considered a widow? 37:20 - The reasoning of the Maharshal on the status of Eliyahu HaNavi's wife. 37:55 - Who was Eliyahu HaNavi ? All aspects of the different opinions are true. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 112a - Yerusha Designated as Maaser Sheni - Dreams in Halakha - Keeping a Secret - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1974.) True account of a man whose father passed away and left him a yerusha - inheritance - but the son didn't know where the money was, or how much of it was designated a
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 112a - Yerusha Designated as Maaser Sheni - Dreams in Halakha - Keeping a Secret - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1974.) True account of a man whose father passed away and left him a yerusha - inheritance - but the son didn't know where the money was, or how much of it was designated as Maaser Sheni - a specific type of charity. Master of Dreams. There are 2 kinds of dreams: those received by means of an angel and those received by means of an impure spirit. Both the Zohar HaKodesh and the Gemara say that no dream is completely true. How food affects dreams. If a person eats food in purity his dreams will be pure. Why dreams are not reliable for determining halakha . Rav Ami expelled a student from his yeshiva for revealing confidential information that was entrusted to him twenty-two years earlier ( Sanhedrin 31a). The mitzvah to respect bread. The Gemara in Yuma includes discussion about the importance of keeping a secret, bringing an example from the life of Moshe Rabbeinu. לאמור also implies לא אמר - "do not say". Anything said to a person is automatically a secret, unless the speaker verbally states that the listener may share what was said. Bris Amar and Bris HaLoshon . אַחַת׀ דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּיִם־זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִים - "HaShem spoke one thing, I heard two, for HaShem has strength" ( Tehillim 62:12). "Fence of Roses". The tiniest barrier can prevent a Jew from overstepping the bounds of Hilkhos Niddah. Debate between the rabbis and Rabbi Zeira concerning restriction about whom may one mekarev. Elisha HaNavi cursed a mob of disrespectful youths and 42 of them were killed. Elisha was punished with a terminal illness for cursing the youths instead of seeking a way to bring them to teshuvah . Summary and closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 7. The essence of being in this world is to yearn for connection to Hashem. This yearning is what unites the People of Israel. 00:00 - Begins near the end of PARAGRAPH 101 right after the quote from Bava Kama 92. The Arba minim (four species) of the Jewish holiday of Sukkos: Lulav, Esrog, Hadas, Aravos , (palm, citron, myrtle, willow) held in the hand bring parnassa (livelihood). 01:52 - PARAGRAPH 102. Sukkos is the main time for the gathering of lost Jewish souls back into the People of Israel. 11:00 - Everyone gets an aliya to the Torah on Simchas Torah to accomplish the gathering of Sukkos. Part of this gathering includes the souls of our leaders and those who are dear to us who are no longer in this world. We pray at kivrei tzaddikim (gravesites of the righteous) on Erev (the eve of) Rosh Hashanah and Erev Yom Kippur to include their souls in the assemblies on Sukkos and Simchas Torah . *13:26 - PARAGRAPH 105. Hilkhos Birkhas HaReyach What is the spiritual difference between eating something and smelling something pleasant? *21:58 - The enjoyment of fragrance needs no concluding blessing, as food does. 23:35 - PARAGRAPH 106. Yearning for holiness is accomplished through Eretz Yisrael - the Holy Land of Israel. 34:12 - PARAGRAPH 107. Avraham Avinu (Abraham) and the blessings of Eretz Yisrael . 37:10 - The letter " hey " added to the name of Avram to create " Avraham ". The qualities of the letter hey are an aspect of yearning. Yearning for holiness is the ikar (essence) of serving Hashem .

Breaking bread, which part do we break off? 06:10 -
lessons.bodyText: (OC2 Lessons 023-2 through 027-1 are in the series " Devarim HaNohagim BaSeudah ". Betziyas HaPas 4 is included in Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 4, and Betziyas HaPas 5 begins with OC2 - Lesson 027-2.) Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Introduction. 02:59 - PARAGRAPH 1. Breaking bread, which part do we break off? 06:10 - PARAGRAPH 2. Matzah - mochin (consciousness). 10:22 - The ten types of work that contribute to the creation of bread. 11:54 - The final refinement of bread is by making the bracha . 14:55 - The importance of eating in a state of kedusha (holiness). 16:40 - Why we emphasize saying the " hey " in hamotzei when making the blessing. 17:49 - Why Matza is broken into portions. 21:30 - A poor person (a person without consciousness of Hashem) is not considered truly alive. 22:16 - Tzedakah (charity) is called " prusa " (portion). 23:09 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why matzah is called lechem oni - "Bread of Poverty". Just as a poor person eats from a portion, we eat from a broken piece. *26:17 - Hilchos aveylus (laws of mourning): The first meal that a mourner eats, he's not permitted to prepare for himself. 28:11 - Changing the " ches " of chumetz to the " hey " of matzah . 28:30 - Another definition of lechem oni - bread that is spoken about. 31:02 - PARAGRAPH 4. Based on Likutey Moharan Torah 5, the kabbalistic meaning of thunder. The main yirah (awe/fear of Hashem) that a person experiences is at the time of eating. See also Likutey Moharan 2 ( Tinyana ), Torah 7. *34:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. The first portion of bread that a person's supposed to eat is the first part that received the heat of the fire in baking (Practical note on how to cut and portion out a loaf of bread: after washing netilas yadayim , hold the loaf facing you, make a nick in the bread that pierces from the top to the bottom of the bread, then put down the knife and make the bracha , holding the bread in ten fingers. Then pick up the knife and cut the slices but not all the way through. Leave the pieces attached at the bottom. Then put down the knife and tear off each piece. This mesorah was observed at the Shabbos tish of R' Michel Dorfman z"l .) *37:02 - PARAGRAPH 6. Purchase of Ma'aras HaMachpeleh was the beginning of acquiring Eretz Yisrael . The main flow of blessing comes through Eretz Yisrael , so the main elevation of bread takes places here. The letter hey in Avraham's name was added in connection with his entering Eretz Yisrael . 40:11 - PARAGRAPH 7. The connection between Avraham Avinu 's purchase of Ma'aras HaMachpeleh and the holiness in matzah /bread. 41:12 - It's important to eat meals in a state of simcha - joy.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 2 - Put Yourself in Good Hands - Hiskashrus - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. "It's very good for a person to rely completely on HaShem " - giving over all the day's thoughts, words, and actions to HaShem . Hiskashrus - התקשרות. "If a person has not studied the laws of Shabbos at least 70 times, they can be confident that they're breaking Shabbos ." What to do until then? Pray to keep Shabbos .

lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 124a - Sanhedrin 90 - Every Jew Has a Portion in Olam Haba - The Hereafter - What Is Gan Eden ? Rebbe Nachman's Stunning Assurance - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Every Jew has a portion in Olam Haba - the Hereafter. Tzaddikim receive 310 worlds in Gan Eden . The 10 sefiros . What is Gan Eden ? Th
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 124a - Sanhedrin 90 - Every Jew Has a Portion in Olam Haba - The Hereafter - What Is Gan Eden ? Rebbe Nachman's Stunning Assurance - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Every Jew has a portion in Olam Haba - the Hereafter. Tzaddikim receive 310 worlds in Gan Eden . The 10 sefiros . What is Gan Eden ? The purpose of creation is to merge upper with lower spiritual levels. Introduction to the Shemos - Names of HaShem . The name ישראל contains the initial letters of the 3 Avos and 4 Imahos of Am Yisrael . Expansions of the Names of HaShem: AV, SaG, BaN, MaH . *Hearing words of Kabbala benefit the soul even if the concepts are not fully grasped by the intellect. The 3 stages of Gan Eden : 1) The 40-Year Reign of Moshiach , 2) Techiyas HaMeysim - Resurrection of the Dead, 3) The renewal of all creation. *Rebbe Nachman's stunning assurance: even though not all souls will merit the third and eternal level of Gan Eden , all who have attached themselves to him will certainly merit it. Exceptions to the rule that every Jew has a portion in Olam Haba . Why is belief in Techiyas HaMeysim fundamental to faith in H aShem and His Torah? Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 126b - Sanhedrin - Resurrection of the Dead - Sefer Daniel - Chananya - Mishael - Azaria - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Techiyas HaMeisim - Resurrection of the Dead. Yechezkel HaNavi's vision of the dry bones - ( Yechezkel 37, 1-14). Why are the bones in Yechezkel HaNavi's vision called "dry"? There are miracles greater than restoring the dead back to life. Rebbe Nachman devoted his teachings to those who had lost their faith. Every tzaddik is at a different level to accomplish different things. Sefer Daniel: Chananya, Mishael, and Azaria. The words of Nevuchadnezzar. The Zohar HaKadosh on angelic beings. After the miracle of being saved, Chananya, Mishael, and Azaria wanted to return to Eretz Yisrael to avoid being honored by Nevuchadnezzar. וְה֣וּא עֹמֵ֔ד בֵּ֥ין הַֽהֲדַסִּ֖ים - "...He stood among the hadassim " ( Zecharia 1:8). What happened to Daniel?

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Sanhedrin 93 - The Geulah Will Come Through Teshuvah and Tefilah - Yitro - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Sefer Ezra was originally written in two sections that are now called "Ezra" and "Nechemia" . Why does a person suddenly become frightened? Mazal is like a heavenly subconscious. Reciting Kriyat Shema is a remedy for inexplicable fear. "The goats at the slaughterhouse are fatter than I am." Tefilah is the key to getting along with others. לְמַרְבֵּ֨ה (כתיב לְםַרְבֵּ֨ה) הַמִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּלְשָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין־קֵ֗ץ - "To him who increases the authority, and for peace without end... " ( Yeshaya 9:6). False Messiahs. Imminent arrival of Mashiach . "The geulah for this long, dark night will come only through teshuvah and tefilah" . Blessing to fulfil the advice of the Navi in our time. Yitro, the father-in-law of Moshe Rabbeinu . Yitro was present at Matan Torah . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

The Gemara describes how Antoninus had a secret tunnel excavated between their houses so that he could visit and serve Rebbe. 05:42 - Antoninus asked Rebbe, "Will I be with you in Gan Eden?" 11:04 - The importance of binding oneself to a tzaddik . The importance of attaching oneself to a tzaddik . How is this done on a practical level? Following his advice. For example, Rebbe Nachman advises to do hisbodedus (pray in solitude) every day, in addition to the prayers with a minyan . By following this advice, a person "binds" himself to Rebbe Nachman. 13:26 - Ketia Bar Shalom - a righteous convert to Judaism. 23:18 - Rav Nasan z"l made sure that his watch was accurate because he wanted to be careful not to waste time. Why Rav Nasan of Nemirov z"l was succeeded by Reb Nachman Tulchin z"l . 24:15 - Onkeles the Ger . Studying Targum (translation of the Torah by Onkeles) is a segulah for finding one's zivug (marriage partner). 35:59 - Targum begematria is tardeyma (deep sleep). 27:00 - The tardeyma of Avraham Avinu . 37:40 - Eretz Yisrael is the most precious location on earth. *40:25 - Hashem Himself protects Eretz Yisrael .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov 164 - Horayot 10 - HaShem Melech - The Anointing Oil - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1977.) Yesharim darchei HaShem - "The ways of HaShem are always righteous" . The mitzvah of Korbon Pesach requires the right kavana - intention. Lot and his two daughters. Yehudah and Tamar . The crim
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov 164 - Horayot 10 - HaShem Melech - The Anointing Oil - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1977.) Yesharim darchei HaShem - "The ways of HaShem are always righteous" . The mitzvah of Korbon Pesach requires the right kavana - intention. Lot and his two daughters. Yehudah and Tamar . The crime of Zimri caused the death of thousands of Jews. Malkhus is related to dinim - negative decrees. Both Shlomo HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech were anointed. When the Kingdom of Israel was split, the kings of the 10 Tribes were not anointed. The son of a king does not need to be anointed. Three exceptions when the son of an anointed king was also anointed. How a king is anointed. The Kohen Gadol is anointed by pouring the oil in the shape of the Greek letter "X". Tefillin are called "Totafos" . Aesop's Fables originate from Medrash . How the anointing oil was made. The anointing of Aharon HaKohen . The beard must be cut according to halakha . The king of Israel must have his hair cut every day. Anointing with Keren vs. Kad - Why Shaul HaMelech's kingdom was only temporary. The word "melech" indicates Din. "HaShem melech, HaShem malach, HaShem yimloch leolam vaed" ( Machzor Rosh Hashanah ). Menatzpach is begematria "melech, malach, yimloch" . The word yimloch means "will rule". The gematria of "HaShem melech, HaShem malach, HaShem yimloch" is "Moshiach" . Question about Dovid HaMelech , who always honored the decision of the Sanhedrin. The anointing oil was hidden by King Yishayahu . Moshiach will be anointed by Eliyahu HaNavi . Closing chizuk and blessing. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: Ein Yaakov 166b - Shemona Perakim - The Eight Chapters of the Rambam 1b - 5 Functions of the Soul
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Ein Yaakov - Shemona Perakim - Eight Chapters of the Rambam - 5 Functions of the Soul - HaMisorer - HaSikhli - Moderation Heals the Nefesh - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1977-11-16.) The Shemona Perakim - Eight Chapters - of the Rambam is his introduction to Pirkei Avos . 00:00 - Review. Kabbalist
lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shemona Perakim - Eight Chapters of the Rambam - 5 Functions of the Soul - HaMisorer - HaSikhli - Moderation Heals the Nefesh - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1977-11-16.) The Shemona Perakim - Eight Chapters - of the Rambam is his introduction to Pirkei Avos . 00:00 - Review. Kabbalistic structure of the soul is (going upward): Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Chaya, Yechida . 01:00 - The Rambam is not addressing the structure of the soul, he's presenting 5 functions of the soul. The first 3 functions: 1) HaMazon - the power of the body to be nourished, grow, and reproduce; 2) HaMargish - the spiritual aspects of the 5 senses; 3) HaMedameh - the power of imagination. 02:44 - End of review. 4th function of the soul: HaMisorer - the power of the soul to awaken the body to a state of desire or to dislike. This power is the source of human emotions, such as anger, fear, courage, love, or hatred. 04:10 - The 5th function of the soul is called HaSikhli - the power to reason - intelligence. 06:12 - PEREK 2. Mitzvos and aveyros are done only through 2 of these 5 functions: HaMisorer and HaMargish . 07:56 - HaSikhli does not take part in sin. *12:16 - "Just as a body become sick, so, too, can a neshama become sick." 15:28 - PEREK 4. 20:16 - הסתפקות - Histapkus - being happy with one's lot. 21:56 - Arrogance. 23:26 - Too much shyness prevents a person from spiritual advancement. 25:45 - Treating a spiritual illness is done by leaning toward the opposite extreme of any given negative character trait, but only temporarily. 28:27 - An example of how a person can be cured of being a miser. 35:15 - Analogy of a healthy person taking medicine because he sees it cures a person who is ill. ***37:06 - "Do not go to any extremes. It's enough if you will obey the mitzvos of the Torah." Moderation heals the nefesh . 38:53 - Why certain teachings of the Rambam are not accepted in chassidus . 42:36 - Emunas Tzaddikim is above all. 43:17 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: lm1-242 - Likutey Moharan 88 - Likutey Moharan 89 - Likutey Moharan 90 - Likutey Moharan 91 - Spiritual Pupose of Clouds - Tznius - Modesty Protects Blessing - Faith Expressed Through the Hands
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 88 - Likutey Moharan 89 - Likutey Moharan 90 - Likutey Moharan 91 - Spiritual Purpose of Clouds - Tznius - Modesty Protects Blessing - Faith Expressed Through the Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 242. Recorded in 1981.) 00:00 - TORAH 088 - PARAGRAPH 1. הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם | בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמ
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 88 - Likutey Moharan 89 - Likutey Moharan 90 - Likutey Moharan 91 - Spiritual Purpose of Clouds - Tznius - Modesty Protects Blessing - Faith Expressed Through the Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 242. Recorded in 1981.) 00:00 - TORAH 088 - PARAGRAPH 1. הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם | בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר - "Who covers the heavens with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth..." ( Tehillim 147:8). Why is the sky darkened with clouds before it rains? Yerida always precedes aliya . Blessing comes through the Tzaddik . 06:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. The tzaddik is in danger when he becomes known. Machlokes (dispute) for the sake of Heaven will arise against him to protect him. 19:24 - TORAH 89. וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְ֖עַט מֵֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ - "Yet You have made him slightly less than the angels, and You have crowned him with glory and majesty" ( Tehillim 8:6). Tznius protects blessing. All human lack is a manifestation of a lack in the Shekhina - Divine Presence of HaShem . This could cause a person to feel sadness. The antidote is for the person to rejoice in awareness of this correspondence, which then crowns him with joy. 33:26 - Q&R - What are the mayim duchrin/nukvin? 38:00 - *TORAH 90. אָֽ֜נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּֽיהֹוָֽה - יִתַּ֚מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים | מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ - "...I shall rejoice in HaShem. Sin will be destroyed from the earth..." ( Tehillim 104:34-35). Shattering of the vessels. Why do people feel a lack? Why do we need things? The main repair of deficiencies is to do mitzvos with simcha - joy. The gematria of eretz is 91 which is the milui of Elokim . NOTE: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal used to say that if a person would always be happy, he would never sin. 45:20 - TORAH 91. וַיְהִ֥י יָדָ֛יו אֱמוּנָ֖ה עַד־בֹּ֥א הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ - "...and his hands were in faith until sunset" ( Shemos 17: Beshalach ). Lifting one's hands after washing for eating bread, draws chokhma - wisdom - into the hands. Even our hands can express our faith in HaShem .

lessons.bodyText: Purim - Likutey Moharan 10 - Dancing, Clapping Hands - Walls of Yerushalayim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Introduction. The teachings of the Likutey Moharan are not separate entities; they inform and flow into one another. PARAGRAPH 1. "Harsh decrees against the People of Israel can be mitigated through dancing and clapping hands." 09:36 - PARAGRAPH 3. Avraham Aveinu called the Presence of HaShem a Har (mountain). Yitzchak called it a Sadeh (field). Yaakov called it a Bayis (house). כי ביתי בית תפלה יקרא לכל העמים (ישעיהו נ"ו) "For My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations." ( Yishayahu 56:7) 15:42 - Macheneh (encampment) is an aspect of how the Beis HaMikdash in Yerushalayim protects Israel. Shlomo HaMelech knew how to build each wall of the Holy Temple with respect to the machaneh which is begematria 103. First wall: machaneh of kedusha . Second wall: Har of Avraham Aveinu , twice machaneh . Third wall: Sadeh of Yitzchak Aveinu is three times machaneh . Fourth wall: Bayis of Yaakov Aveinu is four times machaneh . And the roof is in the merit of Moshe Rabbeinu , the number of his tefilos alluded to in the word VaEeschanan is begematria 515, which is five times machaneh . 21:02 - When HaShem is praised by lowly people, He is exalted the most. *26:48 - PARAGRAPH 4. Elevating tefilah to the level that its visible and accessible even to non-Jews is only achieved through the tzaddikim of the generation. "When someone has a person in their family who is ill, they should turn to a chakham (wise man) to pray for them." ( Bava Basra 116a) מי שיש לו חולה בתוך ביתו, ילך אצל חכם ויבקש עליו רחמים: (בבא בתרא קטז)

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 50 - The Truth About Doctors - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw18a. Recorded in 1976.) SICHAH 50. The Talmud states: טוֹב שֶׁבָּרוֹפְאִים – לְגֵיהִנָּם - "The best of doctors goes to Gehinnam " ( Kiddushin 82a). What does this mean? The angel of death has assistants. What should a patient do after the doctors have "given up" on him? Chezkiyah Melech Yehudah hid the Sefer HaRefuos - "The Book of Cures" - and HaShem considered this good. Why? וְרַפֹּ֥א יְרַפֵּֽא - "...and the doctor shall heal" ( Shemos 21:19, Mishpatim ). Rabbi Elazar b'Rav Shimon Bar Yochai zal explained the meaning of "Cure us and we shall be cured" : a person who is ill usually needs to return to a doctor several times, but HaShem has the power to cure a person at once. Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal . " HaShem is so great He can even heal through a doctor!" - Rabbi Eliyah Chaim Rosen zal . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 50b - 51 - Rabbi Yosei and the Herbalist - Fourth Dimension - Extraterrestrials - Aliens - What Is Important in This World - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw18b. Recorded in 1976.) SICHAH 50b. In our generation, we're not at a high enough spiritual level to rely only prayer to recover from illness. We use doctors but maintain faith in HaShem . "HaShem is so powerful that He can heal a person even if a doctor's treating him" - Rabbi Eliyah Chaim Rosen zal. Story of Rabbi Yosei and the herbalist ( Menachos ). The origin of extraterrestrials. Why do aliens not invade the earth? Story of a rabbi's visit to the Fourth Dimension. Rabbi Yosei returns to Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . Spiritual powers in vegetation - lowly "moss" is used for purification from contact with a dead body. In our generation, Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal avoided doctors and lived to be 94. "We cannot say that everyone should always avoid doctors... so if they are consulted, at least a person should maintain strong faith that it is only HaShem Who cures." SICHAH 51. Material gain in this world is not worth much. Stay young. A person shouldn't be wasteful of his abilities. Don't let this material world fool you. HaShem holds non-Jews responsible for their deeds, especially if they harm Jews. Milchamas HaYetzer - maintaining purity on the battlefield of the heart.

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Parshas Tetzaveh - Am Yisrael as a Fruitful Tree - Hiskashrus to the Tzaddik - Nusach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. The People of Israel are compared to an olive tree and a grape vine. The role of Moshe Rabbeinu as the Tzaddik of his generation, and how the dynamic between Tzaddik and Am Yisrael translates into our lives today. The Tzaddik knows how to activate, incorporate, and unite all the Tefilos, Torah study, and Mitzvos of those connected to him. Hiskashrus - attachment to- the Tzaddik is done through studying his Torah, following his advice, visiting his grave site, giving Tzedakah to support his teachings, and a verbal statement made daily: הריני מקשר עצמי לכל הצדיקים האמתיים שבדורנו, ולכל הצדיקים האמתיים שוכני עפר קדושים אשר בארץ המה, ובפרט לרבינו הקדוש, צדיק יסוד עולם, נחל נובע מקור חכמה, רבינו נחמן בן פיגא, זכותו יגן עלינו ועל כל ישראל אמן "I’m now attaching myself to all the true Tzaddikim of our generation and to all the true Tzaddikim who have passed away and are resting in the earth, and especially to our holy teacher, righteous foundation of the world, 'Flowing Stream, Source of Wisdom' Rabbeinu Nachman ben Feigeh, may his merit protect us, Amen." It's customary for men to say this when wrapping themselves in the Talis each morning. Women say this before Shacharis, after the statement "Hareini....'v'ahavta l'reyecha c'mocha" - "I hereby accept upon myself the mitzvah of 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'" More about hiskashrus to the Tzaddik from Rabbi Nasan Maimon is HERE and also HERE . More in depth about hiskashrus to the Tzaddik from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal is HERE: SICHOS HARAN 22 .

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 86b - 87 - 88 - 89 - Wedding Customs - Crying for a Beautiful Esrog - Free Speech - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw23b. Recorded on 1977-01-03.) SICHAH 86. Wedding Customs. A wife receives advancement through her husband, but does not descend with him if he falls. Parnassah (livelihood) depends on the respect a husband shows for his wife. Why is the face of a Jewish bride covered with a veil? "The beautiful maiden without eyes" ( Zohar 96-97) refers to emunah - faith. The kovod - honor - of HaShem is that which is hidden. Taharas Mishpacha - laws of marriage purity. The importance of tznius - modesty in dress and behavior. A wedding is compared to the giving of the Torah at Sinai. The discourse given by the Chasan - groom - at his wedding helps to unite the couple. The custom of dancers doing somersaults at a wedding alludes to Moshe Rabbeinu ascending Har Sinai and HaShem descending (so to speak) to give the Torah. SICHAH 87. Crying for a Beautiful Esrog . The esrog is analogous to a wife. The moach (marrow) in the bones is the moach - brain - of the body. The marrow is sustained by fats and fluids. Why a foolish person often has a beautiful wife. The wisdom of a person enlightens his face. His path before him is illuminated, he can see clearly. Spiritual dimensions of the Lulav (date palm branch) and Esrog (citron). The beauty of the Esrog comes from the tears a Jew sheds on Yom Kippur. SICHAH 88. Free Speech. Redeeming speech from exile. SICHAH 89. Clearing the slate with kindness. One sin leads to another. The 13 Attributes of Mercy. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 94 - 95 - 96 - 97 - 98 - Machlokes - A Tzaddik Builds Through Conflict - What's In a Name? - Live in the Hereafter - The Power of Sefer Tehillim - Hisodedus - Tikkun HaKlali - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw24b. Recorded on 1977-01-17.) SICHAH 94. The Brighter Side of Machlokes . Distinctions are made through intelligence and give rise to strife. Torah study requires contention and a tzaddik builds through conflict. HaShem created darkness as well as light. Darkness is not simply the absence of light. Darkness is a creation in itself. SICHAH 95. What's In a Name? The name of a child is the garment of his soul and is decreed in heaven. It is customary to add to a person's name if he falls seriously ill. HaShem created all the worlds by means of His Name. The first question a person is asked after his passing is "What is your name?" His name clothes him in Olam Haba . It's good to complete tasks quickly, because one never knows how much more time they have in this world. SICHAH 96. Live in the Hereafter. Get used to being in Olam HaBa . The ability to forget is sometimes a blessing. What is Gan Eden like? Every tzaddik is granted 310 worlds in Olam HaBa . He builds these worlds himself during his lifetime in Olam HaZeh . Every mitzvah creates an angel. Tolerance and patience create these worlds. SICHAH 97. *The power of Sefer Tehillim . "To be able to say Tehillim with kavana is a very big zechus ." The reward for delivering good news is the ability to say Tehillim with kavana . When a person says Tehillim with sincerity and focus, it's as if Dovid HaMelech himself were saying the words. Delivering good news brings the merit to say Tehillim with kavana . SICHAH 98. The reward for saying Tehillim with kavana . The reward for saying Tehillim is as great as the reward for learning Torah. Saying Tehillim benefits someone who is ill. The supportive qualities that betachon brings to an invalid. Hisbodedus - "Every blade of grass sings praises to HaShem" . * Tehillim can be used as hisbodedus . The power of Tikkun HaKlali . Tehillim begematria is 485 to counteract the name of an impure force L--- which is also begematria 485. NOTE - Torah study protects a person from death. The word התלמוד is also begematria 485. Keyl Elokim is also begematria 485. Tikkun HaKlali should be said with emunah that it will have a beneficial effect. These chapters of Tehillim are: 16, 32, 41, 42, 59,7, 90, 105, 137, 150.] True account of a city where a simple Jew was mocked for saying Tehillim . When this simple Jew passed away, the residents of the city were forced to abandon their homes and flee for their lives because the city was consumed in fire. It's very good to say Tehillim every day, especially Tikkun HaKlali . On Shabbos it's recommended to say all of Tehillim Perek 119 through the end of Sefer Tehillim . *Saying Tikkun HaKlali is like saying the entire Sefer Tehillim . Closing blessings.

If a person feels sad, lazy, or unfocused during tefilah - it's due to a lack in emunah -faith. Through his analogy of how a grain of wheat sprouts and grows, Rebbe Nachman teaches that there's a power in growth itself . 08:20 - PARAGRAPH 2. We say "May He lead us with uprightness to our Land" immediately before we say the Krias Shema to establish the connection between Emunah and Eretz Yisrael .

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 199 - 200 - 201 - 202 - 203 - 204 - 205 - Tzedakah - Tikkun HaKlali - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Lesson 288. Recorded in 1982.) TORAH 199. Preventing the death of one's wife. TORAH 200. "Whoever fulfills the Torah in poverty will fulfill it in wealth" ( Avos 4:9). TORAH 201. It is a custom to pray loudly on Pesach . The word Pesach alludes to the phrase פה סח - "the mouth speaks". TORAH 202. הנשים דעתן קלה - "Woman's daas is flexible" ( Shabbos 33b). "No matter what a person's gender, craving honor is a sign of foolishness" (Notes on Likutey Moharan 202, Breslov Research Institute). TORAH 203. Shekhina - Malkhus . TORAH 204. Tzedakah given to a talmid chakham is elevated to the level of Torah itself. "Sin cannot extinguish Torah" ( Sotah 21a). TORAH 205. Tikkun HaKlali . The sequence of 10 Kapitlach Tehillim recommended by Rebbe Nachman to repair the soul: 16, 32, 41, 42, 59, 77, 90, 105, 137, 150.

lessons.title: R' Rosenfeld - Sipurey Maasios 01 - The Prince of Precious Stones
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Sipurey Maasios - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal explains Rabbi Nachman's story "The Prince of Precious Stones" in light of the Zohar HaKodesh . He reveals how counting the Omer relates to the 42-letter Name of HaShem alluded to in this story. Text: Sichos HaRan 147. (Lesson rw30b. Recorded in 1977.) INTRODUCTION to the
lessons.bodyText: Sipurey Maasios - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal explains Rabbi Nachman's story "The Prince of Precious Stones" in light of the Zohar HaKodesh . He reveals how counting the Omer relates to the 42-letter Name of HaShem alluded to in this story. Text: Sichos HaRan 147. (Lesson rw30b. Recorded in 1977.) INTRODUCTION to the Sipurey Maasios - The Stories of Rebbe Nachman. The story of The Prince of Precious Stones begins. The Jews of the kingdom searched for a tzaddik and found him. An unusually gifted daughter is born to the king. A second hidden tzaddik is found. The princess pretends to be ill. Leprosy is fatal. Through magic, the princess almost kills her brother, the prince. The tzaddik prescribes a remedy for the king. Rebbe Nachman gave permission to interpret his stories: the prince is Moshe Rabbeinu . The precious stones are the souls of Am Yisrael . תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי־קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת - "...the holy stones are scattered at the head of every street" ( Eicha 4:1). The sages of the Gemara say that the mother of Moshe Rabbeinu , Yocheved, gave birth to 600,000 souls - רַבִּי הָיָה יוֹשֵׁב וְדוֹרֵשׁ וְנִתְנַמְנֵם הַצִּבּוּר, בִּקֵּשׁ לְעוֹרְרָן, אָמַר יָלְדָה אִשָּׁה אַחַת בְּמִצְרַיִם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא בְּכֶרֶס אֶחָת, וְהָיָה שָׁם תַּלְמִיד אֶחָד וְרַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי שְׁמוֹ, אָמַר לֵיהּ מָאן הַוָּת כֵּן, אָמַר לֵיהּ זוֹ יוֹכֶבֶד שֶׁיָּלְדָה אֶת משֶׁה שֶׁשָּׁקוּל כְּנֶגֶד שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל ( Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:3). יוכבד begematria is מ"ב. Moshe Rabbeinu became leprous when Basya bas Paraoh rescued him. How the story of "The Prince of Precious Stones" applies to every Jew. The principle of Klipah Kadma lePri: - the shell/rind precedes the fruit. Explanation of the structure of the Shem Mem Beis - Ana BeKoach . Each line of Ana BeKoach corresponds to one of the days of the week. The third line of Ana BeKoach . The fourth line of Ana BeKoach . The main goal is to strengthen emunah . Closing blessing.

lessons.title: R' Rosenfeld - Sipurey Maasios 06 - Introduction to "The Seven Beggars" and Day 1
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal introduces the last story of the Sipurey Maasios ( Stories of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov ) to begin the deep and wondrous tale of " The Seven Beggars ". Text: Sichos HaRan 149. (Lesson rw33a. Recorded on 1977-09-05.) Sichos HaRan 149 - Seven Beggars - Lesson 1 - A Prince Mourns His Fall from
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal introduces the last story of the Sipurey Maasios ( Stories of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov ) to begin the deep and wondrous tale of " The Seven Beggars ". Text: Sichos HaRan 149. (Lesson rw33a. Recorded on 1977-09-05.) Sichos HaRan 149 - Seven Beggars - Lesson 1 - A Prince Mourns His Fall from Faith - Two Lost Children - Yearning for the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw33a. Recorded on 1977-09-05.) Introduction to the Sipurey Maasios and to the story of The Seven Beggars . "Even if you don't understand the deeper meanings of the story, if you only hear the words on a simple level, you will understand it more fully in the Olam HaEmes - World of Truth." Seder Yom of Rebbe Nachman. "The sleep of a tzaddik is his visit to heaven." There are two ways to learn Rebbe Nachman's seforim - first at the surface level and then in depth. The Seven Beggars. "I will tell you how people were once filled with joy." A prince mourns his fall from faith. Two lost children cry for help. One after another, Seven Beggars appear. Each one provides the two lost children with food and a mysterious blessing. The two children find a path, reach a town, and decide to become beggars. A pit is dug out to serve as a wedding hall for the two lost children. *At times of joy, a person must remind themselves of kindnesses he has received. The children's yearning demonstrates how yearning for the Tzaddik Emes enables him to create garments for any soul, no matter how lost. The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." All blessing is preceded by אתערותא דלתתא. The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." All seven beggars are one and the same person: the Tzaddik Emes .

lessons.bodyText: Sipurey Maasios 07 - The Seven Beggars - Day 1 - The Blind Beggar - Day 2 - The Deaf Beggar - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw33b. Recorded in 1977.) Review of the story thus far. On Day 1 of the Sheva Brachos (seven-day wedding celebration) the Blind Beggar explains his initial blessing to them by telling a story that reveals the powers of memory. The Blind Beggar reveals to the chatan and kallah that "I am very old, but very young." The Blind Beggar now presents his initial blessing of long life to the couple as a wedding gift. The Deaf Beggar appears on Day 2 of the children's Sheva Brachos and describes the satisfaction of his good life.

lessons.bodyText: Sipurey Maasios - Seven Beggars - Day 4 - Beggar With a Crooked Neck - Story of Two Birds - Prophecy - Tikkun Chatzos - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Text: Sichos HaRan , Sichah 149. (Lesson rw35a. Recorded ca. November 1977.) Brief review of the story until Day 4 of the Sheva Brachos . Day 4 - Beggar With a Crooked Neck. He closed off his throat to be free of the worthless sounds of the world. Instead, he was able to produce all the non-verbal sounds of the world, including those of musical instruments. Story of Two Birds who lost one another. The Two Birds represent the sefiros of Netzach and Hod , through which prophesy emanates into the physical world. These two birds are also related to the korbon brought by a leper when he is cured. The separation of the two birds represents the separation of the Shekhina from Am Yisrael at the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash. Tikkun Chatzos. The Tzaddik can correct this separation and reunite the two birds. The Fourth Beggar describes how he can do this. Then he demonstrates his power of reproducing any sound and throwing his voice. How the power of the Fourth Beggar relates to the life of Shmuel HaNavi as the voice of nevuah - prophecy. While the Shekhina is in exile, even the blessings have been given to the klipos - forces of impurity. Kibbutz Galios - the Kol Shofar reunites the Shekhina and Bnei Yisrael . The chasan and kallah receive the wedding gift of the Fourth Beggar and their rejoicing leads to the appearance of the Fifth Beggar. Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

A man's wife is his crown. אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ - "A virtuous woman is the crown of her husband..." ( Mishlei 12:4). "Real life begins when a person passes away." Boaz and Rus. Who had a greater test - Yosef HaTzaddik or Boaz ? The Yetzer Hara - the Evil Inclination - past and present. Palti ben Laish . SICHAH 115. Mastering physical desires. The key to being victorious is tefilah . Closing blessings.

Be stubborn in pleading with HaShem - "HaShem, please take me back!" Hisbodedus is most effective when done surrounded by nature. Hisbodedus is best from chatzos layla (midnight) until morning because it's quiet. Question about dangers of going out at night into nature. During Rebbe Nachman's times, these dangers were less. "Nowadays, times have changed." Even a plant in a flowerpot on your porch can also lend power to hisbodedus . SICHAH 145. The origin and tremendous value of the Likutey Tefilos . Today, with our tefilos we bring korbonos . SICHAH 146. Mesiras Nefesh has many forms. Davening with kavana is similar to giving one's life al kiddush HaShem . If a person is suddenly has doubts, crying out to HaShem will purify his mind and resolve doubts. All tzaddikim throughout every generation reached their greatness only through hisbodedus .
