lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 147 - Sipurey Maasios - Prince of Precious Stones in Light of the Zohar HaKodesh - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw30b. Recorded in 1977.) INTRODUCTION to the Sipurey Maasios - The Stories of Rebbe Nachman. The story of the Prince of Precious Stones begins. The Jews of the kingdom searched for a tzaddik and found him. An unusually gifted daughter is born to the king. A second hidden tzaddik is found. The princess pretends to be ill. Leprosy is fatal. Through magic, the princess almost kills her brother, the prince. The tzaddik prescribes a remedy for the king. Rebbe Nachman gave permission to interpret his stories: the prince is Moshe Rabbeinu . The precious stones are the souls of Am Yisrael . תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי־קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת - "...the holy stones are scattered at the head of every street" ( Eicha 4:1). The sages of the Gemara say that the mother of Moshe Rabbeinu , Yocheved, gave birth to 600,000 souls - רַבִּי הָיָה יוֹשֵׁב וְדוֹרֵשׁ וְנִתְנַמְנֵם הַצִּבּוּר, בִּקֵּשׁ לְעוֹרְרָן, אָמַר יָלְדָה אִשָּׁה אַחַת בְּמִצְרַיִם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא בְּכֶרֶס אֶחָת, וְהָיָה שָׁם תַּלְמִיד אֶחָד וְרַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי שְׁמוֹ, אָמַר לֵיהּ מָאן הַוָּת כֵּן, אָמַר לֵיהּ זוֹ יוֹכֶבֶד שֶׁיָּלְדָה אֶת משֶׁה שֶׁשָּׁקוּל כְּנֶגֶד שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל ( Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:3). יוכבד begematria is מ"ב. Moshe Rabbeinu became leprous when Basya Bas Paraoh rescued him. How the story of "The Prince of Precious Stones" applies to every Jew. The principle of Klipah Kadma lePri: - the shell/rind precedes the fruit. Explanation of the structure of the Shem Mem Beis - Ana BeKoach . Each line of Ana BeKoach corresponds to one of the days of the week. The third line of Ana BeKoach . The fourth line of Ana BeKoach . The main goal is to strengthen emunah . Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 149 - Seven Beggars - Lesson 1 - A Prince Mourns His Fall from Faith - Two Lost Children - Yearning for the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw33a. Recorded on 1977-09-05.) Introduction to the Sipurey Maasios and to the story of The Seven Beggars . "Even if you don't understand the deeper meanings of the story, if you only hear the words on a simple level, you will understand it more fully in the Olam HaEmes - World of Truth." Seder Yom of Rebbe Nachman. "The sleep of a tzaddik is his visit to heaven." There are two ways to learn Rebbe Nachman's seforim - first at the surface level and then in depth. The Seven Beggars. "I will tell you how people were once filled with joy." A prince mourns his fall from faith. Two lost children cry for help. One after another, Seven Beggars appear. Each one provides the two lost children with food and a mysterious blessing. The two children find a path, reach a town, and decide to become beggars. A pit is dug out to serve as a wedding hall for the two lost children. *At times of joy, a person must remind themselves of kindnesses he has received. The children's yearning demonstrates how yearning for the Tzaddik Emes enables him to create garments for any soul, no matter how lost. The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." All blessing is preceded by אתערותא דלתתא. The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." All seven beggars are one and the same person: the Tzaddik Emes .

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 149 - Seven Beggars - Lesson 5 - Day 4 - Story of Two Birds - Prophecy - Tikkun Chatzos - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Text: Sichos HaRan , Sichah 149. (Lesson rw35a. Recorded ca. November 1977.) Brief review of the story until Day 4 of the Sheva Brachos . Day 4 - Beggar With a Crooked Neck. He closed off his throat to be free of the worthless sounds of the world. Instead, he was able to produce all the non-verbal sounds of the world, including those of musical instruments. Story of Two Birds who lost one another. The Two Birds represent the sefiros of Netzach and Hod , through which prophesy emanates into the physical world. These two birds are also related to the korbon brought by a leper when he is cured. The separation of the two birds represents the separation of the Shekhina from Am Yisrael at the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash. Tikkun Chatzos. The Tzaddik can correct this separation and reunite the two birds. The Fourth Beggar describes how he can do this. Then he demonstrates his power of reproducing any sound and throwing his voice. How the power of the Fourth Beggar relates to the life of Shmuel HaNavi as the voice of nevuah - prophecy. While the Shekhina is in exile, even the blessings have been given to the klipos - forces of impurity. Kibbutz Galios - the Kol Shofar reunites the Shekhina and Bnei Yisrael . The chasan and kallah receive the wedding gift of the Fourth Beggar and their rejoicing leads to the appearance of the Fifth Beggar. Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 153 - 154 - Based on 2Likutey Moharan 78 - Nitzavim - Prustock - The Tzaddik Emes Sometimes Appears To Be an Ordinary Person - The Torah Sustains the World - Derech Eretz - The Path to Eretz Yisrael - Treasury of Free Kindness - Ain Shum Yiush Klal - Never Give Up! Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw37b. Recorded in 1977.) 00:00 - Text of 2Likutey Moharan 78 is first studied in order to understand Sichah 153. ***02:00 - Nitzavim. When Rebbe Nachman begins with the word דע - "know" - he is about to bring a concept from Olam HaAtzilus . The Torah is required for life, as in כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֨יךָ֙ וְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔יךָ - "...for it is your life and the length of your days..." ( Devarim 30:20, Nitzavim ). Since this is a fact, what sustains people who don't study Torah? They receive life energy from the Tzaddik Emes . 06:35 - What is meant by "The Path to Eretz Yisrael "? The 26 generations before the Torah was given was sustained by HaShem's "Treasury of Free Kindness". 07:50 - In Tehillim 136 there are 26 verses. 16:45 - During the first 26 generations before the Torah was given, the Torah was hidden in the 10 utterances of creation, which are also called דרך ארץ - Derech Eretz - The Path to Eretz Yisrael . 28:20 - The Tzaddik Emes can transfer life energy from the Otzar Chesed Chinam to a person who is spiritually lost. *34:00 - End of learning the text of 2Likutey Moharan 78. Beginning of textual study for Sichos HaRan 153, which reveals the biographical setting behind 2Likutey Moharan 78. ***29:30 - The main goal in life is to find and connect with the Tzaddik Emes . A person needs to pray for this connection while he is in this world. 31:16 - מפרסמים של שקר - False leaders of Am Yisrael draw people to themselves and thereby mislead people away from the Tzaddik Emes . 33:09 - SICHAH 153. 34:34 - Shabbos Nachamu - a few weeks before Rebbe Nachman's passing. ***36:00 - Rebbe Nachman told his students, "The only thing that keeps me alive is my trip to Eretz Yisrael." He then gave the teaching of 2Likutey Moharan 78 . 37:20 - "Never fall into despair!" 40:43 - Rebbe Nachman's usual custom was to wash for bread first and then to sing Azamer BeShevachin afterwards. On this occasion, he sang Azamer BeShevachin first. 41:31 - SICHAH 154. Prustock - an ordinary person. The importance of simplicity in serving HaShem .

This sichah is based on 2Likutey Moharan 17 - it is a mitzvah to be joyful on Shabbos . 12:40 - It's important to sing zemiros at the Shabbos meals. 15:20 - SICHAH 156. The procedure for calling a particular soul when visiting a graveyard. 19:20 - Rebbe Nachman assured his daughter that after his passing, he would always hear the voice of anyone who visited his gravesite. 20:18 - SICHAH 157. Rebbe Nachman revealed many lessons related to his illness in order to cure that illness. However these revelations didn't achieve the intended goal of healing him because the listeners weren't worthy. 24:00 - Developing emunah in the Tzaddik Emes is central to serving HaShem . 24:50 - SICHAH 158. Biographical notes about Rebbe Nachman's yearning and to serve HaShem and practices of self-nullification when he was in his teens. 00:00 - SICHAH 159. 30:10 - SICHAH 160 - SICHAH 161. Rebbe Nachman sometimes used to fast from Shabbos to Shabbos and would immerse in a freezing mikveh . 37:00 - Rebbe Nachman kept his services of self-nullification hidden. 38:20 - SICHAH 162. Rebbe Nachman encouraged having a room of one's own - a special room for hisbodedus - personal prayer. 42:00 - SICHAH 163. Hisbodedus . Rebbe Nachman also used to go out to the hills to speak to HaShem . 44:00 - Through hisbodedus and joy a person can reach the highest spiritual levels.

Recorded ca. 1977-1978.) SICHAH 170. Accomplishment is according to the effort. SICHAH 171. Rebbe Nachman had exceptional determination for spiritual advancement even when he was a young child. SICHAH 172. When he gave his previous Tallis (prayer shawl) to one of his students, Rebbe Nachman told him "Be careful with this Tallis . I shed a tear for every thread in it until I understood its true meaning." Everything used by a tzaddik for kedushah can convey holiness. SICHAH 173. Rebbe Nachman's first follower, Reb Shimon ben Baer zal was sent into exile. When he returned, Rebbe Nachman described what he was able to achieve through going to Eretz Yisrael . SICHAH 174. *Giving even a small amount of Tzedakah to support Rebbe Nachman's students or teachings brings tremendous blessing. SICHAH 175. Pidyon Nefesh and the 24 heavenly courts. SICHAH 176. Before falling asleep, Rebbe Nachman would see all 600,000 letters of the Torah, corresponding to the 600,000 root souls of Israel. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 177 - 178 - 179 - 180 - 181 - 182 - Be Happy Always - Time is Fleeting - Wisdom That Can Sustain Physical Life - Opposition to the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1978.) SICHAH 177. Always be happy. Sadness is called the "bite of the serpent" Enjoying the pleasures of this world to attain spiritual goals. "It is a very great mitzvah to be happy always." Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 24 . SICHAH 178. Life is fleeting - seize the time! SICHAH 179. Not long before his passing, Rebbe Nachman said he can no longer make spiritual progress while clothed in his physical body. SICHAH 180. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 88 . See also Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim, Birkas HaPeyros 5. The Torah's prohibition of cutting down a fruit tree or removing leaves from a tree. * "Every blade of grass and every leaf on a tree davens to HaShem constantly." Why it is forbidden and even dangerous to eat unripe fruit. A tzaddik can draw spiritual treasures from a fruit by eating it. The Torah permits killing an animal to eat its meat because the animal's soul receives benefit when it rises to a higher level. NOTE: cooking unripe fruit does not remove its negative effects. Angels are appointed to sound Shofros when lost articles are found. Sohd Kavanas Elul - Tikkun HaBris and lost articles. On Rosh Hashanah person should be beSimcha . The Zohar reveals that the Tzaddik Emes is Moshe Rabbeinu and that he is a composite of HaShem's Names Keyl SHaKaI . The Milui of Keyl Shakai beGematria is TaRaT . A person should never give up hope. Rebbe Nachman suggested to a child that the best possuk to say in Hisbodedus is: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֖בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֜צְו‍ֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי - "I went astray like a lost lamb; seek Your servant, for I did not forget Your commandments" Tehillim 119:176. A Jewish soul is never abandoned even if we feel lost. SICHAH 181. Rebbe Nachman said there is a certain type of wisdom that he can't reveal. Acquiring new wisdom causes joy and satisfaction. A person can be so immersed in acquiring wisdom that he doesn't feel hunger. There is a level of wisdom that can sustain a person physically. SICHAH 182. Spiritual reasons for enmity against the Tzaddik Emes . Opposition to the Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh . Opposition to Rebbe Nachman. The "Hall of Exchanges". Sipurey Maasios - Story of the Exchanged Children. Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 250 - 251 - 252 - 253 - 254 - 255 - 256 - 257 - How To Make a Living - Encouragement for the Childless - Shabbos - Dairy and Meat Meals on Shavuos - Akdamos - Eyes of the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw45b. Recorded on Ohr LeRosh Chodesh Sivan 5738, 1978-06-05.) SICHAH 250. A person should not worry about parnassah - earning a livelihood. The life of a Jew is based on emunah - faith. Worrying will not provide a person with what he needs. This doesn't mean waiting for a miracle - it means first praying for aitza tovah and then taking positive action. SICHAH 251. Rebbe Nachman advised some people (not all) to read through the entire TeNaCH between Rosh Chodesh Elul and Hoshanah Rabbah . SICHAH 252. A person can taste Gan Eden if he is close to a true tzaddik . SICHAH 253. Rebbe Nachman's encouraged a man who was childless by assuring him that the offspring of a tzaddik are his good deeds. Then the Rebbe advised the man to give a pidyon nefesh , and the couple had a son. The Tzaddik Emes - then, and now - helps childless couples bear children. SICHAH 254. Shabbos is like a lavish and joyful wedding. It's a mitzvah to always be happy, but especially so on Shabbos . SICHAH 255. It's easier to advise others than it is to advise oneself. When a person seeks good counsel, the key is to first present the question to HaShem in Hisbodedus . SICHAH 256. Rebbe Nachman greatly praised the Akdamos - the special tefilah sung before the Torah reading on Shavuos . He described how both the melody and the words of this traditional prayer express love and devotion for HaShem . NOTE about the power of Rebbe Nachman's voice. NOTE: in addition to a dairy meal on Shavuos morning, we also eat a two meat meals on Shavuos - one at night and one at midday. SICHAH 257. Rebbe Nachman said that he was able to know a man's sins simply by looking at him. עֵינֵ֣י יְ֖הֹוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֜אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם - "The eyes of HaShem are to the righteous, and His ears are to their cry" ( Tehillim 34:16). Looking into the eyes of the Tzaddik strengthens the soul. Closing blessing for hiskashrus - to be bound to the Tzaddik Emes .

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 13 - Sometimes people who have faith in Hashem have no parnassah - livelihood - and this causes them stress and confusion. But this is good for the world, because many important things result from this kind of confusion. Distraction is a form of tardeyma - deep sleep - which can lead to either positive results or nothing at all. Only through tefilah (prayer) asking for Hashem's help can we distinguish between the two types of confusion. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 49 - The Purpose of Creation - Importance of Good Thoughts - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) Rebbe Nachman taught this lesson on 3 Nissan 5503 ( Parshas VaYikra , 26 March, 1803), the Shabbos two days after the marriage of his daughter, Sarah, to Rabbi Yitzchak Isaac Dubravn
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 49 - The Purpose of Creation - Importance of Good Thoughts - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) Rebbe Nachman taught this lesson on 3 Nissan 5503 ( Parshas VaYikra , 26 March, 1803), the Shabbos two days after the marriage of his daughter, Sarah, to Rabbi Yitzchak Isaac Dubravner zal . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Before the creation, the light of the Holy One, Blessed be He, "removed" Himself (so to speak) to make room for the existence of people. He created good and evil to make free will possible. Dovid HaMelech (King David) removed the evil inclination from his heart to create a "vacated space" within himself. 08:05 - PARAGRAPH 2. Tefilah (prayer) is service of the heart. 09:16 - PARAGRAPH 3. The letter hey corresponds to malkhus (sovereignty). The letter Hey is comprised of a Dalet to which a Yud ( Chokhma ) has been added. 10:33 - PARAGRAPH 4. Binah is the heart. The purpose of creation is to reveal HaShem's Kingship. 18:15 - Every Jew is a חלק אלוק ממעל - "portion of HaShem from above." *28:29 - The importance of thinking good thoughts in order to merit good deeds, good attributes, attentive prayer, and teshuvah (repentance). 31:21 - PARAGRAPH 5. The Ten Types of Song that will arise in the future. 33:58 - Sukkah is an aspect of Sarah/ Malkhus . 35:09 - PARAGRAPH 6. Teshuvah, Tishrei, and Nissan . Shabbos is an aspect of teshuvah . The revelation of Kabbalah . 41:44 - PARAGRAPH 7. The t'kheiles (blue) of the tzitzis is an aspect of Dovid HaMelech . 46:32 - "A tenth of an Ephah of find flour for the Mincha..." . "Ayeh makom k'vodo" - "Where is the place of His Glory".
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated by the Taback family for the complete recovery of Yitzchak ben Devora Pessa נ"י רפואה שלמה ליצחק בן דבורה פעסא נ"י

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Likutey Moharan 49 - Why a Kalleh Sends Her Chasan a Tallis - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) PARAGRAPH 7b. To draw kedushah - holiness - into Malkhus - sovereignty - a person needs to join the Upper House ( Binah /flour) with the Lower House ( Malkhus /oil). PARAGRAPH 8. The tzaddik is com
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 49 - Why a Kalleh Sends Her Chasan a Tallis - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) PARAGRAPH 7b. To draw kedushah - holiness - into Malkhus - sovereignty - a person needs to join the Upper House ( Binah /flour) with the Lower House ( Malkhus /oil). PARAGRAPH 8. The tzaddik is compared to the sun. PARAGRAPH 9. Why the kallah (bride) sends the chasan (groom) a tallis (prayer shawl). PARAGRAPH 10. Why money is distributed when the word " Shabbos " is shouted at a wedding celebration. PARAGRAPH 11. How the letter dalet (alluding to poverty) is transformed into the letter hey (a vessel for blessing) through the addition of a yod ( chokhma /wisdom). PARAGRAPH 12. "One who wants to pour a wine libation on the altar should fill the throats of Torah scholars with wine" ( Yoma 71a). PARAGRAPH 13. After a person merits teshuvah (return to HaShem through observance of His Torah), he needs great enthusiasm to compensate for whatever took place before his return.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, 10th of Adar 2, 5776 (2016-03-20). 00:00 - Review of PARAGRAPHS 1-3 and beginning of PARAGRAPH 4. Speech that is accepted must contain good. Praising tzadikkim causes speech to be accepted. The 365 gidin (tendons) through which the blood flows correspond to the 365 prohibitions in the Torah
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, 10th of Adar 2, 5776 (2016-03-20). 00:00 - Review of PARAGRAPHS 1-3 and beginning of PARAGRAPH 4. Speech that is accepted must contain good. Praising tzadikkim causes speech to be accepted. The 365 gidin (tendons) through which the blood flows correspond to the 365 prohibitions in the Torah. What does it mean to change the "red" into "white" ? What's the meaning of: "At all times your clothing should be white." ( Koheles /Ecclesiastes 9:8). The importance of the Tikkun HaKlali. 05:32 - PARAGRAPH 4 (mid). "Like an eagle arousing its nest..." ( Devarim /Deuteronomy 32:11). 15:10 - Every bracha (blessing) contains letters that spell abba (father) and ema (mother).* 24:25 - The most important thing in coming close to Hashem is Tikkun HaBris (moral purity between husband and wife/men and women). 28:20 - PARAGRAPH 5. Earning a livelihood without struggle depends on tikkun habris . 32:23 - Being careless with bread and breadcrumbs leads to poverty.* 36:00 - Question: is there a correlation between the 365 days of the solar calendar, the 365 negative commandments of the Torah, and the 365 gidin ? 36:50 - The "28 times" of Koheles . 40:36 - Yaakov Aveinu 's vision of the ladder and why he is described as "a dweller in tents". 46:05 - PARAGRAPH 6. Tikkun HaKlali. 48:13 - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai and the rainbow as a warning sign for the generation about tikkun habris .

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 44 - Likutey Moharan 45 - Likutey Moharan 46 - Shiur given on Yom Rishon deParshas Terumah , 30 Shevat 5777 (2017-02-26). The profound spiritual effects of clapping hands during tefilah . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 – TORAH 44 – PARAGRAPH 5. אתם נצבים היום לפני ה’ אלקיכם (דברים כ”ט) “Today you are standing , all of you, before Hashem your G-d…” ( Devarim /Deuteronomy 29:9). “Standing” means tefilah (prayer). “Before HaShem ” means Eretz Yisrael . 08:52 – PARAGRAPH 7. Tefilah corresponds to the korbon tamid (regular/daily offering). 13:24 – PARAGRAPH 8. Giving charity to the worthy of Eretz Yisrael helps kavana (concentration, focus, sincerity) and protects a person from the MaBUL (flood) of confusing thoughts during prayer. ( Eretz Yisrael was not covered by the flood.) 16:41 – The air of Eretz Yisrael makes a person wise. 21:15 – TORAH 45. Introduction – why is clapping hands so important? 21:55 – Q&R about the concept of the tzaddik emes in relation to the potential tzidkus (righteousness) of every Jew. If Rabbi Nachman put something in the Likutey Moharan , it’s for each one of us to know, to implement at our own individual level. 23:07 – Story of Rav Nasan zal and Reb Naftali zal being surprised at the length of time Rabbi Nachman spent with a simple Jew. 25:20 – TORAH 45. Inside the text. Clapping hands while praying. Hands are related to wings, lungs, speech, angels. Moshe Rabbeinu and speech impediment. Five fingers times five is twenty five, two hands makes fifty; this alludes to the fifty times leaving Mitzrayim (Egypt) is mentioned in the Torah. מי שם פה לאדם: (שמות ד’) “ MI (Who/50) gave the power of speech?” ( Shemos 4). 38:04 – TORAH 46. Clapping hands during prayer mitigates/sweetens judgments. Bed is placed between north and south because these directions correspond to hands/ tefilah /prayer (we face east). Marital union corresponds to prayer. 40:45 – PARAGRAPH 2. The soul is in speech. Three times yad (hand) is 42 in gematria and corresponds to “ KI BI ” (“because for me”) in the possuk כי בי חשק ואפלטהו: (תהלים צ”א) “Because for Me he yearned, I will rescue him.” ( Tehillim 91:14).

It mitigates harsh judgments. 06:
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 46 - Three Times Yad - End of Dinim - Purim Topics. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 – PARAGRAPH 1. Clapping hands during tefilah (prayer) is an aspect of union between Hashem and the People of Israel and the principle of “positioning the bed between north and south”. It mitigates harsh judgments. 06:38 – כי בי חשק ואפלטהו – תהלים צ”א: י”ד “Because for Me he yearned I will deliver him.” ( Tehillim/Psalms 91:14). 42 is three times yad (hand) and KI BI also has this value, corresponding to mitigating דינים (harsh judgments or decrees). 12:39 – PARAGRAPH 3. Clapping hands during tefilah also eliminates strife, as aspect of Korach against Aharon. כל העמים תקעו כף – תהלים מ”ז: ב “ All nations join (clap) hands. ” ( Tehillim/Psalm s 47:2) 22:05 – PARAGRAPH 4. Rav Nasan of Nemirov introduces the fact that he will now be presenting notes of his own on this Torah of Rabbi Nachman. 25:12 – Rav Nasan z”l brings the Pri Etz Chaim to further clarify the nature of the “three hands” – yad hagadolah ( yad yamin – right), yad hachazaka ( yad hasmol – left), and yad haramah (the unification of right and left aspects). 30:25 – Clapping hands during tefilah helps strengthen the memory. 37:32 – Purim topics.

( Tehillim /Psalms 89:16) 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Ba
lessons.bodyText: This shiur in Likutey Moharan 35 was given on 5 Cheshvan 5777 (November 6, 2016). Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. אשרי העם ידעי תרועה ה' באור פניך יהלכון: תהלים פ"ט "Happy is the people that knows the shofar's blast, Hashem, in the light of Your countenance they shall go." ( Tehillim /Psalms 89:16) 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Bas Pharaoh (daughter of Pharaoh) refers to intellectual pursuit that ignores the existence of Hashem and therefore is not דעת (Torah wisdom). When the angel Gavriel plunged a reed into the sea it became the city of Rome. How Bas Pharaoh affected Shlomo HaMelech (King Solomon). 28:11 - Question and discussion: what is the definition of extraneous "philosophy" in Rabbi Nachman's teachings?* 35:56 - PARAGRAPH 2. The soul gives vitality to the body. 40:28 - PARAGRAPH 3. The soul is renewed through sleep. 45:33 - PARAGRAPH 4. There are different kinds of sleep, beyond the simple understanding of going to sleep at night. Studying the Torah in the plain meaning of the words, without delving into deeper levels, can be a form of rejuvenation for the soul. (PARAGRAPH 5 was not covered in this shiur .) 46:50 - PARAGRAPHS 6-7. Faithful business activity done according to monetary law is a form of restfulness and refreshment for the soul.

lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. 'ואכלתם אכול ושבוע והללתם את-שם ה' - יואל ב "Then you will eat and be satisfied and praise the name of Hashem..." (Joel 2:26) A person with uncontrolled desire for food is distant from the truth and beset by strict judgment and shame. Gaining mastery over eating merits the light of the face of Yaakov and the light of tefillin . 19:12 - PARAGRAPH 2. The praise of the Land of Israel is that its inhabitants eat bread not because of poverty, but because they have broken the uncontrolled desire for food. 25:28 - " Ve zeh pirush ..." (this is the meaning of) " A land that consumes its inhabitants... " ( Bemidbar /Numbers 13:32). Israel receives its bounty through its holy inhabitants: Yaakov. 33:15 - QUESTION: Literal wealth? 35:16 - QUESTION: Meaning of " Loshon Rabeynu ..." in the Likutey Moharan ? 37:55 - ונתתי עשב בשדך לבהמתך - דברים י"א " I will provide AiSeV in your SaDeh for your animals " ( Devarim/ Deuteronomy 11:15) Tikkuney Zohar 51: AiSeV (field) refers to the harmonious presence and blending of all supernal colors. This is the beauty and power achieved when a person overcomes the animal approach to food.* 38:57 - PARAGRAPH 3. Shame and poverty result from unbridled desire for food. 40:23 - PARAGRAPH 4. Eretz Yisrael (the Land of Israel) and its connection to the light of Yaakov's face, and to tefillin . 42:03 - ראה חיים עם אשה - קהלת ט' "Live life with an ishah " ( Koheles /Ecclesiastes 9:9) also relates to tefillin which are called life. " Naphtali is a deer set loose... " - The name "Naphtali" contains the same letters as Tefillin . 44:16 - PARAGRAPH 5. A person who controls their desire for food merits the true wealth and satisfaction of Eretz Yisrael . They also merit the power of changing nature through tefila (prayer). 50:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. More about the concept of " Loshon Rabeynu " in the Likutey Moharan . 51:04 - PARAGRAPH 6 (first paragraph of this section only). When a person has no control over the desire for food it's a sign of dishonesty, strict judgments, and poverty.

lessons.title: Birkhas HaIlanos - To Bless is to Blossom
lessons.speaker: Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Right in the middle of Pesach cleaning we’re invited by the Creator of the Universe to forget about cabinets and crumbs for a while to venture forth to the great outdoors. And so we interrupt our annual roundup of pasta and popcorn to focus, instead, on the eternal signs that springtime has arrived. Siddur in hand, we
lessons.bodyText: Right in the middle of Pesach cleaning we’re invited by the Creator of the Universe to forget about cabinets and crumbs for a while to venture forth to the great outdoors. And so we interrupt our annual roundup of pasta and popcorn to focus, instead, on the eternal signs that springtime has arrived. Siddur in hand, we squint against the sunlight until we find them – tiny, white flowers spangled on an olive branch or waves of magenta peach blossoms flooding a hillside orchard. Rabbi Nachman taught: "Every flower of the field yearns to be part of our tefilos (prayers)" so the trees actually "join us" as we say: ברוך אתה ד' אלהינו מלך העולם, שלא חסר בעולמו כלום, וברא בו בריות טובות ואילנות טובים, להנות בהם בני אדם. “Baruch atah Hashem, Elokeinu Melech Haolam, shelo chisar b’olamo klum, u'vara vo b’riyos tovos v'ilanos tovim l’hanos bahem b’nei adam. "Blessed are You, Hashem, our G-d, Master of the universe, Whose world lacks nothing, and Who created within it beneficial creatures and beneficial trees to bring enjoyment to people." The best of us are compared to a fruit tree: “The righteous shall flourish like a date-palm…” ( Tehillim, 92:12) and even the smallest tree in the orchard is protected by the Torah. ( Devarim, 20:19). Like trees, we draw strength from our roots, we need water and nutrients to live, we're renewed by the changing seasons, we bear fruit, and we grow upward — reaching toward the light. The more trees, the better... ...but even one is enough. ( Teshuvos Halachos Ketanos 2:28) According to most authorities, the Birkhas Hailanos is made during daylight hours of any weekday in the month of Nissan ( Sdei Chemed, Berachos 2:1 and Kaf ha-Chayim, 126:1). Not all fruit-bearing trees qualify. They cannot have been grafted and they need to be more than three years old. The brachah is preferably recited on two different types of fruit trees, though even one type of tree is valid. The blossoms should be open, yet before the fruit appears (Chida, Moreh b'Etzba 198). A Time-Bound Mitzvah ? Similar to a woman’s obligation to bring first fruits — bikurim — to the Beis Hamikdash , this commandment is not considered "time-bound." It is a "season-bound" opportunity for everyone, man or woman, to open all our senses, drawing inspiration from the harmony of nature that goes far beyond words. Rav Abba taught: There is no greater revelation of redemption than that which the pasuk states: "And you, mountains of Israel, you shall give forth your branches and you shall bear your fruit for my people Israel, for they shall soon come." ( Yechezkel 36:8 , Bavli Sanhedrin, 98a). The geulah , then, resembles the blossoming of fruit branches. Is the World Lacking... or Not? To understand what Rav Abba is telling us, consider the wording of the brachah itself: “...Whose world lacks nothing.” Meanwhile, in the blessing “ borei nefashos ” that we say after eating, we thank Hashem who fulfills the “lack” in His “living creatures”. So, is there a lack or isn’t there? Birkhas Hailanos holds the answer. This unique blessing reminds us of the distinction between Hashem’s creatures and Hashem’s world . Creatures have a sense of lack – we get hungry, thirsty, or lonely. But Hashem’s world itself has no lack. This is the distinction between the state of galus — exile — and the state of geulah — redemption. When we focus only on our lack, we feel distant from Hashem. When we focus on His provision of what we lack, we feel His Presence, His love. As we say in Lecha Dodi on Shabbos evening: “ Karva El nafshi, gealah — When Hashem is close to my soul, redemption !” Intellectual Emunah is not enough... When we experience Hashem's Presence through our senses, we're rescued from exile in a powerful way. Through learning, praying, and doing mitzvos we bring our personal redemption closer. Our voice is a key to this process. “They shall inherit the Land forever; the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, in which I glory” ( Yishayahu/ Isaiah 60:21). The surge of new life bursting forth in nature makes it possible for us to experience Hashem’s interaction with every detail of His creation. This reassures us that, ultimately, nothing is lacking. Each one of us is “planted” by Hashem in the best environment for our soul to experience His kindness. Whenever we perceive His miracles “right in our own backyard”, the darkness of exile recedes. As we say the blessing this year, may everything become possible again for the People of Israel who are “the planting of His hand”. And may each one of us blossom through giving voice to His miracles. lessons.title: What's an Omer?
lessons.speaker: Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: A Measurement of Grain Simply counting the days between Pesach (Passover) and Shavuos renews the health and power of every Jewish soul. The word עמר – omer ( ayin, mem, reish ) – refers to the amount of barley or other grain that can be harvested with three strokes of a sickle or a scythe. We begin counting the days of
lessons.bodyText: A Measurement of Grain Simply counting the days between Pesach (Passover) and Shavuos renews the health and power of every Jewish soul. The word עמר – omer ( ayin, mem, reish ) – refers to the amount of barley or other grain that can be harvested with three strokes of a sickle or a scythe. We begin counting the days of the omer at the time of the barley harvest at Pesach (Passover) a nd we continue all the way up to the wheat harvest that begins near Shavuos . Barley and Wheat Why do we begin with barley and end with wheat? Barley is considered animal food; wheat is for people. So the process of counting the omer reflects the process of developing from animal to human. What distinguishes people from animals? כח הדיבור – ko-ach haDibur – the power of speech. Rabbi Nachman explains that when a child begins eating wheat, he begins developing the ability to express himself in words. A Seven Week Process The word ha-omer equals seven times the word ADaM – man. Why do we say ha-ome r? Ha-omer is spelled hey (5), plus ayin (70), plus mem (40), reysh (200) so the gematria is 315. ADaM is 45: alef (1), daled (4) mem (40). Seven times forty-five is 315. So ha-omer equals seven times ADaM . The s even weeks of the omer parallel the harvesting and processing of grain: reaping, sifting, refining. Harvest of Miracles The miracle of counting the omer is: we accomplish all 49 aspects of profound inner transformation simply by using our power of speech! All we need to do is count each day between Pesach and Shavuos in a voice loud enough for us to hear what we're saying. There's a blessing we say, as well. But it can only be said if we haven't missed a day. Missed a Day? Don't Worry! We heard from our teacher, Reb Michel Dorfman זצ"ל that if we miss counting the omer with a bracha (saying the blessing) to the extent that we can't continue with saying the bracha , we should continue counting without the bracha but without diminishing our joy in the slightest! (c) 2017 by Sara Wurtzel

lessons.bodyText: Tefilah (Jewish prayer) in light of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This anthology of Rabbi Nachman's teachings about tefila (prayer) began as a small collection called Hishtapkhus Hanefesh ( Outpouring of the Soul ). It was compiled by Rabbi Moshe Yehoshua Bezhilianski (known as Reb Alter of Teplik) and first published in Jerusalem about 1904. The sefer explains Rabbi Nachman's re-introduction of hisbodedus – literally "seclusion" – (voluntary prayer in one's own words) to strengthen, enrich, and empower the individual's emotional connection with the traditional mandatory prayers included in the siddur (Jewish prayer book).

lessons.description: The process of counting the Omer establishes the purity of mind necessary for receiving the Torah. (This halakha is based on Torah 72 of Likutey Moharan 2.) 00:00 - At the time of the Exodus, the People of Israel did not yet merit to receive the Torah. The nature of Chometz (leavened dough) is an aspect of katnas democ
lessons.bodyText: The process of counting the Omer establishes the purity of mind necessary for receiving the Torah. (This halakha is based on Torah 72 of Likutey Moharan 2.) 00:00 - At the time of the Exodus, the People of Israel did not yet merit to receive the Torah. The nature of Chometz (leavened dough) is an aspect of katnas demochin (constricted consciousness). 11:51 - PARAGRAPH 32. Ruach (spirit) is received from the tzaddik through seeing him as well as by being seen by him. 19:00 - Sefiras HaOmer (Counting the Omer ), Shavuos , Matan Torah (the giving of the Torah at Sinai). The power of redemption is techiyas hamaysim (revival of the dead) which is facilitated only through receiving the Torah. 35:00 - The essential purity of the relationship between man and woman is established through purity of thought. Rabbi Nachman of Breslov provides a technique for taking control of stray thoughts. He compares the mind to a horse that veers off the path. All we need to do is guide the "horse" back onto the path. 38:50 - It's impossible to entertain two thoughts at the same time. 40:38 - Sefiras HaOmer . It's not enough that we count seven weeks. The mitzvah (commandment) includes counting seven Shabasos (Sabbaths) so that we can free ourselves completely from the impurity of Egypt.

lessons.bodyText: Insights from Rabbi Nachman of Breslov about why it's important to have a rabbi. All protection and success results from closeness with tzaddikim (righteous Jews), but who are they in our generation? How can we find the tzaddik today? Tefilas chatzos (midnight prayer), sweetening of dinim (harsh judgments), Perek Shira . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Waking up from sleep at midnight for prayer. *(clip): "This month will be to you the first of the months." ( Shemos /Exodus 12:2). Sweetening harsh judgments can be done at chatzos , which is related to Rosh Chodesh and the sod haIbur (secret of calculating the time of the New Moon). 14:40 - PARAGRAPH 3. Every Jewish soul has an "inner Moshe Rabeynu ". שמד Shmad (spiritual failure) is 344. רצון Ratzon (aspiration) is 346. Precisely between the two is משה Moshe , gematria 345. *19:45 - (clip) It's important to have a rabbi because all protection and success results from closeness with tzadikim (righteous Jews), but who are they in our generation? *25:12 - (clip excerpt) Who are the tzaddikim in our generation? How can we find the tzaddik today? 28:16 - PARAGRAPH 4. Waking up at midnight. The blessing on the rooster (the heart) and discernment between night and day. 31:42 - Perek Shira. *34:32 - PARAGRAPH 5. By calling on the Name of Hashem we awaken from our sleep. 39:57 - PARAGRAPH 6. Birkhas HaTorah (blessings on learning Torah) - the importance of being careful with them. 44:51 - PARAGRAPH 7. From shmad to ratzon is possible through Birkhas HaTorah .

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov explains the concept of pidyon (redemption of an individual soul). Related to this topic, it has become a widespread practice in Israel to learn the Letter of Rav Shimshon Ostropoli on Erev Pesach . It includes a deep analysis of the ten plagues and is considered to be a segula (special merit) for a year of success and protection. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 – PARAGRAPH 18. 13:25 – Segula to read the letter of Rav Shimshon Ostropoli on Erev Pesach . 39:36 – PARAGRAPH 20. The final geulah (redemption) and the revelation of moshiach will be through the strength of Dovid HaMelech (King David). 46:46 – PARAGRAPH 21. The redemption from Egypt was through the power of Shabbos (the Sabbath).

Review. PARAGRAPH 41. Ratzon means to receive appeasement or to show favor. *The valuable effect of holy elders on their generation. *The power of mikveh . Biographical account of Rav Yosef Chaim Sonnenfeld zal . The process from impurity to the purity needed to receive the Torah requires the ability to wait. Sometimes complete purity can only be achieved through death. Purification is facilitated by counting the omer . PARAGRAPH 42 . "Let's talk to the people who are starting to get older." Summary of the power of the holy elders and the importance of learning Torah through being close with a tzaddik.

lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Based on Likutey Moharan Torah 215 and Likutey Moharan Tinyana Torah 4. Topics: Ratzon (favor, appeasement), menorah , mishkan , tzedaka (charity), Tetzaveh , BeHaalosekha , Betzalel, Moshe Rabeynu (Moses), Rebbe Nachman's final shiur . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 44. The soul is compared to a candle
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Based on Likutey Moharan Torah 215 and Likutey Moharan Tinyana Torah 4. Topics: Ratzon (favor, appeasement), menorah , mishkan , tzedaka (charity), Tetzaveh , BeHaalosekha , Betzalel, Moshe Rabeynu (Moses), Rebbe Nachman's final shiur . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 44. The soul is compared to a candle, because the natural mode of the soul is to be illuminated by Hashem. The Rambam explains that coercing a man to give a divorce a not a legal fiction. 17:10 - The soul is a composite of seven midos (character traits) that have both positive and negative aspects. These seven traits correspond to the seven lights of the menorah in the Beis HaMikdash and in the Mishkan . 35:35 - BeHaalosekha - when the Kohen Gadol kindles the seven lights in the Beis HaMikdash , these represent the souls of the Jews, that should be glowing with the light of Hashem. The flames all leaned toward the central light, which refers to the tzaddik . 44:04 - Why in BeHaalosekha the mitzvah of lighting the menorah is juxtaposed with the celebration of putting up the mishkan on Rosh Chodesh Nissan . 53:06 - Parshas Tetzaveh - why the lighting of the menorah is the first service in the mishkan to be mentioned. The purpose of the mishkan was to repair the damage of the Golden Calf.

lessons.title: OC1 - Lesson 125 - Birkhas HaShachar 5 - Para. 45b-46 - Moshe Rabbeinu and Betzalel; Tetzaveh; BeHaAlosekha; Terumah - Gifts From the Heart
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaShachar . Zayin Adar 5772 (1 March 2012). This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 215 and Likutey Moharan Tinyana Torah 4. Ratzon (favor, appeasement), menorah , mishkan , tzedakah (charity), Tetzaveh , BeHaalosekha , Moshe Rabbeinu (Moses) and Betzalel ; Rebbe Nachman's final shiur
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaShachar . Zayin Adar 5772 (1 March 2012). This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan Torah 215 and Likutey Moharan Tinyana Torah 4. Ratzon (favor, appeasement), menorah , mishkan , tzedakah (charity), Tetzaveh , BeHaalosekha , Moshe Rabbeinu (Moses) and Betzalel ; Rebbe Nachman's final shiur . 00:00 - Review. 02:20 - The essence of idol worship is misdirected desire for money. It results in suffering involved with making a living. ( Likutey Moharan 23.) 07:18 - The suffering of earning a living is repaired through the 39 melakhos (types of creative tasks) needed for the construction of the mishkan . This repair is accomplished in our generation through giving tzedakah (charity) to worthy causes. 10:30 - Gifts from the heart. In the construction of the mishkan , an array of different materials was used to perfect the full range of human qualities. Gavnanim Ilayim - colors of metal: gold, silver, copper, bronze, iron, tin, reflect different aspects of heavenly light. *17:20 - Pekudei - even when the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed, it continued to protect the People of Israel. This is why the mishkan was taken down and put back up a number of times when Israel was traveling in the wilderness. These structures have a power even in their dismantled state. The tzaddikim are involved with constructing the mishkan of our tefilos in every generation. This helps every individual to safely navigate the wilderness of their life. ( Likutey Moharan 27.) *26:40 - PARAGRAPH 46. Although it was difficult for Moshe Rabbeinu to understand the construction of the menorah , Betzalel understood it right away. 31:33 - The menorah is the spiritual "generator" that streams ratzon (determination, desire for good) into the souls of Am Yisrael . 36:00 - The 49 parts of the menorah correspond to the 49 levels through which the soul passes from darkness to light. Moshe Rabbeinu was only missing the fiftieth level (called " ratzon ") but rose to that level at the time of his passing. 39:26 - Betzalel understood that Moshe Rabbeinu was limited in aspects of creativity because of his humility. 47:30 - The Chmielnitsky massacre. An account of Rebbe Nachman's determination to teach Torah even though he was in terrible pain during his final illness. 55:50 - Bnei Yissachar on L'Ag BeOmer . Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakai was a gilgul (incarnation) of Moshe Rabbeinu . In Pirkei Avos he says a good heart includes all other good character traits. The Bnei Yissachar points out that Lev Tov (good heart) is b'gemtria 49.

lessons.bodyText: Ein Yaakov - Shabbat 49-53 - Tefillin - Miracles - Income - Ashrei - Key to Parnassah - Income - Tzniut - Modesty - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1970.) Shabbat 49. The mitzvah of tefillin signifies belief in HaShem in a very powerful way, similar to the observance of Shabbat . The miracle of Elisha Baal Knafayim - "Elisha - Master of Wings" and how he got his name ( Shabbat 49a). The miracle of a man who was able to nurse his infant child when its mother died ( Shabbat 53). Parnassa - livelihood - is as difficult as the miracle of dividing the waters of the Red Sea. Only HaShem Himself has the key to parnassah . *The importance of saying "Ashrei" ( Tehillim 145) three times a day. Kavanah (focus, intention, sincerity) is necessary when saying the verse פותח את ידך ומשביע לכל חי רצון "You open Your Hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing." Tzniut - modesty. lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaReyach 1 - 2 - Why No After-Blessing on Fragrance - Praising HaShem Enables Spiritual Progress - The Power of Saying Blessings on Food - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded on 2021-02-25.) PARAGRAPH 1. Why there is no need for a bracha achrona on smelling a fragrance. Hilkhos Birkhas HaReyach 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . Kavanas of the blessings made before eating. PARAGRAPH 2. Blessing made on the fragrance of an Esrog . Blessing on fragrance on Motzei Shabbos . הֹד֣וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ - "Give thanks to HaShem because He is good, for His kindness is eternal" ( Tehillim 107:1). The custom in nusach Sefard is to say Tehillim 107 on Erev Shabbos . PARAGRAPH 3. Praising HaShem is the key to spiritual progress. Stage 2 of teshuvah - when challenges begin. ***To break through from one spiritual level to a higher one, it's necessary to praise HaShem . The 4 requirements to praise are related to refining one's food intake. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 1 . Hisbodedus. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 10 . ***Even if a person's not physically standing in a field, it's possible for the trees and plants to contribute their energy to his tefilah . ***Through man's tefilah , the many types of vegetation return their powers to their Source and this brings healing and life-energy into food. The concept of Moshiach is related to the sense of smell. The bracha made on lechem brings the blessing of healing. The berakha achrona - blessing after eating - distributes the nutrients into the body. The blessing Borei Nefoshos . Birkhas HaMazon . Just as the body has 613 elements, the soul also has 613 elements. Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 - the nostrils are related to the ruach of Moshiach . Reyach is tefilah/Dvar HaShem . Indexing and notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Hishtapkhus HaNefesh - Outpouring of the Soul - Hisbodedus - Tefilah (Jewish prayer) in light of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This anthology of Rabbi Nachman's teachings about tefila (prayer) began as a small collection called Hishtapkhus Hanefesh ( Outpouring of the Soul ). It was compiled by Rabbi Moshe Yehoshua Bezhilianski (known as Reb Alter of Teplik) and first published in Jerusalem about 1904. The sefer explains Rabbi Nachman's re-introduction of hisbodedus – literally "seclusion" – (voluntary prayer in one's own words) to strengthen, enrich, and empower the individual's emotional connection with the traditional mandatory prayers included in the siddur (Jewish prayer book). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14b. 18:48 - PARAGRAPH 15.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel

The mistake of Korach . 09:39 - Korach' s complaint about the commandment to shave his head. 11:38 - The mitzvah for a metzorah (leper) to shave his head. "Metzorah" is made up of two words: "motzi" "ra" - a person wh
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 7. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The mistake of Korach . 09:39 - Korach' s complaint about the commandment to shave his head. 11:38 - The mitzvah for a metzorah (leper) to shave his head. "Metzorah" is made up of two words: "motzi" "ra" - a person who brings forth evil. 13:16 - Why Torah-observant men keep the hair on the top and back of their head short. A brief mention of Dovid HaMelech' s son, Avshalom . 14:46 - Silence protects knowledge. 18:20 - Sod HaIbur is the secret of inter-calculating of the lunar and solar calendars. How we make the nations aware that we know this mystery without revealing the principle itself. 20:29 - Performing the mitzvah of Parah Adumah - the red heifer - expresses that a person "knows his place" in the world. 25:34 - Death came into the world when Adam tried to understand Hashem's mysteries of good and evil too deeply. What is death? Separation of the body and soul. 27:35 - What we correct through the mitzvos of Purim. How the lottery helped us understand that some things are beyond our ability to understand. 32:21 - PARAGRAPH 8. 33:45 - Ki ikar Sod HaIbur - the essence of the secret of the Jewish calendar. 37:44 - PARAGRAPH 9. The goal of Torah study is action - to know how to conduct ourselves in different situations. Thinking we know something often leads to strife. 40:32 - Conflict and dispute is the most destructive force in serving Hashem. It causes more harm to a person than any other sin, and that's what led to the destruction of the Beis HaMidkash . Conflicts, among religious Jews, is what keeps us from rebuilding the Beis HaMikdash . 43:11 - New topic: What part of the bread do we make the blessing on first? 47:37 - The importance of holding the bread with all ten fingers when breaking/cutting the loaf. 49:02 - PARAGRAPH 12. 52:31 - The purpose of eating is spiritual refinement. 61:01 - The essence of wisdom is silence. *62:40 - The importance of exactly how we make the blessing on bread. This is an aspect of tzimtzum (restraint) that expresses yirah (reverence for Hashem). 79:35 - End of clip on eating properly. 81:03 - PARAGRAPH 14. The importance of making the blessing hamotzi on an unbroken loaf or roll. 85:34 - PARAGRAPH 15. Pesach and Torah 7 of Likutey Moharan 2 .

lessons.title: Emphasizing the Letter Hey of HaMotzi in the Blessing on Bread
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov explains why, when we say the blessing before eating bread, we emphasize the pronunciation of the letter " hey " in the word " hamotzi ". This calls to mind the five types of grains for which Eretz Yisrael (the Land of Israel) is praised, and the letter " hey " that was added to the name of Avr
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov explains why, when we say the blessing before eating bread, we emphasize the pronunciation of the letter " hey " in the word " hamotzi ". This calls to mind the five types of grains for which Eretz Yisrael (the Land of Israel) is praised, and the letter " hey " that was added to the name of Avraham Aveinu (the Patriarch Abraham). Through doing this we spiritually connect the meal we're about to eat with the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . Text: Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 2, Hilkhos Devarim HaNohagim BaSeudah 4, Paragraph 23. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - End of PARAGRAPH 19. *03:55 - PARAGRAPH 20. Parshas BeMidbar . Every Jewish soul is a soldier, each is assigned a position. 04:57 - Why Hashem insists that the children of Israel should be counted. Because counting restores spiritual loss, it's an important element in returning to Hashem. The souls of Israel correspond to the 600,000 letters in the Torah. How reading the parsha of BeMidbar directly before the holiday of Shavuos helps us prepare for receiving the Torah. 22:03 - A person should stay within their bounds. As soldiers, each Jewish soul has a specific mission so no one should overstep their boundaries to disturb the mission/station of another. Hashem praises the children of Israel for "following their flags" - meaning each knew their place and stood there. 35:03 - PARAGRAPH 21. The four images that appear on the throne of Hashem which correspond to the four sections of our daily tefilos /prayer: the lion, ox, and eagle allude respectively to shacharis (morning prayer), mincha (afternoon prayer), and aravis (evening prayer). The human face in the throne corresponds to one's concentration. How to deal with foreign thoughts during tefilah . 41:46 - Teshuvah - returning to Hashem. 44:54 - The heart is the source of all the emotions. The four letters of Hashem's name, yud, hey, vav, hey, correspond to the four elements of creation: aish (fire), mayim (water), ruach (air), afor (earth) - in that order. 49:50 - PARAGRAPH 22. Kadosh, kadosh, kadosh . 51:13 - "The earth is filled with His glory." *57:38 - The ARIZaL's description of how the neshoma yiseyra (additional soul) arrives in stages through the tefilos of Shabbos . 1) Friday night the nukva (female) aspect of the neshoma yisera is received: Bo-i Callah Shabbos Malkhesa ( nefesh ), 2) HaPoreys Sukkas Shalom Aleynu ( ruach is), 3) Baruch Hu after tefilah ( neshoma ). 58:42 - Arrival of dukra (male) aspect of the neshoma yisera on Shabbos morning: 1) Nishmas Khol Chai ( nefesh ), 2) Go'al Yisrael - Hashem Sifsei Tiftach (ruach) , and 3) Ayeh Makom Kevodo in kedusha of mussaf (congregation's response) ( neshoma ). 59:59 - What is the honor of the angels? *66:11 - Dealing with honor in the right way, based on Likutey Moharan 6. A description of the hospitality of Avraham Avinu . *67:40 - Even though receiving honor for its own sake is dangerous and brings judgement, we instill children with honor for parents. How is this done? 71:37 - Shavuos . Why we read megilas Rus on Shavuos . Dovid HaMelech (King David) did not sin with Batsheva - the incident had to appear as a sin to help people to know that teshuvah is always possible. 74:10 - The most important ingredient in teshuvah is the ability to be embarrassed about mistakes.

lessons.title: OC2 - Lesson 059 - Birkhas HaReyach 4 - Para. 23-30 - The Jewish Soul is a Bridge between Hashem and His Creation
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Hashem offered the Torah to all the 70 root nations, but each nation refused it. 06:22 - PARAGRAPH 24. Why Parshas BaMidbar is read just before Shavuos . Counting is an aspect of clarifying the כח המדמה Koach HaMeDaMeh – power of imagination. What is special about the
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Hashem offered the Torah to all the 70 root nations, but each nation refused it. 06:22 - PARAGRAPH 24. Why Parshas BaMidbar is read just before Shavuos . Counting is an aspect of clarifying the כח המדמה Koach HaMeDaMeh – power of imagination. What is special about the People of Israel? The clarification of misguided imagination depends on the People of Israel. When a Jew does a mitzvah, he serves as a bridge between the different worlds of existence, uniting all creation to the Creator Himself. 13:15 - The Jewish soul is in perfect unity with Hashem. They are One. The power of imagination is the lowest level in the Jewish soul. This is the point of interface between the blessing of Hashem and His worlds. By counting Jewish souls, this point of interface is repaired because counting clarifies imagination. 18:05 - The confusion of the imagination streams from the venom of the nachash (serpent), the original mistake of Adam and Chava. Counting souls is dangerous and can bring judgment, so the half-shekel is given by each Jew and the money is counted instead. This donation was given for the public sacrifices of the community. What does the sacrifice of an animal accomplish? 22:10 - The design of the mishkan , with all of its different elements, reflects the diversity of all the elements in creation that need to be purified at the level of imagination. As long as the imagination is impure, we are in exile. In Sefer Daniel , there is an allusion to the fact that even when the Second Beis HaMikdash was standing, we were actually still in exile. *24:50 - PARAGRAPH 25. The beginning of the redemption of Israel begins with Purim. *27:15 - Hashem sends the remedy before the illness. He draws the light of the redemption into the present time. He did this when He performed the great miracles in the time of Mordechai and Esther, overturning the plans of destruction made by Amalek. This light from the future sustains us now and returns every year, at the time of those miracles. In Likutey Moharan 2 ( Tinyana ), Torah 74, Rebbe Nachman explains how Purim and Pesach are connected. The light accessible on Purim helps a person be protected from eating chometz on Pesach. 38:10 - PARAGRAPH 26. On Purim we received the Torah anew. The date that Haman was hung, was the sixteenth day of Nissan, which is the day from which the Omer is counted. Description of the powerful way the kehilla counts the Omer in a Breslov minyan. 43:10 - PARAGRAPH 27. Haman tried to choose the best for the lottery. Hashem commanded the allocation of the Land of Israel by lot, because the main center for clarifying imagination is Eretz Yisrael . A lottery is used in place of rationality. To the point that a person has purified their imagination, their dreams are pure. 51:30 - A lottery is a form of Ruach HaKodesh . Mikra (coincidence) is made of the initial letters of "Rak MeyHashem" (Only from Hashem). 52:50 - Yom HaKippurim is the most powerful day of clarification of the imagination. On that day there was a lottery between two sacrificial goats, which to honor Hashem, and one to be sent l'Azalzel. Fortune tellers are an aspect of bilbul hamedameh (confusion of the imagination). 57:45 - Haman and his family knew magic, which actually existed at that time. Purim is called "lottery" because through submitting to "chance" we allow Hashem to demonstrate His powers above human rationality. *62:30 - Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l brought from the Chessed l'Avraham , grandfather of the Chida z"l : just as a person receives a neshamah yiserah (additional soul) on Shabbos , similarly a neshamah yiserah is given to a Jew the moment he or she sets out to go to Eretz Yisrael . 75:36 - PARAGRAPH 29. Every time we try to get to a higher level, we're sent trials and opposition. Therefore it's important to ask Hashem to prepare a protection for us when we set out on a new spiritual endeavour so we can withstand the obstacles. This is how we can benefit from Hashem's miraculous ability to prepare the remedy before the illness. *78:00 - Getting drunk on Purim – why?

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Tammuz - Av - The Three Weeks - Tisha beAv - Kamtza and Bar Kamtza - Eretz HaTzvi - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal ( Ein Yaakov, Gitin 56). Historical background for the mourning period of the Three Weeks, including the destruction of the second Beis HaMikdash - the Holy Temple in Jerusalem. *00:00 - In his ope
lessons.bodyText: Tammuz - Av - The Three Weeks - Tisha beAv - Kamtza and Bar Kamtza - Eretz HaTzvi - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal ( Ein Yaakov, Gitin 56). Historical background for the mourning period of the Three Weeks, including the destruction of the second Beis HaMikdash - the Holy Temple in Jerusalem. *00:00 - In his opening remarks, Rabbi Rosenfeld mentions that this lesson would be good to listen to on the Fast of Tisha b'Av . 00:36 - When Aspanyanus (Vespasian) became emperor and had to return to Rome, he assigned Titus HaRasha (the Evil Titus) to continue the siege of Jerusalem. Titus was a direct descendant of Esav and began an attack against HaShem by profaning the Beis HaMikdash . When he later voyaged back to Rome, the sea all around his ship rose up, on its own, to defend the honor of HaShem . 04:33 - The greatness of Pinchas . 05:55 - Titus is punished by HaShem through a worm that entered his brain and as it grew, increased his suffering. 11:50 - Onkelus the Ger consults with three souls who are in Gehinnam (purification in the next world), asking each of them "Who is considered the most worthy in Heaven?" 15:37 - Onkelus calls on Bilaam . 20:17 - The process of the gradual revelation of the Zohar HaKadosh over generations. The ARIzal reveals that Bilaam was reincarnated as Naval . 22:24 - Onkelus brings up the soul of "the unmentionable one". 25:16 - The destruction of Yerushalayim followed as a result of the incident between Kamtza and Bar Kamtza . Embarrassing a person in public is a very great sin. 26:45 - The massacre of thousands of Jews in Tur Malka through the incident of a rooster and a hen. 28:52 - The sincere prayer of even an evil person is accepted by HaShem . *34:59 - Why Eretz Yisrael is called Eretz HaTzvi (Land of the Deer). Miracles of the Beis HaMikdash - there was always room for everyone.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: The Three Weeks - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . The heroic faith of the Jewish people and the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . Nevuzaradan , the Roman general responsible for the murder of millions of Jews, abandoned his past and converted to Judaism. The fact that his repentance was accepted is a powerfu
lessons.bodyText: The Three Weeks - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . The heroic faith of the Jewish people and the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . Nevuzaradan , the Roman general responsible for the murder of millions of Jews, abandoned his past and converted to Judaism. The fact that his repentance was accepted is a powerful reminder that we should never give up hope because HaShem wants us to return to Him, no matter what we did in the past. Text: Gitin 57.

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Avraham Dov ( Ba'R Dovid ) of Avritch (1765-1840) is called the “ Bas Ayin ” after his most well-known work. Hilkhos Harshaah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 6. PARAGRAPH 1. Teshuvah and the three parts of the letter Aleph : upper point, lower point, connecting Vuv . PARAGRAPH 2. When courts d
lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 2 - Teshuvah - Mishpat Tzedek - True Justice - The Angel MaTaT - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in 2014.) INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Harshaah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 6. PARAGRAPH 1. Teshuvah and the three parts of the letter Aleph : upper point, lower point, connecting Vuv . PARAGRAPH 2. When courts decides a case with fairness and truth, the disputed property is returned to its proper place. Teshuvah (repentance) is also accomplished through mishpat tzedek - true justice. Establishing true justice establishes peace. PARAGRAPH 3. The Malach Mem Tess . Mentioning the full name of any angel may bring harm unless the name spoken is in common use as a name of a person. The Mesifta Ila'ah is the highest level yeshiva in Gan Eden . Beneath that is the Mesifta deRekiah , which is the yeshiva of the Malach Mem Tess . Account of the four who entered Pardes - Gan Eden . "Today is 21 days in the Omer." The high points of sefiras ha'Omer : L'AG B'Omer and the 25th (central) day, Netzach shebe Netzach . Israel had to be in Egypt and in all exiles to repair the sin of Adam HaRishon and the Etz HaDaas . Note about Yehoshua Bin Nun . PARAGRAPH 4. When a representative is appointed by a litigant, it's more difficult for the judges of the case to establish true justice.

lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The spiritual nature of parnassah (income/livelihood). 13:09 - Children inherit from their father because they bring the blessing of parnassah with them into the world. It's absurd to imagine that if a person has less children they'll have more money, when the truth is the opposite. *17:12 - Tikkun emunah (completion of faith in Hashem) can't be done in one generation. One of the most important things we can do to educate our children is to teach them to say the Shema . Chinuch bonim (education of children) is an aspect of "His faith is from generation to generation." ( Tehillim /Psalm 100:4). 28:07 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parnassah and melachah (creative work) relate to the building of the mishkan (tabernacle).

lessons.bodyText: Devarim - True Friendship and the Danger of Giving Rebuke - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Dedication of shiur in memory of Rabbi Yechiel Michel b'Rav Yehoshua Dovid HaLevi Dorfman zal who passed away in 5766 (2006) on the yahrzeit of the Arizal , the 5th of Av . The focus of Rebbe Nachman's last shiur was on community. Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat 1, Hilkhos Oreyv 3, Para. 30-31 . Imagine if a person could "Google" HaShem . Lot and his daughters: the sin was worse when it was repeated. The pain of seeing another person's misdeed should move us to pray for them. Account of Rabbi Rosenfeld zal's apology to his students for insulting them when he was in pain. Rebuke is only successfully given or received through sincere yearning to do Teshuvah - return to Hashem and His Torah. A person is defined by their goals. Zohar HaKodesh, Reya Hemna - the greatness of Moshe Rabbeinu's yearning on behalf of Klal Yisrael . Closing blessing - HaShem reprimands those He loves.
lessons.dedication: This shiur is in memory of Rabbi Yechiel Michel b'Rav Yehoshua Dovid HaLevi Dorfman זצ"ל Kaminets-Podolsk, Ukraine, 1913 - Ihr HaKodesh Yerushalayim , 5 Menachem Av , 5766 (2006) לעילוי נשמת הרב החסיד ר' יחיאל מיכל זצ"ל בהר"ר יהושע דוד הלוי הי"ד דורפמן פעל רבות בעניני רבינו הק' ומסר נפשו על ציונו הק' והקיבוץ של ראש השנה שלו באומן ו זכה לבנות שם את ה"קלויז" החדש. נלב"ע ה' מנחם אב תשס"ו ת.נ.צ.ב.ה To dedicate a Torah shiur, click HERE.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 27. Through digging wells the Avos (Patriarchs) accessed deep waters of emunah (faith in Hashem ) and aitza (counsel/advice), allowing these blessings to flow into the world. 02:06 - PARAGRAPH 28. The bracha of " Ata Gibor " praises Hashem for His ability to bring the dead back to life. *08:56 - The bracha of Mechayei Meysim (revives the dead) is related to the ability to control one's thoughts. Practical advice on how to direct the mind according to intention. 17:57 - Ata Gibor – You are strong – gevurah (strength) is the ability to contain, restrict, enforce boundaries. That's why this blessing is an aspect of controlling one's thoughts. 28:52 - Mechayei Meysim is mentioned in this blessing five times, corresponding to the five senses. 30:19 - Rashi on Tehillim/Psalms 92:2 " VeAta Marom LeOlam ..." explains that Hashem will always have the "upper hand" no matter who the adversary is. 33:48 - Aitzos Amitios (true words of counsel and guidance) are what's most needed to rescue a person. The meaning of " Rav leHoshia " - "great to rescue". Discussion about how to access advice and guidance from tzaddikim in our generation.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel

The Beis HaMikdash draws
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum 3, Para. 7-9. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Parshas Shoftim. Why the Beis HaMikdash is in Nachalas Binyomin ; Har Moriah ; The Spiritual Aspects of Shoes; The Importance of Emunas Chochomim . This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 57 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7b. The Beis HaMikdash draws its power from the vows of Am Yisrael . This is the source from which emunas chochomim also emanates. 04:05 - Why the Beis HaMikdash is located in the nachalah (region) of Binyomin . *05:35 - Parshas Shoftim. Why the Beis HaMikdash is called "Har Moriah" ( Taanis 16). 06:38 - לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן־הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־יַגִּ֥ידוּ לְךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל - "You shall not divert from the word they tell you, either right or left..." ( Devarim 17:11 Shoftim ). 09:13 - The Beis HaMikdash was established through the vow of Dovid HaMelech , as in אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֜דַ֗ר לַֽאֲבִ֥יר יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "That he swore to Hashem, he vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob..." עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֖קוֹם לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֜שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַֽאֲבִ֥יר יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "...until I find a place for the Lord, dwellings for the Mighty One of Jacob..." ( Tehillim 132:2-5). 13:30 - Why Binyomin was named by both Rochel and Yaakov . 14:55 - PARAGRAPH 8. The mitzvah of yibum and the spiritual aspects of shoes. 16:49 - Shoes refer to a wife ( Tikkunei Zohar ). 17:36 - Women were given nine measures of the ten measures of speech in the world. 20:03 - Shoes originate from vows. 28:00 - Binah as an aspect of the legs ( Shir HaShirim ). 30:25 - Chidush of the SheLaH HaKadosh heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל: "Mi pi gevurah" is the same gematria as Moshe Rabbeinu . The importance of emunas chochomim (faith in Rabbis). 35:29 - The morning blessing she asa li kol tzorchi - on "everything I need" - refers specifically to shoes because they include all needs. *40:18 - Biographical note from Reb Yechiel Michel Dorfman ז"ל about the Chozeh m'Lublin ז"ל in response to a student who felt he couldn't honestly say the blessing "Who takes care of all my needs." 47:43 - The importance of wearing shoes. 48:18 - Reference to Shabbos 129: why the sages of the gemara advise "Sell everything you own to buy shoes". 56:39 - PARAGRAPH 9. The spiritual aspects of not wearing shoes on Yom Kippur .

lessons.title: EH - Lesson 082 - Yibum 3 - Para. 9b-10 - How Does Removing Our Shoes on Tisha B'Av Repair What Caused the Destruction of the Beis HaMikash?
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum, Halakha 3, Para. 9b-10. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 57. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. "Remove your shoes from your feet..." ( Shemos /Exodus 3:5). Hashem tells Moshe Rabeynu not to separate himself from the holiness of the Land. The origin of
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum, Halakha 3, Para. 9b-10. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 57. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. "Remove your shoes from your feet..." ( Shemos /Exodus 3:5). Hashem tells Moshe Rabeynu not to separate himself from the holiness of the Land. The origin of wearing leather shoes after Adam and Chava ate from the Tree of Knowledge. Garments of light vs. garments of leather. Why we look at the distinction between fingernail and skin by the light of the Havdalah candle. 13:43 - PARAGRAPH 10. The connection between not wearing leather shoes on Tisha B'Av and the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash (the Holy Temple in Jerusalem). 25:36 - Sanhedrin 74. In a time of shmad (forced conversion) it's forbidden to imitate the religious practices of the non-Jews "even concerning a shoelace." *29:41 - Ikar chorbon Beish HaMikdash - the essential truth is that the Holy Temple was destroyed because we turned away from Torah authorities. (Clip - Part 1). *42:16 - We are repaired by means of that which caused us to stumble. Lack of emunas chochomim (faith in true rabbis) is repaired through lowering ourselves by fasting and removing our shoes. .

lessons.bodyText: Tisha b'Av - the ninth day of the lunar month of Av - soul and sole. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum 3, Para. 10b. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Image: Chalitza Shoe, 19th Century.) 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10b. Ikar chorbon Beish HaMikdash - the Holy Temple was destroyed because the People of Israel disregarded Torah authorities. 07:14 - Nimtza - we are repaired by means of that which caused us to stumble. Because Israel failed in emunas chochomim (faith in true rabbis) our repair is through lowering ourselves through reading Eicha ( Lamentations ), fasting, and removing our shoes.

lessons.title: YD1 - Lesson 013b - Treyfus 2 - Para. 1-2 - Memory vs. Imagination - 5 Sections of the Lungs - 5 Strings of Dovid HaMelech's Harp - Meals in Joy
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Treyfus 2 - Memory vs. Imagination - 5 Sections of the Lungs - 5 Strings of Dovid HaMelech's Harp - Meals in Joy - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Treyfus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . TREYFUS 2 - INTRODUCTION. The importance of protecting one's memory. Pharaoh decreed death to the male children of Bnei Yisra
lessons.bodyText: Treyfus 2 - Memory vs. Imagination - 5 Sections of the Lungs - 5 Strings of Dovid HaMelech's Harp - Meals in Joy - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Treyfus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . TREYFUS 2 - INTRODUCTION. The importance of protecting one's memory. Pharaoh decreed death to the male children of Bnei Yisrael because he was attacking zicharon (memory) which is an aspect of zochor (male). Yad (hand) is an aspect of simcha (joy) which can subdue the power of imagination. Music is used to bring simcha . Because Yosef HaTzaddik was not ruled by his imagination, he was the antithesis of Pharaoh. PARAGRAPH 1. The 18 types of treyfus that relate to defects in species of animals that are permissible to eat. The differentiation between what's kosher and what's not kosher is done through an aspect of neginah (melody). PARAGRAPH 2. Birkas HaMazon (blessings after eating bread) and the ten halakhos about the kos shel bracha , which correspond to the ten types of negina . The prohibition against eating a living or damaged animal - ever min hachai . The 5 sections of the lungs are related to the 5 strings of Dovid HaMelech 's harp and the 5 books of the written Torah. Protecting the memory depends on eating in holiness and joy. *The korbonos (sacrifices) brought in the Beis HaMikdash elevate a person by separating out the ruach habeyma (animal spirit) from holiness. Bava Kama 72: "I haven't yet eaten meat." Those entrusted with deciding matters of halakha are especially required to protect their clarity of discernment.

lessons.bodyText: Cheilev veDam 3 - Parshas Tzav - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. The good that's trapped in the Side of Evil can be released through burning the cheilev (fat) on the altar of the Beis HaMikdash . The elevation of this good is the purpose of the animal sacrifices. 02:42 - PARAGRAPH 4. Why this process cannot be accomplished through eating. The fire that burned on the mizbeyach had the ability to purify the negative spiritual qualities in the fat of animal sacrifices. If a person were to ingest this fat, he and his children would be harmed by these qualities. 09:55 - *Clip for Parshas Tzav . 11:27 - PARAGRAPH 5. In our times, this type of purification is accomplished through fasting.

lessons.bodyText: Mikvaos 1 - Eitz HaDaas - Humility - Teshuva - Adam and Chava - Mikveh as Antidote to Depression - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikvaos 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 82. Mikveh (ritual immersion in waters fed by rainwater or a natural wellspring) in light of the teachings of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov. Spiritual and physical healing results from connecting with the Divine life-force of Hashem that streams through natural sources. Ritual immersion is one of the Torah's many antidotes to depression. Adam and Chava in Gan Eden (the Garden of Eden).

lessons.bodyText: Shevachey HaRan 1 - Lesson 8 - Para. 21-23. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Rabbi Nachman describes his process in overcoming the desire for food. 05:06 - PARAGRAPH 22. Improving character traits: controlling anger. The perfection of patience and tolerance is only possible in Eretz Yisrael . The humility of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai and of Rabbi Nachman. Receiving Kovod - honor - is dangerous.

Rabbi Nachman describes how he gained mastery over his tolerance of physical discomfort but training himself not to react to itching sensations. 07:56 - PARAGRAPH 25. The importance of being stubbo
lessons.bodyText: Shevachey HaRan 1 - Lesson 9 - Para. 24-27 - Praises of Rebbe Nachman - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Rabbi Nachman describes how he gained mastery over his tolerance of physical discomfort but training himself not to react to itching sensations. 07:56 - PARAGRAPH 25. The importance of being stubborn and determined when it comes to overcoming negative character traits and bad habits. 11:53 - PARAGRAPH 26. Rabbi Nachman opposed the concept that a person inherits good character. He insisted that anyone can achieve greatness, no matter what their background is. The story of "The Rabbi's Only Son" from Sipurey Masiyos . 16:27 - PARAGRAPH 27. (Last paragraph in Part 1 of Shevachey HaRan - Part 2 is about Rabbi Nachman's journey to Eretz Yisrael ). The most important thing in life is: crying out to Hashem in hisbodedus - personal prayer in one's own words.

lessons.bodyText: Shevachey HaRan 2 - Para. 6-8 - Rebbe Nachman's Journey to Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The response of Rebbe Nachman's family to his trip to Eretz Yisrael . 02:04 - PARAGRAPH 7. 03:56 - PARAGRAPH 8. 04:41 - Chayey Moharan 136 describes Rebbe Nachman's preparation for the trip. He has a dream in which Rabbi Menachem of Vitebsk ז"ל reveals to him a Segulah for protection while traveling at sea: the Name of Hashem אתה - Atah . 06:09 - Tehillim 89 - waves at sea, Atah . 06:44 - (CLIP A) Reb Shimon, close student of Rabbi Nachman, and the concept of "garments" in kabbalah . Why did Rebbe Nachman risk his life to travel to Eretz Yisrael ? 07:02 - Reb Nachman of Tcherin ז"ל, a student of Rav Nosson of Nemirov, explains exactly how the Segulah of Atah is done with five parchments dropped into a stormy sea. 09:39 - Return to PARAGRAPH 8 of Shevachey HaRan 2. 11:47 - Reb Yudel ז"ל makes Havdallah in a graveyard and both he and his student hear one of the souls respond " Omein ". 19:39 - The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh explains a possuk in Aleynu about always seeking spiritual progress. 22:14 - (CLIP B) Rebbe Nachman hears the sounds of Matan Torah on Shavuos before he embarks on the ship.

lessons.bodyText: Shevachey HaRan 2 - Lesson 07 - Para. 18 - Rebbe Nachman's Journey - Sukkos in Haifa - Shabbos with Reb Avram Kalisker ז"ל in Tiveria - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. After celebrating Sukkos in Haifa and visiting the cave of Eliyahu HaNavi , Rebbe Nachman traveled to the holy city of Tiveria (Tiberias). There he spent Shabbos with Reb Avram Kalisker ז"ל. This shiur includes a description of Rebbe Nachman's broken-hearted preparation for spiritual aliya - ascent.

lessons.bodyText: It's forbidden to use the Chanukah lights for personal benefit. The tzaddikim are compared to the lights of the menorah (36 lights total parallel the 36 tzaddikim in Eretz Yisrael and the 36 tzaddikim in the rest of the world). lessons.bodyText: Parshas Bereishis - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. When HaShem said "Let us make man..." ( Bereishis 1:26, Bereishis ) He was speaking to the forces of creation that He had already brought into existence (cf. Targum Yonasan, Ramban ). Why did some of the angels oppose the creation of man, and why did HaShem choose to ignore them? A fascinating account based on the teachings of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov in the Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 1. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat 2, Hilkhos Matanah 5, Paragraph 1. (Excerpted from CM2 - Lesson 017a.)
