lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Text: Likutey Moharan I. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - TORAH 163. Life and death are in the power of speech. 06:07 - Speech is an aspect of sarah (rulership). Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l pointed out that the word sarah in atbash (interchanging letters in opposing order of the alef-beis ) is 95. Her other names
lessons.bodyText: Text: Likutey Moharan I. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - TORAH 163. Life and death are in the power of speech. 06:07 - Speech is an aspect of sarah (rulership). Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l pointed out that the word sarah in atbash (interchanging letters in opposing order of the alef-beis ) is 95. Her other names are Milkha and Yiska , both of which have the value of 95. 11:37 - The forces of evil (an aspect of "Egypt") are always trying to capture the power of speech. The three evil forces are parallel to the three ministers of Pharaoh, which are associated with an excessive desire for food. These opposing forces relate to the windpipe (trachea), the foodpipe (esophagus), and the jugular veins in the throat. 21:40 - Parshas Korach . 27:55 - A person whose speech is imprisoned by forces of evil is compared to a person who is starving, cold, or so ill that he has no appetite. 32:09 - If we turn away from Hashem , He turns away from us, reducing our ability to perceive His Presence in our lives. This disconnection from the Divine light is an aspect of ערף oref ("back of the neck"). 43:39 - A custom introduced by the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh : on Friday afternoon before Shabbos we say Tehillim /Psalms 107, which speaks about the challenges we went through during the six days of the week, when the 39 curses issued to Adam and Chava , which resulted in the struggle for parnassah (making a living). 45:19 - Question and response about the tzaddik's part in the process of purifying speech: nefesh corresponds to malkhus and to speech. The tzaddik has the responsibility to do this at a higher level, as the Sages taught: “Who rules over Me? The Tzaddik.” ( Mo’ed Katan 16b) 47:20 - Question and response about when a soul is ensnared and needs rescue. 49:01 - Summary of this Torah and its practical application in our lives today. 53:42 - TORAH 164. The everyday conversations of the true Tzaddik . Based on the concept taught by the Sages: "Even the everyday conversations of the Sages require study." ( Avodah Zarah 19b). *57:03 - Sometimes the Tzaddik , in order to cure a particular soul, needs to hide the Torah in a disguise, or mitigate the remedy, making it weaker so they can bear it. "If a person is worthy, the Torah can heal a person, but if a person isn't worthy, it can be a lethal poison." lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - The letters of the alef-beis (Hebrew alphabet), and the crowns, vowels, and musical notes of the written Torah. There are 600,000 letters in the Torah, representing the 600,000 root souls of the Jewish People. The yearning to achieve a greater spiritual level actually creates new life-force in a person. 11:57 - Law in Shulchan Aruch that when a married man is going away on a business trip he should be with his wife before he leaves. 15:37 - Everything in this world is created from the letters of the Torah. 19:27 - Based on a person's yearning, they can receive the light of Hashem. 21:24 - Simply wishing isn't enough, a person needs to put the yearnings into words, as in "My soul goes forth in my speech." 24:42 - What type of rabbi to search for. Based on Moed Katan : " If the rabbi is like a heavenly angel, seek the Torah from his mouth. But if not, do not seek the Torah from him." * 25:32 - Electrons and protons are the "scientific" explanation for existence, but in truth everything exists through the spiritual element of speech. 31:00 - Depending on the quality of his teacher, a student can receive a good healthy direction for how to serve Hashem. 34:11 - The four great rabbis who entered Gan Eden and only Rabbi Akiva succeeded ( Chagigah ).

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal singing "The Rebbe's Nigun ". According to Rabbi Rosenfeld's teacher, Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal (1862-1955), great grandson of Rav Nosson zal , this melody was composed and sung by Rebbe Nachman for the wedding of his daughter Sarah on Rosh Chodesh Nissan 5563 (1803). Since then, it is often sung by Breslov chassidim before learning a teaching of Rebbe Nachman. Rabbi Rosenfeld sings it with the traditional cadence passed down from father to son as received from Rebbe Nachman himself.

The Three Weeks - the era of the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . The blood of Zechariah HaNavi boiled up from the earth to be avenged. When the Roman general responsible for the murder of millions of Jews realized the horror of his actions, he abandoned his past and converted to Judaism. lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedication: This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas (for the elevation of the soul of) Gittel Leah bas Aaron Yosef ע"ה, whose yahrzeit is on the 27th of Tishrei (grandmother of Suri Albert and Aviva Wurtzel) and l'ilui nishmas HaRav Hershel Baruch haLevi ז"ל whose yahrzeit is on the 28th of Tishrei (the father of Ami Rosen). 00:36 - TORAH 207. Sweetening harsh judgments through speech. The reason Eliyahu HaNavi attends every bris milah . 23:26 - Torah 208. "The evil person looks to the tzaddik and wants to kill him, but Hashem will not abandon the tzaddik and allow him to fall into the hands of the evil person." ( Tehillim /Psalms 37). Controversy sometimes protects a tzaddik from harmful fame. It's often necessary for a tzaddik to keep a low profile to prevent the forces of evil from causing him harm. 29:48 - Both Rebbe Nachman and his student, Rav Nasan z"l , went through opposition. 30:46 - Torah 209. Everyone experiences "bad prayer" - that is, asking Hashem for things that are not connection to spiritual goals. These lower level prayers create opposition for the person's good prayers. What protects a person from this opposition is hosting a talmud chochom (Torah scholar) in his home. "The guest blesses." 42:33 - Torah 210. 43:56 - Why, on Yom Kippur , we read sefer Yonah (Jonah). 49:03 - Conclusion: when a person causes the Name of Hashem to be great in the world by doing business in an honest way, they are spared hardships in earning a living. 50:33 - Story about the importance of honoring chol hamoed .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - TORAH 211. Why do the students of a tzaddik travel to be with him for Rosh Hashanah? 05:20 - How can one attach oneself to the tzaddik ? (Reference to Likutey Moharan Torah 4.) 06:37 - TORAH 212. Clapping hands during tefilah (prayer). "All my bones will declare..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 35:10). 08:59 - Niv sifsayim - movement of the lips in tefilah . 11:06 - The only time a Jew lifts his hands is in tefilah , never to strike someone. Moshe Rabeynu confronts Dasan and Aviram . 13:29 - By clapping hands we unite our tefilah with both the Written and Oral Torah. The luchos (tablets of Torah Law given at Sinai) were constructed with 5 commandments on each of them, corresponding to the five fingers on two hands. 16:41 - When clapping hands, noise doesn't need to be made. It's the gesture that counts, not the sound. Both Rabbi Michel Dorfman z"l and Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfel z"l clapped silently (3 or 4 claps). 17:41 - TORAH 213. The protective Name of Hashem ( Samech, Alef, Lamed ) is formed from the initial letters of the phrase "Ata seyser li" in Tehillim /Psalm 32. 20:49 - Pinchas saw the letter Mem hovering during the incident of Zimri - which signified death. He combined this letter Mem with the letters of his name to create a " romach " (spear). (The gematria of Pinchas is 208 plus Mem 40 = romach 248.) 26:23 - The custom of pausing to make a separation between the words " ata seyser li " and " mitzar " when saying Tehillim 32. 28:50 - TORAH 214. Torah study protects a person from death. 33:37 - Question and response about " Atah seyser li " when saying Tikkun HaKlali . 35:03 - TORAH 215. This Torah begins with the word דע - " Da'ah " which, according to Breslov tradition, hints that the teachings it contains come from the Olam HaAtzilus - the highest level of Torah. It describes pidyon nefesh (redemption of the soul) in all 24 courts. 44:48 - The reason Moshe Rabeynu is buried "mul Baal Peor" . 48:40 - Eliezer HaGadol converted non-Jews to Torah observance. He was a gilgul (incarnation) of Moshe Rabeynu 's son, Eliezer.( Bereishis Rabbah 70:5).

"Inscribe the Torah on the tablets of your heart..." 12:28 - Tammuz is a time of greater judgment than the month of Av . 16:43 - Torah 218. Publicity and recognition can harm a person. Burial at sea of Reb Leib m'Stretenitz z"l . 22:55 - Torah 219. 25:12 - "Hashem clothes Himself in majesty ..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 93). 30:39 - The word מה indicates humility. Malchus indicates a state of lack, poverty. 39:58 - Torah 220. When a person is suffering from a major difficulty, he can benefit from speaking with a person who is blessed with wisdom, power, or wealth and authority. 45:03 - Torah 221. Ma'aser - tithing one's income. An account from the life of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l. Giving ma'aser saves a person from enemies. Hashem sides with the one who is being oppressed or attacked. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Introduction. 02:59 - PARAGRAPH 1. Breaking bread, which part do we break off? 06:10 - PARAGRAPH 2. Matzah - mochin (consciousness). 10:22 - The ten types of work that c
lessons.bodyText: Parsha in-depth study for advanced students. Text: Likutey Halakhos , Orach Chaim 2, Betziyas HaPas 3, Para. 1-7. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Introduction. 02:59 - PARAGRAPH 1. Breaking bread, which part do we break off? 06:10 - PARAGRAPH 2. Matzah - mochin (consciousness). 10:22 - The ten types of work that contribute to the creation of bread. 11:54 - The final refinement of bread is by making the bracha . 14:55 - The importance of eating in a state of kedusha (holiness). 16:40 - Why we emphasize saying the " hey " in hamotzei when making the blessing. 17:49 - Why Matza is broken into portions. 21:30 - A poor person (a person without consciousness of Hashem) is not considered truly alive. 22:16 - Tzedakah (charity) is called " prusa " (portion). 23:09 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why matzah is called lechem oni - "Bread of Poverty". Just as a poor person eats from a portion, we eat from a broken piece. *26:17 - Hilchos aveylus (laws of mourning): A mourner is not permitted to prepare his first meal. 28:11 - Changing the " ches " of chumetz to the " hey " of matzah . 28:30 - Another definition of lechem oni - bread that is spoken about. 31:02 - PARAGRAPH 4. Based on Likutey Moharan Torah 5, the kabbalistic meaning of thunder. The main yirah (awe/fear of Hashem) that a person experiences is at the time of eating. See also 2 Likutey Moharan 7 . 34:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. The first portion of bread that a person's supposed to eat is the first part that received the heat of the fire in baking. Some say this is the top of the loaf, some say the bottom. *37:02 - PARAGRAPH 6. Purchase of Ma'aras HaMachpeleh was the beginning of acquiring Eretz Yisrael . The main flow of blessing comes through Eretz Yisrael , so the main elevation of bread takes places here. The letter hey in Avraham's name was added in connection with his entering Eretz Yisrael . 40:11 - PARAGRAPH 7. The connection between Avraham Avinu 's purchase of Ma'aras HaMachpeleh and the holiness in matzah /bread. 41:12 - It's important to eat meals in a state of simcha - joy.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated by Peretz Rubel in memory of his mother: l'iluy nishmas Sara Leah bas Lieber a"h , whose yahrzeit is on the 3rd of Kislev . 00:18 - Telling stories of tzaddikim (righteous people) in the proper way purifies thought. 17:30 - הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ "...and the Torah gives life to those who bring it forth." (Koheles /Ecclesiastes 7:12). It is crucial to vocalize Torah study, not simply read text with the eyes. 18:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The importance of how, to whom, and about whom a story of Tzaddikim is told. 21:41 - Sefer Kokhvey Ohr – "Stars of Light" – is a Breslov collection of biographical accounts collected by Reb Avrum b'Reb Nachman Tulchiner . 27:32 - PARAGRAPH 3. Emulating Hashem is achieved through the ten levels of holiness in Eretz Yisrael . 32:12 - "Ain tamid eleh Eretz Yisrael" – the concept of forever is the Land of Israel ( Midrash Yalkut Tehillim 105). 33:02 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 7: Eretz Yisrael, tefilah , and miracles – these three are one. 33:23 - PARAGRAPH 4. The Name of Hashem that's used to appoint a king. 36:26 - Daniel replies concerning Nevuchadnezzar: הוּא מְהַשְׁנֵ֚א עִדָּֽנַיָּא֙ וְזִמְנַיָּ֔א מְהַעְדֵּ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין וּמְהָקֵ֣ים מַלְכִ֑ין "He changes the seasons, He removes kings and He appoints kings." ( Daniel 2:21). 36:50 - The meaning of Yosef HaTzaddik 's dream about the stalks of grain bowing. 37:45 - Note about the tefilah said on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur : Vechol Ma'aminim – "And All Who Believe." 39:00 - Biographical note about Rebbe Nachman: he told his students that what influenced him in a powerful way as a child was living in the house that belonged to his great-grandfather, the Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh . He explained that because his parents raised him in this house, he often heard the stories of tzaddikim whenever travelers passed through to pay their respects. 41:30 - Saying the section of Likutey Tefilos that relates to this teaching helps a person be able to relate stories of tzaddikim in a good way. 42:17 - The Vilna Gaon criticizes the Rambam's statements about amulets not truly being effective. 44:42 - The power of saying Shemos HaTzaddim .

lessons.bodyText: Vayeishev - Youthfulness in Serving HaShem - Biographical Notes About Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. *00:00 - Yosef HaTzaddik is called Ben Zakunim - "a child of old age" . The importance of youthfulness in serving HaShem . The yetzer hara (evil inclination) is called an "old, foolish King', as in ט֛וֹב יֶ֥לֶד מִסְכֵּ֖ן וְחָכָ֑ם מִמֶּ֤לֶךְ זָקֵן֙ וּכְסִ֔יל ( Koheles 4:13). Likutey Moharan 1 - Jewish respect for knowledge and intellect. Yehoshua bin Nun was called a naar (youth) - because he was youthful in his service of HaShem . It takes a certain youthfulness to do teshuvah (return to Hashem). 04:24 - Rabbi Yekutiel , the Magid of Terhovitz , asked where the seforim of Adam HaRishon, Noach , and the Avos are. His question was answered in a teaching he heard from Rebbe Nachman of Breslov: Likutey Moharan II, Torah 32. This explanation immediately convinced him to become a student of Rebbe Nachman. 15:05 - Biographical notes in honor of the yahrzeit of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh BenZion b"R Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal , whose yahrzeit is on the 11th of Kislev . He passed away in 1978 (5739) in Eretz Yisrael and his gravesite is on Har HaZeisim (the Mount of Olives). 20:34 - The shiur on parsha continues: azus dekedusha (boldness in serving HaShem ). Why are goats prominent at times in the Torah, for example in the incident of Yehuda and Tamar ? What's the meaning of Esav Ish Seir ? What can we learn from the azus (brazenness, stubbornness) of goats? 25:36 - Closing remarks - observing Chanukah properly requires azus dekedusha .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedication of shiur l'ilui nishmas Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l . 00:23 - TORAH 235. If a person is ridiculed for slipping and falling while he's walking, this came about through a lack of respect for the observance of Yom Tov (Jewish holidays) with joy. Reference to Hoshea 9. 04:22 - Three reasons why Hashem imposes suffering on a person: to atone for sins, to remind a person to repent, and/or to increase a person's reward in Olam HaEmes (the World of Truth). 05:02 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 65 - why, when a person experiences pain, he closes his eyes. 05:37 - Questions and responses. 07:13 - TORAH 236. When a person honors a Torah teacher, he is rewarded according through whatever is considered valuable in his particular generation. Oral tradition about this. 10:42 - Teaching heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld based on a mishnah in Peyah concerning pretending to be blind in order to increase the collection of funds for tzedakah (charity). If a person pretends to be a tzaddik , will he eventually become one? ( Peyah, Perek 8, Mishnah 9) 12:54 - TORAH 237. Music and song were elevated in the world through Levi. Why Leah named her son Levi: joining two things together is done through nigun (music). The importance of music at a Jewish wedding. Pesukei deZimra . 16:33 - The importance of saying Tehillim (Psalms). 24:40 - TORAH 238. The dynamic of disagreements between people sometimes involves the shoresh neshama (root of souls). 27:41 - Reference to sefer Noam Elimelech : why some people immediately seem "familiar" - it depends on the root of each soul. 30:38 - TORAH 239. Conflict makes it impossible to communicate; the essence of communication is through peace. Accepting upon oneself the mitzvah of "love your neighbor as yourself" before tefilah (prayer). 34:26 - Note from the teachings of Rabbi Rosenfeld based on the SHeLaH HaKodesh : explanation of why seeing a pot in a dream indicates peace. 38:39 - The word sukkah represents peace and incorporate two Names of Hashem (in gematria 380. W Shem HaEtzem and Alef Daled Nun Yud . 41:43 - Speech originates from heat. 44:02 - Connection between speech and tevas Noach (Noah's ark): the five parts of the mouth that are used to form words. 44:46 - TORAH 240. (Beginning). All blessing that comes into the world is sent via the true tzaddik . " Tzaddik yisod olam ." The riddle of Shimshon (Samson). The mazal (fortune) of a person is received through the tzaddik .

TORAH 240. All blessing comes through the tzaddik . Chana the wife of Elkanah is assured by Eli HaKohen that her tefilos (prayers) will be answe
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 240 - 241 - 242 - Hiskashrus - Attachment with to the Tzaddik - Praying on Behalf of a Friend - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (lm1-302, Recorded on 2019-12-15.) TORAH 240. All blessing comes through the tzaddik . Chana the wife of Elkanah is assured by Eli HaKohen that her tefilos (prayers) will be answered. ***If someone is ill or someone in his household is ill, he should ask a chocham to pray for them. ***One who prays for his friend is answered first - an explanation given by Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . What is mazal ? *** Moshol - parable - of a person trying to lift a heavy object and the exertion causes them harm or even kills him. *What does "attaching oneself with the tzaddik " mean? Reference to < em>Likutey Moharan 4 . First way: traveling to see him and breathe the same air, "Your eyes should see your teacher." The Torah is not only conveyed through hearing, it's conveyed through all one's senses. Second way of being close to the tzaddik : supporting him through tzedakah - charity. Third way: opening one's heart to the tzaddik can be done through speaking about one's difficulties. Fourth way: studying his Torah and following his advice. It's impossible for a person to have both wealth and chochmah (Torah knowledge), unless he has true humility. Maggid of Mezeritch. TORAH 241. When judgement comes directly through HaShem He does not destroy a person completely, as in "I will use up my arrows on them " ( Devarim 32:23, Haazinu ). However, HaShem does allow a human opponent to destroy another person completely. Counting Jews brings judgement. Dovid HaMelech was mistaken to count the people of Am Yisrael and the result was a deadly plague. When a person judges himself, he is protected from Divine punishment. *Reuven saved Yosef HaTzaddik from his brothers by suggesting they throw him into a pit with snakes and scorpions. The Ohr HaChaim HaKodesh explains why this was considered a rescue. Bilaam and Pinchas . Question and response: can the tzaddik fool the midas hadin (heavenly judgement)? Story from the Zohar HaKodesh about one of the students of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . Question and response about Pinchas . TORAH 242. Orech Anpin of the klipos - holiness is paralleled by unholiness. The negative forces oppose to HaShem's light but sometimes it's difficult to tell that they're forces of darkness. Rabbi Masya ben Chorosh prevented being distracted by the sight of a woman by blinding himself. Giving Tzedakah can save a person from sinful thoughts. It's best for a man to avoid excessive conversation with a woman. Q&R: why are thoughts of niuf (illicit relationship) compared to death?

lessons.bodyText: Rav Avrohom ben Devorah v'b'R Naftali Hertz Sternhartz zal passed away on the 20th of Elul 5715 (1955). He was the great-grandson of Rav Nasan of Nemirov zal and grandson of the Tcheriner Rav zal . Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal speaks about him on Rav Avrohom's yahrzeit . (Recorded ca. 1972, based on a comment by R' Nasan Maimon in a later hilula for Rav Avrohom zal .) Introduction. When speaking about Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal , we can only say: לְךָ֚ דֻמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה - "Silence is praise..." ( Tehillim 65:2). "Let's try to understand - what does a Tzaddik Emes do for us - what does he accomplish?" - Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . The Tzaddik Emes/Shabbos separates Yismael from Esav and thereby subdues both powers of evil. Rebbe Nachman hid his miracles. " Rav Kokhav-Lev zal never took a vacation from Tikkun Chatzos " - Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . "Every morning he was up for Vasikin ." Rav Kokhav-Lev zal knew the entire Likutey Moharan by heart. Rav Moshe Breslever zal testified that Rav Kokhav-Lev's shiur in Likutey Halakhos was given over exactly as his grandfather, Rav Nachman Tcherin zal , had said it. Rav Kokhav-Lev zal was the Baal Tefilah for the Rosh Hashanah gathering in Uman for at least 50 years - . Closing blessing. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel

The story illustrates how essential it is to receive the guidance of a
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. *6:23 - A tzaddik answers a person according to how their question is presented. 24:48 - Account from the Kokhvey Ohr about Reb Mordechai m'Neshkiz who advised one of his students to buy a building. The story illustrates how essential it is to receive the guidance of a true tzaddik to be able to withstand the confusion caused by forces of evil (an aspect of Pharaoh). 30:37 - QUESTION - Were the meraglim considered the tzaddikim of the generation? If so, why was Am Yisrael held so accountable? 34:05 - Story of how R' Nasan of Nemirov wouldn't give up seeking the best possible advice from Rebbe Nachman. 36:56 - Incident in Rabbi Maimon's life when Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l advised him about parnassah . Rabbi Rosenfeld encouraged his students to work and learn. 44:33 - PARAGRAPH 9. Fasting during a drought to bring rain. Emunas chochomim (faith in true rabbis) is essential to faith in Hashem. Receiving advice from a true tzaddik repairs the soul. An example of this is when Hashem revealed the Yud Gimmel Midos HaRachamim to Moshe Rabbeinu to remedy the sin of the Golden Calf. The Yud Gimmel Midos correspond to the 13 Principles through which the Torah is acquired. 55:51 - QUESTION - The "13 points of the beard" refer to the 13 Attributes of Hashem's Mercy/Kindness.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Review of previous shiur and introduction to the Megalah Amukos (Rav Nosson Notta Shapira) quoted in the Yalkut HaReuveni . 02:06 - PARAGRAPH 10. Introduction to mystical aspects of the geviya shel Yosef HaTzaddik (Cup of Joseph). The Megalah Amukos gives 252 explanations from many different sources for Moshe Rabbeinu's yearning to be in Eretz Yisrael He brings that the word גביע " geviya " (cup) is a combination of 2 parts: yod gimmel (13) times veis ayin (72) - chesed /kindness). This alludes to Hashem's 13 Attributes of Kindness. This also equals 936 which is " shalom " with the Mem Sofis in full (300 plus 30 plus 6 plus . 08:53 - PARAGRAPH 11. 11:38 - Ehven SheSiya (Foundation Stone) is an aspect of the perfection of advice. The main satiation of the body is through drinking, which supports the process of digestion and helps the food nourish the body. 14:07 - The significance of the cup of wine used for bentching Birkhas HaMazon (blessing after a meal). *16:43 - The spiritual and physical benefits of saying Birkhas HaMazon . 17:35 - The focus of this blessing is Eretz Yisrael , which is the source of good counsel. 18:31 - Dovid HaMelech (King David) will hold the Kos Shel Bracha at the time of Moshiach . 24:46 - Why the haftarah of Parshas VaYigash describes how the split in the Kingdom of Israel will be repaired. 26:00 - The dispute between Yosef HaTzaddik and his brothers was precursor to the splitting of the Kingdom of Israel between Malchus ben Dovid and Yeravam ben Navat . *21:01 - Universal and eternal unity is expressed in the possuk "On that day Hashem will be one and His Name will be One." (Zechariah 14:9) 28:08 - QUESTION: if the great talmidei chochomim of the past failed to achieve unity and perfection of counsel, what chance do we have? RESPONSE: Account about Rav Nachman Tulchiner was appointed by Rav Nasan of Nemirov as the one to guide people through aitza, even though Rav Nachman Tcherin was much more knowledgeable. 32:45 - Tehillim /Psalms 101: "I walk within my house with the sincerity of my heart." Story of Reb Avrum Ber and Reb Moshe Breslover. 42:10 - PARAGRAPH 12. 43:59 - PARAGRAPH 13. The stones Yaakov Avinu placed around his head correspond to the 12 precious stones in the choshen of the Kohen Gadol in the Beis HaMikdash . 54:58 - Closing remarks and blessings for creating achdus (unity) in our homes and interactions with others. 56:09 - QUESTION: to prepare for receiving better aitza , should we try to do an act that facilitates greater peace? RESPONSE: Yes. This is an aspect of the tree (in the Tale of the Fifth Beggar) where all are at peace with one another (Rebbe Nachman's story of the Seven Beggars).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Taanis 4 - Aitza (Advice) - Baalei Teshuvah - Opposition of Angels - Finding a True Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and review. Today, the 4th of Iyar , is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Maimon's paternal grandmother, Malka Sara bas R' Shabsi ע"ה 01:32 - PARAGRAPH 14. Asifa (gather together elements t
lessons.bodyText: Taanis 4 - Aitza (Advice) - Baalei Teshuvah - Opposition of Angels - Finding a True Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and review. Today, the 4th of Iyar , is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Maimon's paternal grandmother, Malka Sara bas R' Shabsi ע"ה 01:32 - PARAGRAPH 14. Asifa (gather together elements that are nearby) vs. kibbutz (gather together elements from distant places). Aitza (advice, counsel) pertains to the feet, which follow through on the concepts and bring a person into action in this world. As Hashem says, "...the earth is my footstool." ( Yishayahu /Isaiah 66:1). Good counsel is not needed in the Eternal World. Baalei Teshuva (those who return to Torah observance) need to access a deeper level of aitza than most others. 08:18 - The true perfection of knowledge is the clear direction of action that can help a person achieve eternal success, not just success in this world. In Mishlei /Proverbs the Torah is referred to as "advice". 08:41 - HaShem did not give the Torah to the angels. Moshe Rabbeinu's response to the angels who opposed his presence in Heaven to receive the Torah. 12:15 - What was the mistake of the angels? 17:03 - The main thing is not studying the Torah, but rather putting it into deeds. 23:05 - Psychologists cannot replace the aitza of true tzaddikim . *30:37 - QUESTION: How do I know who is a true tzaddik and how can I decide which one to follow? RESPONSE: Because the tzaddikim are hidden, praying for aitza tova is the best way to be able to find and obtain counsel from a true tzaddik . A powerful tefilah for this is in the siddur when we say (in Maariv and Kriyas Shema al HaMitah ): ותקננו בעצה טובה מלפניך “Vesakneynu b’aitza tova m’lfanecha” – “Establish us through good counsel.” 36:08 - QUESTION: What was the deeper reason the angels were not given the Torah? The Torah is not simply concepts, it lives through man's fulfillment of the mitzvos based on emunah /faith. 45:08 - Even though the enemies of the Jews rose to power during the holocaust, they ultimately failed and became less than nothing. 49:20 - The meaning of Yaakov Avinu holding onto the heel of Esav at birth. 50:09 - The establishment of a kingdom depends on its advisors. 52:05 - Closing remarks about the suffering of Am Yisrael and its assured redemption.

lessons.bodyText: Taanis 4- Yaakov Avinu's Victory Over the Angel of Esav - Eating to Strengthen Emuna (Faith) - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Introduction and Dedications. This shiur was given on the 5th of Iyar , 5780. This is the day Rebbe Nachman left Breslov and began his journey to Uman in preparation for his passing from the world. It's the yahrzeit of Reb Yitzchak Menachem b'Reb ---- Rothenberg z"l , a close friend of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld's father and a leading Breslover chossid in his generation. The 5th of Iyar is also the yahrzeit of Reb Moshe ben AKiva HaKohen Eisenmesser z"l , an outstanding Breslov scholar. 03:31 - Comment about Yom HaAtzma'ut (Israeli Independence Day). 27:57 - Dovid HaMelech (King David) knew the exact time of chatzos . The Breslov tradition is that it begins 6 hours after nightfall, and lasts for two hours. 43:33 - Received from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : the four names of Moshiach . 45:28 - QUESTION about Moshiach . 47:08 - PARAGRAPH 16. Chatzos - the midnight prayer. 53:25 - Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal begin his day at chatzos halayla , 7 days a week, for over 70 years.

lessons.bodyText: Taanis 4 - Prayer at Chatzos HaLayla - Half- Shekel Pidyon - the Danger of Counting Jews - Covid-19 - Sohd HaIbu r (Inter-calculation of Solar and Lunar Calendars)Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Taanis 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 61. 00:00 - Dedicated l'ilui nishmas (for the elevation of the soul of) Reb Hillel b'Reb Meir by his family in Johannesburg. 00:16 - PARAGRAPH 16. The importance of waking up at chatzos halayla (6 hours after nightfall). The light of day represents geulah (redemption). 12:21 - Dovid HaMelech (King David) represents moshiach . *13:19 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about how to begin waking up for prayer at chatzos . Rabbi Maimon supports the Breslov Chatzos Kollel , where members begin their day at chatzos halayla and continue learning Torah until the earliest possible morning tefilah (prayer) at netz hachama (daybreak). 19:04 - PARAGRAPH 17. Rosh Chodesh Adar and the Machtzis HaShekel (half-shekel) donation. The three things Moshe Rabbeinu had to be shown through illustration by Hashem, form the letters of his name: M enorah , S hekel , and H aChodesh . 25:40 - Why it's forbidden to count Jews. The half-shekel donation protected Am Yisrael from plagues that could result by counting Jews. 27:42 - Chesed (kindness) originates from Chokhmah (wisdom). *30:28 - When a couple marries, the chasan says to the kallah "I betroth you according to the Law of Moshe and Israel." Moshe Rabbeinu is equivalent to the Jewish Nation. Gematria heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : the Mem of Moshe's name, 40, times the Shin of his name, is 12,000. This number multiplied by the Hey of his name is 60,000. This number multiplied by Moshe Rabbeinu's height, 10 amos (cubits), equals 600,000 - the number of root Jewish souls. 36:09 - The last words of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai z"l just before his passing were: שם צוה ד את-הברכה חיים "...for there HaShem has commanded the blessing, may there be life..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 133:3) 36:58 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about a possible connection between counting the Omer and the fact that at the time this shiur was given, every day on the news there were announcements of the number of people who died, or who were ill, or who recovered from the Covid-19 virus. 43:16 - PARAGRAPH 18. The unification of the twelve tribes of Israel and the inter-calculation of the solar and lunar calendars - Sohd HaIbur . The tziruf (form of HaShem's Name) that one has in mind during the sanctification of the new month on the Shabbos preceding each Rosh Chodesh . The tziruf for the additional Adar during a leap year includes all the forms of HaShem's Name.

The sound of the shofar is an aspect of teshuvah (return to Hashem) and tefilah (prayer) from the depths of the heart. *13:16 - Chiddush (Torah innovation)from the AriZal on קָר֣וֹב יְ֖הֹוָה לְכָל־קֹֽרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶֽאֱמֶֽת - "Hashem is close to those who call to Him, all those who call out to Him with honesty" - ( Tehillim 145:18). 16:00 - Return to text: through sincere tefilah a person can be rescued from difficulties. Teruah is the only sound of the shofar mentioned in the written Torah. Description of the three different sounds of the shofar . The four aspects of Hashem's throne parallel the four elements: earth, air, fire, water. The creation of the world was through אמת emes (truth). Emes preceded the creation of the world. 28:00 - Why the shofar is narrow on one side and wide on the other, and why it must be sounded from the narrow side. *34:15 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about expressing anger toward Hashem, expressing feelings with respect and humility. 35:36 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about possuk (verse) "min hameytzar" - "From the depths I called out to You Hashem." 37:24 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about two levels of truth. 42:28 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about Moshe Rabbeinu arguing with Hashem to save Am Yisrael . The joys of the World-to-Come can be experienced by thanking Hashem and praising Him. "In the future, all sacrifices will be abolished except for the thanksgiving-offering." ( VaYikra Rabbah 9:7, 27:12). 04:27 - PARAGRAPH 2. How the heart is affected when a person suffers or is troubled. 06:38 - Four types of people required to give special praise to Hashem through the blessing " HaGomel " - based on Tehillim 107. What is " Toras Chesed " ( Mishlei ) - is there a Torah that's not Chessed ? The heart is the place of understanding and is therefore most sensitive to any crisis, physical, emotional, or spiritual. During any affliction, the blood rushes to the heart to "seek counsel" about what to do. 17:50 - PARAGRAPH 3. Spiritual aspects of childbirth and how these principles apply to Halakha - Torah Law. 26:04 - The suffering of Asa. One of the ultimate goals of Torah study is to reach the conclusion of Halakha , that is, what action does the Torah advise. 29:21 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about why Asa's legs were affected, as opposed to his eyes. 30:42 - PARAGRAPH 4. Thanking Hashem for the good things in our life enlightens our speech, as does speaking the Emes (truth).

lessons.title: 2020-05-19 - LH3 - OC3 - Rosh Hashanah 5 - Intro. - Para. 1-2a - Yitzchak Avinu - Time - Sleep - HaKol Kol Yaakov - Yisro - Listening to the Shofar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 79 and 2Likutey Moharan 61. *00:00 - Introduction. Yitzchak is related to time. Hi name contains the word Chai - life - and Ketz - end - referring to temporal existence. 11:58 - Chiddush (Torah innovation) heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל ab
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 79 and 2Likutey Moharan 61. *00:00 - Introduction. Yitzchak is related to time. Hi name contains the word Chai - life - and Ketz - end - referring to temporal existence. 11:58 - Chiddush (Torah innovation) heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל about HaKol Kol Yaakov - "the voice is the voice of Yaakov." Kol is twice Orev (sweet) in Gematria . 14:53 - Elul is b'Gamtria Binah , which is above time. The seven lower Sefiros represent time. *16:36 - The letters Kuf and Tzaddik of Yitzchak correspond to sleep. 16:54 - Explanation of sleep and how it distorts time (based on Likutey Moharan 61). 19:53 - Midrash Rabbah on the meanings of the letters in the name Yitzchak . The kuf and the tzaddik refer to the 190 years from Yitzchak Avinu 's birth to when Yaakov Avinu went down to Mitzrayim (Egypt). These are counted as the first 190 years of Galus (exile). *21:58 - Continuing inside the text - Yitzchak ben Avraham is the concept of reaching a level above time through Teshuvah (repentance/return to Hashem). 25:57 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 ( Tinyana ) 79 - " VaYishma Yisro " - "And Yisro heard". He heard about Krias Yam Suf (the splitting of the Red Sea) and the defeat of Amalek . Kriyas Yam Suf is bitul hazmanim - the nullification of temporality. A miracle eliminates time. 27:26 - Examples of miracles involving the nullification of time. Aharon and Hur supporting the hands of Moshe Rabbeinu . 31:47 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about where Yaakov Avinu fits into this relationship to time. 32:25 - PARAGRAPH 1. The Mitzvah of listening to the sound of the Shofar on Rosh Hashanah . 37::18 - Why the Shofar is made of a ram's horn. 39:66 - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld: The word Zman - time (97) is b'gematria Hashem's Name "Kel" which indicates Hashem's kindness ( "chesed keyl kol hayom" ) and Shem Adnus 65 plus 31 is 96 plus 1 for the Kollel is Zman . Kol represents the six Sefiros of Zer Anpin . 42:52 - PARAGRAPH 2. *44:36 - The concept of time represents incomplete Daas (knowledge/awareness of Hashem). Time is distorted during sleep. 53:11 - QUESTION and RESPONSE. What is the purpose of going above time? 55:49 - QUESTION about time bound Mitzvos and RESPONSE: why this world is more important to Hashem than all other worlds. 56:42 - QUESTION about Olam HaBah (the World to Come) being an aspect of "length of days". RESPONSE: Why the two days of Rosh Hashanah are considered "one long day." 57:30 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about time seeming to speed up in our generation even though there's less Daas .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon

Hilkhos Rosh Hashanah 6 refers to the last story in Rebbe Nachman's Sipurei Masiyos , specifically to the Tale of the Sixth Begg
lessons.bodyText: Rosh Hashanah 6 - Parshas Bereishis - Castle of Water - Blessing for Rain on Shemini Atzeres - Moshe at the Wellspring - Sukkos - Giving Tzedakah With Two Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Rosh Hashanah 6 refers to the last story in Rebbe Nachman's Sipurei Masiyos , specifically to the Tale of the Sixth Beggar. - Introduction to explain what Roshei Perokim are in the Likutey Halakhos . - PARAGRAPH 3. Castle of Water. The blessing for rain on Shemini Atzeres and the ten walls of water in the Tale of the Sixth Beggar. - Moshe Rabbeinu , when traveling through Midian, went to a wellspring because he knew the Avos (forefathers) found their Zivugim (marriage partners) through water. - The Avos were involved in digging wells. The Tefilah for rain on Shemini Atzeres . - Q&R - are the Tikkunim alluded to through walls of water connected with Kriyas Yam Suf (the splitting of the Red Sea)? - *Q&R summarizing briefly the entire Tale of the Sixth Beggar, including a reference to how the ten walls of water and the Midos of HaShem . - PARAGRAPH 4. Sukkos and the Arba Minim (the Four Species). - The vapor that rises up from the earth is an aspect of the Isarusa deLasata - awakening from below. Water represents Daas (knowledge of Hashem that's communicated). - * Parshas Bereishis. Why the creation of water is not mentioned in the Torah in a revealed way. The mysteries of the "Castle of Water" and ten walls of water in Rebbe Nachman's story of The Seven Beggars (Tale of the Sixth Day). - Why the abbreviation for the sounds of the Shofar is " KeSHeT " (bow). - The generation of the Mabul - flood. - Q&R about the rainbow not being seen during the life of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . Explanation of the blessing we say on seeing a rainbow. - One of the main functions of Tzaddikim is to protect the world, especially today. - Q&R - Tikkun haBris in today's world? The restraint developed for Tikkun HaBris is a key to many other mitzvos . - How Tikkun HaBris is also a key to parnassah (livelihood). - Comment about Tevas Noach in the writings of the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh . - *RESPONSE describing what a Klipa is - it's not only harmful, but also protective. - The Ten Days of Teshuvah prepared us for the tikkun of mayim (water) which is accomplished during Sukkos , for example through Simchas Beis haShoeyvah - Celebration of the Water Drawing. Why Sukkos is called the "Zman Simchaseynu" - the "Season of Our Joy". Allusion to the Leviasan , which is b'Gematria Malchus . - The importance of increasing tzedakah on Erev Sukkos to insure joy on the Yom Tov . - Tzedakah as "open, open your hands" as explained in the Likutey Moharan . - PARAGRAPH 5. Why the mitzva of the Arba Minim - Four Species - on Sukkos is done through the hands. Women remove rings from their fingers before making the blessing on the Lulav and Esrog . - *Q&R - Is giving Tzedakah with two hands an allegory or literal? RESPONSE: יְהֹוָ֥ה שֹֽׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהֹוָ֥ה צִ֜לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ “Hashem is your shadow at your right hand.” ( Tehillim 121:5). - ***KABBALAH COURSE - Every nuance of our actions to serve HaShem make a big difference. - ***RESPONSE specifically to giving tzedakah with two hands: in Breslov communities in Eretz Yisrael it is a custom to take this literally, but Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal said that “with two hands” can also mean with all one’s heart. - Q&R about how to hold the Arba Minim . The function of the Koshikel - the woven holder for the Lulav , Hadas , and Arava . - Q&R about Simchas Torah . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Yom HaKippurim 1 - Harnessing the Animal Soul - Importance of Marriage - Moshe Rabbeinu and Tziporah - Tikkun HaBris for Women - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Yom HaKippurim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 29 . PARAGRAPH 2. The Kohen Gadol is not permitted to enter the Kadosh Kadoshim without spiritual preparation. The purpose of sacrifices offered in the Beis HaMikdash were to subdue animal desires in man. אַל־תִּהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶתֶג ורֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרוֹב אֵלֶֽיךָ - "Be not as a horse, as a mule with no discernment, who must be held with bit and bridle, so when he’s being groomed, he doesn’t come near you" ( Tehillim 32:9). Roshei Teyvos (initial first letters) of the words בְּמֶתֶג ורֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם spell בועל. PARAGRAPH 3. Tikkun HaBris is prerequisite to receiving the Torah. One of the ways this level of purity is achieved is through observing the mitzvos of Yom Kippur. *Q&R: How does Tikkun HaBris (guarding the covenant) apply to women? In addition to tznius - modesty and maintaining purity between husband and wife, shemiras haloshon is especially relevant for women since malchus peh is an aspect of shemiras habris and women have nine tenths of the world's power of speech ( Kiddushin 49b). Preparing for and observing Shabbos is also an aspect of Shemiras Habris . Reference to Likutey Moharan 36. Q&R about Nadav and Avihu . PARAGRAPH 4. Through fasting a person can subdue physical desires. Reference to Likutey Moharan 37. The 5 restraints of Yom Kippur. PARAGRAPH 5a. On Yom Kippur we say ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד aloud.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 29. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The האושפיזין ha-ushpizin (Aramaic for "the guests"), Israel's "Seven Shepherds", the supernal visitors to the sukkah during the holiday of Sukkos . 11:00 - Definition of a person's rabbi - the one who teaches us emunah - fai
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 29. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The האושפיזין ha-ushpizin (Aramaic for "the guests"), Israel's "Seven Shepherds", the supernal visitors to the sukkah during the holiday of Sukkos . 11:00 - Definition of a person's rabbi - the one who teaches us emunah - faith in Hashem. 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Even if the walls of the sukkah don't actually reach up to the schakh (roofing of reeds), the sukkah is kosher as long as the walls are at least 10 tefachim tall, measured from the floor. Any partition above 10 tefachim marks a division between public and private domain (10 tefachim equals about 80 to 100 cm or about 3 to 3 1/2 feet). 16:00 - QUESTION about how the Seven Shepherds relate to the seven openings of the head. 26:00 - HALAKHA 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Preventing a "Fallen Sukkah" - reference to the movement of the blood through the 365 gidin (sinews) which correspond to the 365 mitzvos lo t'asey Torah prohibitions. Reference to Likutey Moharan 29, "keshes habris" (bow of the covenant), and the support given to the sukkah through the arba minim (four species), which are an aspect of the four white garments worn by the Kohen Gadol on Yom HaKippurim . *35:00 - The sukkah is an aspect of Ema-Binah - spiritually, a mother's womb. The four days between Yom HaKippurim and Sukkos correspond to the four white garments. 41:00 - Why we hold the Arba Minim during Hallel . Saying Hallel achieves tikkun hadibur for speech and shaking the lulav achieves tikkun haklali for the entire body. All four types of tikkun haklali are connected. 58:00 - Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l emphasized carrying the arba minim with pride when walking to shul during Sukkos . 61:00 - QUESTION about why we don't make the blessing on the Arba Minim on Shabbos . 61:00 - CLOSING COMMENTS about the 20th of Sivan , yahrzeit of Rabbi Shimson Ostropoli z"l and Rabbi Yechiel Michel of Nemirov z"l . Commemoration of the hundreds of thousands of Jewish martyrs during the Chmelnitsky massacres (Ukraine, 1648) which began the day this shiur was given.

lessons.bodyText: Halakha 109 - Shabbat - Mitzvot deOreita and deRabanan - Carrying on Shabbat - Gold Watch of Rabbi Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal - Muktza - Candle Lighting - Preparing for Shabbat - Challot - Kiddush and Eyesight - Rabbi Akiva and the Importance of Attending a Torah Shiur - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . Techum Shabbat - the maximum distance one is permitted to walk outside of a city on Shabbat . Mitzvot deOreita (laws based on the written Torah) and mitzvot deRabanan (rabbinic ordinances). The prohibition of carrying on Shabbat . Rabbi Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal let his gold watch fall into the gutter when he discovered it in his pocket on Shabbat . Brief overview of the Beit Yosef and the Shulchan Aruch . Laws of muktza (objects that are forbidden to move on Shabbat ). Why it's forbidden to lean against a tree on Shabbat . Most muktza can be touched as long as it isn't moved. Items that are not solidly immovable, like a chandelier, may not be touched. Chapter 310 in the Shulchan Aruch speaks about "basis l'devar muktza" - when the table supports items that may not be moved on Shabbat . *Why the mitzvah of candle lighting is given to women. The husband should put the candelabra on the table, prepare the lights, and singe the wicks to make it easier for the wife to kindle the lights. Disposing of a tissue on Shabbat . The mitzva of carrying from private domain to public domain on Shabbat can be overridden by rabbinic decree to uphold kavod hatzibur . When making Kiddush on Shabbat , gazing at the wine heals physical eyesight. The candles should be on the table where the meal will be. They can be moved by the husband after the wife lights them, if more room is needed at the table for guests. Kiddush Friday night is said standing, and then one sits down to drink the wine. *It is an important minhag ARIzal (custom based on the Zohar HaKadosh ) to leave the kiddush cup on the Shabbat table through Shabbat with a bit of wine in the bottom. The kiddush cup should not be removed from the table until after Shabbat . For each meal, it can be rinsed out just before the meal and replaced. Story from the life of Rabbi Akiva about the importance of attending a Torah shiur . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Halakha 109 (Clip) - Shabbat - My Father's Gold Watch - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal with questions from students. Rabbi Yisroel Abba Rosenfeld zal (1882-1947) was a descendant of Rav Aharon zal - the Rav of Breslov and a close student of Rebbe Nachman. During the Russian Revolution, Rabbi Yisrael Abba's brother, Zvi Aryeh hy"d , was murdered by the Bolsheviks. Rabbi Yisrael Abba escaped with his wife and young daughter to Poland, where his son, Rabbi Zvi Aryeh was born. The family emigrated to America in 1924 and settled in the Brownsville section of Brooklyn. Excerpt from a class in the Torah Laws of Shabbat in which Rabbi Rosenfeld zal speaks about his father. TRANSCRIPT: Rabbi Rosenfeld: ... . Rabbi Rosenfeld: While you are walking, without stopping. Should you have stopped, then you can take it out of your pocket and put it on the floor, but the crime has been committed already. The minute you stop walking, you have made a hanacha . You have stopped. You have deposited this item. Even though you didn't touch it at all. So therefore under no condition should you stop. The biggest mistake is a person who says "Ooh, I have something in my pocket," and he stops. That stopping is the same as a person putting on a light and saying "Ooh, I put it on." And he puts it off right away. On Shabbat . Student: So the question is, what do you do? Rabbi Rosenfeld: Once he stopped, the thing is done. And now he can't start walking again with it because he would break another law. So he's got to drop it out of his pocket when he stopped. He did a wrong thing, naturally. Student: How about a person who's going to shul ... Rabbi Rosenfeld: ... telling stories! Student: No, but you feel it , and there's a red light. And you're stopping for the red light and you keep on walking and you're hit by the car? Another Student: You walk in a circle! Rabbi Rosenfeld: I once told you a story. You forgot it. I was about four, five years old at the time. It was Friday night. I don't recall the story exactly. The three of us were walking. Walking with our father, alav hashalom . And as he walked, he suddenly felt in his pocket and his watch was there. Now this was a watch he got in Europe. A gold watch. And everything he had in the world was in that gold watch. In other words, this was the only money he had to his name. And he just looked at it, "Ooh!" And I remember seeing the gold and I thought to myself, 'Shabbat? The gold watch? How do you give up everything you own?' He didn't think for a second. He kept walking for a few steps and went over to the gutter and just dropped it in the gutter. Now, there were a lot of things he could have done. But the thing was: this showed the yirat shemayim. Listen to the entire shiur HERE .

lessons.bodyText: Arbaah Minim 2 - The Lulav as Spiritual Weapon - Aravos - Hadas - Ushpizin - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Arbaah Minim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . Dedications. This shiur was given on the 15th of Tammuz , yahrzeit of the Ohr HaChaim HaKadosh . He explained why Reuven's suggestion to throw Yosef HaTzaddik into a pit is considered a "rescue." PARAGRAPH 3. All beauty is contained within the Arbaah Minim - The 4 Species. The word שדיים is composed of the roshei teyvos of : Smol Dokeh, Yemin Mekarev (the left pushes away, the right gathers in). Meaning behind the shaking of the Lulav . PARAGRAPH 4. The meaning of the Aravos (willow twigs): when newcomers begin to serve HaShem . The Hadas (myrtle branches) represents how a Jewish soul's return to HaShem completes the mizbeyach . Meaning of the Hadas . Sephardic custom of using Hadas for Havdallah . NoGaH is roshei teyvos: הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ ( Bereishis 17:5). PARAGRAPH 5. The Ushpizin - The Seven Shepherds of Am Yisrael who are guests in the Sukkah . Tikkun HaAchila is accomplished through eating in the Sukkah . Why the holiday of Sukkos is called Chag HaAssif - the Harvest Festival. PARAGRAPH 6. Through the mitzvah of tzedakah the "air" is cleared and a person makes friends. Q&R How does eating in holiness bring kapara (atonement)? Closing blessings on completing this halakha . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

( G'ra , Sifrei D'tzniusa? ) However, since a number of posukim in the Torah are disputed as to being one or two verses, the exact correspondence isn't known. According to one calculation, the posuk for 5780 might be :כִּי־ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה - “For they are a nation without counsel, and they have no understanding.” ( HaAzinu , end of fourth aliya ; Devarim /Deuteronomy 32:28).

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 2, Birkhas HaPeyros 5 - Para. 22. This is a clip from the entire shiur found HERE . The Arizal's description of how the neshoma yiseyra (additional soul) arrives in stages through the tefilos of Shabbos . 1) Friday night the nukva (female) aspect of the neshoma yisera is received: Bo-i Callah Shabbos Malkhesa ( nefesh ), 2) HaPoreys Sukkas Shalom Aleynu ( ruach ), 3) Baruch Hu after tefilah ( neshoma ). Arrival of dukra (male) aspect of the neshoma yisera on Shabbos morning: 1) Nishmas Khol Chai ( nefesh ), 2) Go'al Yisrael - Hashem Sifsei Tiftach (ruach) , and 3) Ayeh Makom Kevodo in kedusha of mussaf (congregation's response) ( neshoma ).

( SHeLaH Hakadosh ). 63:22 - Sheleymus Tikkun HaMishpat (the perfection of justice) will be completed and established through Moshiach . 64:40 - Closing remarks and blessing for the 15th of Av . lessons.description: Rosh Hashanah 4 - Behar - Bechukosai - Kavanos of Elul - Wordless Cry of the Shofar - Doing Teshuvah on Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Rosh Hashanah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 . BeHar - BeChukosai - When HaShem loves someone, He reprimands them. Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . PARAGRAPH 3. The h
lessons.bodyText: Rosh Hashanah 4 - Behar - Bechukosai - Kavanos of Elul - Wordless Cry of the Shofar - Doing Teshuvah on Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Rosh Hashanah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 . BeHar - BeChukosai - When HaShem loves someone, He reprimands them. Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . PARAGRAPH 3. The human image that sits on the throne. The diminishing of the light of the moon. The terms "sun" and "moon" relate to Kudsha Brich Hu and the Shekhina . * Teshuvah repairs the letter Aleph in Adam . The main thing is to repair and to unite the lower nekuda (point) and the upper nekuda of the letter Aleph . Vezeh bechinas Rosh Hashanah : uniting the lower and upper point of the Aleph , because this is a beginning for the sun and a beginning for the moon. Why on Rosh HaShanah we don't mention Rosh Chodesh. The face of the baal tokeyah turns colors, like the sky. Kol is the Vav connecting the upper and lower nikudos of the Aleph . Yaakov Avinu is represented by the Vuv in the Shem Havayah . Vezeh bechinas shofar - the sound of the shofar is Binah/Teshuvah . The beauty of the sound of the shofar itself. PARAGRAPH 4. The shofar gathers in all those who are lost and distant. The lower part of the Aleph is generated by silence. Brief review of Kavanos of Elul . ***When a person who feels very distant from HaShem wants to do teshuvah , the first step is simply cry out to HaShem without words, like the sound of the shofar. QUESTION: does a person need to have consciousness of the kavanos in order for them to be effective, or is their spiritual effect automatic? The power of the shofar's wordless cry takes effect automatically and instantly, no matter what a person's level or understanding of kavanas - intentions. The word shofar is made of the letters that create the word "beauty". PARAGRAPH 5. The meaning of the shofar sounds on Rosh Hashanah . Tekiah is an aspect of shtika - silence. QUESTION about the sin of the moon. QUESTION about the nachash (serpent). RESPONSE: the more we understand our responsibility to Hashem , the more we merit honor. PARAGRAPH 6.Why the shofar is sounded many times. Doing Teshuvah on Teshuvah - repentance on repentance - what is it? QUESTION about the moon being the guide at night. RESPONSE: if Klal Yisrael had gone to Yehoshua before they made the Egel HaZahav (Golden Calf), the sin could have been averted. QUESTION about the sounds of the shofar and feelings of remorse. RESPONSE: our souls were present and participated in the sin of Adam HaRishon . Our souls were part of the sin of the levana also - as a reflection of our own need for sovereignty. *QUESTION about personal renewal at the time of Rosh Chodesh . RESPONSE: the word chadash (new) is b'gematria twelve times Shem Havaya .

lessons.bodyText: Purim 4 - Purim 5 - The Hiddenness of Esther HaMalka - Why Purim Needs No Issur Melakha - Eretz Yisrael and the Defeat of Evil - Siddur Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:58 - PARAGRAPH 5. 03:07 - PARAGRAPH 6. 05:39 - PARAGRAPH 7. Esther HaMalkah is an aspect of the hiddenness of HaShem . The forces of evil could not affect her because she was invisible to them. A spiritual substitute was sent to stand in for her when she had to be with Achashverosh . 11:35 - PARAGRAPH 8. Why there is no issur melakha on Purim. 18:00 - *** Siddur Course - Shacharis: Yotzer Ohr u'Vorei Choshech in morning blessings, why is choshech a higher level of creation? 14:47 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 243 - Shir HaShirim ( Song of Songs ) is considered the holiest book of the Torah, yet no mention of HaShem appears there in any obvious way. 17:43 - Melakha (creative work done on weekdays) is usually forbidden on holidays. On Purim, however, melakha is permitted because the source of evil is eliminated completely, so it's not necessary for us to sanctify this day through issur melakha . We also don't have to do any specific act of holiness to separate the day (such as making kiddush ), because the weekday energy has no hold on Purim whatsoever. 20:37 - Heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : the word "Purim" hints that this holiday contains the holiness of all the other holidays combined : the Peh stands for "Pesach" , the Vuv stands for "v'Sukkos" , the Resh is for "Rosh Hashanah" , the Yud is for "Yom Kippur" , and the Mem is for Matan Torah ( Shavuos ). 23:32 - HALAKHA 5. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Purim 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 55 . The downfall of the wicked is only possible through the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 28:17 - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : When Esav came to meet Yaakov Avinu , he brought 400 men. The words "ra ayin" (evil eye) is b'gematria 400. VaYechi Yaakov - 17 years in Egypt, 130 years in Eretz Yisrael . Tov Ayin (good eye) is b'gematria 130. 33:00 - וּ בְצֵל יָדִי כִּסִּיתִיךָ "...with the shade of My hand I cover you..." ( Yeshayahu 51:16). 34:33 - A person needs to rectify his tefilah through three types of "voices". 35:24 - The mitzvah of separating challah is with the merit of the Avos . And wherever the Avos are found, the Shekhinah is found, because it is an aspect of challah . גם represents the Shekhinah . חלה is b'gamatria גם . זות is also a name for the Shekhinah . 36:38 - הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־טּ֖וֹב וּמַה־נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־יָֽחַד - "... Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brothers also to dwell together" ( Tehillim 133:1). גם יחד is b'gematria A - D - N - I , which is another name for the Shechinah . 45:51 - PARAGRAPH 1. Throughout the generations, Amalek is used to punish Clal Yisrael . "Yad al Kies Kah" - HaShem allows the evil of this nation to exist for His purposes in bringing the geulah . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

The main focus of ra ayin is adultery. *28:21 - How the mitzvah of tznius (modest dress and behavior) is the antidote for ra ayin . 31:20 - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : "Vashti" begematria (716) is twice "nachash" - serpent (358). 32:23 - Shabbos is an aspect of tov ayin . How kiddush heals eyesight on Shabbos . 34:16 - The holiest union between husband and wife is on Shabbos . 36:28 - QUESTION about the 70 nations. 40:08 - Explanation heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld about how vision is repaired through Kiddush on Shabbos . This is accomplished by looking briefly at the wine briefly before saying the blessing "borey pri hagefen" . *43:34 - PARAGRAPH 9. The extraordinary modesty of Esther HaMalka helped Am Yisrael defeat the power of ra ayin . She was a descendant of Rochel Imeinu through Binyamin and Shaul HaMelech . The main defeat of ra ayin is accomplished through the power of Eretz Yisrael . 46:37 - QUESTION about the practical applications of the material covered in today's shiur . 48:24 - QUESTION about the practical application of avoiding positions of honor ( Likutey Moharan 54).

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon (broadcast from Uman). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 56. The "table of kings" whenever a Jew eats a meal. 06:20 - The five grains represent daas (Torah wisdom). Stressing the letter " hey " in " hamotzi ". 10:48 - The definition of matzah . 12:11 - Note from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l . Chita (wheat) b'gematria 22 parallels the 22 letters of the alef-beis . Lechem is begematria 3 times Shem Havaya . Pas (bread) is begamtria talmud . The importance of eating pas shacharais (a morning meal with bread). HaLechem is spelled with the same letters as machalah (sickness), referring to 83 different afflictions. Eating pas shacharis protects a person from 83 different kinds of illness. 15:36 - Biur Halikutim emphasizes the seven blessings possible during a seudah of bread. 16:21 - QUESTION: Is matzah considered pas shacharis ? RESPONSE: yes. 17:21 - QUESTION: is it possible to us a mezonos to fulfill pas shacharis . RESPONSE - bdi'eved (only if bread is not available). 17:53 - Is bread made from Spelt considered bread? RESPONSE: yes. 21:00 - The Arizal points out that matzah is begamtria AV - ayin beis , SaG - samech gimmel . 29:18 - Israel had to leave Egypt in a hurry and had to eat matzah specifically to counteract the power of Pharaoh. 33:41 - How does chometz (leaven on Pesach) affect the soul? Why is chometz permitted throughout the year? 36:25 - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l : in Shiras HaYam ( Parshas BeShalach, Shemos /Exodus 15:1) in the phrase אָשִׁ֤ירָה לַּֽיהֹוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה - the initial letters of the word גאה allude to the " G immel A vos H aKadoshim" . 36:54 - Why we were forced to eat matzah when we left Egypt. 39:32 - QUESTION and RESPONSE: the four elements (earth air, fire, water) are all necessary to create bread. But matzah was commanded when we left Egypt because we hadn't received the Torah yet and couldn't refine the ruach /air aspect of bread at that point. 41:24 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the water needed to create bread or matzah is related to chesed - kindness. 41:57 - "Mayim" is chokhmah and binah , just as lechem is AV and SaG . 42:35 - PARAGRAPH 2. Washing hands before eating bread to purify the daas . Lifting up the hands after washing them. 44:15 - Thoughts of teshuvah and taking a deep sigh (אנחה - anacha ) before beginning a meal. 44:51 - Why do we need to spiritually purify our hands? If a person can't feed themselves, he still needs to ritually wash with a blessing before eating bread. While the person who's feeding them doesn't. 47:30 - The size of the cup that holds the water for washing has to hold a "r'vi'is" (strictest opinion: at least 5 fluid ounces or 150 ml. of water. However, more is preferred by chazal (Sages of the Talmud). 49:37 - NOTE on malkhus . Reference to Likutey Moharan 49 - sometimes malkhus is in a lower state, an aspect of the letter "dalet" , and when it's in a higher, more completed state, it's an aspect of the letter "hey" . *51:51 - Update on Uman - travel to Uman is being restricted as of today, but for those already in Uman, all is proceeding with safety and order. 60:00 - QUESTION and RESPONSE. 63:00 - NOTE: heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld based on the SheLaH HaKadosh - the importance of contemporary rabbis Torah SheBaal Peh . Written Torah vs. Oral Torah in practice of halakha . M'd'rabonon is roshei teyvos gevurah . What is the definition of a talmud chochom ? To find a true rabbi, investigate his chain of mesorah .

lessons.bodyText: Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal - Yahrzeit on the 20th of Elul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded on 2015-09-03.) Rav Avrohom b'R' Naftali Hertz Sternhartz zal - (1862-1955) - His lineage: Paternal: One of Rav Nosson 's sons was R' Shachneh zal . Reb Shachneh's son was R' Naftali Hertz zal . R' Naftali Hertz's son was Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal . Maternal: Rav Aharon Goldstein zal had a son: Zvi Aryeh Goldstein zal . Zvi Aryeh's son was Reb Nachman Goldstein zal . Reb Nachman's daughter, Devorah a"h married R' Naftali Hertz b'R Shechneh . Their son was Rav Avrohom Sternhartz. Rav Avrohom Sternhartz was married to Yuta Basya a"h , a granddaughter of Rav Noson of Nemirov . Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal and his father, Rabbi Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal , corresponded with Rav Avrohom and raised funds for the Breslov community in Eretz Yisrael . Rav Avroham Sternhartz was invited to become the Rav of Lublin, but his grandfather, Rav Nachman Tcherin zal , encouraged him instead to lead the Breslov community. Rav Avrohom Sternhartz was taken prisoner by the Arabs in 1948. Translation of a letter written by Rav Avrohom asking friends to help him emigrate from Russia to Eretz Yisrael . "Clothing" the Torah enables it to be heard. Reference to Likutey Moharan 47 - Eretz Yisrael enables a person to bring forth words of beauty. LINKS FOR FURTHER LISTENING: Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal – Yahrzeit – 20th of Elul – Speaker – R’ Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal (Recorded at a Hilula - Yahrzeit Gathering for R' Avrohom zal , ca. 1972). 20th of Elul - Joy and Awe - The Life of Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - Speaker: R' Nasan Maimon. Likutey Moharan 002 - Introduction - Tefilah - Bris - Mishpat - Based on Tovos Zichronos by Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternartz zal. Speaker: R' Nasan Maimon. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 7, especially from Paragraph 10, regarding "son and student". 00:05 - PARAGRAPH 1. 23:25 - PARAGRAPH 2. 25:51 - PARAGRAPH 3. Purifying the mind through purifying the hands before eating. 29:58 - The purpose of the creation of man was the creation of ratzon - will/yearning. 32:19 - The word "Moshe" is b'gematria 345. Ratzon (will/yearning) is 346. *32:45 - Why did Hashem need to command Adam to eat from all the other trees in Gan Eden? Wasn't this understood from the prohibition to eat from one particular tree? Eating from the trees of Gan Eden is the ultimate perfection of man. The word nefesh (soul) means ratzon (desire). 35:17 - The meals of Shabbos . Ha-aros haratzon is an aspect of "MaH" - deep yearning that can't be put into words. The meaning of the name "Moshe" : MaH (yearning) plus the letter Shin which stands for the the three parts of the brain: chokhmah, binah, and daas . 37:48 - NOTE: If Aharon hadn't taken the gold from the hands of Israel, the golden calf wouldn't have emerged ( Zohar ). Reference hands in Likutey Moharan 22, Paragraph 2. Reference in Ki Sisa "Aharon took it from their hand" ( Shemos /Exodus 32:4). 40:23 - The meals of Shabbos (continued) are an aspect of the mohn (mannah). 43:02 - The oneg (pleasure) of Shabbos food. 44:14 - Meaning of the word "Eden". 46:48 - QUESTION about setting the washing cup down rather than hand from left to right. RESPONSE: best we look into Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l 's halacha shiurim . 47:12 - Boney chayey u'mezoney - chiddush from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l about why the life and sustenance of one's children does not depend on merit, but rather on pure kindness from Hashem that streams from an aspect of His light that's "above" Him, so to speak. 49:14 - How the three meals of Shabbos are related to ratzon . Tapuchin Kadishin - "Field of Holy Apples". *52:09 - RESPONSE FROM STUDENT about the reason for setting the washing cup down (Beis Yosef). 52:44 - QUESTION: definition for "Zer Anpin" ? 53:34 - Biographical note about Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l making a siyum on Tikkunei Zohar . 55:27 - QUESTION about tapuchin kadishin . RESPONSE: Apple's thin outer covering is red ( din ), while the interior is white ( chesed ). Chakal is 138, alluding to the two names of Hashem, ELoKIM (86) and BaN (52). See also the sefer Oneg Shabbos (by Rabbi Ephraim of Pshedbarz) additional information can be found in the explanation of the Friday night Shabbos song "Azamer B'Shevachin"

The kedusha (holiness) of Eretz Yi
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 44. Recorded in Uman, Ukraine. Explaining the Breslov tradition of clapping hands quietly at points during prayer; bringing the holiness of Eretz Yisrael into our meals; customs of washing hands before a bread meal. The kedusha (holiness) of Eretz Yisrael is the source of all blessing sent by Hashem into this world. 00:00 - Dedications. 01:03 - HALAKHA 2. Purifying the air to a state of Eretz Yisrael through the 28 sections of the two hands which correspond to the first 28 letters in the written Torah. This is done through clapping 3 or 4 times (quickly tapping the right hand together against the left) but this can be done silently - there's no need to make a sound. 08:13 - The mitzvah of washing one's hands before eating bread or matzah is related to the kedushah (holiness) of Eretz Yisrael . Eating and praying are related concepts. 08:40 - Both during eating and during prayer, we are involved with refining and elevating "sparks" of the material world, returning them to their spiritual Source. 09:57 - All blessing comes into this world through Eretz Yisrael . Reference to Likutey Mohara n 62. Washing hands before eating bread unites the person's daas with Eretz Yisrael and the true source of the blessing in the food he's about to eat. 14:16 - Repairing the sins that led to the mabul (flood) is done through eating in holiness. This repair also corrects the sin of Adam. 19:24 - QUESTION about "bringing hands together." RESPONSE: joining hands together is referring to clapping hands during tefilah , not to eating. *19:55 - QUESTION: Is there a specific point during prayer that we clap hands? RESPONSE: No. Clapping hands can be done at any point, but it's done quietly or even silently, to prevent disturbing those around us. Reference to כָּ֥ל עַצְמֹתַ֨י | תֹּאמַרְנָה֘ יְהֹוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ "Kol atzmosei tomarna, Hashem, mi c'mocha..." ( Tehillim /Psalms35:10). Tefilah is a "full body" experience. 21:35 - QUESTION: When people leave Eretz Yisrael to collect tzedakah , is it only money they're bringing back to Israel? RESPONSE: No. "Shefa" (bounty) includes other kinds of wealth, too - health resources, goods, know-how. 22:08 - QUESTION: Why did Rebbe Nachman say he accomplished all he needed to accomplish after taking four steps in Eretz Yisrael ? RESPONSE: reference to Kesuvos/Ketuvot 111a: "One who walks a distance of four cubits (approximately 6 - 8 feet) in the Land of Israel is assured of being a ben olam haba - heir to the World to Come." 23:19 - QUESTION about the mabul . *24:22 - QUESTION about clapping hands during tefilah . RESPONSE: even in Eretz Yisrael a person can be "outside" the Holy Land if his mind is elsewhere. We are wherever our consciousness is, so clapping hands brings one into the consciousness of Eretz Yisrael , no matter where we are, even at the Kosel (Western Wall). 25:12 - The spiritual effects of washing our hands before a bread meal. 29:45 - Why the washing cup must be unbroken. 32:45 - The sins of the mabul are rectified through mayim tahorim - "purifying waters". 33:34 - מקוה ישראל מושיעו בעת צרה - "Mikveh Yisrael Hashem, moshiah b'eys tzara " ( Yirmiyahu /Jeremiah 14:8). 37:37 - QUESTION about washing hands. RESPONSE: Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l used to set the cup down after washing the right hand, before washing the left. 39:04 - QUESTION: how does the second pouring of water over the hands relate to the mabul ? 41:19 - Alternatives if a person can't go to the mikveh - the Ben Ish Chai brings washing netilas yadayim 39 times with kavanah (intent) that one is doing this as if they're immersing in a mikveh . 42:50 - QUESTION: At which point do we say the blessing "al netilas yadayim" ? RESPONSE: After washing the hands, before drying the hands. 44:08 - Parshas Ki Savo. Story of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai and the dove.

lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated l'iluy nishmas (for the elevation of the soul of) Malka Chaya bas R' Yaakov a"h by her sister, Mrs. Jeanette Adams. This shiur is also dedicated by Mr. Nathan Rudy for the refuah sheleyma of Yosef ben Adelle . 00:30 - PARAGRAPH 77a-b. Review. Saying "Elokim" in the mezuman (invitation to say the blessings after eating bread) when ten men are present. 14:00 - Q&R - Why ten people and not eleven - as in the ketores - which includes the chelbanah ? 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 77c . There are ten levels from Keser to Malchus and all ten are mentioned. 17:00 - Sipurey Masios - the Story of the Baal Tefilah . 19:00 - Back into the text. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 77d. Why we do not mention the name "Elokim" to invite for birkhas hamazon if there are less than ten men. 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 77e. Drawing light into the Malkhus of Olam HaAsiya and the Malkhus of Olam HaYetzira . 37:00 - Explanation of kabbalistic concepts just presented: from where does the Keser of the Olam HaAsiya receive light? 40:00 - Q&R about why Tikkun Chatzos does not require a minyan . I is the custom in Breslov minyanim to say Tikkun HaKlali on Shabbos with a minyan after tefilah . 44:00 - Q&R about the influx of light to the Keser of Olam HaAsiya . 44:00 - *Concepts relating to the 11th of Cheshvan , the yahrzeit of Rochel Imeinu . 48:00 - There is a tradition that the tefilah said on Rosh Chodesh was composed by Rochel Imeinu . 49:00 - Medrash about Rochel Imeinu pleading for Am Yisrael after the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . 53:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal and the kever of Nasan HaNavi . The power of visiting kivrei tzaddikim . 58:00 - Q&R about the confusion in the world because of the COVID pandemic lockdown. 62:00 - Rabbi Avrohom Sternhartz zal reassured a person who wanted to know "Why isn't Moshiach here?" by telling him: "He is here."
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated l'iluy nishmas (for the elevation of the soul of) Malka Chaya bas R' Yaakov a"h by her sister, Mrs. Jeanette Adams. This shiur is also dedicated by Mr. Nathan Rudy for the refuah sheleyma of Yosef ben Adelle .

lessons.description: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Ayeh Makom Kvodo - Where is the Place of His Honor - Prayer at the Gravesite of a Tzaddik - Tisha B'Av - Eicha - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated l'iluy nishmas Ratziah Sarah bas Rafael Abbah a"h
lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Ayeh Makom Kvodo - Where is the Place of His Honor - Prayer at the Gravesite of a Tzaddik - Tisha B'Av - Eicha - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated l'iluy nishmas Ratziah Sarah bas Rafael Abbah a"h whose yahrzeit is on the day this shiur was given: the 16th of Cheshvan . She was the younger sister of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal and was a devoted supporter of Breslov teachings. This shiur is also dedicated by Robert Weiss in memory of his father: l'iluy nishmas Avraham b'Reb Aharon zal , whose yahrzeit is also on the 16th of Cheshvan . 02:22 - PARAGRAPH 79b. 08:09 - PARAGRAPH 80. Eicha . Hisbodedus (personal prayer in one's own words) should end on a positive note. 15:00 - Attaching oneself to the Tzaddik Emes is an aspect of rebuilding the Beis HaMikdash . Yirmiyahu HaNavi assumed personal responsibility for causing the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . 21:00 - And yet, the navi ends on a positive note, proclaiming: " Chasdei Hashem Ki Lo Samnu - the kindness of HaShem has no limit" ( Eicha ). 28:34 - Heard from Rav Kalman Rosen zal : In the chumash, Moshe Rabbeinu tells Am Yisrael : "You were rebels from the first day I knew you". This verse can be read that Moshe Rabbeinu is admitting he has a part in their acts of rebellion. 30:51 - ***The Zohar HaKodesh, Medrash NaNe'elam, Parshas Noach , page 40. One small group of people, when they are united to achieve complete return to HaShem , can bring Moshiach . 38:25 - Q&R about tefilos (prayers) going through the tzaddik . RESPONSES: Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 - we are praying to Hashem (not to the tzaddik ). *53:00 - Reb Michel Dorfman z"l always told people that at the grave of a tzaddik , we pray to Hashem only . Hiskashrus to the tzaddik - nusach . 49:08 - *Q&R about how to direct prayers when visiting the gravesite of a tzaddik . 51:02 - * Nusach for daily hiskashrus to the tzaddikim 52:19 - ***Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal emphasized that at the kever of a tzaddik , we pray only to HaShem. 55:13 - Comment from a student about Yirmiyahu HaN avi and the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . 57:44 - Comment from student about the Tisha B'Av coming out on Shabbos . 59:25 - Q&R about spiritual response to the current Corona virus. 61:30 - Comment from a student about current events increasing our desire to come close to HaShem . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: 2020-11-04 - LH2 - OC2 - Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Para. 84a (Betziyas HaPas 6 - Devarim HaNohagim baSeudah - Nafilim - Sichon and Og - 515 Prayers of Moshe Rabbeinu
