lessons.description: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Parshas Devarim - Nafilim - Sichon - Og - 515 prayers of Moshe Rabbeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas (for the elevation of the soul) of Rabbi Ozer b'Reb Alexander HaKohen Ber
lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - Parshas Devarim - Nafilim - Sichon - Og - 515 prayers of Moshe Rabbeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas (for the elevation of the soul) of Rabbi Ozer b'Reb Alexander HaKohen Berger zal , whose 14th yahrzeit was on the day this shiur was given: the 17th of Cheshvan 5781. 01:31 - PARAGRAPH 84. Parshas Ekev and Parshas VaEschanan . 09:06 - Moshe Rabbeinu's defeat of Sichon and Og and the klipos empowering them. 14:44 - Could there be any enemy worse than Haman ? Yes - the klipa personified by Zeresh (wife of Haman ) causes a Jew to fear keeping the Torah. 17:34 - Gesher tzar meod - "The world is a narrow bridge." The message to Yehoshuah was, "Don't be afraid because HaShem is going to defend you." 20:34 - Yehoshuah is the level of student, so he was given the encouragement not to be afraid. His name is composed from the roshei teivos (initial letters) of the verse: Ye kumun Ve Yerannanu SH ochnei Ah for "Rise up and rejoice, those who dwell in dust" ( Yeshayahu 25:19). 25:59 - * Parshas Devarim and Parshas VaEschanan : The greatness of HaShem is revealed through man, because the angels are not as powerful as the tzaddikim of of this world. 28:10 - Q&R about being afraid. A Jew is not permitted to put himself in danger. Tefilas HaDerech - prayer for traveling. Times when fear is appropriate: respect for one's parents, respect for the holiness of a holy place. 30:32 - Q&R what's the difference between "yirah" (awe/respect) and "pachad" (fear of punishment). 32:21 - Q&R about Moshe Rabbeinu's defeat of Sichon and Og . RESPONSE: the klipos (opposing forces) that gave them strength are still operating in our world. 33:45 - * Parshas VaEschanan (continued). The tzaddik "rules over" HaShem . The word "tziyon" sometimes means gravesite, sometimes Eretz Yisrael , and sometimes the tzaddik . Moshe Rabbeinu' s plea to enter Eretz Yisrael because this is the place where the upper and lower worlds can be unified. 36:57 - Man was created by HaShem to be a "partner" in the creation, so man has creative powers that are greater than those of the angels. 38:59 - Why Moshe Rabbeinu pleaded to enter Eretz Yisrael. 43:15 - Joining upper and lower worlds is done through the revelation of Matan Torah . 46:02 - * Chiddush on VaEschanan heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l . Reference to the Megalah Amukos . What happened to all of those 515 tefilos poured out by Moshe Rabbeinu ? (515 is the gematria of "TeFiLaH" ). Rebbe Nachman ben Feiga is b'gematria 516. 52:53 - *No tefilah is ever lost. 54:32 - Q&R about the passing of a tzaddik . 59:47 - *Closing blessings. The greatest revelation of HaShem takes place in this world, the lowest one. Current events in light of Torah and tefilah and mitzvos . 61:06 - *Every geulah (redemption) is named after the tzaddik of its time. The word "gam" (also) hints at the Shekhina ( HaShem's Divine Presence in the lower worlds).
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas (for the elevation of the soul) of Reb Ozer b'Reb Alexander HaKohen Berger z"l , whose 14th yahrzeit was on the day this shiur was given: the 17th of Cheshvan 5781.

lessons.bodyText: Tehillim 92 - Joy, Ten Pulses, Ten Types of Song. Based on 2Likutey Moharan 24 and on Likutey Moharan 282 - Azamra . Speaker: Sara Wurtzel (recorded in 2005). מִזְמ֥וֹר שִׁ֜֗יר לְי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת 1 - A song with musical accompaniment for the Sabbath day. ט֗וֹב לְהֹד֥וֹת לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וּלְזַמֵּ֖ר לְשִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן 2 - It is good to give thanks to Hashem and to sing to Your Name, O Most High. לְהַגִּ֣יד בַּבֹּ֣קֶר חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וֶֽ֜אֱמוּנָֽתְךָ֗ בַּלֵּילֽוֹת 3 - To declare in the morning Your kindness and Your faith at night. עֲלֵֽי־עָ֖שׂוֹר וַֽעֲלֵי־נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר 4 - Upon a ten-stringed harp and upon a psaltery, with speech upon a harp. כִּ֚י שִׂמַּחְתַּ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּפָֽעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּמַֽעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן 5 - For You have made me happy, Hashem, with Your work; with the work of Your hands I shall exult. מַה־גָּֽדְל֣וּ מַֽעֲשֶׂ֣יךָ יְהֹוָ֑ה מְ֜אֹ֗ד עָֽמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ 6 - How great are Your works, Hashem! Your thoughts are very deep. אִ֣ישׁ בַּ֖עַר לֹ֥א יֵדָ֑ע וּ֜כְסִ֗יל לֹֽא־יָבִ֥ין אֶת־זֹֽאת 7 - A boorish man does not know; neither does a fool understand this. בִּפְרֹ֚חַ רְשָׁעִ֨ים | כְּֽמ֥וֹ עֵ֗שֶׂב וַ֖יָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן לְהִשָּֽׁמְדָ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַֽד 8 - When the wicked flourish like grass, and all workers of violence blossom, only to be destroyed to eternity. וְאַתָּ֥ה מָ֜ר֗וֹם לְעֹ֘לָ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה 9 - But You remain on high forever, Hashem. כִּ֚י הִנֵּ֪ה אֹֽיְבֶ֡יךָ | יְֽהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֣ה אֹֽיְבֶ֣יךָ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ יִ֜תְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן 10 - For behold Your enemies, Hashem, for behold Your enemies will perish; all workers of violence will scatter. וַתָּ֣רֶם כִּרְאֵ֣ים קַרְנִ֑י בַּ֜לֹּתִ֗י בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן רַֽעֲנָֽן 11 - But You have raised my horn like that of a wild ox; to soak me with fresh oil. וַתַּבֵּ֥ט עֵינִ֗י בְּשׁ֫וּרָ֥י בַּקָּמִ֣ים עָלַ֣י מְרֵעִ֑ים תִּשְׁמַ֥עְנָה אָזְנָֽי 12 - My eye has gazed upon those who stare at me; when evildoers rise up against me, my ears hear. צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח כְּאֶ֖רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן יִשְׂגֶּֽה 13 - The righteous one flourishes like the palm; as a cedar in Lebanon he grows. שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּחַצְר֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ 14 - Planted in the house of Hashem, in the courts of our Master they will flourish. ע֖וֹד יְנוּב֣וּן בְּשֵׂיבָ֑ה דְּשֵׁנִ֖ים וְרַֽעֲנַנִּ֣ים יִֽהְיֽוּ 15 - They will yet grow in old age; vibrant and fresh will they be. לְהַגִּיד כִּֽי־יָשָׁ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה צ֜וּרִ֗י וְֽלֹא־עַוְלָ֥תָה (כתיב עַלָ֥תָה) בּֽוֹ 16 - To declare that Hashem is upright, my Rock in Whom there is no injustice.

A tzaddik needs to be able to access all levels, to unite heaven and earth, in order to elevate every soul. 34:50 - PARAGRAPH 8. 45:40 - The Torah teacher needs to make a fence for his words, being careful about what to reveal and what not to reveal. 47:13 - When Moshe Rabbeinu received the Torah, he asked about the crowns being placed on the letters of the alef beis . Hashem told him there would be a person in the future (Rabbi Akiva) who would understand secrets of the Torah from these crowns. Moshe asked Hashem why not give the Torah through this person? In response, Hashem told Moshe to be silent. ( Menachos 29b). 53:10 - The dynamics of acquiring wisdom: a makif is knowledge not yet acquired. When a person reveals a perception, a new perception arises in thought. 55:15 - Moshe Rabbeinu was not permitted to enter Eretz Yisrael because he was on a higher level than Eretz Yisrael . (Zohar). 55:57 - Beginning of Pirkei Avos section. 63:19 - "Make a fence for the Torah." lessons.bodyText: Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 - The Effect of the Holiness of Eretz Yisrael on the Jewish Soul - The Merit of Avraham Avinu Was His Desire To Do Good - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Netilas Yadayim LiSeudah 6 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated by Harry Fox for his father, l'iluyi nishmas Reb Shabsi b'Reb Yissachar Dov a"h . The shiur is also dedicated l'ilui nishmas Reb Chaim Dovid ben Ozer Pinchas a"h , a student of Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . ***00:26 - The effect of the holiness of Eretz Yisrael on the Jewish soul. *06:19 - The holier a goal is, the more challenges will be sent to confront a person who's trying to reach that goal. 09:18 - The gematria of Moshe (345) is one less than the gematria of ratzon (346) - the level he achieved with his petira (passing). The word nefesh (soul) also means "desire". 11:33 - PARAGRAPH 107. Blessing to Avraham Avinu in parshas Lech Lecha . 16:57 - The letter Hey that was added to the name of Avraham Avinu. 17:36 - Akdamus - special song on Shavuos . *20:13 - Explanation of the Shem MaH . *21:16 - The letter Hey represents ratzon - will/desire. The main way Avraham Avinu served HaShem was through the desire to give. This desire is what sustains Am Yisrael even today. Reference to Likutey Moharan 142. 25:35 - QUESTION about Avraham Avinu fulfilling the Torah. 27:33 - QUESTION about the sofei teyvos (final letters) of the phrase "le v nishba r venidke h Eloki m l o " - this spells the name Avraham . לֵב־נִשְׁבָּ֥ר וְנִדְכֶּ֑ה אֱ֜לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א תִבְזֶֽה - "HaShem will not despise a broken and contrite heart..." ( Tehillim 51:19). 29:54 - "May the words of my heart..." ten Yods corresponding to the ten Yods in all four expansions of HaShem's Name. Also, the roshei teyvos (initial letters) of "Rachmana Liba Bai" (" HaShem desires the heart" - 232) add up to the total of all four Names of HaShem : AV (72), SaG (63), MaH (45), BaN (52). 31:20 - In Divrei HaYomim , the full lineage all the way back to Yaakov Avinu is only mentioned by the name of the Levi, Heiman. 41:25 - Closing comments on finishing this halakha , one of the longest in the entire Likutey Halakhos .

lessons.bodyText: Betziyas HaPas 3 - Matzah - Lechem Oni - Poor Man's Bread - First Meal of Mourner - Thunder - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedication and review. 01:11 - PARAGRAPH 3. (need to check). 09:10 - Seudas Havra'ah (the first meal of a mourner after the burial - "meal of consolation") should be donated to him. This custom is based on a concept in Bemidbar /Numbers 19:11 that contact with a corpse results in impurity. 12:45 - Another meaning of "lechem oni" - matzah is: a bread that we speak about. Introduction to the concept of a "thunderous voice" in prayer. 19:25 - PARAGRAPH 4. "Tefilah bekoach" - prayer with force. *20:10 - A person's strength comes from his food. 22:33 - When the sound of a person's own voice in prayer strikes his brain, this generates an aspect of thunder. *23:37 - Conclusion of clip about a person's spiritual strength originating in the food he eats. 25:33 - QUESTION about Seudas Havra'ah . 26:43 - QUESTION about encouraging others to eat meals with more daas (spiritual awareness). 33:01 - QUESTION about refraining from giving spiritual guidance. RESPONSE: analagy brought from fund raising. 35:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 - two types of avodas Hashem . Even if a person doesn't remember all the chassidus of eating bread that's being explained here, he will at least remember that there are deep mysteries involved. 38:01 - Story heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l about a miserly landlord evicting a widow - Vizhnitzer Rebbe goes to visit the landlord. 43:58 - QUESTION about tefilah bekoach (prayer with force) and shimush tzaddikim . RESPONSE: Accounts of Rabbi Shimshon Barsky z"l and Rav Eliyahu Chaim Rosen z"l concerning praying loud vs. praying quietly. 51:52 - QUESTION: practical advice for increasing the spiritual aspect of meals. 54:47 - QUESTION about clapping during kaddish . RESPONSE: clapping hands during tefilah is traditionally done silently.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This shiurm presented on the 3rd of Kislev 5781 , is dedicated by Peretz Rubel l'ilui nishmas his mother, Sarah Leah bas Reb Lieber a"h . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. 06:11 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas Lech Lecha : Eretz Yisrael is the place from which all blessing flows, and it contains all ten levels of holiness that exist in the world. Avraham Avinu received Eretz Yisrael after the letter "Hey" was added to his name. "The air of Eretz Yisrael gives chochmah." 10:57 - PARAGRAPH 7. Parshas Chayei Sarah : the first acquisition of Eretz Yisrael took place when Avraham Avinu purchased the land of Ma'aras HaMachpeleh (Cave of the Patriarchs). We only do mitzvos outside of Eretz Yisrael in order to remember how to do them. *14:39 - "In order for food to have beneficial effects on the body and soul, a person needs to be in a state of joy." Reference to Likutey Moharan 5. 16:28 - Reference to "It was good in his heart" ( Megilas Rus ). 18:56 - QUESTION about the difference between allegory and applying kabbalistic concepts to practical Torah observance. 20:27 - RESPONSE, quoting from end of Likutey Moharan 6: Every move a human being affects the higher worlds.

lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - Introduction to Hilkhos Devarim Hanohagim baSeudah 4. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. 02:06 - PARAGRAPH 1. The centrality of Eretz Yisrael to Torah observance. 10:21 - QUESTION: Request for clarification of the terms Olam, Shanah, Nefesh . 11:04 - A person who achieves dwelling in Eretz Yisrael is called "gibor" - mighty. 11:31 - Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l would always kiss the ground when he arrived in Eretz Yisrael . 12:31 - The main holiness of Eretz Yisrael is revealed on Rosh Hashanah. Reference to Likutey Moharan 40. Concept of "back to back" between Zer Anpin and Malchus - a spiritual process that takes place during the period between Rosh Hashanah and Shemini Atzeres . 21:10 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 4. Malkhus is called "Isha yiras Hashem" . (The second letters of each of these three words spell the name "Sarah".) The name of the shekhinah (Divine Presence) during the time of the imahos (Matriarchs) was "Sarah" during her time, "Rivkah" during her time, and "Rochel v' Leah" during their time. *22:52 - NOTE: it's also traditional to kiss the ground when leaving Eretz Yisrael . As Rebbe Nachman said, "Wherever I go, I am going to Eretz Yisrael." 24:31 - Story of how Reb Moshe Borstein z"l came to Eretz Yisrael . 28:40 - "Wherever I go, I am on my way to Eretz Yisrael." 30:50 - How can a person leave Eretz Yisrael to go to Uman for Rosh Hashanah? Kedushas Eretz Yisrael applies to the gravesites of tzaddikim . Imros Tahaors by Rav Avraham Sternhartz z"l shows how the kedushah of Eretz Yisrael emanates by merit of the tzaddik . Account of how Reb Nachman Horodenker z"l yearned to go to Eretz Yisrael . 32:56 - QUESTION: How can a person leave Eretz Yisrael to go to Uman for Rosh Hashanah? 37:28 - QUESTION about an account of Rav Eliyahu Chaim Rosen z"l building a sukkah in Kiev.

lessons.bodyText: Betziyas HaPas 3 - Para. 1-2 - What is the Meaning of "Breaking Bread"? The Letter "Hey" in HaMotzei and in Matzah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 5. 00:00 - Welcome to David Kadoch and his family who made aliya recently, B"H. 06:02 - Introduction to Betziyas HaPas (Breaking Bread) 3. 12:46 - PARAGRAPH 1. 17:38 - On what part of the bread do we make the blessing? 18:23 - PARAGRAPH 2. 37:48 - COMMENT from student: "There are those who study Torah in order to know how to eat." 39:08 - QUESTION about why we need to struggle with the negative influence of chometz during the year. 40:52 - COMMENT from student about the difference between bread and all other foods. 43:08 - QUESTION about the processes needed to make bread. 49:03 - Breaking the middle matzah at the Pesach seder . 59:03 - Reb Michel Dorfman z"l s way of cutting and then breaking bread on Shabbos: with the challah knife, he would make a scratch in the challah in the place he intended to cut. Then he put the knife down, made the blessing, holding both challos in his hands. Then he placed the unmarked challah on the table, out of his way. He took the marked Challah and turned it on its side, with the top of the challah facing him. Then, beginning with the nick, he sliced with every stroke reaching from the top of the challah through the bottom. When the slice was almost fully cut, he put down the knife, leaving a small section still joined to the loaf. Then he picked up the challah and tore the slice off. 62:23 - COMMENT from a student about the difference between breaking bread on Shabbos and breaking bread on a weekday. 64:00 - QUESTIONS about the blessings on bread and about the challenges after Moshiach is revealed. 65:36 - QUESTION: is thinking about Torah considered a machshava zara (stray thought) during tefilah (prayer)?

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. *07:31 - PARAGRAPH 2. On Rosh Hashanah , one of the main things we pray for is to merit the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 19:59 - QUESTION about tefilah b'din . *27:00 - If Hashem does not seem to answer our tefilos , our respect and love for Him should remain constant. 36:30 - Parshas Toldos . 30:00 - It's impossible to reach Eretz Yisrael except through defeating opposing spiritual powers through the Torah. In prayer before giving a Torah lecture, the teacher attaches himself to the souls of all stud ents present, both in this world and the next. Statement of intent of fulfilling "Love your neighbor as yourself" before tefilah . 35:30 - The power of prayer before teaching Torah b'Rabim . Each student in a community has a portion in the Torah being brought down by the teacher. These prayers defeat the negative forces blocking kedushas Eretz Yisrael . 39:50 - All nefeshos (souls) are not alike. Some souls are worth many others. Story about when Rebbe Nachman was preparing to give Likutey Moharan 60 on Rosh Hashanah which included a section on Choni HaMa'agal . Some of Rebbe Nachman's students burst into tears because they had experienced the power of being "included" in the tzaddik's Torah. *43:17 - QUESTION about the power of Torah innovation. Importance of praying for Hashem's help before teaching Torah, for example on Erev Shabbos , if one will be giving over Torah at the Shabbos meals. 51::50 - Mention of Rebbe Nachman's vision that preceded his presentation of Likutey Moharan 20.

Reference to mention of "ship" in Mishlei 31:14 ( Aishes Chayil ). 16:09 - Meaning of Rabbi Eliezer being asleep and Rabbi Yehoshua being awake. 18:03 - Story of the Arizal and his student Rav Avraham HaLevi zal . 18:57 - What Rabbi Yehoshua represents in the account. 20:32 - "Rabbi Eliezer woke up" and asked Rabbi Yehoshua, "Mah zeh Yehoshua?" 29:11 - Malchus is the source of yirah (respect). 30:07 - PARAGRAPH 15. The dream of Pharaoh ( Parshas Miketz ). 36:24 - PARAGRAPH 16. The hidden gravesite of Moshe Rabbeinu ( Sota 14) is in the category of makifin (knowledge hidden from us). 41:14 - PARAGRAPH 17. The three sections of the Shemoneh Esrei of mussaf on Rosh Hashanah: t
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. Today's shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas Yitzchak ben Dovid whose yahrzeit was on the day this lesson was given: the 7th of Kislev . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. 10:16 - PARAGRAPH 5. The three sections of the Shemoneh Esrei of mussaf on Rosh Hashanah: the malchios (statements of kingship); the zichronos (statements about remembrance), and the shofros (statements about the shofar ). 15:51 - PARAGRAPH 6. Zichronos . Why is Rosh Hashanah called Yom HaZikaron - "Day of Remembrance"? The meaning and importance of a name. 26:08 - The Names of Hashem. 28:15 - For more on the great significance of a person's name and what it means for a person to have a "good name", see Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 1, Hilkhos Birkhas HaShachar 3, Para. 32-37; Likutey Moharan 56, and Sichos HaRan 95. 29:39 - The highest level Name of Hashem that we have been given is only mentioned in the Beis HaMikdash ( Yuma 69) 33:06 - QUESTION about the recognition of Hashem's Name in Yerushalayim (Jerusalem). RESPONSE: In Eretz Yisrael there are levels of kedusha , when a person comes to Yerushalayim he is making another aliya (spiritual advancement). 36:16 - QUESTION about "borders". RESPONSE: account of one of Rabbi Maimon's first trips to Eretz Yisrael when Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l said that Eilat and Sinai are outside Eretz Yisrael . 38:36 - QUESTION about the holy cities outside Yerushalayim: Tzefas (Safed) and Tiveria (Tiberias). RESPONSE: holiness is related to the Name of Hashem. 40:35 - Avraham Avinu proclaimed the Name of Hashem when he entered Eretz Yisrael . 42:21 - The highest level of Torah is that of Eretz Yisrael . The Torah is comprised of many Names of Hashem. 46:52 - NOTE: Naming a boy at his bris milah . Today is the scheduled day for the bris milah of Zvi Aryeh Kramer's son. 48:19 - COMMENT from student about a gadol calling out the child's name at a bris milah . 48:34 - Why is a baby girl named on Shabbos ? Sources for the custom of naming a baby girl on Shabbos . 51:33 - QUESTION about the letters of the alef beis containing the letters of Hashem's name. 52:39 - The futility of arguments that sometimes arise before naming a child.

categories.title: soul of Tzaddik fills the world

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6b (Beginning with the words "Ki c'mo sheHaAretz hi tachlis haGashmius" ). The Names of Hashem give us a way to relate to Him. 06:50 - One of the main goals of a Jew in this world is to achieve Eretz Yisrael . 09:00 - When a person passes away, one of the first things he's asked is "Do you remember your name?" The custom of saying one's own name after the Shemoneh Esrei . 11:00 - All the deeds of a person are inscribed in their name. 13:18 - The deep significance of a Jewish name. *14:17 - Shemos HaTzaddikim . Just by mentioning the name of a tzaddik , we draw upon ourselves his holiness and his merit. This strengthens our ability to access holiness, purity, and supports our return to Hashem. Because everything about the tzaddik we mention is included in his name. For example, even the rivers of tears shed by the mother of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai z"l are included when his name is mentioned. 19:53 - Moshe Rabbeinu , Eliyahu Hanavi , and mentioning the avos in Shemoneh Esrei . 21:11 - QUESTION about a person who is not given a Jewish name. 21:50 - QUESTION about remembering one's name after they pass away. 24:10 - Story of the Baal Shem Tov and the man with a bone disease. A person's sins are etched into their bones. 26:38 - The Arizal could see a person's deeds in their face. 29:15 - QUESTION about palm reading. *31:03 - QUESTION: is there merit in mentioning the names of righteous women? RESPONSE: The Zohar HaKodesh explains that the masculine principle includes the feminine. Therefore, when we mention a tzaddik 's name, this automatically includes the merits of his wife. For example, the merits of Sarah Imeinu are automatically included when we mention the name of Avraham Avinu . 32:25 - QUESTION about saying the full name of a tzaddik . RESPONSE: The word "sefer" (book) is begematria "shem" (name). Sometimes a tzaddik is called by the name of a sefer he authored. 33:31 - Account of Breslov gathering in Lublin, Poland before World War 2. Rav Meir Shapiro z"l . 34:52 - QUESTION: is there a merit in saying the full name of Rav Yehuda Meir Shapiro z"l ? 35:36 - QUESTION about possukim for one's name after the Shemoneh Esrei . 35:47 - QUESTION: how can many people have the same name? RESPONSE: the particular configuration is unique. 36:44 - QUESTION about giving the name at a bris milah (circumcision). 37:36 - QUESTION: why do we say Rabbeinu z"l or "the Rebbe" instead of saying "Rebbe Nachman"? 39:46 - Why is Rosh Hashanah called "Yom HaZikaron" ? 42:21 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: Reb Michel Dorfman z"l explained how viduy is done in Uman on Erev Rosh Hashanah. When tens of thousands want to say viduy in the presence of the Tzaddik , how can everyone be "present"? Reb Michel answered, "All a person has to do is say his own name when actually in sight of the kever . Then later, from a distance, he can add all the details of the viduy" . 45:05 - End of biographical note, return to text about Rosh Hashanah as Yom Hazikaron . 47:36 - Adam HaRishon gave a name to everything in creation, including Hashem. 52:18 - QUESTION: what if a person can't travel to Uman to say viduy in the presence of the tzaddik ? RESPONSE: The soul of the tzaddik fills the world. Reference to Likutey Tefilos 4 (which corresponds to Likutey Moharan 4). 53:49 - QUESTION about mentioning a child's full name at least once a day. RESPONSE: Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l used English names at times. 55:13 - COMMENT from student about Rav Shmelke of Nikolsburg z"l . *55:37 - QUESTION about Adam HaRishon giving a name to Hashem. RESPONSE: Why did Hashem give the job of naming things to Adam? This teaches us about the role of a Jew in the world: Hashem created the world for the sake of the People of Israel and invited us to be partners with Him in the ongoing renewal of creation. 58:23 - QUESTION about Eretz Yisrael and the Name of Hashem. RESPONSE: Reference to Likutey Moharan 4: אוַֽעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ "The humble shall inherit the Land..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 37).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Devarim HaNohagim BaSeuda h 4 - Rosh Hashanah - Eretz Yisrael - "Back to Back" - Tikkun HaSheina - Repairing Sleep in Kislev - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Devarim HaNohagim BaSeudah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 20 . PARAGRAPH 3. Introduction to the connection between Rosh Hashanah and Eretz Yisrael . The Tora
lessons.bodyText: Devarim HaNohagim BaSeuda h 4 - Rosh Hashanah - Eretz Yisrael - "Back to Back" - Tikkun HaSheina - Repairing Sleep in Kislev - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Devarim HaNohagim BaSeudah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 20 . PARAGRAPH 3. Introduction to the connection between Rosh Hashanah and Eretz Yisrael . The Torah taught by great tzaddikim on Rosh Hashanah. In Shaar Hakavanos , the Arizal explains the kabbalistic concept of "back to back". Adam and Chava were originally one being. When Zer Anpin (the sefiros of Chessed through Yisod ) "sleeps" - lacks consciousness. Every mitzvah a person does increases their sechel - holy intelligence. Simply learning Torah is not enough. Study is done for the purpose of performing mitzvos . The Bnei Yissa'char brings that understanding the Torah correctly is a higher level than seeing Eliyahu HaNavi . Sheina - sleep - praying as if one has nothing - is the opposite of Mateh Oz - literally "staff of strength" - praying in the merit of one's spiritual accomplishments. Slichos before Rosh Hashanah are pleas from a state of humility and poverty. Q&R about why the word tzaddikim is in plural. Q&R: what is Daas Torah ? Q&R about the Ches and the Hey that distinguish Chometz from Matzah . Q&R about tefilos of the Yomim Noraim - "Days of Awe" - Rosh Hashanah through Yom Kippur. Vezeh bechinas sheina - "And this is an aspect of sleep". In Shaar HaKavanos , the Arizal explains that when "sleep" is imposed on Zer Anpin , Binah distributes gevuros directly to Malchus , without needed to go through Zer Anpin . This enables Zer Anpin and Malchus to be separated, in order that Malchus can be built up. Knesses Yisrael is another term for Shekhina . Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal explained that Knesses Yisrael, Shekhina, and Klal Yisrael - are one. Reference to Pirkei Avos : if a person's knowledge exceeds his deeds, his knowledge will not last. *Reference to Yakara deShabata by Rav Nachman Tcherin zal . He relates the story from Sipurey Maasios of The Master of Prayer; kovod - honor - actually is a foundation of the world, but it's honor for HaShem . Q&R about the statement "veTalmud Torah C'neged Kulam." Introduction to PARAGRAPH 4. ***NOTE: The Bnei Yissa'char (based on Sefer Yetzirah 5:9) brings that the month of Kislev is a favorable time to rectify sleep. Suggestions for practical ways to do this. BRIEF OVERVIEW of entire shiur . Q&R about Akeidas Yitzchak . Q&R about chiddushei Torah - innovations. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. 00:48 - PARAGRAPH 7c (from the words "ve'al keyn nitna haTorah bekol shofar.") The sound of the shofar signals the ingathering of all who are distant from Hashem. 03:25 - "Make Torah into tefilah (prayer)" - Rebbe Nachman. 07:01 - The essence of Rosh Hashanah is to draw upon ourselves the kedusha (holiness) of Eretz Yisrael . Eretz Yisrael receives its kedusha from Rosh Hashanah. 10:15 - Gematria of the "eyes of Hashem" is 260, which is ten times Y-H-V-H . 10:37 - PARAGRAPH 8. The separation of Malchus from Zer Anpin during Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, and the intermediary days. of Teshuvah . " Mochin " are revelations of Torah. The Ten Days of Teshuvah correspond to the ten levels of holiness in Eretz Yisrael . 15:12 - QUOTE from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l : "Rosh Hashanah is Malchus, Yom Kippur is Keser." 17:51 - QUESTION about mentioning the names of malachim (angels). 19:24 - Saying 10 chapters of Tehillim (Psalms) during the Ten Days of Teshuvah . 20:07 - PARAGRAPH 9. The sukkah and the Arba Minim (Four Species) on Sukkos . The concept of "spiritual weapons". 23:13 - As brought in Likutey Moharan 20 - the souls of the students present in a Torah shiur (public lecture) facilitate the Torah that can be accessed by the teacher. 24:53 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 8 - the last public teaching given by Rebbe Nachman before his passing. The importance of every student present in a Torah shiur . 27:38 - Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. 29:49 - The wells dug by Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov correspond to the waters of Torah drawn down to the world through the tefilos (prayers) of Rosh Hashanah , Yom Kippur , and all Ten Days of Teshuvah . 33:35 - Avraham Avinu was the first person to whom Hashem revealed the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . Because of this, he began digging wells that would facilitate, on mystical levels, drawing the Torah into the world. 36:19 - QUESTION about students enabling Torah to be accessed from higher realms. RESPONSE: How every student present in a shiur (lesson) gives the teacher more power to draw down new aspects of the Torah. 38:51 - QUESTION about the timing of the revelation of Eretz Yisrael's kedusha to Avraham Avinu .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Zvia Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l . Based on Avodah Zarah 10a-b. 00:00 - Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi (known as Rebbe or Rabbeinu HaKadosh ) and the Roman Emperor Antoninus. The Gemara describes how Antoninus had a secret tunnel excavated between their houses so that he could visit and serve Rebbe. 03:16 - Why Rav Nasan of Nemirov z"l was succeeded by Reb Nachman Tulchin z"l . 04:13 - Antoninus asked Rebbe, "Will I be with you in Gan Eden?" 05:07 - The importance of attaching oneself to a tzaddik . How is this done on a practical level? One way is by following his advice. For example, Rebbe Nachman advises to do hisbodedus (pray in solitude) every day, in addition to the prayers with a minyan . By following this advice a person "binds" himself to Rebbe Nachman.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. 00:00 - Dedications. This shiur , given on the 13th of Kislev , honors three yahrzeits that fall on this day: the mother of Reb Michel Dorfman z"l , Chana Perel bas Reb Aryeh Leib a"h ; Rabbi Maimon's niece, Chiena Rochel bas Reb Chaim Menachem a"h ; and the mother of Ronald Mandell, Devorah Bas Yechezkel a"h . 00:40 - PARAGRAPH 7b (beginning with the words "umakmas she'b'Rosh Hashanah..." The mitzvah of Sukkah represents the Ananei HaKavod - the "Clouds of Glory" that accompanied Am Yisrael in the wilderness guiding us on a path to Eretz Yisrael . 08:23 - QUESTION: on which aspects of Eretz Yisrael should we focus during Sukkos ? 09:05 - COMMENT from a student about chiddushim (Torah innovations) on Rosh Hashanah. 10:10 - QUESTION do we celebrate kabalas haTorah (receiving the Torah) on Yom Kippur? 10:36 - PARAGRAPH 10. 14:13 - The mitzvah of Sukkah is an aspect of the path to Eretz Yisrael , which are represented by the Ananei HaKavod (Clouds of Glory) that accompanied Am Yisrael in the wilderness, clearing the path for them. 18:30 - PARAGRAPH 11. The Arba Minim (Four Species) as spiritual weapons that enable Am Yisrael to merit Eretz Yisrael . Reference to Likutey Moharan 20, Paragraph 10. 24:05 - The Zohar HaKadosh explains that carrying the Arba Minim demonstrates spiritual victory, because only the victor carries his weapons after the battle is won. 29:08 - The Esrog represents Malchus , which is an aspect of Eretz Yisrael and the Shekhina . 34:13 - QUESTION about what the snakes and scorpions etc. represent as obstacles to Eretz Yisrael . 35:52 - COMMENT from student about Yaakov and Esav. 36:41 - QUESTION: How can a person living outside Eretz Yisrael gain access to its spiritual aspect? 38:46 - QUESTION about the Esav's power of the sword being transformed. 40:50 - PARAGRAPH 12. The Lulav represents tikkun habris .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and introduction. 00:00 - A person needs to be cautious when giving rebuke, because if reproof is not taken well, the situation could become worse. 20:59 - "I heard Your voice in the garden..." There is an aspect of kol ("voice of kedushah ") that waters and nourishes the Garden of Souls. 33:46 - NOTE - "HaKol Kol Yaakov" - two times kol is begematira 272, which equals the word oreyv (sweet), as in the possuk הַשְׁמִיעִ֖נִי אֶת־קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה - "...Let me hear the sound of your voice, for your voice is sweet and your face is beautiful..." ( Shir HaSHirim /Song of Songs 2:14). 36:11 - PARAGRAPH 2. The way that a person gets to this level of kol is through tefilah (prayer). 38:02 - True compassion is dependent on daas (Torah wisdom). Tefilah without kavana (intention) allows the forces of evil to damage compassion. 40:23 - "Even sea-serpents offer compassion" ( Eicha /Lamentations 4:3). 47:01 - Immorality arises from ruined compassion. 48:20 - Three parts of the brain correspond to three levels of kindness. The kindness of a father for his child extends three generations. 50:16 - The three daily prayers correspond to the three levels of kindness that are dependent on the brain. 54:05 - QUESTION regarding 4 mochin vs. 3 mochin .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 20. 00:00 - Dedications. 00:19 - PARAGRAPH 19. Bread represents the Torah and Eretz Yisrael . 02:23 - NEWS ITEM: This morning it was announced in Israel's news media that, b'ezras Hashem, a yeshiva might be re-established in Shechem at kever Yosef HaTzaddik . 03:57 - The special holiness of Shabbos meals. 06:10 - Torah, Eretz Yisrael , and Shabbos are all one. 08:31 - PARAGRAPH 20. Why the blessings before and after a bread meal include all the types of food that will be eaten during the meal. Blessings on food that is not considered part of the meal, for example fruit eaten for dessert. 10:17 - "B'rov am hadras Melech." - "In a multitude of people is the King's glory." ( Mishlei /Proverbs 14:28). A Torah teacher attaches himself to the souls of his students at the time of his shiur (lecture). 15:01 - The Arba Minim (Four Species) on Sukkos . 15:49 - PARAGRAPH 21.There are ten mitzvos related to creating bread. 19:59 - QUESTION: why is dessert is not considered part of a meal? 23:01 - QUESTION about the ten tikkunim in the seudah . Ten levels of holiness in Eretz Yisrael ( Mishna Keilim 1). 26:35 - PARAGRAPH 22. The holiness in the food and in Eretz Yisrael is drawn down through the tzaddik . 28:54 - The holiness of Eretz Yisrael emanates from receiving the Torah. 30:42 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 , Torah 8. 32:14 - Why the word lechem (bread) is related to milchama (war). 34:29 - Reference to the Yanuka ( Zohar HaKodesh 188b). 37:12 - PARAGRAPH 23. Why we emphasize the letter "hey" when making the blessing "hamotzi lechim min ha'aretz" . 40:58 - QUESTION about lechem being milchama . 41:35 - RESPONSE: Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld regarding holiness at mealtime - the throat's sound pipe vs. food pipe. *45:56 - QUESTION about Eretz Yisrael. RESPONSE: Rabbi Shmuel Shapiro z"l encouraged that a person who lives in Eretz Yisrael should continue to daven (pray) to acquire the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 48:05 - COMMENT from a student about the Alter of Novardok z"l (it was his yahrzeit on the day this shiur was given). 49:16 - QUESTION about a guest's obligation to say brochos on food vs. the obligation of the baal habayit's obligation to say brochos on food. 51:00 - QUESTION about the Arba Minim (Four Species). 51:36 - QUESTION about food needing to be refined. RESPONSE: in the future, when people are on a higher spiritual level, eating animals that are not kosher may become permitted. 54:48 - COMMENT from a student relating an account of the Alter of Novardok.

lessons.description: Betziyas HaPas 5 - Bringing Your Light to the Tzaddik - Zos Chanukah and the Face of the Menorah - Tetzaveh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Betziyas HaPas 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 14 . 02:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 8:8 and the Haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah from Zecharia HaNavi . *08:00 - Why olives mu
lessons.bodyText: Betziyas HaPas 5 - Bringing Your Light to the Tzaddik - Zos Chanukah and the Face of the Menorah - Tetzaveh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Betziyas HaPas 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 14 . 02:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 8:8 and the Haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah from Zecharia HaNavi . *08:00 - Why olives must be crushed to produce light for the Menorah. 10:15 - Parshas Tetzaveh. Why are the Jews compared to olives? 12:42 - The Ner Tamid (Eternal Light). *14:57 - NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל: The 600,000 root souls of Israel are hinted in the letters Tav, Reish, Alef. (Parshas Tetzaveh). 21:05 - Q&R - How do we bring our light/mind to the Tzaddik ? Reference to Likutey Moharan 195 - the face, mind, and soul of a Tzaddik are in his writings. In addition to visiting his grave site, we can bring our light to the Tzaddik by studying his teachings . 23:40 - Q&R - How the principle of finding the good point applies to non-Jews. 24:30 - Q&R - Bringing one's Torah learning to Rebbe Nachman is an aspect of bringing one's light to the Tzaddik. For example, whenever Reb Zalman z"l went to Uman, he would "bring" a Siyum (completion of study of a specific portion of Torah) in honor of Rebbe Nachman. The origin of the custom of paying for an Aliya in Shul . 28:00 - After Rabbi Avraham Sternhartz (Kochav-Lev) ז"ל arrived in Eretz Yisrael , Reb Shlomo Wechsler ז"ל used to bring a fruit every day to Reb Avraham with the statement that he was bringing bikurim (the mitzvah of First Fruits) to the Beis HaMikdash (Holy Temple). 30:11 - Zos Chanukah. NOTE: By Hashgacha (Divine Providence) his shiur was given on the seventh day of Chanukah, 5781. 33:11 - PARAGRAPH 25. Reference to BeHaAlosekha . Torah reading for Zos Chanukah (the Eighth Day of Chanukah). The tzaddik is the combination of all 70 Faces of the Torah, which is called the "Face of the Menorah" - the source from which all Jewish souls draw their light. 37:11 - QUESTION: Do we have any portraits of either Rebbe Nachman or Rav Nasan of Nemirov? RESPONSE: No. *48:20 - PARAGRAPH 26. The haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah. The vision of Zecharia HaNavi . 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 27. The light of Chanukah is activated through the Name of Hashem created by the first letters in the words "L'hadlik Ner Chanukah" - this is one of the reasons why why we omit the word "shel" when making the Bracha on kindling the Chanukah lights. 44:00 - Why the menorah was made of one solid piece of gold. 47:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. 51:00 - Q&R - Is there only one Tzaddik Emes in a generation? Although there are many Tzaddikim in every generation, each one responsible for a certain number of Jewish souls, only one Tzaddik includes all the souls of Israel. 55:00 - PARAGRAPH 29. 58:00 - Chiddush (Torah innovation) in honor of Chanukah. The Malchus of Kedushah : "Alefim, Meos, Chamishim, Esarim" precisely counteracts the Malchus of the Sutra Achra: Af, Mashchis, Chet, Avon" . *61:45 - Zos Chanukah : The eighth and final day of Chanukah is called Zos Chanukah , “This is Chanukah.” The Torah reading on this day contains the words “Zos chanukas hamizbeyach,” “ This is the dedication of the altar” ( BaMidbar 7:84). With the kindling of all 36 lights (total throughout the holiday) their fullest spiritual potential is activated: " This is Chanukah."

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 14. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 30 - Visiting kivrei Tzaddikim (grave sites of the righteous). 07:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 14 and the passing of Reb Gedaliah Aharon b'Reb Yitzchak Yoel Rabinowitz of Linitz (1812-1878). His passing is alluded to in this teaching through the observation that eulogies are not permitted during Chanukah. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. When Chizkiyahu Melech Yehudah passed away, a sefer Torah was placed near his gravesite. This honored the fact that he taught Torah to his generation, and demonstrated that the roots of Torah study are connected to the tzaddik . 28:00 - QUESTION: Why is it difficult to feel a connection to the tzaddik when visiting his gravesite? 30:00 - Biographical account of Reb Michel Dorfman z"l . 38:40 - How Reb Eliyahu Chaim Rosen z"l was once asked: "If your Rebbe is such a big tzaddik , why does everyone know where he's buried?" Reb Eliyahu Chaim responded, "You live here in Uman all your life. Have you ever been to his kever ?" The man admitted that he hadn't, and was silent. 46:00 - PARAGRAPH 32. Tzaddikim are even greater after their passing than they were in their lives. Doors of the Beis HaMikdash remained locked to Shlomo HaMelech (King Solomon) until the merit of Dovid HaMelech (King David) was mentioned. 55:00 - Saying Shemos HaTzaddikim . *62:00 - Zos Chanukah.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Brief review of Torah 8, Paragraphs 1-3. 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The spiritual aspects of thunder. 10:32 - PARAGRAPH 5. The seventy root souls of Israel. Prophecy emanates from these seventy souls. 18:49 - PARAGRAPH 6. 22:41 - Slichos (forgiveness) of avonos - sins. Misdeeds are compared to clouds which interfere with the healing light of the sun. But through tefilah (prayer) these clouds are dispelled. *28:10 - The principle of binyanim (structures). When Jewish souls gather to pray, the number of relationships they form increases factorially. To illustrate: three stones can combine in six ways ( 3 x 2 x 1), while four stones can combine in 24 ways (4 x 3 x 2 x 1). If one more stone is added to the group, the number of combinations is 120 (5 x 4 x 3 x 2 x 1). 35:41 - וּבַל־יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי "And the neighbor will not say 'I'm sick'..." ( Yeshayahu /Isaiah 33:24). Each individual sin is mitigated through the power of the gathering. 40:24 - Unity in Klal Yisrael facilitates prophecy. 43:17 - The Koach HaMidameh (power of imagination) is considered the lowest part of the intellect. 51:31 - The ten levels of prophecy correspond to the ten commandments. 56:33 - QUESTION about imagination vs. emunah (faith).

This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 34. Shame and embarrassment break a person's heart. To repair this, we connect our heart to the specific holiness relevant to one's life at present. The miracle of oil celebrated on Chanukah took place through the kohen gadol because he was an aspect of the leading tzaddik of the generation. 06:19 - The seal on the oil in the Beis HaMikdash corresponds to shmiras habris . 12:28 - When a Jewish soul receives light from the tzaddik of the generation, it brings healing to his broken heart. This is the deeper meaning of the Chanukah lights. 18:15 - Why the ark and the luchos are on the Ehven Shesiya (Foundation Stone). 26:16 - The word "ketores" means to join together because this offering repairs the shattered heart. "Oil and ketores (incense) bring joy to the heart." 17:53 - Lev Simcha (joyful heart) is b'gematria Shekhina (the Divine Presence). 28:48 - QUESTION and response about how the midos function. The task of the kohen gadol is to elevate the fallen nekudos , which erases the sins of Klal Yisrael . 32:59 - QUESTION about sheviras hakeylim - the shattering of the vessels. RESPONSE: reference to Likutey Moharan 33. 34:06 - QUESTION about how to tap into this process of healing the broken heart during the rest of the year. 33:00 - Ketores of Yom Kippur. 40:26 - The special, private prayer said during repetition of the Amidah on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. 42:09 - PARAGRAPH 12. The Torah readings during Chanukah: the offerings of the nesiyim (princes/leaders) of the 12 shevatim (tribes). 51:39 - QUESTION: Can a person speak to the tzaddik even if he's not at the gravesite? RESPONSE: Reference to the tefilah composed for visiting the gravesite of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai. 54:40 - PARAGRAPH 13. lessons.title: 2021-01-05 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaMazon 3 - Para. 14-16 - Unifications of the Word Ner - Time Span of Chanukah Lights - Torah Teachers as Stars - When Binah Rises - Milui vs Acharayim (Gematria)
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Birkhas HaMazon 3 - Time Span of Chanukah Lights - Torah Teachers as Stars - When Binah Rises - Milui vs. Acharayim in Gematria - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaMazon 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 34 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The light of the Chanukah candles is a manifestation of the Ohr HaNekudah - the
lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaMazon 3 - Time Span of Chanukah Lights - Torah Teachers as Stars - When Binah Rises - Milui vs. Acharayim in Gematria - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaMazon 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 34 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The light of the Chanukah candles is a manifestation of the Ohr HaNekudah - the central emanation of HaShem's light into the generation ( tzaddik , Torah). The Arizal brings that the word ner (lamp/candle, 250) is the numerical value of 3 unifications of HaShem's name. To explain: When Binah Rises. Sometimes the Shekhina (Divine Presence) is in its most receptive ("lowest") position: Malkhus . In this position, it is called Alef-Daled-Yud-Noon ( A - D - N - Y - 65). At other times, the Shekhina rises to become Gevurah , and is side by side with Chesed . In this position, the Shekhina is called ELOKIM - 86. When the Shekhina rises to its "highest" position of Binah , it is called Alef-Hey and Yud-Hey ( E - K - Y - H - 41). When each of these three Names are combined with the Shem Havaya ( Y - K - V - K - b'gematria 26) the total is 250 - Ner . Y - K - V - K (26) plus A - D - N - Y (65) = 91 em>Y - K - V - K (26) plus ELOKIM (86) = 112 em>Y - K - V - K (26) plus E - K - Y - H (21) = 47 91 plus 112 plus 47 = 250 ( Ner ). 03:36 - When we light the Chankuah candles, we simultaneously affect all three of these unifications of HaShem's Name, which also correspond to the three nekudos explained in previous shiurim in the study of this halakha . 05:30 - PARAGRAPH 15. 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. Time span of Chanukah lights - for how long are they supposed to burn? 20:30 - Chanukah is a time for prayers of gratitude and praise. 25:30 - QUESTION about how to determine spiritual priorities. 31:00 - Story of Rabbi Eliyahu Chaim Rosen zal meeting a friend who poured out his heart to him, and afterwards explained that his intention was that he was pouring out his heart to Hashem. 36:45 - The custom of washing hands with fragrant oil after a meal. 42:36 - QUESTION - why is hunger associated with shame? 45:35 - RESPONSE via Kabbalah: The milui of the Names of HaShem usually imply blessing. An example of how milui is calculated: Yud is written Yud Vuv Daled = 20. So the milui of Y - K - V - K is 72. The milui of ELOKIM is 300. The combination of both Names b'milui equals 372 - שבע Sovah (satisfaction). 47:03 - Acharayim is a type of gematria that usually implies din - constriction. Y - K - V - K in acharayim (72) plus ELOKIM in acharayim (200) equals 272 - רעב ra'av - hunger, famine. *49:17 - Chanukah is a special time for distributing tzedakah .

RESPONSE: Reference to Likutey Moharan 4. *34:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Kos Shel Birkhas HaMazon - cup of wine in honor of the blessings after a bread meal shared by 10 men. HisPearos (pride of HaShem) is the basis for the holiness of Eretz Yisrael , which is drawn through the eyes. This kos represents the tzaddik . 37:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. 37:12 - By looking at this wine, we generate the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 39:52 - "Kos" begematria is "Elokim" . 40:35 - Eretz Yisrael receives its holiness from the hispearus - satisfaction/pride- that HaShem receives from the mitzvos of Klal Yisrael . 40:55 - NOTE about the union between Tiferes and Malkhus . 41:26 - The person who leads the zimun must look at the kos . 43:27 - הִנֵּ֚ה עֵ֣ין יְ֖הֹוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַֽחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ "The eye of Hashem is to those who fear Him" ( Tehillim /Psalms 33:18). The gematria of ayin (eye) is 130. Hashem's name YKVK is 26. Together they create 156 which is the gematria of Yosef . 44:30 - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal's two students: the gematria of Rabbi Elazar plus Rabbi Abba is 312 which is exactly twice 156. These two students were the "Eye of HaShem". *46:05 - Gematria of "wine" (70) and gazing into the Shabbos kiddush wine to heal the eyes. Eretz Yisrael is an aspect of Shabbos . 47:44 - Q&R about "wine that brings joy".

lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaMazon 4 - Ratzon (desire for holiness); Revelation of Hashem through Eretz Yisrael and Blessings After a Meal - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaMazon 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 40 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. The holiness of Eretz Yisrael is drawn from the hispa'arus (splendor of diversity) that is revealed through the blessings recited after a meal of bread. 03:36 - The main way a Jew serves Hashem is through his desire for holiness. 06:39 - The word Nefesh (soul) means desire. 11:51 - Tefilah is an expression of Ratzon . Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 : there are two aspects of Ratzon - desire in the heart ( Ratzon beKoach /potential) and expression through speech ( Ratzon bePoel /realization). 12:57 - NOTE: Moshe Rabbeinu was the most beloved person to Hashem , so why didn't Hashem allow him to enter Eretz Yisrael ? Sefer Megaleh Amukos is entirely devoted to this topic, providing 252 reasons why Moshe Rabbeinu could not enter the Land. 16:11 - QUESTION about traveling to Uman for Rosh Hashanah during the Covid-19 outbreak in 2020. RESPONSE: Account of one of Rabbi Rosenfeld zal 's trips to Uman when the driver didn't allow them to get to the gravesite of Rebbe Nachman. 18:31 - The greatest satisfaction Hashem receives from Am Yisrael is their persistence. The importance of stubbornness and determination in serving Hashem . *30:18 - Getting to Eretz Yisrael requires tremendous persistence. Rebbe Nachman considers this one of the greatest accomplishments a Jew can achieve in this world. *34:52 - The word מניעות Meniyos (obstacles) contains the same letters as the word נעימות Naimus (pleasantness). *36:50 - "Sometimes a person prays for something that costs a hundred thousand dollars, but the Tefilah itself is worth a billion dollars." 38:20 - Reciting Shir HaShirim /Song of Songs on Erev Shabbos counteracts the negative energy and impurities of the previous week. 40:19 - Customs of a man immersing in a Mikveh on Erev Shabbos . 45:42 - NOTES about Gematria of Ahava (13), Moshe (345), and Ratzon (346). Har Nevo is "Noon" "Vo" - the 50th Gate arrived. 47:09 - "Our love for You is as powerful as death..." ( Shir HaShirim /Song of Songs). 57:20 - QUESTION about practical ways to increase Ratzon for holiness and love for Hashem . 54:41 - QUESTION about desiring something bad. 55:42 - Closing remarks.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Ruach , heart and lungs; enthusiasm in serving Hashem vs. "stormwinds"; Yishuv HaDaas - Torah-true perspective; hisbodedus . 00:00 - TORAH 9. PARAGRAPH 1. Ruach (breath/spirit/wind), heart, and lungs. 04:30 - Everything in the universe was created to help us understand how to serve Hashem better. Reference to Likutey Moharan 1: one of our missions in this world is to find the sechel (intelligence) in natural phenomena. 05:02 - Through their ruach , tzaddikim remove the dust and ashes of confusion from the hearts of their generation. *05:55 - The People of Israel are called the "Heart of the World." Each Jew functions as the heart of that location needing the dimension of heart. 10:02 - TORAH 9. PARAGRAPH 2. The stormwind of misguided enthusiasm. 13:39 - Too much oil extinguishes the lamp. 14:19 - Eliyahu HaNavi mastered the stormwind and the chariot of fire. 18:02 - QUESTION about restoring one's initial fire of התלהבות hislahavus (enthusiasm) in Torah observance. 22:00 - Renewing one's tefilos (prayers). 24:39 - TORAH 10. PARAGRAPH 1. Yishuv HaDaas (Torah-true perspective) vs. distractions that interfere with serving Hashem. 30:31 - PARAGRAPH 2. Sadness imprisons the mind and keeps it in a state of exile. *36:44 - PARAGRAPH 3. How can a person maintain happiness in a dark, "upside-down" world? Especially since we are in the longest exile of all. 39:55 - The importance of giving one's fellow Jew the benefit of the doubt. 41:24 - בַּ֖צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י "In my distress, You relieved me..." "China Scam"). 51:30 - Account of Rav Nasan of Nemirov z"l as a child, wondering about death and the purpose of life.

lessons.title: 2021-01-19 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaMazon 5 - Para. 2 - Four Negative Kinds of Torah Study are Counteracted by the Four Blessings After a Bread Meal; Malach Mem Tess; Mistake of the People of Beitar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Four negative kinds of Torah study are counteracted by Birkhas HaMazon (four blessings after a bread meal). מטטרון - "Malach Mem Tess" ; Mistake of the People of Beitar. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 28. 00:00 REVIEW of yesterday's shiur : the four negative kinds of Torah study,
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Four negative kinds of Torah study are counteracted by Birkhas HaMazon (four blessings after a bread meal). מטטרון - "Malach Mem Tess" ; Mistake of the People of Beitar. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 28. 00:00 REVIEW of yesterday's shiur : the four negative kinds of Torah study, the four aspects of Alef ; Adam, Chava (Eve), and the snake. 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Four negative incidents that began with the word "af" - anger. 1) The words of Adam in his defense of his sin; 2) The words of the baker when Yosef HaTzaddik when he was in prison; 3) The complaint of Korach's followers against Moshe Rabbeinu ; 4) The words of Haman when he reports his invitation to Esther's banquet. All draw their strength from the "fallen alefs ". These allude to the four negative kinds of Torah study, the four aspects of alef ; Adam, Chava, and the snake. 14:50 - QUESTION: What happened to the Lamed of the word Alef ? 16:50 - QUESTION: Where was Adam when the snake tempted Chava ? 17:35 - PARAGRAPH 3. How the four blessings of Birkhas HaMazon counteract the four negative kinds of Torah study. 22:00 - Reference to the Sdeh Chemed on the principle that a Jew is not supposed to leave Eretz Yisrael . 26:30 - The Beis HaMikdash is the source of True Torah. 27:12 - The word Tziyun (gravesite) is the same gematria as Yosef . The blessing Boneh Yerusahalyim draws the holiness of Torah and Beis HaMikdash. 28:43 - The fourth blessing, HaTov veHaMeitiv , refers to the power of the tzaddikim to extract the good from Torah learning that has fallen. The process of extracting the good from something that seems negative is alluded to in the structure of the letter "Tess" . Story of Rabbi Meir and the pomegranate. 32:10 - NOTE: There are different yeshivas in shemayaim (heaven), the highest is Mesivta Ilai ("Upper Yeshiva"), which corresponds to Shabbos . Hashem Himself presides in this mesifta . Here there is no debate; all revelations are clear facts. Below that is the Mesivta HaRakeah ("Yeshiva of the Firmament/Heavens"), which corresponds to the back and forth dialogue of the six weekdays. Here מטטרון presides. The inner letters of his name ( Tess - Tess ) equal 18 - chai alluding to the Aitz HaChaim , as opposed to the Aitz HaDaas . Aitz HaChaim is where good and evil are mixed together. The outer letters spell "rimon" (pomegranate). This is what is hinted in the story of Rabbi Meir. 36:12 - NOTE about LaG B'Omer : Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai z"l was niftar on the 18th of Iyar and his gravesite is in Meron. The inner letters of Malach Mem Tess hint to the 18th of Iyar , the outer letters hint at Meron. 37:23 - Return to Birkhas HaTov veHaMeitiv . 44:00 - Why is the burial of Beitar's dead commemorated in the Birkhas HaMazon ? 46:28 - QUESTION about the connection between tikkun habris (repair of physical purity) and tikkun achila (repair of eating). RESPONSE references the sin of Adam and Chava . 50:25 - QUESTION about the mistake of the people of Beitar. RESPONSE references the Kohen Gadol being asked "Which is better food, lamb or goat?" A person has to search for the true talmidei chochomim . 58:28 - QUESTION about desire for food leading to other sins. RESPONSE includes a reference to Likutey Moharan 60, Paragraph 6.

lessons.title: 2021-01-18 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaMazon 4 - Para. 23-24 - The Good Will of Avraham Avinu; Halakha 5 - Para. 1 - The Sin of Adam and Chava Resulted From "Fallen Torah"
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaMazon. The good will of Avraham Avinu ; The sin of Adam and Chava resulted from "Fallen Torah". 00:00 - Review and PARAGRAPH 23. The three meals of Shabbos . 05:32 - Kos shel Bracha of a mezuman (minimum of three men who have shared a bread meal). 06:45 - PARAGRAPH 24. The nedivas
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaMazon. The good will of Avraham Avinu ; The sin of Adam and Chava resulted from "Fallen Torah". 00:00 - Review and PARAGRAPH 23. The three meals of Shabbos . 05:32 - Kos shel Bracha of a mezuman (minimum of three men who have shared a bread meal). 06:45 - PARAGRAPH 24. The nedivas lev - good will - of Avraham Avinu . Reference to Likutey Moharan 142. 12:22 - Through his yearning to serve Hashem, Avraham Avinu merited Eretz Yisrael and the mitzvah of bris milah . 13:59 - The merit of Boaz was tikkun habris . Hispa'arus (pride) and simcha (joy) accompany one another. 17:00 - QUESTION about the centrality of tikkun habris in Torah observance. 19:36 - QUESTION about husband and wife uniting even if the goal isn't the conception of a child. 20:21 - QUESTION about kos shel bracha for a mezuman . 21:30 - QUESTION about how pride and joy compliment one another. 23:55 - QUESTION: How does tikkun habris apply to women? 24:25 - HALAKHA 5. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 28. 24:45 - PARAGRAPH 1. "Fallen Torah" results when people who study Torah oppose faith in tzaddikim . This negative result stems from the "Fallen Alef ". The letter Alef is associated with chochma (wisdom). 31:32 - Through humility a person defeats enemies. 34:30 - The Korbon Tamid repairs the fallen Alefs . 36:45 - "Vechol zeh sohd kavanas Parshas Tamid." 39:40 - The mitzvah of Birkhas HaMazon - blessings said after a meal of bread. 42:15 - All blessings on food are related to separating the good from the extraneous in food. 46:01 - The sin of Adam and Chava (Eve) resulted in the mixture of good with extraneous, which is the source for "Fallen Torah". 53:12 - QUESTION: How can a person distinguish between Toras Nafulos and Toras Emes ? 54:14 - QUESTION about about Sipurey Masiyos : In Rebbe Nachman's story of The Exchanged Children , does the principle of the tzaddik uniting the upper and lower worlds pertain to the home of the forest man in the story, since his dwelling is hovering between heaven and earth? RESPONSE: Yes. Reference to Likutey Moharan 28. 54:42 - QUESTION about the good intentions of Adam HaRishon .

lessons.title: 2021-01-20 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaMazon 5 - Para. 4-5 - Torah from a Kosher Source - Sweetening Harsh Judgements - BeHaAlosekha - Toras Emes and the Mishkan - Merit of Righteous Jewish Women
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Birkhas HaMazon 5 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. BeHaAlosekha: Toras Emes and the Mishkan - sweetening harsh judgements - the merit of righteous Jewish women. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 28. 00:00 - Review. 00:37 - PARAGRAPH 4. The importance of Toras Emes - receiving Torah from a qualified source. 12:22 -
lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaMazon 5 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. BeHaAlosekha: Toras Emes and the Mishkan - sweetening harsh judgements - the merit of righteous Jewish women. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 28. 00:00 - Review. 00:37 - PARAGRAPH 4. The importance of Toras Emes - receiving Torah from a qualified source. 12:22 - Reference to Reishis Chochmah by Rabbi Moshe ben Cordevero (1520-1570). Mussar (rebuke) needs to be measured out with care by a qualified Torah teacher who knows the material and knows the student. 14:09 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 28, learning Torah from the wrong source can cause a person fatigue. 16:43 - Q&R about learning kabbalah .Reference to the Chida z"l who encourages learning kabbalah through "PeReD (mule) is roshei teyvos (initial letters) Pshat, Remez, Drush (leaving out Sohd ). 21:48 - Q&R about how to apply the concepts presented in this shiur to our current times. 25:55 - "For a person to merit the truth of the Torah it takes a higher level of truth than the nevuah of Eliyahu HaNavi." - B'nei Yissachar . 27:58 - PARAGRAPH 5. Building the mishkan (tabernacle) was a task given to Bnei Yisrael to repair the sin of the Golden Calf. 37:13 - Dinim (harsh judgements) can only be sweetened at their source. By means of traveling in the wilderness, the "Fallen Torah" was elevated to Torah Emes . *41:54 - Parshas BeHaAlosekha. The mishkan had to be dismantled and rebuilt time and again during the 40 years in the wilderness to defeat the forces of evil. When the mishkan rested, by placing the Aron Kodesh into the Kadosh Kadoshim, the Torah Nefulos were then elevated to Toras Emes . This destroyed the energy source of Israel's enemies. 47:04 - וּבְנֻחֹ֖ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה רִבֲב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - - "And when the mishkan rested, Israel would say '...Return, Hashem, among the myriads of thousands of Israel'" (Bamidbar/Numbers 10:36). 48:08 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 12 and Likutey Moharan 28. *49:31 - Q&R about customs during the time an Aron Kodesh in shul is open and the Sefer Torah is taken and "travels" among the people present. The meaning of Toras Emes . 51:53 - Q&R about when the mitzvos of the Torah were actually given. 53:41 - Q&R about elevating the Toras Nefulos . ***57:21 - Q&R: Since the women during the Dor HaDeyah ("generation of wisdom" at the time of Moshe Rabbeinu ) didn't participate in the Cheyt Egel HaZahav (sin of the golden calf), in what Zechus merit were they protected from the Aitza (advice) of the Erev Rav ("mixed multitude") while the men fell prey to that bad advice? Is this related to the fact that the women also didn't take part in the Cheyt HaMeraglim (sin of the spies), so they didn't speak against Moshe Rabbeinu or against Eretz Yisrael ? The merit of righteous Jewish women throughout history and especially now. According to the Zohar , Jewish women of the present generation are incarnations from the Dor HaDeyah . 59:15 - Closing remarks and thank-you's.

Through this process, Fallen Torah was restored to the state of Toras Emes . 10:48 - PARAGRAPH 7. The main repair for Fallen Torah took place through the Beis HaMikdash . The error of Shlomo HaMelech . 31:19 - QUESTION: can a person accomplish hosting a Torah scholar through all guests? Establishing centers for Torah study repairs fallen Torah and rebuilds the Beis HaMikdash . The concept of Mikdash Me'aht ("Miniature Sanctuary"). 49:09 - QUESTION about Bas Pharaoh . 50:23 - NOTE about the Arizal , Rabbi Chaim Vital z"l and the Alshich HaKadosh z"l . 53:48 - Reference to Rav Nachman Tcherin z"l's introduction to Alim L'Trufa (the collected letters of Rav Nasan of Nemirov z"l ). 54:48 - QUESTION: What quality made Rabbi Chaim Vital z"l such an outstanding student? 60:36 - QUESTION: Who was Cleopatra? 61:07 - Closing remarks and thank-you's.

"Ani velo malach." 09:51 - Kudsha Berich Hu v'Oreisa are One. 11:00 - Hashem's name "Shakei" equals 314 - the gematria of the Malach Mem Tess. 11:26 - If a person receives Torah from an impure source, that Torah becomes a deadly poison. *14:00 -- Parshas Bo . 16:04 - There are a number of different ways the Torah can be "dressed" in "garments". 17:00 - There are many types of Torah Nefulah ("Fallen Torah"). 19:51 - Hashem consulted with the angels before He created man. 23:48 - Geulah in Atbash is Keser . 24:34 - QUESTION and RESPONSE: it is possible to fulfill the mitzvah of hospitality for a Talmud chachom by providing for his needs for Shabbos ? RESPONSE: Yes, it's one of the highest forms of tzedakah . 25:47 - QUESTION about Toros Nefulos . RESPONSE: A person can't reach the highest level of the Torah through simply reading seforim . 28:44 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about why Rebbe Nachman was reluctant to perform open miracles. 29:47 - Story of the Baal Shem Tov accepting the loss of his Olam Habah when he decreed that a couple should not remain childless. 33:44 - QUESTION about "clothing" the Torah. 34:46 - QUESTION about the closing phrase of this halakha : Kudsha Berich Hu v'Oreisa are One.

lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaPeyros : Blessing Before Eating Fruit - Elevating the Souls in Food - The Seven Species of Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:36 - HALAKHA 1b. Elevating the souls in food by making the blessings before eating. The Seven Species of Eretz Yisrael . Spiritual reason why people are drawn to certain fruits. 02:04 - There is a special blessing on foods that grow from trees (Borey Pri HaEtz) because there are "sparks of souls" within them. The blessing on fruits precedes the blessing on vegetables, which grow directly from the earth (Borey Pri HaAdamah) . 07:00 - Daas (Torah wisdom) bears fruit. 08:31 - "For man is a tree of the field." 11:01 - The brakha HaAdamah before eating a vegetable. 16:05 - The intentions when eating food. 17:25 - NOTE: Sefardim make the blessing Mezonos on matzah during the year. *21:59 - Because of the spiritual processes being accomplished, it's important to respect food and to eat with honor and dignity. 23:47 - QUESTION about the animal desires of the body. 25:35 - Biographical note about Reb Yechiel Michal Dorfman zal . 29:46 - QUESTIONS about the blessing of Shehakol and blessings said after eating bread. 31:32 - QUESTION about vinegar and olive oil. 35:10 - Rebbe Nachman stressed the importance of studying halakha every day. 32:32 - NOTE from student: Wasting food brings dinim (harsh judgements) because each piece of food discarded has a spark of holiness. *34:27 - HALAKHA 2. Giving priority of blessing to the Seven Species for which Eretz Yisrael is praised. When we make a blessing on one of the Seven Species, we generate the kedusha (holiness) of Eretz Yisrael wherever we are. This principle applies also to clapping hands during tefilah (prayer). 41:44 - The word כח - koach (strength) is b'gematria 28, corresponding to the 28 sections of the fingers. 44:15 - Gemara in Berakhos 35. 47:40 - QUESTION about being in Eretz Yisrael .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaPeyros ; Earning Eretz Yisrael through saying a blessing on food; Tzedakah (charity) of Eretz Yisrael . 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated by Yehuda Wurtzel l'ilui nishmas his mother, Bernice bas Avraham a"h , whose yahrzeit is the 12th of Shevat . 13:24 - The Seven Species for which Eretz Yisrael is praised. 16:45 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30: the physical and spiritual structure of the eye. 20:45 - Nimtza - we conclude... 21:41 - Whichever of the Seven Species is listed first in the Torah has priority in blessing. Four parts of the eyes correspond to the four aspects of the Torah (letters, vowels, crowns, cantillation). These four parts of Oreisa correspond to the 4 aspects of the "Eyes of Hashem". 27:30 - QUESTION about saying a bracha on food generating the environment of Eretz Yisrael . What about people who are in Eretz Yisrael ? 31:30 - QUESTION: request for clarification about the shiurim and the Seven Species. 34:24 - QUESTION about hagba (when Torah scroll is opened and lifted up so the congregants can see the letters). 37:01 - HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 37. Soul vs. body corresponds to man vs. animal, memory vs. forgetfulness, intelligence vs. foolishness, and more... 41:05 - The main credit of a fast is the tzedakah given that day. 41:42 - There are two levels in charity: supporting those in Eretz Yisrael and supporting those dispersed in the rest of the world. 42:17 - There are two levels of Torah: that being spoken by those who have sinned, vs. that of young children who have not sinned. 47:35 - "Be careful talmidei chochomim who have forgotten their Torah." - Rabbi Yehuda ben Baseira. 48:31 - The souls of the children of unlearned Jews are very precious. 58:57 - Keeping the right hand above the left hand when davening (praying). 59:16 - QUESTION about fasting. RESPONSE: beyond the standard fasts instituted by Torah, best to invest in tefilah . 62:05 - NOTE: Rav Yitzchak Elchanan b'Rav Yisrael Issa Specktor z"l (1817-21 Adar 1896) explains that not drinking before morning prayer is actually an example of te'inas sha'os (literally "Fasts of Hours"). This chumra (stringency) is a valuable legacy from Rebbe Nachman because abstaining from eating and drinking for even a few hours is counted as a fast but doesn't weaken strength. 63:40 - QUESTION about the effects of fasting on a person's patience and clarity of thinking. 64:59 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 179. 65:12 - QUESTION on "Dirshu Hashem b'Uzo..." (Seek Hashem in strength...")

Nezikin - Damages: Elevating a soul through money. *17:10 - PARAGRAPH 3. Priorities in Blessings; the Seven Species of Eretz Yisrael . Kovod - honor. It's important which blessing is made first when eating several different types of food because there are different levels of soul in different foods. Showing respect to a soul helps elevate that soul. 20:43 - "Table of Kings" - treating food with respect elevates the souls within it. *34:36 - Breslov Tu BeShevat customs. Although most chassidim don't make a "seder" on Tu BeShevat because it's not minhag Arizal , it is customary in the Breslov community to enjoy festive meals including washing for bread, including the Seven Species, and saying the she'hechiyanu blessing on a new fruit. Birkhas HaPeyros - Remembering Shabbos through wine; memory; remembrance; drinking on Purim; five Parts of the soul; Borchi Nafshi ; Kos Shel Bracha . 00:00 - Dedications. Today, the 16th of Shevat , the shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas Reb Yaakov Gedaliah b'Reb Nesanel Tefilinsky z"l . Today's shiur is also dedicated by Reb Gershon Weintraub for his father, whose yahrzeit is on the 17th of Shevat : l'ilui nishmas Reb Eliezer Lipa b'Reb Yaakov Mordechai Weintraub z"l . Today's shiur is also dedicated by Michael Ben Meleh to honor his mother's yahrzeit on the 17th of Shevat : l'ilui nishmas Devorah Feiga bas Reizel a"h . 01:50 - PARAGRAPH 7. Remembering Shabbos through wine. Remembrance of Shabbos throughout the week by saying the Shir Shel Yom each day. 13:00 - Last three lines of the Shir Shel Yom (Song of the Day) that we recite on Wednesday are the beginning phrases 22:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56: to the degree a person increases their daas , to that degree their parnassa (livelihood) . 23:00 - Remembering Shabbos through wine eliminates the negativity of the six weeks days and connects them to the holiness of Shabbos. 20:10 - Tu B'Shevat is the birthday of Rav Nasan of Nemirov. Rabbi Rosenfeld z"ls birthday was the 16th of Shevat . 20:30 - PARAGRAPH 8. It's mitzvah of to get drunk on Purim because on that day, wine is elevated to the holiness of memory. Parshas Zachor . *25:13 - NOTE about drinking wine on Purim and drinking wine on Pesach . Rabbi Yehudah b'Rabbi Ilui had his head bandaged from Pesach until Shavuos . Women can use grape juice for the 4 cups of wine on Pesach . Guidelines for drinking on Purim. 28:37 - PARAGRAPH 9. Kos Shel Bracha : Saying Birkhas HaMazon (blessing after eating bread) over a cup of wine, elevates the preceding meal to "Holy Remembrance" of Hashem's sovereignty. 31:37 - PARAGRAPH 10. 31:54 - QUESTION about a person who can't drink wine. 33:16 - Five remembrances correspond to the five parts of the soul, which allude to the five times "Borchi Nafshi" in Tehillim /Psalm 104. This also alludes to the five concluding letters of the Aleph Beis : MeNaTzPaCh . 39:49 - The four cups of wine on Pesach (Passover) correspond to the four expressions of geulah . 41:20 - Remembrance of the Torah 41:40 - Remembrance of Amalek. 42:26 - Remembering the story of Miriam HaNeviyah : her punishment for speaking against Moshe Rabbeinu . Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 and how loshon hara (evil speech) works against zikaron dekedusha (holy memory). 46:11 - Remembrance of Shabbos . 47:11 - QUESTION about the difference between memory and remembrance. RESPONSE: Reference to the Blind Beggar in Rebbe Nachman's story of "The Seven Beggars". 49:16 - QUESTION about five remembrances vs. six remembrances. 49:32 - QUESTION: How do we know when to "forget about it" when other Jews want to cause harm to Am Yisrael ? 53:41 - Closing remarks and thank-you's.

When making a blessing on a fruit, the fruit must be held in the right hand. 07:02 - NOTE: announcement heard in background of the shiur , the passing of the Rosh Yeshiva of Brisk, Rav Meshulam Dovid b'Rav Yitzchok Zev Soloveitchik zal . 10:08 - Sounding the trumpets during offerings in the Beis HaMikdash is an aspect of zikaron - remembrance. 11:10 - HALAKHA 4, PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Birkhas HaPeyros 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 71 - אַחַ֚ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־יְהֹוָה֘ - "One thing I ask of HaShem..." ( Tehillim 27:4). Noam HaElyon . 16:19 - The word " Noam " in gematria is 160. When one is added, it equals one of the expansions of HaShem's Name E - K - Y - H , which corresponds to Binah . 17:05 - The main goal in making a blessing on food is to elevate the souls in the food. 18:55 - Reference to Shir HaShirim . 20:50 - All blessings are an aspect of songs and praises to HaShem . 26:09 - The essential holiness of all food originates in Eretz Yisrael . 31:48 - PARAGRAPH 2. 38:45 - PARAGRAPH 3. The Seven Species of produce for which Eretz Yisrael is praised. 42:40 - * Eretz Yisrael. CLIP. 44:30 - The letters of the word "achas" are the first letters in the three things acquired only through difficulty: Eretz Yisrael, Chayey Olam Habah, and Torah. 45:20 - * "There is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." ( Vayikra Rabbah 13:1) 45:54 - Moshe Rabbeinu's deep yearning for Eretz Yisrael . 46:30 - *Why did Moshe Rabbeinu long so powerfully to enter Eretz Yisrael ? His desire wasn't for the physical aspect of the fruits of Eretz Yisrael , but for the spiritual aspects of the Land's fruit (the Noam HaElyon ). 50:35 - QUESTION: why do we not make blessings on each specific fruit? 52:08 - QUESTION about Noam HaElyon . 54:26 - QUESTION about the diverse tastes of fruit being an indication of the array of Hashem's splendor. 55:00 - REFERENCE to Yisod VeShoresh HaAvodah (Rav Alexander b'Rav Moshe Ziskind of Grodno): the different tastes of food are the nitzotzos (sparks) of kedusha (holiness)" 55:33 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2021-02-01 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaPeyros 4 - Para. 4 - Achieving the Holiness of Eretz Yisrael; The Power of Human Will; The Seven Species; Sefer Shemos; Mindfulness
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros . Achieving the holiness of Eretz Yisrael ; the power of human will; the Seven Species; Sefer Shemos , mindfulness. 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated by Nissim ben Naomi נ"י for the hatlzacha of his father, Ezra ben Seti נ"י, and a yeshuah for Nomi bat Simcha תחי-ה. 00:52
lessons.bodyText: Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros . Achieving the holiness of Eretz Yisrael ; the power of human will; the Seven Species; Sefer Shemos , mindfulness. 00:00 - This shiur is dedicated by Nissim ben Naomi נ"י for the hatlzacha of his father, Ezra ben Seti נ"י, and a yeshuah for Nomi bat Simcha תחי-ה. 00:52 - PARAGRAPH 4. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 71. Eretz Yisrael is the main location for holy seykhel (intelligence). 06:48 - Achieving the holiness of Eretz Yisrael through overcoming obstacles. 13:30 - Reference to the journey of Rebbe Nachman to Eretz Yisrael . *14:42 - The power of human will: the real obstacles in accomplishing anything in this world is lack of clarity in a person's mind. Because anything that a human being really wants, they can accomplish. There is no obstacle in existence that can stop the person. There is nothing that can stand up to human will power. 31:28 - The central goal of the entire Sefer Shemos is achieving the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 35:19 - Biographical NOTE about Reb Moshe Burstein z"l : The fact that he and his wife came to Eretz Yisrael saved both of them from the holocaust. 37:48 - QUESTION: Under what circumstances can a person leave Eretz Yisrael ? 43:08 - Mindfulness. 49:00 - The Seven Species of produce for which Eretz Yisrael is praised correspond to the Noam Elyon (spiritual splendor/closeness with Hashem). The importance of praising Eretz Yisrael . Through faith in the sweetness of Eretz Yisrael , a person can overcome the obstacles to the holiness of Eretz Yisrael , as embodied in the seven nations that once occupied the Land. 53:45 - What is the meaning of the phrase "A Land flowing with milk and honey" ? "Milk" is associated with giving birth and "honey" alludes to the sweetness of the Noam Elyon . 55:35 - Eretz Yisrael has a blessing for bearing, sustaining, and raising children. Announcement of three upcoming weddings in our community B"H.

lessons.title: 2021-02-02 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaPeyros 4 - Para. 5-7a - Parshas Shelach - Meraglim and Eretz Yisrael; Giving Charity Before Meals; Shofar on Rosh Hashanah

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros. Parshas Shelach, Meraglim (sin of the spies) and Eretz Yisrael ; Miketz - Zimras HaAretz ; giving charity before meals; Shofar on Rosh Hashanah.
