Parshas Shelach: Meraglim and Eretz Yisrael . 03:59 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas Shemos . Why Hashem made things more difficult for the Jews before redeeming them from Egypt. ( Shemos /Exodus 5:9). 11:24 - "Egypt is the opposite of Eretz Yisrael ." When the Noam HaElyon (spiritual splendor) is damaged, immorality results. 13:30 - Parshas Miketz: "Take from the produce of the Land" ( Bereishis /Genesis 43:11). 19:55 - QUESTION: Leviim (Levites) are an aspect of song, but are also an aspect of gevurah . How does song, in this respect, relate to chesed ? RESPONSE: Kabbalah vs. "logic": for example, Binah is a higher level of Chesed than Chesed itself (which is below Binah ). 24:08 - QUESTION: what are the main obstacles to experiencing the kedushah of Eretz Yisrael ? 25:39 - PARAGRAPH 7. Moshe Rabbeinu and Eretz Yisrael . "Why did You make things more difficult?" (Parshas Shemos ) 31:20 - Reference to the Megaleh Amukos brings hundreds of reasons why Moshe Rabbeinu wanted to enter Eretz Yisrael and why he was not permitted. 33:00 - "That which was, will be..." Roshei teyvos (initial letters) of "Moshe." 34:14 - QUESTION about the Noam HaElyon being susceptible to damage. RESPONSE: Niddah (impurity) is "Nod" (wander) Hey (the letter representing Malkhus/Shekhina ). וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יְמָה - note on the word Mitzraimah - the Hey at the end of the word "Egypt" indicates that Hashem's Shekhina (Divine Presence) was with us. 38:56 - The greater the person, the more difficulties they encounter in reaching Eretz Yisrael . 57:51 - QUESTION about the process of coming closer to tzaddikim . 61:00 - By understanding how the body works, we can understand how the soul works.

lessons.title: 2021-02-03 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaPeyros 4 - Para. 7b-10a - Noam HaElyon vs. Chovlim; Eretz Yisrael; Giving Tzedakah Before Meals; Lost Princess; Rosh Hashanah as Birthday of the World; Shofar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros. Noam HaElyon (connection with Hashem) vs. Chovlim (opposition). Eretz Yisrael . Giving tzedakah (charity) before meals. The Lost Princess . Rosh Hashanah as birthday of the world. Shofar and the ten types of song. This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas Chava bas Reb Mos
lessons.bodyText: Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros. Noam HaElyon (connection with Hashem) vs. Chovlim (opposition). Eretz Yisrael . Giving tzedakah (charity) before meals. The Lost Princess . Rosh Hashanah as birthday of the world. Shofar and the ten types of song. This shiur is dedicated l'ilui nishmas Chava bas Reb Moshe and Batya a"h , whose yahrzeit is today, the 21st of Shevat . This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 71. 00:00 - Review and PARAGRAPH 7b. Before a person can achieve Noam HaElyon , he first encounters chovlim . 07:33 - Converting the Klipa Noga - Shabbos can be brought in early, from the time of Plag HaMincha (פְּלַג הַמִּנְחָה, literally "half of the Mincha") is the midpoint between Minchah Ketanah and sunset, i.e. one and one-quarter variable hours before sunset. 09:01 - Klipa Noga is also related to the part of Eretz Yisrael on the eastern bank of the Yarden (Jordan River). 10:00 - QUESTION about how to distinguish between Klipa Noga which can be converted to holiness, and other types of Klipa . 11:44 - QUESTION about the evil inclination being constantly in opposition to a person's desire to make spiritual progress. 12:53 - PARAGRAPH 8. When Moshe Rabbeinu killed the Egyptian, he saw the reason why Jews were being persecuted. 19:53 - NOTE: Meaning of – ת – י – ק – ו "TEKU" - Roshei Teivos (initial letters) of "Tishbi – Yitareitz – Kushiyot – u'Ba'ayot" - (Eliyahu Hanavi) will resolve these unresolved issues." 22:12 - QUESTION about Eliyahu HaNavi establishing peace. 22:32 - QUESTION about the acronym "TEKU" . 22:57 - QUESTION about not having a tzaddik present to ask for resolutions to questions. *24:33 - PARAGRAPH 9. Giving charity before meals. 28:10 - Reference to Rebbe Nachman's story of The Lost Princess : the "magic vessel" in the story is tzedakah . 31:40 - The AtBaSH of tzedakah is tzedakah . Clarification of AtBaSH and explanation of how tzedakah doesn't set a person back in his income but rather increases it. 32:41 - PARAGRAPH 10. Noam HaElyon is Binah . "The father gave the command and the mother carried it out." The days of creation (7) came from Binah (8). 39:33 - Man was created on Rosh Hashanah. Since man is the purpose of creation, Rosh Hashanah is called "the birthday of the world". 41:35 - Shofar on Rosh Hashanah - the ten types of song with which Sefer Tehillim was composed. 45:25 - QUESTION about Uman on Rosh Hashanah. 49:34 - QUESTION about bones of Shevet Ephraim . 53:34 - NOTE: wishing happy birthday to a student and to all, since we're given a new life every day. 54:25 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the dangers of leytzanus (ridicule of holiness).

lessons.title: 2021-02-04 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaPeyros 4 - Para. 10b-12a - Remembrance of Childless on Rosh Hashanah; Yehoshua's Conquest of Eretz Yisrael Began with Shofar; Miketz - Why Stay Awake on Rosh Hashanah?
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros. Remembrance of childless on Rosh Hashanah; Yehoshuah's conquest of Eretz Yisrael began with shofar ; Noam HaElyon; Saying Tikkun HaKlali every day; Miketz - Pharaoh's dream - why stay awake on Rosh Hashanah? 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10b. The custom to give tzedakah durin
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Likutey Halakhos, Birkhas HaPeyros. Remembrance of childless on Rosh Hashanah; Yehoshuah's conquest of Eretz Yisrael began with shofar ; Noam HaElyon; Saying Tikkun HaKlali every day; Miketz - Pharaoh's dream - why stay awake on Rosh Hashanah? 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10b. The custom to give tzedakah during Elul , before Rosh Hashanah. This increases the Noam HaElyon which increases the kingdom of Hashem. On Rosh Hashanah the childless are remembered, which brings more children into the world. Sarah Imeinu was remembered on Rosh Hashanah. 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Why Yehoshua's conquest of Eretz Yisrael began with the sound of the shofar . 14:40 - Shir Shel Yom l'Yom Chamishi - Song of the Day of Thursday - sound the shofar, kinor na'aim - and expression of the "sweet sound" of song is in the shofar on Rosh Hashanah. Through this, the spiritual opposition of the nations is defeated. 19:30 - QUESTION. What does these aspects of the power shofar mean on a practical level for us? RESPONSE: Reciting Tehillim activates the powers of the shofar's "sweet sound" of song. 20:00 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the custom in Breslov to recite Tikkun HaKlali every day. 21:40 - PARAGRAPH 12. Parshas Miketz . Pharaoh's dream took place on Rosh Hashanah and Yosef Hatzaddik was released from prison on Rosh Hashanah. How this applies to life today: spiritual aspects of sleep vs. awakening from sleep. Why we don't sleep on Rosh Hashanah. 35:00 - The Noam HaElyon streams from Eretz Yisrael . Eretz Yisrael is the source of all blessing that Hashem sends into the world. 48:00 - How the Noam HaElyon of Eretz Yisrael is made invisible. 50:00 - QUESTION about free will. 62:00 - COMMMENT from student that "things can get better".

lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaPeyros 4 - Yearning for Holiness and Locking It In - Reshimu - Imprinted Memory - Parshas Miketz - The Gravesite of a Tzaddik Has the Holiness of Eretz Yisrael - Dancing After Tefilah - Tikkun HaBris - Sources for Uman Rosh Hashanah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 PARAGRAPH 12b - The everyday ups and downs of yearning for holiness and then falling into discouragement. The remedy: when in a state of connection with HaShem - locking it in through doing a mitzvah - taking action. This creates reshimu - spiritual imprints on the memory that can be recalled and used for inspiration at a later time. 04:07 - The essence of a person is the mind. 09:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 222 . 09:50 - הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה | אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָה (כתיב וְֽנָשׁ֔וּבָ) חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם: "Restore us to You, HaShem, that we may be restored! Renew our days as of old." Aicha /Lamentations 5:29) *10:50 - Parshas Miketz : How Yosef HaTzaddik could provide the solution for Pharaoh's dream. If you feel a sudden yearning for HaShem , turning it into action will imprint it deeply in your memory so you can recall it whenever needed. 18:10 - The seven good years indicated in Pharaoh's dream represent the Seven Species of Eretz Yisrael , and the seven bad years represent the chovlim - obstacles - facing the Jews whenever they aspired to merit the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . Yosef HaTzaddik is rooted in the Noam HaElyon , and his merit allowed Israel to defeat spiritual opposition. 23:00 - After his passing, even the bones of Yosef HaTzaddik supported Israel's defeat of spiritual negativity. 24:45 - QUESTION about reshimu . RESPONSE - taking the reshima and "locking it in." 29:16 - Dancing after tefilah as an example of reshimu . 31:40 - COMMENT from student about Noam Elyon and the connection to a tzaddik . 32:21 - COMMENT from student about remembering the good through Dayeinu . RESPONSE: other techniques for remembering the good. 32:56 - Ezras Avoseinu in the morning tefilah . ***33:50 - PARAGRAPH 13. Visiting the grave sites of tzaddikim during Elul . The Torah expression for passing away is "nistalek" - going up - to the Noam Elyon . The place where a tzaddik is buried, no matter what its geographical location, has the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ - "The righteous shall inherit the Land and dwell forever in it" ( Tehillim 37:29). Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 109 . 37:25 - Saying Tehillim at the gravesite of a tzaddik . 39:56 - חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֖י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַֽ֜חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי - "Portions have fallen to me in pleasant places; even the inheritance pleases me." ( Tehillim /Psalms 16:6) *44:56 - A Jew should always be trying to draw the kedushas Eretz Yisrael upon himself. 48:57 - QUESTION about tikkun habris . RESPONSE includes encouragement for both men and women to say Tikkun HaKlali every day. 53:32 - Question about Rebbe Nachman passing away at a young age. 55:11 - QUESTION about leaving Eretz Yisrael to visit the grave site of Rebbe Nachman in Uman. 56:12 - References to Reb Ephraim b'Reb Naftali zal , Reb Nachman Tulchiner zal , and to the Sdei Chemed as sources for traveling to Uman from Eretz Yisrael . 59:00 - QUESTION about "making deals with HaShem ". 62:17 - Closing remarks and thank-you's.

The merit of raising children; the merit of Jewish women during the exile in Egypt; intentions of Elul ; danger of eating unripe fruit; the purpose of man is finding lost articles; Rebbe Nachman's story of The Lost Princess . 00:00 - PAR
lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaPeyros - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. The meaning of the word "shofar" . The merit of raising children; the merit of Jewish women during the exile in Egypt; intentions of Elul ; danger of eating unripe fruit; the purpose of man is finding lost articles; Rebbe Nachman's story of The Lost Princess . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The Noam Elyon (Divine Pleasantness/connection with HaShem ) and the Ten Types of Song. The meaning of the word "shofar" is derived from the word word for "beauty". 03:05 - PARAGRAPHS 15. The beginning of the geulah (redemption) from Egypt was in the merit of raising children even while the Jews were suffering in exile. 11:25 - Uva l'Tzion . Moshiach can only arrive after all Jewish souls have been born into this world. The importance of getting married and bringing more children into the world. 12:50 - PARAGRAPH 16. The only way to overcome the obstacles blocking a person from the holiness of Eretz Yisrael is through simcha (joy) and the Ten Types of Song. 16:03 - QUESTION and RESPONSE: "In the merit of the righteous women our ancestors were redeemed from Egypt" - Sotah 11b. 16:50 - Birkhas HaPeyros - HALAKHA 5. Introduction: overview of Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 87, and Likutey Moharan 6 - the Kavanas of Elul - (intentions of the month before Rosh Hashanah). 19:33 - Overview of Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 88 - the danger of eating unripe fruit. 22:22 - When melachim angels find a lost article, they create a major commotion, sounding supernal shofars that generate tremendous joy. 26:18 - HALAKHA 5. Introduction : The danger of eating unripe fruit. Finding lost articles. 30:03 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 87. 32:41 - QUESTION about the melachim who find lost objects. RESPONSE: Wait. Rav Nasan of Nemirov z"l will gradually explain. 32:54 - QUESTION if these principles apply to unripe vegetables as well as to unripe fruit. RESPONSE: Wait. Rav Nasan of Nemirov will gradually explain. 33:22 - PARAGRAPH 1. The importance of making blessings with kavana , especially on fruits - this is an aspect of finding lost articles - the holy sparks contained in the fruit. 37:23 - NOTE: When a child is born, a malach strikes his upper lip, causing him to forget the Torah he learned before birth ( Nidah 30b). *The purpose of man is to find lost articles - the fallen sparks of creation. There are many different types of lost articles that a person needs to find. 38:46 - A person needs to find all the lost articles that pertain to him. This is the essence of teshuvah (spiritual return) to repair the sins he committed. וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכָל־לְבָֽבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ - “And from there you will seek HaShem your G-d, and you will find Him, if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.” ( Devarim /VaEschanan 4:29). 43:26 - Rosh Hashanah . 47:04 - Reference to the Sipurey Masiyos , the story of The Lost Princess , which illuminates the concept of finding lost articles. 49:58 - Tzaddikim return all the unclaimed lost articles to their owners. 50:38 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 188 . 53:00 - The importance of visiting the graves of tzaddikim during Elul and the Ten Days of Teshuvah . דִּרְשׁ֥וּ יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּהִמָּצְא֑וֹ קְרָאֻ֖הוּ בִּֽהְיוֹת֥וֹ קָרֽוֹב "Search for Hashem when He can be found; call Him when he is near" ( Yeshayahu 55:6). 54:13 - QUESTION on Likutey Moharan 188: how do we achieve the honesty and integrity spoken about in this teaching?

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Birkhas HaPeyros 5 - Remembrance of Sarah Imeinu on Rosh Hashanah - Lost Articles - Finding One's Soulmate - Precedence to Fruits of Eretz Yisrael - Tribe of Dan vs. Amalek - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaPeyros 5 - Remembrance of Sarah Imeinu on Rosh Hashanah - Lost Articles - Finding One's Soulmate - Precedence to Fruits of Eretz Yisrael - Tribe of Dan vs. Amalek - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaPeyros 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 87 as well as on 2Likutey Moharan 88 and on Likutey Moharan 188 . This shiur is dedicated by Mrs. Chana Druck in honor of the yahrzeit of her father, R' Abba b'R Yehuda HaLevi zal on the 26th of Shevat . This shiur is also dedicated by Dr. Michael Wetzler in memory of his father, R' Aharon b'R Mordechai zal . 00:00 - Dedications and review of the halakha thus far. 01:36 - PARAGRAPH 1b. Remembrance of Sarah Imeinu in the Torah reading of the first day of Rosh Hashanah and the birth of Rivka Imeinu in the Torah reading of the second day. The import of these two events and why they are essential elements of Rosh Hashanah. The spiritual aspects of finding lost articles. 06:00 - NOTE: the Arizal explains that the closing letters of the Alef Beis - MeNaTzPaCH - are b'gematria 280 which equals isha - woman - representing din - judgement. The Pey and Reish of the word "shofar" correspond to the PaR Dinim - 280 measures of judgement. The Shin Vuv is b'gematria "Av HaRachamon." So the letters of the word shofar are conduits for the process whereby the Av HaRachamon is mamtik (sweetens) the PaR Dinim . 08:36 - Two days of Rosh Hashanah: First day: Dina Kashya - "Harsh Judgement"; second day: Dina Rafya - "Soft Judgement". Brief mention of the Kavanas (Intentions) of Elul , which will be explained in more depth in later sections of this halakha . 12:14 - * The importance of Eliezer finding Rivka Imeinu - the zivug (soulmate) of Yitzchak Avinu . Finding one's soulmate is strengthened through the Torah reading of the second day of Rosh Hashanah. 15:30 - *Rebbe Nachman's "specialty" is taking the ancient principles of the kabbalah and applying them in a practical way to life today. The general principal is: that every Jew needs to search for and elevate his own "missing articles" - the sparks of kedusha in this world that are relevant to his soul. 20:00 - "If a person says, 'I struggled and I found', believe him" ( Megilah 6). 23:50 - Analogies for spiritual success from baseball and school report cards. 25:59 - *Q&R about finding one's soulmate as a result of searching for a lost article. Finding one's soulmate. It's the mission of the man to search for a wife. 28:34 - PARAGRAPH 2. Birkhas HaPeyros . Precedence given to fruits of Eretz Yisrael . Reference to the Story of t he Lost Princess. The golden mountain described there is Har HaBayis in Yerushalayim . Returning lost souls to Eretz Yisrael . 30:38 - Sipurey Maasios. Reference to Rebbe Nachman's Story of the Lost Princess . 33:10 - Explanation heard from Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal about Likutey Moharan 67 - Tisha B'Av - רָחֵ֖ל מְבַכָּ֣ה עַל־בָּנֶי֑הָ מֵֽאֲנָ֛ה לְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־בָּנֶ֖יהָ כִּ֥י אֵינֶֽנּוּ "Rochel cries over her children, who have been exiled. She refuses to be consoled, because they are not there." ( Yirmiyahu /Jeremiah 31:14). "When something is not in its proper place, it can't function properly." 34:57 - Why a fruit is held in the right hand when saying its blessing. 40:35 - NOTE: heard from Rabbi Felberbaum: correct meaning of Adon Olam is "Eternal Master", (relating to time) whereas Adon HaOlam means "Master of the World" (relating to place). 42:28 - PARAGRAPH 3. The mitzvah to remember the evil of Amalek. 44:00 - Amalek was especially determined to attach Machaneh Dan - the encampment led by Shevet Dan - the tribe of Dan. Because they were last in the order of marching, the task of Dan was to gathered all the stragglers, lost souls, and lost articles. 48:24 - *Q&R about Tikkun HaBris . RESPONSE includes how Tikkun HaBris applies to women. 55:00 - A person can achieve finding their "lost articles" by putting their yearning into tefilah (prayer) and enduring difficulties and embarrassments while trying to come close to true tzaddikim . 56:59 - Q&R about Rebbe Nachman's statement "I don't know anything." Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

lessons.description: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaReyach . Mordechai and Esther. lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Birkhas HaReyach . Mordechai and Esther. Why smelling a fragrance requires no after-blessing; praising Hashem dispels spiritual opposition; today is Taanis Esther (Fast of Esther); all food eaten on Shabbos goes to kedusha (holiness). Seder (order) of liver, heart, brain. The power of fasting. 00:00 - Note about the hashgacha (Divine Providence) that we are beginning the study of Hilkhos Birkhas HaReyach on Taanis Esther - a fast day. The name "Mordechai" alludes to myrrh, one of the ingredients of the ketores (incense offering in the Beis HaMikdash ). Esther is also called Hadassah - (myrtle) which is also a fragrant herb that's not eaten is enjoyed through the sense of smell. 14:05 - Review of the concepts just presented about the two levels of refinement. 14:54 - Why smelling a fragrance requires no after-blessing. 17:51 - PARAGRAPH 2. 19:23 - Reference to Shulchan Aruch 216, Para. 14. No blessing on fragrance is said during Sukkos on one's esrog . 24:09 - PARAGRAPH 3. Note about Taanis Esther . Reference to Likutey Moharan 163: "Speech from the back of the neck." 36:37 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 57, Paragraph 5. All food eaten on Shabbos goes to kedushah . 41:23 - The proper seder of receiving energy from food is: MoacH (brain), LeV (heart) and KaVeyD (liver) - roshei teyvos MeLeKh . Note from Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l The opposite of the above seder creates KaLeyM (destroy). Reference to Tehillim /Psalms 8:3 - מִפִּ֚י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים | וְֽיֹנְקִים֘ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צֽוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֜וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם: - the power of fasting defeats enemies. 46:14 - וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף - "And I shall crush his adversaries from before him..." ( Tehillim /Psalms 89:24). 49:02 - QUESTION about " KaLeyM ." 49:42 - The importance of eating on Purim and on Erev Yom Kippur.

lessons.title: 2021-03-03 - LH2 - OC2 - Birkhas HaReyach 3 - Para. 1-2a - Sense of Smell - Bitul - Return to Self - Fragrance of Gan Eden - Yitzchak Avinu - Rivka - Garments of Nimrod
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Birkhas HaReyach 3 - Sense of Smell - Bitul (Self Nullification) - Return to Self - Fragrance of Gan Eden - Yitzchak Avinu - Rivka - Garments of Nimrod - Humility - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaReyach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 and Likutey Moharan 4 . REVIEW of the introduction to Birkhas HaReya
lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaReyach 3 - Sense of Smell - Bitul (Self Nullification) - Return to Self - Fragrance of Gan Eden - Yitzchak Avinu - Rivka - Garments of Nimrod - Humility - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Birkhas HaReyach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 and Likutey Moharan 4 . REVIEW of the introduction to Birkhas HaReyach 3: bitul - self-nullification. PARAGRAPH 1. The fragrance of Gan Eden : Yitzchak, Rivka, and the garments of Nimrod. The Tisha Heichalim - "9 Palaces" - described in the Zohar HaKodesh are mentioned in Likutey Moharan 24 . בְּרַ֣ח | דּוֹדִ֗י וּֽדְמֵֽה־לְךָ֤ לִצְבִי֙ א֚וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים - "Flee, my beloved, as a deer on mountains of spice." ( Shir HaShirim 8:14). The sense of smell, bitul , and return to self. Reference to Zohar, Idra Zuta, HaAzinu : When a deer runs away from something, it pauses to turn back. Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 and the histalkus of Moshe Rabbeinu . The main goal and purpose of a purpose in this world is to achieve bitul - detachment from the physical world but in a fluctuating manner. *Q&R - When does a person strive for the state of bitul ? Self-nullification is most accessible during the prayer of Shemoneh Esrey , but can be achieved at any time when praying or performing mitzvos . Reference to Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chaim, 98 ( Tefilah ) - Kavana (focus, intention) during tefilah . Different levels in tefilah . PARAGRAPH 2. How the blessings on smelling fragrance affect the soul. The main sense of satisfaction of a person is through nourishment of the soul, which is achieved only through bitul . Parshas Yisro and Parshas Mishpatim . Q&R about the deer mentioned in the possuk from Shir HaShirim . Q&R about practical application of the concepts presented in this shiur . Q&R about end of shiur yesterday - last words of the Arizal . The importance of humility. HaShem's intent in the creation of man. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.
lessons.dedication: This shiur is dedicated l'illui nishmas the father of Dr. Sari Mansheim - Reb Mordechai Yehuda ben Leib ע"ה.

lessons.bodyText: Birkhas HaReyach 3 - Bitul - Satisfaction from Food Is Received by Saying After-Blessings - Fragrance During Havdallah - Why There Is No Bracha Achrona on Fragrance - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in the U.S.) PARAGRAPH 2b. Satisfaction from eating and drinking is achieved through making after-blessings. אֵין־טוֹב בָּאָדָם שֶׁיֹּאכַל וְשָׁתָה וְהֶרְאָה אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ - "Is it not good for a man that he eat and drink and show himself enjoyment..." ( Koheles 2:24). Eating the mohn - manna. PARAGRAPH 3. Achieving bitul - self-nullification - through saying the after-blessings for eating and drinking. PARAGRAPH 4. The blessing on fragrance that's made during Havdallah after Shabbos . PARAGRAPH 5. Why there is no bracha achrona on fragrance. Q&R about using essential oils to lift a person's spirit. Q&R about the practical application of bitul . Q&R about returning to regular life after being in a state of bitul . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal on achieving bitul at chatzos and connecting it to the Torah. Q&R about "grounding" after bitul by doing a mitzvah . PARAGRAPH 6. Blessings about Eretz Yisrael after eating food. The main application of bitul is during tefilah . Eretz Yisrael. The first city the Bnei Yisrael entered in Eretz Yisrael was Yericho - alluding to the "good fragrance" of the Land. The city was named after the fragrance of afarsimon - persimmon - that was raised in this area. PARAGRAPH 7. On Shabbos , all forces of Din are banished. Ketores - the incense offering in the Beis HaMikdash . The anointing oil. Q&R about the custom of learning halakha after tefilah . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

His name is based on the term Morah Dachra , the most important spice of the ketores - incense offering. 12:02 - PARAGRAPH 6. Seudas Purim. Why did HaShem specifi
lessons.bodyText: Ki Savo - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal and the Dove - Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. * Zohar Chadash on Parshas Ki Savo - the account of how Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal and his son Rabbi Elazar zal fled to the wilderness of Lod and were sustained by a miraculous wellspring and Carob tree. Why did HaShem specifically provide a wellspring and a Carob tree? The explanation from the Ben Ish Chai zal describes that the main task of tzaddikim in this world is to mitigate judgements against Klal Yisrael . Tzaddikim can mitigate judgment against Klal Yisrael by accepting suffering, or through prayer. The Ben Ish Chai zal : the word Keruv - carob - b'Gamtria is Gevurah . Water alludes to Chesed - loving-kindness. Eliyahu HaNavi would learn Torah with Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai and Rabbi Elazar . The contemporaries of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai searched for the meaning of Hashem's Tochecha - rebuke - in Parshas Ki Savo . These curses correspond to the destruction of the Second Beis HaMikdash and the present exile. Their question was: why is there no consolation given, as it is after the tochecha in Parshas Bechukosai ? Rabbi Yehuda B' Rabbi Ilui expresses yearning for the teachings of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai . Rabbi Yossi B'Rabbi Yehuda , writes their question in a note and attaches it to a dove that's sent on a quest to find Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai . *Response of Eliyahu HaNavi about the difference between the Tochecha - in Parshas Bechukosai and that in Ki Savo . The 32 verses of the first Tochecha correspond to the 32 paths of Chokhma . The 53 verses of the second Tochecha correspond to the 53 Parshios of the Torah. *The transformation of the curses in Ki Savo into blessings depends on the Teshuva of Klal Yisrael . . וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֽׂוּן "... So that you will understand what to do" ( Devarim 29:8). Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai replies to the rabonim of his generation by writing a note and sending it with the dove.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Recorded in Uman, Ukraine. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Counting the People of Israel. 04:16 - Being careful not to interrupt the prayer of another. The importance of being considerate of others, especially when visiting the tziyun (gravesite) of Rebbe Nachman. If there are many people, just to say one's name's and a brief tefilah , then make room for others. The Tikkun HaKlali can be said at a distance, one doesn't need to be close to the tziyun - just in view of it, even from a distance. 11:08 - Every person serves Hashem in their own way. 12:14 - Rabbi Rosenfeld z"l on the difference between the Ramban z"l and the Rambam z"l . 13:41 - The importance of maintaining privacy between one Jew and another. 16:50 - Derech Eretz when sharing a meal - it's good to be conscious of how many people need to share the portions and act accordingly. 17:20 - Why Hashem instructed Moshe Rabbeinu to count the Jewish People. 19:55 - The dangers of counting the People of Israel. Using shekalim to counteract the negative aspects of counting. *25:41 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about Viduy and seder yom on Erev Rosh Hashanah. Seder of Reb Michel Dorfman z"l on Erev Rosh Hashanah. Some people fast half the day, but it's not obligatory. Immsersion in a mikveh is very important and can be done at any point during the day from chatzos halayla (midnight) onward. Seder Yom : 1) Tefilas Chatzos ; 2) Slichos ; 3) Shacharis ; 4) Tikkun Haklali with tzedakah for the aliya of Rebbe Nachman's neshama ; 5) Viduy (confession); 6) Break the fast; 7) Rest and preparations; 8) Last Mincha of the year - be early. 28:51 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 and the corresponding prayer in Likutey Tefilos . 32:52 - QUESTION about dealing with all the distractions in Uman on Erev Rosh Hashanah . RESPONSE: A person cannot assume that other people are less than he is. Story of the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh and the child with a whistle. 36:13 - Account of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l telling a student to observe the customs of mourning on Shabbos . 37:49 - Story of the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh and the simple man who said the entire siddur every day. 43:21 - PARAGRAPH 15. 50:29 - Closing blessings before Rosh Hashanah.

lessons.bodyText: Faith in HaShem , in the Tzaddik , and in Yourself - Uman Rosh Hashanah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Erev Shabbos Kodesh Parshas Nitzavim 5781 (2021-09-03). Parshas Nitzavim . *Connecting with the souls of all Jews before tefilah . Shem Mem Beis - the 42-letter Name of HaShem and the tefilah "Ana B'Koach" . All souls are part of Adam HaRishon , who was created on Rosh Hashanah. Shabbos is a taste of the future world. Connecting with Moshiach before he arrives. The Likutey Moharan begins with the concept that Torah enhances prayer: Likutey Moharan 1 . All the many different aspects of Klal Yisrael are gathered together in Uman Rosh Hashanah. Each person needs to have faith in the unique strength they bring to the community's prayer. Concerning travel to Uman for Rosh Hashanah: "If Rebbe Nachman didn't need you, you wouldn't be here." Closing blessings. Appreciation for the mesiras nefesh - self sacrifice - of all the women at home who support the Rosh Hashanah gathering in Uman. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Arvis 4 - Shelach - Meriting the Holiness of Eretz Yisrael - The Power of Beginnings - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and PARAGRAPH 32b. Uniting the upper waters and lower waters of the creative process is only fully achieved in Eretz Yisrael . It's impossible to elevate these sparks without drawing O
lessons.bodyText: Arvis 4 - Shelach - Meriting the Holiness of Eretz Yisrael - The Power of Beginnings - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and PARAGRAPH 32b. Uniting the upper waters and lower waters of the creative process is only fully achieved in Eretz Yisrael . It's impossible to elevate these sparks without drawing Ohr "MaH" ha Chadash - an especially high level light - from above. But how can one even begin this process? Bitul allows a person to access that light, but complete bitul can only be achieved in Eretz Yisrael . At the same time, a person cannot get to Eretz Yisrael without keylim – vessels – that are only obtainable in Eretz Yisrael . So attaining the holiness of Eretz Yisrael seems a paradox. Many people, including Torah scholars and tzaddikim , experience obstacles before they merit the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . This is because the forces of impurity attached themselves to the holy sparks of the "shattered vessels" at the time of creation. These negative forces try to prevent the sparks from escaping their hold. 18:56 - QUESTION about the difference between a kli (vessel) and light. RESPONSE: A vessel is a lower form of light. *20:02 - PARAGRAPH 33. Parshas Shelach. Why Moshe Rabbeinu was willing to allow Am Yisrael to send spies to explore Eretz Yisrael before entering it. 39:55 - PARAGRAPH 34. Exile gives Israel the opportunity to refine and repair the fallen holy sparks that resulted from the shattering of the vessels during creation. The essential element of this process is the power to begin anew, no matter what level a person is on. This power of renewal, no matter what the circumstances, initiates the process of attaining the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 44:27 - Analogy brought to illustrate concept of baki b'rotzo, baki b'shov - "mastery of running and returning": Rabbi Tzadok fasted 40 years to delay the decrees against the Beis HaMikdash . After his fast, he recovered by means of small amounts of nourishment given in gradual portions ( Gittin 56a). *54:24 - Q&R about the power of beginnings.

lessons.bodyText: Kriyas Shema 2 - Chanuka - HaShem Yearns To Hear the Truth - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Kriyas Shema SheAl HaMitah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 35 . " HaShem yearns for the truth." 00:00 - By reciting the Shema at night before going to sleep, we declare our faith in the Unity of HaShem . 15:28 - Viduy (confession) is a powerful expression of truth. 18:00 - When a person prepares for sleep through reciting Kriyas Shema , their sleep is healthy and restores them physically and spiritually 22:40 - Chanukah is celebrated during the longest nights of the year. 25:37 - Kriyas Shema al ha mitah prevents and repairs the sin of zera l'vatala (wasting seed), which begins in thought. 27:57 - Thought is repaired through sleep. Kriyas shema al hamitah is one of the most powerful antidotes for this sin. *36:04 - Tehillim 51 was said as viduy (confession) by Dovid Hamelech . HaShem yearns to hear the truth. 38:46 - בְּיָֽדְךָ֘ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְ֜הֹוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת: "Into Your Hand I entrust my spirit; You have redeemed me, O Lord, HaShem of truth.." ( Tehillim 31:6) The last word from a person's lips before he goes to sleep at night is "emes" - truth. 41:08 - Hashkiveynu . 44:06 - The essence of teshuvah (returning to HaShem ) is repairing thought.

lessons.title: 2021-12-17 - LH4 - YD1 - Shechita 5 - Para. 15b-18 - Holiness is Hidden - The Four Elements of Creation - Land of the Weasel - Customs of "Shovavim"
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Michel Dorfman z"l
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. What is the meaning of Dovid HaMelech 's phrase "Land of the Weasel" ? ( Tehillim 49:2). 00:00 - Holiness is hidden. "All land animals have a counterpart under the sea, except for the weasel." What do the sages teach through this statement? ( Chulin 127a based on Tehillim /Psalms 49:2. 01:3
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. What is the meaning of Dovid HaMelech 's phrase "Land of the Weasel" ? ( Tehillim 49:2). 00:00 - Holiness is hidden. "All land animals have a counterpart under the sea, except for the weasel." What do the sages teach through this statement? ( Chulin 127a based on Tehillim /Psalms 49:2. 01:36 - Moshe Rabbeinu mentioned the aron hakodesh first, but when Betzalel went ahead with the actual construction, he made the mishkan first. 02:00 - Every type of animal that's found on land has a counterpart under water. 04:55 - The four elements of creation correspond to the four letters of Hashem's Name Yud - Hey - Vuv - Hey . QUESTION: Does man have a counterpart in water? RESPONSE: In the gemara , the sages say yes, but it's not like depicted in popular culture. (See Rashi on Bechoros 8a, and the Chidah in Midbar Kademut ) 09:37 - PARAGRAPH 16. "Moshivi Akeres HaBayis" ( Tehillim 113:9) and "Your children have made me like a weasel that hides in the foundations of homes..." - Rashi on the gemara : As a result of our sins, Hashem has to hide Himself ( Pesachim 118). 11:50 - Constructing the mishkan counteracts Teivos Mamon - desire for excessive wealth. Ritual purification usually takes place through water. 15:35 - "The end of a man is death, the end of an animal is slaughter." 16:43 - The miracle of Purim. The gemara relates that Haman is alluded to in the Chumash in Adam's sin regarding the Eitz HaDaas - Tree of Knowlege. "Hamin ha aitz" - Hamin is spelled with the same letters as Haman. 22:04 - The power of the tzaddik , Mordechai . 25:41 - QUESTION about the concept "moshivi akeres habayis" and the chuldah (weasel). 30:56 - COMMENT by student about Rabbi Avigdor Miller zal . 31:28 - PARAGRAPH 18. Parshas Parah . *45:30 - QUESTION about customs of Shovavim and Shovavim Tat - the weeks between Parshios Shemos and Mishpatim (in a leap year, between Shemos and Tetzaveh ). Historical and kabbalastic background. The customs today, in summary: 1) Slichos (found at the back of some siddurim ) once a week before Shacharis (in the Breslov Yeshivah, Meah Shaarim - Thursday mornings except for Rosh Chodesh ). 2) Some people fast once a week, for a day or half a day. 3) Some people refrain from eating animal products once a week (meat, fish, eggs, dairy). 4) Special care to say Tikkun HaKlali every day. 5) Renewed attention to mikveh and all mitzvos of Tikkun HaBris .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Beginning with the words: ִּי דַּע, כִּי כָל הַפְּשׁוּטִים הַנַּ"ל, הֵן לַמְדָן שֶׁהוּא עוֹסֵק בַּתּוֹרָה לְשֵׁם שָׁמַיִם Otzar Matnas Chinam - The Treasury of Unearned Gifts. 13:00 - The 26 verses that end "Ki LeOlam Chasdo" ( Tehillim /Psalms 136) refer to the 26 generations that existed before the Torah was given. The entire Torah is contained in the Eseres HaDibros (Ten Commandments). In the Eseres HaDibros there are 620 letters corresponding to the 613 mitzvos plus the seven mitzvos of the Bnei Noach (righteous non-Jews). 19:03 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the avos and the Treasury of Unearned Gifts. 19:40 - The essence of Eretz Yisrael's holiness. 32:00 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the holiness of Eretz Yisrael and the relationship of the People of Israel with the Land, is based on the asara ma'amaros (ten utterances) of creation, as Rashi HaKodesh explains in his first comment on Chumash . Words need editing at 4:59 pm. The asara ma'amaros are the path to Eretz Yisrael - this is another definition of the phrase "Derech Eretz" . 29:27 - Why didn't Hashem just put the Bnei Yisrael in Eretz Yisrael to begin with? 32:00 - The entire Torah is hidden in the asara ma'amaros . The Ten Commandments are hidden in the Kriyas Shema . 35:18 - QUESTION about why the non-Jews are hostile to Am Yisrael . RESPONSE - it's an upside-down world to allow free will to exist. 40:14 - PARAGRAPH 5. The tzaddik must go down into "ordinary person" so that he can give life to all of the ordinary people. 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. 48:27 - PARAGRAPH 7a. "Despair doesn't exist." 58:07 - Historical background of this Torah - until Rebbe Nachman arrived, Uman was considered a city of darkness. 61:49 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about a summary of this teaching. 64:56 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the connection of the tzaddik to Hashem. lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 82. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Laws regarding sharecropping. The creation of man was initially as male and female joined back-to-back. 14:17 - Malchus (sovereignty) is related to " MaH " - one of the most recognizable aspects of Hashem . Seder (order) is the upper level when in relationship with lo c'seder (disorder). 21:48 - The dynamic between Adam and Chava (Eve) is the model where this principle can be seen. 35:09 - PARAGRAPH 2. When two opposing qualities meet, the lower is absorbed into the upper. When lo c'seder is unified with seder , it becomes seder . An example of this is the wife receiving the last name of the husband when she marries.

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan , Torah 3. 00:00 - Pharaoh tried to stop the process of Matan Torah through disrupting Israel's power of speech. *04:36 - The exile of Mitzrayim (Egypt) was a prototype for all the exiles to follow and was essentially the exile of speech. 10:06 - What is yichud of speech in kabbalah ? 16:27 - Yetziyas Mitzrayim - the exodus fulfilled the purpose of taking speech out of exile so that Israel could receive the Torah. Korbon Pesach (the Passover sacrifice) and the distinction between holy song and profane. 29:18 - Pesach, matzah, maror.

lessons.bodyText: Text: Likutey Moharan 2, Torah 82, Para. 1-3 - Order and disorder; Adam and Chava (Eve); Humility. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. In this teaching Rebbe Nachman presents the concepts fundamental to all his teachings: seder (order) and lo c'seder (disorder). lessons.bodyText: Breslov Basics - HaShem Can Forgive, No Matter What - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . King Chezkiyahu’s son Menashe did so many evil things during his reign that the angels blocked his repentance. Therefore, to accept Menashe’s plea for forgiveness, HaShem dug a tunnel to His Throne that bypassed all the courts of heaven. This account is an encouragement to any sincere person that the path of return is always open. Based on Melachim II 21, Divrei HaYomim II 33:13, and Midrash Yalkut Shemoni . Tu beShevat customs: Although most
lessons.bodyText: Tu BeShevat - The Seven Species of Eretz Yisrael require special priority during a meal. It's important which blessing is made first when eating several different types of food because there are different levels of souls in different foods. Showing respect to a soul helps elevate it. Tu beShevat customs: Although most chassidim don't make a "Seder Tu BeShevat" because it's not minhag Arizal , it is customary in the Breslov community to enjoy festive meals by washing for bread, including at least one or two of the Seven Species, and making the she'hechiyanu blessing on a new fruit. Praying for a beautiful esrog to honor Sukkos is also customary on Tu BeShevat. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. The entire shiur is HERE .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon

Recorded on 2022-01-11 in Efrat, Israel. 00:00 - The Fifteenth of Shevat – Rosh Hashanah leIlanos (New Year for the Trees) – is the birthday of Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal . Jus
lessons.bodyText: Tu beShevat - Birthday of Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal - Eitz HaDaas - Mystical Tree of Rebbe Nachman's Fifth Beggar - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Recorded on 2022-01-11 in Efrat, Israel. 00:00 - The Fifteenth of Shevat – Rosh Hashanah leIlanos (New Year for the Trees) – is the birthday of Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal . Just as Avraham Avinu relied on his closest student, Eliezer Damasek , to assist him in bringing faith in HaShem into the world, so too did Rebbe Nachman of Breslov rely on his closest student, Rav Nosson zal . 07:00 - Was the Eitz HaDaas (Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil) a grape vine? 12:00 - Looking at the wine during Kiddush on Shabbos repairs spiritual damage to vision. 15:00 - Was the Eitz HaDaas wheat, or (18:00) a fig tree, or (19:00) an Esrog (citron) tree? 22:30 - The apple symbolizes the Shekhina (Divine Presence). 28:48 - In Sefer Tehillim (Psalms), Dovid HaMelech (King David) begins with reference to a tree that is also alluded to in a number of other places in the Torah: וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל־פַּלְגֵי מָיִם אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ׀ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ וְעָלֵהוּ לֹא־יִבּוֹל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִיחַ: (תהלים פרק א פסוק ג) *30:00 - In his Tale of the Seven Beggars, Rebbe Nachman describes a tree near which all creatures are in harmony. It its shade, even natural enemies are at peace with one another. Its three roots are אמונה (faith), יראה (fear/respect), and עניוות (humility). The trunk of the tree is אמת (truth). These four attributes correspond to Avraham Avinu, Yitzchak Avinu, Moshe Rabbeinu, and Yaakov Avinu, respectively. When a person works to develop these four character traits in himself, he strengthens them in others and contributes to world peace. The tree alludes to the Torah and to the Tzaddik , as in אַשְׁרֵי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר׀ לֹא הָלַךְ בַּעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים וּבְדֶרֶךְ חַטָּאִים לֹא עָמָד וּבְמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים לֹא יָשָׁב - "He shall be as a tree planted beside rivulets of water, which brings forth its fruit in its season, and its leaves do not wilt; and whatever he does prospers" ( Tehillim 1:1).

These are also the letters of Menatzpach . Through these five Halakhos we are able to elevate the human soul trapped in the animal to the status of a human soul. 03:01 - PARAGRAPH 2. The Shochet is required to show his knife to a Talmud Chakhom at any time it's requested. Reference to Likutey Moharan 37 and the two categories - spiritual vs. physical. Elevation of the soul is done through Kovod (respect) - since all souls originate from beneath the Kisey HaKavod (Throne of Hashem). 09:04 - Only a Bar Yisrael may do shechita . If the Bar Yisrael is not Torah observant, then the Shechita is not kosher. *11:08 - PARAGRAPH 3. It's forbidden to slaughter an animal and its offspring on the same day. Every animal that's slaughtered according to Halakha is actually a human soul trapped in the body of an animal. The purpose of Shechita is to elevate that soul from Beheyma (animal) to human. 13:00 - Therefore, a Shochet must be Torah observant and a Yireh Shemayim . He must be extremely careful in saying the blessing on Shechita and performing all the Halakhos of Shechita . There are five basic laws of Shechita correspond to the five books of the Torah. The mitzvah of Shechita encompasses the entire Torah. 16:11 - Until Moshiach comes, we are involved in the Tikkun of elevating souls every day. This is a process which cannot be completed in one day alone. No two days are the same. Each an every day there are Birurim - refinements - that need to be done today. The same thing is true for the generation. 8:28 AM 12/7/2021. Story about the students of the Arizal and his students who were ready to bring Moshiach when a Makhlokes - dispute - broke out and the opportunity was missed. Why we try not to delay a Mitzvah : story of Nachum Ish Gamzu and the man unloading his donkey. *21:16 - It's an obligation to bring children into the world because every generation has to make specific refinements based on that generation. Analogy of an assembly line. Just as the sun rises and sets every day, so too there's a new generation each and every day. 24:00 - This is why we say in Kriyas Shema "These words that I am instructing you today should be on your heart..." and "teach your children ." These two concepts are one: "today" and "your children - the new generation". 34:03 - PARAGRAPH 4. Prohibition against slaughtering an animal and its offspring on the same day. 40:03 - PARAGRAPH 5. Fasting. The seven days of the week correspond to the seven basic Midos , as alluded to in הֽוֹדִ֘יעֵ֚נִי יְהֹוָ֨ה | קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה־הִ֑יא אֵֽדְעָ֗ה מֶה־חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי - ( Tehillim 39:5). Q&R about fasting in our generation. The Name of Hashem : Tav Khaf Hey - brings about the downfall of our enemies. This Name brings about the destruction of Avoda Zara - idol worship.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 70 - Spiritual Aspects of Gravity - The Tzaddik is a Magnet - The Mishkan Today - Shemini - Parshas Pekudei 5773 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. (Recorded in March, 2013.) וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י קָרָ֣א משֶׁ֔ה לְאַֽהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו וּלְזִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "And it was on the eighth day, that Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel" ( Vayikra 9:1, Shemini ). 00:00 - Introduction: the force of gravity in nature. 05:18 - כַּעֲב֣וֹר ס֖וּפָה וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם - "When the whirlwind passes, the wicked man is no more, but the righteous one is the foundation of the world " ( Mishlei 10:25). Shimshon's riddle about the lion and honey. *06:09 - Just as the earth has a magnetic field, so a tzaddik who humbles himself has the power to attract souls at every level. 08:00 - A tzaddik is called ochel - nourishment. All tzaddikim of a given generation are branches of one central Tzaddik . 12:10 - Blessing that streams into the world is sent from HaShem via the Tzaddik . When a person gives charity to the central Tzaddik of the generation, the donor is actually receiving. 14:18 - Yirmiyahu HaNavi punished those who opposed him by asking HaShem to prevent their charity from reaching worthy recipients. 26:55 - The Mishkan draws holiness to the place where it stands. 28:05 - Midrash - the Mishkan is a guarantee that HaShem is with Am Yisrael . 30:50 - Even when the Mishkan isn't standing, the synagogues and yeshivas of Am Yisrael serve in its place. 32:23 - Parshas Pekudei : eleh pekudei hamishkan - the word Mishkan appears twice in this verse alluding to the fact that when the Mishkan is assembled, it's operating - and and when it's in pieces, it's still operating. 33:10 - The Nassi'im - the tzaddikim of their generation - donated the wagons on which the elements of the Mishkan were transported. 36:00 - שֹׁכֵן עַד וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ אֶשְׁכּוֹן וְאֶת־דַּכָּא וּשְׁפַל־רוּחַ לְהַחֲיוֹת רוּחַ שְׁפָלִים וּלְהַחֲיוֹת לֵב נִדְכָּאִים - "...'With the lofty and the holy ones I dwell, and with the crushed and humble in spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble and to revive the heart of the crushed'" ( Yeshayahu 57:15). 37:05 - All honor allocated by HaShem to people is distributed via the central Tzaddik of the generation. The first mitzvah presented in Torah Law with regard to observing the holiday of Pesach is giving charity to
lessons.bodyText: Maos Chitim - Charity for Pesach - Kimcha dePischa - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. וְלֹ֧א יֵֽרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם - "...and they shall not appear before Me empty-handed" ( Devarim 16:16, Ki Sisa ). The first mitzvah presented in Torah Law with regard to observing the holiday of Pesach is giving charity to those in need ( Shulchan Aruch 429). The Egyptians worshiped sheep because that animal was a measure and expression of wealth in their culture. People today are prone to a similar worship of wealth. However, giving charity is an expression of faith in HaShem , rather than faith in money. All wealth belongs to HaShem and is distributed by Him. לִ֥י הַכֶּ֖סֶף וְלִ֣י הַזָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת - "Silver is Mine, and gold is Mine, says the Lord of Hosts" ( Haggai 2:8). The first day of Rosh Chodesh Iyar (the 30th of Nisan ) is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Chaim b'R' Yosef Vital zal. At first, he was a close student of Rabbi Moshe Cordovero zal - the Ramak . After his teacher's passing, Rabbi Chaim began studying with Rabbi Yitzchak Luria - the Arizal - who had arrived in Tzefas in the year 5330 (1570 CE). Rabbi Chaim described an incident that marked his introduction to the Arizal's teachings: “When I came to the sainted master to study, he took me with him aboard a boat on the Kineret . Then, at a location opposite the Old Synagogue of Tiberius, he dipped a cup into the water and gave it to me to drink. He told me that now I would be able to understand his teachings, for I had tasted water from the Well of Miriam . From that moment on I was able to enter the depth of this wisdom.” (Source: Nagid U'Mtzaveh by Rabbi Yaakov Tzemach zal , written about 60 years after the Arizal's passing.) The entire shiur is HERE .

lessons.bodyText: Maachalaey Akum 2 - Nature is Elokim - Teshuvah - Az Yashir - Song of the Future - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Maachaley Akum 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . Yayin Nesech, Kol, Akdamos . PARAGRAPH 7. The prohibition of drinking the wine of a non-Jew – yayin nesech . Tochecha (holy rebuke) can sweeten a harsh judgment at its root. “Song is only said with wine” ( Brochos 35). Wine is associated with song and the elevation of how the voice is used. "Az Yashir Moshe uVenei Yisrael" ( Shemos ). Q&R about the practical application of the issur of yayin nesech . PARAGRAPH 8. The prohibition of drinking the wine of a non-Jew – yayin nesech . NOTE about the Name of HaShem and the four tzaddikim of the Kisey HaKavod. Q&R - Is Shavuos an aspect of Yitzchak Avinu and Olam Habah ? PARAGRAPH 9. The Arizal states that haTeva (nature) is begematria Elokim . "There is no such thing as nature”. All of creation is an interdependent network. Constellations are related to people, because every person has the ability for tikkun (spiritual repair). The individual therefore has the power to bring a great light to all worlds, or the opposite. The Torah was given over to the hands of man. The account of Rabbi Eliezer eliciting the endorsement of Heaven that his ruling was correct. Rabbi Joshua then said: "'The Torah is not in heaven!' ... We take no notice of heavenly voices, since You, HaShem, told us at Sinai that ruling in the Torah 'follows the majority.' " ( Bava Metzia 59a–b). Teshuvah was established before the creation of the world. Shabbos is an aspect of Teshuvah . In the future, all will be miracles. The activation of the Song of the Future. Through holy song, our sins are forgiven. The Akdamos sung on Shavuos was composed by Rabbi Meir bar Yitzchak (Nehorai) of Orléans, a baal tefilah in Germany, who died about 1095 BCE. Q&R on the connection between Shem Mem Beis , sweetening harsh judgments at their root, and praying with a nigun (melody).

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 19. The immersion in a mikveh of a vessel used for food, if it was acquired from a non-Jew, even if the vessel was never used by the non-Jew ( Bamidbar 31:23 - Parshas Mattos ). 01:89 - PARAGRAPH 1. 02:44 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 - all avoda zara is rooted in teyvos mamon . 03:55 - Reference to Likutei Moharan 23 which explains the connection between cleansing from sin and freeing oneself from unconstrained desire for wealth, based on the words וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר ( Bereishis 33:18, Parshas VaYishlach ). *06:28 - The two faces of money: a face of light or a face of darkness. 08:37 - When a person is steeped in desire for wealth, his face becomes dark. 09:27 - The correspondence between money and vessels used for food. 10:38 - The seven types of metal correspond to the seven lights of the face, which are aspects of the menorah and the seven midos of consciousness. (See Likutey Moharan 21 for more about this.) 13:57 - Immersion in a mikveh restores the light of the face, because mikveh is an aspect of daas (Torah wisdom). 19:24 - Mikveh is an essential part of the teshuvah process. 20:53 - PARAGRAPH 2. 24:35 - Earning a livelihood is twice as difficult as giving birth. (Reference to Likutey Moharan 23.) 29:19 - PARAGRAPH 3. 26:01 - Just as a nidah requires tevilah , so does a vessel used for food. Both types of impurity originated through the sin of Adam HaRishon . "And a river went out to water the garden" ( Bereishis ). 28:19 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about dam niddah . "Respect your wife so that you will become wealthy" (Bava Metzia 59a) 29:19 - PARAGRAPH 3. A vessel is made kosher through the means it became non-kosher. Likewise, a person who wants to return to Hashem is tested through challenges in which he originally failed. 34:21 - The spiritual aspects of metal vessels vs. those of earthenware vessels. Earthenware don't require immersion in a mikveh . 42:06 - A sword used to kill a person is a source of impurity. The stones of the Beis HaMikdash had to be formed without metal tools. 43:24 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about the Jewish soul being compared to a vessel made of metal. 44:11 - QUESTION and RESPONSE about immersing glass vessels in a mikveh . 44:48 - Closing blessings and note about the six days following Shavuos .

PARAGRAPH 7. Klipos (forces of destruction) can only draw sustenance from HaShem through keylim (vessels). They cannot draw from HaShem's ligh
lessons.bodyText: Hechsher Keylim 2 - 3 - Calling HaShem's Name - More Energy by Saying Blessings on Food - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hechsher Keylim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 61 . PARAGRAPH 7. Klipos (forces of destruction) can only draw sustenance from HaShem through keylim (vessels). They cannot draw from HaShem's light directly. When Yitzchak Avinu prepared to give his blessing to Esav , he told Esav to bring keylim (tools, vessels). Similarly, the essential destruction of the Beis HaMikdash came about through the enemy capturing its vessels - the mizbeyach (altar), menorah, and all the other items used there. When klipos are attached to metal keylim , those who use these vessels do not have aitza sheleyma - their ability to make good decisions is impaired. The seven metals are related to the seven כוכבי לכת - "traveling luminaries" of the night sky (sun, moon, and five planets). The sohd ha'ibur (hidden Torah knowledge of the intercalation of the lunar and solar calendars) is based in the seven luminaries. Reference to Likutey Moharan 61 and Rebbe Nachman's story: "The King Who Decreed Conversion" (also known as the story of "The Bull and the Ram"). "HaShem will overturn the counsel of the nations" ( Tehillim 33:10). Through immersing metal vessels used for food, a Jew is protected from the negative influence of the 70 nations and Kingdom of Israel is no longer split apart. The Hebrew word for kingdoms - ממלכות - also refers to advice/counsel - עצות. As in מִלְכִּי יִשְׁפַּר עֲלָךְ - "May my counsel please You..." ( Daniel 4:24). Netzach and Hod feed into Malkhus. Moshe Rabbeinu received nevuah (prophecy) from "...between the Keruvim" - that represented Netzach and Hod . Q&R - The same principles relating to the immersion of metal cooking utensils are also related to a person's immersion in the mikveh . 40 seah minimum volume of water in a mikveh corresponds to Binah ( Pirkei Avos 5:21). The Zohar explains that in the word Binah - discernment - the letter Beis stands for Binah , the Yud is for Yisod , the Noon is for Netzach , and the Hey is for Hod . The Jewish Kingdom was split through defective counsel, but will be unified through good counsel. The Zohar Hakodesh calls the 613 mitzvos of the Torah "613 pieces of good advice". A Jewish king is obligated to write two sifrei Torah "...so that he and his descendants will have a long reign..." ( Devarim 17:19-20). A Jew cannot benefit from the holiness of food he eats unless he sanctifies the vessels used in the preparation of his food. HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Hechsher Keylim 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 56 - "U'veyom HaBikkurim" . The introduction is a very brief summary of several key elements in this teaching. *Q&R about the distinction between a tzaddik and a complete tzaddik . Account of Rebbe Nachman’s arrival in Uman and his first encounter with Jewish atheists. Continuing inside the text: according to the amount of daas (wisdom based on awareness of HaShem ), so is the amount of parnassah (livelihood) and peace. *"Because people who are working are also learning Torah, Am Yisrael has an easier time earning a livelihood." * Mikveh of Shavuos . *PARAGRAPH 1. Eating and drinking according to the Torah actually turns the food and drink into Torah. The life-sustaining energy of food is placed there by HaShem . *Science disregards HaShem : "Two rocks collided in mid-air a billion years ago?" This disregard allows people to exist without any moral obligation to H aShem . In contrast, a Jew is not permitted to eat food until he praises the Name of HaShem . By reciting the blessing we're connecting to the Name of HaShem and His life-giving energy in the food. *וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ - “You will eat and you will be satisfied...” ( Ekev/Devarim 8:10) - the main satisfaction from food is achieved through saying the words of the blessings before and after eating. A Jew brings blessing to all the nations and even to all the animals when he makes blessings on food. *Q&R about the mikveh of Shavuos - is there a way we can bring that holiness into the rest of the year? Account of Rav Yosef Chaim Zonnenfeld zal (1938-1942): "If the mikveh can make a non-Jew into a Jew, imagine what it can do for a Jew!" Q&R about blessings and food. Q&R about non-Jews receiving blessing through Am Yisrael .

lessons.bodyText: Chayey Moharan - Rebbe Nachman's Arrival in Breslov - Weddings of His Daughters - Kabbalah of Wine - Shpoler Zeide - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 115. In 1812 Rebbe Nachman arrives in Breslov. 03:31 - Rebbe Nachman was not concerned about being driven out of Breslov, saying, "No matter where I go, I'll repair things." 04:22 - Rabbi Noson of Nemirov wrote Chayey Moharan and Rabbi Nachman Tcherin ז"ל organized it into its published format. 04:34 - Rav Nachman Tcherin quoted Rebbe Nachman as saying that "We conquered Breslov through clapping our hands and dancing." 05:31 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 10 - "V'Eleh HaMishpatim" , the teaching in which clapping hands and dancing is discussed. 06:07 - "Today we have established the name of the Breslov Chassidim." Rabbi Moshe Kramer: B'gematria Breslov is 294, and Nachman ben Feiga is also 294. 07:03 - PARAGRAPH 116. In 1803, Rebbe Nachman arranged the wedding in Medvedevka of his daughter, Sarah, with Rabbi Yitzchak Isaac of Dubravner ז"ל. 10:02 - After teaching Likutey Moharan 49 at the Third Meal on Shabbos , Rebbe Nachman danced in an especially inspiring way. His intention was to annul the decrees conscripting Jewish men into the Czar's army. 11:40 - The marriage of Rebbe Nachman's daughter, Miriam, in 1804. 13:47 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 22. 14:53 - Rebbe Nachman's mother had passed away the previous year but the Shabbos preceding the wedding, he invited the neshomos to the wedding through the traditional Breslov melody sung for blessing the new month. 17:15 - "A person who knows how to drink properly can bring about forgiveness for sins" ( Likutey Moharan 177). 17:30 - We bring in Shabbos and every holiday with a cup of wine. 20:30 - Q&R about drinking wine. Wine is begematria 70, parallel to the 70 root nations. The expansions of Hashem's Name AV and SaG contain, together, 7 yuds . Wine draws its power from the seven yuds , which also correspond to the brain. A person commits a sin when they become temporarily insane. So when wine is drunk properly it elevates a person's mind. 27:29 - A deeper understanding of the word kos - cup - id presented. Kos equals ELoKiM in gematria (86). The nekudos - vowelmarkings - under "ELoKiM" - under the aleph is chataf segel (five nekudos ) and two more nekudos in EloKiM total seven. Understanding why a kiddush cup is holy. A revi'is is at least 3.8 fluid ounces. 29:56 - A deeper perspective on the word yayin - wine. 32:00 - Q&R about yayin and kos . 33:22 - Mention of the kos of Rebbe Nachman. 34:06 - Q&R about slow nigunim - melodies. 35:51 - Q&R about nigun when learning gemara . 36:35 - Before his trip to Berdichev, Rebbe Nachman had a public debate against the yetzer hara (evil inclination). 38:53 - Rebbe Nachman's meeting with the Shpoler Zeide - Rabbi Yehuda Leib ben Baruch of Shpola (a town near Uman). Reference to Sipurey Masiyos , the story of The Spider and the Fly .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 66. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. The process of transforming potential into actuality. The two Yuds in the combined Names of Hashem A - D - N - Y and Y - K - V - K . 05:11 - Eleh toldos Noach, Noach Ish Tzaddik . "Noach" twice - upper and lower ruach . 09:03 - PARAGRAPH 1. Every person has a responsibility to perfect creation. 17:49 - Q&R about bris milah on the eighth day. 19:06 - PARAGRAPH 2. אֵ֣לֶּה תֽוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִ֣בָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם - "These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, on the day that Hashem the Master made earth and heaven" ( Bereishis 2:4). The essential realization of potential is in Torah knowledge. In a sense, the creation of the world actually began with Avraham Avinu , who introduced people to faith in Hashem. 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. The opening of the two yuds . Sin creates a separation between Hashem and the person who's rebelling against Him. וְהַֽחַיּ֖וֹת רָצ֣וֹא וָשׁ֑וֹב - "And the living beings would run and return ..." ( Yechezkel 1:14). *42:00 - A person needs help from Above in order to repair damage they've done. Analogy of a person falling into a ditch. 41:41 - Teshuvah (return to Hashem) is above Torah. The greater the sinner, the greater the tzaddik needed to complete the spiritual repair. Reference to Likutey Moharan 44:23 - Introduction to the concept of "pi shenayim" - the double portion received by a student when his teacher rises to a new level. 46:04 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Tammuz - Strengthening Memory and Vision - Bnei Yissachar - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Recorded at the Shaarei Chesed Breslov Shul, Yerushalayim, Sivan 5775 (June 2015). Deeper meaning of the word "Tammuz" - the breaking of the Luchos (two tablets engraved with the Ten Commandments) resulted in spiritual forgetfulness. This can be repaired best through strengthening memory and vision during the months of Tammuz and Av . Introduction to the Bnei Yissa'char - a Sefer about the hidden Torah aspects of the Hebrew calendar, written by Rabbi Tzvi Elimelech of Dinov (1783-1841). *The Tziruf (kabbalistic format) of the Shem HaEtzem (Name of HaShem Y - H - V - H ) differs for each of the 12 months of the year. In Tammuz , the order of the letters is backwards, indicating a time of strict judgement. End of clip about the Tziruf of Tammuz . The return of Am Yisrael to Eretz Yisrael during the time of Ezra HaSofer . The 12 months of the lunar year correspond to the 12 tribes. Tammuz and Av correspond to Reuven and Shimon . *The Arizal : the 12 months of the lunar calendar correspond to the 12 parts of the head. The two eyes correspond to Tammuz and Av . * Tu B'Av . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 66. M'koach el hapo'el - thought into action, potential into actual. Pi Shneyim - double spiritual portion. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 6. During Sefiras HaOmer , by counting each day we complete the process of creation, bringing thought into acti
lessons.bodyText: This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 66. M'koach el hapo'el - thought into action, potential into actual. Pi Shneyim - double spiritual portion. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 6. During Sefiras HaOmer , by counting each day we complete the process of creation, bringing thought into action. During each of the seven days of creation, Hashem brought forth a unique element. These seven days correspond to the Omer period. In the Pri Eitz Chayim by the Arizal there's a chart that explains the kavana for each day of Sefiras HaOmer based on this principle. 03:13 - Three groups operating during service in the Beis HaMikdash - Kohanim, Leviim, Yisraelim . The representatives from Yisrael would read the portion of the Torah about what was brought from Hashem's "thought" into actuality during each of the seven days of creation. By studying Torah each day, a Jew completes the process of the creation. "All creation depends on the sixth day of Sivan" when Hashem gave the Torah to Bnei Yisrael . 09:28 - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai brings that three things are acquired through difficulties: Eretz Yisrael , Torah, and Olam Habah ( Brachos 5a). אַחַ֚ת שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־יְהֹוָה֘ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵֽית־יְ֖הֹוָה כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י - "One I ask of Hashem, this is what I seek: that I may dwell in the house of Hashem all the days of my life" ( Tehillim 27:4) - "Achas" is made up of the roshei teyvos (initial letters) of these three items, since all three are aspects of Beis Hashem . 11:29 - PARAGRAPH 7. Tevilas Keylim - immersing cooking utensils in a mikveh . Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 where Rebbe Nachman explains how this relates to the concept of m'koach el hapo'el . 28 letters in the first possuk of the Torah correspond to twice yad - hand (14). 14:52 - The two yuds in Y-K-V-K and A-D-N-Y correspond to the two hands. 16:35 - To "...dwell in the house of Hashem" is to draw physical life via holiness, which is accomplished through Torah and mitzvos . 18:18 - Binding the upper and lower levels of holiness creates pi shneyim . This occurs whenever a tzaddik rises to a new level. 20:28 - Opening the "two Yuds " of Y-K-V-K and A-D-N-Y correspond to the two hands. פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן - "You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing its desire" ( Tehillim 145:16). 22:44 - The process of "thought into action" applies to the physical world as well as the spiritual. 26:27 - The four worlds correspond to the four levels of creation. For example, the spiritual/thought energy of plants is considered physical/action in relation to the spiritual/thought energy of animals. 28:56 - The tzaddik is constantly rising from level to level. Every time the upper level connects with the lower level, there's a double portion of spiritual light. 30:02 - When a tzaddik progresses, this synapse occurs every time he rises to a new level, and at that moment, his students can receive a portion of this light. The pi shneyim is most powerful at the moment of the tzaddik's passing from this world. 31:03 - Even when a person passes away, a slight bit of spiritual energy remains in the bones. 34:50 - The punishment of koreys is a disconnection from the soul's Source. 37:43 - A tzaddik is helping to repair the souls of Israel even after his passing. 38:26 - Q&R about the punishment of koreys . 38:57 - A person can receive from the pi shneyim of a tzaddik by visiting his gravesite and praying to Hashem there. *42:50 - In these generations, a person can obtain some types of tikkun - spiritual repair - only from tzaddikim of previous generations, more so than from those of his contemporary generation. 44:01 - Every time a person visits the gravesite of a tzaddik , a new aspect of that person's soul can be corrected/purified. יֵֽלְכוּ מֵחַ֣יִל אֶל־חָ֑יִל יֵֽרָאֶ֖ה אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּצִיּֽוֹן - "They go from strength to strength; he will appear to Hashem in Zion" ( Tehillim 84:8). 49:21 - Q&R about visiting kivrei tzaddikim . Reference to Parshas Korach . 53:08 - The customs of Reb Michel Dorfman ז"ל and Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל at kever Yochanan ben Zakkai and other kivrei tzaddikim in Eretz Yisrael . Rebbe Nachman used to go to the kever of Reb Yishaya m'Yanov ז"ל if he couldn't get to the kever of the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh and asked him to be a shaliach to the Baal Shem Tov . 55:37 - Q&R about visiting kivrei tzaddikim . Story of a rebbe and talmud heard from Reb Michel Dorfman ז"ל: when a student began giving gifts to his rebbe's teacher (bypassing his own rebbe) Hashem's judgement was brought against the student.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon, Sara Wurtzel
lessons.description: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 66. 00:00 - לֹא־תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל־בֵּ֜יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים - "She doesn't fear for her household for snow, since all her household are dressed in crimson" ( Mishlei /Proverbs 31:21). The greater a person's need for spiritual
lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 66. 00:00 - לֹא־תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל־בֵּ֜יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים - "She doesn't fear for her household for snow, since all her household are dressed in crimson" ( Mishlei /Proverbs 31:21). The greater a person's need for spiritual repair, the greater the tzaddik needed to facilitate this. Reference to Likutey Moharan 30. 04:41 - מֵרָח֕וֹק יְהֹוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֣ה לִ֑י - "From afar Hashem appeared to me..." ( Yirmiyahu 31:2). 06:35 - Devorah HaNeviyah brought Bnei Yisrael to teshuvah - return to Hashem. This required the element of pi sheneyim , as hinted in Shiras Devorah : אָֽנֹכִ֗י לַֽיהֹוָה֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָשִׁ֔ירָה - "I, to the Lord I shall sing" ( Shoftim 5:3). 07:47 - Eliyahu HaNavi also led Am Yisrael to teshuvah , through the pi sheneyim of Hashem Hu HaElokim, Hashem Hu HaElokim . 08:39 - כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּי־אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְאֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְעָזֽוּב - "...when He sees that the power is increasing, and none is controlled or strengthened" ( Devarim 32:36 - Parshas HaAzinu ). 09:00 - Posukim throughout the Torah that refer to pi shneyim . 10:57 - Lechem mishneh on Shavuos and Shabbos . The name Yosef is twice lechem . 15:00 - The essence of pi shneyim is received by the tzaddik himself, which he shares with his students. 16:33 - Q&R about application of this teaching. 17:07 - NOTE on אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖יךָ לְמַֽעֲנִ֑י וְחַטֹּאתֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר - "I I erase your transgressions for My sske, and your sins I will not remember" ( Yeshayahu 43:25). Nokhach (present) and nistar (hidden). Keser is called nistar . The light needed to remove sins has to be drawn from the hidden, more elevated light. Titaharu is b'gamtria keser . 20:09 - "She is more precious than pearls" - the kohen gadol and the tzaddik emes are compared to pearls. 20:45 - Q&R about ani , anochi , hu in Hebrew. In kabbalah, we refer to lower levels in first person, while we refer to higher levels in second person, to indicate the distance. Hu refers to keser . 22:13 - Heard from Rababi Rosenfeld ז"ל - " children, life, and livelihood are not received because of merit, but because of mazal - fortune." But what about the concept that ain mazal b'Yisrael ? The term mazal is a "code word" for the keser . The rachamim of Zer Anpin is lower than the rachaamim of Keser . Mazla is 3 times Y-K-V-K, which indicates that it refers to the third, highest grouping of the sefiros . 24:05 - PARAGRAPH 9. The additional sacrifice of mussaf on Shabbos , Rosh Chodesh , and Yom Tov . Reading Mikra Once and Targum twice on Erev Shabbos is another aspect of pi shneyim . 28:51 - Q&R about teshuvah on teshuvah . It's possible that his relates to pi sheneyim , as might the concept that if Am Yisrael keeps two Shabbasim , Moshiach will arrive. 29:14 - PARAGRAPH 10. הֹוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֘ יָרֵאתִי֒ יְהֹוָ֗ה פָּֽעָלְךָ֙ בְּקֶ֚רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּרֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר - "Hashem, I heard a report of You; I feared, Hashem, Your deed. In the midst of the years, revive it; in the midst of the years, let it be known. In anger You shall remember to have mercy " ( Chavakuk 3:2). "Don't read "years" - read "twice" ( Sotah 49). 33:06 - NOTE - the word Chayim contains two Yuds . Tefilah is called pi sheneyim . 36:48 - This possuk refers to the concept of pi she neyim , and it's through eliminating the subduing the ruach - spirit - of Hashem's fire into the gentle ruach of Moshiach . When this is done, it's possible to bring thought into action, potential into actuality, thus fulfilling the purpose of creation. 39:03 - Q&R about how a person can access pi shneyim . Torah, performing mitzvos, tefilah , tikkun habris , and observing Shabbos are all aspects of pi sheneyim . 42:23 - What is bracha ? The Vilna Gaon points out: Beis is 2, Reish is 2 (200), Chaf is 2 (20). 42:50 - PARAGRAPH 11. The 13 midos shel rachamim - attributes of kindness. Rabbi Rosenfeld ז"ל went through the different opinions of chazal about what, exactly, these midos are. He concluded with the opinion of the Zohar HaKodesh : א-ל / Hashem — mighty in compassion to give all creatures according to their need; רַחוּם / rachum — merciful, that humankind may not be distressed; וְחַנּוּן / ve’chanun — and gracious if humankind is already in distress; אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם / erech apayim — slow to anger; (once, to the righteous) אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם / erech apayim — slow to anger; (repeated again for the wicked) וְרַב-חֶסֶד / ve’rav chesed — and plenteous in kindness; וֶאֱמֶת / ve’emes — and truth; נֹצֵר חֶסֶד / notzer chesed — keeping kindness לָאֲלָפִים / la'alafim — unto thousands; נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן / noseh avon — forgiving iniquity; וָפֶשַׁע / vafeshah — and transgression; וְחַטָּאָה / vechata'ah — and sin; וְנַקֵּה / venakeh — and pardoning. 46:43 - Closing blessings. 47:17 - Q&R - Being present for a Torah shiur is also an opportunity for a person to receive pi shneyim .

Water represents the potential for creation. 25:36 - The source of holiness is bringing potential into actual, which is an aspect of mikveh mayim - purifying waters. The Ruach of Moshiach is a combination of all the spiritual aspects of creation. 30:17 - וְזָֽרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכָּל־גִּלּֽוּלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם - "And I will sprinkle pure water upon you, and you will be clean; from all your impurities and from all your abominations will I cleanse you" ( Yechezkel /Ezekiel 36:25). 32:47 - Q&R - Renewing one's faith in the effectiveness of mikveh can be done through Torah and tefilah . Analogy of a car mechanic who repairs a car but the owner looks at the car and doesn't see a change. Story of the Bas Ayin zal when he first arrived in Eretz Yisrael . 37:50 - Q&R about a woman not being required to go to the mikveh after a certain age. The dangers of dismantling gender. 41:26 - PARAGRAPH 13. Immersing cooking vessels in a mikveh .

lessons.bodyText: Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. Text: Sotah 2a. 00:00 - Hashem as Matchmaker. When the Yam Suf was split, all the waters of earth were split from one into two. Creating a zivug - husband and wife - is as difficult as splitting Yam Suf . 06:52 - A husband and wife were originally one soul. Marriage unifies the soul because it was divided into two before birth. 07:51 - A man is given a wife who matches his spiritual level ( Sotah 2a) yet 40 days before the forming of a male child, his zivug is announced in Heaven. How is this seeming contradiction resolved in a way that recognizes free will? 11:28 - Another question arises concerning this announcement at the moment of his conception. Before a man marries he should have a home and a livelihood. 13:06 - The most important day in a man's life is the day of his marriage, because that's when he becomes a complete person. On his wedding day, a chatan (groom) receives a complete pardon for all the sins of his lifetime until then. The entire shiur is HERE .
