Ratzon (Yearning) Creates Yirah (Respect for Hashem) Through Observing the Holidays; Length of Days via Tzedakah (Charity); Two Aspects of Wine; Two Kinds of Yirah ; The Purpose of Suffering; Joy. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 .
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Kley HaYayin 1. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Ratzon (Yearning) Creates Yirah (Respect for Hashem) Through Observing the Holidays; Length of Days via Tzedakah (Charity); Two Aspects of Wine; Two Kinds of Yirah ; The Purpose of Suffering; Joy. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַייָ בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם, מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ - " On the day of the first fruits, when you offer up a new meal offering to the Lord, on your festival of Weeks; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall not perform any mundane work " ( Bamidbar 28:26). 01:10 - INTRODUCTION. Brief overview of 2Likutey Moharan 4 . רצון - desire and yearning for Hashem - creates יראה - respect for Hashem. The most opportune time for this process is during Pesach, Shavuos and Sukkos , when we celebrate Hashem’s miracles as expressions of His ratzon - favor towards Am Yisrael . 05:30 - Tzaddikim counteract the false thinking of "wild animals" - scientists and philosophers who explain miracles as "natural" in denial of Hashem. 08:28 - Metzach HaNachash - "Brow of the Serpent". Each day a person lives he needs to increase holiness and דעת - awareness of Hashem. If not, he gives life-energy to negative forces. 10:05 - Hashem equates "light" with "day", as in וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים | לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם - "And Hashem called the light 'day' " ( Bereishis 1:5). If a person doesn't increase holiness and דעת each day, he's in danger of falling into bitterness as he ages, Heaven forbid. 11:06 - Through the mitzvah of tzedakah the despair of "fallen days" is transformed into "new light" and "length of days". שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ - "Cast your bread upon the surface of the water , for after many days you will find it" ( Koheles 11:1). 13:48 - When there is a revelation of Hashem's light, יראה - respect for Him increases. יראה is an aspect of constriction and creates a vessel or conduit, as in וּמְחֹקֵ֖ק מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלָ֑יו - "...and the staff from between his feet..." ( Bereishis 49:10, Vayechi ). The revelation of Moshiach is the revelation of Hashem's ratzon. 17:03 - Q&R about the dynamic between Jews and non-Jews when Moshiach is revealed. 17:32 - PARAGRAPH 1. The Torah prohibits a Jew from drinking wine made or stored by a person who worships idols. Wine is an aspect of gevurah , as inה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִשְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְאַנְשֵׁי־חַ֖יִל לִמְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר - "Woe to the mighty to drink wine and men of strength to mix strong wine" ( Yeshayahu 5:22). Wine has two aspects, negative and positive. 19:46 - Faith in Hashem creates a vessel to benefit from the positive aspect of wine. 21:50 - Wine is associated with יראה and דין. A person who has strong faith in Hashem has joy no matter what. **23:28 - יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֖י לֹ֥א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם - "Hashem is for me, I will not fear. What can man do to me?" ( Tehillim 118:6). Even if at times a person suffers, he can still be b'simcha - joyful. Since illness and other difficulties purify the soul, they express Hashem's kindness, as in טֽוֹב־יְהֹוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֜רַֽחֲמָ֗יו עַל־כָּל־מַֽעֲשָֽׂיו - "Hashem is good to all, and His mercies are upon all His creatures" ( Tehillim 145:9). 27:07 - Suffering has its limits, as Hashem assures in כִּ֣י לֹ֚א לְעוֹלָם֙ אָרִ֔יב - "For I will not contend forever..." ( Yeshayahu 57:16). 30:13 - How fortunate the life of a person who has emunah because he knows that everything is from Hashem. עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֜גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה - "Serve Hashem with fear, and rejoice with trembling" ( Tehillim 2:11). 32:28 - The story of Rabbi Akiva when he was once traveling and had to sleep in forest outside a city because no one gave him shelter. He saw everything as a benefit from Hashem even when his lantern went out and his animals were killed. In the morning he discovered that all in the city had been murdered, so each "misfortune" had actually saved his life ( Berakhos 60b). 33:24 - יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֖דִּיק כִּֽי־חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם פְּעָמָ֥יו יִ֜רְחַ֗ץ בְּדַ֣ם הָרָשָֽׁע - "The righteous man will rejoice because he saw revenge; he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked" ( Tehillim 58:11). 35:25 - In Mispar Katan (a type of gematria ) the Name of Hashem Y-H-V-H is 17 - טוב - good. ( Yud is one, Hey is five, Vuv is six, and Hey is five.) 36:00 - The solution to suffering is אמונה - faith in Hashem. Connection to the teachings and ways of tzaddikim strengthens emunah . 37:21 - Q&R about free will. It's beyond our understanding that even though Hashem allows people to do whatever they want, He "always comes out on top", as in וְאַתָּ֥ה מָ֜ר֗וֹם לְעֹ֘לָ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה - "But You remain on high forever, Hashem" ( Tehillim 92:9). 41:51 - Q&R about fear and suffering. The distinction between emunah - faith - and bitachon - trust. *43:22 - Q&R about Yaakov Avinu's confrontation with Esav increasing Yaakov's fear of Hashem. 44:08 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 60 - there are two kinds of yirah , one positive and negative. The positive aspect is expressed in יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֖הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים - "Fear of Hashem increases days" ( Mishlei 10:27). Similarly, there two aspects of fire: at Har Sinai during Matan Torah, fire brought dread. However, the flames of the Chanukah lights bring life. Yirah, emunah, and simcha are constantly changing in a person. These elements are dynamic, moment to moment. 46:36 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 48:18 - NOTE about the flood negative fears in the world today. Only someone with emunah experiences true happiness in life. 49:32 - Closing blessing.

Hilkhos Kley HaYayin 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Kley HaYayin 1 - Para. 2. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Two Aspects of Wine; Length of Days; Kiddush on Shabbos and Yom Tov ; Kos Shel Bracha ; Eretz Yisrael ; Erev Rosh Chodesh Elul . Hilkhos Kley HaYayin 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַייָ בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם, מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ - " On the day of the first fruits, when you offer up a new meal offering to the Lord, on your festival of Weeks; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall not perform any mundane work " ( Bamidbar 28:26). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Wine has both positive and negative aspects. When a person has complete אמונה - faith in Hashem - then his יראה - fear of Hashem - generates שמחה - joy. 02:20 - יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֖הוָה תּוֹסִ֣יף יָמִ֑ים - "Fear of Hashem adds length to life" ( Mishlei 10:27). אריכות ימים - "Length of Days" - is the capacity for generating more holiness. 04:00 - רצון - will - generates יראה - respect for Hashem. Miracles reveal that nature is controlled by Hashem. When people witness these miracles, their respect for Hashem increases. 05:16 - The reverse is also true: the more a person respects Hashem, the more Hashem reveals Himself to that person through miracles. וַיִּירָ֧א יַֽעֲקֹ֛ב מְאֹ֖ד וַיֵּ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ - "...Yaakov became very afraid and was distressed" ( Bereishis 32:8). 07:55 - יראה results in שמחה - joy. *08:40 - Suffering brings a person fear of Hashem's punishment, which eventually helps that person to achieve true joy in life. *12:35 - Even if a person doesn't fully perfect יראה after going through difficulty or suffering, he receives great benefit from simply maintaining faith in Hashem. 13:53 - The Zohar HaKadosh explains how שמחה is encoded in the Shema . When a person has אמונה and יראה, he can experience true שמחה - joy. 14:57 - When a non-Jew touches wine or its container, that wine becomes contaminated by the false beliefs of the 70 nations. Even if the non-Jew doesn't actually worship idols, his thoughts are still rooted in denial of Hashem and transfer spiritual impurity to the wine. 18:05 - Drunkenness is also the result of going through suffering without אמונה. Pain can cause a person to lose his mind. Someone who lacks faith becomes confused and is plagued by unhealthy fears. Living in denial of Hashem is a form of being drunk, as in וּשְׁכֻרַ֖ת וְלֹ֥א מִיָּֽיִן - "...drunk but not from wine" ( Yeshayahu 51:21). 21:53 - Q&R about drunkenness caused by suffering. 22:27 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why Yosef HaTzaddik sent to Yaakov Avinu יין ישן שדעת זקנים - "wine that's aged as the wisdom of elders" . The concept of Zikeinim D'Kedusha - people who, like fine wine, improve as they age ( Megillah 16b). 24:20 - PARAGRAPH 4. On Shabbos and Yom Tov , the revelations of Hashem's רצון make it possible to receive the positive aspects of wine. *27:29 - PARAGRAPH 5. The vessels used for containing kosher wine need to be supervised.The Torah doesn't speak of "wine of blessing" but rather "cup of blessing" - meaning that there's blessing in wine only when it's contained by a proper vessel. כוס - cup - is b'gematria 86 - Elokim . It is also b'gematria HaTeva - nature. This illustrates the two opposing aspects of wine: faith in Hashem vs faith in nature. 30:15 - Nature serves to "hide" Hashem, allowing man free will. When Hashem wants to demonstrate that He controls nature, He performs miracles such as the ones we celebrate on the holidays. 32:42 - NOTE: Whenever Erev Rosh Chodesh comes out on Erev Shabbos , the tefilos of Yom Kippur Katan are said on Thursday rather than on Friday. 33:22 - What perfects any vessel is אמונה. The holiness of Shabbos and Yom Tov is drawn to a person through reciting Kiddush on a cup of wine. Introduction to the concept of Kos Shel Bracha . 35:38 - PARAGRAPH 6. Kos Shel Bracha - Kos Shel Birkhas HaMazon - the cup of wine held during the blessings said after a meal with bread. וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ - "And you will eat and be satisfied, and you shall bless Hashem for the good Land He has given you" ( Devarim 8:10, Ekev ). Reference to Likutey Moharan 7 : Eretz Yisrael is the Land of Miracles. 39:00 - All ten levels of holiness in the entire world are found in Eretz Yisrael . What is kedushah - holiness? Belief in the רצון of Hashem. 40:31 - כִּֽי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֖בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ - "For Your servants desired its stones and cherished its dust" ( Tehillim 102:15). Ehven Shesiya - Foundation Stone - represents the highest level of Hashem's רצון. 42:27 - It is a Torah obligation for men to visit the Beis HaMikdash three times a year on each of the three major holidays. שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים | בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵֽרָאֶה֩ כָל־זְכ֨וּרְךָ֜ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ - "Three times in the year each of your males shall appear before Hashem, Your Master" ( Devarim 16:16, ReEh ). The רצון of Hashem is revealed on these occasions through "seeing" the "Face of Hashem" (so to speak) and to be "seen" by Hashem. 43:52 - Q&R about drinking wine. The stronger a person's spiritual level, the greater his ability to have mastery over wine's positive aspects. Guidelines for drinking on Purim. *46:48 - NOTE about Erev Rosh Chodesh Elul : Even those who don't usually say the Tefilos of Yom Kippur Katan during the rest of the year usually do say them in honor of Rosh Chodesh Elul . 47:04 - Closing blessing.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Kley HaYayin 1 - Para. 7. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Kos Shel Bracha - Tzedakah - Charity for Shabbos and Charity for Yom Tov - Tov Ayin - A Good Eye - Chidush for VaYechi - Reiva deReiven . This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה ח
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Kley HaYayin 1 - Para. 7. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Kos Shel Bracha - Tzedakah - Charity for Shabbos and Charity for Yom Tov - Tov Ayin - A Good Eye - Chidush for VaYechi - Reiva deReiven . This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַייָ בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם, מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ - " On the day of the first fruits, when you offer up a new meal offering to the Lord, on your festival of Weeks; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall not perform any mundane work " ( Bamidbar 28:26). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The Kos Shel Bracha is similar in concept to the concept of tzedakah - charity. Both reveals a quality called רצון - which means Hashem's will or appeasement, and can also refer to a person's good will, yearning, desire, or inclination. טֽוֹב־עַ֖יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל - " He who has a good will be blessed, for he gave of his bread to the poor " ( Mishlei 22:9). 02:34 - The Zohar HaKodesh describes an encounter between the students of Rabbi Shimon and a yanuka - a child born with complete memory of the Torah he learned in a previous גלגול - reincarnation. When his mother told her son to greet the great rabbis, the child replied, "What great rabbis? They didn't even say Kriyas Shema today." How did this child know? After their seudah there was an exchange between the yanuka and the visiting rabonim about the Kos Shel Bracha . 05:44 - Kos Shel Bracha and טוב עין. Tzedakah is usually given in honor of a meal to celebrate an occasion of simcha . The story of how Rabbi Akiva's daughter gave her meal to a poor person on her wedding day and how this act saved her from a deadly snake. 08:17 - Tzedakah on Shabbos . *09:13 - Fulfillment of the mitzvah to rejoice on a Yom Tov includes providing charity for those in need. וְשָֽׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִפְנֵ֣י | יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבִתֶּ֘ךָ֘ וְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וַֽאֲמָתֶ֒ךָ֒ וְהַלֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ וְהַגֵּ֛ר וְהַיָּת֥וֹם וְהָֽאַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ בַּמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖וֹ שָֽׁם - "And you shall rejoice before Hashem – you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite who is within your cities, and the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow, who are among you – in the place which Hashem will choose to establish His Name" ( Devarim 16:11). Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 12:22 - שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ – “Cast your bread upon the surface of the water , for after many days you will find it” ( Koheles 11:1). *14:43 - Charity for Yom Tov . It is a custom to increase tzedakah in honor of the holidays. It's impossible to experience the joy of Yom Tov without giving צדקה. Giving charity to a "fitting recipient" elevates the donor to the spiritual level of "a good eye". צדקה in honor of Yom Tov reveals Hashem's רצון - good will - in the world. 15:47 - Q&R can tzedakah be given on Shabbos and Yom Tov , or only before? Making a monetary pledge for charity on Shabbos and Yom Tov . Buying an aliya . 17:40 - Q&R - Who is a "fitting recipient" for charity? Helping a person to be able to earn a living. The tzaddik as "fitting recipient". 19:31 - Kos Shel Birkas HaMazon . At every meal it's good to give charity. טֽוֹב־עַ֖יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ - "He who has a good will be blessed" . 22:31 - The mitzvah to protect wine. 23:40 - Respect for consequences and fear of punishment is crucial for any person – Jew or non-Jew – to succeed in life. 24:53 - People who deny Hashem are filled with destructive fear. Wine stored in the vessel of a non-Jew becomes forbidden because it's spiritually contaminated. Drinking it harms the mind by introducing denial of Hashem and is considered an aspect of idol worship. 27:55 - הִ֜שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה - "...You have given us to drink wine of bewilderment" ( Tehillim 60:5). תרעלה - the term for "bewilderment" in this phrase - means "blocked" ( Rashi ). 29:35 - כִּ֚י כ֪וֹס בְּיַד־יְהֹוָ֡ה וְיַ֚יִן חָמַ֨ר | מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֘ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֖מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֜֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ - "For a cup is in the hand of Hashem, and strong wine, a full mixture, and He pours out of this , but all the wicked of the earth will drain and drink " ( Tehillim 75:9). *30:54 - In the time of Moshiach , wine from the six days of creation will be given to those who maintained faith in Hashem even during the suffering of exile. Because they used their difficulties and pain to bring them closer to Hashem, they will be receive a wine of complete joy ( Berakhos 34). 34:40 - Moshe Rabbeinu passed away during the hours of the fullest revelation of Hashem: ברעוא דרעוין - on Shabbos in the late afternoon. 36:50 - Q&R about drinking wine. NOTE about invitation to R' Maimon to take part in a podcast about Uman Rosh Hashanah. *39:46 - NOTE - Tov Ayin - a good eye - chidush for Parshas VaYechi . When Esav came to meet Yaakov , he brought and army of 400 men. 400 is b'gematria רע עין - "evil eye" - jealousy. Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל shows how Yaakov Avinu is just the opposite because he has an - עין טוב - "good eye". Parshas VaYechi begins וַיְחִ֤י יַֽעֲקֹב֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י יְמֵי־יַֽעֲקֹב֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיָּ֔יו שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה - " (Bereishis 47:28, VaYechi). His entire life span was 147 years. The 17 years after he knew that his son Yosef was alive he considered טוב - good. The remaining years, 130, have the gematria of עין - eye.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Kley HaYayin 1 - Kedoshim - VaEschanan - VeZos HaBerakha - Chanukah - Oil and Joy - 13 Midos Shel Rachamim - Cup of Wine at Bris Milah - Ratzon HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Kley HaYayin 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַייָ בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם, מ
lessons.bodyText: Kley HaYayin 1 - Kedoshim - VaEschanan - VeZos HaBerakha - Chanukah - Oil and Joy - 13 Midos Shel Rachamim - Cup of Wine at Bris Milah - Ratzon HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Kley HaYayin 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . וּבְיוֹם הַבִּכּוּרִים, בְּהַקְרִיבְכֶם מִנְחָה חֲדָשָׁה לַייָ בְּשָׁבֻעֹתֵיכֶם, מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ יִהְיֶה לָכֶם כָּל מְלֶאכֶת עֲבֹדָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ - "On the day of the first fruits, when you offer up a new meal offering to HaShem, on your festival of Weeks; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall not perform any mundane work" ( Bamidbar 28:26, Pinchas). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Chanukah and the spiritual aspect of oil. 03:00 - Parshas VeZos HaBerakha . Oil is associated with רצון, as in Moshe Rabbeinu's blessing to the tribe of Asher : וּלְאָשֵׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ מִבָּנִ֖ים אָשֵׁ֑ר יְהִ֤י רְצוּי֙ אֶחָ֔יו וְטֹבֵ֥ל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן רַגְלֽוֹ - "And of Asher he said: 'May Asher be blessed with sons. He will be pleasing to his brothers, and immerse his foot in oil'" ( Devarim 33:44, VeZos HaBerakha ). The source of HaShem's רצון is called Metzach HaRatzon - the "Countenance of Favor" . 05:34 - Spiritual significance of the beard of Aharon HaKohen . 06:04 - How family relationships correspond to the order of the sefiros . 07:13 - The correspondence between the oil of the Chanukah lights and concepts of Metzach HaRatzon and יראה - fear/respect. 08:07 - כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹֽכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא - "For HaShem is a consuming fire..." ( Devarim 4:24, VaEschanan ). יראה is associated with fire. 09:07 - ***The oil for the Chanukah lights is רצון, and the fire with which we kindle the flames is יראה. Respect for HaShem is a vessel in which we can receive His kindness. 10:52 - On Chanukah we increase tzedakah - charity. 13:27 - Oil indicates happiness. וְיַ֚יִן | יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְבַב־אֱנ֗וֹשׁ לְהַצְהִ֣יל פָּנִ֣ים מִשָּׁ֑מֶן - "And wine, which cheers man's heart, to make the face shine from oil" ( Tehillim 104:15). Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 3, Hilkhos Chanukah . * 15:00 - Reference to the Pri Etz Chaim where the Arizal describes how the 13 Midos Shel Rachamim correspond to the eight days of Chanukah . Yaakov is an aspect of 7 and Yosef HaTzaddik is an aspect of 6. 17:19 - Q&R about saying the word אמת eight times after Kriyas Shema in Shacharis . שְׁלַח־אֽוֹרְךָ֣ וַֽ֖אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי - "Send Your light and Your truth, that they may lead me" ( Tehillim 43:3). 18:23 - PARAGRAPH 9. The spiritual process of Bris Milah . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 20:06 - וּמִצְחַ֥ת נְח֖שֶׁת עַל־רַגְלָ֑יו - "And copper armor covered his legs" (1 Shmuel 17:6). Golias attacked the faith of Am Yisrael every morning and every evening at the time of reciting Kriyas Shema . מצח refers to the Metzach HaNachash of evil which opposes the Metzach HaRatzon of Hashem . 22:05 - Parshas Kedoshim. מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָֽדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּֽאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ - "You shall stand up for an elder and respect the venerable face, by which you shall fear your HaShem" ( Vayikra 19:32, Kedoshim ). The beard contains 13 spiritual elements that beautify the face. 23:17 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 24:06 - The word Bereishis is a combination of the words Bris and Aish . Yosef HaTzaddik and the concept of Tikkun HaBris . The mitzvah of Bris Milah was accepted by Klal Yisrael with שמחה - joy. 26:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 27 which explains the connection between emunah and bris . 30:00 - How the process of Bris Milah removes false concepts that cover up the Light of Hashem. Every Bris Milah is a revelation of the fact that everything in the world is רצון of HaShem . 31:27 - There are different categories of evil; only klipas nogah can be transformed to good. 32:50 - Q&R about the relationship between יראה - fear - and אהבה - love. 34:10 - PARAGRAPH 10. The cup of wine at Bris Milah when the name of the child is announced. The root of the word milah is מל which is 70, as is יין. The Seventy Faces of the Torah oppose the false beliefs of the Seventy Nations. 38:00 Encouragement about the difficulty of this halakha . Location of other halakhos related to Kley HaYayin . 39:12 - NOTE about the 30,000 Jewish martyrs who were massacred in Uman because they refused to bow down to a cross. 41:25 - Closing blessing - Elul is begematria Binah . 40 days to Yom Kippur .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Text: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum 3, Para. 7-9. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Shoftim - Beis HaMikdash - Ultimate Source for Emunas Chochomim - Faith in Rabbis. Why the Beis HaMikdash is in Nachalas Binyomin ; Har Moriah ; The Spiritual Aspects of Shoes. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 57 . 00:00 - PAR
lessons.bodyText: Text: Likutey Halakhos, Even HaEzer, Yibum 3, Para. 7-9. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Shoftim - Beis HaMikdash - Ultimate Source for Emunas Chochomim - Faith in Rabbis. Why the Beis HaMikdash is in Nachalas Binyomin ; Har Moriah ; The Spiritual Aspects of Shoes. This halakha is based on Likutey Moharan 57 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7b. The Beis HaMikdash draws its power from the vows of Am Yisrael . This is the source from which emunas chochomim also emanates. 04:05 - Why the Beis HaMikdash is located in the nachalah (region) of Binyomin . *05:35 - Parshas Shoftim. Why the Beis HaMikdash is called "Har Moriah" ( Taanis 16). 06:38 - לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן־הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־יַגִּ֥ידוּ לְךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל - "You shall not divert from the word they tell you, either right or left..." ( Devarim 17:11, Shoftim ). 09:13 - The Beis HaMikdash was established through the vow of Dovid HaMelech , as in אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֜דַ֗ר לַֽאֲבִ֥יר יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "That he swore to Hashem, he vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob..." עַד־אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֖קוֹם לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה מִ֜שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַֽאֲבִ֥יר יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "...until I find a place for the Lord, dwellings for the Mighty One of Jacob..." ( Tehillim 132:2-5). 13:30 - Why Binyomin was named by both Rochel and Yaakov . 14:55 - PARAGRAPH 8. The mitzvah of yibum and the spiritual aspects of shoes. 16:49 - Shoes refer to a wife ( Tikkunei Zohar ). 17:36 - Women were given nine measures of the ten measures of speech in the world. 20:03 - Shoes originate from vows. 28:00 - Binah as an aspect of the legs ( Shir HaShirim ). 30:25 - Chidush of the SheLaH HaKadosh heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל: "Mi pi gevurah" is the same gematria as Moshe Rabbeinu . The importance of emunas chochomim (faith in Rabbis). 35:29 - The morning blessing she asa li kol tzorchi - on "everything I need" - refers specifically to shoes because they include all needs. *40:18 - Biographical note from Reb Yechiel Michel Dorfman ז"ל about the Chozeh m'Lublin ז"ל in response to a student who felt he couldn't honestly say the blessing "Who takes care of all my needs." 47:43 - The importance of wearing shoes. 48:18 - Reference to Shabbos 129: why the sages of the gemara advise "Sell everything you own to buy shoes". 56:39 - PARAGRAPH 9. The spiritual aspects of not wearing shoes on Yom Kippur .

lessons.bodyText: Avodas Elilim Akum 1 - Nitzavim - Mesiras Nefesh - Self Sacrifice - Tefilah biVechinas Din - Yonah HaNavi - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Avodas Elilim Akum 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - Shiur given on 2022-08-28. HALAKHA 1 - INTRODUCTION. 01:48 - PARAGRAPH 1. There are only three mitzvos for which a Jew gives his life rather than transgress. 04:03 - תפילה בבחינת דין - Tefilah biVechinas Din - "Judgment-Prayer". 05:09 - Pinchas is eight times HaShem 's Name Y - K - V - K corresponding to Binah - the origin of all din - constriction, judgment. 07:27 - Shiur given on 2 Elul 5782. Dedications. L'Ilui nishmas Dishleh bas Reb Yechiel Michel HaLevi a"h . 08:34 - PARAGRAPH 2. The Torah was given to promote life. 09:40 - כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֨יךָ֙ וְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔יךָ - "...for He is your life and the lengthening of your days..." ( Devarim 30:20, Nitzavim ). 11:52 - The Aramaic expression for תפילה - prayer - is רחמי - kindness, mercy. 13:05 - אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֜הֹוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא - "To You, HaShem, I will lift up my soul" ( Tehillim 25:1). *13:57 - כִּֽי־ עָ֖לֶיךָ הֹרַ֣גְנוּ כָל־הַיּ֑וֹם - "Because it is for Your sake that we are killed every day..." ( Tehillim 44:23). Reference to Likutey Moharan 80 . *14:21 - Every mitzvah is done with some degree of mesiras nefesh . 21:04 - Life is the connection between the soul and the body. Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 . 26:39 - HaShem wants us to live so we can continue serving Him. 28:20 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 6 - this teaching is known as "Sohd Kavanas Elul" . 35:24 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 36 . 38:47 - The three mitzvos for which a Jew gives his life rather than transgress. All three are aspects of teivos niuf - sins against the holiness of marriage. 39:17 - נאוף is b'gematria Satan . 41:56 - Parparaos L'Chakhmah on Yonah HaNavi as an example of tefilah bivechinas din . 50:19 - גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ - "... those mighty in strength, who perform His word..." ( Tehillim 103:20). 50:57 - עשרה הרוגי מלכות - The Ten Martyrs. 53:16 - Intentions for Mussaf on Yom Kippur. 54:47 - Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal on the mesiras nefesh of the 30,000 martyrs in Uman. 57:02 - Traveling to Uman for Rosh Hashanah calls for mesiras nefesh . 57:34 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 1, Introduction, Para. 2b-3. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Topics: Rabbi Shraga Feivel Mendelovitch ז"ל; The Ten Martyrs; VaEira ; Matos ; Pidyon Nefesh ; Tefilah BiVechinas Din ; Bilaam Killed By Sword 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b - from the words וזה בחינת מה שכתוב בזהר שהגוף של העשרה הרוגי מלוכה - The bodies of the Ten Martyrs were given over to the Sutra Achra temporarily. This was an example of תפילה בבחינת דין - Tefilah BiVechinas Din - "Judgment Prayer". 03:15 - קַ֧ח אֶת־מַטְּךָ֛ וְהַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ לִפְנֵֽי־פַרְעֹ֖ה יְהִ֥י לְתַנִּֽין - "...take your staff, cast before Pharaoh; it will become a serpent" ( Shemos 7:9, VaEira ). 07:00 - There are only three sins in the Torah for which a Jew gives up his life. All three are aspects of תאות נאוף. 09:08 - NOTE: Pidyon nefesh is a type of tzedakah for tefilos on the donor's behalf. The "24 Courts of Heaven". *12:09 - NOTE: Gimmel Elul is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Shraga Feivel b"R Moshe Mendelovitch ז"ל. Account of how Rav Mendelovitch once told Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל about his deep respect for the Likutey Moharan . 13:53 - PARAGRAPH 3. Tefilah BiVechinas Din . 17:46 - The Seventy Nations have no spiritual authority over Am Yisrael . 20:15 - The main source of Am Yisrael's life force is the Holy Torah. 21:52 - Why Chananiah, Mishael and Azariah ignored Nevuchadnezzar's decree. אֲנִי֙ פִּי־מֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְעַ֕ל דִּבְרַ֖ת שְׁבוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים - "I observe the commandment of the King, and concerning the oath of Hashem" ( Koheles 8:2). 25:43 - The Sutra Achra's main ability to attack holiness is gained only through it's own attachment to holiness. When this occurs, Am Yisrael has to use Tefilah BiVechinas Din . 28:36 - "The ax that chops the tree is from the forest itself" ( Sanhedrin 39b) - through this principle the Seventy Nations are defeated. 29:10 - Bilaam wanted to defeat Am Yisrael through the power of speech, which is the weapon of Am Yisrael . Therefore, Pinchas killed Bilaam with a sword - using the weapon of the Seventy Nations. 31:20 - The name בלעם hints at the totality of Bilaam's opposition to the Torah: Beis is the first letter of the Torah, Lamed is the last, Ayin alludes to the Seventy Faces of the Torah, Mem to the 40 days the Torah was received on Har Sinai . 31:48 - Bilaam had two sons, Yunus and Yumbrus , who were leaders of the Erev Rav . The sum of the gematria of their names equals the gematria of דעת because they were the דעת of the Sutra Achra ( Zohar Balak 13). 32:34 - הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם - "They were the same ones who were involved with the children of Israel on Balaam's advice..." ( Bamidbar 31:16, Matos ) 33:33 - Q&R about the ability of the Sutra Achra to draw strength from the Right Side. A brief review of "Right and Left" in kabbalah . חכמה is 73, חסד is 72. "Ani Bina, Li Gevurah" . 34:43 - NOTE: Chidush of Rabbi Rosenfeld ז"ל on Likutey Moharan 2 - Review of the story: the chakhamim lit a fire on the back of a large fish and the fish flipped over. 35:38 - The letters of the word for "back" allude to the "Left Column": Gevurah, Binah, Hod . ***42:34 - Bilaam and Balak . If Am Yisrael falls into spiritual decline, the forces of evil can access the Right Side . When this happens, Am Yisrael needs to "switch to a different channel": tefilah bivechinas din . 39:08 - Why Pinchas killed Bilaam with a sword ( Zohar HaKodesh ). Pinchas is b'gematria Yitzchak - din . וְאֶת־פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א - "Moshe sent... Pinchas the son of Eleazar the Kohen to the army ( Bamidbar 31:6, Matos ). 41:35 - The Sitra Achra only has power over Am Yisrael spiritually when Am Yisrael is in spiritual decline. 42:21 - Garon - throat - is three times Elokim . Tefilah BeVichinas Din is an aspect of the sword. רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֖ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם - "Praises of Hashem in their throats and a double-edged sword in their hands" ( Tehillim 149:6).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Avodas Elilim Akum 1 - Shemos - Acharei Mos - Mesiras Nefesh - Kiddush HaShem - Tefillin - Shoes and Shoelaces - Pinchas - Ata Gibor Is Tefilah BiVechinas Din - Minyan - Tying Left Shoe Before the Right - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Giv
lessons.bodyText: Avodas Elilim Akum 1 - Shemos - Acharei Mos - Mesiras Nefesh - Kiddush HaShem - Tefillin - Shoes and Shoelaces - Pinchas - Ata Gibor Is Tefilah BiVechinas Din - Minyan - Tying Left Shoe Before the Right - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Giving one's life Al Kiddush Hashem - for the sanctification of HaShem's Name ( Sanhedrin 74). The spiritual aspects of shoes. 03:10 - Giving one's life Al Kiddush Hashem is an example of Tefilah BiVechinas Din . 04:35 - The curse given to the serpent: ה֚וּא יְשֽׁוּפְךָ֣ רֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תְּשׁוּפֶ֥נּוּ עָקֵֽב - "... will crush your head, and you will bite his heel" ( Bereishis 3:15). Through the sin of Adam and Chava , garments of אור - light - were changed to garments of עור - leather. 06:38 - The three daily tefilos counteract the three klipos of Taivas Niuf embodied in the three sins for which a Jew sacrifices his life. מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים - "How beautiful are your footsteps in shoes..." ( Shir HaShirim 7:2). 07:05 - Parshas Shemos. שַׁל־נְעָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ - "...remove your shoes from your feet..." ( Shemos 3:5, Shemos ). 11:22 - Why a Jew ties his shoes in a way that differs from non-Jewish custom. 13:12 - The spiritual connection between tefillin and shoes. ( Shabbos 61). The tefillin are tied on the left arm. Even though we put the right shoe on first, then the left shoe, we tie the left shoe first, and afterwards the right. 18:56 - תפילה בבחינת דין - Tefilah BiVechinas Din . The light of the Yod of Yaakov counteracts the forces of evil brought to the world through Esav . The spiritual dimension of the angel of Esav wounding Yaakov in the thigh. Repairing this injury is accomplished through mesiras nefesh and Tefilah BeVechinas Din . 24:55 - The Gemara specifies not even changing one's shoelaces when the Torah is under attack. Principles of giving one's life al kiddush Hashem . 27:50 - The power of prayer with a minyan : the perfection of tefilah is achieved when ten Jews pray together. 28:13 - PARAGRAPH 5. Mesiras Nefesh, Kiddush HaShem. Giving one's life rather than transgress the Torah. 31:20 - Q&R about why the Gemara specifies shoelaces rather than shoes. 32:39 - PARAGRAPH 6. 35:03 - Parshas Acharei Mos. בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵֽי־יְהוָֹ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ - "...when they drew near before HaShem and they died" ( VaYikra 16:1, Acharei Mos ). 38:52 - Through his mesiras nefesh Pinchas corrected the spiritual damage caused by Nadav and Avihu . 40:45 - NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal about the gematria of Pinchas . The letters חס are begematria חיים. The letters פנ are 130 which is twice A - D - N - Y . 43:55 - PARAGRAPH 7. The blessing "Ata Gibor" in tefilas Shemoneh Esrei is an example of Tefilah BiVechinas Din . Following this a minyan can say "Kadosh Kadosh Kadosh" . 46:07 - Thunder is an aspect of gevurah . כִּֽי־מָֽלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים - "...for the land shall be filled with knowledge of HaShem as water covers the sea bed" ( Yeshayahu 11:9). 49:23 - Techiyas HaMeisim . 49:57 - Through Tefilah BiVechinas Din in the blessing Ata Gibor we merit the "Song of the Future" played on an instrument of 72 strings, corresponding to the Yod of Yaakov discussed above. 51:07 - Closing encouragement and blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Avodas Elilim Akum 2 - Introduction, Para. 1-5a. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Topics: Nitzavim; Chukas ; The "Treasury of Free Gifts"; The Hidden Torah; Purpose of Creation; Purpose of Man; A Jew is the Soul of the World; Man and Woman as Soul and Body; Sipurey Masiyos - "The King Who Decreed Conversion" ("Story of the Bull and the Ram"). Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 2. INTRODUCTION. Two halakhos will be discussed: 1) An idol made by a Jew can never be nullified ( Yoreh Deah 157) and 2) There are only three prohibitions in the Torah for which a Jew sacrifices his life rather than transgress: idolatry, forbidden relations, and murder. However, when the Torah is under public attack, a Jew sacrifices his life rather than transgress any mitzvah whatsoever ( Yoreh Deah 157). 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. מתנת חנם - The "Treasury of Free Gifts". Through התורה הנעלמת - the "Hidden Torah" - the world was able to exist before Matan Torah . *06:00 - The entire Torah is hidden in the ten statements of Creation. The 620 letters in the Aseres HaDibros - the Ten Commandments - parallel the 613 Mitzvos DeOraisa - Laws of the Written Torah - plus the seven mitzvos DeRabbanan - Laws of the Oral Torah. Everything in the world has Torah hidden within it. *07:58 - Bitul Torah : pausing in avodas Hashem allows a person to renew and strengthen their ability to serve Hashem. During the break, the person is sustained through מתנת חנם that are streaming from התורה הנעלמת. This is an aspect of שביטולה של תורה זהו יסודה - "The nullification of Torah is its foundation" ( Menachos 99b). 08:58 - The sanctity and infinite value of a Jewish life. “Desecrate one Shabbos so he will observe many ...” ( Yoma 85b, Shabbos 151b). 09:28 - The entire world was created for the sake of Am Yisrael . Yom HaShishi - the Hey alludes to the sixth day of Sivan , when the Torah was given and Creation was then completed. *11:30 - Am Yisrael is the life and the soul of all of the worlds. קדשא בריך הוה ואוריתא וישראל כלא חד - "Hashem, the Torah, and Yisrael are One" ( Zohar Vayikra 7). 12:27 - NOTE: Parshas Nitzavim . The ten divisions of Klal Yisrael . 13:20 - The purpose of creation is mankind's recognition of Hashem ( Zohar, Bo 41). 14:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. Everything in creation has two aspects: physical and spiritual. All the functions of the body were created to serve the soul. 16:00 - נפש means רצון, as in אִם־יֵ֣שׁ אֶת־נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם לִקְבֹּ֤ר אֶת־מֵתִי֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י - "If it is your will that I bury my dead from before me" ( Bereishis 24:8, Chayey Sarah ). When the body is subservient to the soul, it becomes part of the soul. Example: a cat that belongs to a kohen can eat terumah . 20:00 - The mitzvos are performed physically to nullify the physicality of our body and our world and thereby purify it to the point that its inner spirituality is revealed. 23:00 - וְצַדִּ֖יק בֶּֽאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ יִחְיֶֽה - "...but the righteous shall live by his faith" ( Chavakuk 2:4). Emunah is the foundation of the Torah and the purpose of creation. 25:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Nothing takes precedence over the life of a Jew except for the three mitzvos for which a Jew sacrifices his life. Every minute a Jew lives, his performance of the Torah's 248 positive commandments and 365 negative commandments reveals the spiritual root of creation. The Jewish Nation - and the individual Jew - is the soul of all worlds. *27:50 - Chukas - זֹ֚את הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אָדָ֖ם - "This is the Torah - Man..." ( Bamidbar 19:14, Chukas ). 30:00 - A Jewish soul is the "battery" of the world. When the Seventy Nations attack the Torah, a Jew sacrifices his life for all the mitzvos . 32:30 - NOTE: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁל֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַֽחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַֽחֲמִשִּֽׁים - " The sum of all those who were counted: six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty " ( Bamidbar 1:46). This number (six, then three plus five plus five) hints at the 613 mitzvos and the fact that Klal Yisrael , the Torah, and Hashem are one. *33:20 - Every single individual Jew, through his faith in Hashem, is a microcosm of the entire Torah and has the ability to elevate the entire world. 35:40 - PARAGRAPH 5. The importance of Tikkun HaBris. Why a Jew sacrifices his life rather than transgress the prohibitions of גלוי עריות. Man and woman as soul and body. 37:50 - NOTE: The son of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai , Rabbi Elazar ז"ל - celebrated his wedding during his Bar Mitzvah seudah . The father of the kallah told his daughter "Go and humble yourself to your husband." A spiritual framework for marriage: the wife as body and the husband as soul. אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֖יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ - "A virtuous woman is a crown for her husband..." ( Mishlei 12:4). 40:30 - When Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai and his students saw women walking in front of them, Rabbi Shimon said, "Don't turn to idols" ( Zohar VaYikra 19:4). 42:20 - The more Torah-observant Jews in the world, the better connected the world is to its spiritual Source. 44:48 - A person can only achieve true faith in Hashem through שמירת הברית. Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 45:30 - Q&R about the Jews who were forced to convert. Sipurey Masiyos - "The King Who Decreed Conversion" ("Story of The Bull and the Ram"). Biographical note about Rabbi Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld ז"ל before and after the Russian Revolution. He left all his wealth and fled to America in order to secure the Torah observance of his family. 49:30 - Q&R about husband and wife as aspects of Keser and Malkhus . 54:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Source for this shiur : Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat, Hilkhos Harshaah 2. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Parshas Shoftim introduces principles of teshuvah - return to Hashem - that are especially attainable during the month of Elul . 04:00 - Bribery causes spiritual blindness. Every person in this world is asked to serve as a judge. 10:00 - The ultimate success of a Beis Din is to bring about a compromise that establishes peace in the world. 15:31 - Judgment in the Heavenly Court begins with the question: were your business transactions honest? ( Shabbos ). 18:21 - וַיְהִ֥י יָדָ֛יו אֱמוּנָ֖ה - "And his hands were in faith" ( Shemos 17:12, Beshalach ). 20:07 - The solution to spiritual blindness in this world is אמת truth. Hisbodedus : speaking to Hashem with complete honesty allows a person to see themselves and others more clearly. 22:52 - The Gemara instructs judges to decide with "honest truth" - using the word אמת twice. This repetition of the word "truth" indicates that the truth can be used in a deceptive way, or in a sincere way. 27:36 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל telling one of his students to sit shiva on Shabbos . The response of Rabbi Moshe Feinstein ז"ל when he heard about this was: "Rabbi Rosenfeld knows the halakha just as well as I do. So if you want to understand what's going on, you'd better find out why he told his student to do that." 31:37 - "The Emeser Emes ": Description of one of the first encounters between Rebbe Nachman and Rav Noson of Nemirov ז"ל. 42:28 - Going to the Beis HaMikdash to receive mishpat . 43:37 - "Anyone who has true knowledge of the Torah, it's as if the Beis Hamikdash is rebuilt in his days" ( Berakhos ). *49:50 - תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ - "Be wholehearted with Hashem" ( Devarim 18:13, Shoftim ). 55:15 - Hashem commanded circumcision to Avraham Avinu with the expression "Go before Me completely..." 57:06 - Closing blessing.

Spiritual aspects of the
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Avodas Elilim Akum 2 - Para. 5b-6. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Topics: Avoda Zara - Idol Worship; False Religion is Rooted in Materialism, Illegitimate Child, What is Idolatry? Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5b. Spiritual aspects of the ממזר - illegitimate child. *05:00 - Everything in creation contains Hashem. Every individual in Am Yisrael has the capability and responsibility to reveal the light of Hashem that's hidden in all things in the physical world. 12:20 - עבודה זרה - is rooted in גשמיות - materialism and excessive physicality. 14:55 - How can so many people in the world be so far from the truth? 18:15 - The connection between idolatry and anger - "There shall not be an idol within you" ( Zohar HaKadosh ). 20:26 - Q&R about the source of Avoda Zara . 21:23 - Q&R about the spiritual potential of a Non-Jew. The Seven Mitzvos of the Bnei Noach . 23:00 - Q&R about how to view non-Jewish religious practices, especially practices that may not appear to be materialistic. *22:46 - There are two forms of evil: immersion in physicality and false spirituality. 25:59 - Nadav and Avihu . 26:15 - Q&R about how excessive physicality causes idolatry in our present generation. 28:02 - Story from the life of Rav Noson of Nemirov ז"ל and his son Rav Yitzchak Tulchiner ז"ל about the power of tefilah at chatzos . Rebbe Nachman speaks about people who seem to be doing miracles, while the actual power is coming into the world via a hidden tzaddik . 30:11 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 . The challenge of being honest when a person needs favors from others. 31:19 - Chiddush from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל about how Hashem punishes a person who collects funds by pretending to be a tzaddik . 33:40 - Q&R about physical pleasure being a test. 35:37 - Q&R about why comparatively few people seek the truth in this world. Hashem loves Am Yisrael because it is small and humble. 37:50 - Q&R about the process of geulah - redemption. 38:54 - PARAGRAPH 6. An idol made by a Jew does not become a forbidden object until it is worshipped. A Jewish soul is above everything in this world. 42:51 - Avoda zara is rooted in the physical world and apportioned to the Seventy Nations, as in אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם - "which Hashem assigned" ( Devarim 4:19). *48:09 - No matter how "artistic" or "beautiful" the objects of idol worship may appear, they block the light of Hashem. 49:47 - What does it mean that the sun and moon are "their" (the idolators') portion? In contrast, the portion of Am Yisrael is Hashem, as in יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מְנָ֣ת חֶלְקִ֣י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֜תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי - "Hashem is my allotted portion and my cup; You guide my destiny" ( Tehillim 16:5). 50:21 - Story of Avraham Avinu destroying the idols of his father. 51:23 - Am Yisrael relates to the spiritual aspects of the sun, moon, and all the other components of the physical world. 53:02 - Q&R about the distinction between an idol made by a Jew and one made by a non-Jew. This topic is to be continued. 53:48 - Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Avodas Elilim Akum 2 - Para. 7-8. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Topics: Torah, Hashem, and Israel are One; Avoda Zara of the Seventy Nations vs. That of a Jew; Prohibition of Murder; גונין - Gavnin - Supernal Colors of the Seven Metals. Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Only the People of Israel are the soul and life of all the worlds, with no connection to the materialism of the physical world. קדשא בריך הוה ואוריתא וישראל כלא חד - "Hashem, the Torah, and Yisrael are One" ( Zohar Vayikra 7). 01:53 - The Seventy Nations are also commanded not to worship idols; this prohibition is one of the Seven Mitzvos Bnei Noach . 03:35 - אֲשֶׁ֚ר יַֽחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל לְשֹׁנ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְֽהֶחֱזִ֡יקוּ בִּכְנַף֩ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדִ֜י לֵאמֹ֗ר נֵֽלְכָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים עִמָּכֶֽם - "...when ten men of all the languages of the nations shall take hold of the corner of a garment of a Jewish man, saying, 'Let us go with you, for we have heard Hashem is with you'..." ( Zacharia 8:23). In the future, the illusion of idolatry will end completely. 05:46 - What happens when a Jew creates an idol. 07:38 - What happens when a non-Jew creates an idol. *15:29 - Q&R - Atheism is idolatry. Harming a Jew and belief in man-made religions are also considered idolatry. 17:32 - PARAGRAPH 8. The prohibition of murder. A Jew is commanded by the Torah to allow himself to be killed rather than to kill another Jew. ( Pesachim 25). 29:34 - HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. Topics to be discussed in this halakha : An idol created by a Jew can never be used for anything. At what point does an idol become a forbidden object? Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 30:49 - יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר־בְּךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר - ..."Israel, in whom I take pride..." ( Yeshayahu 49:3). The גונין - gavnin - supernal colors of the seven metals - are found in every Jew. 38:53 - Q&R about the gavnin . 39:51 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Chayey Moharan - Rebbe Nachman Arrives in Uman - Histalkus of Rebbe Nachman - No Generation Is an Orphan - Protection from Dangers of Innovation - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 185. A fire in the city of Breslov causes Rebbe Nachman to leave the city. 03:00 - Rebbe Nachman spoke up and said, "Everything is ours." Story of Rebbe Meir not giving his valuables to an innkeeper named "Kidor" . 06:45 - Reference to Sichos HaRan 3 : Hashem's greatness cannot possibly be expressed in writing. 08:00 - The greatness of Teshuva - repentance. 09:08 - Q&R how can damage caused by past mistakes be completely repaired? 10:00 - Accepting difficulties with joy and love. It's not wise to express joy openly in front of a sad person. 13:20 - Rebbe Nachman's parting words as he left Breslov: "If you pray together, maybe you can bring me back." The story of Rebbe Nachman's students in Nemirov gathering to form a Breslov minyan . *14:31 - PARAGRAPH 188. Rebbe Nachman's encouragement to Rav Nosson ז"ל was, in effect: "It's not just that everything will turn out okay in the end. It's that everything is already good because it's the will of Hashem..." *16:00 PARAGRAPH 189. Hashem always helps Am Yisrael . There's no such thing as an orphaned generation, that is: with no leader to guide them. Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai ז"ל assured the sages that the Torah would never be forgotten. 20:00 - Rebbe Nachman said of himself: "Ani nahor..." - "I am a river that purifies from all types of stains". B'Gematria the word Nahor - river - is b'Milui Bris ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 21:14 - Rebbe Nachman's story about the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh repairing souls. 23:26 - PARAGRAPH 191. The histalkus of Rebbe Nachman - his passing on the 18th of Tishrei 5671. Rebbe Nachman's choice of his burial place. *26:32 - Q&R - Do Rebbe Nachman's words to his students at the time of his passing apply to us today? 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 192. Rebbe Nachman alludes to his deep spiritual considerations about Uman. 30:38 - Q&R - Tikkun Neshamah - what does it mean that Rebbe Nachman "repaired souls"? 32:09 - The three outstanding maskilim - Jewish atheists - of Uman and how they gradually came to respect Rebbe Nachman very deeply. One was named Hersh Ber - he was the son-in-law of Nachman Nosson Rapaport, the previous owner of the house Rebbe Nachman was living in. A description of how Rebbe Nachman succeeded in bringing these men closer to Torah observance. Comparison between these types of people and Yisro . 36:16 - PARAGRAPH 199. When a person reveals something new in science or philosophy, that discovery usually destroys him. Examples: Galileo, Socrates, and others. Rebbe Nachman cautions about innovation because if a person's intentions are not for the sake of truth, the innovation can cause harm. 38:30 - Chidushim in Torah bring blessing but only if they're made with humility. 40:42 - Q&R - To protect oneself when working in research and development a person should be careful not to seek honor. 41:57 - Q&R about interview of Rabbi Maimon on a recent podcast. 42:37 - Closing notes about the protection needed by Klal Yisrael everywhere. Today there was a terrorist attack on an army bus traveling on the highway through the Jordan valley. This is the usual bus route for people going to Meron. Closing blessing

lessons.bodyText: Avodas Elilim Akum 3. Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Idolatry; Holy Light in Wealth is Revealed via Tzedakah . Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Madameh is associated with the illusions of the material world. Sechel is the perception of emes - truth. 07:00 - The gavnin (holy light/metallic colors/attributes) of gold, silver, copper, etc. are aspects of sechel . The term avdus means serving, worshiping. 11:18 - Wherever there's more potential for holiness, there's more potential for evil. 13:40 - Q&R about the term "serving" as "worshiping". 15:50 - PARAGRAPH 4. Why Am Yisrael acquired the wealth of Egypt before leaving. Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . 22:35 - NOTE about a non-Jewish teacher receiving a car from his Jewish students in appreciation for his dedication. 29:12 - Yosef HaTzaddik is an aspect of tzedakah . 34:32 - While Am Yisrael was involved with releasing the light within the Egyptian money, Moshe Rabbeinu was rescuing the bones of Yosef HaTzaddik . *44:00 - How the concept of Yitzias Mitzrayim applies to each one of us today. Gavnin - holy light in wealth - is revealed via tzedakah . 44:41 - NOTE about a friend who was "on fire" to give tzedakah . 48:40 - Q&R about the crush of earning a living. 50:16 - NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל - "Running is reserved for mitzvos , not for money." 52:27 - Q&R about the difference between tikkun habris and tikkun hamamon. Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 1, Tefilah 4 . 54:24 - Q&R about the connection between Moshe Rabbeinu's involvement with tzedakah (rescuing the bones of Yosef ) while Am Yisrael's involvement with gathering the wealth. This was a coordinated, two-step process. 57:05 - The Gemara recounts how the Egyptians brought a court case to Alexander the Great against Am Yisrael . Am Yisrael claimed back wages for their years of slavery and the Egyptians ran away. 60:00 - How the Egel HaZahav - Golden Calf - illustrates the connection between tikkun habris and money.

Tzedakah defeats the medameh (power of illusion) and therefore is the essence of Purim. 04:30 - PARAGRAPH 17. The
lessons.bodyText: Avodas Elilim Akum 3 - Parshas Ki Sisa - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. The tzedakah - charity - of Matanos l'Evyonim and Mishloach Manos on Purim reveals the spiritual light in wealth. Tzedakah defeats the medameh (power of illusion) and therefore is the essence of Purim. 04:30 - PARAGRAPH 17. The joy of Purim. הוֹד֚וּ לַֽיהֹוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָֽעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽיו - "Give thanks to Hashem, call out in His Name; make His accomplishments known among the peoples" (1 Divrei HaYomim 16:8). 07:00 - לְכוּ נְרַֽנְּנָ֣ה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֜רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ - "Come, let us sing praises to Hashem; let us shout to the Rock of Our Salvation" ( Tehillim 95:1). Siddur : the chapters of Tehillim recited on Friday evening to welcome Shabbos . 11:30 - Possukim in the tefilos of Rosh Hashanah : בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָֽתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ - "With Your name they rejoice every day, and with Your righteousness they are exalted" ( Tehillim 89:17). כִּֽי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֜בִרְצֽוֹנְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם (כתיב תָּר֥יּם) קַרְנֵֽנוּ - "For You are the glory of their might, and with Your favor our horns will be raised" ( Tehillim 89:18). *12:45 - שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהֹוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֚ל נַפְשִׁי֙ בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֚י הִלְבִּישַׁ֙נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־יֶ֔שַׁע - "I will rejoice with HaShem; my soul shall exult with HaShem , for He has dressed me with garments of salvation" ( Yeshayahu 61:10). "Garments of salvation" refers to the spiritual light in wealth that are revealed through tzedakah . 16:30 - PARAGRAPH 18. Intoxication on Purim until the person can't distinguish between "cursed be Haman " and "blessed be Mordechai " ( Megilah 7). 33:00 - Q&R about spiritual levels. Reference to Likutey Moharan 24 . 35:00 - Every Jew in every generation is engaged in a battle against the evil inclination. This struggle can only be won through the help of HaShem, as in לוּלֵ֣י יְ֖הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם - "Had it not been for Hashem Who was with us when men rose up against us..." ( Tehillim 124:2). 41:00 - * Parshas Ki Sisa. Mordechai is alluded to in the Written Torah in וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֘ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־דְּרוֹר֙ - "And you, take for yourself spices of the finest sort: of pure myrrh..." ( Shemos 30:23, Ki Sisa ). 44:00 - The anointing oil of the Mishkan reveals the gevanin - spiritual colors - of HaShem's Light. וְהִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י - "And I will reveal Myself in My greatness and in My holiness" ( Yechezkel 38:23). 48:00 - The structure of the Mishkan corresponds to the structure of a human being. The Mishkan was a composite of all spiritual levels, just as man is a composite of all spiritual levels. 50:00 - NOTE about difficulties endured through traveling to Uman on Rosh Hashanah. 55:00 - Q&R about spiritual levels.

lessons.description: Avodas Elilim Akum 3 - Para. 18b - is Hilkhos Ribis , Part 5 - Parshas Ki Sisa - Mordekhai HaTzaddik - Mishkan and Man - Teshuvah on the Last Shabbos of the Year - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 00:00 - Recorded in Uman, 27th Elul 5782. Brief update from Uman
lessons.bodyText: Avodas Elilim Akum 3 - Para. 18b - is Hilkhos Ribis , Part 5 - Parshas Ki Sisa - Mordekhai HaTzaddik - Mishkan and Man - Teshuvah on the Last Shabbos of the Year - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avodas Elilim Akum 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 00:00 - Recorded in Uman, 27th Elul 5782. Brief update from Uman recorded on Erev Shabbos . 03:50 - PARAGRAPH 18b. Mordechai and Haman . The celebration of Purim will continue even after the revelation of Moshiach . 05:42 - NOTE from the Arizal about the 13 Midos of Rachamim - Rav Chesed is b'gematria Mordechai . 08:52 - Ki Sisa - Mordechai is alluded to in the Written Torah in וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֘ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־דְּרוֹר֙ - "And you, take for yourself spices of the finest sort: of pure myrrh..." ( Shemos 30:23, Ki Sisa ). 14:33 - NOTE on kabbalistic concepts: Ohr, mayim, rokiah. 17:00 - The anointing oil of the mishkan reveals the gevanin (spiritual colors) of HaShem's Light. וְהִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י - "And I will reveal Myself in My greatness and in My holiness" ( Yechezkel 38:23). Mordechai HaTzaddik is a composite of all the gevanin , on all levels. 19:34 - *The Mishkan and Man. The structure of the mishkan corresponds to the structure of a human being. Both the mishkan and man are composites of all spiritual levels. 21:02 - Q&R about spiritual levels and imagination. 24:02 - Q&R about sechel and not forcing issues before their time. How the medameh (imagination) is active in sleep. The relationship between daas and time. 26:00 - Q&R about the Ketores and the Anointing Oil. 28:06 - Return to text: HaShem gave Mordechai HaTzaddik the power to defeat Haman . 28:41 - Every Jew in every generation is engaged in a battle against the evil inclination. This struggle can only be won through the help of Hashem, as in לוּלֵ֣י יְ֖הֹוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם - "Had it not been for HaShem Who was with us when men rose up against us..." ( Tehillim 124:2). 30:49 - The Tzaddik in every generation has the power to defeat the Amalek in his generation. 31:22 - NOTE about the progressive levels of holiness during Shabbos . 33:38 - Yosef HaTzaddik : Yosef is b'gematria six times Y - K - V - K . 34:08 - Tefilah is a "nuclear weapon". Moshe, Yosef, Dovid is b'gematria 515. NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal that the gematria of Rebbe Nachman ben Simcha is 516. 38:37 - NOTE - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : The letters of the word Purim contain the roshei teyvos - initial letters - of all the holidays of the year. The days of Purim are remembered and reactivated in every generation. 41:24 - Ve yesh b'inyan shinuyim harbeh l'ain mispar... Sometimes the Yetzer Hara is disguised as a righteous person. 46:00 - Instances when a son might not be required to daven in the same shul as his father. 48:00 - Closing blessings. NOTE about the last Shabbos of the year, when teshuvah can be accomplished for all previous Shabbosim . 48:42 - The word Esrog is made up of the roshei teyvos of emunah, teshuvah, refuah, and geulah . 49:12 - Haman was not obliterated completely - he's still "hanging around". 49:47 - Q&Rs - The mistake of Korach . 51:46 - NOTE on Parshas HaAzinu . 57:00 - Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Hilkhos Ribis 5. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Recorded in Uman on the 27th Elul 5782 (2022-09-23). 00:00 - Why the word בראשית - Bereishis - "in the beginning..." contains the word Shabbos ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 08:10 - The six close talmidim of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai z"l called him "Shabbos" . 13:01 - What Shab
lessons.bodyText: Shabbos is the Source of Teshuvah. Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Recorded in Uman on the 27th Elul 5782 (2022-09-23). 00:00 - Why the word בראשית - Bereishis - "in the beginning..." contains the word Shabbos ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 08:10 - The six close talmidim of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai z"l called him "Shabbos" . 13:01 - What Shabbos is in time, Eretz Yisrael is in location. Similar to Shabbos and Eretz Yisrael , the Tzaddik is a central element to Klal Yisrael . 13:15 - צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ - "The righteous shall inherit the Land and dwell in it forever" ( Tehillim 37:29). The grave of a tzaddik is an aspect of Eretz Yisrael . 13:51 - Why Ezra HaSofer waited until his rebbe passed away before going to Eretz Yisrael . 15:21 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 16:41 - Reb Avrum b'Reb Nachman z"l : The highest level of holiness is a Jew on Shabbos in Yerushalayim . 18:34 - The word בראשית contains the letters that spell "yoreh Shabbos" - respect for Shabbos . 19:36 - Shabbos is the source of teshuvah - repentance/return to Hashem and His Torah. 21:11 - Respect for Shabbos is accomplished through preparing for it. Spiritual aspects of bathing in hot water on Erev Shabbos and changing to special Shabbos garments. 26:35 - We show honor to Hashem by doing His will. 30:18 - Baal Shem Tov on a Gemara in Chulin comparing the humility of Avraham Avinu, Dovid HaMelech and Moshe Rabbeinu . 35:18 - Tasting Shabbos is tasting life. 39:02 - NOTE from Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z"l about the tremendous opportunity for teshuvah on the last Shabbos of the year and on Shabbos Teshuvah . 40:58 - NOTE from Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman z"l about chinuch : Education begins the minute a child is born. 43:00 - Bathing and mikveh on Erev Shabbos is from midday on. 44:22 - Commemoration of shiur for iluy nishmos Arthur and Dorothy Mandel a"h . 45:00 - Rebbe Nachman's choice to be buried near the 30 thousand martyrs of Uman. 45:38 - Closing blessings about Uman: "Everyone was saying 'the Breslovers aren't going to Uman this year' but B"H we're here."

29:59 - NOTE: Itarus haratzon - awakening of will/desire. 31:35 - Comment by student: 2 x Lechem (78) plus melach (78) x 3 is begematria Shabbos (702). 32:27 - PARAGRAPH 25. 36:13 - Clarification of previous paragraph according to the Arizal . 40:13 - Comment by student: Rabbi Shimshon Rafael Hirsch zal on the Korbon Tamid . 41:04 - * Inyanim of the season - "Today is Erev Yom Kippur ..." 44:17 - The Torah is the equivalent of the Kadosh Kedoshim in our generation: Mishlei - yakara m'peninim - "More precious than pearls" - refers to the Torah . 46:13 - Q&R about possuk showing male and female are equal. 47:26 - *Closing blessings - noshim tzidkaniyos - righteous women. 48:04 - Working on the Sukkah immediately after Yom Kippur . 49:47 - Three customs about dipping challah in salt and honey during the Yomim Norayim - High Holidays. 50:42 - R' Nasan's apology to the kehillah . 51:26 - Q&R about pidyon nefesh . 51:59 - Q&R about Tikkun HaKlali . 53:05 - *Q&R - saying Tashlich is permitted even if no natural body of water is available. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Roshei Perokim - Part 2. Power of Tefilah at Chatzos ; Parnassah ; Wealth from Eretz Yisrael ; Havdalah ; Bereishis - Emeser Emes - Perfect Truth. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedications and brief review. 01:45 - ROSHEI PEROKIM PART 2. The power of tefilah - prayer - at chatzos halayla - midnight. 08:28 - It's difficult to know the precise time of chatzos halayla . 14:53 - NOTE from Zohar Hakodesh about shefa - bounty - emanating from Eretz Yisrael . 15:58 - Why neshech - monetary interest - is called a "bite". Why one of the Torah readings for Chol HaMoed Pesach relates to lending money. 18:14 - Q&R about the advice of Dovid HaMelech concerning parnassah . 19:27 - "Hashem planted truth and cast it down to the earth" ( Bereishis Raba 8:5). The main source of conflict in this world is imperfect truth. When Adam and Chava ate from the Tree of Knowledge, Hashem asked "Who told you that you're naked?" ( Bereishis 3: 9,11). 27:02 - The resurrection of the dead depends on אמת - truth. *27:36 - Havdalah on Motzei Shabbos draws the holiness of Shabbos into the following six weekdays. 32:00 - NOTE: The Ben Ish Chai teaches that one hour of learning Torah on Shabbos is equal to a thousand hours of Torah learning on a weekday. 36:00 - The one message Hashem conveys before He reveals the Torah on Har Sinai is "Stand back." 41:07 - Q&R about the sin of Adam HaRishon and the introduction of sheker - falsehood - into the material world. 42:28 - PARAGRAPH 1. Creation was for the sake of man. Emes and sheker - truth and falsehood. Duality/diversity gives rise to conflict and evil. 47:43 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 . 50:18 - Free will is the greatest miracle of creation. 52:10 - עָשָׂ֧ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם יָשָׁ֑ר וְהֵ֥מָּה בִקְשׁ֖וּ חִשְּׁבֹנ֥וֹת רַבִּֽים - "...for Hashem made man straight, but they sought many intrigues" ( Koheles 7:29). 54:39 - אֲ֜נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ - "...this day have I begotten you" ( Tehillim 2:7). Daas - Torah wisdom - enables a person to rise above the concept of time. 57:09 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Ribis 5 - Para. 1b. Achieving World Peace, Love Your Neighbor, ואהבת לרעך כמוך. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Today, the 25th of Tishrei , is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Levi Yitzchak ben Sarah Sasha and b'r Meir of Berditchev ז"ל. Dedications. 02:30 - PARAGRAPH 1b. 05:09 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . 06:07 - בֵּ֣אלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר בַּֽ֜יהֹוָ֗ה אֲהַלֵּ֥ל דָּבָֽר - "With Hashem's I will praise a word; with Hashem's I will praise a word" ( Tehillim 56:11). *08:00 - Achieving world peace: when everyone places Hashem as his or her central focus in life, all can live in harmony. This unity between Hashem and all mankind is the ultimate goal of creation and therefore the most important element in creation. 9:30 - ואהבת לרעך כמוך - love your neighbor as yourself. 10:12 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 12:49 - Parshas Bereishis - the creation of Chava brought diversity into the world, which is the root of conflict. 15:45 - Repairing the mistake of Adam and Chava is possible in every generation. 17:38 - NOTE about how individual people influence attendance in Uman for Rosh Hashanah. 19:13 - The Arizal said that many Jewish women are reincarnations of the Dor Deyah . 20:04 - A person can influence his friend to counteract the influence of the Yetzer Hara ( Sichos HaRan 81 ) . 21:34 - Parshas Korach - praise for the wife of Ohn Ben Peles , who saved her husband from taking part in the uprising against Moshe Rabbeinu led by Korach .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Ribis 5 - Para. 2-3 - Bereishis - Conflict Causes Poverty; Since Wealth is a Mindset, Why Pray to Improve Our Lives? Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 2. Conflict causes poverty. Justice is the result of true peace between people. 05:20 - Money
lessons.bodyText: Ribis 5 - Para. 2-3 - Bereishis - Conflict Causes Poverty; Since Wealth is a Mindset, Why Pray to Improve Our Lives? Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 2. Conflict causes poverty. Justice is the result of true peace between people. 05:20 - Money is associated with less daas , as in מִצָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה - "Gold comes from the north" ( Iyov 37:22). 06:40 - וְעַל־פַּת־לֶ֜֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע־גָּֽבֶר - "...but for a piece of bread a man will sin" ( Mishlei 28:21). 20:48 - Q&R about children who are financially dependent on their parents. 22:25 - PARAGRAPH 3. Money and the concepts of time and beyond time. 26:45 - וּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑נוּ - "And charity will be for us..." ( Devarim 6:25, VaEschanan ). The power of tzedakah . 27:49 - וַֽחֲטָאָךְ֙ (כתיב וַֽחֲטָיָךְ֙) בְּצִדְקָ֣ה פְרֻ֔ק - "...showing mercy to the poor will remove your sin" ( Daniel 4:24). 30:00 - Poverty originated when Adam and Chava ate from the Knowledge of Good and Evil, as in בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה - "...you will derive food from it in anguish..." ( Bereishis 3:17, Bereishis ). One conflict between people can impoverish thousands. 32:10 - Wealthy people and poor people think differently, which sometimes causes animosity, as in וַיִּרְדֹּ֡ף אִישׁ־עָנִ֣י וְ֖אֶבְיוֹן - "...and he pursued a poor and needy man..." ( Tehillim 109:16). 36:15 - Q&R about Beis Din meeting on Mondays and Thursdays. *37:06 - Q&R about wealth being a frame of mind rather than how much money a person has. Example of different types of equipment given for different tasks in the army. "The privilege of being poor". 38:43 - Moshal - story with a moral - two people who joined the army and are issued different types of equipment and clothing. 40:34 - Q&R about mindset and wealth. Examples from Sipurei Masiyos - Story of the Clever Man and the Simple Man, and Story of the Master of Prayer. *45:47 - Q&R - Since wealth is a mindset, why pray to improve our lives? Tefilah creates vessels to receive Hashem's blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5 , Para. 4-6. Giving an Interest-Free Loan Can Be Greater Than Charity; Tikkun Chatzos - Prayer at Midnight Improves Livelihood. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 4. Giving an interest-free loan is better than giving charity. 09:00 - The test of the Tree of Knowledge had to do with eyesight. 12 :30 - Q&R about the benefit of receiving or giving an interest-free loan vs. receiving or giving charity. 14:07 - NOTE: when a person gives a loan, they make a connection with the recipient. 14:25 - When ribis - monetary interest - is charged for a loan, the illusion of time is strengthened. By not taking interest, the illusion of time is negated ( Baba Metzia 71). 19:00 - The name "Moshe" is comprised of the first letters of the phrase מַה־שֶּֽׁהָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁיִּֽהְיֶ֔ה - "That which was, will be..." ( Koheles 1:9). 00:00 - מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֖הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֜גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ - "He who is gracious to a poor man lends to Hashem, and He will repay him his reward" ( Mishlei 19:17). 18:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 79 . 20:50 - PARAGRAPH 5. The importance of chatzos - prayer at midnight - which counteracts sleep and eliminates the illusion of time. ( Zohar Bereishis 23). 29:38 - Q&R about the time of chatzos - according to the Arizal , it's 6 clock hours (360 minutes) after nightfall and continues for two hours thereafter. However it's permitted to say Tikkun Chatzos until Alos HaShachar . 32:16 - Q&R about staying awake until chatzos - it's preferable to go to sleep earlier and then wake up. 33:36 - PARAGRAPH 6. Using time wisely to prepare for Olam HaBah - the Future World. Reference to the spiritual aspects of sleep in Likutey Moharan 64 . *38:00 - Dovid Hamelech would get up at chatzos to pray, and in the morning the sages would consult him about parnassah - livelihood - for Am Yisrael . What's the connection between chatzos and parnassah ? 46:40 - Q&R about how non- Jews receive livelihood. NOTE about going to the Tzaddik especially at mincha on Shabbos to receive blessing for the coming week through Torah, sharing a meal, singing, and dancing. 49:26 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Ribis 5 - Para. 7-8. Parshas Bereishis - Adam, Chava , and the Nachash ; Creation Is Only Fully Repaired by Tzaddikim ; Parshas Ki Seitzei - Neshech . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 7. נֶ֕שֶׁךְ כָּל־דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּֽׁךְ - "...interest o
lessons.bodyText: Ribis 5 - Para. 7-8. Parshas Bereishis - Adam, Chava , and the Nachash ; Creation Is Only Fully Repaired by Tzaddikim ; Parshas Ki Seitzei - Neshech . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 179 . 00:00 - Dedications. PARAGRAPH 7. נֶ֕שֶׁךְ כָּל־דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּֽׁךְ - "...interest on food or interest on any item for which interest is taken" ( Devarim 23:20, Ki Seitzei ). Taking interest for a loan is similar to loshon hara - evil speech. Neshech alludes to the nachash - serpent. 04:22 - The present exile is lengthened due to loshon hara and makhlokes - conflict. 05:42 - Ribis is the opposite of peace. Yosef and his brothers. 07:25 - PARAGRAPH 8. 08:29 - Bereishis contains the letters spelling b'Alef Tishrei . 09:00 - The body and soul are judged together after a person passes away. 10:06 - The repair done by the tzaddik relates to before creation and after creation. 12:00 - Creation is only fully repaired by tzaddikim . 14:25 - Tzaddikim on Rosh Hashanah . Why Rosh Hashanah is the first day of the Eseres Yemei Teshuvah - Ten Days of Return. 17:45 - Teshuvah is an aspect of returning the soul to its original Source. It's compared with the cantillation Zarka . זרקה means to throw something back to the place from which it was taken. Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . 18:50 - Traveling to tzaddikim for Rosh Hashanah . 23:34 - Q&R about sweetening dinim at their root. 24:52 - Parshas Bereishis - The task of Adam HaRishon . *25:59 - How could Adam have failed in his task? The origin of sheker - falsehood. 29:29 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 . 30:38 - Why the nachash approached Chava rather than Adam. 32:00 - Ish v'isha - man and woman - parallel nefesh v'gufa - soul and body. Three partners in the creation of a child: husband and wife provide the body and Hashem provides the soul. The main test of man is tikkun habris . Chava was created through the concept of sleep. 35:32 - Man is a microcosm of creation. Reference to Likutey Moharan 49 . 36:50 - Q&R about Chava being created through sleep. 37:45 - Q&R about tahara - purity - and bechira - free will. *38:51 - Parshas Bereishis. Q&R about the creation of Chava through sleep. Adam and Chava were one being at first. Hashem brought sleep to them in order to separate Chava into a separate being. 40:26 - The gematria of Adam (45) is Y-K-V- K (26) plus Chava (19). Zachor (227) plus nekeva (157) plus one is the gematria of Shekhinah . 41:30 - Parshas Bereishis . How the nachash - serpent - deceived Chava . 43:22 - Why it is a tradition to visit kivrei tzaddikim on Erev Rosh Hashanah . 44:32 - Closing NOTE - today is Yom Kippur Katan . Blessing. 45:16 - Q&R about how a tzaddik can affect changes in the world after he passes away and no longer has bechirah - free will. Through aliyas in Olam HaEmes , the tzaddikim are able to repair the world.

lessons.title: 2022-10-25 - LH4 - YD2 - Ribis 5 - Para. 9-11
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Ribis 5 - Honesty in Tefilah ; Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov - Before Creation and After Creation - Establishing Truth and Peace before Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Creation is repaired through אמת - truth. Chesed/Avrah
lessons.bodyText: Ribis 5 - Honesty in Tefilah ; Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov - Before Creation and After Creation - Establishing Truth and Peace before Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Creation is repaired through אמת - truth. Chesed/Avraham and Gevurah/Yitzchak represent "before creation" and "after creation". 03:29 - Kol shofar is an aspect of אמת. 07:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 - echad is ahava . 13:00 - וְהַחוּט֙ הַֽמְשֻׁלָּ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בִמְהֵרָ֖ה יִנָּתֵֽק - "...and a three-stranded cord will not quickly be broken" ( Koheles 4:12). Yaakov Avinu/Emes connects the concepts of "before creation" and "after creation". 17:00 - The birth of a child is a new creation. The term tzaddik refers to a man who has mastered shmiras habris . 20:00 - The shofar on Rosh Hashanah is an aspect of the mitah sheleyma - perfection of offspring - of Yaakov Avinu/Emes . 21:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Truth is the elixir of life. The Angel of Death could not kill anyone in the city of Kushta because everyone there spoke the truth ( Sanhedrin 97). אמת unites the principle of "before creation" with the principle of "after creation". 23:30 - כִּ֣י הַמָּ֔וֶת יַפְרִ֖יד - "...death separates..." ( Rus 1:17). In Olam HaEmes , truth is revealed. 26:30 - אֱמֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח - "Truth will sprout from the earth..." ( Tehillim 85:12). The conclusion of tefilos on Rosh Hashanah is אמת. 30:21 - PARAGRAPH 11. The importance of establishing truth and peace before Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur . 32:38 - רֹֽאשׁ־דְּבָֽרְךָ֥ אֱמֶ֑ת - "The beginning of Your word is truth" ( Tehillim 119:160). 35:28 - Conflict results from lack of unity/truth. ה֗וֹי הָאֹֽמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע - "Woe to those who say of the evil that it is good and of the good that it is evil" ( Yeshaya 5:20). 44:00 - Traveling to Uman from Eretz Yisrael for Rosh Hashanah . 46:23 - Closing blessings. The third and permanent Beis HaMikdash corresponds to Yaakov Avinu and therefore will be an aspect of אמת - truth - which stands forever.
