lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 12-13. Judgement on Rosh Hashanah "Like Sheep"; אין עוד מלבדו - Ain Od Milvado - There is Nothing But Hashem. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - On Rosh Hashanah all the inhabitants of the world are examined by Hashem lik
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 12-13. Judgement on Rosh Hashanah "Like Sheep"; אין עוד מלבדו - Ain Od Milvado - There is Nothing But Hashem. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - On Rosh Hashanah all the inhabitants of the world are examined by Hashem like sheep, one by one ( Rosh Hashanah 1:2). Yet, Hashem doesn't need to judge individually, since He doesn't need time to process information as people do. So why does the gemara describe this one-by-one process? 05:46 - Hashem's justice is always truthful. אֱמֶת֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט שָׁל֔וֹם שִׁפְט֖וּ בְּשַֽׁעֲרֵיכֶֽם - "...truth, and judgment of peace you shall judge in your cities" ( Zecharia 8:16). 06:00 - עַל שְׁלֹשָׁה דְבָרִים הָעוֹלָם קַיָּם: עַל הַדִּין, וְעַל הָאֱמֶת, וְעַל הַשָּׁלוֹם - "Three things sustain the world: law, truth, and peace" ( Pirkei Avos 1:17). 7:12 - By performing mitzvos we become part of Hashem. The word mitzvah in gematria Atbash is Y - K - V - K. Through speaking truth, a person draws Hashem's supervision upon him. 10:15 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 and the concepts of "before creation" and "after creation". The ultimate purpose of man is to connect with the perfected spiritual level of "before creation". 12:30 - NOTE on spiritual principles that can be understood through observing the process of purifying metal. 15:18 - "Don't do a lot of evil" - a person should not think "I'm already doing something bad, so I may as well do something even worse." Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 "No eye has ever seen..." ( Yuma 21). 19:40 - Answer to the question posed at beginning of shiur : why are people judged one by one, as sheep? 21:25 - Hashem judges each and every person individually according to their unique abilities 27:00 - Q&R about the soul returning to its Source. If all merges to purity, how can there be judgement for good and evil? 28:48 - Q&R about the soul being in a constant state of creation. 29:51 - Q&R about judgement on Rosh Hashanah . 32:53 - PARAGRAPH 13. On Rosh Hashanah a person is assigned his unique mission in the world throughout the new year. To succeed in this mission, a person needs faith in Hashem's direct supervision. 40:00 - No one can "run away" from Hashem. פְּלִ֣יאָה (כתיב פְּלִ֣אָיה) דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֜שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹֽא־אוּכַ֥ל לָֽהּ - "Knowledge is hidden from me; it is hard, I cannot attain it" - אָנָ֣ה אֵלֵךְ מֵֽרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֜אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח - "Where shall I go from Your spirit, and where shall I flee from Your presence?" ( Tehillim 139:6-7). אין עוד מלבדו - there is nothing but Hashem. 41:00 - אִם־אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֖מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ - "If I ascend to the heavens, there You are, and if I make my bed in the grave, behold, You are there" ( Tehillim 139:8-10). 43:00 - בְּֽכָל־מָ֖קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֜פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וְטוֹבִֽים - "The eyes of Hashem are everywhere, viewing the evil and the good" ( Mishlei 15:3). 43:50 - The perfection of faith is achieved through connection with tzaddikim . 54:00 - "Panei Hashem" - the Face refers to His השגחה - supervision. 56:00 - אין עוד מלבדו - It's impossible to "run away from" Hashem. עֵינֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ בָּ֔הּ מֵֽרֵשִׁית֙ הַשָּׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד אַֽחֲרִ֥ית שָׁנָֽה - "The Eyes of Hashem are always upon , from the beginning of the year to the end of the year" ( Devarim 11:12; Rosh Hashanah 8). 59:09 - Q&R about "before and after creation". 59:30 - Q&R about atheists and the impossibility of "running away from Hashem".

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 14-15. Walking to a Tzaddik and to the Beis HaMikdash ; Tehillim 122; Seventh Beggar; Spiritual Aspects of Feet/Traveling/Walking - הליכה ברגלין. Biographical Note. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The sig
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 14-15. Walking to a Tzaddik and to the Beis HaMikdash ; Tehillim 122; Seventh Beggar; Spiritual Aspects of Feet/Traveling/Walking - הליכה ברגלין. Biographical Note. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The significance and importance of traveling to the tzaddik emes . 05:29 - וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י - "...and the earth is My footstool..." ( Yeshaya 66:1). Faith in Hashem connects "Before Creation" with "After Creation". הַמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת - "...Who dwells on high..." - הַמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ - "Who lowers to look in the heavens and the earth" ( Tehillim 113:5-6). 08:54 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 . 11:24 - Throughout all generations it's been customary to travel to one's Torah teacher. *12:12 - שָׂ֖מַחְתִּי בְּאֹֽמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ - "...I rejoiced when they said to me, 'Let us go to the house of the Lord'..." - עֹֽמְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֜שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם - "Our feet were standing within your gates, O Jerusalem" ( Tehillim 122:1-2). 13:42 - There is great merit in every step taken to do a mitzvah , as alluded to in מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת־נָדִ֑יב - "How fair are the footsteps you take in sandals..." ( Shir HaShirim 7:2). 16:19 - Q&R about walking to a shul established in the name of a tzaddik . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל mentioning the "dust of Yaakov" with regard to R' Maimon's walking a considerable distance to attend his shiurim on Shabbos . 18:33 - יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֜עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו - "The built-up Jerusalem is like a city that is united together" ( Tehillim 122:3). The Upper Yerushalayim is merged with the Yerushalayim of the physical world through אמת - truth. 23:00 - Loshon Hara is associated with the feet, as in לֹֽא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ - "You shall not go as a gossip among Your People..." ( Vayikra 19:16, Kedoshim ). 24:22 - NOTE about the Sipurey Masiyos : the seventh beggar seems to have no feet and corresponds to the revelation of Moshiach . 26:00 - Rosh Hashanah . The tzaddik is the Rosh Bayis - master of the house. "Rosh Bnei Yisrael" is roshei teivos "Rebbe" . 32:00 - Q&R about how loshon hara - evil speech - causes a separation between the head and the feet. 33:45 - PARAGRAPH 15. אמת - truth. 35:37 - כָּל לָשׁוֹן הָרַע שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ דְּבַר אֱמֶת בִּתְחִילָּתוֹ אֵין מִתְקַיֵּים בְּסוֹפוֹ - "Any slander that does not begin with a truthful statement ultimately does not stand." ( Sotah 35a) 36:32 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Reb Michel Dorfman ז"ל - when he was asked about choosing a school for a child, he advised to look at the older children in that school, the graduates, and how they turn out to be. 38:00 - וְתַשְׁלֵ֚ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה - "...and it will cast truth to the earth" ( Daniel 8:12). 39:00 - תֵּֽאָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּֽבְר֖וֹת עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָ֜תָ֗ק בְּגַֽאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז - "Let lying lips become mute, those that speak against a righteous man falsely, with haughtiness and disdain" ( Tehillim 31:19). 40:38 - וְאַל תַּאֲמִין בְּעַצְמְךָ עַד יוֹם מוֹתְךָ - "...do not trust in yourself until the day of your death..." ( Pirkei Avos 2:4). 41:06 - NOTE warning against the dangers of excluding parts of the Torah, for example studying kabbalah without studying halakha . 44:57 - Repair of the world by MoshiachTzidkeynu depends on the "feet" of אמת.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 16-17. Some Angels Opposed the Creation of Man; Obstacles to Truth Create Spiritual Potential. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. When Hashem was about to create Adam He consulted with the angels and some an
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 16-17. Some Angels Opposed the Creation of Man; Obstacles to Truth Create Spiritual Potential. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. When Hashem was about to create Adam He consulted with the angels and some angels opposed the creation of man ( Midrash Rabah Bereishis 8). חֶֽסֶד־וֶֽאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ - "Kindness and truth met; righteousness and peace kissed" ( Tehillim 85:11). 02:46 - Hashem cast אמת - truth - down to the earth in order to create man. How can there be a difference between אמת and Hashem Yisborach ? 05:37 - Hashem created the world so mankind would be able to search for Him and honor Him. 09:28 - כָּעֵ֗ת יֵֽאָמֵ֤ר לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה־פָּעַ֖ל אֵֽל - "In time it will be said to Yaakov and Yisrael, 'What has Hashem done?' ( Bamidbar 23:23, Balak ) ( Bava Basra ). 10:34 - Why some angels opposed the creation of man. 11:36 - מְ֜אֹ֗ד עָֽמְק֥וּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ - "...Your thoughts are very deep" ( Tehillim 92:6). 14:42 - There is only one truth, but it contains many levels of refinement. 20:21 - כָּל לָשׁוֹן הָרַע שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ דְּבַר אֱמֶת בִּתְחִילָּתוֹ אֵין מִתְקַיֵּים בְּסוֹפוֹ - "Any slander that does not begin with a truthful statement ultimately does not stand." ( Sotah 35a). 25:50 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the teshuvah of a member of the Syrian community. 36:18 - The more diversity - the more potential for sheker . Example: being overwhelmed by diversity of products when food shopping. 33:54 - PARAGRAPH 17. Obstacles to truth create spiritual potential. עָשָׂ֧ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם יָשָׁ֑ר וְהֵ֥מָּה בִקְשׁ֖וּ חִשְּׁבֹנ֥וֹת רַבִּֽים - "...for Hashem made man straight, but they sought many intrigues" ( Koheles 7:29) 41:49 - ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֹתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָֽאָדָֽם - "The end of the matter, everything having been heard: fear Hashem and keep His commandments, for this is the entire man" ( Koheles 12:13). 44:20 - בְּרָב־עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־מֶ֑לֶךְ - "The King's glory is in a multitude of people..." ( Mishlei 14:28). 45:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 45:40 - The first mitzvah in the Torah is the commandment to inhabit the world. 48:30 - שְׁלַח־אֽוֹרְךָ֣ וַֽ֖אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ - "Send Your light and Your truth, that they may lead me; they shall bring me to Your Holy Mountain and to Your dwellings" ( Tehillim 43:3). 49:46 - וְֽ֠הָיָה מִסְפַּ֚ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֵֽאָמֵ֚ר לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵֽאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־חָֽי - "And the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which shall neither be measured nor counted; and it shall come to pass that, instead of saying to them, 'You are not My people,' it shall be said to them, 'The children of the living Hashem' " - ( Hoshea 2:1). 52:00 - Q&R about how to find the tzaddik today. 54:35 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2022-10-30 - LH4 - YD1 - Ribis 5 - Para. 18-20a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 18-20a. When Moshiach is Revealed All Will See the Truth. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. When Moshiach is revealed, all will see the complete truth. כִּֽי־כוּלָּם֩ יֵֽדְע֨וּ אוֹתִ֜י לְמִקְּטַנָּ֚ם וְעַד־
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 18-20a. When Moshiach is Revealed All Will See the Truth. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. When Moshiach is revealed, all will see the complete truth. כִּֽי־כוּלָּם֩ יֵֽדְע֨וּ אוֹתִ֜י לְמִקְּטַנָּ֚ם וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָם֙ - "...for they shall all know Me from their smallest to their greatest" ( Yirmiyahu 31:33). Until then, this perception of truth is only possible through overcoming challenges. 09:20 - Q&R about the perception of truth being possible only through overcoming challenges. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 11:20 - PARAGRAPH 19. Even the highest level of מלאך - angel - cannot perceive complete truth. Tzaddikim , however, can achieve this perception. Some angels opposed the creation of man. 17:05 - Hashem cast the truth down to the earth. 18:53 - NOTE about young man going away from Torah and taking refuge with his grandparents. 24:09 - NOTE about King Menashe . 25:15 - NOTE about Bilaam . 28:00 - Kabbalah is called the " chokhma of emes ". 28:45 - Q&R - Why is the level of truth achieved by tzaddikim greater than the perception of angels? NOTE from Reb Nachman Burstein ז"ל - example of a couch being repaired to a state better than new. 31:51 - Q&R about Torah outreach. 33:13 - NOTE about Sipurey Masiyos - The Master of Prayer . Students who attempted to save the "Kingdom of Wealth" failed because they didn't first consult with the Master of Prayer. 40:05 - Return to text: ועל-כן תכף שאמרו מלאכי השרת 43:14 - NOTE about Sipurey Masiyos - The Rabbi's Only Son . *44:04 - PARAGRAPH 20 - הֵ֣ן אֱ֖מֶת חָפַ֣צְתָּ בַטֻּח֑וֹת וּ֜בְסָתֻ֗ם חָכְמָ֥ה תוֹדִיעֵֽנִי - "Behold, You desired that truth be in the hidden places, and in the concealed part You teach me wisdom" ( Tehillim 51:8). 48:25 - Sometimes אמת is hidden by unqualified teachers who misrepresent the Torah. 54:37 - Q&R about how to strengthen one's perception of truth.

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 20b-21. The Root of Conflict Between People in Every Generation; The "Seven Waters" of Opposition to Truth. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 – The opposition of the angels to the creation of man is the root of all conflict in every generation. 11:51 - Why the holy tzaddikim are able to perceive a greater level of truth than the angels can. 16:51 - NOTE - is Rebbe Nachman the only Tzaddik Emes ? The "Seven Waters" of opposition to the truth. Sipurey Masiyos, The Burgher and the Pauper . 18:57 - NOTE - story of Rabbi Akiva surviving a shipwreck. 23:32 - The conflict between Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech . 24:12 - "May they be destroyed, those who speak falsely..." Midrash Rabba, Bereishis 32. 25:41 - There are two types of truth. 30:45 - The Tzaddik includes all of mankind. 35:21 - Q&R about the decision made by Pinchas vs. the decision of Yosef's brothers. 37:18 - Q&R about the differences between tzaddikim . 38:33 - Q&R about the angels' opposition to the creation of man. 39:29 - The reason Hashem "cast the truth to the earth". 43:38 - PARAGRAPH 21. Truth is perfected only when it's combined with faith in Hashem. When justice and truth join, they become faith. Accomplishing this is the purpose of every soul. 51:09 - אמונה - Emunah - faith - is called ארץ - Eretz - land. 53:52 - Q&R about tzaddikim . 56:05 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon

Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 – PARAGRAPH 22. Emes v'emunah - truth and faith are like man and woman. דעת
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 22-23. אמת ואמונה - Truth and Faith; Parshas Bereishis - עזר כנגדו - Ezer Knegdo ; Parshas Noach - Migdal Bavel . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 – PARAGRAPH 22. Emes v'emunah - truth and faith are like man and woman. דעת - Daas - True Knowledge is produced by a union of אמת ואמונה. 08:33 - Parshas Bereishis - עזר כנגדו - Ezer Knegdo - helper in opposition. 13:00 - When a man is worthy, his wife helps him. When he's not worthy, she opposes him. 19:00 - The tzaddik is a seed of truth in this world. כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת - "...completely true seed..." ( Yirmiyah 2:21). 19:48 - Q&R about truth originating from the mother. 20:38 - PARAGRAPH 23. Conflict and anger cause destruction. 25:08 - Q&R about makhlokes l'shem shemayim - conflict for the sake of heaven. 26:34 - NOTE - Today is election day in Eretz Yisrael . 31:04 - Yuma 38. The destructive nature of makhlokes , for example between chassidim and misnagdim . 36:00 - NOTE - inspiring story about a donor in the Syrian community, Dovid Assoulin. Dispute between Beis Hillel and Beis Shammai . 40:40 - Nothing can be resolved through conflict. *43:06 - How to ask a sheyla . 44:08 - "Being yotzeh " - it's not enough to just "get by" in performing mitzvos . 46:16 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 27 . 46:35 - Eliyahu hu Moshiach . 49:33 - NOTE on Parshas Noach , Migdal Bavel .

lessons.title: 2022-11-02 - LH4 - YD1 - Ribis 5 - Para. 24-27
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 24-25. אמת - Truth and the Importance of Self-Confidence; Hashem's Forgiveness is Infinite. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Distancing from conflict. אמת - truth and the importance of self-confidence. 09:3
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 24-25. אמת - Truth and the Importance of Self-Confidence; Hashem's Forgiveness is Infinite. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Distancing from conflict. אמת - truth and the importance of self-confidence. 09:38 - PARAGRAPH 25. Any "truth" that detracts from a person's self-confidence in serving Hashem is not actually truth. This mistake originates with the angels' opposition to the creation of man. 12:10 - מָֽה־אֱ֖נוֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ - "What is man that You should remember him..." ( Tehillim 8:5). 15:10 - Self-confidence is strengthened by drawing closer to true tzaddikim . This is done by praying to be able to find a true tzaddik and praying to be able to receive and live by their teachings. 16:24 - Q&R - An example of drawing close to the tzaddik through an account about the students of Rebbe Nachman: Reb Aharon ז"ל. 19:47 - Hashem rejoices when a person "defeats" Him through prayer. Account from the life of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai . 21:11 - PARAGRAPH 26. An example of the above principle from the life of Dovid HaMelech : כִּֽי־פְ֖שָׁעַי אֲנִ֣י אֵדָ֑ע וְחַטָּאתִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד - "For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me" ( Tehillim 51:5). How Dovid HaMelech reasoned with Hashem about forgiveness. *25:29 - The Baal HaTanya ז"ל: Hashem's ability to forgive exceeds man's ability to sin. Hashem yearns (so to speak) to be merciful. 27:09 - Tefilos on Yom Kippur Katan . *29:00 - Dovid HaMelech's gratitude for Hashem's infinite ability to forgive, and he prays for spiritual insight. 32:04 - There is a type of teshuvah - return to Hashem - that transforms all past sins into merit. Reference to Sichos HaRan 50 . 33:23 - Q&R about understanding the words of Sefer Tehillim . 35:30 - PARAGRAPH 27. The avodah of Yerach Esonim - "Month of the Powerful Ones" - Tishrei - especially Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. 38:03 - הַקֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב - "...the voice is the voice of Yaakov..." ( Bereishis 27:22, Toldos ). The sounds of Torah, tefilah , and the shofar are aspects of the voice of Yaakov. 40:20 - בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ - "Know Him in all your ways..." ( Mishlei 3:6). The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh teaches on this possuk : Daah - Hey Vuv - through all of your paths, bring about a union of the last two letters in the Name of Hashem . *42:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Maimon's son asking about his teacher's emphasis on learning Torah full-time, while the building that housed the yeshiva had been built by workers who were not learning Torah full-time. If a person is only "high-intensity" in learning Torah, they won't succeed. Other activities are very important. 45:13 - The Four Species on Sukkos represent the diverse groups in Klal Yisrael . 49:03 - כִּי־אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה - "For then I will convert the peoples to a pure language..." ( Zephania 3:9). 49:38 - Everyone gets an aliya to the Torah on Simchas Torah . 51:12 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2022-11-03 - LH4 - YD1 - Ribis 5 - Para. 28-30a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 28-30a. אמת - Finding Truth is a Process; Simchas Torah and Parshas VeZos HaBerakha - Last Possuk in the Torah; Broken Luchos ; VaEira - Reluctance of Moshe Rabbeinu . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. Simch
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 28-30a. אמת - Finding Truth is a Process; Simchas Torah and Parshas VeZos HaBerakha - Last Possuk in the Torah; Broken Luchos ; VaEira - Reluctance of Moshe Rabbeinu . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. Simchas Torah and Parshas Zos HaBerakha . אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה משֶׁ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "...which Moshe performed before the eyes of all Israel" ( Devarim 34:12, Zos HaBerakha ). The last possuk in the Torah alludes to Moshe Rabbeinu breaking the Luchos HaBris by throwing them down to the ground. This was an aspect of "Truth was cast to the earth" . 06:35 - אמת - Hashem's truth is revealed in the world by Am Yisrael - the People of Israel. "There's no such thing as a Torah without the Jewish People." *08:44 - Why we join the last words of the Torah immediately with the first words "Bereishis Bara Elokim" are sofei teyvos Emes . Breaking the first luchos made it possible for Am Yisrael to begin serving Hashem all over again through every generation. 09:38 - A guest is obligated to obey the wishes of his host, except if asked to leave. 12:30 - תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֖נוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּ֑א - "You bring man to the crushing point..." ( Tehillim 90:3). A person can return to Hashem even from the lowest level. 13:12 - Q&R about the creation of the world through midas hadin - the attribute of justice. 14:15 - Q&R about a guest's obligation to his host. 14:39 - PARAGRAPH 29. A judge who faithfully rules on a decision of law is functioning as a partner with Hashem . 20:20 - Q&R about tempering judgement with compassion. The Sanhedrin never put a criminal to death. Analogy brought from Sipurey Masiyos, The Master of Prayer . 27:06 - 48 ways to acquire Torah: the importance of shimush chochomim - observing and supporting one's Torah teacher. We learn how to temper judgement with compassion by emulating the actions of tzaddikim . 29:40 - Q&R about how an unmarried woman can observe and support a tzaddik . 31:24 - Q&R about the last possuk quoted in the previous paragraph. אחד - one - Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 . 32:26 - Story about Reb Yudel ז"ל who, when he first met Rebbe Nachman, spoke with slight disrespect. To repair this - the Rebbe explained to him how it's possible to turn sheker into kesher . 34:26 - Q&R about how a married woman can observe and support a tzaddik . 34:52 - PARAGRAPH 30. Parshas VaEira - Moshe Rabbeinu's reluctance to take a leadership role in Am Yisrael .וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־משֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה: וָֽאֵרָ֗א אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־יִצְחָ֥ק וְאֶל־יַֽעֲקֹ֖ב בְּאֵ֣ל שַׁדָּ֑י וּשְׁמִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖עְתִּי לָהֶֽם - "Hashem spoke to Moshe, and He said to him, "I am Hashem. I appeared to Avraham, to Yitzchak, and to Yaakov with A - D - N - Y, but My Name Y - K - V - K, I did not become known to them." ( Shemos 6:2-3, VaEira ). Finding truth is a process. 39:54 - וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֹתִ֗י זֶ֚ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים - "...yet they have tested me these ten times..." ( Bamidbar 14:22, Shelach ). 43:05 - The yetzer hara draws its power from the angels' opposition to the creation of man. 43:49 - Moshe Rabbeinu's confrontation with Pharaoh. 46:03 - The "truth" of Dasan and Aviram seemed reasonable. Even the greatest tzaddik can be affected by the defective אמת that originated in the angels' objection to the creation of man. 50:12 - This mistake about the nature of truth occurs in every generation. "The Ivy League is Poison Ivy." *51:05 - Q&R about connecting with Breslov traditions and applications of Rebbe Nachman's teachings via contemporaries. 55:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Ribis 5 - Parshas Vayera - Truth and Real Truth - Avraham Avinu vs. Avimelech - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Text: Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5, Para. 33-34. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 32b. 03:45 - PARAGRAPH 33. Moshe Rabbeinu merits a greater level of truth through speaking to Hashem about his reluctance to lead Am Yisrael . 05:53 - Egel HaZahav - Sin of the Golden Calf. 14:24 - Baal HaTanya : man's ability to sin never exceeds Hashem's ability to forgive. 15:19 - NOTE: Bnei Yissachar on the Yud Gimmel Midos . 16:16 - NOTE: Kiddush Lavana . 19:53 - Searching for the real truth continues throughout every generation. 24:40 - Tehillim "v'Ani Tefilasi..." - "I am prayer..." . 27:19 - The Torah is the "Book of Truth". 28:40 - Q&R - if a person has a cheerful attitude why should he want to change Hashem's decrees? 34:04 - PARAGRAPH 34. Parshas Vayera. Avimelech's claim of innocence and his blame of Avraham Avinu . *44:00 - Parshas Vayera. Truth and the Real Truth. Avraham Avinu confronts Avimelech . 50:57 - מִי־יַֽ֖עֲלֶה בְּהַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִי־יָ֜ק֗וּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ - "Who will ascend Hashem's mountain and who will stand in His Holy place?" נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּבַ֪ר לֵ֫בָ֥ב - "He who has clean hands and a pure heart..." ( Tehillim 24:3-4). 54:15 - Q&R about spiritual purity. Rabbi Moshe Burstein zal remarried in his seventies so he could continue being a Baal Tefilah . 55:39 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5 - Changing the Truth for the Sake of Peace - Havdalah on Motzei Shabbos - Wisdom and Wine - Parshas Acharei Mos - Torah reading for Yom Kippur - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, Ribis 5 - Changing the Truth for the Sake of Peace - Havdalah on Motzei Shabbos - Wisdom and Wine - Parshas Acharei Mos - Torah reading for Yom Kippur - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Ribis 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 35. Changing the truth for the sake of peace. 02:36 - PARAGRAPH 36. Before creating man, Hashem cast the truth to the earth. 13:58 - וְהָֽאֱמֶ֥ת וְהַשָּׁל֖וֹם אֱהָֽבוּ - "...but love truth and peace" ( Zecharia 8:19) 17:47 - Q&R about how and when conflicts in Am Yisrael will be resolved. 17:00 - PARAGRAPH 37. Havdalah on Motzei Shabbos draws the holiness of Shabbos into the weekdays. 21:52 - Shabbos is the essence of truth. 26:12 - NOTE about Korach's mistake. 27:29 - Q&R about sichos chulin - the "everyday" speech of tzaddikim . 28:08 - PARAGRAPH 38. פֶּן־יֶֽהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־יְהוָֹה֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְנָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ רָֽב - "...lest they break trying to see Hashem, many of them will fall" ( Shemos 19:21, Yisro ). *33:21 - PARAGRAPH 39. Parshas Acharei Mos - the prohibition of drinking wine to excess before entering the Mishkan/Beis HaMikdash . 37:34 - Why the Torah's prescription about wine immediately follows the death of Aharon HaKohen's sons, Nadav and Avihu . Why this incident is part of the Torah reading for Yom Kippur . How this prohibition relates to Havdalah on Motzei Shabbos . 41:02 - PARAGRAPH 40. Wisdom and wine: " When wine enters, a secret goes out" ( Eruvin 65). 44:05 - A drunkard is not permitted to be a judge. When a person is drunk, everything seems to be permissible. 45:47 - PARAGRAPH 41. More about why the Torah reading for Yom Kippur morning begins with the passing away of Aharon HaKohen's sons. אַֽחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַֽהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵֽי־יְהוָֹ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ - " ...after the death of Aaron's two sons, when they drew near before the Lord, and they died" ( Vayikra 16:1-3, Acharei Mos ). הֵ֑נָּה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַֽחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת - "...behold the soul that sins, it will die" ( Yechezkel 18:4). 50:45 - וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶֽאֱמֶֽת - "...and abundant in loving kindness and truth" ( Shemos 34:6, Ki Sisa ). 52:30 - Q&R about using wine to expand the consciousness.

Reference to Likutey Moharan 62 . Emunah depends on emes . 32:00 - "Truth was cast to the earth." 32:37 - Q&R about emunah . 33:34 - Q&R about truth being "one". 34:51 - PARAGRAPH 44. lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1, MeOneyn uMenacheysh 2 - Para. 2-4. Prohibition of Sorcery, Magic, and Fortune-Telling; Sincerity in Serving Hashem ; Torah Tradition That Mondays and Wednesdays Are Not Opportune for New Ventures. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ - "Be wholehearted with Hashem, your Master" ( Devarim 18:13). 12:30 - The importance of sincerity and simplicity in serving Hashem . Being wholehearted by avoiding all forms of sorcery is a key to meriting Eretz Yisrael . 18:00 - Prophecy will be restored when Am Yisrael has qualified, fitting leaders. 19:00 - Q&R about the perception of Hashem's intervention in one's life. 21:30 - NOTE about the modest standard of living of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. 22:47 - PARAGRAPH 3. The Torah tradition that Mondays and Wednesdays are not opportune ( Yoreh Deah 189:2). 27:00 - וְהָיָ֚ה אֽוֹר־הַלְּבָנָה֙ כְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַמָּ֔ה - "And the light of the moon shall be like the light of the sun..." ( Yeshaya 30:26). In the future, all that's lacking will be restored. 31:49 - Q&R about the second day of creation. Positive vs. negative separation 34:28 - PARAGRAPH 4. Observing Rosh Chodesh is a recognition of the constant renewal of creation. 37:48 - All Jewish holidays are celebrations of miracles when Hashem revealed His actions above the laws of nature. This is why all holidays are scheduled based on Rosh Chodesh . *40:23 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld ז"ל about the definition of "miracle". 41:41 - NOTE about the missing letter "noon" in Ashrey ( Tehillim 145). 43:05 - Q&R about the positive and negative aspects of separation. 45:16 - Why kiddush hachodesh - sanctification of the new month - was the first mitzvah given to Klal Yisrael . 46:48 - כָּעֵ֗ת יֵֽאָמֵ֤ר לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה־פָּעַ֖ל אֵֽל - "...in time it will be said to Yaakov and Yisrael , 'What has Hashem done?'" ( Bamidbar 23:23, Balak ). 49:40 - Concluding paragraph. 51:06 - Closing blessings; announcements regarding Rabbi Rosenfeld ז"ל's yahrzeit .

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 60 - Sipurey Masiyos - The Lost Princess - Yiras Hashem - Choni HaMaagel - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. 02:04 - PARAGRAPH 1. 05:35 - This Torah is known as an explanation of the first story in Sipurey Masiyos - "The Lost Princess". Explanation of the "mountain of gold" at the end of the story. 08:17 - The meaning of "carve for yourself" when Moshe Rabbeinu is told to engrave the luchos . 11:50 - PARAGRAPH 2. *13:58 - What is arichas yomim - length-of-days? 18:11 - PARAGRAPH 3. 24:18 - אַל־תַּחְמֹ֣ד יָ֖פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֜קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ - "Do not covet her beauty in your heart, and do not let her captivate you with her eyelids" ( Mishlei 6:25). 29:24 - All the different types of wealth are dependent on rain. And rain is an aspect of breath. *30:55 - הֲיֵ֨שׁ בְּהַבְלֵ֚י הַגּוֹיִם֙ מַגְשִׁמִ֔ים - "Are there among the vanities of the nations those who give rain?" ( Yirmiyahu 14:22). The functioning of the intellect depends on breathing, which maintains the moisture of the body. 34:07 - נֵ֣ר יְ֖הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם - "The soul of man is the lamp of Hashem..." ( Mishlei 20:27). 34:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. יראה - fear/reverence - is perfected by developing its three aspects: fear of Hashem , of one's teacher, and of one's parents. 37:12 - One's wealth should be divided into three portions: business, real estate, and liquid assets. ( Bava Metzia 42a). 41:20 - PARAGRAPH 5. Giving birth reveals fear of Hashem. 43:41 - PARAGRAPH 6. Spiritual sleep is caused through sins or impure food. Bread supports the heart ( Rus 3:7). *49:28 - Sipurey Masiyos have the power to awaken people from spiritual sleep. The 70 Faces of the Torah are hidden in the stories of the world. 54:25 - וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד - "...abundant kindness ..." ( Shemos 34:6, Ki Sisa ). 56:34 - PARAGRAPH 7. A Torah teacher needs to have worthy students. 59:38 - וְעָלֵ֖הוּ לִתְרוּפָֽה - "...and its leaves shall be as a cure" ( Yechezkel 47:12). "Healing leaves" are the "mundane" conversations of a Torah scholar. 60:44 - PARAGRAPH 8. 66:38 - Spiritual aspects of breaking an earthenware plate at a marriage engagement. 73:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Shofar . 78:40 - PARAGRAPH 10. Choni HaMaagel . 91:02 - PARAGRAPH 11.

lessons.bodyText: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 1a. Prohibition of Tattoos and Other Self-Harm - What to Remember and What to Forget - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . 02:43 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . NOTE about Chanukah and memory. Even though eating olives causes forgetfulness, olive oil strengthens memory. 05:35 - When a person forgets what they should forget, they will be able to remember the essential truth of Olam HaBa - the Future World. 06:50 - NOTE: Sipurey Masiyos - "The Seven Beggars". The First Beggar remembers "nothing" because he is able to close his eyes to the material world. *09:07 - When a person dwells on what they're supposed to be forgetting, they forget what they should be remembering! 11:51 - NOTE: a newborn forgets the Torah he knew before he was born. Forgetting is an aspect of achieving holy memory. Chanukah . 16:32 - Q&R about Olam Haba . 17:30 - Q&R - How can we connect with something we don't experience? The use of imagination to achieve spiritual advancement. 19:35 - Q&R about סור מרע ועשה טוב - Turning away from evil is the first step toward doing good. 21:11 - We do not delve into the halakhos of death unless a person is actually in the state of mourning. This is an aspect of forgetting about death in order to remember life. 26:54 - The main prohibition of excessive mourning is self-harm as an expression of grief. This is in contrast to non-Jewish customs of tearing out the hair of their head, or doing other kinds of self-harm. This behavior is forbidden by the Torah. 29:08 - The hair of the head is an aspect of malkhus . Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . 30:32 - The prohibition of tattoos or tearing out hair from the head. Self harm weakens memory. 31:52 - NOTE about Jewish customs in remembrance of those who passed away. 34:30 - Q&R about achieving balance in mourning. *36:07 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the conduct of Reb Michel Dorfman zal during mourning. 38:08 - Closing blessings. 39:22 - NOTE about a song "Woe to us that we're going to die!" 40:26 - NOTE about travel ads in Jewish magazines.

lessons.bodyText: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 1b-2 - Unity in Klal Yisrael via Minhag HaMakom; Prohibition of Tattoos. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 1b. 04:04 - "Between your eyes..." Tefillin vs. pulling out the hair of the head. 05:50 - Prohibition of tearing out hair or other forms of self-harm to express grief. 07:34 - Strengthening unity in Klal Yisrael by respecting Minhag HaMakom - the customs regarding of one's community. 12:20 - Divrei Elokim Chaim - roshei teivos "Echad" . 13:40 - Q&R about the intentions behind non-Jewish custom of self-harm to express mourning. 16:16 - HALAKHA 2. This halakha is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 17:00 - מדמה - Medameh - the power of imagination. 22:34 - Body and soul are parallel animal and human. Reference to Likutey Moharan 37 . 23:58 - Medameh also refers to the ability to compare or make mental associations. 24:14 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . 25:14 - The confusion caused by the medameh is based in the sin of Adam HaRishon . How purification of the מדמה is achieved. 29:19 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 8, Para. 9 . 29:30 - The prohibition of excessive mourning through inflicting self-harm. Death is a transition to eternal life. 32:38 - Self harm negates the holiness of the physical. 35:50 - The prohibition of tattoos or any permanent defacement of the body. Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 about the difference between reading print and hearing. *42:00 - The purpose of living in the physical world is to purify the physical. The term אדם - man - is three times Hashem's Name Y - K. When a person disfigures his body, he denies its spiritual aspect and displays lack of faith in the principle that Hashem constantly renews the world. 44:19 - Techiyas HaMeyis is the completion of the purification of the physical body of man. 46:02 - Q&R about decomposition of the body after death. Suffering in this world reduces suffering in the next. 47:27 - Q&R about purification of the body. 50:31 - Q&R - Depression stems from the body, not the soul. 51:19 - Introduction to Hilkhos Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3. Closing blessings.

Perfected faith brings those who are distant from HaShem closer to Him. 12:19 - PARAGRAPH 4. Elevation and purification of speech. וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלָ֜יו יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֘ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִי֒ יְדַבֶּר־נָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֤ דָבָר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י וְאַל־יִ֥חַר אַפְּךָ֖ בְּעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י כָמ֖וֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹֽה - "Then Yehudah approached him and said, 'Please, my lord, let now your servant speak something into my lord's ears, and let not your wrath be kindled against your servant, for you are like Pharaoh'" ( Bereishis 44:18, Vayigash ). 14:01 - PARAGRAPH 5. The three officers of Pharaoh correspond to the trachea, esophagus, and veins. 00:00 - To elevate speech it's necessary to fast. 28:07 - Faith is "A beautiful maiden who has no eyes." 30:48 - PARAGRAPH 6. The prayer of a tzaddik can influence HaShem to rearrange nature. 35:55 - PARAGRAPH 7. Vayigash Yehudah . 38:02 - PARAGRAPH 8. Explanation of the opening verse "So HaShem led the People around..." 39:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. Peace between the members of Am Yisrael destroys heresy. 42:16 - PARAGRAPH 10. Dispute gives rise to Torah Law. Reference to Likutey Moharan 12, Para. 4 .

Hilkhos Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 2b. Writing is remembrance for future generations. 05:39 - The main prohibition of writing on the body is not to cut the skin. 15:55 - Q&Rs about writing on the skin, tattoos, and engraving. 21:21 - HALAKHA 3. Hilkhos Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . Shalom leads to teshuvah . וְהָֽדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן - "...and you shall respect the elderly..." ( Vayikra 19:32, Kedoshim ). 25:58 - There is a connection between peace and bitterness - medicines are bitter. 26:57 - Sickness in the body results from a lack of peace between its four basic elements: fire, water, air, and earth. 28:28 - PARAGRAPH 1. Every Jew has the potential to bring the world to teshuvah . 35:31 - Q&R about speaking with people who are not Torah observant. 37:05 - PARAGRAPH 2. וּכְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֹֽה - "...and You shall not etch a tattoo on yourselves. I am Hashem" ( Vayikra 19:28, Kedoshim ). Every part of a Jew's body corresponds to a place in the world. 48:04 - Closing blessings - the importance of every part of the body.

lessons.title: 2022-12-09 - LH4 - YD1 - Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 3-5
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 3-5. Restoring Hadras Ponim Through Mourning and Eulogy; Visiting Graves of Tzaddikim - Customs and Procedure. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Hadras Ponim - spiritual radiance of the face. When the soul leaves th
lessons.bodyText: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 3-5. Restoring Hadras Ponim Through Mourning and Eulogy; Visiting Graves of Tzaddikim - Customs and Procedure. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Hadras Ponim - spiritual radiance of the face. When the soul leaves the body, the Hadras Ponim departs. It is restored through the mitzvos of mourning and eulogy performed by those who survive. Visiting the grave of the soul also restores Hadras Ponim . 07:40 - A tzaddik is greater in death than in his lifetime. 09:58 - Shalom is achieved through harmonizing opposites. 13:57 - At the hour a tzaddik leaves this world, three groups of angels descend to meet him. *17:20 - Q&R about the passing of a tzaddik and procedure when visiting kivrei tzaddikim . We pray only to Hashem , not to the tzaddik . 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The importance of visiting grave of tzaddikim often. The kever of a tzaddik has the holiness of Eretz Yisrael ( Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh ). צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ - "The righteous shall inherit the land..." ( Tehillim 37:29). *30:00 - Tzaddikim are more present and active in this world after their passing than they were during their lifetime. ( Zohar HaKodesh, Acharei Mos ) 30:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. The purpose of eulogy and mourning is to restore the Hadras Ponim of the one who passed away. Reference to Sichos HaRan 45 . 36:35 - The Ten Types of Song and reciting Tehillim at Kivrei Tzaddikim . Reciting Tikkun HaKlali at the gravesite of Rebbe Nachman ( Sichos HaRan 141 ). 38:00 - עֲלֵֽי־עָ֖שׂוֹר וַֽעֲלֵי־נָ֑בֶל עֲלֵ֖י הִגָּי֣וֹן בְּכִנּֽוֹר - "Upon a ten-stringed harp and upon a psaltery, with speech upon a harp" ( Tehillim 92:4). 39:56 - Q&R about peace as a resolution of opposites. 41:54 - Ana BeKoach - 72 three-letter words comprise a powerful Name of Hashem . 72 is b'gematria חסד - chessed - loving-kindness. 72 times three is 216 - גבורה - gevurah - strength/restraint. 44:54 - Bitterness is part of the process toward establishing peace. 45:00 - Restoring the Hadras Ponim of a person who passed away. וְאֹ֣הֲבָ֔יו כְּצֵ֥את הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָת֑וֹ - "They that love Him as the sun when he goes forth in his might" ( Shoftim 5:31). 48:48 - לָשׂ֣וּם | לַֽאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר - "To place for the mourners of Zion beauty instead of ashes..." ( Yeshaya 61:3). Tzaddikim are called ציון - Tziyon . Through yearning for the tzaddik , we draw his soul into this world. 50:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . The process of receiving the neshoma yesayra in 6 stages begins Layl Shabbos and is completed during Kedusha of Shabbos Mussaf . Nefesh means ratzon - yearning. 53:00 - Through visiting kivrei tzaddikim , a person receives Hadras Ponim . 54:00 - Tziyon is begematria Yosef . 54:38 - Achieving peace is a two-step process. 58:20 - Every Jew can restore the Hadras Ponim of the tzaddikim in Olam HaBah and bring the light of Hashem into this world. עַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ - "And your people, all of them righteous, shall inherit the Land forever..." ( Yeshaya 60:21). 60:00 - Hadras ponim is temporarily lost when a person passes away, but is restored through the mitzvos of mourning. This process is an aspect of "...beauty instead of ashes" .

lessons.title: 2022-12-11 - LH4 - YD1 - Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 6-12a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 6-12a - Eulogy for a Tzaddik Brings Peace; Parshas Nitzavim ; The Difference Between Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The essence of eulogy and mourning is to restore Hadras Poni
lessons.bodyText: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 6-12a - Eulogy for a Tzaddik Brings Peace; Parshas Nitzavim ; The Difference Between Shaul HaMelech and Dovid HaMelech . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The essence of eulogy and mourning is to restore Hadras Ponim - spiritual radiance of the face - and thereby bring shalom - peace. 02:45 - PARAGRAPH 7. The prohibition of tearing out the hair of the head to express mourning. 05:46 - PARAGRAPH 8. The hair of a Nazir is kodesh - holy. 08:05 - Q&R about the flow of mochin - spiritual consciousness - into the hair. 10:09 - PARAGRAPH 9. 300 halakhos were forgotten during the mourning period for Moshe Rabbeinu . Asniel ben Kanaz was able to retrieve these halakhos . This was an aspect of restoring the lost Hadras Ponim of Moshe Rabbeinu . 14:58 - PARAGRAPH 10. The eulogy of a tzaddik brings shalom to those who mourn him and mitigates the bitterness of his passing. 18:20 - The famine during the time of Dovid HaMelech ( 2Shmuel 21). This was a direct result of Israel's elders failing to mourn Shaul HaMelech properly (Shabbos 105). 16:31 - The famine during the reign of Dovid HaMelech was also a result of Shaul HaMelech commanding Doeg to kill the kohanim of Nove , thus taking away the parnassah of the Gibonim Yevamos 78). 21:40 - Shaul HaMelech was the "Chosen One" of Hashem and didn't lower himself to bring the Gibonim to teshuvah . The complete tzidkus - righteousness - of Shaul HaMelech was an obstacle for him. ( Yuma 22). 24:54 - In contrast to Shaul HaMelech , Dovid HaMelech was involved in bringing even the lowest sinner back to Hashem , as in יָחֹס עַל־דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ - "He will have pity on the poor and needy, and he will save the souls of the needy" ( Tehillim 72:13). 26:30 - אַתֶּ֨ם נִצָּבִ֤ים הַיּוֹם֙ כֻּלְּכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֣ם שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרֵיכֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - " You are all standing this day before Hashem, Your Master - the leaders of your tribes, your elders and your officers, every man of Israel..." טַפְּכֶ֣ם נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם וְגֵ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַֽחֲנֶ֑יךָ מֵֽחֹטֵ֣ב עֵצֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד שֹׁאֵ֥ב מֵימֶֽיךָ - "...your young children, your women, and your convert who is within your camp, both your woodcutters and your water drawers" ( Devarim 29:9-10, Nitzavim ). 28:24 - Shalom brings blessing; famine is a sign there is lack of shalom . Reference to Likutey Moharan 39 . 29:56 - Q&R about when to bring a person closer to Hashem , and when not to. 31:23 - NOTE - Moshe Rabbeinu saving Micah from being killed by the Egyptians; Parshas Vayishlach - the importance of having the ability to wait. 33:34 - Q&R about Shaul HaMelech and the difference between making a mistake vs. being an evil person. 35:38 - Q&R about Shaul HaMelech losing the kingdom. 36:13 - PARAGRAPH 11. Purim. There is no generation that is an orphan. Reference to Likutey Moharan 27 . In every generation the tzaddikim are confronted with opposition. 44:59 - PARAGRAPH 12. Man is a combination of physical and spiritual. Harmonizing these opposites creates peace. 47:36 - Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: Chanukah 5783 - Tzedakah Brings the Light of Peace and Truth. A special message from Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - צדקה - charity - illuminates the world with Hashem's Light. Reference to Likutey Moharan 27 . 01:48 - וְהָיָ֛ה מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַצְּדָקָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָבֶ֖טַח עַד־עוֹלָֽם - "Charity shall bring peace, it will bring tranquility and confidence forever" ( Yeshaya 32:17). 02:11 - מַרְבֶּה צְדָקָה, מַרְבֶּה שָׁלוֹם - "The more charity, the more peace..." lessons.title: 2022-12-12 - LH4 - YD1 - Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 12b-14
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 12b-14 - Suffering is a Bitter Cure; Parshas Zochor - Amalek ; Purim - Mordechai's Opposition to Haman Brought Peace. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. יִּ֩יצֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָ
lessons.bodyText: Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 - Para. 12b-14 - Suffering is a Bitter Cure; Parshas Zochor - Amalek ; Purim - Mordechai's Opposition to Haman Brought Peace. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Karcha uKhsoves KaAka 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 27 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. יִּ֩יצֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים - "And Hashem formed man of dust from the ground, and He breathed into his nostrils the soul of life..." ( Bereishis 2:7, Bereishis ). Man is a combination of spiritual and physical. The Seven Days of Creation are balanced evenly between "upper" and "lower". Man's task is elevate the world to a state of שלום - shalom - peace. 04:00 - Peace is a harmonization of opposites. Reference to Likutey Moharan 80 . 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Bitterness is a necessary and healing element in achieving peace. 17:30 - וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לְהִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ - "...and they could not delay..." ( Shemos 12:39, Bo ). Hashem knows and allocates exactly the amount of bitterness a person needs as a cure. 21:50 - Amalek is the constant enemy of Am Yisrael . When a person rebels against Hashem in protest of the bitterness he is receiving, he receives more bitterness. *25:30 - Even though Hashem is kind and tries to make a person's life easy, He dispenses bitterness as a spiritual cure. This is an aspect of "peace cloaked in bitterness" and is actually a kindness. *28:00 - NOTE: "If a person isn't willing to suffer a little, he will suffer a lot." Hashem pays a person according to their actions, as in וּלְךָ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּמַֽעֲשֵֽׂהוּ - "And You, Hashem, have kindness, for You repay a man according to his deed" ( Tehillim 62:13). 31:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Reb Michel Dorfman ז"ל - he used to ask Hashem to please keep in mind that he's not able to bear the kind of bitterness that a greater person could. 33:30 - Q&R about understanding one's suffering. Sometimes a person has to go through difficulty because of a previous reincarnation. Pegam HaMishpat is the mistake of judging Hashem . 39:00 - Parshas Zachor - Amalek. Israel waged war against Amalek when Amalek tried to cool the warmth of Israel's attachment to Hashem . 44:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Purim - Mordechai , Esther , and Haman-Amalek . 49:00 - The name Mordechai is composed of the words מר - bitter - and דרור - "freedom/peace". Mordechai's opposition to Haman brought peace to the world. 52:00 - Q&R about bitterness. 57:00 - NOTE about Chanukah : twice Yavan - Greece - is 760, which is twice Nachash - serpant. 58:00 - Closing blessings for peace.

lessons.bodyText: Yahrzeit of the Bas Ayin ; Holiness of Eretz Yisrael ; Opposition to the Creation of Man; Shabbos is the Source of Blessing. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 02:53 - Yahrzeit of Rabbi Avraham Dov Ber B'Rav Dovid Avritch, the Bas Ayin ז"ל. Story about perceiving the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . 14:55 - Hashem consulted with the angels before creating man. 20:04 - The mission of a Jew is to grow. 20:37 - The eight lights of Chanukah correspond to the 8 times the word אמת - emes - truth - is said in tefilas Shacharis . 25:38 - Shabbos is the source of all blessing. 27:28 - The last letters of the words "zavas chalav udevash (flowing with milk and honey)" spell Shabbos . 30:26 - There are four levels in creation: domem, tzomeyach, chai, medaber . 31:33 - Closing blessing.

lessons.title: 2022-12-14 - LH4 - YD4 - Giluach 1 - Giluach 2 - Introduction - Beard and Peyos - Holy Aging - Rav Eliyah Chaim Rosen zal
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Michel Dorfman z"l
lessons.description: Giluach 1 - Giluach 2 - Introduction - Beard and Peyos - Holy Aging - Rabbi Eliyahu Chaim Rosen zal . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 , which Rebbe Nachman taught on Shabbos Chanukah . *00:00 - This shiur was given on the 20th of Kislev , the yahrzeit of Rabbi Eliyahu Chaim
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 1 - Giluach 2 - Introduction - Beard and Peyos - Holy Aging - Rabbi Eliyahu Chaim Rosen zal . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 , which Rebbe Nachman taught on Shabbos Chanukah . *00:00 - This shiur was given on the 20th of Kislev , the yahrzeit of Rabbi Eliyahu Chaim b'Reb Klonimus Kalman Rosen (1899-1984). Rabbi Maimon shares biographical notes about the life of this accomplished and dedicated Torah scholar, co-founder of the Central Breslov Yeshiva in Meah Shaarim, and revered elder in the Breslov community. 07:10 - HALAKHA 1. The prohibition of shaving the beard and peyos. Ekev is twice Peya . Avraham Avinu did not cut his peyos in order to distinguish himself from rest of the world. 13:14 - The hair of the face and head is an aspect of chokhma tata - the lower level of the intellect - also called מלכות. 14:20 - Malkhus has no light of its own. It has to receive from chokhma . For this reason, each of the three Avos contributed some of their years so that Dovid HaMelech could live. 16:00 - אֵ֚לֶּה מֽוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה - "These are Hashem's appointed ..." ( Vayikra 23:4, Emor ). 17:36 - Arba Malchios of the Sitra Achra are the four exiles. Malkhus . 19:00 - HaShem will establish His Throne through chessed . When HaShem loves someone, He rebukes them. Rebuke is a revelation of chessed . 19:53 - Prohibition of shaving the beard and peyos . The beard and peyos are the hadras ponim of a Jew, as in מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָֽדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן - "You shall rise before a venerable person and you shall respect the elderly" ( Vayikra 19:32, Kedoshim ). 20:58 - חָכְמַ֤ת אָדָם֙ תָּאִ֣יר פָּנָ֔י ו - "...a man's wisdom illuminates his face..." ( Koheles 8:1). The Thirteen Attributes of Kindness are related to the beard. Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 and Likutey Moharan 27 . 21:50 - Hairs are pipelines. The Hebrew word for hair - שיער - is related to the word for "measure" - שיעור. 25:40 - The prohibition of cutting stones for an altar with a metal tool. 27:52 - The two peyos (right and left) and the beard (center) correspond to the three major holidays and the three Avos . 28:26 - Meaning of "the Light of HaShem's Face". 28:44 - Miracles increase fear of HaShem . Avraham Avinu is the "right side" - chessed , Yitzchak Avinu is the "left side" - gevurah , Yaakov Avinu is "center" - tiferes . *32:21 - Q&R about animal sacrifices in the Beis HaMikdash . The difference between the life of an animal and the life of a human being. 33:26 - Q&R about the halakha of shaving the beard and peyos . 35:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal to illustrate how a tzaddik sometimes disguises himself. 41:00 - Back into the text: cutting all the other hair of the head is permitted and spiritually beneficial. 44:21 - HALAKHA 2. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Giluach 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . When HaShem reveals His ratzon - will - in a way that contradicts the rules of nature, man respects and fears Him. 48:29 - Metzach haratzon and "holy aging". *51:22 - Holy aging means becoming ever kinder and more productive as life continues, as opposed to falling into קְצַ֥ר יָ֜מִ֗ים וּֽשְׂבַ֣ע־רֹֽגֶז - "...short of days and full of fear" ( Iyov 14:1). 52:57 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Giluach 3 - Para. 2-3a. The 13 Tikkunim of the Beard; Azus deKedusha - Holy Persistence; Chanukah and the 13 Attributes of Kindness, Bechukosai . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The spiritual importance of the beard and the meaning of the concept of the "Beard of Hashem" . The 13 Tikkunim of the Beard correspond to the 13 principles through which the Torah is acquired. 12:00 - דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים בְּנַ֖חַת נִשְׁמָעִ֑ים מִזַּֽעֲקַ֥ת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בַּכְּסִילִֽים - "The words of the wise are heard softly, more than the shout of a ruler of fools" ( Koheles 9:17). *18:00 - Q&R about how the spiritual attributes of hair relate to women. 21:00 - חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֨מֶת֙ נְקַם־בְּרִ֔ית - "...an army that avenges the avenging of a covenant..." ( Vayikra 26:25, Bechukosai ). וְעַל־חַרְבְּךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה - "And you shall live by your sword..." ( Bereishis 27:40, Toldos ). 25:00 - Tikkun HaBris protects אמונה - faith - and purity of mind. 28:00 - NOTE - analogy of a child operating the controls of a war room and not seeing any results. 30:00 - Q&R about the connection between physical actions and spiritual consequences. 31:00 - Q&R about the prerequisites necessary for learning and/or teaching kabbalah . 34:35 - PARAGRAPH 3. Rebuke is a kindness. Azus deKedusha - holy persistence - relates to the 13 Tikkunim of the Beard which correspond to the 13 Attributes of Kindness. (Reference to Zohar Naso 130). פִּיהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחָכְמָ֑ה - "She opens her mouth with wisdom..." ( Mishlei 31:26). *42:48 - NOTE - During Chanukah the Shekhina HaKadosha makes a bikur cholim visit into our homes. Chanukah and the 13 Attributes of Kindness. Yaakov is 7 times Y - K - V - K and Yosef is 6 times Y - K - V - K. The combination of these two aspects of Hashem's 13 Attributes of Kindness. 48:03 - Biographical note about Rabbi Michel Dorfman ז"ל when he was first arrived in Meah Shaarim from Russia and had to make a decision about wearing a streimel . 50:37 - "Sometimes preparing for a mitzvah is just as important as the mitzvah itself." 53:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Giluach 3 - Para. 3b-6. Ohr HaPanim ; Sohd HaIbur ; Chanukah and the 13 Attributes of Kindness; the Four Parshios . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. The Ohr HaPanim is spiritual light emanating from the kingdom of Moshiach. It is the highest source of
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 3 - Para. 3b-6. Ohr HaPanim ; Sohd HaIbur ; Chanukah and the 13 Attributes of Kindness; the Four Parshios . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. The Ohr HaPanim is spiritual light emanating from the kingdom of Moshiach. It is the highest source of malkhus . 06:36 - Tefilah - malkhus - rescues Am Yisrael from exile. Malkhus is represented by the letter Dalet and corresponds to the four exiles. 07:27 - The beard receives from the highest source of malkhus - ( Aitz Chaim 13:12). 09:29 - PARAGRAPH 4. The three holidays are scheduled by the spiritual elders of the generation. 11:30 - Sohd haIbur - the secret of the intercalation of the thirteenth month added in a leap year. The thirteen month ( Adar Sheni ) is related to the 13 Attributes of Kindness. *16:00 - Q&R about how Ohr HaPanim - Emes relates to Chanukah . The Thirteen Formulas through which the Torah is expounded relate to the Thirteen Attributes. Seven times Yaakov is Y - K - V - K . The first seven days of Chanukah correspond to the first seven of the 13 Attributes of Kindness. The eighth day of Chanukah relates to the final six attributes of the Thirteen. 18:30 - שמן - Shemen is begematria shemayim - the Light from Above. The lowest level permissible to light Chanukah candles is 3 tefachim . 3 times tefach is ארץ - eretz . 19:50 - Q&R about the connection between Binah and Chanukah - Binah is the eighth level up from malkhus . *20:35 - PARAGRAPH 5. The Four Parshios during Adar and Nissan . 22:45 - Parshas Shekolim . 24:00 - Parshas Zochor - bringing about the downfall of Amalek . 25:00 - Parshas Parah - purification from contact with a dead body. Rebuke is associated with din , even though in truth it is chessed . 30:40 - The Parah Aduma is accomplished in Moshe Rabbeinu's name. Every procedure of Parah Aduma must include ashes from the original Parah Aduma , to create an unbroken connection with Moshe Rabbeinu and his ability to give true rebuke. 33:40 - The procedure of Parah Aduma cannot be done by the Kohen Gadol . 35:40 - The custom of a Torah sage being interpreted through a meturgamon - translator. 38:45 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 140 . 40:30 - Parshas HaChodesh - Rosh Chodesh is a manifestation of malkhus . 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The Four Parshios as related to the Arba Bonim - Four Sons - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 - Para. 6 . 44:00 - וְחָכְמַ֤ת הַמִּסְכֵּן֙ בְּזוּיָ֔ה - " ...but the wisdom heard from a poor man is disregarded..." ( Koheles 9:16). Parshas Shekalim corresponds to Yitzchak . He is the Ben Chakhom and is associated with Ohr HaPanim and tzedakah . 46:00 - Parshas Zachor . 47:15 - Parshas HaChodesh corresponds to Yaakov Avinu . He is the Ben Taam and is also associated with the Ohr HaPanim . 48:49 - Chanukah schedule: Chayeh Moharan shiur today begins at 4 pm Israel time (9 am EST) and will be only half an hour long. Throughout Chanukah , the daily Likutey Halakhos shiur will begin at 8:15 am to accommodate the longer morning tefilos .

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 65 - Boaz and Rus - Master of the Field - Gathering Flowers of Speech to Create Prayer - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) PARAGRAPH 1. וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶל־ר֜וּת הֲלֹ֧א שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ בִּתִּ֗י - "And Boaz said to Rus, 'Listen well, my daughter' ..." ( Rus 2:8). The Master of the Field. *PARAGRAPH 2. Souls bear fruit when they carry out the will of HaShem . Gathering flowers of speech to create prayer. PARAGRAPH 3. Unity is the ultimate goal, as in בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד - "...on that day HaShem will be One and His Name will be One" ( Zecharia 14:9). When a person is in pain, he closes his eyes. PARAGRAPH 5. The joy experienced when a person is released from suffering brings him to a higher level of insight. When the Jews sinned, their crowns were taken away. PARAGRAPH 6. The Master of the Field enables a person to unify his prayer. Unification of the beginning of creation with the end is related to the concept of MaNTzPaKh - the five ending-letters of the AlefBeis . PARAGRAPH 7. וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶל־ר֜וּת הֲלֹ֧א שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ בִּתִּ֗י - "And Boaz said to Rus, 'Listen well, my daughter'..." ( Rus 2:8). * Boaz is the Sechel/Neshama and Rus is the Nefesh - lower soul. "Let your ears hear what you say." The Field of Souls corresponds to Gan Eden . PARAGRAPH 9. The future circle of Tzaddikim .

(Recorded in 1960.) 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1A. The tzaddik is like a tree. At the time of a tzaddik's passing, his students - the branches of the tree - can receive a double portion of spiritual power. 03:47 - PARAGRAPH 1B. The tzaddik achieves more after his passing than he does during his lifetime. 08:04 - PARAGRAPH 1C. There are many different types of students. Kavana - praying with honesty. 11:28 - אִם־תִּרְאֶ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לֻקָּ֚ח מֵֽאִתָּךְ֙ יְהִֽי־לְךָ֣ - "If you see me as I am being taken from you, it will be so..." ( Melachim II 2:10). 14:39 - PARAGRAPH 2A. The process of turning potential into actual. Two Yuds that combine with the letter Vuv to create the letter Alef . 34:35 - PARAGRAPH 3B. Truth is strongest when a person relies on Hashem rather than on people. 40:59 - אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי - "I will praise HaShem with my life..." ( Tehillim 146:2). 42:30 - PARAGRAPH 3C. Evil is defeated through truth. שְֹֽפַת־אֱ֖מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד - "A true tongue will be established forever..." ( Mishlei 12:19). The main perfection of speech is on Shabbos . 46:14 - PARAGRAPH 3D. לֹ֣א אִ֥ישׁ אֵל֙ וִֽיכַזֵּ֔ב - "HaShem is not human, that He should be false..." ( Bamidbar 23:19, Balak ). 63:20 - The Tess Nekudin - nine vowel points - correspond to the nine sefiros . ***67:06 - Whatever a person truly wants to accomplish, he will accomplish. 68:20 - PARAGRAPH 5A. Performing mitzvos when challenged by obstacles. 71:25 - PARAGRAPH 5B. וַיֵּ֣רֶד מִצְרַ֔יְמָה - "...and he went down to Egypt..." ( Devarim 26:5, Ki Savo ). 72:22 - PARAGRAPH 6. When a person becomes dependent and others, his world darkens ( Beitza 32b). 73:40 - PARAGRAPH 7. Story of a chossid who heard two spirits conversing in a cemetery.

lessons.bodyText: Giluach 3 - Para. 10-12a. Emunah is the Essence of serving Hashem ; Pesach - Matzah, Chometz, Leaving Egypt Quickly - Don't Ask "What Will I Eat"? Getting Free From Addiction. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. 06:30 - Q&R about the process of acquiring knowledge. 09:36 - PARAGRAPH 11. Aspiring to a personal experience of Hashem . 14:26 - Heichal is b'gematria A - D - N - Y . Noam Hashem refers to Binah - the Upper Shekhina , and Heichal refers to Malkhus , the Lower Shekhina ( Zohar HaKodesh ). *15:13 - Experiencing even the slightest awareness of Hashem is sweeter than anything in the material world. 18:20 - Q&R about the viability of reaching spiritual heights in our generation. 21:03 - The importance of preparing for mitzvos - for example - for the mitzvos of Chanukah by saying Likutey Tefilos for Chanukah and immersion in a mikveh . 21:56 - Q&R about the priority of emunah and chakhmah . 23:15 - PARAGRAPH 12. Pesach - matzah and chometz . כִּֽי־יִתְחַמֵּ֥ץ לְבָבִ֑י - "For my heart was in ferment..." ( Tehillim 73:21). *33:13 - The importance of leaving Egypt quickly. כִּי־גֹֽרְשׁ֣וּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לְהִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ וְגַם־צֵדָ֖ה לֹֽא־עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם - "...for they were driven out of Egypt, and they could not delay, and also, they had not made provisions for themselves" ( Shemos 12:39, Bo ). This principle applies to every individual today who is ensnared by his mistakes. "Don't ask 'What will I eat?' Just get out - run for your life! 40:50 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Maimon's experience in High School to illustrate the difficulties in breaking destructive habits. *43:38 - Getting free from an addiction or getting out of a any situation that threatens the soul. 45:53 - "At that time it's forbidden to think about lunchboxes!" 46:59 - Sometimes a person needs to escape a situation quickly to save his life. 48:19 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rav Nosson of Nemirov ז"ל. 50:40 - NOTE about the Sipurey Masiyos - the Baal Tefilah gave different advice to each student depending on what that student needed. 51:27 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the Chayey Adam - Rabbi Avraham Danzig z"l (1748–1820).

lessons.bodyText: Giluach 4 - Para. 6-9a - Sefiras HaOmer - Counting the Omer Increases Parnassah - Livelihood. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - Dedications. 01:18 - PARAGRAPH 6. The catastrophic rise of the haskalah movement - "Reform" Judaism - in Europe, especially in Germany. Why its emphasis on shaving the beard and peyos? 13:47 - PARAGRAPH 7. עַל־כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזָב־אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד - "Therefore, a man shall leave his father and his mother, and cleave to his wife, and they shall become one flesh" ( Bereishis 2:24, Bereishis ). "Father and mother" represent intellect. *17:02 - NOTE - Rabbi Chaim Vital ז"ל on the prerequisites for learning kabbalah . The most important prerequisite is emunah . 19:30 - PARAGRAPH 8. Sefiras HaOmer - Counting the Omer for seven complete weeks - to purify the seven levels of the constriction of Hashem's light. שערה - barley - is two times Menatzpach - sum total of the five closing letters Mem, Noon, Tzaddi, Peh, Khaf : 2 x 285 plus 5 = 575. 25:00 - Tikkun Layl Shavuos . 28:06 - Q&R about shaving the beard and payos . 29:44 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. 32:10 - Sefirah is called "Seven Sabbaths". 36:25 - Q&R about the connection between emunah and Shabbos . 36:42 - PARAGRAPH 9. Conducting business with emunah results in money that contains spiritual light. 40:32 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 68 . Children, life and parnassah - livelihood - depend on mazal - the highest level of Hashem's kindness. *43:52 - Encouragement to say the additional tefilos when counting the Omer . Counting the Omer increases parnassah . 46:15 - Q&R about parnassah being an aspect of constriction. 48:18 - Closing blessings. 48:49 - Q&R about studying kabbalah before the age of 40.

Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - Dedications. Today, the 4th of Teves , is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Mordechai Pinchas Teitz - הרב מרדכי פינחס בהרה"ג ר' בנימין אברהם ז"ל טייץ - (תשנ"ו – 1996) 04:45 - PARAGRAPH 9b. Sefiras HaOmer - Counting the Omer increases parnassah - livelihood - אֶרֶץ נָֽתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֜בָֽרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ - "The earth gave forth its produce; Hashem, our Master, will bless us" ( Tehillim 67:7). 09:22 - Q&R about the mohn as an aspect of parnassah bekedusha . 11:22 - PARAGRAPH 10. Spiritual aspects of clothing. לֹא־יִֽהְיֶ֤ה כְלִי־גֶ֨בֶר֙ עַל־אִשָּׁ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִלְבַּ֥שׁ גֶּ֖בֶר שִׂמְלַ֣ת אִשָּׁ֑ה - "A man's attire shall not be on a woman, nor may a man wear a woman's garment..." ( Devarim 22:5, Ki Seitzei ). This chapter is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 13:11 - Through emes a person strengthens emunah . Giving and receiving aitza is like marriage. 17:17 - The mitzvah of tzitzis protects a person from bad advice. 18:48 - Q&R about the curse given to Adam HaRishon and how it affects women. NOTE about the major role of women in the events celebrated during Chanukah . 21:27 - Q&R about a woman working outside the home. 22:49 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל - when he was unsure about the effectiveness of Torah outreach if a student falls away. 25:23 - Q&R about the nachash . 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֖א יִתְבּשָֽׁשׁוּ - "And they were both naked, the man and his wife, but they were not ashamed" ( Bereishis 2:25, Bereishis ). 28:11 - Reference to the Zohar HaKodesh, Noach 61. 34:22 - מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַֽעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ | יְהֹוָ֗ה כֻּ֖לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ - "How great are Your works, Hashem! You have made them all with wisdom..." ( Tehillim 104:24). *42:00 - The process of the creation of new life, whether a tree or a man, is beyond rational understanding. 40:01 - Before the sin of the Etz HaDaas , knowledge of the truth was perfectly clear. 41:01 - It's impossible to grasp the Torah without it being "dressed in garments". Every word of the Torah is a seed for new life. Reference to Sichos HaRan 219 . 44:00 - The spiritual aspects of clothing. Garments protect the soul. Chashmal is b'gematria malbush . 45:14 - חשמל - Chashmal (378) is b'gematria malbush - מלבוש. 45:23 - Q&R about Torah observance and emunah . 48:05 - Closing blessings.

Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. Spiritual Aspects of Clothing. T
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 4 - Para. 11b - Sefiras HaOmer - Counting the Omer Increases Parnassah - Tehillim 67; Spiritual Aspects of Clothing; Giving and Receiving Aitza is Like Marriage. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. Spiritual Aspects of Clothing. The mitzvah of Tzitzis is a tikkun - spiritual repair - for all clothing. 04:23 - Clothing needs tikkun because it's the outermost aspect of the soul and interfaces with the klipos - spiritual impurities. 07:03 - Women benefit from the tzitzis worn by her father, husband, and/or sons. 07:30 - PARAGRAPH 12. The prohibition of women wearing men's garments, and the prohibition of men dressing as women. Generally speaking, truth is the arena of man and faith is the arena of woman. 14:00 - Torah concepts require garments. 20:30 - Reference to Gitin 43 . 25:00 - The essence of all knowledge is truth. Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 3, Hilkhos Pesach 7 . 29:00 - אַל־יִתְהַלֵּ֚ל חָכָם֙ בְּחָכְמָת֔וֹ וְאַל־יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל הַגִּבּ֖וֹר בִּגְבֽוּרָת֑וֹ אַל־יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל עָשִׁ֖יר בְּעָשְׁרֽוֹ - "...Let not the wise man boast of his wisdom, nor the strong man boast of his strength, nor the rich man boast of his riches" ( Yirmiyahu 9:22). The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh on "Toras Hashem temima..." . 32:43 - לְכָל תִּ֖כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָֽתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד - "Of every finite thing I have seen the end; Your commandments are very broad" ( Tehillim 119:96). 38:52 - כִּ֣י שְׁאַל־נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים | אָדָם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְצֵ֥ה הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ - "For ask now regarding the early days that were before you, since the day that Hashem created man upon the earth, and from one end of the heavens to the other end of the heavens, whether there was anything like this great thing, or was the likes of it heard?" ( Devarim 4:32, VaEschanan ). *45:00 - Q&R about sources for Torah study and choosing a rabbi. "Learning from everyone is learning from no one." Analogy of a person who's lost in the wilderness and lost track of time; he needs to arbitrarily designate one day to perform the positive mitzvos of Shabbos . The tzaddik is an aspect of Shabbos . 51:15 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Giluach 4 - Para. 12b-14 - Prohibition of a Man Dressing as a Woman, or a Woman Dressing as a Man; Parshas Re'eh - Prohibition of Damaging One's Skin; Spiritual Osmosis. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. Emes is called "man" and emunah
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 4 - Para. 12b-14 - Prohibition of a Man Dressing as a Woman, or a Woman Dressing as a Man; Parshas Re'eh - Prohibition of Damaging One's Skin; Spiritual Osmosis. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. Emes is called "man" and emunah is called "woman". 01:00 - The Heichal HaTemuros - Hall of Exchanges - is a place of spiritual danger. 05:24 - ה֗וֹי הָאֹֽמְרִ֥ים לָרַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְלַטּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֚שֶׁךְ לְאוֹר֙ וְא֣וֹר לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְמָת֖וֹק וּמָת֥וֹק לְמָֽר - "Woe to those who say of the evil that it is good and of the good that it is evil; who present darkness as light and light as darkness, who present bitter as sweet and sweet as bitter" ( Yeshaya 5:20). 06:05 - Hashem sends true Tzaddikim into every generation. *08:06 - Words as garments - the tzaddik "packages" the Torah in words that strengthen the emunah of each individual student, according to their need. 10:15 - PARAGRAPH 13. *13:30 - Zivug d'kedusha brings together אמת - truth - and אמונה - faith. The purpose of bringing children into the world is to increase the world's awareness of Hashem . 14:18 - דּ֣וֹר לְ֖דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַֽעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ - "Generation to generation will praise Your works, and they will proclaim Your mighty deeds" ( Tehillim 145:4). 19:21 - Q&R about emunah - faith. 20:14 - PARAGRAPH 14. 23:29 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . 31:04 - Dovid Hamelech begins Sefer Tehillim with the words אַֽשְֽׁרֵ֥י הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֚ר לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֘ בַּֽעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים - "The praises of a man are that he did not follow the advice of the wicked..." ( Tehillim 1:1). 37:18 - Death was created to benefit man. Dust is associated with emunah , as in בְּטַ֥ח בַּֽ֖יהֹוָה וַֽעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֜֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה - "Trust in Hashem and do good, dwell in the Land and nurture faith" ( Tehillim 37:3). Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 and Likutey Moharan 64 . 34:00 - וְהִנֵּה־ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד - "...and behold, it was very good..." ( Bereishis 1:31, Bereishis ). 38:25 - Prohibition of damaging one's skin. Spiritual light enters the soul via the skin and hair. 39:43 - Story illustrating Rav Safra's profound honesty, as an example of "Speaking the truth in your heart". Reference to Likutey Moharan 38 . 44:21 - Even though death came into the world through the side of evil, death is a process that repairs the sin of Adam HaRishon . *47:23 - Parshas Re'eh - בָּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִתְגֹּֽדְד֗וּ וְלֹֽא־תָשִׂ֧ימוּ קָרְחָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין עֵֽינֵיכֶ֖ם לָמֵֽת - "You are children of Hashem Your Master. You shall neither cut yourselves nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead" ( Devarim 14:1, Re'eh ). 52:53 - NOTE about this week's Parsha - VaYigash and the Tenth of Teves . 54:01 - Closing blessings.
