This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Niddah and Mikvah - Taharas Hamishpacha - Family Purity. Reference to Eruvin 1
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 4 - Para. 15 - Niddah and Mikveh - Family Purity; Tzitzis . Giluach 5 - Introduction - Para. 1-2a - Sekhel HaMakif . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. This section of Hilkhos Giluach 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Niddah and Mikvah - Taharas Hamishpacha - Family Purity. Reference to Eruvin 100. 03:25 - The Sheva Neki'im - after menstruation a wife counts seven days to prepare for immersion in the mikvah to achieve taharah - spiritual purity. These seven days correspond to the seven days of the week and the seven lower Sefiros - conduits of Hashem's light. The function of the sefiros is to carry Hashem's light into the malkhus . 05:43 - זאת - Zos - refers to Malkhus , as in וְ֠זֹ֠את אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֨ר לָהֶ֤ם אֲבִיהֶם֙ - "...and this is is what their father said to them..." ( Bereishis 49:28, Vayechi ). 09:30 - PARAGRAPH 16. Mikveh corresponds to the Sefirah of Binah which is an aspect of the Future World. The seven lower Sefiros are related to to the Present World. 10:48 - כִּֽי־מָֽלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים - "...for the land shall be full of knowledge of Hashem as water covers the sea bed" ( Yeshaya 11:9). Tzaddikim draw from future waters of Emunah to nurture the faith of their students. 12:39 - Farmers need Emunah because they trust constantly in miracles. Tehom means "depth" and also "wonderment". 14:01 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . Emunah is strengthened through the spiritual aspects of water, as in מַ֣יִם עֲ֖מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֑ישׁ - "Counsel in man's heart is like deep waters..." ( Mishlei 20:5). 15:36 - Connections between Mikveh and Binah : the word מקוה is 151 - equals b'gematria the expansion of Hashem's Name E - K - Y - H ( Alef Lamed Pey, Hey Hey, Yud Vuv Daled, Hey Hey ). The minimum amount of water in a mikveh is 40 Seah - which is related to "Ben arbaim l'binah..." ( Pirkei Avos ). 16:38 - Q&R about the Name E - K - Y - A sometimes being associated with Keser . 17:03 - Tzitzis also draw from the waters of Emunah - which is related to the river that flows from Eden to create four streams. These four streams correspond to the four tzitzis . 18:57 - The union between husband and wife - Emes and Emunah - is related to the Mitzvah of Tzitzis , as in וּפָֽרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֨ךָ֙ עַל־אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ - "...and you shall spread your garment over your handmaid..." ( Rus 3:9). 20:16 - Q&R about the spiritual aspects of Mikveh . 20:33 - PARAGRAPH 17. The mention of rain in the blessing (in the Amidah ) for Techiyas HaMeysim - resurrection of the dead. 22:40 - PARAGRAPH 18. A mikveh must be int he earth - not in a vessel - because earth is an aspect of Emunah , as in בְּטַ֥ח בַּֽ֖יהֹוָה וַֽעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֜֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה - "Trust in Hashem and do good; dwell in the land and nurture faith" ( Tehillim 37:3). The spiritual benefit of being buried in Eretz Yisrael . 25:41 - NOTE: "As much as it's good to be buried in Eretz Yisrael , it's even better to live in Eretz Yisrael ." 25:54 - Q&R about Rebbe Nachman not being buried in Eretz Yisrael . Some chosen tzaddikim , for example Moshe Rabbeinu , are involved in gathering every Jew from the diaspora. Reference to Parshas Vayechi . 27:16 - HILKHOS GILUACH 5. INTRODUCTION. לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹֽאשְׁכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽךָ - "You shall not round off the corner of your head, and you shall not destroy the edge of your beard" ( Vayikra 19:27, Kedoshim ). Hilkos Giluah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . *28:50 - Sekhel HaMakif . The knowledge that we do have draws light from one's Sekhel HaMakif - knowledge imminently within one's grasp but not yet fully understood. 33:39 - Reference to Berakhos 17: "In the future the tzaddikim will sit with their crowns in their heads." Sitting implies lack of bechira - free will. "...in their heads" refers to the completion of each Tzaddik receiving his Sekhel HaMakif . They have achieved understanding of all they prayed and labored to understand. 36:11 - Q&R about the advancement of tzaddikim after their passing. 36:53 - PARAGRAPH 1. The beard and peyos are aspects of a Jew's holiness and set them apart from the 70 Nations. The hairs of a Jewish man's beard and peyos are vessels that draw the Sekhel HaMakif into the Daas - realized awareness of Hashem . 42:43 - PARAGRAPH 2. The two steps needed for incorporating the Sekhel HaMakif into one's Daas are referred to in the opening verse of the Haftarah for Shabbos Nachamu : נַֽחֲמ֥וּ נַֽחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶֽם - "'Console, console My People' says Your Master..." ( Yeshaya 40:1). The first step is hinted in the word Omer - to say. This alludes to praying with deep feeling. 45:32 - The second step needed for receiving the Sekhel HaMakif is purification of the "Seven Lights" in the Mishkan - the seven openings of the head: eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth. Reference to Likutey Tefilos 21. 48:02 - Spiritual function of peyos and beard. 49:36 - Closing blessings.

(This shiur was given on the 9th of Teves. ) Hilkos Giluah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. The hair of the beard and peyos is in proximity to th
lessons.bodyText: Giluach 5 - Para. 2b-6a. Beard and Peyos - Sekhel HaMakif - The Silent Scream - Why Babies Cry - Chupah - Sheva Brachos . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Miamon. (This shiur was given on the 9th of Teves. ) Hilkos Giluah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. The hair of the beard and peyos is in proximity to the "Seven Lights of the Menorah" - the seven openings in the head through which a person receives awareness: eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth. 05:21 - Peyah is b'Gematria Elokim . 09:24 - The Thirteen Tikkunim of the Beard. 11:00 - Review of the process through which a person acquires Sekhel HaMakif . The first step is through Tzaakah - crying out with no words. 14:29 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why the hair of a newborn grows, but the beard doesn't grow until adulthood. The Mochin of a newborn begins developing in ibur - pregnancy. 17:27 - PARAGRAPH 4. Why a sterile man can't grow a beard. 21:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Why babies cry. Newborns and very young children scream without words as they give birth to their mochin - awareness. *22:57 - An important lesson for a person who wants to increase their Mochin : crying out to Hashem - even without words - helps. 24:27 - There are many facets and levels to the concept of Mochin . 27:05 - NOTE about the Tza'aka of Am Yisrael at Yam Suf . *28:34 - NOTE about the life of Rav Nosson of Nemirov ז"ל. Description of the silent scream. 29:58 - Q&R about the definition of scream. 31:30 - Q&R why women don't have beards. Women have a different relationship with דעת than men have. 31:51 - Q&R about the spiritual quality of the mouth. 32:11 - PARAGRAPH 6. In Ashkenazic tradition, the Kallah circles the Chatan seven times when they enter under the Chupah - wedding canopy. This corresponds to the seven Makifin . This also corresponds to the Sheva Brachos - the seven blessings following the wedding meal during the seven days of celebration after the wedding. Every aspect of the Chupah is to draw the Makifim into the couple. 34:48 - The union between husband and wife is called דעת. 36:18 - The purpose of marriage is to bring awareness of Hashem into the world. 37:35 - Why the ultimate test of a person in this world is with respect to Teyvus Niuf . The mystery of free will and the importance of maintaining the purity of the "Seven Lights of the Menorah". 44:53 - Activity in the brain generates warmth in the heart. 48:10 - Reference to Sichos HaRan 115 . The union between husband and wife begins in the brain. 48:42 - NOTE about the Yahrzeit of Rav Nosson of Nemirov ז"ל which begins tonight. Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Giluach 5 - Para. 6b-9. Chinuch - Torah Education; Sekhel HaMakif - Za'akah - Seven Lights of Menorah; Turning Tefilah Into Torah; Cause of Suffering; Fasting In SHOVaVIM . Parshas Shemos . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Miamon. This shiur was given on the 10th of Teves , Yom Gimmel Parshas Vayechi . Hilkos Giluah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6b. בְּעֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים - "...in pain you shall bear children..." ( Bereishis 3:16, Bereishis ). 04:53 - PARAGRAPH 7. וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יְמָה אֵ֣ת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵית֖וֹ בָּֽאוּ - "And these are the names of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt; with Yaakov, each man and his household came" ( Shemos 1:1, Shemos ). 05:08 - Introduction to SHoVaVIM that will be covered in PARAGRAPH 8. 05:53 - NOTE about the Fast of the Tenth Of Teves . 10:04 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . A father has the main responsibility for the Torah education of his child. 18:33 - The word Shekhina also alludes to Knesses Yisrael . 23:32 - NOTE on the word אסתרה - hidden. 34:56 - Q&R about Za'akah (wordless crying out to Hashem ) being a necessary step in turning Tefilah into Torah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 35:40 - Q&R about qualification for teaching Breslov chassidus. Torah teachers. 37:34 - PARAGRAPH 8. Fasting During SHOVaVIM or SHOVaVIM TaT - the acronym made from the initial letters of Parshios Shemos through Mishpatim (plus Terumah and Tetzaveh during a leap year). שׁ֣וּבוּ בָנִ֚ים שֽׁוֹבָבִים֙ - "Return, rebellious children..." ( Yirmiyahu 3:14). 45:05 - Q&R about fasting during SHOVaVIM . 45:28 - PARAGRAPH 9. All suffering is a result of lack of דעת - recognition of Hashem . The mystery of free will in light of Hashem's omniscience. 58:38 - NOTE about Rav Nosson of Nemirov's yahrzeit today. Rav Nosson Ben Chaya Lana, B"R' Naftali Hertz ז"ל. 59:19 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Lo Yilbash Gever 1 - Introduction - Para. 1-2. Spiritual Aspects of Clothing for Men and Clothing for Women; Torah Study at One's Level; Hair Cutting for Men and Women - Differences; Parshas Ki Seitzei . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Lo Yilbash Gever 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. 01:55
lessons.bodyText: Lo Yilbash Gever 1 - Introduction - Para. 1-2. Spiritual Aspects of Clothing for Men and Clothing for Women; Torah Study at One's Level; Hair Cutting for Men and Women - Differences; Parshas Ki Seitzei . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Lo Yilbash Gever 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. 01:55 - PARAGRAPH 1. Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 . לֹא־יִֽהְיֶ֤ה כְלִי־גֶ֨בֶר֙ עַל־אִשָּׁ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִלְבַּ֥שׁ גֶּ֖בֶר שִׂמְלַ֣ת אִשָּׁ֑ה - "A man's attire shall not be on a woman, nor may a man wear a woman's garment..." ( Devarim 22:5, Ki Seitzei ). 03:07 - The importance of Torah study at one's level. 05:02 - The prohibition of a woman not wearing the garments of a man and its spiritual dimensions. 09:21 - גֶּֽבֶר־חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז - "A man is wise with strength..." ( Mishlei 24:5). 11:40 - "Lo yihiheh" at the beginning of the possuk in Ki Seitzei , while "vlo yilbash" for the next part of the possuk - why this difference in wording? 14:15 - NOTE to illustrate Torah study at one's level. 14:38 - Q&R about Baki beRatzo - Baki beShov - Mastery of Running and Returning. Reference to Likutey Moharan 6 . 15:42 - The greater the person, the stronger his Yetzer Hara . 17:32 - Hair cutting for men and women - differences. 21:00 - Tremendous care and caution are needed when teaching Torah b'rabim . Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 . 24:00 - Parshas Yisro - vayishma Yisro . 24:47 - "Happy is one who speaks to ears that are listening" ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 25:29 - The greater the person, the stronger his Yetzer Hara . 26:27 - Q&R about Torah study at one's level - account of how Rebbe Nachman dealt with heretics. 29:06 - Q&R - Given all the purity needed for spiritual advancement, how do we, in our present generation, even stand a chance? By attaching ourselves to the greatest possible Tzaddik . 30:11 - Q&R about advice given by Rebbe Nachman to Rav Nosson ז"ל. 31:26 - PARAGRAPH 2. וְהַמֶּ֚לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיְכַסֻּ֙הוּ֙ בַּבְּגָדִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִחַ֖ם לֽוֹ - "And King David was old, he came into his old age, and they covered him with clothes, but he was not warmed" ( 1Melachim 1:1). Understanding is an aspect of clothing. 34:45 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 . 37:44 - Dovid Hamelech was punished in this way for cutting the tzitzis of Shaul HaMelech . 40:59 - Shmuel HaNavi and Shaul HaMelech . 47:16 - Q&R about the Malkhus of Dovid HaMelech . 51:09 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Niddah 1 Para. 1-2 - Taharas HaMishpacha ; Feet Are an Aspect of Malkhus ; Distancing and Rebuke at the Beginning of Teshuvah . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Niddah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Feet are an aspect of Malkhus . 04:09 - One of the major factors that allows damage to the Malkhus is lack of Tochacha - fitting rebuke. 06:17 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . The feet are an aspect of Malkhus , Halakha , and Aitza . 09:54 - PARAGRAPH 2. The wife's counting of Shiva Nekiyim - Seven Days of Purity - in preparation for immersion in a Mikveh . *12:51 - Often a person encounters distancing and rebuke at the beginning of Teshuvah . מוּסַ֣ר יְ֖הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־תָּ֜קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ - "My son, do not despise the discipline of Hashem, and do not hate His rebuke" ( Mishlei 3:11). 15:45 - חסד - kindness - is "a day that goes with all seven days" ( Zohar HaKadosh ). 18:48 - Q&R about customary Torah study during the weeks of SHOVaVIM . 20:56 - Q&R about Niddah . 22:17 - Q&R about source in Sichos HaRan about gradual Tikkun HaMidos - analogy of the boiling pot of water: Sichos HaRan 79 .

lessons.bodyText: Likutey Moharan 74B - Healing the Soul - Mitigating Judgments - Revealing HaShem's Glory - Pachad Yitzchak - Dina Kadisha - Holy Judgment -Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded in 1960.) ר֣וּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ - "Be exalted above the heavens, HaShem; be Your glory upon all the earth" ( Tehillim 57:6). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. שורש נשמה - Shoresh Neshama - each person needs to elevate his soul to its root. 01:03 - PARAGRAPH 2. There are 2 types of harsh judgments. Holy Judgment seems like rejection from HaShem but is actually a necessary step in a person's return to Him. 03:05 - PARAGRAPH 3. Pachad Yitzchak. Gevurah is the ultimate expression of Chessed - kindness. 04:06 - PARAGRAPH 4. Sarah Imeinu is an aspect of Malkhus . 05:31 - PARAGRAPH 5. Each person needs to progress from constricted consciousness to expanded consciousness. 07:24 - PARAGRAPH 6. Yitzchak is an aspect of Dina Kadisha - Holy Judgement. 08:28 - PARAGRAPH 7. Mitigating judgments. 13:36 - PARAGRAPH 8. Through mitigating judgments, tzedek - justice - becomes tzedakah - charity. 14:39 - PARAGRAPH 9. תּ֘וֹרַ֚ת יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּ֖מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ - "The Torah of HaShem is perfect, restoring the soul..." ( Tehillim 19:8). 17:20 - PARAGRAPH 10. ר֣וּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֖ל כָּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ - "Be exalted above the heavens, HaShem; be Your glory upon all the earth" ( Tehillim 57:6).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Niddah 1 - Mikveh - 40 Seah - Binah - Ohr HaPanim - Tikkun of the Malkhus; Chuppah - Sheva Brachos; Kiddush Levana . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Niddah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Sheva Nekiyim - a wife's Seven Days of Purity in preparation for immersion in a Mikveh . Mikveh is asso
lessons.bodyText: Niddah 1 - Mikveh - 40 Seah - Binah - Ohr HaPanim - Tikkun of the Malkhus; Chuppah - Sheva Brachos; Kiddush Levana . Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Niddah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 30 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Sheva Nekiyim - a wife's Seven Days of Purity in preparation for immersion in a Mikveh . Mikveh is associated with the Sefira of Binah . 08:04 - Mikveh Noon is an aspect of Mohn - manna. Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 . 09:01 - Q&R about Chessed and Binah with reference to Mikveh . 10:41 - PARAGRAPH 4. The minimum amount of water in a mikveh is that which can be contained with the cubic area of 40 seah . 13:10 - Mikveh corresponds to the Shalosh Ragolim - The Three Central Jewish Holidays - Pesach, Shavuos, Sukkos . 12:20 - NOTE - The Sukkah is an aspect of Binah - which the lower Sefiros of Zer Anpin to Malkhus . 13:43 - Roshei Teivos Netzach - Hod - Yisod is b'gematria Shem Hashem Alef Daled Noon Vuv (65). 15:41 - וְעָלָה֩ הָאִ֨ישׁ הַה֚וּא מֵֽעִירוֹ֙ מִיָּמִ֣ים | יָמִ֔ימָה - "And that man would go up from his city from appointed time to appointed time" ( 1Shumel 1:3). 18:57 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 - Para. 3 . 19:53 - The Three Dimensions of a Mikveh - 1 Amah by 1 Amah by 3 Amot - correspond to the Shalosh Ragolim . The measurement of " Amah " corresponds to the Tzaddik as foundation of the world. An Amah is 6 Tefachim . The Three Dimensions of a Mikveh parallel the three levels through which the Malkhus rises to reach the level of Chokhma-Binah-Daas , which is called Ohr HaPanim . 24:45 - NOTE: The elevation of the Malkhus/Shekhina through these three levels takes place every Shabbos during Kiddush through 1) elevating the Kos of wine above the legs, 2) Holding the Kos in front of the upper body during recital of the first part of Kiddush , and 3) Looking at the Kiddush wine during recital of the second part of Kiddush . 27:32 - PARAGRAPH 5. The elevation of the Malkhus of Am Yisrael began with the reign of Shaul HaMelech . The main establishment of Malkhus takes place through destroying Amalek . The 3 mitzvos incumbent on Am Yisrael when they entered Eretz Yisrael . 33:14 - Terminology of relationships in Kabbalah - Bonim through Savim . 34:31 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 3 - song and nevuah - prophecy. חזן - Chazan is begamtria Alef - Daled - Noon - Yud (65). 35:08 - PARAGRAPH 6. The bride's observance of Sheva Naki'im before marriage. Inner dimensions of a Jewish wedding: Chupah and Sheva Brachos . 36:06 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . 38:31 - Chupah and Sheva Brochos . Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 . A bride who has not received the Sheva Brachos is forbidden to her husband. 39:15 - PARAGRAPH 7. The minimum size of a stain that renders a woman a Niddah is the size of a grain of barley. Why this term? ( Yoreh Deah 190). 40:50 - The Malkhus is the tenth Sefirah , and is represented by the letter Daled - corresponding to the Four Worlds - Asiya, Yetzira, Beriya, Atzilus . In each of these Four Worlds, the Malkhus contains the nine Sefiros above it. 42:07 - The purification cycle of a wife corresponds to the lunar cycle. 44:23 - The custom to wait seven days after Rosh Chodesh to say Kiddush Levana . 45:13 - The custom to say Kiddush Levana on Motzei Shabbos . 45:49 - The Sefer Yetzira begins with "There are 32 paths of Chokhma..." 46:48 - Closing blessings.

Taking a break from Torah insures its continuity. 05:36 - PARAGRAPH 1. 08:00 - וְצַדִּ֖יק בֶּֽאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ יִחְיֶֽה - "...and the righteous shall live by his faith" ( Havakuk 2:4). 12:20 - PARAGRAPH 2. 14:00 - Illustration of how building a house is planned. 16:25 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל - The word Go-el in ATBaSH , is Keser . The Geulah will come from Hashem's highest light. 18:00 - The world can only exist on the foundation of Emunah . The purpose of creation is that all can realize the existence of Hashem . 25:11 - אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵֽרָחֹ֖ק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן - "...I will praise Your name, for You have dealt wondrously; counsels from long ago in true faith" ( Yeshaya 25:1). 27:31 - The concept of Reshima - impression. 35:26 - Q&R about establishing good will in business. 37:14 - Q&R about Emunah and Daas . 37:54 - PARAGRAPH 3. lessons.bodyText: Niddah 2 - Para. 6b-8a - Dveykus ; Tzimtzum - Containment Before Union; The Shekhina Rests Between Husband and Wife. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Niddah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 16 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6b - Dveykus . Tzimtzum - containment before union. All containment is rooted in Hashem's original containment before creation. The importance of taking a break from the higher levels of serving Hashem . 11:48 - Tzimtzum means diminishing light. 12:56 - Q&Rs. 16:50 - PARAGRAPH 7. When a husband and wife are at peace, the Shekhina rests between them ( Sotah 17). בְּעֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים - "...in pain you shall bear children..." ( Bereishis 3:16, Bereishis ). 28:24 - PARAGRAPH 8. Emunah, Sechel, and Daas . 'וְאֵֽרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־ה - "And I will betroth you to Me with faith, and you shall know Hashem" ( Hoshea 2:22). 34:31 - There are 3 sins that push the Shekhina out of the world and one is transgressing the prohibition of Niddah ( Zohar Shemos 3). 39:32 - Q&R about Emunah and Torah study. 44:02 - Return to text: Husband and wife are an aspect of Daas and Emunah . Separation from a Niddah during her Vecess - time the period is expected. 48:40 - Q&R about Taharas HaMishpacha. 49:11 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2023-01-16 - LH4 - YD1 - Mikvaos 1 - Introduction - Part 2 - Para. 1-4a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mikvaos 1 - Introduction - Part 1. Humility Prerequisite to Receiving Torah; Mikveh is 40 Seah; Bavli vs. Yerushalmi on 960; C'Seder vs. Lo C'Seder ; A Tzaddik is Like a Mikveh ; Tziruf HaChodesh ; Wellsprings. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikvaos 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 82 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION - Part
lessons.bodyText: Mikvaos 1 - Introduction - Part 1. Humility Prerequisite to Receiving Torah; Mikveh is 40 Seah; Bavli vs. Yerushalmi on 960; C'Seder vs. Lo C'Seder ; A Tzaddik is Like a Mikveh ; Tziruf HaChodesh ; Wellsprings. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikvaos 1 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 82 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION - Part 2. One of the main seasons for Teshuvah is the month of Elul . C'Seder vs. Lo C'Seder . 04:02 – PARAGRAPH 1. 08:38 - Why the Nachash approached Chava first. 13:17 - The only way to be free of spiritual impurity is through the waters of Mikveh . כִּֽי־מָֽלְאָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּמַּ֖יִם לַיָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים - "...for the Land shall be full of knowledge of Hashem as water covers the sea bed" ( Yeshaya 11:9). 18:19 - PARAGRAPH 2. The minimum shiur of a Mikveh is 40 Seah corresponding to the second time Moshe Rabbeinu received the Torah for 40 days on Sinai. At that time he carved out a path for Teshuvah - a way for people to transform Lo C'Seder to C'Seder . 20:21 - The waters of Mikveh may not be contained by a vessel that disconnects them from the earth. 22:45 - Q&R about the Name of Hashem conveying the concept of C'Seder . 23:04 – Humility prerequisite to receiving Torah. 25:59 – מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ - "...the whole earth is filled with His glory" ( Yeshaya 6:3). 27:33 - NOTE about the minimum size of Mikveh - 40 Seah . 30:11 - A Tzaddik is like a Mikveh . 31:34 – PARAGRAPH 3. All that Hashem creates is C'Seder . 31:55 - All that Hashem creates is C'Seder . Whatever man creates is Lo C'Seder . 33:39 - NOTE about the plague of Arov - wild animals. *34:38 – Overview of Tziruf HaChodesh - the Name of Hashem and how it shapes the inner dimension of the lunar months. 38:52 - PARAGRAPH 4. *41:50 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: The dedication of Rabbi Michel Dorfman ז"ל to immersion in the mikveh when he was living in Russia. *44:02 – לַֽ֖יהֹוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ - "...the earth and what fills it belong to Hashem..." ( Tehillim 24:1). The spiritual meaning of wellsprings. 45:52 - Closing announcements.

lessons.title: 2023-01-17 - LH4 - YD1 - Mikvaos 1 - Para. 4b
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mikvaos 1 - Para. 4b – Wellspring - Parshas Toldos - RaMBaN - Mikveh Means Hope - Mayim Chaim - SIYUM. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikvaos 1 is based on 2 Likutey Moharan 82 . 00:00 - DEDICATIONS and NOTE about the Yahrzeit of Rabbi Shneur Zalman b"R' Boruch ז"ל of Liadi - the Baal HaTanya . 01:24 - PARAGRAPH
lessons.bodyText: Mikvaos 1 - Para. 4b – Wellspring - Parshas Toldos - RaMBaN - Mikveh Means Hope - Mayim Chaim - SIYUM. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikvaos 1 is based on 2 Likutey Moharan 82 . 00:00 - DEDICATIONS and NOTE about the Yahrzeit of Rabbi Shneur Zalman b"R' Boruch ז"ל of Liadi - the Baal HaTanya . 01:24 - PARAGRAPH 4b. Spiritual meaning of natural wellsprings. *04:00 - TOLDOS : RaMBaN on Yitzchak Avinu restoring and renaming the wellsprings of Avraham Avinu . 07:00 - NOTE from the Arizal about the RaMbaN . 11:38 - Mayim Chaim . 13:00 - RaMBaN on the Third Beis HaMikdash ( Bereishis 26, Toldos ). 15:30 - Immersion in the water of Mikveh purifies. 16:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 – Mikveh of the 50 th Level. Uniting the aspect of C’Seder with Lo C’Seder . This corresponds to the union of Hashem with Knesses Yisrael . 19:00 - Immersion in waters of Mikveh connects a person with the waters of creation. 20:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 . ( Yirmiyah 14:8). *20:30 - Mikveh has two meanings: “hope” and “gathering of water”. Mikveh is the hope of a Jew – the first thing to do in a crisis is immersion in the mikveh. “Di Ershte zach iz Mikveh.” 22:00 - When the letters of Hashem’s Name Y – K – V – H are in proper order - this is an aspect of c’seder . 23:00 - Q&R about Mikveh as both Chochma and Binah . 25:13 - Q&R about how a woman can access the purifying aspect of Mikveh . Connecting to the Tzaddik - 16 x 60 - Yosef 960 26:20 - NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל - saying Tikkun HaKlali is like immersing in waters of Mikveh . 27:00 - Q&R about Mikveh connecting a person with the waters of Creation. 28:12 - Q&R about 960 can purify a Beriya - complete being (Talmud Yerushalmi). 29:35 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 52 about the process of purifying Midos . Bitul during Shemoneh Esrei – not to glance away from page of Siddur during this Tefilah . Mikveh is an aspect of Bitul – nullification of physical self. *32:00 - Beshalach - Nachshon ben Aminadav . Holding one’s breath when under the waters of Mikveh . ( Tehillim - Hoshiyana…ad nefesh). 33:00 - Appreciation to students. 35:00 - Mikveh is as aspect of Hashem ( Yuma 85). 37:22 – BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Rosenfeld z”l’s study of Likutey Halakhos . 38:17 - Closing blessings for Siyum of Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 1.

lessons.bodyText: Nedarim 1 - Para. 1-2a - Tikkun - Repairing the World - Fallen Kindness - Points of Connection. Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nedarim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 34 . 00:00 – PARAGRAPH 1. Overview of Likutey Moharan 34 . Through speech a person connects to the point of connection that applies at any given moment. 03:57 - PARAGRAPH 2. Three essential connections: to the Tzaddik , to a friend, to oneself. These connections are made through speech. 05:17 – פִּי יְדַבֵּ֣ר חָכְמ֑וֹת וְהָג֖וּת לִבִּ֣י תְבוּנֽוֹת - "My mouth shall speak wisdom and the thoughts of my heart are understanding" ( Tehillim 49:4). 09:39 - Closing blessings. *11:13 – Q&R – How can a person speak to the Tzaddik ? By having in mind that when a person speaks to Hashem , all the Tzaddikim are listening.

Introduction to Sefer Tehillim - based on 2Likutey Moharan 24 and on Likutey Moharan 282 - Azamra . Speaker: Sara Wurtzel (recorded in 1995). הַ֥לְלוּיָ֨הּ | הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֜לְ֗לוּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ 1 - HalleluKah! Pra
lessons.bodyText: Tehillim 150 - Introduction to Sefer Tehillim - Antidote for Exile - Hallelukah . Introduction to Sefer Tehillim - based on 2Likutey Moharan 24 and on Likutey Moharan 282 - Azamra . Speaker: Sara Wurtzel (recorded in 1995). הַ֥לְלוּיָ֨הּ | הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֜לְ֗לוּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ 1 - HalleluKah! Praise Hashem in His holy place, praise Him in the firmament of His might. הַֽלְלוּהוּ בִּגְבֽוּרֹתָ֑יו הַֽ֜לְל֗וּהוּ כְּרֹ֣ב גֻּדְלֽוֹ 2 - Praise Him with His mighty deeds, praise Him as befits His superb greatness. הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֜לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר 3 - Praise Him with a shofar blast, praise Him with psaltery and lyre. הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֜לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעֻגָֽב 4 - Praise Him with timbres and dance, praise Him with stringed instruments and flute. הַֽלְלוּהוּ בְּצִֽלְצְלֵי־שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֜לְל֗וּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה 5 - Praise Him with resounding cymbals, praise Him with resonant cymbals. כֹּ֣ל הַ֖נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֜֗הּ הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ 6 - Let every soul praise Hashem. HalleluKah!

Reference to Likutey Moharan 10. 02:00 - Recognizing the sovereignty of Hashem on Rosh Hashanah. 09:00 - PARAGRAPH 22. 21:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Makifim - knowledge in potential. Chaim Aruchim - Long Life - refers to a life that's worth living - a life of Chokhmah - wisdom. The word Chaim is b'Gematria Chocham . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7:6 . 26:00 - The Tzaddik is called כל - "all" - heaven and earth. He is the one who's allowing the world to exist, from the upper level to the lower level. His light shines into all people, and all worlds. "Wisdom is the source of life". 28:00 - Reference to Shaarei Olam 8. 31:00 - The process of awakening from spiritual sleep is accomplished through the Mitzvah of sounding the Shofar on Rosh Hashanah. Rabbi Eliezer represents the son and Rabbi Yehoshua represent the student. 33:00 - Tekufas HaYomim and Tekufas HaShanim . The importance of spiritual renewal each day. Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . 37:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Spiritual process of "Back to Back" to "Face to Face" on Rosh Hashanah . Reference to Pri Eitz Chaim . 41:00 - Sipurey Masiyos - The Seven Beggars - Story of the Fourth Day - The Fourth Beggar. The two birds that were separated from one another represent the two Keruvim on the Aron Kodesh as well as the Shekhinah/Knesses Yisrael and Kudshah Brikh Hu . 45:00 - "Shekhinah" b'milui is 601 - Tav Resh Alef correspond to Knesses Yisrael - 600,00 - Tav Resh Elef . 46:00 - תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֖בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֜צְו‍ֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי - "I went astray like a lost lamb; seek Your servant, for I did not forget Your commandments" ( Tehillim 119:186). Reference to Likutey Moharan 206 . *49:00 - The purpose of the Sipurey Masiyos is to reach Knesses Yisrael . 52:00 - Nimtza ... the prayers of Knesses Yisrael . Sometimes the Tzaddik has to cloak his tefilos in stories. Reference to Likutey Moharan 5 .

(This Shiur was given as part of the series in Ein Yaakov - Lesson 38b .) 00:00 - Introduction. 01:00 - A truthful person can detect honesty in others. 01:55 - The presence of many insects flying in a house indicates a lack of Ahava in t
lessons.bodyText: Sefer HaMidot - Introduction and Selected Topics by Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. (This Shiur was given as part of the series in Ein Yaakov - Lesson 38b .) 00:00 - Introduction. 01:00 - A truthful person can detect honesty in others. 01:55 - The presence of many insects flying in a house indicates a lack of Ahava in that house. *02:37 - A person should not say that something is "co-incidence" because this implies a lack of faith that all is through Hashem's providence. 02:56 - The words of a heretic are harmful to the soul. 03:33 - Moshiach will come suddenly and the joy will be so great that Am Yisrael will be shocked. 04:08 - Segulah (Torah-based remedy) to treat insomnia: concentrate on Techiyat Hameytim - revival of the dead. 04:49 - A person should not worry about the future Parnassah (livelihood) of his children. *05:11 - If a daughter is the first-born in a family, Ayin Hara (evil eye/jealousy) will have no power over any of the children in that family. 05:53 - A person should not enter an uninhabited house because it might contain sheydim - harmful spirits. 06:59 - To assure good fortune, the first thing a person should bring into a new home is a knife. 07:23 - If a person must borrow and must put up an item for security, it's a sign that he misused this item in the past. 08:00 - It's a Mitzvah to publicize the names of people who do evil. *08:23 - One who is accustomed to giving good news will never suffer pain in his feet or legs. *08:40 - Gazing up at the sky can help bring a person to tears, which originate in the separation of the upper waters from the lower waters at the time of creation. *09:50 - A person can reduce his arrogance by looking up at the sky. 10:20 - If a person benefits from theft, his misdeed will be revealed. 10:35 - The more physical strength a person has, the less his depth of wisdom. 10:57 - Taking long strides reduces concentration. 11:12 - A person's time and place of death is predestined. 12:26 - If a person falls, this nullifies a decree against him and saves his life. 12:46 - Mitigating harsh judgements through immersing in a mikveh . *13:32 - A person should listen carefully when a friend shares his troubles, because the listener can learn about how to improve his own Midot (character traits). 13:52 - If a person can solve something through money rather than prayer, he should do so. 14:27 - Keeping a dog in one's house arouses harsh judgements, unless the dog serves a purpose. 15:17 - Two people with the same name should not live in the same house. 15:35 - Segulah for winning a court case: reading the section about the Korbonot (sacrifices) brought on Shabbat and Yom Tovim (holidays) in Parshas Pinchas ( BaMidbar /Numbers 28:1 - 29:39). 16:19 - Wearing the belt of a Tzaddik helps eliminate bad thoughts. 16:30 - One who divorces his wife will not be successful in life. 17:04 - Segulah for a woman who is childless: 1) she should carry a small magnet with her, and 2) she should look at the blood on the knife used to perform a Bris Milah . 18:14 - The fact that two people meet and speak is an aspect of Shidduch . *18:57 - Whenever a person tries to instill Yiras Shemayim through speaking to a friend, he becomes the author of a Sefer that is written down in Shemayim (heaven). 19:26 - Staring at an Etrog (citron) is a cure for any pain in the eyes. 19:46 - Even if a government is run by non-Jews, the ruling power should be respected. 20:19 - Studying Torah even if done when half asleep is still beneficial. 21:32 - It's forbidden to teach a Chiddush (Torah innovation) to a person who does evil. 24:50 - If an evil person speaks the truth, it's permissible to refute him. 26:10 - If a person has an itch, it's a sign he has enemies. 30:14 - Do not speak words of Mussar (spiritual rebuke) to a Jew who has converted to another religion. 32:25 - By doing even a small favor for a Tzaddik a person can gain Olam Habah (eternal reward). *35:01 - Tikkun haGuf kodem latikkun hanefesh - healing the physical body precedes healing the soul. *35:54 - Clothing is called the honor of a person. A person should dress properly for Tefilah (prayer) in order to insure that his prayers will be accepted.

lessons.bodyText: Hilula - 18th Tishrei 5760 - Yahrzeit of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov - Speaker: Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal - Locating the Tziyun in Uman. (Recorded 1999-09-28. Hebrew.) 00:43 - In the year 5715 (1955) I arrived in Uman for Rosh Hashanah, after having been in Siberia. On the second day of Rosh Hashanah, I asked Reb Shneur Zalman , who lived in Lemberg, "How do you know this is the exact location of the Rebbe's Tziyun (grave site)?" Reb Shneur Zalman answered: 02:00 - After the war, the land near the Rebbe's grave site was slated for building private homes. 04:07 - Reb Shneur Zalman searched for the markers but couldn't find them. That evening he wept bitterly, crying out "Rebbe, where are you?" *04:15 - During the night he saw the Rebbe in a dream, dressed in beautiful clothing. The Rebbe assured him, "I'm still with you!" And in the morning, Reb Shneur Zalman found the two markers. After the Tziyun was relocated, the land adjacent to the Rebbe was purchased by a Ger Tzedek , and to protect the Tziyun a house was built with placement of the Tziyun between 2 windows. This house stands there to this day. 07:14 - In praise of the Rebbe's many gifts of true compassion, for example Sipurey Masiyos and hisbodedus . 07:59 - "If the Rebbe only came to the world to bring the gift of Tikkun HaKlali , it would have been enough!" 11:04 - At the end of his life, the Rebbe said, "If I had known the power of tefilah I wouldn't have afflicted myself..." . 13:02 - Every soul is a part of HaShem . 13:41 - A child comes to its father and asks forgiveness - the father won't forgive? 16:14 - Reference to Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . 18:54 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 98 - The Tzaddik has the eyes of Hashem . 21:15 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 8 - the last Torah given by Rebbe Nachman. 22:55 - Reference to Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - direct descendant of Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal. . 25:42 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Halakha 070 - Sleep on Shabbos - Dinei Kriyas HaTorah on Shabbos - Three Sifrei Torah - Ki Sisa - Massei - 42 Journeys - Shem Mem Beis - Maftir - Haftara - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל. 00:00 - Making 100 brachos every day. 00:40 - 01:18 - Sleep on Shabbos - the custom of taking a nap on Shabbos . 03:38 - The special Mitzvah of Limud Torah on Shabbos . The custom of sleeping a bit later than usual on Shabbos morning. 08:29 - The obligation to daven - pray - on time. 18:38 - Hilkhos Shabbos - Dinei Kriyas HaTorah - Ashkenaz traditions. 36:36 - Occasions when three Sifrei Torah are read. 40:13 - Combining Parshios during years with less weeks. *40:28 - Parshas Ki Sisa. 41:44 - Parsas Massei. The 42 journeys of Am Yisrael in the Midbar correspond to Shem Mem Beis - the Name of Hashem containing 42 letters. 44:18 - Hilkhos Kriyas HaTorah on Shabbos - continued. 45:40 - If a person doesn't receive an Aliya to the Torah, he should accept the situation with patience. The importance of peace between everyone in a Shul . 46:58 - Priorities in Aliyas for Kriyas HaTorah . *48:17 - Aliya for the father of a newborn if the mother is in Shul . Custom of a woman not to leave her home after giving birth until she answers Baruch Hu (answers Omein to a minyan ). 50:20 - The custom to give an Aliya to a guest in Shul . 51:58 - The custom that in an Ashkenazic Shul the Torah is not read with Sefardic pronunciation. 55:03 - Maftir . 55:41 - Shabbos - Kriyas HaTorah - Maftir - history of the custom of Haftara . 58:08 - Maftir - continued in next recording.

Nedarim 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Fear of Hashem lengthens life and increases wealth that enables access to deeper levels of Torah. 03:40 - P
lessons.bodyText: Nedarim 5 - Fear of Hashem Lengthens Life - Sipurey Masiyos - Stories from Ancient Times Awaken from Spiritual Sleep - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Nedarim 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Fear of Hashem lengthens life and increases wealth that enables access to deeper levels of Torah. 03:40 - PARAGRAPH 1. 06:30 - Sipurey Masiyos - a special type of story told by Tzaddikim to awaken people from spiritual sleep. Faces of the Torah are hidden within these stories. 09:04 - The connection between Nedarim and Sipurey Masiyos . Forgetting one's purpose in life causes spiritual sleep. *12:20 - When a person is overwhelmed by the illusions of this world, the Tzaddik can awaken him through Sipurey Masiyos . Somewhere within all the stories of this world, the Faces of the Torah are hidden. 16:37 - PARAGRAPH 2. Through making a Nedar , a person transforms a mundane action in this world into Torah. This is similar to what is accomplished through Sipurey Masiyos . 19:00 - Vows have the power to take a person out of spiritual sleep and increase their determination to complete a Mitzvah . 20:54 - אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה נָ֜דַ֗ר לַֽאֲבִ֥יר יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "That he swore to Hashem, he vowed to the Mighty One of Yaakov" ( Tehillim 132:2-4). 21:00 - נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי וָֽאֲקַיֵּ֑מָה לִ֜שְׁמֹ֗ר מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ - " I swore and I fulfilled, to keep the judgments of Your righteousness" ( Tehillim 119:106). Dovid HaMelech vowed not to sleep until he found the site of the future Beis HaMikdash . 21:52 - PARAGRAPH 3. The message of the Shofar is "Awaken, you who are asleep!" 23:12 - The Tefilah of Chana went above the usual level of prayer. 24:18 - Neder is similar in concept to Sipurey Masiyos . 24:43 - Rebbe Nachman instructed that his Sipurey Masiyos should be printed in Yiddish for the benefit of women, especially those having difficult bearing children. 25:03 - PARAGRAPH 4. Pesach. Yetziyas Mitzrayim depended on awakening Am Yisrael from spiritual sleep. 28:26 - Hashem began the Torah with stories rather than Mitzvos to enable Am Yisrael to succeed in waking up from sleep. 34:07 - כִּ֥י לֹֽא־בָאתֶ֖ם עַד־עָ֑תָּה אֶל־הַמְּנוּחָה֙ וְאֶל־הַנַּֽחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ - "For you have not yet come to the resting place or to the inheritance, which Hashem, your Master, is giving you" Devarim 12:9, Re'Eh ). 34:33 - Q&R. *35:40 - PARAGRAPH 5. Sometimes you can wake a person from sleep through the Seventy Faces of Torah in "Recent Stories". But when a person has fallen to a level where he has disconnected from all Seventy Faces of the Torah, the Tzaddik needs to tell "Stories from Ancient Times" - referring to stories originating at the higher level from which the Seventy Faces of the Torah receive their light. 39:14 - The word גם refers to the Shekhina . Challah is b'Gematria גם. 42:57 - פָּנִ֣ים | בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ - "Face to face, Hashem spoke with you at the mountain out of the midst of the fire" ( Devarim 5:4, VaEschanan ). 48:51 - Q&R about why Sipurey Masiyos were necessary before Matan Torah . 49:54 - EkYeH asher EkYeH . 51:57 - Why twice EkYeh . 53:52 - Dedication for Rabbi Maimon's mother, Maras Yenta Fradel bas R' Yehoshua Aryeh ע"ה.

lessons.bodyText: Kevod Rabo 2 - Introduction - Para. 1-4 - Halakha 3 - Para. 1-2 - Na'aseh veNishma - Nigla veNistar - 70 Faces of the Torah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Kevod Rabo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 2. INTRODUCTION. Na'aseh is Nigla (Revealed Torah) and Nishma is Nistar (Hidden Torah). 04:20 - PARAGRAPH 1. When a rabbi teaches Torah to a student, he is transforming Nistar to Niglah . 09:10 - אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֜הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל - "...a woman who fears Hashem is to be praised" ( Mishlei 31:30). 09:50 - Standing up for a rabbi. 10:40 - PARAGRAPH 2. 15:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. Standing up for a person who is over 70 years old expresses respect for the Seventy Faces of the Torah. 19:49 - PARAGRAPH 4. *23:00 - Q&R about respect for holy places, such as a Shul or the grave site of a Tzaddik . 27:00 - Q&R about showing respect to elders who have lost their Torah wisdom - reference to Likutey Moharan II: 7 . 29:00 - Q&R about standing up for a rabbi or elderly person - customs in our present generation. 31:00 - Q&R about Nistar and Nigla . 32:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the respect shown Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld ז"ל by his students. 35:00 - HALAKHA 3. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Kevod Rabo 3 is based on Likutey Moharan II: 8 . Story of Reb Zusha and the Vilna Gaon. 46:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Hashem defends the respect due a Talmid Chocham more than His own. *51:00 - Respect shown for a Talmid Chocham expresses respect for Hashem . Reference to Likutey Moharan 126 . 54:00 - Q&R - In what ways is a Talmid Chocham greater than a Navi - prophet? 57:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Kevod Rabo veTalmid Chochom 2 - Para. 3-4; Halakha 3 - Para. 1-5 - Halleluka in Psukei deZimra - Arichas Yomim - Long Life - Aging With Faith and Wisdom - Chanuka - Yom HaAtzma'ut - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3 - Praising Hashem in daily Tefilah . 06:00 - Psukei deZimra - joining the Hallukas at the beginning and end of the closing chapters of Tehillim in Psukei deZimra . 07:00 - "Shiru lo, zamru lo..." doubling the praise of Hashem . 08:00 - Difference between superscription in Tehillim : LeDovid Mizmor and Mizmor LeDovid . *13:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Aging is the process of gaining clarity and increasing Emunah - faith in Hashem . Reference to Likutey Moharan II - 8:7 . 17:00 - Parshas Lech Lecha - Ten levels of Emunah correspond to the Eseres HaDibros - the Ten Commandments. These correspond with ten levels of prophecy and the Ten Utterances of Creation. 18:00 - Arichas Yomim - long life - results from the light of Ruach HaKodesh - Zakeyn Maleh Rachamim . 19:30 - וְגַ֚ם עַד־זִקְנָ֨ה | וְשֵׂיבָה֘ אֱלֹהִ֪ים אַל־תַּֽעַ֫זְבֵ֥נִי עַד־אַגִּ֣יד זְרֽוֹעֲךָ֣ לְד֑וֹר לְכָל־יָ֜ב֗וֹא גְּבֽוּרָתֶֽךָ - "And even until old age and white hair, Hashem, do not forsake me, until I speak about Your strength to the generation, to everyone who comes - Your might" ( Tehillim 71:18). 20:00 - No one displayed signs of aging until Avraham Avinu ( Bava Metzia ). 23:00 - מִזְּקֵנִ֥ים אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן כִּ֖י פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי - "From the wise elders I gain understanding, for I kept Your precepts" ( Tehillim 119:100). 24:00 - The Thirteen Tikkunim - the "White Beard" of Hashem . *26:00 - Q&R about Tefilah with Kavana . Story of Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berdichev ז"ל: "She says it, but I know it." 30:00 - Q&R about Kavana in Tefilah . Sipurey Masiyos - Story of the Baal Tefilah . 33:00 - Q&R about Birur HaMedameh - clarification of the imagination. 35:00 - The word Medameh is b'gematria Chanukah . The Shema has 25 letters - "they rested on the 25th day of Kislev" - the number 25 alludes to Emunah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 25 . 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Standing up for the elderly: Ruach Nevua - prophecy - is facilitated through honoring Hashem . Showing respect for elders leads to Yirah - respect for Hashem . 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Chanukah and Birur HaMedameh . The purpose of the Beis HaMikdash is to proclaim Emunah and respect for Hashem to the world. Emunah and Yirah facilitate Nevuah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 51:00 - Q&R about how Nevuah flows into the world. *53:00 - Q&R about Yom HaAtzma'ut .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld z”l
lessons.description: Iyar - LaG BeOmer 5733 - The Torah Will Never Be Forgotten - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1973-05-19.) Transcript of Clip: Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal promised, assured, he guaranteed, that the Torah will never be forgotten from the Jews. How? Through him. Through his guarantee, through his ass
lessons.bodyText: Iyar - LaG BeOmer 5733 - The Torah Will Never Be Forgotten - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded on 1973-05-19.) Transcript of Clip: Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal promised, assured, he guaranteed, that the Torah will never be forgotten from the Jews. How? Through him. Through his guarantee, through his assistance. The Gemara brings ( Shabbat ) there's a Machloket - a debate - between the rabbis and Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal . The rabbis say "There will come a time when Chas veShalom the Torah will be forgotten. There will come that time – a very dark moment. There will be no more Torah. That moment will be a moment of darkness." But Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal says that darkness will never come, Chas v'Shalom . The Torah will never be forgotten. Why? Because of the Possuk ... כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ - "...the Torah will never be forgotten from the Children of Israel " ( Devarim 31:21, Vayelech ). But in that Possuk "...will never be forgotten from His children..." the last letters of those words are "Yochai" which means: "Because of his child." Whose? Rabbi Yochai's child. Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal . Therefore the Torah will never be forgotten. Why? Because the Zohar HaKadosh says: Through the Zohar HaKadosh , which Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal wrote, this will bring the Geulah for the Jews. The word "Zohar" is "light". The Zohar HaKadosh says, with the words of the Gemara ( Nedarim 32), " Im lo briti ..." – "If not for the Torah, this entire world, the entire universe, the heaven and earth, would be destroyed." There must be a Torah, otherwise there is no creation. The moment the Torah stops, Chas v'Shalom , everything disappears. So if there would come a time when there would be no Torah - it would be forgotten - that means this is the end of all creation. בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים - "In the beginning, HaShem created..." Bereishith is the letters Alef , Taf, Reish, Shin, Beit, Yud . That means "Ohr Torah" . The Torah - light - of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal is what ברא - continually creates now, keeps this creation in being - of the heavens and the earth. Through the light of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai zal 's Torah. Which light is that? That's the light of the Zohar . MP3 and Transcript of the entire shiur is HERE .

lessons.bodyText: Milah 4 - Avadim - Freedom from Slavery is Above the Concept of Time - Kisey Shel Eliyahu at a Bris Milah and on Motzei Shabbos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Milah 4 - Hilkhos Avadim is based on 2Likutey Moharan 61 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Slavery and the concept of time. 09:00 - The Mohn - mannah - was given to Am Yisrael individually, each day according being accessible according to a person's level of Daas - awareness of Hashem - on that day. *12:00 - A person with Daas is not concerned with establishing permanence in this world. "Don't suffer tomorrow's worries." "Make your Torah permanent and your concerns about livelihood temporary." The only person who is truly free, and not a slave, is one for whom Torah is central to his life. 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. 43:00 - Freedom from slavery is above the concept of time. 44:10 - PARAGRAPH 15. The Kisey Shel Eliyahu at a Bris Milah . Eliyahu HaNavi is above the concept of time. 47:00 - Reference to Sipurey Masiyos - Story of the Exchanged Children. 48:00 - Motzei Shabbos - Eliyahu HaNavi , who is above the concept of time, is the bridge through which the freedom of Shabbos can be drawn into the six following weekdays. 50:00 - Eliyahu HaNavi nullifies the concept of time at a Bris Milah in order to purify the Olam HaAsiyah - the physical world. 53:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 117 about why it's difficult to sleep on Motzei Shabbos .

lessons.bodyText: Gerim - Time and Above Time - Calculating the Leap Year - Zodiac - Waters of Mikveh are Above Time - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. The leap year connects the 12 months of the year to their Source above time. 05:00 - PARAGRAPH 22. Time is an aspect of Midas HaDin - constriction. Haman is associated with the Etz HaDaas because he calculated which day and moment would be most opportune to attack Am Yisrael . 23:00 - Q&R about "That which was will be..." ( Koheles ). 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Gerim - converts to Judaism - the requirements of Beis Din , Bris Milah , and Tevilah - immersion in ritual waters - for conversion to Judaism. *27:00 - Water was created before light. Time is measured by means of light/darkness, but water preceded this. Therefore, through water a person can connect with the aspect of Above Time. "Ruach Elokim" hovering over the waters ( Bereishis ) is related to Moshiach . 36:00 - Various aspects of Hashem's Name and Mikveh in Gematria . 37:00 - Kabbalistic meaning of the letters of the word מים - water. Netilas Yedayim - washing hands - in the morning. 38:00 - Purification from Nidah through Mikveh . The Tikkun of a woman is accomplished through her husband.

Hilkhos Milah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Why we close our eyes when experiencing pain. 09:00 - Q&R about looking at the physical world. Rabbi Michel Dorfman ז"ל: "A Breslover has
lessons.bodyText: Milah 5 - Eyes and Vision - Bein HaMetzarim - The Three Weeks is a Time for Tears - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Milah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Why we close our eyes when experiencing pain. 09:00 - Q&R about looking at the physical world. Rabbi Michel Dorfman ז"ל: "A Breslover has to be in the world, and out of the world." 12:20 - PARAGRAPH 2. Why Bris Milah is on the eighth day of the child's life. 17:00 - NOTE on how the Torah begins and ends speaking about the eyes. Bereishis : Beis and Tav is Bas - the pupil of the eye. Reish, Alef, Shin allude to the three Avos and the other parts of the eye. 19:00 - Vision is the most far-reaching of the senses. Closing the eyes connects a person to Olam Habah . 27:45 - Q&R about the "clouds covering the eyes" that interfere with sight. 29:00 - Q&R about how the child receives the spiritual benefits of Bris Milah when he doesn't have any Daas yet. NOTE from Rabbi Rosenfeld ז"ל - even a person who is not aware of the Kabbalistic intentions of Tefilah is still achieving those kavanos . So even though the child doesn't know what's going on spiritually, his neshama receives the benefits. 32:00 - Bein HaMetzrim - The Three Weeks. From the 17th of Tammuz through the 9th of Av is a time for tears. Account of Buba ben Buta : "Walls have ears." Rebuilding the Beis HaMikdash . 37:45 - Buba ben Buta was a Gilgul - reincarnation - of Shimshon HaGibor . Account of Rav Sheshes, who was born blind. 41:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 - the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . Any generation in which the Beis HaMikdash is not rebuilt, is not worthy for it to have been standing. Tears of mourning cleanse the eyes of spiritual misuse. 46:00 - NOTE about studying Kabbalah without Halakha. 50:00 - "When a person has Daas, it's as if the Beis HaMikdash was rebuilt in his time." 51:00 - Closing blessings. NOTE about saying the Tikkun Chatzos by day if he didn't say it the previous night.

lessons.bodyText: Milah 5 - Rochel Imeinu - Tefilah Depends on Focus of Vision - Torah is the Name of Hashem - Kavanas of Bris Milah - Pri Eitz Chaim - Bris on Shabbos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Milah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. Rochel Imeinu . Tefilah depends on the eyes - focus of vision - Iyun Tefilah . One important aspect of this is making Torah into Tefilah . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 25 . 04:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 38 . *07:00 - Tzaddikim of previous generations would prepare themselves for an hour before Tefilah , and would wait for an hour after Tefilah . The result was that both their Limud Torah and their Parnassah were blessed. 10:00 - The concept of Bitul - self nullification. Torah is the Name of Hashem . Naming a child at his Bris Milah . 12:00 - Q&R about Reshimu - spiritual imprint. 13:00 - B'dimayich Chayi - Why "In your blood you will live..." ( Yechezkel 16:6) is said twice at a Bris Milah . 17:00 - Kavanas of Bris Milah as taught by the Arizal in Pri Eitz Chaim . *19:00 - Whatever Hashem does is for the good ( Berakhos 60). But even so, we pray to get out of a difficult or painful situation. End of Shiur : Looking up at the sky strengthens Emunah - account of Rebbe Nachman and his student, Reb Chaikel - "Did you look up at the sky today?" NOTE: Yahrzeit of Reb Shimshon b'R Pesach Ostropoli hy"d .

lessons.bodyText: Milah 5 - Drawing Waters of Torah through Tefilah - Bitul in Prayer - Seder of Shemoneh Esrei - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Milah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4b. Spiritual thirst is quenched by drawing waters of Torah through Tefilah . *05:00 - Unifying Tefilos is like gathering flowers into a single bouquet. This is because the person's intent is to connect all his various Tefilos to the unity of the Future World. 08:00 - Toras Emes - as opposed to Torah that is not Emes . 12:00 - Q&R about the practical application of this teaching. The three steps back before Shemoneh Esrei is leaving the physical world and the three steps forward enter the Throne Room of Hashem . Hisbodedus - prayer in seclusion - is an aspect of Bitul from the physical world. By binding ourselves to a Tzaddik , we connect with the Tefilos of a man who is achieving this Bitul in a more complete way than we are. 17:00 - Q&R about Tefilah and Torah . Tefilah is humility. *19:00 - Ve Al Keyn - it's impossible to reach the highest level of Tefilah except through the true Tzaddik . 26:00 - Q&R about Shemoneh Esrei and Tefilah in general. 27:00 Q&R about how a Kohen can connect with Tzaddikim because he can't go to their graves. 21:00 - Shlomo HaMelech asked that the Tefilos of Am Yisrael should be fulfilled l'Tovah - that having our Tefilos fulfilled should only bring us closer to Hashem . PARAGRAPH 5. Through Tefilah a person creates vessels which enable him receive blessings l'Tovah - without being harmed by them. 32:00 - A person should not be stubborn when praying for something in the physical world. It is dangerous to "force Hashem's Hand" so to speak. Reference to Likutey Moharan 20 . *43:00 - Story of the young man who asked to marry the king's daughter. This is like asking Hashem to be close to Him. 50:00 - The importance of following the Seder of the blessing in Shemoneh Esrei : praise, requests, gratitude. 57:00 - Q&R about how Tefilah creates vessels. 58:00 - Q&R about balancing Hishtadlus - effort/practical initiative - with Emunah - faith. Reference to Kitzur Likutey Moharan 60 about this issue.

Hilkhos Milah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 65. 00:00 - The blessings of the Shemoneh Esrei . Ata Gibor.... 16:08 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 . Why do we have to pray when Hashem knows what we need? Our speech creates vessel with which we can contain Hashem's blessings. 25:53 - PARAGRAPH 6. Kavanas of Bris Milah . 34:36 - Q&R - What are Kelim ? 35:17 - PARAGRAPH 7. Zohar HaKodesh on people who "bark" at Hashem - asking for physical benefits instead of spiritual benefits - Tikkun HaNefesh to elevate the Shekhina . NOTE from Rabbi Michel Dorfman ז"ל: In this world it's important to also pray for material benefits, as long as the ultimate purpose is spiritual. 38:31 - Q&R about Tefilah . *40:52 - PARAGRAPH 8. Why the Tzaddikim of previous generations paused for an hour after Tefilah to internalize and absorb the Reshimu of the experience of Bitul . Since these Tzaddikim did 9 hours of prayer each day, when did they study Torah or work? Their Torah and work was blessed. 48:26 - Q&R about the word קלי as both weapon and vessel. *51:30 - Q&R about learning Torah full time vs. also working. Who should teach or Paskin Sheilos , and who should not.

lessons.bodyText: Avadim 2 - Tzedakah Unites Am Yisrael - Sefiras HaOmer Nullifies Sheker - Why Conversion to Judaism Requires Milah, Mikveh, and Beis Din - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avadim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - 11:00 - Q&R about the connection between Tzedakah and Emes . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Sefiras HaOmer - Am Yisrael's purification from the mentality of enslavement. By restoring truth, Sefiras HaOmer restores the unity of Klal Yisrael . 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Mikveh is a process of Bitul - self-nullification. Mikveh connects the person with the unity of pre-creation. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Gerim - converts to Judaism. Orlah is an aspect of Sheker . Through Milah and Mikveh a non-Jew can become a Jew. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Why Beis Din is necessary for conversion to Judaism. 38:00 - The spiritual dynamics of a Beis Din . 40:00 - Gerim - converts to Judaism requires a Beis Din to be present during each step of the conversion process. *43:00 - NOTE: Sheker was not able to take hold of Adam HaRishon until duality was present - the creation of Chava . Establishment of Emes is only possibly through three. 46:00 - Q&R about even numbers vs. odd numbers. 48:00 - Q&R about Chavrusa , when two people learn Torah together, Hashem is the "Third Partner." 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Birkas HaKohanim - the three-fold blessing of the Kohanim . 52:00 - Q&R about the process of lifting up Kohanim . How the Kedushah of a person can emerge from a lower to higher level.

lessons.bodyText: Avadim 3 - Self-Auditing Protects from Negative Forces - Square Within a Circle - Traveling to True Tzaddikim for Rosh Hashanah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avadim 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. When a person draws others to serving Hashem , he needs to protect himself from the negative attributes of the newcomers. This is achieved through the spiritual fire of Mishpat - self-auditing. 03:37 - Mishpat is a form of fire. *05:59 - Teaching Torah is not just an intellectual process. It's a process of transmitting and nurturing Yiras Hashem . 07:07 - The name "Yerushalayim" is a nickname for Yiras Hashem . 07:35 - Q&R about self-auditing vs. self loathing. A person needs to find his good points. 12:28 - NOTE: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה - "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her penitent through charity" ( Yeshayahu 1:27). Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 2 -giving charity is a form of Mishpat - justice. 14:19 - וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ - "...and you shall observe My Sabbaths" ( Vayikra 19:3, Kedoshim ). 14:57 - The concept of "a square within a circle" alludes to the letters Samech (circle) and Mem (ending letter - square). These two letters were suspended miraculously in the engraved Luchos ( Likutey Moharan 59:4 ). 16:00 - Bringing others to serve Hashem requires the emissary to be especially careful to do Hisbodedus every day, including an honest self-audit - regarding things to be improved and things that have shown improvement. 18:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. Gerim - converts to Judaism - why conversion requires a Beis Din , which is an aspect of Mishpat . *22:45 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why the process of conversion to Judaism begins with Milah . 25:35 - Q&R about the difference between a non-Jewish woman and a Jewish woman. 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The "square withing a circle" described in Likutey Moharan 59:4 alludes to the "Kisey Mishpat" . The concept of Bitul b"Shishim (60 - Samech - circle) relates to the Mishpat of removing the Orlah during Milah . 30:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 - the "Double Edged Sword" - which is empowered by the fire of Mishpat . This sword refers to Milah . 33:13 - Q&R about Bitul b'Shishim . 36:30 - Mikveh is a Gathering of Waters. 37:55 - PARAGRAPH 5. Traveling to the "True Tzaddikim of the Generation" for Rosh Hashanah - the Day of Judgement - when the fire of Mishpat is enthroned. *43:00 - וְיֶאֱתָֽיוּ כֹל לְעָבְדֶּֽךָ וִיבָרְכוּ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ - "All will come to serve You..." is a highlight of the Rosh Shashanah Tefilas Mussaf . *44:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Shofar is an aspect of Yirah and the Fire of Mishpat . קֽוֹל־יְהֹוָ֥ה חֹצֵ֗ב לַֽהֲב֥וֹת אֵֽשׁ - "The Voice of Hashem cleaves with flames of fire" (Tehillim 29:7). 48:00 - Why Shavuos is the holiday when the story of Rus is read. 49:00 - NOTE - the process of conversion to Judaism is not easy.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Gerim 3 - Mishpat - Tehillim 47 Before Sounding the Shofar - Discouraging Conversion to Judaism - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avadim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6b. 10:00 - Q&R - How did Moshe Rabbeinu know which converts were acceptable and which were not? Midrash about how even Avrah
lessons.bodyText: Gerim 3 - Mishpat - Tehillim 47 Before Sounding the Shofar - Discouraging Conversion to Judaism - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avadim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6b. 10:00 - Q&R - How did Moshe Rabbeinu know which converts were acceptable and which were not? Midrash about how even Avraham Avinu and Sara Imeinu were able to tell the difference through a tree that would miraculously spread its branches to shade the newcomer only if he was worthy. 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The sound of the Shofar activates the fire of Mishpat that burns away negative attributes. תִּקְע֣וּ בַחֹ֣דֶשׁ שׁוֹפָ֑ר בַּ֜כֶּ֗סֶה לְי֣וֹם חַגֵּֽנוּ - "Sound the shofar at the new moon, on the appointed time for the day of our festival..." ( Tehillim 81:4). 15:30 - Overview of entire Tehillim 47 that is said before sounding the Shofar. The blasts of the Shofar gather in all the people from distant places. 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. *44:00 - Discouraging a non-Jew from converting to Judaism is a form of Mishpat . 49:00 - שָׁל֨וֹם | שָׁל֜וֹם לָֽרָח֧וֹק וְלַקָּר֛וֹב אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה וּרְפָאתִֽיו - "...'peace, peace to the far and to the near,' says the Lord, 'and I will heal him'." ( Yeshayahu 57:19).

Hilkhos Avadim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. 04:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. 15:00 - NOTE a
lessons.bodyText: Gerim 3 - Beis HaMikdash is the Center of Mishpat - Sanhedrin - Fire of the Mizbeyach - Arrangement of the Heichal - Ketores - Shulchan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Avadim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. 04:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. 15:00 - NOTE about current events: the proposed reform of court system in Eretz Yisrael . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 - Kilkul HaMishpat . 18:00 - The Beis Hamikdash was and will be the center of Mishpat for Am Yisrael . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Why Parshas Yisro ends with the Mizbeyach , and Parshas Mishpatim begins directly afterward. The spiritual fire of the Beis HaMikdash was generated by the close proximity of the Sanhedrin. 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. In the Mishkan/Heichal - the Shulchan was placed to the north, the Menorah to the south, and the Mizbeyach for Ketores was between them. Ketores is associated with Gerim - converts to Judaism. 32:00 - Gold - wealth - comes from the north. 35:00 - Q&R about Gerim who fall away from Torah. 37:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Chatzos Leila - הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֖הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי - " Arouse Yourself and awaken to my judgment, my Hashem and my Master, to my cause ..." ( Tehillim 35:23). At midnight, Mishpat is activated. 41:00 - Q&R about "Chut Shel Chessed" and Chatzos . 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. Reincarnation. תּ֘וֹרַ֚ת יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּ֖מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ - "The Torah of Hashem is perfect, restoring the soul..." ( Tehillim 19:8). In order to complete the Torah, a soul returns again and again. 48:00 - NOTE about the danger of rescuing a drowning person. 50:00 - A person can only succeed spiritually through Hisbodedus , which is an aspect of Mishpat . The importance of self-auditing every day, asking Hashem "What am I doing right? What am I doing wrong?" This burns away the negativity surround a person's heart. 54:00 - Q&R about good and bad. Reference to Likutey Moharan 33 .

lessons.bodyText: Gerim 3 - Generating Angels Through Mishpat - Self-Appraisal - Parshas Mishpatim - Shofar - Malkhios, Zikhronos, Shofaros - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Gerim 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 26. Generating angels through Mishpat . 06:00 - Through careful self-appraisal of every word one says, one can merit bringing others closer to Hashem . Pirkei Avos begins with the advice to take time to judge and raise many students. Mishpat is a combination of Chesed and Gevurah . 12:00 - Respect for a Talmid Chacham is compared to handling hot coals. Story of Rabbi Yochanan and the student who didn't believe him until he saw giant emeralds being pulled out of the sea. 14:00 - Self-appraisal of one's deeds is an important form of Mishpat , but appraising what to say to another is much more difficult and requires a more intense level of Mishpat and additional Siate d'Shemaya - assistance from Heaven. 18:00 - NOTE about not being m'karev missionaries for other religions who are Jews. 20:00 - The Beis HaMikdash will be rebuilt through "Wondrous Mishpat " as in כִּימֵ֥י צֵֽאתְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת - "As in the days of your exodus from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders" ( Micah 7:15). *23:00 - Story of Rav Nosson of Nemirov ז"ל and finding the good points in students. 26:00 - Q&R about how to find a rabbi. *28:00 - PARAGRAPH 27. Why Parshas Mishpatim follows directly after Matan Torah. Yisro's suggestion to Moshe Rabbeinu about setting up a system of Mishpat . *34:50 - PARAGRAPH 28. The three sounds of the Shofar correspond to Avraham Avinu, Yitzchak Avinu, and Yaakov Avinu and the three groupings of Tefilos on Rosh Hashanah: Malkhios, Zikhronos, Shofaros . 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. Morning is a time when the Mishpat is awakened. When a person is asleep "the courts are closed" - judgement is in the hands of Hashem . When a person wakes up, his ability to judge returns to him. *48:00 - Kol - sound - activates Mishpat . The Kuf and Lamed of the work קול is five times Y - K - V - K . The Vuv of the word קול represents the sixth Sefirah - Yisod . 51:00 - Q&R about the difference between Erev Rav and enemies of Am Yisrael . 54:00 - Q&R about the custom of praying with one's Rabbi on Rosh Hashanah. 55:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sefer Torah 1 - Beheyma to Adam - Animal to Human - Obligation to Write a Sefer Torah - Writing is Asiyah - HaAzinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sefer Torah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. A nursing infant receives nourishment from the upper part of his mother, while an animal receives from the lower part of its mother. A human receives nourishment from a higher level: Binah . 02:00 - The four levels of life created by Hashem: Domem, Tzemach, Beheymah, Adam. 06:00 - Why a Sefer Torah is written on the hide of an animal. The obligation for a Jew to write a Sefer Torah . Every individual Jew in every generation has to receive the Torah. Writing is Asiyah - the act of writing is an aspect of elevating from Beheyma to Adam . Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 . Those things that are in written form are considered "created". Writing elevates something from Medameh - imagination - to Zicharon - memory. 16:00 - Parshas HaAzinu . NOTE about Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai ז"ל since thousands will be traveling to his grave site today . 18:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 37 : forgetfulness relates to the level of Beheyma . *20:00 - Even if a person knows the words by heart, the written Torah must be read from a written page, not recited from memory. 25:00 - Why it is forbidden to write the Oral Torah on parchment. Reference to Likutey Moharan 11 .

Hilkhos Sefer Torah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את - "And now, write fo
lessons.bodyText: Sefer Torah - Parshas VaYelech - NaAsey vNishmah Correspond to Niglah vNistar - Tefilah Leads to Simcha - Writing a Letter in a Sefer Torah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sefer Torah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את - "And now, write for yourselves this song..." ( Devarim 31:19, VaYelech ). 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Naaseh vNishmah corresponds to Niglah v'Nistar - revealed and hidden. Joy is a crown. . 06:30 - The task of a Jew is to progress from level to level - through Tefilah he turns Torah that's hidden from him into Torah that's revealed to him to the point where it becomes "his" so he can renew himself and improve his actions. 13:42 - Joy is a crown. וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם - "...and eternal joy upon their heads..." ( Yeshayaha 35:10). Kol is an aspect of Oz - Azus dKedushah - boldness for the sake of Heaven. 17:00 - Q&R about Simcha and the relationship between the heart and the mind. Simcha is b'Gematria Machshava - thought. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan - 24 . 20:00 PARAGRAPH 2. Every Jew is obligated to write a Sefer Torah , or at least to write one of the letters in a Sefer Torah . 23:00 - Tefilah is associated with Nishmah/Nistar/Malkhus . 26:40 - Rav Nosson zal's dream of "Climb... and hold." 27:33 - Writing a Sefer Torah - or a letter in a Sefer Torah - is an example of NaAsey vNishmah . 34:00 - Internalizing Torah from " Hashem's Torah" to one's own Torah. 35:00 - Black fire and white fire corresponds to Nistar and Nigla , respectively. 36:00 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on the Zohar HaKodesh - concerning the words Yotzer Ohr uVorey Choshech" - "[Who Forms light" - ( Tefilas Shacharis ). 42:00 - Every person has a different level of NaAsey vNishmah . 43:00 - Q&R about Kavanah during Hagbah - the goal is to be able to see the letters on the parchment. 46:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Torah shb'Kesav and Torah sh'Baal Peh - the Written Torah and the Oral Torah. The Written Torah corresponds to Nishma/Nistar . 52:00 - Q&R about the Written Torah corresponding to Nishma/Nistar. 53:00 - Closing blessings.

Yes. 28:00 - Rosh Hashanah - Malkhios, Zichronos, Shofros . 32:00 - When a person rises to a new level, he's at the bottom of that level. 36:00 - "Write on the tablets of your heart" alludes to NaAsey vNishmah through Turning Torah into Tefilah in Hisbodedus . *38:00 - Clear. brief summary of NaAsey veNishmah being the key to Simcha . Kol is an aspect of Oz - power. 39:00 - Shofar on Rosh Hashanah. The blast of the Shofar is an expression of Azus d'Kedushah . 41:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 42:00 - Q&R about writing as a means of remembering Torah. 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Eseres Yemei Teshuva - the Ten Days of Return. Yerida before Aliya - Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 44:00 - Dovid HaMelech did not sin with B athsheva . This incident occurred to teach the world the power of Teshuvah - returning to Hashem. 50:00 - Nishmah is an aspect of Ain Sof . 51:00 - After the sin of the golden calf, Moshe Rabbeinu asked to be erased from the "...book which You have written" - Sofei Teyvos Keser . 54:00 - Q&R about how this world can be a reflection of the upper worlds - analogy of "preferred banking" and the Light of the Ain Sof . 56:00 - Closing blessings.

Parshas Shelach . וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ - "I have forgiven them in accordance with your word..." ( Devarim 1:1, Devarim ). *36:00 - By mentioning the locations where Am Yisrael sinned, Moshe Rabbeinu's rebuke is, at the same time, a Tefilah for Hashem's mercy. 44:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas VaYelech . וְ֠עָֽנְתָ֠ה הַשִּׁירָ֨ה הַזֹּ֤את לְפָנָיו֙ לְעֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ - "...this song will bear witness against them, for it will not be forgotten from the mouth of their offspring..." Summary of the correspondence of the Ilan with Tehillim 1. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. בְּטַ֥ח בַּֽ֖יהֹוָה וַֽעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֜֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה - "Trust in Hashem and do good; dwell in the Land and be nourished by faith" ( Tehillim 37:3). 07:00 - Bitachon depends on Yirah . Reference to Sefer HaMidos - Bitachon 3. 10:30 - The connection between Good and Truth. Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 . 11:00 - Sefer HaMidos - Bitachon 3 - text, translation, and explanation. 12:20 - How the words "...dwell in the Land..." correspond to the root of Anava - humility. *15:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The Tree of the Seven Beggars - Fifth Day - is compared to the three Avos and Moshe Rabbeinu . Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 . Avraham Avinu stands for Emunah . Yitzchak Avinu represents Yirah . Yaakov Avinu is the trunk of the tree - Emes - and Moshe Rabbeinu exemplifies humility. 20:00 - NOTE from Chulin - Aleph stands for Avraham , Daled for Dovid HaMelech , Mem for Moshe Rabbeinu . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. HaEtz Chaim and the Ilan of the Seven Beggars. The concept of space in the Beis HaMikdash and Yerushalayim . 26:00 - Eretz Yisrael is an example of the "small holding much". In the time of Moshiach , the entire Land will be an ample home for every Jew. Wherever there is holiness, there is a sense of expansion. 28:00 - The Aron HaKodesh was completely above the confines of space. 32:00 - The more Daas , the more a sense of spaciousness. Story of the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh advising a family to bring livestock into their home until the family eventually learns to appreciate its living space. 35:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The obligation for every Jew to write a Sefer Torah . Every letter of the Aleph-Beis is an example of "small holding much". Analogy of the first computers being large as a room, while today they can be contained on a microchip. 41:00 - Q&R about the letters of the Aleph-Beis . Reference to the Tikkunei Zohar on the composition of each letter. 43:00 - NOTE about the number of components of a Phantom Jet. 45:00 - NOTE - the correspondence between the 613 Mitzvos and the 613 parts of the human body. 46:00 - Only the Tzaddik has the ability to bring Am Yisrael to the state of "small holding much" - that is, above the concept of space. The Fifth Beggar only seems to be a hunchback because he's carrying much. 50:30 - עול תורה - The Yoke of Torah isn't a burden - it uplifts anyone who takes it upon himself. The Aron Kodesh carried the people who only seemed to be carrying it.

lessons.title: 2023-08-25 - LH5 - YD2 - Sefer Torah 3 - Para. 7b-9
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sefer Torah 3 - Purpose of Life - Small Holding Much - Writing a Sefer Torah Completes All Four Aspects of the Mystical Ilan - Garments of Leather - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sefer Torah 3 is based on Sipurey Masiyos - The Seven Beggars - Fifth Day - Story of the Hunchbacked Beggar (commentary - Sichos HaRan
lessons.bodyText: Sefer Torah 3 - Purpose of Life - Small Holding Much - Writing a Sefer Torah Completes All Four Aspects of the Mystical Ilan - Garments of Leather - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sefer Torah 3 is based on Sipurey Masiyos - The Seven Beggars - Fifth Day - Story of the Hunchbacked Beggar (commentary - Sichos HaRan 149). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7b. The purpose of life - elevating the world above the concept of place. 09:50 - Q&R about the purpose of life. Q&R about Hashem being "obligated". Q&R about free will. Reference to Likutey Moharan 52 . 14:40 - Writing the letters of the Torah brings spirituality into the physical, and achieve the concept of "small holding much". 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Writing a Sefer Torah completes all four aspects of the mystical Ilan . 22:06 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 18 . 21:30 - Each letter in a Sefer Torah has many components with various spiritual attributes. 22:27 - The letter Yud embodies Anava - humility - and alludes to Olam Habah . Complete reward in the Future World is only possible for those who have humility. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 72 . *26:32 - The Ilan's central Midah of Emes is achieved through the three Midos of its roots. These Midos are prerequisite in the Sofer writing a Sefer Torah : Emunah - faith, Yirah - respect, and Anava - humility. 31:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. The letters of a Sefer Torah are written on the hide of kosher animal. 36:00 - It's forbidden to turn the Torah into something physical. Reference to Likutey Moharan 110 . 37:50 - Q&R about why Adam and Chava were created with different levels of Daas . 39:00 - The Etz HaChaim and the Etz HaDaas in Gan Eden is an aspect of Toras Nistar - the hidden aspects of the Torah. Adam and Chava - garments of leather - garments of light. *46:10 - The Torah is clothed in "garments of leather" by writing it on the hide of an animal. This brings its light into the physical world. 48:18 - Q&R about the Fifth Beggar - the hunchback - and humility. 51:30 - Closing blessings.
