lessons.title: 2024-03-12 - LH5 - YD2 - Pehter Chamor 2 - Para. 2-3
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Pehter Chamor 2 - Tikkunei Atik - Arichas Yomim - Hisbonenus - Sohd HaIbur - Sheep Indicate Ashirus deKedusha - Holy Wealth - Sifsei Kohen - Sipurei Maasios - Announcing Stories from Ancient Times - Shem Beis Yud Tess - Tehillim 133 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 .
lessons.bodyText: Pehter Chamor 2 - Tikkunei Atik - Arichas Yomim - Hisbonenus - Sohd HaIbur - Sheep Indicate Ashirus deKedusha - Holy Wealth - Sifsei Kohen - Sipurei Maasios - Announcing Stories from Ancient Times - Shem Beis Yud Tess - Tehillim 133 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Monetary wealth and Tikkunei Atik - Arichas Yomim - are prerequisites for hisbonenus - a greater depth of Torah understanding. Sohd HaIbur - intercalation of the lunar calendar - Bnei Yissachar . 05:00 - Sheep indicate ashirus dekedusha - kosher, holy wealth. 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why the pidyon is given to a kohen . The kohen represents the tzaddik of the generation. The kohen comes from shevet Levi, who were blessed by Moshe Rabbeinu as יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְתוֹרָֽתְךָ֖ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל - "They shall teach Your ordinances to Jacob, and Your Torah to Israel..." ( Devarim 33:10 VeZos HaBracha ). Also in כִּֽי־שִׂפְתֵ֚י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ־דַ֔עַת וְתוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִפִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֛י מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה־צְבָא֖וֹת הֽוּא - "For a kohen's lips shall guard knowledge, and teaching should be sought from his mouth, for he is a messenger of the Lord of Hosts" ( Malachi 2:7). 20:00 - Q&R about Pehter Chamor in our present generation. It is still done, but occurs rarely since so few Jews raise donkeys. 21:00 - Q&R about a donkey - ashirus desutra achra - wealth of impurity. Sheep represent wealth of kedusha . 22:00 - The process of sotah - suspected wife - is performed by a kohen . This process enables an akara - childless woman - to give birth. Chana was blessed by Eli HaKohen . 25:00 - The Beis HaMikdash is a place of yirah . The blood sprinkled on the mizbeyach - alter - is an aspect of din - however the blood of the sacrifice removes the judgement of death, and instead lengthens the life of the one bringing the offering. 29:00 - וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹֽנִיּֽוֹת - "And then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem shall be pleasant to HaShem, as in the days of old and former years" - ( Malakhi 3:4). The concept of Atik and "Stories from Ancient Times." "Ancient Stories" and service in the Beis HaMikdash enable people to awaken from spiritual sleep. 31:00 - The kohen gadol must be very wealthy and is anointed with holy oil to attain Tikkunei Atik - the higher levels of sechel . 34:30 - "The oil on your head should never be lacking." 35:30 - Q&R about the higher level of chokhmah hidden in the Sipurei Masiyos . Only those who are qualified are able to see the higher levels of light hidden in these stories. In those who might be harmed by this light, the light is hidden. 37:00 - כַּשֶּׁ֚מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב | עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַל־הַזָּ֫קָ֥ן זְקַ֥ן אַֽהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֜יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו - "As the good oil on the head runs down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, which runs down on the mouth of his garments" ( Tehillim 133:2). "The holy beard of Aharon" alludes to Tikkunei Atik . 38:00 - כְּטַ֥ל חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֘ עַל־הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֚י שָׁ֨ם | צִוָּ֣ה יְ֖הֹוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֜יִּ֗ים עַד־הָֽעוֹלָֽם - "As the dew of Hermon which runs down on the mountains of Zion, for there HaShem commanded the blessing, life forever" (Tehillim 133:3). "As the dew of Mount Hermon..." alludes to the blessing of long life and wealth. A beard represents longevity. 41:00 - NOTE: The last words of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal were: כִּ֚י שָׁ֨ם | צִוָּ֣ה יְ֖הֹוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֜יִּ֗ים עַד־הָֽעוֹלָֽם - "...for there HaShem commanded the blessing, eternal life" ( Tehillim 133:30) to hint that he was departing from this world to enter another realm of life. When a tzaddik passes from Olam HaAsiya to Olam HaBah , his strength becomes even greater. *42:00 - Blessing for the present month of Adar . ***43:30 - Q&R - A person receives an aspect of Tikkunei Atik even by simply by reading the Sipurei Masiyos , even if the deeper meaning is not understood. Announcing Sipurei Maasios - there is a custom of beginning and/or ending a shiur or chavrusa in Sipurei Maasios by reading the paragraph: "This is to reveal and proclaim/announce that these stories bring the light into the world." 46:00 - A kohen was only permitted to bring the ketores once, to insure that all the kohanim would receive wealth. 50:00 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal - The Name of HaShem especially related to Tikkun HaBris is the Shem Beis Yud Tess . These are the Roshei Teyvos of Bezroah Yikabetz T--- . Beis Yud Tess is begamtria E - K - Y - H - Binah - hisbonenus . ATBaSH of Beis Yud Tess is Shemen - which represents both a higher level of sechel , and Tikkun HaBris . 52:00 - PURIM: the golden scepter mentioned in Megillas Esther alludes to mastery in Tikkun HaBris - "Sharvit" alludes to " Saar of Beis Yud Tess ." 53:00 - Q&R about the English term "bit" in present finances. 54:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-03-13 - LH5 - YD2 - Pehter Chamor 2 - Para. 4-8
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Pehter Chamor 2 - Hisbonenus via Beis HaMikdash - Yirah - Sanhedrin - 70 Faces of the Torah - Wealth - Donkey - Yissachar - Yetzias Mitzraim - Krias Yam Suf - Zeh Keyli - Oref vs. Face - Golden Calf - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Beis HaMikda
lessons.bodyText: Pehter Chamor 2 - Hisbonenus via Beis HaMikdash - Yirah - Sanhedrin - 70 Faces of the Torah - Wealth - Donkey - Yissachar - Yetzias Mitzraim - Krias Yam Suf - Zeh Keyli - Oref vs. Face - Golden Calf - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Beis HaMikdash was a center for yirah , therefore it was built with and contained tremendous wealth. "For a person who has daas , it's as if the Beis HaMikdash was built in his lifetime." 03:00 - From the Sanhedrin in the Beis HaMikdash , the 70 Faces of the Torah was radiated into the world. 04:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Hisbonenus is achieved through holy wealth. A firstborn donkey represents wealth. Choni HaMaagal . Rashi on the mitzvah of Pehter Chamor . 11:00 - Am Yisrael carried away the wealth of Egypt on donkeys. Tikkun HaAtik is achieved through the kohen - shmiras habris - ashirus dekedusha . Yetzias Mitzrayim was achieved through Binah - hisbonenus . The 50 Gates of Binah correspond to the 50 times that Yetzias Mitzrayim is mentioned throughout the Chumash . *15:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Krias Yam Suf - Zeh Keyli. When HaShem split the Yam Suf , the Yam of Chokhma was also split and Am Yisrael was blessed with an outpouring of hisbonenus . 17:30 - "The sea saw... and fled..." The sea saw the merit of Yosef HaTzaddik and "fled." Yosef HaTzaddik was the exemplification of shmiras habris , so in his merit, Am Yisrael received the wealth of Egypt and was rescued by means of the miracles at Yam Suf . Shmiras HaBris requires true yirah . 22:00 - NOTE on how the first word in the Written Torah, "Bereishis", contains the words "Yiras HaShem" . To reach hisbonenus , the first step is yirah . 23:00 - Q&R about achieving ashirus dekedusha through yiras HaShem . 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. If firstborn donkey is not redeemed by giving a sheep to the kohen , then the donkey must be killed by striking it dead on the oref - back of the neck. This insures that the owner of the donkey will not be harmed by his wealth. 26:00 - Sipurei Maasios - Stories from Ancient Times - 70 Faces of the Torah. The oref is the opposite of the face. 28:00 - "Oref" is composed with the same letters as "Pharaoh" . *30:00 - Ashirus deSutra Achra is an aspect of idol worship. אַ֜֗ף אֵ֖ין יֶשׁ־ר֣וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם - "...neither is there any breath in their mouth" ( Tehillim 135:17). Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 : Arichas haneshima vs. hefsake haneshima . Wealth that is not ashirus dekedusha is not truly wealth. 36:00 - Egal HaZahav - the sin of the golden calf - was a means to pegam habris . 38:00 - Q&R about why a person would not want to do the mitzvah of Pehter Chamor . Parallel to those who don't want to give charity. 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Holy wealth is received via the "Face of HaShem " - as in the Birkhas Kohanim . Through doing a pidyon , a person repairs and merits ashirus dekedusha . 48:00 - Q&R about strictness in Torah observance. NOTE about Rav Moshe Bursteyn zal's strict observance of tznius - modesty. The importance of praying for and seeking guidance in how to do a mitzvah. Reference to Likutey Moharan 1 . 55:00 - Closing blessings for our times. 56:00 - Q&R about solar eclipse approaching this Rosh Chodesh Nissan (5784).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Pehter Chamor 2 - 3 - Joy Saves Lives - King David's Harp - Tikkun Chatzos - Yetziyas Mitzrayim - Wealth in Merit of Avraham Avinu - Yirah - Tefillin - VeAni beRov Chasdecha - Parshas Vayeitzei - Yaakov Avinu - Markings on Sheep - Silent Scream - Menorah of the Face - Birth Brings New Daas - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.bodyText: Pehter Chamor 2 - 3 - Joy Saves Lives - King David's Harp - Tikkun Chatzos - Yetziyas Mitzrayim - Wealth in Merit of Avraham Avinu - Yirah - Tefillin - VeAni beRov Chasdecha - Parshas Vayeitzei - Yaakov Avinu - Markings on Sheep - Silent Scream - Menorah of the Face - Birth Brings New Daas - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 60 . 00:00 - Dedication in memory of a young man who suffered from depression. 01:00 - *Joy Saves Lives. The importance of learning and implementing Rebbe Nachman's treasury of practical advice about achieving joy. Protecting the lives of others by acknowledging their presence, giving encouragement, and especially by simply and quietly emanating joy. 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. Yetzias Mitzrayim was in the merit of Avraham Avinu . 05:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. King David's Harp. Shiras HaYam - Tikkun Chatzos. 18:00 - *PARAGRAPH 13. Parshas VaYeitzei. Yaakov Avinu and Markings on Sheep - Berudim - Nekudim - Akudim . וַתֵּלַ֣דְןָ הַצֹּ֔אן עֲקֻדִּ֥ים נְקֻדִּ֖ים וּטְלֻאִֽים - "ringed, spotted, and striped..." ( Bereishis 30:39, VaYetze ). 20:00 - The three categories of markings on the sheep of Yaakov Avinu correspond with the 3 types of yirah: Yiras HaRav - the respect a tzaddik has for HaShem; Yiras HaTalmid - the respect a student has for his rabbi; Yiras HaBen - the respect a son has for his parents. 27:00 - *Q&R about Tikkun Chatzos being healthy. "Thomas Edison turned night into day." There isn't a parsha in the Torah that doesn't mention chatzos . 29:30 - HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 , which speaks about bechira - free choice - and makifim - knowledge that's in potential. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Bechira - makifim - free choice. 35:00 - *Purification of the 7 openings of the face - called "7 Lights of the Menorah" (Menorah of the Face). Screaming in prayer and Limud Torah gives birth to the mochin . צ֥וּר יְלָֽדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹֽלְלֶֽךָ - "You forgot the Rock Who bore you; you forgot HaShem Who delivered you" ( Devorim 32:18, Haazinu ). 37:00 - *NOTE - description of Menorah of the Face. 38:30 - *PARAGRAPH 2. Every birth brings new daas to the world. This refers not only to people, but to animals as well - since animals were created for the benefit of man. 43:00 - Closing blessings. 44:00 - Q&R - every birth brings the world new daas - how? Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. Pehter Chamor - redemption of a first
lessons.bodyText: Pehter Chamor 3 - Redemption of Firstborn Sustains Free Choice - VaYechi - Yissachar Chamor Gorem - Shemos - Material Wealth - Questions Bring Chiddushim - Torah Innovation - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pehter Chamor 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 21 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. Pehter Chamor - redemption of a firstborn sustains free choice in the world. 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Shemos - material wealth. וַיְמָֽרֲר֨וּ אֶת־חַיֵּיהֶ֜ם בַּֽעֲבֹדָ֣ה קָשָׁ֗ה בְּחֹ֨מֶר֙ וּבִלְבֵנִ֔ים - "And they embittered their lives with hard labor, with clay and with bricks..." ( Shemos 1:14) 25:00 - The yetzer hara is a benefit to the world. 26:30 - VaYechi . יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר חֲמֹ֣ר גָּ֑רֶם רֹבֵ֖ץ בֵּ֥ין הַמִּשְׁפְּתָֽיִם - "Yissachar is a strong-boned donkey, lying between the boundaries" ( Bereishis 49:14, VaYechi ). 29:00 - Q&R - Brief review of this halakha so far. *33:00 - אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֖מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֜שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ ע֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד - "Length of days is in its right hand; in its left hand are riches and honor" ( Mishlei 3:16). Reference to Chayey Moharan 493 . "Wealth and honor" on the right side emerges from a question. "All wealth comes from questions." 39:00 - Wealth originates from the psulos (waste matter) of the luchos . Introduction to a Torah concept falls away after the chiddush (Torah innovation) is revealed. Reference to Likutey Moharan 60 . *44:00 - Questions bring about Torah innovation. 45:00 - The tzaddik is compared to Yissachar . וּמִבְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יֽוֹדְעֵ֚י בִינָה֙ לָֽעִתִּ֔ים לָדַ֖עַת מַה־יַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל - "And of the sons of Issachar, those who had an understanding of the times, to know what Israel should do..." ( 1Divrei HaYamim 12:33). 49:00 - עֹ֛שֶׁר שָׁמ֥וּר לִבְעָלָ֖יו לְרָֽעָתֽוֹ - "...riches kept by their owner for his harm" ( Koheles 5:12). 50:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Pehter Chamor 3 - Moshe Rabbeinu - Aharon HaKohen - Holiness of the 7 Lights of the Face - Sheep Symbolize Ashirus deKedusha - 7 Kolos Made from a Sheep - BeShalach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Sheep make their owner wealthy because every part of a sheep can be used for holiness. Sound can be made from 7 parts of the sheep. lessons.bodyText: Challah 1 - Tikkun HaBris - Tikkun Loshon HaKodesh - Separating a Portion of Dough - Eys Ratzon - Time of Favor - Chava - Challah Means Tefilah - Repairing Speech - Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Challah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. Challah - separating a portion of dough when making bread. 02:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 58 . 13:30 - NOTE - the ten sefiros are present in the body as well as in the face. 15:30 - Why a portion of the challah dough is given to the Kohen . 19:49 - The mitzvah of separating challah is given to women because Chava ruined the challah of the world: Adam - mankind. Therefore women are responsible for repairing her mistake. 21:30 - The word challah refers to tefilah . 23:00 - Rain completed the process of creation. 24:00 - Q&R about why the dough is not given to the Kohen today. 25:00 - Q&R about why Adam is called the challah of the world. 26:00 - Q&R about the amount of dough required for separating challah . 27:00 - Repairing speech. Until Adam prayed for rain, the world was incomplete. The word Shefa is composed of the first letters of the three tefilos: Amida, Sicha, Pegiya . All shefa comes through tefilah , which is Sheleymus Loshon HaKodesh . *29:45 - The time of separating dough is an Eys Ratzon - a time of favor for tefilah . 31:40 - Speech comes down to the world by passing through all ten sefiros , from the highest level - Chokhma - all the way down to Malkhus . 35:00 - When the Beis HaMikdash stood, if a person was in chutz l'aretz , the portion of dough separated for the mitzvah of hafrashas challah was not given to a kohen . 40:00 - (2024-03-19). מֵֽהָאֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְהָאֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ם - "...From the fire they have emerged, but the fire will devour them..." ( Yechezkel 15:7). 42:00 - Hey HaDiyah. Flour emanates from Gevurah and water from Chessed . Joining the water and flour generates daas , a union of Gevurah and Chessed . It's only after the water is mixed with the flour that the dough is separated for the mitzvah of Hafrashas Challah . 50:00 - NOTE about the structure of Likutey Halakhos : the first halakha in a topic from Shulchan Aruch is usually briefer than subsequent halakhas on that topic.

lessons.bodyText: Challah 2 - Parshas Shelach - Challah is Reishis - Bread Sustains the Heart - Everything Needs Repair - Pinchas - Bris Shalom - Hafrashas Challah for Shabbos - Hafrashas Challah is Usually Done by a Woman - Omer - Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Challah 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 34 - The holy good point in every person. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Overview of Likutey Moharan 34: ... וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם - "...and the Tzaddik is the foundation of the world" ( Mishlei 10:25). Herpah shever libi - a broken heart. A person needs to receive from the tzaddik , from himself, and from friends in order to repair the negative aspects of a broken heart. Humility is the positive aspect of a broken heart. 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. וְהָיָ֕ה בַּֽאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה - "And you eat from the bread of the Land, you shall set aside a gift for HaShem" ; רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ - "The first portion of your dough, you shall separate a loaf for a gift; as in the case of the gift of the threshing floor, so shall you separate it" ( Bamidbar 15:19-20, Shelach ). Challah is reishis . In the merit of women doing the mitzvah of separating the challah , the world is sustained. "Bereishis" alludes to the holy point of light withing every soul. *09:45 - "Bread sustains the heart." A person's sins weigh his heart down. Bread requires a tikkun so it doesn't damage the heart. Everything in the world is damaged, therefore everything needs repair. 14:20 - The separated portion of challah is given to the kohen . Pinchas - Bris Shalom. 16:40 - Parshas Emor - holiness of a kohen . 18:00 - Q&R about the repairing the heart through the mitzvah of hafrashas challah . Review of this halakha so far. 22:00 - Q&R about Chesed - Ahavos Nefulos. 23:00 - כִּֽי־שִׂפְתֵ֚י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ־דַ֔עַת וְתוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִפִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֛י מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה־צְבָא֖וֹת הֽוּא - "For a priest's lips shall guard knowledge, and teaching should be sought from his mouth, for he is a messenger of HaShem of Hosts" ( Malachi 2:7). Finding a rabbi. 26:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. Hafrashas challah when preparing for Shabbos ( Shulchan Aruch 242). Pas Akum during the week, separating challah for Shabbos . 30:20 - The heart is associated with the letter Vuv . The six days of the week represent when the heart is in a state of Ahavos Nefulos . On Shabbos , the heart is repaired through Ahavah beTaAnugim on Shabbos . *32:20 - PARAGRAPH 4. Why Hafrashas Challah is usually done by a woman. 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The minimum shiur of dough requiring separation is parallel the Omer - a tenth of an Ephah . Why hafrashas challah is related to Eretz Yisrael . *45:00 - Q&R - Tikkun Chatzos is a higher priority than Shacharis at Netz HaChamah (sunrise) .

lessons.bodyText: Challah 3 - Reward for a Mitzvah Is Joy - Thunder Straightens Out the Heart - The Mind is Nourished by Bread - Eating in Holiness - Matzah on Pesach Elevates Chometz During the Year - Achieving Tefilah beKoach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Challah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 - "BeChatzotzros" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. 03:30 - The physical world is composed of three dimensions: space, time, and levels of soul - Domem, Tzomeyach, Chai, Medaber . 04:00 - True joy is impossible until the heart is "straightened out". The sound of thunder removes the crookedness in the heart. A person can generate the quality of thunder through Tefilah beKoach - a higher level of sincerity in prayer achieved by using the breath more fully and applying stronger mental/emotional focus. 08:00 - The mind should be pure and cleared of troubles. Morning is an aspect of chessed . All revelation comes about through chessed . *12:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Hafrashas Challah - separating a portion of bread dough for the Kohen. Chometz is souring/spoilage of dough and alludes to misuse of the mind. The goal is to free the mind from the chometz of negative thoughts. Chometz is associated with the Sutra Achra . Only when the mind is cleared of negative thoughts can a person achieve Tefilah beKoach and true simcha . 15:00 - Q&R - The chessed aspect of Tefilah beKoach is the humility of pleading. Biographical NOTE: Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal : "There's a difference between screaming to HaShem and screaming at HaShem ." *17:45 - Life energy is the sechel - activity of the brain. הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ - "...wisdom gives life to its possessor" ( Koheles 7:12). 18:30 - The importance of Pas Shacharis - eating bread in the morning. The sechel is activated through eating. 22:00 - Koheles 5:15. Eating matzah especially straightens out the heart. 23:00 - Q&R about Tefilah beKoach . This level of prayer doesn't necessarily mean using a louder, more forceful voice. *38:00 - Eating Matza heals and purifies the mind and body and enables a similar purification and healing throughout the rest of the year through eating chometz /bread. *42:00 - Bread is associated with holiness of the mind. 44:00 - It is a custom to emphasize the letter Hey when saying the bracha "HaMotzi" before eating bread. This connects the bread to the Hey of matzah . 46:00 - וַֽאֲכַלְתֶּ֚ם אָכוֹל֙ וְשָׂב֔וֹעַ וְהִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־שֵׁ֚ם יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם לְהַפְלִ֑יא וְלֹֽא־יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם - "And you shall eat, eating and being sated, and you shall praise the Name of HaShem your G-d, Who has performed wonders with you, and My people shall never be ashamed" ( Yoel 2:26). 47:00 - יַרְעֵ֚ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֖קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת - "HaShem thunders with His voice wondrous ..." ( Iyov 37:5). 48:00 - צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֖כֵל לְשֹ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ - "A righteous man eats to sate his appetite..." ( Mishlei 13:25). 49:00 - For the tzaddik, "satiation" is tefilah bekavana . 50:00 - Q&R about Tefilah beKoach . Since a person can scream silently, without engaging the vocal chords at all - הָרִ֚ימִי בַכֹּ֙חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ - "...raise your voice with strength...." ( Yeshaya 40:9) doesn't necessarily mean raising the volume - it means elevating the use of the voice by putting more intense force behind the breath, and increasing focus in the mind and heart.

lessons.bodyText: Challah 3 - Thunder - Separating Challah on Erev Shabbos - Lechem Mishneh on Shabbos - Two Coverings - Mohn - Simcha Shel Mitzvah - Zrizus - Enthusiasm and Quickness in Doing Mitzvos - Yetzias Mitzrayim Took Place Quickly - Mitzvah Goreres Mitzvah - Naaseh veNishmah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Challah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 - "BeChatzotzros" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. The connection between thunder and separating a portion of challah dough to the kohen . *05:45 - PARAGRAPH 4. Hafrashas Challah - Separating challah on Erev Shabbos . Two coverings for the challah on the Shabbos table signify that challah is an aspect of mohn - manna. 11:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 57 . 13:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. Lechem Mishnah - two loaves at each Shabbos meal. 22:00 - NOTE about Olam HaBa - עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־רָאָ֗תָה - "...no eye had ever seen..." ( Yeshayahu 64:3). 23:20 - The matzah brought out of Egypt had the taste of mohn - manna. Matzos represent all the mitzvos - the two words are spelled the same. The importance of doing a mitzvah quickly - not letting it have time to become chumetz . 29:00 - Mitzvos should be done quickly. *33:00 - The secret of zrizus - enthusiasm and quickness - is simcha . A mitzvah is not a chore - it's the most rewarding thing in life. "Run to do even a light mitzvah ". Reference to Likutey Moharan 155 - Patience, Faith, and Eretz Yisrael. 37:45 - Q&R about preparation vs. performing a mitzvah . 46:40 - NOTE about the preparation for a mitzvah as well as for the mitzvah . וַיֵּֽלְכ֥וּ וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל - "...the Bnei Yisrael went and did..." Shemos 12:28, Bo ). Story about Rav Kook zal when his son passed away just before his chupah . 51:00 - NOTE about Taanis Esther . ***52:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Naasey veNishmah - Mitzvah goreres mitzvah . The mitzvah being done is an aspect of naasey . The coming mitzvah is an aspect of nishmah - hearing, yearning.

Surviving exile - HeAras HaRatzon through eating. 21:18 - Ratzon - yearning to serve HaShem . מַה־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וּֽמַה־תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ - "...why should you awaken, and why should you arouse the love until it is desirous?" ( Shir HaShirim 8:4). 22:30 - Q&R. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Hafrashas Challah . 28:00 - Q&R about Pas Shacharis . 29:00 - Q&R about other keys to HeAras HaRatzon , such as the concept of Eys Ratzon - a "time of favor" for tefilah . 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Hafrashas Challah - the amount of dough that needs separation for the Kohen is equivalent to the volume of 43 eggs. *32:00 - Stadiums and theaters that were used for wasteful activities during the exile will be transformed into places for service of HaShem . 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. If a person gives the entire batch of dough to the Kohen, the mitzvah is invalid. Reishish - the first portion - is what elevates the dough. 40:00 - Am Yisrael is called Reishis - first among nations. 43:00 - Ruach of Moshiach. Moshiach helps Am Yisrael survive exile. 48:00 - The separation of light from darkness is an aspect of Reishis .

lessons.bodyText: Trumos uMaasros 1 - 2 - Power of Blessings Before Eating or Drinking - Thought - Speech - Action - How Trumos uMaasros Is Determined - Upper and Lower Ruach - Pi Shneyim - Maaser Sheni - Neta Revai - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 . ***00:00 - Power of Blessings Before Eating or Drinking: the blessings bring HaShem's life energy into the food or drink by connecting it to its holy Source. Our words "recreate" the food. 04:00 - Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 2, Nedarim 1 . 06:13 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 : every person has an upper and lower ruach . Thought must go through the stage of speech before becoming action. 09:00 - How Trumos uMaasros is calculated. 14:00 - A person should make 100 blessings every day, alluding to the fact that the lower ruach of a person is 1/100th of the upper ruach . 19:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 11 . Story of the bird with its head in heaven. Birds are associated with speech. 20:00 - Loshon Kodesh is referred to as Pi Shneyim - "double power" - because it's a combination of the upper and lower ruach . 22:00 - One hundred steps from the upper to lower ruach , corresponding to the calculation of trumos umaasros , and the concept of saying 100 blessings each day. 27:00 - מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַֽעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ | יְהֹוָ֗ה כֻּ֖לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ מָֽלְאָ֥ה הָ֜אָ֗רֶץ קִנְיָנֶֽךָ - "How great are Your works, HaShem. You have made them all with wisdom; the earth is full of Your possessions" ( Tehillim 104:24). 31:00 - Maaser Sheni was eaten in Yerushalyim . 36:00 - Neta Revai. 38:00 - NOTE explanation about why in any series in Likutey Halakhos , the first halakha is usually more difficult to understand. 39:00 - HALAKHA 2. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 46:50 - The 39 Melakhos of Shabbos originated from the 39 curses that resulted from the sin of Adam and Chava . In the Future World there will be no need for a person to work, even though work is an aspect of serving HaShem . 51:00 - Q&R about how aging can go toward kindness or toward resentment. 52:00 - Q&R about aging in a positive way. 53:00 - Closing blessings.

The dangers of being overly zealous in performing mitzvos . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The ten blessings in bread. 42:00 - אַל־תְּהִ֤י צַדִּיק֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה וְאַל־תִּתְחַכַּ֖ם יוֹתֵ֑ר - "Be not overly righteous, and be not overly wise..." lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Excessive Fire in the Heart - Pinchas vs. Zimri - The Key to Teshuva Is Humility - Achila beKedushah - Eating with Holiness - Etz HaDaas vs. Etz HaChaim - Lifting the Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - Dangers of excessive fire in
lessons.bodyText: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Excessive Fire in the Heart - Pinchas vs. Zimri - The Key to Teshuva Is Humility - Achila beKedushah - Eating with Holiness - Etz HaDaas vs. Etz HaChaim - Lifting the Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - Dangers of excessive fire in the heart. Pinchas vs. Zimri . 07:00 - Dovid HaMelech and Yeravam ben Navat . 09:00 - The key to teshuvah is humility - a broken heart. Even if the only result of a person's teshuva is to reduce his punishment in Olam Habah , it's worth it. 13:00 - Excessive fire in serving HaShem is an aspect of arrogance. 15:00 - Q&R about examples of excessive fire in the heart: fasting, staying up late and not getting enough sleep. *16:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. Achila beKedushah - eating with holiness. Achieving balance in the use of energy received from food. 18:30 - Good vs. very good. A person needs to stay away from the Etz HaDaas , which is a mixture of good and evil, and cling to the Etz HaChaim . Adam HaRishon's mistake was to try to go beyond his bounds. 23:00 - יַֽעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֖מַיִם יֵֽרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת - "They went up to the heavens, they came down to the depths..." Tehillim 107:26. Reference to Likutey Moharan 72 . 25:30 - The error of Chava in adding to what HaShem commanded was an example of excessive fire in the heart. 28:00 - Esav tried to fool his father by asking questions that were overly religious. ***29:30 - Q&R - How can learning gemara be dangerous for a person if they're new to it? 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The mitzvah of separating Trumah and giving it to the kohen . *34:00 - It's important to study Torah with balance and not with excessive fire. The five books of the Torah correspond to the 5 branches of the lungs, which cool the heart. 36:00 - The hands are an extension of the lungs. Reference to Likutey Moharan 45 . 40:00 - Q&R about lifting the hands - a Jew doesn't lift his hands to do harm, but lifting the hands in tefilah is permitted. 41:00 - Q&R about knowing the "middle path" day by day: through daily tefilah , Torah study, and attachment to tzaddikim . 44:45 - NOTE - today is the yahrzeit of Rabbi Elimelech of Lizhensk zal - the 21st of Adar . 47:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-04-01 - LH5 - YD2 - Trumos uMaasros 3 - Para. 5b-7
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Achila beKedusha - Torah Balances the Heart with the Lungs - Cooling the Negative Passions - Maaser Is a Tenth - Kohen - Levi - Song Comes from the Left Side - Water Purifies - 50 Gates - Sefiras HaOmer - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 -
lessons.bodyText: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Achila beKedusha - Torah Balances the Heart with the Lungs - Cooling the Negative Passions - Maaser Is a Tenth - Kohen - Levi - Song Comes from the Left Side - Water Purifies - 50 Gates - Sefiras HaOmer - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5b. 04:00 - Washing the hands before eating bread. The lungs and hands are connected, spiritually. שְׂאֽוּ־יְדֵכֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֜בָֽרְכוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה - "Lift your hands in the holy place and bless HaShem" ( Tehillim 134:2). 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Giving Trumah to the kohen and Maaser to the Levi . Kohen draws chesed and the ruach that cools the heart, Levi draws gevurah that brings the ability to limit. 09:00 - Gevurah is an aspect of Torah sheBaal Peh - the Oral Torah. Words put boundaries on concepts. Tzimtzim - Dibur - T orah sheBaal Peh . Maaser is a tenth - a specified amount ( Din ), whereas Trumah is an unspecified amount ( Chesed ). 12:30 - Song comes from the left side. NOTE from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : The word Yisrael is made up of two words: Keyl ( Chessed ) and Shir ( Levi/Din ). *15:00 - The dynamics of song. Song is an aspect of tzimzum - measured constriction of the lungs and vocal chords. *16:30 - Q&R - When washing the hands for bread, we only raise them to the level of the face, not above the head. 18:30 - Purification from all types of tumeh - impurity - is done through water. 19:00 - Just as water is necessary to get to a higher level of holiness, water is also necessary to return to a lower level from a higher level, eg. the Kohen Gadol on Yom Kippur. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The connection between trumeh and the lungs. 26:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 27:00 - The number 100 refers to Malkhus and speech, as in Meah Brachos - saying one hundred blessings every day. ***30:00 - Sefiras HaOmer. The word טמא - is begematria 50. Through Torah study we leave the 50 gates of tumeh and enter the 50 gates of holiness. The Torah was given after the completion of 50 days. 33:00 - Q&R about Trumos uMaasros today. 34:00 - Shaar HaChamishim - The Fiftieth Gate of holiness - Shavuos . 37:00 - NOTE: Neshama is "Moshe Noon" . Moshe Rabbeinu was buried on Har Nevo - "the fiftieth arrived". 38:00 - There are 50 levels of impurity. *44:50 - Q&R about finding the "middle path" in serving HaShem . The importance of reading biographies of and stories about tzaddikim .

lessons.title: 2024-04-02 - LH5 - YD2 - Trumos uMaasros 3 - Para. 8-10 - Trumos uMaasros 4 - Para. 1 - Parshas Acharei Mos - Parshas Terumah - Parshas Nitzavim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Parshas Acharei Mos - Parshas Terumah - Parshas Nitzavim - Limiting the Fire of the Heart - 50 Loops and Clasps of the Parokhes - Curtains of the Mishkan - 50 Levels of Holiness - Chumrah - Stringency in Halakha - Parshas VaYetze - Sulam - Three Times Yad - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumo
lessons.bodyText: Trumos uMaasros 3 - Parshas Acharei Mos - Parshas Terumah - Parshas Nitzavim - Limiting the Fire of the Heart - 50 Loops and Clasps of the Parokhes - Curtains of the Mishkan - 50 Levels of Holiness - Chumrah - Stringency in Halakha - Parshas VaYetze - Sulam - Three Times Yad - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 78 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Parshas Acharei Mos . 03:40 - וְאַל־יָבֹ֤א בְכָל־עֵת֙ אֶל־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־הָֽאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת - "...he should not come at all times into the sanctuary within the dividing curtain, in front of the cover that is upon the ark, so that he should not die..." ( Vayikra 16:2, Acharei Mos ). 08:29 - * Parshas Terumah . וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת "And you shall make loops of blue wool on the edge of one curtain..." ( Shemos 26:6, Terumah ). 50 Loops of the parokhes - Curtain in the Mishkan . Constriction of HaShem's light makes it possible for people to accomplish tikkun in the world. 12:33 - PARAGRAPH 9. Giving Maaser to the Levi completes the process of giving terumah to the Kohen. 22:21 - ***PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas Nitzavim . לֹ֥א בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵאמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַֽעֲלֶה־לָּ֤נוּ הַשָּׁמַ֨יְמָה֙ וְיִקָּחֶ֣הָ לָּ֔נוּ וְיַשְׁמִעֵ֥נוּ אֹתָ֖הּ וְנַֽעֲשֶֽׂנָּה - "It is not in heaven, that you should say, 'Who will go up to heaven for us and fetch it for us, to tell to us, so that we can fulfill it?' " Devarim 30:12, Nitzavim ). 30:45 - Parshas VaYetze - וַיַּֽחֲלֹ֗ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה סֻלָּם֙ מֻצָּ֣ב אַ֔רְצָה וְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ מַגִּ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יְמָה וְהִנֵּה֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים וְיֹֽרְדִ֖ים בּֽוֹ - "And he dreamed, and behold! a ladder set up on the ground and its top reached to heaven; and behold, angels of God were ascending and descending upon it" ( Bereishis 28:12, Vayetze). 29:27 - ***Conclusion of "It is not in heaven..." and closing blessings. 35:41 - ***Q&R about observing chumrah - stringency - in Torah. NOTE about Rav Shlomo Yaakov Goldman on observing second day of Yom Tov in Chutz L'Aretz if a Jewish resident of Eretz Yisrael is visiting outside of Israel. 42:44 - HALAKHA 4. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 46 - three times Yad , clapping hands. 46:55 - NOTE: Three times Y - K - V - K is begematria Chessed . 47:10 - NOTE: Shalev and three times Y - K - V - K . 49:00 - Q&R - The left hand is called Gevurah - meaning containment. It doesn't imply HaShem's "Left Hand" is stronger than His "Right Hand". 47:58 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-04-03 - LH5 - YD2 - Trumos uMaasros 4 - Para. 2-9 - Korach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Trumos uMaasros 4 - Procedure of Trumah to the Kohen and Maaser to the Levi - Curse Affecting the Earth's Produce - Throat - Yabbok - Preference of Right and Left in Observing Mitzvos - Tzedakah - Lifting the Hands - Shir of Channah - 10 Mitzvos of Bread - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 4 is based
lessons.bodyText: Trumos uMaasros 4 - Procedure of Trumah to the Kohen and Maaser to the Levi - Curse Affecting the Earth's Produce - Throat - Yabbok - Preference of Right and Left in Observing Mitzvos - Tzedakah - Lifting the Hands - Shir of Channah - 10 Mitzvos of Bread - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Trumos uMaasros 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 46 - three times Yad , clapping hands. 00:00 - Review of the introduction to this halakha . Three time Yad - three times Elokim . Shin Lamed Vuv . שָׁ֘לֵ֚ו הָיִ֨יתִי | וַיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז - "I was at peace (shilav) but He crumbled me to pieces " ( Iyov 16:12). 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Observing the 613 mitzvos enables Am Yisrael to sweeten dinim - judgments. ***03:30 - Concise overview of the 3 steps of Trumos uMaasros . ***07:20 - Produce that grows from the ground is cursed due to the sin of Adam HaRishon . These curses affect eating, when food passes through the constriction of the throat. *10:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parshas Korach . Why the mitzvos of Trumos uMaasros are given directly following the account of Korach's rebellion. Korach was a Levi, Aharon was a Kohen. Korach's tikkun was to make din subservient to chesed , which is the universal tikkun . 12:15 - The SheLaH HaKodesh explains why Korach was actually denying the entire Torah. Making the left subservient to the right repairs all the worlds. 14:15 - Parshas Korach. וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם תְּרֽוּמַתְכֶ֑ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן־הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן־הַיָּֽקֶב - "Your gift shall be considered for you as grain from the threshing-floor and as the produce of the vat" ( Bamidbar 18:27, Korach ). Chiddush of Rav Nosson zal: Goren, Garon, Yabbok . Ya'aneynu beyom kareynu - Roshei Teivos Yabbok. שלו is 3 times Yabbok . 3 times Y - K - V - K overpowering 3 time ELOKIM . 19:00 - Q&R about preference of right and left in performing mitzvos . 20:00 - Q&R about the difference between the sin of Adam HaRishon and the sin of Korach . 21:00 - Student's NOTE about preference of right and left in performing mitzvos . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Tzedakah . "I'm giving this tzedakah to enable me to become attached to true tzaddikim ." 30:00 - Q&R about giving tzedakah to enable attaching oneself to tzaddikim . *31:00 - NOTE - Breslov custom to emphasize the words "because HaShem commanded" when reciting the ketores each day. 32:20 - PARAGRAPH 5. Spiritual aspects of hands. Lifting the hands upward expresses yearning for HaShem . 35:00 - וְתַֽעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָֽלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין - "...and rise to your lot at the end of the days" ( Daniel 12:13). *36:00 - Lifting the hands upward helps a person connect with a higher spiritual level. 38:00 - Q&R about the left side being subservient to the right with regard to a woman being the crown of her husband. 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas Korach - וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח משֶׁ֔ה לִקְרֹ֛א לְדָתָ֥ן וְלַֽאֲבִירָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּֽאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַֽעֲלֶֽה - "Moshe summoned Dasan and Abiram, the sons of Eliav, but they said, 'We will not go up' " ( Bamidbar 16:12, Korach ). 42:40 - Because they refused to go up, they went down. Their punishment matched their crime: the earth swallowed them up. 44:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Shmuel HaNavi , a Levi and descendant of Elkanah , accomplished the tikkun for the sin of Korach . In contrast to Korach , merged earth with heaven. The shir of Channah describes how the arrogant are cast down. ***48:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Reference to Likutey Moharan 45 . Connecting the five fingers of one hand with the five fingers of the other hand corresponds with the ten different mitzvos we fulfill through bread. This is why we hold the bread with all ten fingers. 50:40 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Reishis HaGez 1 - Garments Protect - Shearing Wool - Cherem - Excommunication - Daled Amos - Four Cubits of a Person's Malkhus - Domain - Shoes - Garments of Leather - Malakh Mem Tess - Etz HaDaas - Tree of Knowledge - Good and Evil - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 a
lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 1 - Garments Protect - Shearing Wool - Cherem - Excommunication - Daled Amos - Four Cubits of a Person's Malkhus - Domain - Shoes - Garments of Leather - Malakh Mem Tess - Etz HaDaas - Tree of Knowledge - Good and Evil - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 and Yoreh Deah 333. Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 : "At all times let your clothing be white..." 00:00 - Garments protect a person physically and spiritually. 18:00 - The first shearing of wool is given to the kohen . This draws the spiritual purity of "whiteness" into clothing. The holy oil with which the kohen and the vessels of the Beis HaMikdash were anointed corresponds with sekhel and tikkun habris . 22:00 - Q&R the difference between the kashrus of food and the laws of shatnez . 25:00 - There are 24 reasons why a person can be put in cherem - excommunication. 28:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . "Nidui" is another word for cherem . 30:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 259 . The mouth is associated with malkhus . The establishment of a kingdom depends on shalom - peace. ***32:00 - Daled Amos - the four cubits of a person's malkhus - domain. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. A person in cherem must remove his shoes. 36:00 - Shoes, leather garments, Malakh Mem Tess . Etz HaDaas - Ra is 270 , Tov is 17 is equal to Chesed plus Gevurah Chava - their original garments of light were replaced by garments of leather. 40:00 - A person needs greatest protection for their feet, since the ground was cursed. Leather shoes are a spiritual protection. "Sell the beams of your house to buy shoes." A person in cherem removes their shoes. 43:00 - Correspondence between the 24 reasons a person is excommunicated, the 24 Courts of Heaven, and the 24 letters in Baruch Shem Kvod Malkhuso LeOlam VaEd . ***45:00 - Q&R about separating good from evil. Brief overview of the Etz HaDaas - Tree of Knowledge - Good and Evil. 46:00 - Q&R about the RaMCHaL being put in cherem . 48:00 - Q&R about how to deal with impure speech in others.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Reishis HaGez 1 - Hilkhos Aveylus - 7 Days of Mourning - Death - Makhlokes - Conflict - Torn Clothing - Shiva - Oil Represents Mochin deGadlus - Reishis HaGez 2 - Determining Halakha Is Related to Shearing Wool - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 . 00:00 - Makhlokes - c
lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 1 - Hilkhos Aveylus - 7 Days of Mourning - Death - Makhlokes - Conflict - Torn Clothing - Shiva - Oil Represents Mochin deGadlus - Reishis HaGez 2 - Determining Halakha Is Related to Shearing Wool - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 19 . 00:00 - Makhlokes - conflict - causes damage to clothing. Tearing garments during shiva - seven days of mourning. 05:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 127 . 11:00 - Anointing with oil is forbidden during aveylus . Oil represents Mochin deGadlus . 12:30 - During aveylus , garments are not washed. 13:00 - 7 days of mourning. Why is aveylus 7 days? 14:00 - 30 days of the secondary period of mourning. 16:20 - A person in mourning is not permitted to cut his hair. 19:00 - Q&R about speaking with a mourner. 20:00 - Q&R about marital relations being prohibited during mourning. 21:00 - A holiday eliminates aveylus , but Shabbos doesn't. When Shabbos is over, the mourner continues the shiva . 24:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 135 . *25:00 - On Shabbos no separation of good from bad is taking place. There's no battle to defeat the Sutra Achra on Shabbos because evil has no grip on good during Shabbos . 25:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . On Yom Tov we're bringing down evil and elevating the Malkhus of Kedusha . Therefore Yom Tov eliminates aveylus . 29:00 - Q&R about a mourner being required to do the symbolic acts of aveylus . 30:00 - Q&R about Yom Tov defeating the 4 kingdoms of the Sutra Achra while Shabbos does not. 31:30 - Q&R about birur on Shabbos . Analogy of a worker taking a vacation. 35:00 - HALAKHA 2. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . - Memory is connected with the eyes. 36:00 - Determining halakha is related to shearing wool because it is a process of separating truth from illusion. 40:00 - The first wool sheared from a sheep belongs to the kohen . וּכְרָחֵ֕ל לִפְנֵ֥י גֹֽזְזֶ֖יהָ - "...and as a ewe before being shorn..." ( Yeshaya 53:7).

lessons.title: 2024-04-07 - LH5 - YD2 - Reishis HaGez 2 - Part 2 - Reishis HaGez 3 - Para. 1-2
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Reishis HaGez 2 - Malkhus Moshiach - Memory Is Related to the Eyes - Shearing Wool - Separating Daas from Medameh - Dovid HaMelech vs. Avshalom - Yaakov Avinu vs. Lavan - Shepherds of Israel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . - Memory Is Related to the Eyes. Dovid Ha
lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 2 - Malkhus Moshiach - Memory Is Related to the Eyes - Shearing Wool - Separating Daas from Medameh - Dovid HaMelech vs. Avshalom - Yaakov Avinu vs. Lavan - Shepherds of Israel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . - Memory Is Related to the Eyes. Dovid HaMelech and Avshalom - Moshiach is the tikkun for a person who has the evil eye of seeking improper hisnasus - leadership. 05:30 - Malkhus Moshiach is damaged by improper hisnasus . ***08:00 - Sipurey Maasiyos - Story of the First Beggar - Zikhoren deKedushah - memory conquers time. Moshiach is all about hischadush - constant renewal. 11:00 - Tzaddikim are perfecting both zikaron - memory - and medameh - imagination - in themselves and in Klal Yisrael . 13:00 - Shearing wool is done to make clothing, which is an aspect of daas/makifim - knowledge/potential knowledge. 14:30 - Animals have only medameh . Separating the wool from an animal elevates the medameh to daas . This reveals the Malkhus Moshiach when "The world will be filled with recognition of HaShem . ***16:30 - The leaders of Am Yisrael all were shepherds, so they could become expert in the processes needed to elevate animal consciousness to human consciousness. 17:30 - מֵֽאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱבִ֫יא֥וֹ לִ֖רְעוֹת בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ - "From behind the nursing ewes He brought him, to shepherd Jacob His people..." ( Tehillim 78:71). Dovid HaMelech's kindness to the sheep he cared for. 19:00 - Yaakov Avinu was bringing mademeh to daas through serving as a shepherd. A dream seems real, but it's not. 20:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 . The term targum is begematria tardeyma - deep sleep. 21:00 - Lavan drew power from targum . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 26:00 - Dovid HaMelech and Naval . וַיָּבֹ֚א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה־נָ֥א גֹזְזִ֖ים לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ - "And Avshalom came to the King, and said, 'Behold now, your servant has sheepshearers...' " 2Shumel 13:24. Why this incident took place at the time of shearing the sheep. 28:30 - Q&R regarding hischadshus - Reference to Likutey Moharan 79 - Rosh Chodesh is a concept of renewal for the leadership, especially Rosh Chodesh Nissan , which is the first of the twelve lunar months. Rosh Chodesh Nissan is the birthday of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. 31:00 - Q&R about how a person today can transform medameh to daas . Any expansion of the daas and Zikharon deKedusha is an aspect of Malkhus Moshiach . 34:00 - HALAKHA 3. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 34:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. Overview of 2Likutey Moharan 7. 40:25 - PARAGRAPH 2. Chashmal - a high level of daas - is begematria Malbush - clothing. "Deep secrets of the Torah" are the garments ( Chagigah 13). 43:00 - The Torah sheBaal Peh is compared to shearing wool. 47:00 - Silence is a protective fence around chokhmah . The kohen represents the tzaddik of the generation - the only person qualified to provide both aspects of how wisdom is acquired: Ben veTalmid , as in כִּֽי־שִׂפְתֵ֚י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ־דַ֔עַת וְתוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִפִּ֑יהוּ - "For a priest's lips shall guard knowledge, and teaching should be sought from his mouth..." ( Malakhi 2:7). If a person wants to draw upon himself the holy garments of the higher levels of chokhmah , he must receive them through the kohen/tzaddik hador. 50:00 - Closing blessings before Rabbi Miamon travels to Uman for Rosh Chodesh Nissan .

lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 3 - Awareness of HaShem - Siyag LeChokhma - Knowing When To Be Silent - Makif - Peleh - Alef - Tzaddik HaDor - How and When To Ask Questions - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. סְיָג לַחָכְמָה שְׁתִיקָה - "...silence is a fence for wisdom" ( Avos 3:13). 04:00 - רֵ֘אשִׁ֚ית חָכְמָ֨ה | יִרְאַ֬ת יְהֹוָ֗ה - "The beginning of wisdom is fear of HaShem..." ( Tehillim 111:10). 07:00 - Sin is a result of Ribui Ohr - too much light. 19:30 - The only person in the generation who truly knows when to be silent is the Tzaddik HaDor . 21:30 - The first wool sheared from a sheep is given to the kohen. This is an aspect of creating garments that are within the boundaries of each individual. 23:00 - The kohen is an aspect of Tzaddik HaDor . כַּשֶּׁ֚מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב | עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַל־הַזָּ֫קָ֥ן זְקַ֥ן אַֽהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֜יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו - "As the good oil on the head runs down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron, which flows down to the hem of his garments" ( Tehillim 133:2). 28:00 - Q&R about knowing which questions to ask. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. 34:45 - וְכָל־בָּנַ֖יִךְ לִמּוּדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה - "And all your children shall be students of HaShem..." ( Yeshaya 54:13). 37:00 - NOTE - HaShem's Name Y - K - V - K relates to the 10 midos of HaShem . The Yud - Hey relates to the 3 upper levels - Keser Chakhma Binah , the Vuv relates to the 6 middle levels. The final Hey relates to Malkhus . Zman - time - is an aspect of the seven lower levels. 39:20 - Q&R about questions and time.

lessons.title: 2024-04-12 - LH5 - YD2 - Reishis HaGez 3 - Para. 5-8a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Reishis HaGez 3 - Whiteness of Wool - Atik - Makifim - Tetzaveh - Seudah at the Time of Shearing Sheep - Achila beKedusha - HeAras HaRatzon - Yehudah, Tamar, Moshiach - Why Dovid HaMelech Will Live Forever - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The h
lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 3 - Whiteness of Wool - Atik - Makifim - Tetzaveh - Seudah at the Time of Shearing Sheep - Achila beKedusha - HeAras HaRatzon - Yehudah, Tamar, Moshiach - Why Dovid HaMelech Will Live Forever - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The holiness of the clothing of the kohen is received through *07:45 - Q&R about who is the Tzaaddik HaDor . There are two different opinions on this in Breslov. 09:00 - Korbon Tamid - two sheep brought twice a day as a forgiveness for Klal Yisrael . The word keves - sheep - is related to the word kavshi refer to the deepest secrets of the Torah, which are represented by the wool of sheep. 11:00 - Parshas Tetzaveh - the oil used for the menorah is an aspect of the makifim . This is related to the clothing worn by the kohanim , which are made of wool, and which draw their holiness from the makifim . *14:00 - The light of Chanukah is generated by the forgiveness of sins on Yom Kippur. 15:00 - Achila beKedusha - HeAras HaRatzon when eating - the custom of having a special seudah at the time of shearing the sheep. *18:00 - Makifim are an aspect of HeAras HaRatzon . 19:00 - וּכְרָחֵ֕ל לִפְנֵ֥י גֹֽזְזֶ֖יהָ נֶֽאֱלָ֑מָה וְלֹ֥א יִפְתַּ֖ח פִּֽיו - "...and as a sheep before it has been shorn" ( Yeshaya 53:7). 21:00 - Sheep make their owners wealthy, because every part of the sheep can be used to benefit man. The main flow of wealth and parnassah is brought to us through makifim . 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Yehudah, Tamar, Moshiach . Correction of the sin of Er and Onan took place at the time of shearing the sheep. 26:30 - NOTE: Niuf is begematria 131 - Tikkun HaBris through makifim . Pi yidaber chakhma - the wisdom that a person is supposed to shine into his child or student. By Er and Onan refusing to bring children into the world, they prevented the flow of light to Am Yisrael from Atik/makifim . The tikkun accomplished through the incident of Yehudah and Tamar , established the flow of light from Atik/makifim and established the lineage of Moshiach through the birth of their sons, Peretz and Zerach . 32:00 - NOTE from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about Tikkun HaBris . The candle is the brain, the oil are the fluids of the body that nourish the brain. Pegam HaBris can be repaired through the Name of HaShem: Beis Yud Tess. - Shemen beAtbash is Beis Yud Tess . כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים - "As a shepherd tends his flock, with His arm He gathers lambs..." ( Yeshaya 40:11). The Chidah zal established a tefilah that brings this Name of HaShem . *36:00 - The significance of Dovid HaMelech being a shepherd. מֵֽאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱבִ֫יא֥וֹ לִ֖רְעוֹת בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֜בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַֽחֲלָתֽוֹ - "From behind the nursing ewes He brought him, to shepherd Yaakov, His People and Israel, His heritage" ( Tehillim 78:71). The kingdom of Dovid HaMelech is the kingdom of Moshiach . 38:00 - Dovid HaMelech is compared to a silent dove - ( Tehillim 56:1). The main tikkun is the ability of the tzaddikim to go above the level of speech, to the realm of makifim and silence. 39:20 - Q&R about makifim bringing forgiveness for sin. 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. NOTE - Malkhus is called Rochel . Malkhus rises up to receive from the Yam HaChokhma . This is symbolized by sheep shearing. Dovid HaMelech , Avigail , and Naval . *47:00 - NOTE: Tov vs. Tov Meod . Too good is not good. 48:00 - Daas is the true life of a person. *49:20 - Why Dovid HaMelech will live forever. 52:00 - Q&R about the protective power of studying Torah. *53:00 - NOTE about Rabbi Maimon's recent trip to Uman for Rosh Chodesh Nissan . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 3 - Dovid HaMelech vs. Naval - Avshalom - Nidui - Chashmal - Protective Power of Shoes - Tefillin - Moshe Rabbeinu Knew When To Be Silent - Parshas Shemos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nidui . 27:00 - The protective power of shoes. Naal - shoe - is from the root word "to close", as in Tefilas Neilah , which is related to silence. 29:00 - Just as tefillin are made from leather, so shoes are also made from leather. 34:00 - Spiritually, weakness in the legs and feet indicates negative forces from lower regions. 35:30 - On Yom Kippur, the Yetzer Hara is powerless. "The sin of the heel of my foot surrounds me" 37:00 - שַׁל־נְעָלֶ֨יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עוֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔יו אַדְמַת־קֹ֖דֶשׁ הֽוּא - "Remove the shoes from your feet, because the place where you're standing is holy ground" ( Shemos 3:5, Shemos ). 49:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu was qualified to receive the Torah on behalf of Am Yisrael because he was Kvod Peh - he knew when to be silent. 50:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Reishis HaGez 3 - Bikur Cholim - Shekhina - Pi Shneyim - Double Portion of Ruach - Importance of Preparing a Last Will - Both Cherim and Aveylus Are 30 Days - Excommunication and Mourning - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Hilkhos Bikur Cholim .
lessons.bodyText: Reishis HaGez 3 - Bikur Cholim - Shekhina - Pi Shneyim - Double Portion of Ruach - Importance of Preparing a Last Will - Both Cherim and Aveylus Are 30 Days - Excommunication and Mourning - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Reishis HaGez 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Hilkhos Bikur Cholim . 07:00 - The importance of bringing children into the world who can continue one's daas . 09:00 - The Shekhina is at the head of the bed of a person who's ill. Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 . Pi Shneyim - Double Portion of Ruach . Every person has a lower ruach and an upper ruach . When it's time for a person to pass away, the upper ruach descends and pulls up with it the lower ruach . 13:00 - Yaakov Avinu achieved the highest level of Ben VeTalmid because all of his children were tzaddikim . He is also the first person ever to fall ill before passing away. 15:00 - NOTE about how Rabbi Rosenfeld zal prepared his students for his passing. The importance of peace and cooperation between children in a family, or unity in a group. 16:00 - The importance of preparing a will. ***22:00 - If a person's children continue in the path of the torah, it's as if the person didn't pass away. "Dovid Melech Yisrael chai vekayam." 24:00 - Q&R about the Avos passing their daas on to children and students. NOTE about Rebbe Nachman's answer to the Trovitzer Maggid about the seforim written by Avraham Avinu and Yitzchak Avinu . 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Both Cherem - and Aveylus are 30 days. Excommunication and mourning. 34:00 - Daas is a unification between opposites. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 89 . Shidduchim - "Sifsei Kohen..." 36:00 - NOTE - The unification between Adam and Chava is called daas . 40:00 - Q&R about peace being related to daas because both are a result of unifying opposites. 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol . 55:00 - Q&R about the significance of the topic around which the cherem of Rabbi Eliezer HaGadol was centered.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Pirya uReviya 3 - Importance of Music at a Wedding - Sweetening Midas HaDin - Song Comes from the North - Sheleymus HaSimcha - Extracting Holiness from Ruach Ra - Ten Types of Song - Lecha Dodi - Whistling Is for Non-Jews - Ketores - Nadav veAvihu - Parshas Shemini - Joy and Holiness in Marriage - Shalom Bayis - Netzac
lessons.bodyText: Pirya uReviya 3 - Importance of Music at a Wedding - Sweetening Midas HaDin - Song Comes from the North - Sheleymus HaSimcha - Extracting Holiness from Ruach Ra - Ten Types of Song - Lecha Dodi - Whistling Is for Non-Jews - Ketores - Nadav veAvihu - Parshas Shemini - Joy and Holiness in Marriage - Shalom Bayis - Netzach shebeNetzach - Birth of Children - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Sheleymus HaSimcha is taking the things that are making one unhappy and including them in one's joy. Hilkhos Pirya uReviya 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. 11:00 - The importance of music at a wedding. 12:00 - Song is created by extracting the Ruach Tov from Ruach Ra . Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . 16:00 - The Ten Types of Song can break a person's heart and draw him closer to HaShem . Lecha Dodi. 17:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 273 - the power of song to draw a person closer to HaShem and bring him to joy. "It's very important for a person to have a song on their lips." 18:00 - "A holy song takes you down, then takes you up." *18:00 - Q&R about the responsibility of a man to bring joy to his wife. Even simply humming a tune takes a person to a completely new place. A person can handle anything when they have a song on their lips. 19:00 - The five levels of holiness in the Written Torah. 21:39 - Q&R - Whistling is for non-Jews ( Rama in Shulchan Aruch , brought by Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal ). 22:35 - PARAGRAPH 5. Ketores. 26:00 - Saying every word of Ketores with feeling and heart. Treating every word of the Ketores as a great treasure helps a person achieve joy. 27:00 - NOTE: The number 10 - 385 is begematria Shekhina . The number 11 is related to the Angel of Death. The name Mordekhai is in the Chumash as Mor DeRor in the Ketores . Chelbanah is begematria Haman . 31:00 - Q&R about listening to acapella song (voices only with no musical instruments) during Sefiras HaOmer . 32:00 - Q&R about music at a wedding in Yerushalayim . 35:40 - Q&R about finding the good in evil. 37:06 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas Shemini . Nadav veAvihu . 43:51 - PARAGRAPH 7. *47:00 - Joy facilitates the birth of children. 48:00 - יִֽשְׂמַח־אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ וְ֜תָגֵ֗ל יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ - "Your father and mother will rejoice, and she who bore you will have joy" ( Mishlei 23:25). 51:00 - NOTE: This Shabbos will be Netzah shebeNetzach - the sefira of Rebbe Nachman and the central day of Sefiras HaOmer . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

Hilkhos Pirya uReviya 3 is based on 2Likutey Moh
lessons.bodyText: Pirya uReviya 3 - Sipurey Masiyos - Seven Beggars - Beggar With No Hands - Tikkun HaBris - The Castle of Water - The Ten Types of Song Represent the Totality of Simcha - Tehillim - Tikkun HaKlali - Shofar - Yom Kippur - 5 Kolos - 72 Strings - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pirya uReviya 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - Introduction 01:00 - PARAGRAPH 10b. Sipurey Masiyos . Story of the Seven Beggars. 14:00 - Q&R about the correspondence between the arrows in the story and Tikkun HaBris . 16:30 - The Castle of Water surrounded by ten walls of water. 21:06 - The 10 Types of Song. Sounds of the shofar . *24:00 - The main cure for all illness is through joy. The 10 Types of Song infuse life into the 10 pulses. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Akeidas Yitzchak on Rosh HaShanah . 32:30 - The name Yitzchak is an expression of the joy of his parents, Avraham Avinu and Sara Imeynu . *33:00 - Akeida means "tying" up the Midas HaDin. 37:00 - Yom Kippur. Living by means of bread vs. living by means of the Voice of HaShem - the 5 Kolos of HaShem correspond to the 10 Types of Song and the 5 tefilos of Yom Kippur. *42:00 - The letter Hey represents the 10 Types of Song. Reference to Likutey Moharan 49 . The Harp of 72 strings. 48:30 - אֲדֹנָ֚י | שְׁמָ֙עָה֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י | סְלָ֔חָה אֲדֹנָ֛י הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה וַֽעֲשֵׂ֖ה אַל־תְּאַחַ֑ר לְמַֽעַנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּֽי־שִׁמְךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל־עִֽירְךָ֖ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ - "HaShem, hear! HaShem, forgive! HaShem, listen, and act without delay for Your own sake, HaShem; for Your Name is attached to Your city and Your People!”" Daniel 9:19. NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : the first letters in a section of this possuk equal 365, a number that alludes to the 3 upper sefiros , the 6 middle sefiros , and the Hey (5) of Malkhus . Through the words of this possuk , Daniel was referring to all ten sefiros . 50:00 - Closing blessings. TEXT: וְאַף-עַל-פִּי שֶׁבְּוַדַּאי אֵינִי זוֹכֶה לֵידַע כְּטִפָּה מִן הַיָּם מִסּוֹד הַמַּעֲשִׂיּוֹת שֶׁסִּפֵּר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה הַמּוּבָאִים בַּסֵּפֶר סִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת, וּמִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן וְכָל שֶׁכֵּן בַּמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנּוֹרָאָה הַזֹּאת הַקְּדוֹשָׁה מִכֻּלָּם כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר שָׁם, אַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן עִנְיָן זֶה בְּוַדַּאי מְרֻמָּז בִּדְבָרָיו בְּתוֹךְ כְּלָלִיּוּת שְׁאָר הָעִנְיָנִים וְהַסּוֹדוֹת הַנּוֹרָאוֹת שֶׁכִּוֵּן, אֲבָל עִנְיָן זֶה כָּלוּל בְּוַדַּאי גַּם כֵּן בִּדְבָרָיו הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁבְּהַמַּעֲשֶׂה הַנַּ"ל, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁזֶּה שְׁאָלוֹ, אֵיזֶה מִין חִצִּים אַתָּה יָכוֹל לְהוֹצִיא? פֵּרוּשׁ, אֵיזֶה פְּגַם הַבְּרִית אַתָּה יָכוֹל לְתַקֵּן? כִּי יֵשׁ כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה בְּחִינוֹת בִּפְגַם הַבְּרִית אַלְפֵי אֲלָפִים וְרִבֵּי רְבָבוֹת, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי לֹא כָּל הַפְּגָּמִים וְהַחֲטָאִים שָׁוִים כַּיָּדוּעַ לַכֹּל, הֱשִׁיבוֹ, מִין פְּלוֹנִי. (וְעַיֵּן שָׁם מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב מֵעִנְיַן הַסַּמִּים שֶׁמּוֹשְׁחִים בָּהֶם הַחִצִּים שֶׁעַל-יְדֵי-זֶה מַזִּיקִים וְכוּ', וְהַכֹּל מְרַמֵּז לָעִנְיָן הַנַּ"ל), כְּלוֹמַר שֶׁזֶּה הַחֵלֶק מִפְּגַם הַבְּרִית שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִין חֵץ פְּלוֹנִי, הוּא יָכוֹל לַחֲזֹר וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ לַחוּץ וּלְתַקֵּן, הֱשִׁיבוֹ זֶה שֶׁבְּלֹא יָדַיִם, עֲדַיִן אֵינְךָ יָכוֹל לְרַפְּאוֹת אֶת הַבַּת מַלְכָּה, מֵאַחַר שֶׁאֵין אַתָּה יָכוֹל לַחֲזֹר וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ כִּי אִם מִין חֵץ אֶחָד וְזֶה יָדוּעַ שֶׁהַבַּת מַלְכָּה שָׁם מְרַמֵּז עַל הַשְּׁכִינָה שֶׁהִיא כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, כְּלָלִיּוּת נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁנִּקְרֵאת "בַּת מֶלֶךְ", כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, "כָּל כְּבוּדָּה בַת מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה", וְכֵן בַּזֹּהַר וּבַתִּקּוּנִים נִקְרֵאת, "בְּרַתָּא דְּמַלְכָּא" בְּכַמָּה וְכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת. וְהַשְּׁכִינָה בְּגָלוּת מְדֻכֵּאת בְּיִסּוּרִים בַּעֲווֹנוֹתֵינוּ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, בִּזְמַן שֶׁאָדָם מִצְטַעֵר שְׁכִינָה מָה אוֹמֶרֶת? קַלַּנִי מֵרֹאשִׁי קַלַּנִי מִזְּרוֹעִי. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, "רָחֵל מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנֶיהָ מֵאֲנָה לְהִנָּחֵם עַל בָּנֶיהָ וְכוּ'" וְעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר (אֵיכָה ג), "דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיַּצִיבֵנִי כַּמַּטָּרָא לַחֵץ, הֵבִיא בְּכִלְיֹתָי בְּנֵי אַשְׁפָּתוֹ". כִּי כָּל הַחִצִּים הָרָעִים שֶׁל פְּגַם הַבְּרִית נִזְרָקִים לְהַשְּׁכִינָה וּכְנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כַּיָּדוּעַ, וְזֶהוּ גַּם כֵּן בְּחִינַת (תְּהִלִּים לח) כִּי חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶךָ. וְעַל-כֵּן אַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן שֶׁזֶּה הִתְפָּאֵר שֶׁיָּכוֹל לְהוֹצִיא חֵץ, אַף-עַל-פִּי-כֵן עֲדַיִן אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְרַפְּאוֹת אֶת הַבַּת מַלְכָּה, שֶׁהִיא הַשְּׁכִינָה, כְּלָלִיּוּת נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, מֵאַחַר שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהוֹצִיא כִּי אִם חֵץ אֶחָד, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁאֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְתַקֵּן כִּי אִם פְּגַם הַבְּרִית אֶחָד יָדוּעַ, אֲבָל יֵשׁ עֲדַיִן חִצִּים רָעִים כָּאֵלּוּ שֶׁהֵם פְּגָמִים גְּדוֹלִים כָּאֵלּוּ שֶׁגַּם הוּא אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לְהוֹצִיאָם וּלְתַקְּנָם, אֲבָל זֶה שֶׁבְּלֹא יָדַיִם הִתְפָּאֵר בַּסּוֹף שֶׁהוּא יָכוֹל לְהוֹצִיא כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי חִצִּים שֶׁבָּהֶם כְּלוּלִים כָּל מִינֵי חֲטָאִים וְכָל מִינֵי פְּגַם הַבְּרִית שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, כָּל הַחֲטָאִים וְהָעֲווֹנוֹת וְהַפְּשָׁעִים הַגְּדוֹלִים מְאֹד מְאֹד רַחֲמָנָא לִצְלַן, הַכֹּל כַּאֲשֶׁר לַכֹּל הוּא יָכוֹל לַחֲזֹר וּלְהַמְשִׁיךְ וּלְהוֹצִיא וּלְתַקֵּן הַכֹּל, כִּי הוּא יָכוֹל לִכְנֹס לְתוֹךְ כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי חוֹמוֹת שֶׁל מַיִם שֶׁשָּׁם מֻנַּחַת הַבַּת מַלְכָּה שֶׁנָּפְלָה חַלָּשׁוּת זֶה כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה מֵאוֹת שָׁנִים, וְהוּא יָכוֹל לִכְנֹס לְשָׁם, לְתוֹךְ כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה חוֹמוֹת שֶׁל מַיִם, וְיוֹדֵעַ לְהוֹצִיא כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי חִצִּים וְיוֹדֵעַ כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי דְּפִיקִין וְיוֹדֵעַ לְרַפְּאוֹתָהּ עַל-יְדֵי כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה נִמְצָא, שֶׁעִקַּר הָרְפוּאָה שֶׁל הַבַּת מַלְכָּה, שֶׁהִיא הַשְּׁכִינָה, כְּלָלִיּוּת נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, הוּא עַל-יְדֵי עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה שֶׁהֵם כְּלָלִיּוּת הַשִּמְחָה. וְזֶה שֶׁכָּתַב רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנַּ"ל, שֶׁעִקַּר כָּל הָרְפוּאוֹת בְּגַשְׁמִיּוּת וְרוּחָנִיּוּת הוּא עַל-יְדֵי שִׂמְחָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה, כִּי עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה מְחַיִּין כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי דְּפִיקִין שֶׁהֵם חִיּוּת הָאָדָם, וְכָל הַחוֹלַאַת, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, וְכָל הָרְפוּאוֹת תְּלוּיִים בָּהֶם בְּהָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי דְּפִיקִין כַּיָּדוּעַ, וְעִקַּר חִיּוּת הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי דְּפִיקִין הוּא עַל-יְדֵי שִׂמְחָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה, עַל-כֵּן הַשִּמְחָה הוּא דָּבָר גָּדוֹל מְאֹד וּצְרִיכִין לְחַזֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּשִׂמְחָה תָּמִיד בְּכָל הַכֹּחוֹת, כִּי הִיא עִקַּר רְפוּאוֹת הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהַגּוּף, בְּחִינַת רְפוּאַת הַבַּת מַלְכָּה כַּנַּ"ל נִמְצָא, שֶׁעִקַּר תִּקּוּן הַתְּשׁוּבָה, שֶׁהוּא רְפוּאַת הַנֶּפֶשׁ וְהַגּוּף, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, "לְכוּ וְנָשׁוּבָה אֶל ה' כִּי הוּא טָרָף וְיִרְפָּאֵנוּ" וְכוּ', הוּא עַל-יְדֵי הַשִּמְחָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה, עַל-כֵּן בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, שֶׁהוּא יוֹם רִאשׁוֹן לַעֲשֶׂרֶת יְמֵי תְּשׁוּבָה, מְעוֹרְרִין כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה עַל-יְדֵי מִצְוַת שְׁמִיעַת קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שֶׁכָּלוּל מֵעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה. וְזֶה שֶׁמּוּבָא בַּתִּקּוּנִים כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים, כְּדֵין בְּרַתָּא דְּמַלְכָּא עָאלַת בַּעֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה, עַיֵּן שָׁם

lessons.bodyText: Periya uReviya 3 - Kol HaYashar - Kol HaChozar - Voice of HaShem - Song - Sound - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pirya uReviya 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 23 . TEXT: אבן העזר, הלכות פריה ורביה ואישות, ג׳:כ וְעַל-כֵּן כָּל חָכְמָתָם שֶׁל הַמְחַקְּרִים הִוא בִּבְחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, שֶׁאֵין שׁוֹמְעִים אֶת קוֹלוֹ הָעֶצֶם יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּלָל, רַק הֵם מַבִּיטִים אַחַר הַבְּרִיאָה, אַחַר הַטֶּבַע לְבַד, וְחוֹקְרִים בְּכָל הָעִנְיָנִים שֶׁאַחַר הַטֶּבַע לְבַד, אֲבָל אֵין חוֹזְרִים פְּנֵיהֶם לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבָם וְאָזְנָם לְהַאֲזִין וּלְהַקְשִׁיב וְלִשְׁמֹעַ מִבֶּטֶן מִי יָצָא הַקּוֹל הַזֶּה כְּדֵי לָשׂוּם כָּל תְּשׁוּקָתָם לְדַבֵּק אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ, כִּי הֵם רַק חֲכָמִים לְהָרַע וּלְהֵיטִיב לֹא יָדָעוּ, וְהֵם רוֹצִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, לְהַפְרִיד בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר מִקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר כְּאִלּוּ קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, יֵשׁ לוֹ מְצִיאוּת בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת נִרְגָּן מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף, שֶׁמַּפְרִיד אַלּוּפוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם וּמְקַצֵּץ בַּנְּטִיעוֹת וְכוֹפֵר בֵּאלֹקִים חַיִּים, שֶׁכָּל זֶה נִמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר שֶׁמִּשָּׁם אֲחִיזַת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וְהַכְּפִירוֹת כַּנַּ"ל עַל-יְדֵי שֶׁאֵינָם מִשְׁתַּדְּלִים לֵידַע וּלְהַאֲמִין שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ לְבַד הַמְחַיֶּה אֶת כֻּלָּם, וְכָל הַחָכְמוֹת שֶׁשּׁוֹמְעִים וּמְבִינִים וְכָל הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם כֻּלָּם הֵם רַק בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת אֵין לוֹ מְצִיאוֹת כְּלָל בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, רַק הִיא הַחְזָרַת קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר וּמִי שֶׁטּוֹעֶה כְּשֶׁהוּא בַּיַּעַר וְשׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל הֲבָרָה וְסוֹבֵר שֶׁהוּא קוֹל בִּפְנֵי עַצְמוֹ, הוּא אֱוִיל, פֶּתִי וּמְשֻׁגָּע, שׁוֹטֶה רָשָׁע, כִּי אֵין מְצִיאוּת לְקוֹל הַחוֹזֵר כְּלָל, רַק הוּא הַמְשָׁכַת וְהַחְזָרַת קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר. כֵּן הוּא מַמָּשׁ כָּל חָכְמָתָם שֶׁחוֹקְרִים אַחַר הַטֶּבַע וְאֵין מַחֲזִירִין פְּנֵיהֶם לְקַשֵּׁר קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר לְקוֹל הַיָּשָׁר, דְּהַיְנוּ לְקַשֵּׁר כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת לְשָׁרְשָׁם, לֵידַע וּלְהַאֲמִין שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ וּלְבַלּוֹת כָּל דַּעְתּוֹ וְחָכְמָתוֹ כָּל יָמָיו לְקַשֵּׁר אֶת עַצְמוֹ בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּהוּ עוֹלֶה לְמַעְלָה עַל כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם וּבוֹ כְּלוּלִים וּטְפֵלִים כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת וְזוֹכֶה לְחַיִּים נִצְחִיִּים לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד וְגַם מִי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לְדַבֵּק אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּתַכְלִית הַשְּׁלֵמוּת לְהַחָכְמָה הָאֲמִתִּית, שֶׁהִוא הַתְּמִימוּת, לַעֲבֹד אוֹתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ בִּתְמִימוּת בְּתוֹרָה וַעֲבוֹדָה בִּפְשִׁיטוּת, הוּא יָכוֹל לִזְכּוֹת אַחַר כָּךְ לְהַשִּיג גַּם כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם בְּעַצְמוֹ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּכַמָּה צַדִּיקִים אֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁבִּתְחִלַּת עֲבוֹדָתָם עָבְדוּ רַק בִּתְמִימוּת וּבִפְשִׁיטוּת, וְשִׁבְּרוּ כָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת וְעָסְקוּ בְּתוֹרָה וַעֲבוֹדָה וּתְפִלּוֹת וְכוּ' וְכוּ' בִּיגִיעָה גְּדוֹלָה עַד שֶׁבָּאוּ לְהַשָּגוֹת גְּדוֹלוֹת, וְאַחַר כָּךְ זָכוּ לְהַשִּיג מִמֵּילָא כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם וַאֲפִלּוּ מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַגִּיעַ לָזֶה אֵין צָרִיךְ לָזֶה כְּלָל, כִּי בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה יָכוֹל לְבַלּוֹת כָּל יָמָיו בְּטוֹב בְּלִי שׁוּם יְדִיעָה מֵחָכְמוֹת אֵלּוּ, וּבָעוֹלָם הַבָּא בְּוַדַּאי אֵינָם נִצְרָכִים לוֹ כְּלָל, אַדְּרַבָּא, אֲנָשִׁים פְּשׁוּטִים שֶׁלֹּא שִׁבְּרוּ עֲדַיִן אֶת כָּל הַתַּאֲווֹת יְכוֹלִים אֵלּוּ הַחָכְמוֹת לַעֲקֹר אוֹתָם מִשְּׁנֵי עוֹלָמוֹת, כַּנִּרְאֶה בַּחוּשׁ, שֶׁכָּל אֵלּוּ שֶׁעוֹסְקִים בָּזֶה, אֲפִלּוּ מְעַט מֵחָכְמוֹת וּלְשׁוֹנוֹת וְכוּ', נַעֲשִׂים אֶפִּיקוֹרְסִים גְּדוֹלִים פּוֹרְקִים עֹל לְגַמְרֵי, רַחֲמָנָא לִצְלַן, כִּי רַק צַדִּיקִים הַגְּדוֹלִים בְּמַעֲלָה מְאֹד בְּנֵי עֲלִיָּה הָאֲמִתִּיִּים הֵם יְכוֹלִים לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶם לְמַה שֶּׁצְּרִיכִים לַעֲבוֹדָתָם, וְגַם כְּדֵי לְשַׁבֵּר דֵּעוֹת הָאֶפִּיקוֹרְסִים, וְגַם אֵינָם מְבַלִּים זְמַן עַל זֶה, כִּי הֵם מַשִּיגִים אַחַר כָּךְ מִמֵּילָא כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת כַּנַּ"ל, וְהֵם יְכוֹלִים לְקַשֵּׁר כָּל הַחָכְמוֹת לְשָׁרְשָׁם הָעֶלְיוֹן, כִּי יוֹדְעִים שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ אבן העזר, הלכות פריה ורביה ואישות, ג׳:כ״א נִמְצָא, שֶׁעִקַּר אֲחִיזַת הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וְהַכְּפִירוֹת הוּא מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת דִּין, עַל-יְדֵי שֶׁאֵין מְקַשְּׁרִין וּמְחַבְּרִין קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר לְקוֹל הַיָּשָׁר כַּנַּ"ל. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת בִּתְחִלָּה עָלָה בְּמַחֲשָׁבָה לִבְרֹא אֶת הָעוֹלָם בְּמִדַּת הַדִּין, רָאָה שֶׁאֵין הָעוֹלָם מִתְקַיֵּם, עָמַד וְשִׁתֵּף מִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים בְּמִדַּת הַדִּין, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, "בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת ה' אֱלֹקִים אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם" כִּי מִדַּת הַדִּין זֶה בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, שֶׁבִּתְחִלָּה רָצָה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה קִיּוּם הָעוֹלָם עַל-יְדֵי בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר לְבַד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִדַּת הַדִּין כַּנַּ"ל, רָאָה שֶׁאֵין הָעוֹלָם מִתְקַיֵּם כִּי אִם לֹא הָיָה רַק בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר מְקַיֵּם הָעוֹלָם הָיָה מִתְרַבֶּה הָאֶפִּיקוֹרְסוּת, כִּי לֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר לְהָאָדָם לְהַשִּיג שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הִתְקַשְּׁרוּת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר לְקוֹל הַיָּשָׁר כַּנַּ"ל, עַל-כֵּן עָמַד וְשִׁתֵּף מִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים בְּמִדַּת הַדִּין, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי הַמֻּרְכָּב מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם, שֶׁהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שִׁתֵּף קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר עִם קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר וְהִמְשִׁיךְ בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קוֹל עֹז, קוֹל הַמֻּרְכָּב מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם, וְעַל-יְדֵי-זֶה יֵשׁ קִיּוּם לְהָעוֹלָם כִּי עַכְשָׁו מֵחֲמַת שֶׁקִּיּוּם הָעוֹלָם עַל-יְדֵי קוֹל הַמֻּרְכָּב, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַקֹּל קוֹל יַעֲקֹב, עַל-יְדֵי-זֶה יֵשׁ קִיּוּם לְהָעוֹלָם, כִּי עַתָּה יֵשׁ לָנוּ כֹּחַ לִדַּבֵּק בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים, לֵידַע וּלְהַשִּיג הָאֱמוּנָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ, וְכָל הַחָכְמוֹת וְהָעַקְמוּמִיּוּת שֶׁבַּלֵּב הַנִּמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, מִבְּחִינַת דִּין, הַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ בִּשְׁבִיל הַבְּחִירָה, כִּי קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר אֵין לוֹ מְצִיאוּת רַק מִקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר, וְכָל זֶה יֵשׁ לָנוּ כֹּחַ לְהַשִּיג עַל-יְדֵי הַרְכָּבַת הַקּוֹל שֶׁהִרְכִּיב וְחִבֵּר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ שְׁנֵי הַקּוֹלוֹת יַחַד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שִׁתּוּף מִדַּת הָרַחֲמִים בְּמִדַּת הַדִּין כַּנַּ"ל, וְלוּלֵא זֹאת, לֹא הָיָה כֹּחַ לְהָאָדָם לְשַׁבֵּר הַבְּחִירָה כְּלָל, כִּי הָיוּ מִתְגַּבְּרִים עָלָיו הַקְּלִפּוֹת וְהַכְּפִירוֹת הַנִּמְשָׁכִים מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר כַּנַּ"ל, אֲבָל עַכְשָׁו יֵשׁ לוֹ כֹּחַ לְהַטּוֹת לְבָבוֹ אֶל הָאֱמֶת לִבְחִינַת קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ נִמְשָׁךְ הַכֹּל, מֵאַחַר שֶׁקִּיּוּם הָעוֹלָם עַל-יְדֵי הַרְכָּבַת שְׁנֵי הַקּוֹלוֹת יַחַד כַּנַּ"ל, כִּי עֶצֶם הַקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר בְּעַצְמוֹ אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְגַלּוֹת כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא יִתְבַּטְּלוּ בַּמְצִיאוּת כַּנַּ"ל וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, בַּעֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם. וְהִקְשׁוּ שָׁם, הָנֵי וַיֹּאמֶר דִּבְרֵאשִׁית ט נִינְהוּ וְתֵרְצוּ, בְּרֵאשִׁית נָמֵי מַאֲמָר הוּא. וְעַתָּה לִכְאוֹרָה קָשֶׁה, מַדּוּעַ בֶּאֱמֶת לֹא כְּתִיב גַּם בַּמַּאֲמָר הָרִאשׁוֹן "וַיֹּאמֶר", כְּמוֹ בִּשְׁאָר הַתִּשְׁעָה מַאֲמָרוֹת אַךְ זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת הַנַּ"ל שֶׁבְּרֵאשִׁית הוּא בְּחִינַת מַאֲמָר הָרִאשׁוֹן, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר שֶׁבּוֹ כְּלוּלִין כָּל הָעֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת, וְכָל הָעוֹלָמוֹת כֻּלָּם מֵרֹאשׁ וְעַד סוֹף, כִּי כֻּלָּם כְּלוּלִים בִּבְרֵאשִׁית שֶׁנִּקְרָא מַאֲמָר סָתוּם, שֶׁכּוֹלֵל הַכֹּל, כַּמְבֹאָר בְּדִבְרֵי רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (בְּלִקּוּטֵי תִּנְיָנָא סִימָן יב) וּמֵחֲמַת שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר בְּעַצְמוֹ אֵינוֹ מְכֻנֶּה בְּשֵׁם מַאֲמָר, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קוֹל וְדִבּוּר, כִּי זֶה הַקּוֹל וְהַדִּבּוּר אִי אֶפְשָׁר לִשְׁמֹעַ וּלְהַשִּיג כְּלָל שֶׁלֹּא יִתְבַּטְּלוּ בַּמְצִיאוּת כַּנַּ"ל, רַק אַחַר שֶׁיָּצָא הַקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁכּוֹלֵל הַכֹּל, אַחַר כָּךְ תֵּכֶף נִתְהַוָּה קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, וְאָז הִרְכִּיב הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁנֵי הַקּוֹלוֹת יַחַד שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי הַנַּ"ל, וּבוֹ בָּרָא הַכֹּל וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת תִּשְׁעָה וַיֹּאמֶר דִּבְרֵאשִׁית שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת קוֹל שֶׁאֶפְשָׁר לִשְׁמֹעַ, כִּי נִמְשָׁכִין מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר וְהַיָּשָׁר הַמֻּרְכָּבִין יַחַד שֶׁבָּהֶם נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם בִּפְרָטִיּוּת, וְנִתְחַלֵּק לְמִינִים שֶׁהֵם כָּל הַדְּבָרִים שֶׁנִּבְרְאוּ עַל-יְדֵי תִּשְׁעָה מַאֲמָרוֹת בְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, כִּי בִּבְחִינַת בְּרֵאשִׁית מַאֲמָר סָתוּם קוֹל יָשָׁר שָׁם הָיָה הַכֹּל כָּלוּל בְּיַחַד, וְלֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר עֲדַיִן לְהַכִּיר פְּרָטִיּוּת הַבְּרִיאָה מֵחֲמַת שֶׁזֶּה הַקּוֹל סָתוּם וְנֶעְלָם מְאֹד וְזֶה עִקַּר עֲבוֹדָתֵנוּ לִכְלֹל הַכֹּל בִּבְחִינַת בְּרֵאשִׁית, לְהַחֲזִיר הַכֹּל לְשָׁרְשׁוֹ לֵידַע וּלְהַאֲמִין שֶׁהַכֹּל נִמְשָׁךְ מִמֶּנּוּ לְבַד, כִּי אֵין מְצִיאוּת לְקוֹל הַחוֹזֵר כִּי אִם מִקּוֹל הַיָּשָׁר כַּנַּ"ל וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת כַּנַּ"ל, שֶׁהֵם מְבָרְרִין הַטּוֹב מִן הָרַע, הָאֱמוּנָה מִן הַכְּפִירוֹת, כִּי הֵם מְקַשְּׁרִין וּמַרְכִּיבִין כָּל הַקּוֹלוֹת וּמְחַבְּרִין הֵיטֵב קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר עִם קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר, עַד שֶׁנַּעֲשֶׂה הַנִּגּוּן הַמַּמְשִׁיךְ אֶת הַלֵּב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁמַּמְשִׁיךְ וּמוֹצִיא הַלֵּב מִן הַכְּפִירוֹת וְהַתַּאֲווֹת הַנִּמְשָׁכִין מִבְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר וּמַחֲזִירִין וּמְקַשְּׁרִין אוֹתוֹ לִבְחִינַת קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת כְּלָלִיּוּת הַבְּרִיאָה בְּשָׁרְשָׁהּ, בְּחִינַת הַדְּבֵקוּת בְּהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁעִקָּרוֹ עַל-יְדֵי בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה כַּנַּ"ל, כִּי עִקַּר הַדְּבֵקוּת הוּא הָאֱמוּנָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַחְזָרַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר לְקוֹל הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מִינֵי נְגִינָה כַּנַּ"ל, וְעַל-כֵּן עִקַּר הַנְּגִינָה מִבְּחִינַת סִטְרָא דְּלֵיוָואֵי, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר, כִּי שָׁם עִקַּר הַבֵּרוּר שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לְבָרֵר הַטּוֹב מֵהָרַע הַנֶּאֱחָז שָׁם עַל-יְדֵי שֶׁמְּחַבְּרִין אֵלָיו קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר וּמַחֲזִירִין הַכֹּל לְקוֹל הַיָּשָׁר שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הַכֹּל כִּי כָּל הַקּוֹלוֹת שֶׁבְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם הֵם בְּחִינַת קוֹל הַחוֹזֵר נֶגֶד קוֹל הַיָּשָׁר הָעֶלְיוֹן בְּעַצְמוֹ, וְשָׁם עִקַּר הַבֵּרוּר שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לְדַבֵּק אוֹתָן בְּקוֹל הַיָּשָׁר עַל-יְדֵי בְּחִינַת נְגִינָה וְכַנַּ"ל
