lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 1 - Bereishis - Toldos - Yisro - Loans - Money - Root of the Soul - Malbush - Clothing Protects - Real Estate - Verbal and Written Contracts - Voice and Writing - Kol - Dibur - Kinyan - Acquisition of Property - Handkerchief - Tziruf - Mar Cheshvan - Yahrzeit of Rochel Imeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 173 . 8:16 am - PARAGRAPH 1. Loans, money and property originate from the same spiritual source as that of the soul. 8:20 am - The spiritual connection between women and wealth. 8:24 am - נַפְשִׁי֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה בְדַבְּר֔וֹ - "...my soul went out when he spoke..." ( Shir HaShirim 5:6). Dibur - speech - clothes the nefesh - soul. Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . *8:36 am - PARAGRAPH 2. The spiritual aspects of owning and transferring ownership of property. Karka - real estate - is associated with the woman. Reference to Likutey Moharan 60 . 8:40 am - תּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ - "...let the earth bring forth living creatures..." ( Bereishis 1:24, Bereishis ). *8:43 - PARAGRAPH 3. Toldos . הַקֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְהַיָּדַ֖יִם יְדֵ֥י עֵשָֽׂו - "...the voice is the voice of Yaakov but the hands are the hands of Esav" ( Bereishis 27:22, Toldos ). 8:50 am - PARAGRAPH 4. Written and spoken contracts. The difference between kol (voice/masculine aspect of communication) and dibur (speech/feminine aspect of communication). 8:56 am - Chashmal / Malbush - clothing protects from sheker . Reference to Likutey Moharan 38 . *8:59 am - Why a kinyan is made with a piece of clothing - even a handkerchief. 9:00 am - אָֽנֹכִ֨י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ - "I am HaShem, Your Master..." Shemos 20:2, Yisro ). "Anochi" - writing contains the soul of the writer. 9:02 am - Q&R about practical application of this teaching. 9:04 am - Closing notes about Chodesh Mar Cheshvan . During Elul and Tishrei there is a custom to say 10 perokim of Tehillim every day. Yahrzeit of Rochel Imeinu . The first letters of Roshei Chadashim l'Amcha spell Rochel . 9:07 - Closing notes about Parshas Noach and R' Nasan's recent short trip to Uman. *9:09 - Q&R about the meaning of the tziruf (formation of HaShem's Name) for each lunar month.

lessons.title: 2024-11-03 - LH7 - CM1 - Halvaah 2 - Para. 1-4a - Mishpatim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Halvaah 2 - Mishpatim - Loans - Lending Is Tzedakah - Written vs. Verbal Document - Yirah - Nevuah - Devar HaShem - Refuah Through Bread and Water Rather Than Herbs or Medicine - Chayei Sarah - Power of Tzedakah - All Blessing Is a Loan - Tefilah Is Repayment to HaShem - Elements of a Contract - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Ma
lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 2 - Mishpatim - Loans - Lending Is Tzedakah - Written vs. Verbal Document - Yirah - Nevuah - Devar HaShem - Refuah Through Bread and Water Rather Than Herbs or Medicine - Chayei Sarah - Power of Tzedakah - All Blessing Is a Loan - Tefilah Is Repayment to HaShem - Elements of a Contract - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Loans. Written vs. Verbal Document. Sheleymus HaYirah is achieved through respecting the holidays. Perfection of Yirah then releases tefilah from being in exile and people do not need refuah through herbs , because their cures will be received through their daily bread and water. Nevuah - Devar HaShem. 09:30 - Parshas Chayei Sarah. וַיֵּצֵ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק לָשׂ֥וּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת עָ֑רֶב - "And Yitzchak went forth to pray in the field towards evening..." ( Bereishis 24:63, Chayei Sarah ). 12:15 - Q&R about the celebration of holidays. 13:00 - Q&R - Sheleymus HaTefilah includes kavana - sincerity - and emunah - faith. 13:50 - PARAGRAPH 2. Loans. The Master of Prayer. All the angels receive healing powers or a flow of wealth by way of the prayers of the Baal Tefilah . These influxes of health or wealth are called a loan. ***19:00 - Tefilah is the vehicle through which all blessing flows into the world. Giving tzedaka before tefilah enables us to receive the flow of blessings from HaShem . Lending is also a form of tzedakah . 22:00 - Mishpatim . אִם־כֶּ֣סֶף | תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת־עַמִּ֗י - "When you lend money to My people..." ( Shemos 22:24, Mishpatim ). It's a mitzvah to lend money to a worthy person who needs it. 22:30 - Q&R - The process of putting aside tzedakah before tefilah and then actually giving it at the words "Ve Atah mosheyl bakol..." in Shacharis . 23:30 - Q&R about the spiritual aspects of lending and borrowing. 23:45 - PARAGRAPH 3. The obligations of the borrower to the lender. Confiscation of property is permitted if the loan was written. ***25:00 - What does it mean that HaShem lends blessing, rather than gives it? These blessings do have to be returned to HaShem . This spiritual energy is returned to HaShem during tefilah . 28:45 - "The earth will give its produce..." 32:00 - Q&R about how blessing enters the world. "When someone prays for what his friend needs, the one who prays on behalf of his friend receives the blessing first." 37:45 - PARAGRAPH 4. Nevuah - prophecy - releases tefilah from exile. 39:30 - NOTE: Yirah and ratzon are connected. Everything is the will of HaShem . On the holidays we celebrate the miracles of HaShem which are called hisgalus haratzon - revelation of the will of HaShem . 41:30 - Everything in existence receives its energy from the Torah. Oral contracts relate to the Oral Torah. Written contracts relate to the Written Torah. The elements of a written contract are important ( Choshen Mishpat 42). Nevuah is part of the Written Torah. The importance of signatures and witnesses for a written contract. 44:45 - עַל־פִּ֣י | שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל־פִּ֥י שְׁלשָֽׁה־עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר - "By means of two witnesses - or three - the matter will stand..." ( Devarim 19:15, Shoftim ). 46:00 - NOTE - HaShem received his nevuah from between the two keruvim . 47:15 - Prophecy is called testimony. 48:10 - Uriah and Zecharia as witnesses ( Yishaya 8).

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Halvaah 2 - Halvaah 3 - Loans - Parshas Bo - Emunah Receives Power from the Torah - Master of Prayer - Emes - 3 Holidays Empower Nevuah - Dvar HaShem - Releasing Tefilah from Exile - Am Yisrael Receives Faith Through the Seven Shepherds - Azus deKedushah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 2 is based on 2Lik
lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 2 - Halvaah 3 - Loans - Parshas Bo - Emunah Receives Power from the Torah - Master of Prayer - Emes - 3 Holidays Empower Nevuah - Dvar HaShem - Releasing Tefilah from Exile - Am Yisrael Receives Faith Through the Seven Shepherds - Azus deKedushah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 280 . Brief review of 2Likutey Moharan 1. 02:35 - Study of text begins. Emunah refines all that can be refined in the physical world. ***06:05 - Tefilah only functions through nevuah . Review of how observing and honoring the 3 holidays empowers nevuah and helps release tefilah from exile. 08:58 - Loans. The 2 witnesses who sign a written contract are compared with the prophets and the Written Torah. 11:10 - A written contract has a kol - voice - because it is "heard" universally. 13:00 - The six sefiros of Zer Anpin comprise kol and the Written Torah. This parallels a written contract . Malkhus is an aspect of Emunah and dibur - the Oral Torah. This parallels an oral contract . Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 . 15:28 - The dates and signatures of the witnesses on a contract must be validated by a Beis Din in order for a contract to be considered valid. 18:07 - Q&R about nevuah in our present time. ***19:30 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 8, Paragraph 7 . Every leader of Am Yisrael must have a "Ruach Acheres" - a bit of Ruach HaKodesh . ***20:02 - PARAGRAPH 5. Parshas Bo . דַּבֶּר־נָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיִשְׁאֲל֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ | מֵאֵ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ וְאִשָּׁה֙ מֵאֵ֣ת רְעוּתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־כֶ֖סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָֽב - "Please, speak into the ears of the people, and let them borrow, each man from his friend and each woman from her friend, silver vessels and golden vessels" ( Shemos 11:2, Bo ). HaShem commanded Am Yisrael to borrow all the wealth of Egypt in order to bring it into the domain of holiness. This represents perfection of tefilah , when the Baal Tefilah gathers all the spiritual energy found in creation and elevates it back to its Source, which is an example of tefilah being released from exile. Reference to Likutey Moharan 7 and reference to Likutey Moharan 9 . 22:00 - NOTE: the Arizal points out that the word Pesach contains the expression Peh Sach - the mouth speaks - alluding to the redemption of tefilah . ***24:18 - Am Yisrael's chipazon - speed - during Yetziyas Mitzrayim . Why did their escape need to be quick? *25:00 - Why HaShem commanded Am Yisrael to "borrow" the wealth of Egypt, rather than to take it. ***28:00 - When tefilah is released from exile, the prayers of Israel are joined with the praise of all creation, which is an aspect of the revelation of Moshiach . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 1, Paragraph 12 . *30:40 - NOTE on the importance of a written contract when borrowing or lending money. 28:58 - HALAKHA 3. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . הֱוֵי עַז כַּנָּמֵר - "...Be bold as a leopard..." ( Avos 5, 20). Holy brazenness allows a person to stand up against the false leaders of the generation. 36:33 - A person acquires azus dekedushah through joy. Joy is acquired through na'aseh venishma - which is an aspect of the two crowns placed on head of every Jew at the time of Matan Torah on Sinai. 38:06 - Reference to Sefer HaMidos HaChadash, Tochakha 3 : "A person who rejects rebuke should know that he will have to borrow from others, as shown through the correlation between the two verses: בִּדְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי־יָ֜בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה - 'A slave cannot be chastised with words, because he will understand, but without response' ( Mishlei 29:19) and עָשִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד ל֜וֶֹ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה - 'A rich man will rule over the poor, and a borrower is a slave to a lender'" ( Mishlei 22:7). *45:34 - A person lacks emunah because he lacks azus dekedushah . 48:39 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 3 - A Loan Should Always Be Made With a Written Contract - Borrower and Lender in Beis Din - Azus deKedushah vs Azus deSutra Achra - Dangers of Being Overly Shy - Training a Child to Greet a Grandparent - Vidui - Confession - Yom Kippur - Courage and "Holy Chutzpah " Are Necessary to Serve HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. A loan should always be made with a written contract. 05:10 - PARAGRAPH 4. Establishing the amount of loan in Beis Din if there is no written contract. Why the borrower is made to swear to an amount. *11:00 - Azus deKedshah vs. Azus deSutra Achra . Holiness is only achieved through a degree of brazenness - "holy chutzpah" - as in הֱוֵי עַז כַּנָּמֵר - "...Be bold as a leopard..." ( Avos 5, 20). 13:40 - There are two kinds of busha - shame/shyness - one is holy and one not. 16:40 - All Jews have a natural busha - shyness. 17:30 - וְכָל־הָעָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹ֜ת וְאֶת־הַלַּפִּידִ֗ם וְאֵת֙ ק֣וֹל הַשֹּׁפָ֔ר וְאֶת־הָהָ֖ר עָשֵׁ֑ן וַיַּ֤רְא הָעָם֙ וַיָּנֻ֔עוּ וַיַּֽעַמְד֖וּ מֵֽרָחֹֽק - "And all the people saw the voices and the torches, the sound of the shofar, and the smoking mountain, and the people saw and trembled; so they stood from afar" ( Shemos 20:15, Yisro ). The Torah was given in lightning and thunder to inspire awe and shyness in Am Yisrael . 19:20 - Excess shame or shyness freeze a person to the extent that they cannot serve HaShem, chas veshalom . 20:40 - אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָֽעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָֽטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־בֽוֹשׁוּ - "They cried out to You and they escaped; they trusted in You and they were not shamed Tehillim 22:6. Out forefathers put aside their embarrassment about their lowliness and sins, so they could trust in HaShem and serve Him. 21:20 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 30 . ***23:00 - If a person is overly shy or ashamed, they won't confess their sins and they won't even be able to daven - pray. 25:00 - מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֖שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם - "He who conceals his sins will not succeed, but he who confesses and abandons will obtain mercy" ( Mishlei 28:13). ***26:00 - NOTE about the importance of training a shy child to say hello to a grandparent in order to teach them respect. 27:00 - Q&R about the difference between atzvus - depression, and azus - boldness. 28:00 - שֶׁאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָאנוּ - "For we are not so brazen and obstinate as to say before You HaShem, our G-d and G-d of our forefathers, that we are righteous and have not sinned..." ( Amidah , Yom Kippur Machzor ). Why do we say "Ain lanu azei panim..." in Vidui ? 32:00 - Courage and "Holy Chutzpah " are necessary to serve HaShem . *40:00 - Lack of self confidence can cause a person to leave the path of the Torah, chas veshalom . *42:00 - Fear of HaShem should be greater than one's fear of people. 49:00 - Saying the sins we committed in Vidui is an example of "Holy Chutzpah ". ***53:45 - NOTE - There is no Vidui on Rosh Hashanah because the initial shame a person feels renders him speechless. Therefore on Rosh Hashanah there is only the wordless cry of the shofar and words of tefilah . That's step one of teshuvah . Step two is the "Holy Chutzpah " of Vidui on Yom Kippur.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Halvaah 3 - Written Contract for a Loan - Borrower and Lender in Beis Din - Beshalach - Seal of Hands - Seal of Feet - Machtzis HaShekel Repairs Lack of Azus deKedushah - Kol - Sound of Coins for Tzedakah - Maaser - Hashiveynu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PAR
lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 3 - Written Contract for a Loan - Borrower and Lender in Beis Din - Beshalach - Seal of Hands - Seal of Feet - Machtzis HaShekel Repairs Lack of Azus deKedushah - Kol - Sound of Coins for Tzedakah - Maaser - Hashiveynu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Written contract for a loan. Borrower and lender in Beis Din . 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. עֵד֖וּת יְהֹוָ֥ה נֶֽ֜אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי - "...the testimony of HaShem is faithful, making the simple one wise" ( Tehillim 19:8). 11:22 - PARAGRAPH 7. 13:00 - וַיְהִ֥י יָדָ֛יו אֱמוּנָ֖ה - "...and his hands were faith..." ( Shemos 17:12, Beshalach ). 14:50 - Two seals: one of the hands and one of the fee. When litigants testify in a Beis Din , they must be standing, as in וְעָֽמְד֧וּ שְׁנֵי־הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֛ים - "Then the two men between whom the controversy exists ..." ( Devarim 19:17, Shoftim ). Standing is the seal of the feet. 16:00 - The seal of the hands is emunah , as in This seal includes both the seal of the hands and the seal of the feet. The written signature of the two witnesses includes both seals. *19:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. The mitzvah of machtzis hashekel is one of the 3 mitzvos that HaShem had to actually demonstrate to Moshe Rabbeinu. The other 2 mitzvos were: the appearance of how the moon looks at the time of kiddush hachodesh and the appearance of the menorah. *22:00 - וְ֜עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת - "...and a rich man replies with impudence" ( Mishlei 18:23). ה֣וֹן עָ֖שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ - "The wealth of a person is his strength" ( Mishlei 18:11). Machtzis HaShekel repairs lack of Azus deKedushah . 29:20 - Donating money to the Mishkan repairs misuse of money, which is an aspect of negative azus . Tzedakah is a form of holy azus . 31:00 - All types of sound are a form of azus - kol . The sound of the coins in a pushkeh is a form of azus dekedusha . 33:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . *34:00 - וְ֜עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת - "...and a rich man replies with impudence" ( Mishlei 18:23). Giving maaser strengthens a person to stand up against persecution. "Giving maaser is one of the most powerful ways to repair and strengthen a person's emunah ." 36:24 - Why the yearly mandatory contribution to the Mishkan is called Machtzis haShekel . The word mishkal means "scales" - a person has to weigh their actions carefully so they don't fall into the wrong type of azus . "This money is a divine gift" 38:20 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal - the gematria of nefesh equals that of shekel . 39:20 - A baal teshuvah encounters many obstacles. ***40:00 - Sometimes even "religious" Jews will try to discourage baalei teshuvah from coming close to the derech that will help him the most. 50:00 - The importance of begging HaShem for help in returning to Him, as in the blessing "hashiveynu" of the Shemoneh Esrei . 52:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Halvaah 3 - Halvaah 4 - Megillas Esther - Machtzis HaShekel vs. Amalek - Wealth Brings Azus - Brazenness - Azus deKedushah of Esther - Azus deSutra Achra - Seir leAzalzel - Mochin deKatnus - Why a Written Document Is Absolutely Necessary for a Loan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Mo
lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 3 - Halvaah 4 - Megillas Esther - Machtzis HaShekel vs. Amalek - Wealth Brings Azus - Brazenness - Azus deKedushah of Esther - Azus deSutra Achra - Seir leAzalzel - Mochin deKatnus - Why a Written Document Is Absolutely Necessary for a Loan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. וַֽעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים כִּכַּר־כֶּ֗סֶף אֶשְׁקוֹל֙ - "... and I will weigh out ten thousand silver talents..." ( Esther 3:9). Machtzis HaShekel vs. Amalek . 06:52 - Wealth brings azus - brazenness. 10:00 - אֵ֚ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֚וּא נֹתֵ֨ן | עֹ֖ז וְתַֽעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם - "...HaShem of Israel - He gives strength and power to the people..." ( Tehillim 68:36). ***10:21 - יְהֹוָ֗ה עֹ֖ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן - "...HaShem shall grant strength to His people..." ( Tehillim 29:11). Am Yisrael has Azus deKedushah . Their boldness allows them to accept the Torah, when the 70 Nations do not. 11:50 - Naaseh veNishma . 13:40 - The Azus deKedusha of Esther HaMalka : וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר אִ֚ישׁ צַ֣ר וְאוֹיֵ֔ב הָמָ֥ן הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה - "And Esther said, "An adversary and an enemy, this evil Haman!" ( Esther 7:6). 16:00 - NOTE about Azus deKedushah from the Shulchan Aruch . 17:30 - NOTE - Yom Kippur - Seir leAzalzel . One goat embodies Azus deKedushah and the other embodies Azus deSutra Achra . 20:50 - HALAKHA 4. Introduction. Reference to Likutey Moharan 42:3 . ***21:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. "Don't you dare borrow money without a written document!" Borrowing means that the borrower is in a state of Mochin deKatnus - vulnerability to the Sutra Achra . ***27:00 - The loan contract must be written according to the laws of the Torah ( Shulchan Aruch, Choshen Mishpat 42) in order to counteract the borrower's vulnerability to the Sutra Achra . 29:00 - בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים לְמִקְרָא - "...the five-year-old to the Written Torah..." ( Avos 5:21). 31:50 - PARAGRAPH 2. Real estate can be used as collateral for a loan, but moveable property cannot. 41:50 - Q&R about the necessity of witnesses for a loan and the connection between a loan contract and the Written Torah. 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Real estate is related to the Written Torah, while moveable property is related to the Oral Torah. 44:20 - The importance of a lawyer doing a title search when purchasing property. 45:45 - The Torah was given through קול - sound. All the future Oral Torah was given at Sinai. 48:50 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 28. 49:10 - PARAGRAPH 4.

lessons.bodyText: Malach and Galuch - Breslov Basics 40 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Progress in serving HaShem means turmoil - a sense of humor helps! Rebbe Nachman attended a wedding where an entertainer dressed up first as a malach (angel) and then as a galuch (priest). Rebbe Nachman told his students, "That's us!" NOTE: "Bitul" - spiritual surrender. Text: Likutey Halakhos, Orach Chaim 1, Netilas Yadayim Shacharis 4, Para. 8. The entire shiur is HERE . TRANSCRIPT: Rav Nosson zal says, regarding this issue of "bitul" that we mentioned, and people trying to reach up to HaShem : there are thousands and tens of thousands of levels and differences between each and every single person. Every person has their own ups and downs and their own thousands of levels of feeling close to HaShem , feeling far from HaShem , etc. And even within one individual Jew there are vast differences at different times. One day a person feels super religious, the next day he thinks the worst. There was an unbelievable episode in Rebbe Nachman's life where he was once at a wedding with his students, and in those days they didn't have the disco stuff we have today, or the other stuff. They kept it simple, so they had different acts that they performed at weddings to liven things up. So one of the things they would do is they would have a performer. They'd have the room totally dark and a person would come up dressed in a certain way and then the room would darken again and the person would come back dressed totally different. And they’d do this in a very humorous way. So Rebbe Nachman was at a wedding like this with his students and he sees the guy come in first time dressed in white and floating around, obviously portraying an angel -- a " malach ". So everybody saw this, they knew, "Oh he's a malach ." The guy went out, came back three seconds later dressed in black robes dressed like a " galuch " -- like a priest. " Malach -- galuch " -- and everybody's laughing. Rebbe Nachman looked at this and he turned to his students and he said, "That's us!" That's a Jew in this world. A Jew at 9:00 in the morning can be an angel and at 10:00 in the morning can be a priest. That's how a pendulum can swing in our lives.

lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 4 - Why the Second Luchos Were Given on Yom Kippur - Separating Adam and Chava - Back to Back - Written Torah - Oral Torah - 10 Days of Teshuvah - VeZos HaBerakha - Moshe Rabbeinu Broke the Luchos - Golden Calf - Ekev - Bereishis on Shemini Atzeres - Fasts of BeHaV - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Halvaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 128 . 00:00 - HaShem created Adam and Chava back to back and then split them apart so they could interact. This process illustrates how the Oral Torah is intrinsic to the Written Torah. 04:00 - Those who oppose Torah observance usually focus on belittling the Oral Torah. 07:00 - The 10 Days of Teshuvah . From Rosh Hashanah until Yom Kippur we are preparing to receive the Second Luchos . 10:00 - Q&R about the pogrom that occurred on Shemini Atzeres 5784 (October 7, 2023). Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat, Choveyl baChaveyro 3 and Likutey Moharan 67 . The massacres of the past achieved kiddush HaShem . 12:37 - PARAGRAPH 9. On Sukkos HaShem shows the world how special Am Yisrael is to Him. 15:00 - HaAzinu. כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַֽעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַֽחֲלָתֽוֹ - "Because HaShem's portion is His People. Yaakov, the lot of His inheritance" ( Devarim 32:9, HaAzinu ). Separating Adam and Chava from their original state of back to back. 16:00 - כִּֽי־יַֽעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֜שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ - "For HaShem chose Yaakov for Himself, Yisrael for His treasure" ( Tehillim 135:4). *17:15 - Parshas VeZos HaBerakha . מִסִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְזָרַ֤ח מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵהַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן - "...HaShem came from Sinai and shone forth from Seir to them; He appeared from Mount Paran..." ( Devarim 33:2, VeZos HaBerakha ). *20:10 - תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ משֶׁ֑ה מֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "The Torah that Moses commanded us is a legacy for the congregation of Yaakov" ( Devarim 33:4, VeZos HaBerakha ). "Torah tziva lanu Moshe..." The Written Torah and the Oral Torah belongs to Am Yisrael . 21:18 - Am Yisrael is special to HaShem . ***23:20 - VeZos HaBerakha - the closing words of the parsha refer to Moshe Rabbeinu's breaking of the First Luchos . Why did this act demonstrate his greatness? ***25:15 - Parshas Ekev. The Egel HaZahav - Golden Calf - resulted from Am Yisrael's mistaken calculation of the sixth and seventh hour of the 40th day - which was an error in the interpretation of the Oral Torah ( Shabbos 89). Reference to Likutey Moharan 62 . ***28:40 - The Written Torah cannot exist without the Oral Torah. ***29:57 - HaShem congratulated Moshe Rabbeinu for breaking the First Luchos ( Shabbos 87). 33:50 - Why the Second Luchos were given on Yom Kippur. *34:30 - Bereishis . Why we begin reading the Torah again from the beginning on Shemini Atzeres. 36:50 - It wasn't until man prayed for rain that the plants could grow. וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה - "...and there was no man to work the soil" ( Bereishis 2:5, Bereishis ). 38:28 - Q&R about how to apply the concepts in the halakha to our lives. The central themes include the importance of the Oral Torah and the inner dimensions of the Yomim Noraim - Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Sukkos , and Shemini Atzeres . *39:30 - Q&R about the Egel HaZahav . Brief review of the chronology of events from Matan Torah until Yom Kippur . The broken luchos were placed in the Aron Kodesh . *41:17 - NOTE - Fasts of BeHaV . The three fasts and slichos that follow Shemini Atzeres - "BeHaV" stands for "Monday, Thursday, Monday". 42:48 - Closing announcements and blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Halvaah 4 - Halvaah 5 - Lending Money Always Requires a Written Document - Adam's Sin Is the Origin of All Debt - Owing Is Slavery - Good Days and Bad Days - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. The whole concept of people needing to borrow money originates with the curse given to Adam HaRishon . That's the origin of all poverty and financial troubles. This was the result of Adam's lack of faith in HaShem (Sanhedrin). 02:50 - The sun and moon are compared to the lender and the borrower. Because the moon is deficient, it receives light from the sun. The diminishing of the moon is the origin of all deficiency and is the cause of all conflicts between people, since the borrower enters a state of mochin dekatnus . *05:45 - It's forbidden to give a loan without a written document. 07:30 - The signed document of the loan corresponds with the Written Torah. Even if the two people involved are completely Torah observant, we are not permitted to rely on a verbal statement. We are only able to rely on a written document. 16:00 - Even though in a Beis Din there are many transactions that are bound by verbal agreement, a loan is never valid in a Beis Din unless there is a written document. 17:20 - Q&R about why Emunah Pratit is related to the Oral Torah. 18:20 - HALAKHAH 5. Hilkhos Halvaah 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 33 . 19:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. Borrowing money is related to the concept of "Good Days and Bad Days". ***23:30 - The person who always sees the good, day by day, will not fall into debt. 25:40 - עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֜שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ - "...who perform His word, to hearken to the voice of His word" ( Tehillim 103:20). It's possible to discover HaShem's Torah - the source of all blessing - in any language . 29:00 - When a person falls into debt, it's very difficult to get out. ***30:20 - The concept of "Good Days and Bad Days" exists in every single day. 33:00 - Reference to Sefer HaMidos, Teshuvah . 34:30 - ( Devarim 4:29, VaEschanan ). 40:00 - Q&R about "Good Days and Bad Days". *42:00 - NOTE: Example of how people used the lock-downs of COVID for profit or for gain. A person who sees the good will be able to connect with HaShem's blessings even when times are difficult. *43:20 - PARAGRAPH 2. It's forbidden to give a loan without a written document. 51:00 - Slavery is the curse given to Esav and one of the curses given at Har Eval (in Parshas Ki Savo ). Owing is slavery. 52:13 - אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֖יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ - "A fool's anger is known within the day..." ( Mishlei 12:16). 55:00 - לוֶֹ֣ה רָ֖שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם - "A wicked man borrows and does not pay..." ( Tehillim 37:21). "A person who borrows and doesn't pay back is in the status of rasha" . *56:00 - The way to protect oneself from the dangers of borrowing money is through making sure there is a written contract. This protects the borrower from the tortures of slavery. This is why it's also forbidden to take interest on a loan. 58:00 - Q&R and closing blessings.

Teshuvah is an aspect of Shabbos . *24:30 - Parshas Beshalach - Mei Meriva - sweetening of the bitter waters of Meriva refers to the Etz HaChaim , as in וַיּוֹרֵ֤הוּ יְהֹוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־הַמַּ֔יִם - "...and the Lord instructed him concerning a piece of wood, which he cast into the water..." ( Shemos 15:25, Beshalach ). 25:45 - Humility makes it possible for the bitter to become sweet. 16:15 - PARAGRAPH 2. Teshuvah is an aspect of Shabbos . Bris Milah and taking an oath are both aspects of Shabbos because they eliminate evil. 23:00 - וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם - "...but the tzaddik is the foundations of the world" Mishlei 10:25. "Tzaddik yisod olam". 31:15 - PARAGRAPH 3. A person denying the amount of a loan in Beis Din is required to take an oath. However, the Written Torah does not impose an oath on someone in total denial of the loan. *34:00 - Spiritual aspects of bathing in hot water on Erev Shabbos . 35:30 - It's forbidden to light Shabbos lights before Plag HaMincha on Erev Shabbos . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. According to the Oral Torah, anyone denying a loan in Beis Din is required to take an oath. The revelation of Moshiach depends on the refinement of all the holy sparks that fell under the sway of evil. Tzaddikim enter the lowest levels of darkness to release the sparks of holiness trapped there. 42:00 - Q&R - Members of the 70 Nations are under the sway of evil, with the exception of converts to Judaism. 43:00 - Q&R about repairing the evil of the 70 Nations. 43:30 - A person in complete denial of a loan in Beis Din is still not considered completely evil. *46:30 - The tzaddik is able to elevate a person from total evil by finding the good in him. Reference to Likutey Moharan 282 . 48:50 - Throughout the Gemara, Rav Nachman embodies the concept of the "sparks of Moshiach " ( Sanhedrin 98). 51:50 - Q&R about how Moshiach can repair complete evil. 53:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-11-28 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 2 - Para. 5-7 - Toayn veNitan 3 - Para. 1-2
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 2 - Parnassah - Honesty in Business - Shabbos Is a Time for Teshuvah - Tikkun HaMishpat - Power of Beis Din - Tzaddik veRa Lo - Why Does a Good Person Suffer? Practical Application of Gilgul - Reincarnation - The Mystery of Soul Connections - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 2 is based o
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 2 - Parnassah - Honesty in Business - Shabbos Is a Time for Teshuvah - Tikkun HaMishpat - Power of Beis Din - Tzaddik veRa Lo - Why Does a Good Person Suffer? Practical Application of Gilgul - Reincarnation - The Mystery of Soul Connections - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 79 - בְּטַ֥ח בַּֽ֖יהֹוָה וַֽעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֜֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה - "Trust in HaShem and do good, dwell in the Land and shepherd faith" ( Tehillim 37:3). 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Shavuah Hesseis . 39 Melakhos - the creative acts forbidden on Shabbos . 01:12 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 03:22 - The 6 days of the week refer to the 6 terms used to determine application of halakha . 05:35 - We connect with the Etz HaChaim by conducting business with honesty. 06:08 - מַ֣ר מִמָּ֗וֶת - "...more bitter than death..." - ( Koheles 7:26). Sholomo HaMelech is alluding to dishonesty in business dealings. 06:32 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 - the positive and negative aspects of money. 07:30 - Shabbos is a time to do teshuvah for the activities of the week. Through this weekly return to HaShem , the bitterness of earning a living is sweetened. 08:49 - PARAGRAPH 6. When taking an oath in Beis Din , the litigant holds a sefer Torah. 10:28 - PARAGRAPH 7. There are two types of oaths in Beis Din , one originates from the Written Torah, and one originates from the Oral Torah. The gravity of taking an oath. 15:12 - HALAKHA 3. Toayn veNitan 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 - Para. 15d - "Tikkun HaMishpat" . 17:00 - תְּהֽוֹם־אֶל־תְּה֣וֹם ק֖וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ - "Deep calls to deep to the sound of Your water channels..." ( Tehillim 42:8). וְיִגַּ֥ל כַּמַּ֖יִם מִשְׁפָּ֑ט - "And justice shall be revealed like water..." ( Amos 5:24). "Fallen mishpat ", as in מִ֖שְׁפָּטֶיךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה - "...Your judgments are the vast deep..." ( Tehillim 36:7). Honesty elevates mishpat . 18:49 - PARAGRAPH 2. Tikkun haMishpat . A Beis Din has the power to elevate mishpat . *23:50 - Tzaddik vera lo - Why do good people suffer? ( Berakhos 14) Questioning HaShem's justice is an aspect of pegam bemishpat . 25:00 - Reference to Berakhos 14. 26:13 - Story of a person who was suffering from poverty and HaShem offered him death so that he could come back as another person. Gilgul - reincarnation. 28:33 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 14 . ***30:13 - The secret of the reincarnation of souls. Practical effects of a previous gilgul . Unpaid loans from previous reincarnations can influence the events of a person's life. 34:07 - Sin of Adam HaRishon with the Etz HaDaas was that he failed to wait. 34:52 - Sins are called "unripe fruit". ***35:40 - "your forefathers ate unripe fruit". The good taste of our deeds is only sweet when we reach Olam HaEmes , as in לָכֵ֚ן חַכּוּ־לִי֙ - "Therefore, wait for me..." ( Zephaniah 3:8). 37:39 - Story in Menachos about a person who paid a high price for a sin but refrained from the sin when his tzitzis struck him. 40:33 - The main challenge in this world is to develop the ability to wait. 42:50 - Parshas Toldos . 44:20 - "Do not steal from your friend." We're not permitted to touch something that belongs to another. 47:15 - Q&R about Adam's sin of not waiting. The mystery of soul connections due to reincarnation. ***48:31 - Q&R about judging others favorably based on previous reincarnations. What are the practical applications of gilgulim ? 51:00 - Q&R about desire being a form of HaShem's light. The mystery of soul connections. The word "nefesh" means "desire". 51:34 - Closing blessings. Today is Yom Kippur Katan .

lessons.title: 2024-11-29 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 3 - Para. 3 - Toayn veNitan 4 - Mishpatim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 3 - Toayn veNitan 4 - Mishpatim - Borrowing and Lending - Tikkun HaMishpat - Tzaddik veRa Lo - When Good People Suffer - Gilgulim - Reincarnation - Beis Din Establishes Justice - Lost Articles - Bava Metzia - Talis - The Body Is the Garment of the Soul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Toayn veNitan 3 is bas
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 3 - Toayn veNitan 4 - Mishpatim - Borrowing and Lending - Tikkun HaMishpat - Tzaddik veRa Lo - When Good People Suffer - Gilgulim - Reincarnation - Beis Din Establishes Justice - Lost Articles - Bava Metzia - Talis - The Body Is the Garment of the Soul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Toayn veNitan 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 - Para. 15d - "Tikkun HaMishpat". 01:53 - PARAGRAPH 3. Cause of Kilkul HaMishpat - injustice. Tzaddik veRa Lo - why do good people suffer? Gilgulim - reincarnation. 04:31 - Through temimus - simplicity and sincerity - we achieve Tikkun HaMishpat . 07:10 - Beis Din has the authority to allocate property. 07:48 - תְּהֽוֹם־אֶל־תְּה֣וֹם ק֖וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ - "Deep calls to deep to the sound of Your water channels..." ( Tehillim 42:8). 08:49 - HALAKHA 4. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 188 . Forgetting is a type of loss. 11:50 - Parshas Mishpatim. עַל־כָּל־אֲבֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ כִּי־ה֣וּא זֶ֔ה עַ֚ד הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יָבֹ֖א - "...for any lost article, concerning which he will say that this is it, the plea of both parties shall come to the judges..." ( Shemos 22:8, Mishpatim ). Laws regarding lost articles. Taking an oath reminds a person to search for the Torah he forgot/lost at birth. Lying is a result of forgetting and loss of Torah. 12:10 - Elokim refers to Beis Din - Moshe Rabbeinu gave smicha to Yehoshua . 15:49 Before he enters the world, a baby must swear he will be a tzaddik . Then, at birth, a malach causes an infant to forget what he learned previously. His lifetime task is to find what he lost. 16:45 - Laws of lost articles. 18:18 - The moment a newborn enters this world, he forgets everything he learned in Gan Eden . 19:37 - Bava Metzia begins with two people finding a lost garment. Most laws of business concerning moveable items are discussed in Bava Metzia . 20:28 - Spiritual aspects of litigation between two people who simultaneously find the same lost article. 21:43 - Talis refers to a garment and also alludes to the soul being clothed in a physical body. 23:13 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-12-01 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 5 - Para. 1-6a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 5 - Shavuah Hesseis - Oath in Beis Din - Spiritual Damage of Refusing to Repay a Loan - Tzedakah Clears the Air - Tiferes Is a Combination of Yirah and Ahava - Hispa'arus - Bereishis - Torah Is the Pride of Israel - Am Yisrael Is a Name of HaShem - Siddur - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTIO
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 5 - Shavuah Hesseis - Oath in Beis Din - Spiritual Damage of Refusing to Repay a Loan - Tzedakah Clears the Air - Tiferes Is a Combination of Yirah and Ahava - Hispa'arus - Bereishis - Torah Is the Pride of Israel - Am Yisrael Is a Name of HaShem - Siddur - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. ה֗וֹן יֹ֖סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים - "Wealth adds many friends..." ( Mishlei 19:4). Rabbi Nachman explains that giving tzedakah brings people together and "calms the air", bringing peace. 03:00 - Gerim (converts to Judaism) and Baalei Teshuvah (Jews who return to Torah observance) repair the damaged mizbeyach - altar - of the Beis HaMikdash . 06:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. Turbulence makes communication difficult. Giving tzedakah calms and clarifies the air, making it possible for the teachings of the tzaddik to be heard. 11:00 - Tzedakah is the tikkun for money. A person who denies having taken a loan creates an atmosphere of turbulence and conflict. 13:00 - NOTE about a recent simcha where neighbors offered guests to stay in their vacant apartment for free. 18:00 - Spiritual damage of Failure to Repay a Loan - Tiferes is a combination of Yirah and Ahava . When a person refuses to repay a loan, the hispa'arus of Israel - the Torah - is damaged. *21:00 - HaShem takes pride in Am Yisrael because we accepted His Torah. ***22:00 - בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ - "In the beginning HaShem created the heavens and the earth" ( Bereishis 1:1, Bereishis ). HaShem takes pride in the action of every individual Jew, every day. 26:00 - The person who takes an oath is Beis Din is required to hold a Sefer Torah in order to remind him of his hispa'arus - Jewish pride - his connection to the Torah. 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. The laws of taking an oath in Beis Din in litigation about a loan. 31:30 - שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־יַֽעֲשׂ֚וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְלֹֽא־יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב - "The remnant of Israel shall neither commit injustice nor speak lies..." ( Zephania 3:13). 33:00 - The events preceding the miracle of Chanukah demonstrated the ability of Am Yisrael to withstand the forces of assimilation. Shavuah Hesseis - Rav Nachman held that there is an aspect of Torah pride even in a Jew who seems entirely under evil influences, and therefore a person who completely denies a debt is also obligated, by rabbinic law, to take an oath in Beis Din . 37:00 - When the good of Am Yisrael is being held by the 70 Nations, this causes a Jew to deny a loan. NOTE about the Jewish hostages presently being held in Gaza, may they all be released. *42:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Am Yisrael is also the "Pride of HaShem" because HaShem , the Jewish Nation, and the Torah are one. *43:00 - Am Yisrael is a Name of HaShem . 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. When Beis Din imposes an oath on a litigant, they warn him of the dangers involved so that his Yirah - respect for HaShem - is increased. 50:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. There are cases in Beis Din when a person who denies taking a loan is not required to take an oath. Examples. ***52:00 - Every day is unique, and every day HaShem takes new pride in each and every member of Am Yisrael . ***54:00 - When HaShem created the world, His intention was that Am Yisrael would accept the Torah. Therefore, how much more is His pride in Israel with every passing day, from the actions of each and every Jew. This explains the vast differences between one day and another. ***56:00 - SIDDUR . Shacharis: "Who renews each day the deeds of creation..."

lessons.title: 2024-12-02 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 5 - Para. 6b-9 - Ki Seitzei - Kedoshim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 5 - Ki Seitzei - Kedoshim - Shavuah Hesseis - Day Worker - Hispaa'rus - Parnassah Improves Shalom Bayis - HaShem Takes Pride in Every Jew - Paying a Worker on Time - Avraham Avinu - Toldos - Yitzchak Avinu's Blindness - Rivka Insures Yaakov's Blessing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 5 - Ki Seitzei - Kedoshim - Shavuah Hesseis - Day Worker - Hispaa'rus - Parnassah Improves Shalom Bayis - HaShem Takes Pride in Every Jew - Paying a Worker on Time - Avraham Avinu - Toldos - Yitzchak Avinu's Blindness - Rivka Insures Yaakov's Blessing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 03:40 - Tehillim - Baruch Hashem Yom Yom. Each person should see to it that his mitzvos each day bring HaShem pride. Reference to Sukkah 46. *09:35 - A day worker's hispa'arus is weak. This is why it's important for an employer to pay a day worker on time. 13:00 - There are troubles in a home that lacks parnassah . Reference to Bava Metzia 59. 14:00 - Tehillim 147. Parnassah improves shalom bayis . When an employer pays his workers on time, this generates love and peace in his own home, as well. *15:45 - Parshas Ki Seitzei. בְּיוֹמוֹ֩ תִתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָר֜וֹ וְלֹֽא־תָב֧וֹא עָלָ֣יו הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֤י עָנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵלָ֕יו ה֥וּא נֹשֵׂ֖א אֶת־נַפְשׁ֑וֹ - "You shall give him his wage on his day and not let the sun set over it, for he is poor, and he risks his life for it..." ( Devarim 24:15, Ki Seitzei ). 16:15 - לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר - "...The hired worker's wage shall not remain with you overnight until morning" ( Vayikra 19:13, Kedoshim ). 17:45 - HaShem's hispa'arus is the source of blessing. Every individual day has its own hispa'arus . בָּר֥וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֘ י֚וֹם | י֗וֹם - "Blessed is HaShem, day by day..." ( Tehillim 68:20). Receiving payment for his daily work enables the worker to experience hispa'arus of each individual day. 20:00 - Shavuah Hesseis does not apply to a day worker who claims he wasn't paid. An employer is suspect of forgetting to pay his worker, since he's usually preoccupied. 26:00 - The hispa'arus of a worker is in the hands of the employer. Therefore, the day worker is in a type of exile and servitude. 30:00 - Q&R - 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Avraham Avinu was a master of chessed - kindness. He and Sarah Imeinu brought souls to belief in HaShem . 32:00 - וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֣וּ בְחָ֑רָן - "...and the souls they had acquired in Haran..." Bereishis 12:5, Lech Lecha ). 38:00 - Tikkun HaMizbeyach - Tzaddik - Yaakov Avinu is the main hispa'arus - the ultimate pride of HaShem . "Yisrael, in You I take pride." ( Yishaya 49:3). 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas Toldos. וַיֶּֽאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶת־יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "And Yitzchak loved Esav because he entrapped with his mouth, but Rivka loved Yaakov" ( Bereishis 25:28, Toldos ). 41:30 - ( Esav "...entrapping with his mouth" Reference to the Pri Etz Chaim of the Arizal . ***44:00 - After initially drawing close to a tzaddik , there are times when a person suddenly can't see the tzaddik's light. This is an aspect of Yitzchak Avinu's blindness. 46:00 - Bereishis 27:7. 50:00 - Sometimes people give tzedakah in order to increase their own pride. NOTE: An example of the damage this in our own time are antisemitic donors giving money to American universities. 55:00 - Toldos - Rivka Imeinu made sure that Yaakov Avinu received Yitzchak Avinu's blessing of material wealth. 56:45 - Q&R about eating the crumbs of challah at the Shabbos table. Generally speaking: this isn't a custom in Breslov.

lessons.title: 2024-12-03 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 5 - Para. 10-13 - Toldos
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 5 - Toldos - Yaakov vs. Esav - Chanukah - Tikkun HaMizbeyach - Hispa'arus - Tzedakah on Chanukah - Bereishis - Ruach Apeinu Refers to Moshiach - What Is Jewish Pride? - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas Toldos. הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 5 - Toldos - Yaakov vs. Esav - Chanukah - Tikkun HaMizbeyach - Hispa'arus - Tzedakah on Chanukah - Bereishis - Ruach Apeinu Refers to Moshiach - What Is Jewish Pride? - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas Toldos. הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ - "...Pour into ..." ( Bereishis 25:30, Toldos ). 04:00 - גַּם־בָּר֖וּךְ יִֽהְיֶֽה - "...he, too, shall be blessed" ( Bereishis 27:33, Toldos ). 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Chanukah. Tikkun HaMizbeyach. 12:00 - א֖וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק - "Light is sown for the righteous..." ( Tehillim 97:11). 14:00 - תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּֽאֲוָת֑וֹ - "Attribute strength to HaShem, over Israel is His pride..." ( Tehillim 68:35). 15:00 - Q&R about Tikkun HaMizbeyach . 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Parshas Bereishis. בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ - "In the beginning, HaShem created the heavens and the earth" וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָֽיְתָ֥ה תֹ֨הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְח֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם - "And the earth was astonishingly empty, and darkness was on the face of the deep, and the spirit of HaShem was hovering over the face of the water" ( Bereishis 1:1-2, Bereishis ). *24:00 - All exiles are included in the present one. 26:00 - Tzedakah is an aspect of water, as in שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם - "Cast your bread your bread upon the surface of the water..." (Koheles 11:1). "Ruach Apeinu" refers to Moshiach ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 28:00 - NOTE: "Yehi" - as in "vayehi ohr" is begematria 25, alluding to the 25th of Kislev . *32:00 - The fact that every day is completely new and different from any other day is an aspect of hispa'arus . 34:00 - Oil represents hispa'arus - glory - as in כַּשֶּׁ֚מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב | עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ - "As the good oil on the head..." ( Tehillim 133:2). 40:00 - Miracle of the oil on Chanukah. *44:00 - HaShem's love for Am Yisrael is expressed through the miracles facilitated by the tzaddikim . 47:00 - וְהָיָה־לָ֚ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ לְא֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וֵֽאלֹהַ֖יִךְ לְתִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ - "...but HaShem shall be to you for an everlasting light, and your Master for your glory" ( Yeshaya 60:5). Jewish pride is not "Chicken soup". Hispa'arus is our connection with HaShem and His Torah. Am Yisrael is the "Pride of HaShem" because HaShem , the Jewish Nation, and the Torah are one.

lessons.title: 2024-12-04 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 5 - Likutey Moharan 17 - Parparaos LeChokhmah - Parshas Ekev
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 5 - Likutey Moharan 17 - Parparaos LeChokhmah - Parshas Ekev - Tikkun HaMizbeyach - Tikkun HaAchila - Elevating the Spiritual Energy in Food - Not By Bread Alone - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:00 - Introduction: Today's shiur will be a review of
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 5 - Likutey Moharan 17 - Parparaos LeChokhmah - Parshas Ekev - Tikkun HaMizbeyach - Tikkun HaAchila - Elevating the Spiritual Energy in Food - Not By Bread Alone - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:00 - Introduction: Today's shiur will be a review of Likutey Moharan 17, Paragraph 3 and Sefer Parparaos LeChokhmah on this teaching. Dedications. 01:45 - Likutey Moharan 17 - PARAGRAPH 3. The klipos draw strength from the mizbeyach . Destructive energy is generated by improper eating. Elevating the spiritual aspects of food. Commentary of sefer Parparaos LeChokhmah . 18:00 - Parshas Ekev. כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִֽחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־כָּל־מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה יִֽחְיֶ֥ה הָֽאָדָֽם - "...for man does not live by bread alone, but rather, by whatever comes forth from the mouth of HaShem does man live" ( Devarim 8:3, Ekev ). 25:00 - Plants and animals receive their life energy for the sake of man. ***27:00 - Darkness and ignorance exist so that man can appreciate light and wisdom. 35:00 - Lack of seder in eating causes a person to lose good judgement. 38:00 - Q&R about negative forces resulting from improper eating. 39:00 - Q&R about Tikkun HaAchila - proper eating. 41:00 - NOTE about the Chanukah lights. 47:00 - Likutey Moharan 17 - PARAGRAPH 4.

Hilkhos Toayn veNitan 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 17 . 00:00 - Continuation of Sefer Parparaos LeChokhmah on Likutey Moharan 17. כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִֽחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־כָּל־מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה יִֽחְיֶ֥ה הָֽאָדָֽם - "...for man does not live by bread alone, but rather, by whatever comes forth from the mouth of HaShem does man live" ( Devarim 8:3, Ekev ). *03:30 - What causes Am Yisrael to be like a child who turns away from His Father? Improper eating empowers negative forces. 07:00 - Tzedakah is called maiseh - action. Reference to Likutey Moharan 28 . 10:00 - "The more charity, the more peace" ( Pirkei Avos 2:8). 11:40 - Gerim - converts to Judaism - contribute to Tikkun HaMizbeyach. This enables the light of the tzaddik to be seen more clearly. *16:20 - The Parparaos LeChokhmah on this section concludes: "What defines a person is not the books they've read, it's their actions." 19:00 - NOTE on Likutey Moharan 66. The Shem HaEtzem is Y - K - V - K , but we are only permitted to pronounce it as A - D - N - Y . Sof Maaseh beMachshava Techila any item, you shall not enter his home to take his security" ( Devarim 24:10, Ki Seitzei ). 31:00 - Am Yisrael is the cause of HaShem's blessings in the world. The 70 Nations benefit from this. The flow of this blessing depends on the actions of Am Yisrael . 32:20 - Q&R about tzedakah . 32:40 - Q&R about not entering a person's home to collect collateral. 39:00 - A person's possessions are an aspect of hispa'arus Hashem . *41:50 - A person's main pride - hispa'arus - is his home. *42:00 - The hispa'arus of Am Yisrael is the Beis HaMikdash . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 45:40 - Collecting a security/collateral from a person's home is an aspect of the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . 50:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-12-06 - LH7 - CM1 - Toayn veNitan 5 - Para. 15 - Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 1 - Geviyas Milveh 2 - Parshas Mishpatim - Ki Seitzei
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Toayn veNitan 5 - Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 1 - Parshas Mishpatim - Ki Seitzei - Laws of Taking Collateral for a Loan - Clothing - Hispa'arus - Daily Blessing on Garments - Tzitzis - Tefillin - A Person's Home Is Their Wealth - Mezuzah - Widow - Sukkah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Parshas Mishpatim
lessons.bodyText: Toayn veNitan 5 - Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 1 - Parshas Mishpatim - Ki Seitzei - Laws of Taking Collateral for a Loan - Clothing - Hispa'arus - Daily Blessing on Garments - Tzitzis - Tefillin - A Person's Home Is Their Wealth - Mezuzah - Widow - Sukkah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Parshas Mishpatim. כִּ֣י הִ֤וא כְסוּת֙וֹ (כתיב כסותה) לְבַדָּ֔הּ הִ֥וא שִׂמְלָת֖וֹ לְעֹר֑וֹ - "for it is his only covering; it is his garment for his skin..." Shemos 22:26, Mishpatim ). Laws of Taking Collateral for a Loan - Clothing - Hispa'arus - Daily Blessing on Garments. 06:20 - Zohar HaKodesh: Tzitzis and Tefillin are the main forms of hispa'arus that HaShem receives every day. 08:40 - HILKHOS GEVIYAS MILVEH 1. Laws of Collecting a Loan. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 69 . 12:47 - Taking all of a person's wealth as collateral is like killing them. 21:20 - Mitzvah that a lender is not permitted into the home of the borrower to collect collateral; the borrower has to bring it out. A person's home is their wealth. 22:45 - Wealth is a blessing that depends on the merit of the wife. 23:24 - וּבְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל־ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים - "With wisdom the rooms are filled with all riches, precious and pleasant" ( Mishlei 24:4). 24:50 - Mezuzah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . ***28:20 - Laws concerning clothing taken as collateral. 30:45 - Parshas Ki Seitzei. הָשֵׁב֩ תָּשִׁ֨יב ל֤וֹ אֶת־הָֽעֲבוֹט֙ כְּב֣וֹא הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ - "You shall return the security to him by sunset..." ( Devarim 24:13, Ki Seitzei ). Returning the borrowers clothing each day is a form of tzedakah. 32:00 - Collateral is not taken from a widow. 35:50 - Q&R - a man's key to wealth is Chokhmah . "Respect your wives, so you may be wealthy." A woman needs respect more than a man does. 37:10 - HALAKHA 2. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . Sukkah represents Daas . 20:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 37 . 40:00 - Parshas Beshalach. לֹֽא־יָמִ֞ישׁ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַמּ֥וּד הָאֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה - "He did not move away the pillar of cloud by day or the pillar of fire at night..." ( Shemos 13:22, Beshalach ). 41:30 - The mitzvah of sukkah is an aspect of the Ananei haKavod - Clouds of Honor. 47:30 - NOTE: Words about this week's parsha - VaYeitzei . When a tzaddik leaves a place, there's a tremendous impact. This week was the yahrzeit of Rav Shimon Shapiro zal , who excelled in love for Am Yisrael , zrizus - enthusiasm - to do a mitzvah , respect for elders, and tefilah . 52:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2024-12-08 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Milveh 3 - Para. 1-4a - Parshas Mishpatim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Milveh 3 - Parshas Mishpatim - Justice - Bringing People Close to HaShem Builds a Heichal HaKodesh - Cheshbon HaNefesh Protects - Fire of Mishpat - Business Dealings Elevate Holy Sparks - Anger Damages Wealth - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 3 is based on Likutey Mohar
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Milveh 3 - Parshas Mishpatim - Justice - Bringing People Close to HaShem Builds a Heichal HaKodesh - Cheshbon HaNefesh Protects - Fire of Mishpat - Business Dealings Elevate Holy Sparks - Anger Damages Wealth - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh BenZion b"R Yisrael Abbah Rosenfeld zal , who devoted his life to bringing people close to HaShem . His yahrzeit is this week on the 11th of Kislev . 01:40 - PARAGRAPH 1. Yad veShem. Tikkun HaMishpat - justice. Bringing people close to HaShem builds a heichal hakodesh . However, doing this has dangers. 05:13 - זֹאת יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם שַׂמְתִּ֑יהָ וּסְבִֽיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ אֲרָצֽוֹת - "...This is Jerusalem; in the midst of the nations I have placed it..." ( Yechezkel 5:5). ***06:20 - When a person is involved with bringing people close to HaShem he must analyze his actions carefully and judge himself daily through mishpat . This mishpat generates a fire that burns away any influence of the negative traits of the people he's bringing close. 10:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 59:4 . 13:10 - עֹ֥שֶׂה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְלֹ֣א בְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּֽחֲצִ֚י יָמָיו֙ (כתיב יָמָו֙) - "...so it is he who gathers riches but not by right; he shall leave them in the midst of his days..." ( Yirmiyah 17:11). 15:00 - Q&R - Cheshbon hanefesh - self-auditing, especially during hisbodedus - protects a person who is bringing people close to HaShem . 17:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. A person involved with business dealings also needs to do cheshbon hanefesh constantly. *18:45 - Kiruv rechokim and business dealings are similar because both occupations elevate sparks of holiness. 22:40 - A spiritually accomplished person and a wealthy person are like magnets - they both attract souls. ***29:38 - Wealth and honor share the same spiritual root, as in וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ - "And wealth and honor are from before You..." ( Divrei HaYomim I , 29:12). 31:15 - Anger is the Yetzer Hara - Evil Inclination - in a person's heart. Anger damages wealth. 32:00 - וְהָסֵ֥ר כַּ֨עַס֙ מִלִּבֶּ֔ךָ וְהַֽעֲבֵ֥ר רָעָ֖ה מִבְּשָׂרֶ֑ךָ - "...and remove anger from your heart, and take evil away from your flesh" ( Koheles 11:10). 33:10 - 39 Melakhos HaMishkan. וִיהִ֚י נֹ֨עַם | אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עָ֫לֵ֥ינוּ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָ֖דֵינוּ כּֽוֹנְנָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּמַֽ֘עֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֜דֵ֗ינוּ כּֽוֹנְנֵֽהוּ - "And may the pleasantness of HaShem our Master be upon us, and the work of our hands establish for us, and the work of our hands establish it ( Tehillim 90:17 - Tefilah leMoshe ). Why does Moshe Rabbeinu repeat the words "establish the work of our hands" ? 36:40 - Q&R How does mishpat counteract anger? 38:00 - It is important to combing Torah with derech eretz . ( Avos 2:2). 38:35 - מִשְׁפְּטֵֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו - "...the judgments of HaShem are true, altogether just" ( Tehillim 19:10). 42:35 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parshas Mishpatim. אֵ֨לֶּה֙ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּשִׂ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם - "And these are the ordinances that you shall set before them" ( Shemos 21:1, Mishpatim ). Money depends on mishpat . Lack of proper mishpat was an important factor causing to the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . ***46:00 - The rebuilding of Yerushalayim is accomplished through mishpat , as in צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה - "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her penitent through righteousness" ( Yeshaya 1:27). 47:00 - ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ - "...all he owns..." ( Mishlei 6:31). 47:45 - PARAGRAPH 4. One of the main causes of poverty is lack of mishpat . 50:00 - Reference to Sefer HaMidos, Mamon A 75: "A poor man is confused like a drunkard". 51:00 - Sometimes poverty distances a person from HaShem . Complaining against HaShem is an aspect of damaged mishpat . 54:40 - NOTE: Tzedakah is a form of mishpat . 55:20 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: 2024-12-09 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Milveh 3 - Parshas Ki Seitzei - Vayera - Mishpat - Tzedakah - Harchavas HaDaas - Give Charity With a Good Heart - From Poverty to Wealth - A Loan Is Mishpat and Tzedakah - Collateral Prohibited From a Widow - Beis HaMikdash - Pekudei - Eicha - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARA. 4b. Review of Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 3 thus far. 01:00 - Damaged mishpat causes poverty to get worse. Bava Kama: "Poverty follows a poor person". *04:30 - Wealth is rooted in mishpat. Tzedakah is tikkun hamishpat . A poor person who is supported receives a chance to repair his damaged judgement. 06:30 - Review of concept that through cheshbon hanefesh a person is able to protect himself and receive wealth. 08:00 - Harchavas HaDaas - expanded consciousness - can take a person out of poverty entirely. Through proper mishpat , a person merits wealth. 08:30 - מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֜צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֚ב | אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ - "...judgment and righteousness You made in Yaakov" ( Tehillim 99:4). 09:00 - Parshas Vayera. כִּ֣י יְדַעְתִּ֗יו לְמַ֩עַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֶת־בָּנָ֤יו וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה לַֽעֲשׂ֥וֹת צְדָקָ֖ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט - "For I have known him because he commands his sons and his household after him, that they should keep the way of HaShem to perform righteousness and justice..." Bereishis 18:19, VaYera ). Avraham Avinu educated his family to conduct themselves with mishpat . 10:30 - The Kohen Gadol wore the choshen mishpat over his heart. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . *11:00 - A person should not have any negative feelings in their heart when they give tzedakah . The baal tzedakah should judge himself, and recognize that HaShem entrusted him with wealth in order to help others. 13:00 - Maaser. It's fitting to give a portion of one's income for tzedakah , since all money belongs to HaShem . If a person knows this he will give tzedakah "with both hands." 15:30 - When a person works very hard for a business owner, he doesn't get a portion of the profits. He gives the worker what he needs to live, and not more. This is compared to HaShem's ownership of the world. Everything we own belongs to Him. 18:00 - Giving tzedakah brings blessing in this world and in Olam HaBah . 19:00 - ט֣וֹב אִ֖ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט - "Good is the man who is gracious and lends, who conducts his affairs with moderation" ( Tehillim 112:5). Rashi: the wealthy person gives generously, but limits his own personal needs. 22:00 - Beis Din is warned to be especially careful when judging a case where a poor person is involved. 23:00 - Moshiach : וְשָׁפַ֚ט בְּצֶ֙דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים - " And he shall judge the poor justly... " ( Yeshaya 11:4). Moshiach will judge the poor with mishpat . ***25:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. In some ways, lending money is a greater form of tzedakah than giving money. 29:00 - ט֣וֹב אִ֖ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט - "Good is the man who is gracious and lends, who conducts his affairs with moderation" ( Tehillim 112:5). 30:00 - Parshas BeHar. וְכִֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָ֥טָה יָד֖וֹ עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהֶֽחֱזַ֣קְתָּ בּ֔וֹ גֵּ֧ר וְתוֹשָׁ֛ב וָחַ֖י עִמָּֽךְ - "If your brother becomes destitute and his hand falters beside you, you shall support him a convert or a resident, so that he can live with you" ( Vayikra 25:35, BeHar ). The importance of lending a person money to prevent him from falling into poverty. 32:30 - A child cannot give a gift. Giving a person a gift on condition that it is returned. 35:40 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas Ki Seitzei . כִּֽי־תַשֶּׁ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ֖ מַשַּׁ֣את מְא֑וּמָה לֹֽא־תָבֹ֥א אֶל־בֵּית֖וֹ לַֽעֲבֹ֥ט עֲבֹטֽוֹ - "When you lend your fellow any item, you shall not enter his home to take his security" ( Devarim 24:10, Ki Seitzei ). A bayis - home - is a form of mishpat . The lender is not permitted to enter the home of the borrower to take collateral. The home is like the roots of a tree. Separating collateral from its source of life-energy - the house - will damage the borrower. A court is called a Bais Mishpat . 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. A lender is not permitted to take collateral from a widow. Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . She represents a tree whose source of life is her late husband. 43:30 - A woman is not permitted to be a judge in Beis Din . 45:00 - The late husband's wealth is the source of chiyus for the widow. 47:00 - Q&R about a married woman working to bringing in parnassah . 48:00 - Q&R about a married woman being dependent financially on her husband. *49:300 - NOTE: Rabbi Rosenfeld zal stressed that a husband should work to earn a living and provide a livelihood for himself and his family. 50:30 - PARAGRAPH 8. Am Yisrael in exile is compared to a widow, as in אֵיכָ֣ה | יָֽשְׁבָ֣ה בָדָ֗ד הָעִיר֙ רַבָּ֣תִי עָ֔ם הָֽיְתָ֖ה כְּאַלְמָנָ֑ה - "O how has the city that was once so populous remained lonely - She has become like a widow..." ( Eicha 1:1). 50:30 - Parshas Pekudei. HaShem takes the Beis HaMikdash as collateral from Am Yisrael . 52:30 - Rebuilding Beis Hamikdash is an aspect of Tikkun HaMishpat , as in צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה - "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her penitent through righteousness" ( Yeshaya 1:27). 53:00 - Closing blessings.

Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Square within a circle. The circle represents Shabbos , the square represents mishpat . 04:30 - מִפִּ֚י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים | וְֽיֹנְקִים֘ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צֽוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֜וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם - "Out of the mouth of babes and nurselings You have established strength because of Your adversaries, in order to put an end to enemy and avenger" ( Tehillim 8:3). The enemies of Am Yisrael are defeated by means of the Shabbos meals. ***05:05 - Parshas Kedoshim. אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֹֽה - "You shall observe My Sabbaths and revere My Sanctuary. I am HaShem" ( Vayikra 19:30, Kedoshim ). If Am Yisrael would keep two Shabbosim - according to some, only one Shabbos - then Moshiach would arrive. 16:10 - כִּ֣י בֵיתִ֔י בֵּית־תְּפִלָּ֥ה יִקָּרֵ֖א לְכָל־הָֽעַמִּֽים - "...for My house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations" ( Yeshaya 56:7). Observing Shabbos rebuilds the Beis HaMikdash . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. 13:00 - Tikkun HaBris is achieved through mishpat . NOTE: When a husband and wife unite in kedushah , souls are generated, even if no physical child is born to the couple from that union. ***15:00 - Cheshbon HaNefesh and hisbodedus are aspects of mishpat . Cheshbon hanefesh generates fire, enthusiasm, that burns away evil. 17:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 . 18:30 - The Sitra Achra originates from fire, and is therefore subdued and defeated by fire. 19:00 - Q&R about why mishpat is associated with a square: shape of the choshen mishpat . 21:12 - Parshas Ekev. וְהָיָ֣ה | עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֤ת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַֽעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְשָׁמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אֶת־הַבְּרִית֙ וְאֶת־הַחֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַֽאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ - "And it will be, because you will heed these ordinances and keep them and perform, that HaShem, your Master, will keep for you the covenant and the kindness that He swore to your forefathers" ( Devarim 7:12). *23:00 - Mishpat burns away desires that prevent tikkun habris . Observing Shabbos has the same power as mishpat in achieving tikkun habris and rebuilding the Beis HaMikdash . 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Souls brought close to HaShem become a garment for the ruach of the person who is being mekarev them. 29:30 - פִּֽי־צַ֖דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֜לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט - "The righteous man's mouth utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks judgment" ( Tehillim 37:30). ***30:00 - NOTE: Speaking to oneself during hisbodedus . Each part of the body has an aspect of the person's soul within it. 32:00 - תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א - "The law of his HaShem is in his heart..." ( Tehillim 37:31). 33:40 - Q&R about the square within a circle. 36:40 - NOTE to explain the square within a circle. Reference to Likutey Moharan 59:3 . 38:45 - HALAKHA 4. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . The perfection of tefilah is its elevation from har to sadeh to bayis - progression from mountain, field, home. 42:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 . 43:00 - Bereishis 3:17. Poverty and the need for loans originates from the sin of Adam. 47:00 - Poverty of tzaddikim atones for the world. ***50:00 - Q&R - Sipurey Maasios - Story of the Cripple. Not only do we overspend, we are being buried in debt. It's important to discipline oneself not to overspend, and to save money rather than borrowing or using credit cards. The first question a soul is asked as it enters shemayim : "Were you honest in business dealings?" Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal : A person reveals his true nature through how he deals with money.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Milveh 4 - Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 1 - Tefilah Elevates Sparks of Holiness - Parshas Ki Savo - What Are Nitzatzos ? - Collecting Debt From Orphans - Nefesh Is Rooted in Bayis - Real Estate - Soul Is Connected to Possessions - Physical Life Is Rooted in the Earth - A Person's Wealth Stands Him On His Feet - Beis HaMikdash Shlishi - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Milveh 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . 00:00 - Tefilah elevates sparks of holiness. 01:35 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . 12:00 - The Beis HaMikdash was collateral for Am Yisrael . 13:39 - וְהִלְוִ֨יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה - "...And you will lend many nations, but you will not borrow" ( Devarim 28:12, Ki Savo ). 14:00 - Bais HaMikdash Shlishi. ***14:30 - Q&R - What are nitzatzos? How do we elevate them? *16:20 - Q&R - What is the spiritual meaning of בית - home? 19:20 - HILKHOS CHOV MAYHAYISOMIM 1. Collecting debt from orphans. Hilkhos Chov MeyhaYisomim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . 20:00 - Wealth comes from the earth. ( Iyov 28:1). 22:00 - Life originates from the earth, as in וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ - "...Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kind..." ( Bereishis 1:24, Bereishis ). 26:00 The nefesh of a person is rooted in his real estate and, to a lesser extent, in his moveable property. 28:00 - After a person passes away, a part of his soul is still attached to his real estate. 29:40 - Q&R about rabbi and student as lender and borrower. 30:20 - The debts of a niftar can be collected from his real estate, but not from his moveable possessions. 32:00 - לְהָקִ֥ים שֵֽׁם־הַמֵּ֖ת עַל־נַֽחֲלָתֽוֹ - "...to preserve the name of the deceased on his heritage" ( Rus 4:5). 34:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 59 . 37:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 61 . ***40:00 - The father's soul is rooted in his land and house. 46:33 - A person's feet are his cosigners. 48:00 - וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם - "...and all the possessions at their feet..." ( Devarim 11:6, Ekev ). A person's wealth stands him on his feet. A borrower is a slave to the lender. Beis HaMikdash Shlishi . 49:00 - Q&R about the sun and moon as lender and borrower. 49:30 - Closing blessings.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 2 is based on Sichos HaRan 112 . There is a
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 2 - Parshas Noach - Collecting Debts From Orphans - A Particular Sin Causes Debt - A Debtor Is a Slave - Real Estate Is Collateral - Shvuah - Vows Sustain the World - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 2 is based on Sichos HaRan 112 . There is a particular sin that causes debt, but Rebbe Nachman did not reveal which one it is. A debtor is a slave. "Shibud" means collateral. 03:30 - A loan is connected to the borrower's real estate, therefore real estate can serve as collateral for a loan. 05:00 - Noach and the curse of his son חם. 6:30 - אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽעֲבוּרֶ֔ךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ - אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽעֲבוּרֶ֔ךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ - "...cursed be the ground for your sake; with toil shall you eat of it all the days of your life" ( Bereishis 3:17, Bereishis ). 08:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . Difficulties in parnassah - livelihood - originate from the curse given to Adam HaRishon . *09:15 - Even though Rebbe Nachman did not reveal which particular sin causes debt, all sins contribute to falling into debt. 21:00 - The lender who claims a niftar owes him money must take an oath in Beis Din . 22:00 - Reference to a sefer that describes each of the sefiros . ***24:30 - Parshas Noach. כִּי־מֵ֥י נֹ֙חַ֙ זֹ֣את לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי מֵֽעֲבֹ֥ר מֵי־נֹ֛חַ ע֖וֹד עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ - "For this is to Me the waters of Noach, as I swore that the waters of Noah shall never again pass over the earth..." ( Yeshaya 54:9). The world was not going to exist after the flood until HaShem took an oath to continue the world. An oath is associated with life and the existence of the world. 30:00 - Parshas Mattos. A vow is taken "in the Name of the King" - HaShem . A shvuah expresses and activates a deep connection to HaShem - the Source of all life. 32:00 - וְלֹא־יֹ֚אמְרוּ עוֹד֙ חַי־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם - "...when they shall no longer say, 'As HaShem lives, Who brought up the children of Israel from the land of Egypt'" but rather they shall say כִּ֣י אִם־חַי־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱלָה֩ וַֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יא אֶת־זֶ֨רַע בֵּ֚ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹנָה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָֽאֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדַּחְתִּ֖ים שָׁ֑ם וְיָֽשְׁב֖וּ עַל־אַדְמָתָֽם - "'As HaShem lives, Who brought up and led the seed of the House of Israel from the northland and from all the lands where I have driven them, and they shall dwell upon their own soil'" ( Yirmiyah 23, 7-8). 33:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Bereishis - Rising From a Spiritual Fall - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Yerida Takhlis HaAliya - Maamar Sasum - Hidden Statement of Creation - Avraham Avinu - Akeidas Yitzchak - Ayeh HaSeh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2L
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Bereishis - Rising From a Spiritual Fall - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Yerida Takhlis HaAliya - Maamar Sasum - Hidden Statement of Creation - Avraham Avinu - Akeidas Yitzchak - Ayeh HaSeh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 05:00 - מאמר סתום - Maamar Sasum - The Hidden Statement of Creation includes all the other statements of creation. 10:50 - Parshas Bereishis. The kovod (honor/will) of HaShem is revealed through the Ten Statements of Creation. 12:20 - וּכְבוֹדִי֙ לְאַחֵ֣ר לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֔ן - "... and My glory I will not give to another..." ( Yeshayahu 42:8). 16:00 - Avraham Avinu - Akeidas Yitzchak . 17:18 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 12 . 20:32 - PARAGRAPH 2. The concept of orphans not being liable for their father's loans relates to the concept of rising from a spiritual fall. Ayeh Makom Kevodo. 24:20 - The essence of life is spiritual advancement. Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 25:20 - Yerida Tachlis HaAliya. During the process of spiritual advancement, it's necessary to go through times of darkness. At those times, a person needs to search for HaShem by crying out "Ayeh makom kevodo." 26:30 - The word Ayeh represents the combination of Keser - Chakhmah - Binah - the highest light of HaShem . 27:45 - The process of spiritual advancement renews the soul. 28:37 - *Why a yerida is necessary before any aliya. 33:43 - Q&R about yerida before aliya . " HaShem likes variety" - even in His selection of tests for a person. These tests are opportunities for coming closer to HaShem and atoning for sins in a large variety of ways. 34:41 - Q&R about yerida takhlis haaliya . 35:29 - PARAGRAPH 3. Kovod HaShem . 36:21 - כבוד - the Khaf Beis alludes to the 22 letters of the Aleph-Beis and the Vuv Daled alludes to the ten sefiros . 38:00 - Before doing something, it's good to ask oneself, "Is this to honor HaShem ?" Everything we say and do should be for Kovod HaShem . 39:44 - *There are times when taking a break from Torah insures the continuity of Torah. ( Menachos 99 ). 43:22 - "VeAyeh HaSeh LeOlah?" 44:55 - There are 10 levels of holiness in the world. 49:24 - Closing blessings. 51:07 - Q&R about finding HaShem's light when we're in darkness. 52:04 - Q&R - In the phrase Ayeh Makom Kevodo , we're addressing HaShem in the third person - "His" kovod . Who are we asking? Response: using third person alludes to the fact that we are addressing the most hidden aspects of HaShem .

Hilkhos Geviy
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas VaEschanan - Tov Torah Im Derech Eretz - Hidden Statement of Creation - Source of All Blessing - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Tetaharu Is Keser - Honoring HaShem in the Material World - When a Person Travels His Torah Precedes Him - Galus - Exile - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - "Tov Torah im derch Eretz." (Avos). 02:28 - ratono zehu kevodo. ***03:20 - "Tov Torah im derech eretz". parallels the Hidden statement of creation - it is the source of all blessing. While he's at work, he will encounter many different situations that will bring him to ask "Ayeh Makom Kevodo" the question that connects him to the highest level of HaShem's light. 06:00 - Tetaharu is begematria Keser . *06:47 - NOTE heard from Rav Chaim Eliya Rosen zal : A person who supports himself is on a higher level than a yireh shemayaim, as in Ashrei yireh HaShem ... yegiah capeichal ... tov loch" . 09:00 - When a person puts efforts into both Torah and Derech Eretz , both his Torah and his physical well-being is established. There's only one in perhaps ten thousand who can learn Torah full time and be successful. 10:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . The workplace is a dangerous place. When a person is emerged in an environment that is not focused on Torah and mitzvos , it's easy for a person to become entrapped by materialism and forget about HaShem , chas v'shalom, as in VeKesev vezahav lach... veram levavecha. 18:55 - NOTE on the Introduction to Sefer Chayey Adam , a commentary on Shulchan Aruch . 20:30 - It's impossible to study Torah only with no involvement in derech eretz , because a person must experience a yerida in order to merit aliya. He must search for HaShem constantly. Derech eretz includes eating, sleeping, and engaging in the "mundane" aspects of daily life. When a person can tap into tetaharu/Keser at these "mundane" times is forgiven all his sins. 23:10 - PARAGRAPH 4. When a person travels, his Torah precedes him, to guide him. 26:30 - Where is HaShem in Dubai? Finding kosher food in a foreign place is an aspect of the extra effort needed to achieve Ayeh Makom Kevodo, as in (Iyov). 28:48 - PARAGRAPH 5. Galus - exile - is an aspect of Ayeh makom kevodo. Imo anochi betzara. "Like a bird wandering from its nest" . ***30:50 - "HaShem will scatter you... you'll find Him if you'll truly search with all your heart." וְהֵפִ֧יץ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּֽעַמִּ֑ים וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה - "( Devarim 4:27-30, VaEschanan ). 34:30 - HaShem is more hidden now than ever before in Jewish history. 52:00 - Q&R about the positive aspects of the present generation counteracting the negative aspects. 53:00 - Closing blessings.
