Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5b. 15:00 - PA
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Beshalach - The Mishkan Is an Aspect of Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Why the Torah Was Given in the Midbar - All Light Is Preceded by Darkness - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5b. 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. 18:00 - וּכְבוֹדִי֙ לְאַחֵ֣ר לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֔ן - "...and My glory I will not give to another..." ( Yishaya 42:8). 19:00 - Q&R about questions in emunah . There are two types of questions: one type leads to light, and the other type cannot be answered now. 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 7ץ 33:00 - Halakhos pertaining to the Beis HaMikdash are those pertaining the mishkan . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Why was the Torah given in the midbar rather than in Eretz Yisrael ? 40:00 - Ayin alludes to Keser, Yesh is Yamin/Smol - Chokhma/Binah . *42:00 - All negative forces draw their energy from the hiddeness of HaShem. 45:00 - Parshas Beshalach. Why the Torah was given in the midbar . וַיִּֽירְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה - "...They were very frightened, and the children of Israel cried out to HaShem" ( Shemos 14:10, Beshalach ). The power of crying out to HaShem: "Ayeh makom kevodo" when Am Yisrael was in Mitzrayim . 47:00 - גואל in Atbash is כתר. The geulah results from asking "Ayeh" . 55:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Beshalach - Yisro - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - The Power of Physical Gestures - Yetziyas Mitzrayim - Geulah - New Kabbalas HaTorah After Each Exile - Moshiach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - PARAGR
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Beshalach - Yisro - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - The Power of Physical Gestures - Yetziyas Mitzrayim - Geulah - New Kabbalas HaTorah After Each Exile - Moshiach - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas Beshalach. Ayehu Makom Kevodo. הֲיֵ֧שׁ יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּקִרְבֵּ֖נוּ אִם־אָֽיִן - "...is HaShem with us or not?" ( Shemos 17:7, Beshalach ). ***04:00 - It's human nature not to search for HaShem until things get difficult. 07:23 - Am Yisrael's battle against Amelek prepared them for Kabalas HaTorah . *09:40 - Q&R about screaming for help vs. calling out to HaShem . ***11:50 - NOTE - When Yisro decided to join Am Yisrael, HaShem announced to the melakhim , c'vayachol , "Stop the world! It's now time to deliver the Torah!" 13:00 - וְהָיָ֗ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ים משֶׁ֛ה יָד֖וֹ וְגָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכַֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנִ֛יחַ יָד֖וֹ וְגָבַ֥ר עֲמָלֵֽק - "It came to pass that when Moshe would raise his hand, Israel would prevail, and when he would lay down his hand, Amalek would prevail" ( Shemos 17:11, Beshalach ). Why Moshe Rabbeinu used a hand gesture, rather than speech, to convey that Am Yisrael should turn to HaShem . A physical gesture is signal, a hint. There are times when speech cannot successfully confront evil, but a more subtle way of communication will. There is power of connecting with HaShem in simply turning the face upward. 19:00 - Q&R about calling out to HaShem from pain. Story of HaShem saving Menashe from cannibals. *21:00 - NOTE: Analogy of two different students getting different grades on an exam. The further away a person is, the tiniest move a person makes is more powerful. 23:30 - Q&R about Rebbe Nachman's statement, at times, "I know nothing". 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Pharaoh imposed even more oppression after Moshe Rabbeinu approached him because the geulah must come from ayeh makom kevodo . Geulah b'Atbash is Keser . 31:00 - Karva Keyl Nafshi - Gaalah . The Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh explains this as the redemption of every person according to their individual level and life circumstances. ***33:20 - Q&R which is more important in tefilah , gratitude or requests? Both aspects are needed. Analogy of asking "What's more important in a car, the battery or the engine?" or "Who's more important, Daddy or Mommy?" The answer is: both. 35:20 - Q&R about crying out "Ayeh Makom Kevodo" since we're supposed to believe that no matter what, HaShem is with us. ***36:40 - NOTE about current events regarding the emergency health care for Rabbi Chaim Menachem ben Leah Kramer shlit"a , may he have a refuah sheleyma . 39:20 - Stories and accounts of people praying to be saved. 43:30 - Q&R - Declaring Rosh Chodesh first requires two witnesses to look up to the sky. ***44:37 - PARAGRAPH 11. After the end of each galus, Am Yisrael merited a renewal of Kabalas HaTorah . After the present exile is over, the kabbalas haTorah of Moshiach's time will be worldwide. 47:10 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Bereishis - Real Estate vs. Moveable Property - Metaltelin Correspond With Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Revealing the Honor of HaShem - Metaltelin Need Protection - Returning Lost Objects - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - וְהָאָ֖רֶץ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֹמָֽדֶת - "...and the earth endures forever" ( Koheles 1:4). ***07:00 - Parshas Bereishis. Why man was created from earth. 08:40 - וַיִּ֩יצֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה - "And HaShem formed man of dust from the ground, and He breathed into his nostrils the soul of life, and man became a living soul" ( Bereishis 2:7, Bereishis ). 10:30 - וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֖בוֹדוֹ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֗רֶץ - "...and His glory will fill the entire earth..." ( Tehillim 72:19). 12:00 - Metaltelin - moveable property - corresponds with "Ayeh makom kevodo" . 13:11 - Repaying a loan via real estate and land vs. repaying a loan via metaltelin ( Bava Kama ). 24:00 - Where moveable objects are most valued, the greatest profit can be made. In that location, the objects are receiving the most light from HaShem . 25:00 - Brief review of the shiur thus far. 28:20 - PARAGRAPH 13. Metaltelin require greater protection and supervision. *30:40 - A person needs to use his physical senses and heart to find the light of HaShem in everything he encounters. Reference to Likutey Moharan 1 . 32:30 - NOTE: Food is an example of HaShem's light being hidden in physical objects. *35:00 - When a person steals land, he never becomes its owner. 36:40 - PARAGRAPH 14. Metaltelin are not collateral that can be collected from the orphans of their owner. 41:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 . 43:00 - Real estate and land is always the property of its owner, even after the owner passes away. 44:00 - The mitzvah of yibum . וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בֹּ֔עַז בְּיֽוֹם־קְנֽוֹתְךָ֥ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד נָֽעֳמִ֑י וּ֠מֵאֵ֠ת ר֣וּת הַמּֽוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת־הַמֵּת֙ קָנִ֔יתָ (כתיב קָנִ֔יתָי) לְהָקִ֥ים שֵֽׁם־הַמֵּ֖ת עַל־נַֽחֲלָתֽוֹ - "And Boaz said, 'On the day that you buy the field from the hand of Naomi and from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the deceased, you have bought , to preserve the name of the deceased on his heritage'." ( Rus 4:5) 45:50 - Halakhos of returning a lost item. 48:50 - Real estate is still attached to the person who dies, so it remains collateral after his death. *51:00 - NOTE: Likutey Halakhos is unique in its presentation of the spiritual aspects of business and money.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - Dedications and brief review. 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. 04:00 - The four exiles - curing the present exile, Edom, HaShem is more hidden than ever before, so more than ever we need to ask "ayeh makom kevodo?" 05:30 - Parshas Vayelech. וְאָֽנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא - "And I will hide My face on that day..." ( Devarim 31:18, Vayelech ). 08:00 - The word ayeh represents the highest, most hidden level of HaShem . 10:30 - שֹׁמֵר֙ מַה־מִּלַּ֔יְלָה שֹׁמֵ֖ר מַה־מִּלֵּֽיל - "...'Watchman, what will be of the night? Watchman, what will be of the night?'" ( Yeshaya 21, 11-12). 12:00 - Searching for HaShem is the most important element in teshuvah . 15:00 - NOTE: Am Yisrael are called Am HaGolah . After the geulah , secular meeting places, such as sports stadium, being used to serve HaShem . As a result of Am Yisrael's wandering during exile, HaShem becomes revealed worldwide. 20:20 - PARAGRAPH 16. Collecting debt from orphans requires shvuah - taking an oath in Beis Din . 23:00 - The most hidden level of HaShem is the most protected. That's how the Presence of HaShem exists even in places of Avoda Zara . ***25:20 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal about the mesiras nefesh of Israeli soldiers. His prayer at the Kosel, following that experience, was a request for HaShem to show us His sweetness rather than his punishment. 27:40 - Every Jew can create a new mitzvah through neder and shvuah - vows and oaths. נדר is Noon Dor - Binah . Neder and shvuah are aspects of the highest level - maamar peleh - so from that place, new mitzvahs can be created. If a Jew says, "I will never drink orange juice" - he creates an issur for himself. *31:00 - Q&R about one's statement of intention obligating him in a new, personal mitzvas aseh . 35:00 - Land and real estate are the revealed honor of HaShem. Matalelin - moveable objects - are the the hidden honor of HaShem . 37:30 - Sheker draws from מאמר סתום - the Hidden Statement of Creation. 38:50 - Q&R about calling out to HaShem "ayeh makom kevodo" during difficult times. Reference to Likutey Moharan 33 . *45:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal warning a person not to overreaching his spiritual capacity. 50:00 - Q&R about the effects of calling out "ayeh makom kevodo" . 51:10 - Closing blessings.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - Dedications and review. Ayeh makov kevodo . 02:40 - PARAGRAPH 17. Seferias HaOmer is an aspect of "ayeh makom kevodo" - searching for HaShem . 04:00 - אַיֵּ֚ה סֹפֵר֙ - "...where is he who counts..." ( Yeshaya 33:18). *08:00 - Not even the slightest movement toward holiness is lost. HaShem sees even the smallest thought, word, or action of teshuvah . *11:00 - Every person has to pass through many experiences and travel through many places until he merits entering the gates of holiness. 12:00 - NOTE - The Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh instituted the custom of saying Tehillim 107 - "Hodu" just before mincha on Erev Shabbos. 13:30 - Reference to the Story of the Lost Princess in Sipurey Maasios . 14:00 - Q&R about searching for HaShem . Why a synagogue is called a Beis Knesses . Why a Torah study hall is called a Beis Midrash . 17:45 - Q&R - the search for HaShem is not easy, but is never futile. Most of a person's efforts toward kedushah cannot be seen by others, they are seen only by HaShem . 23:14 - Return to text. 27:10 - Rebbe Nachman encouraged his students: "Gevald! Never give up!" Rav Nosson zal described the tremendous feeling and heart with which the Rebbe said these words. 29:10 - The korbon of barley. 33:20 - PARAGRAPH 18. Pesach Sheni. Ain Shum Yiush BeOlam - never give pp - more literally: "there's no reason on earth to despair". 36:30 - A person who is in conflict must seek a tzaddik , just as Rivka Imeinu went to inquire at the yeshiva of Shem veEyver when she was troubled about her pregnancy. 39:50 - The light of Shavuos originates from the place of "Ayeh" - the highest level of HaShem . 41:30 - Shavuos is called keser . 41:45 - Q&R - there are different types of searching. 42:20 - INTRODUCTION to PARAGRAPH 19. By hashgacha , the next topic - LaG BeOmer - will focus on concepts in his week's parsha: Vayeishev . "Meguri" means "megaier" - bringing people close to HaShem . The Avos were constantly involved in outreach. Yosef HaTzaddik knew that the task of the tzaddik is to connect with people of all spiritual levels. ***44:40 - NOTE about Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal orchestrating a confrontation between Rabbi Gamliel and Rabbi Yeshuah . This initiated a change in policy of Torah study in the generation, whereby students of all levels were now welcome. 46:45 - This incident is just one example of why people of all levels of Torah observance revere Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal - why "LaG BeOmer is for everyone."

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 - Parshas Vayelech - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - LaG BeOmer - Rabbi S himon Bar Yochai zal - Chanukah - Rabbi Akiva - Crowns on Letters of the Torah - Students of Rabbi Akiva - Why LaG BeOmer Is a Joyous Day - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 12 - "Ayeh HaSeh" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. LaG BeOmer. In the merit of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal, Am Yisrael will never forget the Torah completely. 04:00 - NOTE about Chanukah . The lights of the menorah are an aspect of searching for HaShem - "ayeh makom kevodo" . 06:00 - Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal was given permission to reveal the secrets of the Torah, especially through the Tikkunei Zohar , which is based on the מאמר סתום - the Hidden Statement of Creation. 11:00 - NOTE - story of Rabbi Yochanan zal and Resh Lakish . 13:00 - NOTE - The "Treasury of Free Gifts" supports the people who are not connected to the Torah. 18:00 - לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִפִּ֣י זַרְע֑וֹ - "...for it will not be forgotten from the mouth of their offspring..." ( Devarim 31:21, Vayelech ). 22:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu was shown the death of Rabbi Akiva zal ( Menachos 29). Rabbi Akiva knew the secrets of the crowns on the letters of the Written Torah. These secrets are from the level of "Ayeh" . ***26:00 - Rabbi Akiva tapped into the "original thought" of HaShem , which was to create the world through Midas HaDin . The tzaddikim sometimes choose suffering to protect Am Yisrael . 30:00 - "Respect your friend as you would respect yourself" ( Pirkei Avos ). Showing respect for a fellow Jew shows respect for HaShem . 33:00 - Am Yisrael's mission in this world is to honor HaShem in order to reveal His light. 36:00 - Q&R about the death of Rabbi Akiva. He didn't deserve death, he took it upon himself to take the suffering due Am Yisrael . Last letters of "Elokekha" in the Shema contain the letters ככה through which Am Yisrael's enemies are struck down. The words "Chanukah" and "Purim" also contain this Name of HaShem . 40:00 - Life is the connection of body and soul. Death means the separation between "ayeh makom kevodo" and מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ - "...the whole earth is filled with His glory" ( Yeshaya 6:3). Reference to the Arizal in Pri Etz Chaim . 47:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7 . The mission of a tzaddik is to leave behind students so he continues to live in this world. ***48:00 - LaG BeOmer is considered a joyous day because every year on that day the soul of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal receives new, greater elevation. The higher the tzaddik goes, the more the light of HaShem is revealed in this world. 50:00 - גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֜פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ - "Uncover my eyes and I shall look at hidden things from Your Torah" ( Tehillim 119:18). "Gahl" alludes to "LaG" beOmer. 51:00 - Closing blessings for Chanukah.

lessons.description: Healthy Parenting - Biographical Notes - Rabbi Yechiel Michel B'Rav Yehoshuah Dovid HaLevi Dorfman zal - Chanukah - Chinuch - Seeing Rebbe Nachman in a Dream - Plague of Darkness Began on the 25th Of Kislev - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Reb Michel zal once saw Rebbe Nachman in a dream. Reb Michel and Rebbetzin Rivka (
lessons.bodyText: Healthy Parenting - Biographical Notes - Rabbi Yechiel Michel B'Rav Yehoshuah Dovid HaLevi Dorfman zal - Chanukah - Chinuch - Seeing Rebbe Nachman in a Dream - Plague of Darkness Began on the 25th Of Kislev - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Reb Michel zal once saw Rebbe Nachman in a dream. Reb Michel and Rebbetzin Rivka ( Bas Mariasa and Bas Rav Nasan Sternhartz) had 3 daughters. All were Torah observant, married, raised children, made aliya to Eretz Yisrael , and worked as medical doctors. His eldest daughter, Dishleh a"h , passed away as a young mother - her kever is on Har HaZeisim . His third and youngest daughter was Itta Basyah ("Bitya") . His second, the middle daughter was Channah Perel - named after Reb Michel's mother a"h . Account of how Reb Michel was asked to daven for the Satmar Rebbe zal at the kever of Rebbe Nachman in Uman. Q&R - if a person davens for another, when HaShem sends the blessing, it enters via the person davening . Q&R about what Reb Michel learned through the dream where he saw Rebbe Nachman. ***After 38 years as refuseniks, Reb Michel and his wife received permission to leave Russian. Reb Michel became the head of the Central Breslov Yeshiva in Meah Shaarim after the passing of Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Bender zal . Reb Michel's advice to a young family making aliya from the U.S. Reb Michel's message to Bar Mitzvah boys: to be a Yireh shemayim, Talmud Chacham, and an emestiker Breslover chassid . His dvar Torah at a seudas Bar Mitzvah: From Ben Yehoyada - by the Ben Ish Chai : Rav Sheshes said, "Congratulate me, I put on tefillin today!" The custom to look at the two Shins engraved in the leather of the batim . A spiritual light emanates from those two engraved letters at the time of putting them on that strengthens the person who sees that light. But Rav Sheshes was blind. How could he see this light? Rav Sheshes advised his students exactly when to move forward through the crowd to view a king passing through their city. Kol Demama daka . Rav Sheshes was a student of Rav . Rav Sheshes asked HaShem to make him blind. The Ben Ish Chai zal points out that the name Sheshes has two Shins and the Tav is for Tefillin . מַעֲנֶה־רַּךְ יָשִׁיב חֵמָה וּדְבַר־עֶצֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָף - "A gentle reply turns away wrath, but a distressing word stirs up anger" ( Mishlei 15:1). Reb Michel advised that rebuke should only be given gently. When Reb Michel came to Eretz Yisrael , he was often asked to be the sandek at a Bris Milah . He would ask, "Who was the sandek for Avraham Avinu? - HaShem! A sandek is supposed to give a gift to the child. What gift did HaShem give to Avraham Avinu? Eretz Yisrael! " The Breslov custom of bringing a son to Rebbe Nachman before the age of seven. NOTES on Chanukah - chinuch. ***NOTE on Chanukah heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . Each plague took approximately a month. The plague of darkness began on the 25th day of Kislev . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

The Beis HaMidrash is a place of searching for HaShem. ( Tehillim 132:4-5). 30:30 - In serving HaShem , only a person who searches can find. 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Parshas Vayeira . עַ֚ל אַחַ֣ד הֶֽהָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ - "...on one of the mountains, of which I will tell you" ( Bereishis 22:2, Vayeira ). 33:40 - אֶזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי - "I recall my music at night; I speak with my heart and my spirit searches" Tehillim 77: ***34:40 - Tefilah is a search. ***35:00 - Q&R about every person having a portion in the Land - every Jew has a portion in Eretz Yisrael - literally. 37:50 - יְהֹוָ֚ה | לֹֽא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֖בִּי וְלֹֽא־רָ֣מוּ עֵינַ֑י - "...HaShem, my heart was not haughty, nor were my eyes raised on high..." ( Tehillim 131:1). 38:50 - More aspects of spiritual searching: in order to achieve forgiveness on Yom Kippur, we have to rise to the level of "ayeh makom kevodo" . 44:00 - Q&R about the experience of reaching the level of "ayeh makom kevodo" . ***45:00 - יְהֹוָ֚ה | לֹֽא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֖בִּי וְלֹֽא־רָ֣מוּ עֵינַ֑י - "...HaShem, my heart was not haughty, nor were my eyes raised on high..." ( Tehillim 131:1). ***46:30 - Lack of self esteem leads to despair. To help cure depression, simply "lift up their eyes" heavenward, physically looking upward, toward HaShem . Saying "ayeh makom kevodo" guarantees that HaShem will immediately respond. 50:00 - Q&R about saying "ayeh makom kevodo" to cure addiction.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 4 - "אנכי" - "Anochi" . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. NOTE about the newly published manuscript end of Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 3. Announcements. 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Any light that is kindled as a mitzvah draws down the Ohr HaAin Sof into Daas . "Ein Sof" is begematria אור. (Reference to Zohar HaKadosh, Bo 42). 09:10 - כִּֽי־אַ֖תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱ֜לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי - "For You light my lamp; HaShem, My Master, does light my darkness" ( Tehillim 18:29). 09:40 - Parshas Tetzaveh. בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָֽעֵדֻ֗ת יַֽעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַֽהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "In the Tent of Meeting, outside the dividing curtain that is in front of the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall set it up before HaShem from evening to morning; an everlasting statute for their generations, from the children of Israel" ( Shemos 27:21, Tetzaveh ). 12:23 - מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־יֹ֜֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ - "From Zion, the finery of beauty, HaShem appeared" ( Tehillim 50:2). 13:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. The four who entered Pardes . 16:30 - Vidui to HaShem in the presence of a talmud chokhom enables the Malkhus to rise to Ain Sof . 18:00 - The four basic passions arise from the four elements of physical creation: Earth, Air, Fire, Water. 20:00 - Humility allows a person to receive light from Ain Sof . Y - K - V - K begematria is 26 - Chaf Vav - כף and ו is 86 - Elokim . "Elokim" is the milui of Y - K - V - K . HaShem's Midas haRachamim is actually the same as His Midas HaDin . 24:00 - Q&R - קני is ___ - three times קני is ___ - Yesh which alludes to Yemin - Smol . (??? check this in recording) 25:00 - Q&R - Who is the tzaddik ? There is a talmid chakham who can play a role in soliciting forgiveness for sins. Reb Nachman Tcherin, in Parparaos LeChokhmah, writes that Rebbe Nachman's students were sometimes permitted to say vidui in front of Rebbe Nachman, but the Rebbe stopped this practice. One of the places a person can do this type of vidui at the kever of Rebbe Nachman in Uman. ***29:40 - In Likutey Tefilos there is a prayer that asks "let my vidui hereby be as if it is said in the presence of a true tzaddik". ***31:30 - "Seeing the face of the tzaddik " - how is this done today? Rav Nachman Tcherin zal writes that studying the sefer of a Tzaddik is as if seeing his face. Reference to Likutey Moharan 192 . *33:45 - PARAGRAPH 3. The miracle of Chanukah. 38:00 - Q&R about the words surrounding a mitzvah are secrets of Torah. Black Fire on White Fire alludes to the letters of the Torah and the spaces between them - both are holy. 41:00 - Sutra Achara is called Elokim Acherim . 42:00 - The historical events of Chanukah reflected the defeat of the kingdom of evil. 44:00 - The power of the miracle of the military victory during Chanukah was in finding the holy oil - which is another term for the wisdom of the Torah. 49:00 - On Yom Kippur, the Kohen Gadol standing on the Ehven Shasiya in the Beis HaMikdash was able to reach the Ohr HaEin Sof . 49:50 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 - Parshas Tetzaveh - Yom Kippur - Chanukah - Ohr HaEin Sof Is Received Through the Tzaddik - Rotzo veShov - Vidui In Front of a True Talmid Chokham - Miracle of Chanukah Oil - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 4 - "אנכי" - "Anochi" . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. Yom Kippur. 00:00 - Parshas Tetzaveh. וְנֹֽעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי - "There I will arrange meetings with the children of Israel, and it will be sanctified by My glory" Shemos 29:43, Tetzaveh ). *13:00 - The Ohr HaEin Sof corresponds to נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ - "Her husband is known in the gates..." ( Mishlei 31:23). Each individual perception of HaShem is received through the Tzaddik Emes . 16:30 - The experience of HaShem cannot be expressed. Emunah is articulated through the reshimu - imprinted memory - of the Ohr HaEin Sof . *18:50 - The Chanukah lights correspond to the menorah in the Beis HaMikdash . 20:00 - NOTE - "No one" was in the Kadosh HaKadoshim on Yom Kippur - " Lo adam haya" - that is, even the Kohen Gadol was not present, because of his absolute bitul . . 21:00 - NOTE from the Bnei Yissachar about Am Yisrael's experience of HaShem at Kriyas Yam Suf . אז - Alef is the Light of HaShem , Zayin is the entire material world via the 7 days of Creation. ***23:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Every year, at the time of Chanukah, every Jew has the opportunity to rekindle the light of the Menorah in the Beis HaMikdash . This enables each person to receive an entirely new perception of HaShem . 26:15 - The story of Raba Bar Bar Chana and the oil from the eyeball of the fish. 27:00 - NOTE: "One eye" alludes to the "Eye of HaShem ". "Two eyes" refers to Chokhma and Binah . 28:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. ***31:00 - NOTE: Viduy in front of a talmid chokham does not mean "any talmid chokham " - but refers to someone on an extremely high level - the Talmid Chokham HaEmes . 34:20 - NOTE: כל ישראל ערבין זה לזה וכולם כגוף אחד וכערב הפורע חוב חבירו - Kol Yisrael areyvin zeh le zeh - the soul of every Jew is forever interlocked and interdependent ( Ritbah , Rosh Hashanah 29a). 35:30 - NOTE about the lights of Chanukah outshining the holiday lights of the 70 Nations. 36:20 - PARAGRAPH 5. The miracle of oil on Chanukah. 43:00 - NOTE: about Rav Shimshon Ostropoli hy"d : What can possibly be great than the Shem HaEtzem ? A repetition of Y - K - V - K . In the revelation of the 13 Midos HaRachamim, Moshe Rabbeinu prayed saying Y - K - V - K twice. The first Shem HaEtzem refers to HaShem's love for humanity before the sin of Adam. The second Shem HaEtzem refers to HaShem's love for humanity after the sin of Adam - which is a much higher level because it includes His infinite power to forgive. 47:00 - Two times 26, three times 26, four times 26. . 49:00 - NOTE about tzedakah and the Ohr HaTzaddik Emes on Chanukah. 51:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 - Vayeira - Vidui In Front of a True Talmid Chokham - Metaltelim Return to the Earth After Their Owner Passes Away - All 4 Elements of Creation Are Included in עפר - The Element of Earth - Cremation Does Not Provide Tikkun for the Soul - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 4 - "אנכי" - "Anochi" . ***00:00 - The four elements correspond to human character traits. The key to all positive character traits is humility. 05:30 - Vidui in front of a true talmid chokham . 10:30 - NOTE in honor of Chanukah about Rachamim Gedolim . 13:40 - NOTE from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal based on Likutey Moharan 7 . עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְךָ֔ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִמְחַכֵּה־לֽוֹ - "...no eye had ever seen a god besides You perform for him who hoped for Him..." ( Yeshaya 64:3). The "Him" in this possuk refers to HaShem at the highest level - therefore the grammar of third person is used. 17:40 - Efforts in this world contribute to Olam HaBaah , similar to how Shabbos requires preparation. 18:00 - Parshas Vayeira. הַכֹּל֙ הָיָ֣ה מִן־הֶֽעָפָ֔ר וְהַכֹּ֖ל שָׁ֥ב אֶל־הֶֽעָפָֽר - "...all came from the dust, and all return to the dust" ( Koheles 3:20). וְאָֽנֹכִ֖י עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר - "...although I am dust and ashes" ( Bereishis 18:27, Vayeira ). 18:40 - The element of עפר - earth - has two aspects, one is humility and one is physicality. All four elements are included in the element of earth. 21:30 - The epitome of humility is to consider oneself as lowly as עפר. 22:40 - Ohr is begematria Ein Sof . *26:00 - Every Jew has a portion of Eretz Yisrael , as in וְעַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ - "And your people, all of them righteous, shall inherit the Land forever..." ( Yeshaya 60:21). 26:40 - When a person leaves this world and his body returns to עפר, all his metaltelim - physical property - also returns to the earth. This is why a person's metaltelim cannot be claimed to repay his debts after he passes away. *42:50 - NOTE - Cremation does not achieve the spiritual tikkun needed by a person who passes away. 44:00 - Q&R - When wealth inherited from one's parents is used to do mitzvos , the souls of the parents are elevated. 45:00 - Q&R - Using earth from Eretz Yisrael for burial outside of Eretz Yisrael . 47:40 - Closing blessings for Chanukah.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 - Dying in Debt Harms the Soul - Gilgul - Reincarnation Is Often Related to Money Matters - Collecting Debt from Orphans - Shvuah - Taking an Oath To Connect With Rebbe Nachman in Olam HaBaah - Chanukah - 13 Midos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 4 - "אנכי" - "Anochi" . ***00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. גַּם־שָׁ֖ם לֹֽא־יָנ֥וּחַ לָֽךְ - "...even there you shall have no rest" ( Yeshaya 23:12). Dying in debt harms the soul by delaying or preventing its final tikkun . 20:00 - Q&R about going into debt to buy real estate. BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about how Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal conducted business for a community gemach - loan fund. 25:00 - Q&R about dying in debt. If a person dies in debt, Reference to the Zohar HaKodesh, Parshas Mishpatim . Reincarnation Is Often Related to Money Matters. 28:00 - Q&R about how to help children buy real estate. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Collecting debt from orphans. Shvuah - taking an oath. 34:00 - Preparing for death by saying vidui and by repaying debts. 35:00 - NOTE - Rabbi Maimon speaks about how his father zal made sure all his debts were paid before he passed away. 36:00 - Q&R about collecting debt. 37:00 - Q&R about our debts to HaShem . Our body and property are all on loan from HaShem . We pay back the loan through Torah, mitzvos, and maasim tovim. 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas Vayechi. וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִשָּֽׁבְעָה֙ לִ֔י וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ - " And he said, 'Swear to me.' So he swore to him..." ( Bereishis 47:31, Vayechi ). 45:00 - Shvuah connects a person to the Ohr Ein Sof . Kadosh Kadoshim in the Beis HaMikdash is the place where bitul to the Ohr Ein Sof was achieved at the highest level by the Kohen Gadol . Burial in Eretz Yisrael is also an aspect of bitul to the Ohr Ein Sof . ***47:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. It is a minhag among Breslov chassidim to take an oath to connect with Rebbe Nachman in Olam HaBaah. Reference to Chayey Moharan 101 . (??? check source). ***50:00 - Q&R about how taking an oath to be with Rebbe Nachman after one's death. A good time to do this is on Simchas Torah , when the sifrei Torah are accessible to take an oath. "I will go to Rebbe Nachman in Olam HaBaah " and not to follow this with "bli neder" but rather to simply make the statement "I will go to Rebbe Nachman in Olam HaBaah ." (More information on this to be presented in shiurim to follow, b'ezras HaShem .) 52:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. A lender has a hold on the possession of the borrower after the borrower passes away because of the shibud - servitude - of the borrower. *55:00 - NOTE about Chanukah. The Arizal on the 13 Midos of Rachamim and how it corresponds to Chanukah. The seventh midah is Emes - Yaakov Avinu - which equals 7 times Y - K - V - K . Yosef HaTzaddik is 6 times Y - K - V - K . Together these two name become 13 times Y - K - V - K , which corresponds to the word "silence". 59:00 - Closing blessing. The third light of Chanukah corresponds to veChanun . Encouragement to connect with Rebbe Nachman during Chanukah.

( Shemos 12:12, Bo ). 13:30 - Goel in Atbash is Keser . 16:00 - Spiritual aspects of the prohibition of chometz during Pesach . The ability to wait is related to Keser . Reference to Likutey Moharan 6 . 18:15 - Issur Chometz enables Am Yisrael to have a healthy connection with the Ohr Ein Sof . 19:00 - A slave who has been freed is no longer collateral for his previous owner's debts. 22:42 - Reference to 23:00 - HALAKHA 5. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . *25:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. How the tzaddik relates to different people, since everyone is on a different spiritual level. 30:30 - עַ֣יִן לֹֽא־רָאָ֗תָה - "...no eye had ever seen..." ( Yeshaya 64:3). ***33:00 - Q&R about the kavana one should have when saying Ayeh Makom Kevodo on Shabbos during the kedusha of mussaf . The neshoma yiseyra - additional soul - received on Shabbos arrives in 6 stages over the course of tefilah on Shabbos . The final stage is when answering Ayeh Makom Kevodo . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Shvuah - taking an oath when claiming repayment of a debt in Beis Din . 43:20 - PARAGRAPH 3. Everything that a person goes through in their life is to develop his ability to return to HaShem . 48:20 - Yetziyas Mitzrayim. *50:00 - Parshas Shemos - HaShem increased Am Yisrael's suffering when the geulah began. 53:00 - Closing blessings. Today is the fourth day of Chanukah.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. Parshas Beshalach. HaShem is Sometimes Revealed and Sometimes Hidden. 06:45 - The mohn - mannah. הִֽנְנִ֨י מַמְטִ֥יר לָכֶ֛ם לֶ֖חֶם מִן־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְיָצָ֨א הָעָ֤ם וְלָֽקְטוּ֙ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ לְמַ֧עַן אֲנַסֶּ֛נּוּ הֲיֵלֵ֥ךְ בְּתֽוֹרָתִ֖י אִם־לֹֽא - "...Behold! I am going to rain down for you bread from heaven, and the people shall go out and gather what is needed for the day, so that I can test them, whether or not they will follow My teaching" ( Shemos 16:4, Beshalach ). 10:20 - Dasan and Avihu went out to gather mohn on Shabbos . 11:00 - The wellspring at Maasa Umeriva . 12:00 - When Am Yisrael doubted HaShem, HaShem sent Amalek - begematria safeyk - doubt. ***13:00 - Q&R about the constantly changing dynamic between emunah and yediah . Some questions are permitted, some questions should not be asked or answered. For example, it's not good to delve into the mystery of free choice vs. HaShem's omniscience. The importance of praying to be freed from doubt. 19:30 - Throughout history, at times HaShem is revealed - at times HaShem is hidden. 25:00 - The dynamic of HaShem being revealed and then hidden occurs on a global, national, and person level. It also affects both physical and spiritual aspects of life. 32:00 - Q&R about free will vs. HaShem's omniscience. 34:00 - NOTE. Accounts of observant Jews under communist rule. How a letter written to HaShem ended up at the Kremlin. 38:00 - HaShem is both revealed and hidden. 40:00 - אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ - "Indeed, You are HaShem Who conceals Himself, HaShem of Israel, the Savior" ( Yeshaya 45:15). 41:00 - NOTE about the faith of Holocaust survivors. ***50:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal and his marriage to the granddaughter of Rav Avrohom Shternhartz zal . 54:30 - Closing blessings for Rosh Chodesh Teves . 56:00 - Story of Rebbe Nachman substituting honey for molten lead.

Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaYisomim 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - מְלֹ֥א כָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ - "...the whole earth is filled with His glory" - ( Yeshaya 6:3). Chol is an aspect of the tzaddik . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7:7 . 05:00 - בָּר֥וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֘ י֚וֹם | י֗וֹם יַֽעֲמָ֫ס לָ֥נוּ הָ֘אֵ֚ל יְשֽׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה - "Blessed is HaShem; every day HaShem lavishes upon us our salvation forever" ( Tehillim 68:20). 06:00 - The mohn was sent daily to strengthen bitachon . 08:00 - הַדּ֗וֹר אַתֶּם֙ רְא֣וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה - "O generation, you see the word of HaShem..." was said as Yirmiyahu HaNavi displayed the jar of mohn to Am Yisrael ( Yirmiyahu 2:31 and Rashi ). Mohn Hu is emunah . 10:30 - Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 2, Shiluach HaKen 5:26 . 13:00 - Ayeh and Malei Chol HaAretz BeKevodo - HaShem is Hidden and Revealed 14:00 - חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹֽא־תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא־כָל֖וּ רַֽחֲמָֽיו - "The kind deeds of HaShem never cease, His mercies never fail" ( Eicha 3:22). 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. 17:00 - לְךָ֣ יְ֠הֹוָה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֚ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּֽי־כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ - "Yours, HaShem, are the greatness, and the might, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty, for all that is in the heavens and on the Earth ..." ( Divrei Hayamim I 29:11). "Ki chol" alludes to Yisod . 18:00 - Taking an oath in Beis Din brings together the hidden aspect and revealed aspect of HaShem and His Torah. 19:00 - Ayeh Makom Kevodo. The mitzvah of wearing Tzitzis is an aspect of HaShem's hidden light. This holds true for all 613 mitzvos - we bring the hidden light of HaShem into the physical world. 22:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 - calling HaShem by mentioning His Name: the Torah. 23:00 - In the possuk "This is My Name forever" - l'olam is not spelled in the usual way to allude to the hidden aspect of HaShem - Ayeh . 26:30 - PARAGRAPH 6. *28:00 - כִּ֣י הַמָּ֔וֶת יַפְרִ֖יד - "...for death separates..." ( Rus 1:17). The soul originates from Ayeh while the body originates from Maleh Haaretz . Life is the constant joining of soul with body. ***29:30 - The most important way to join HaShem's aspect of Ayeh with His aspect of Maleh is through connection with the Daas of the Tzaddik Emes - including that which continues in the world even after his passing. 34:00 - Death is synonymous with lies. ( Sanhedrin 97). 35:00 - When taking a shvuah - oath - the word "life" is usually said. 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Shvuah - taking an oath - is an aspect of life - the joining of the Hidden and Revealed aspects of HaShem . Debt cannot be collected by the orphans of the lender. 40:00 - NOTE about Yehoshuah being entrusted as the new leader of Am Yisrael even though he was not Moshe Rabbeinu's son. Similarly, Rebbe Nachman passed his mantel of leadership to Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal and Rav Nosson passed it to Rav Nachman Tulchiner zal . 42:00 - Q&R about inheriting wealth from parents who were lacking Daas . ***43:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: During his trip to America on a mission to save the tziyun of Rebbe Nachman in 1979, Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal told over the chiddush of the Ben Ish Chai zal on the phrase Im Daas kanisa, mah chisarta? - "If you have acquired wisdom, what do you lack?". The Ben Ish Chai zal explains that since each letter in the Alef Beis has a milui - an extra, unspoken part (called the "psoles" of the letter) the concept that Moshe Rabbeinu received his wealth from the pesoles of the luchos is revealed in: "Lamed" - take Mem Daled . Vuv - take Yud Vuv. Ches - take Sav. Vuv take Yud Vuv. Tav take Beis . Adding up the pesoles of luchos equals "Daas" 474. Money inherited from people who have no daas is empty and lacks blessing. Reference to Likutey Moharan 60 . 48:00 - The tzaddik eats to satisfy his soul. Blessing enters the world via the tzaddik . 49:30 - Moshe Rabbeinu is begamtria 613. Every Jew has a portion in the Torah.

The word אפ
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 1 - Parshas Behar - Apoteki Applies Only to Land or Slaves - Real Estate - Yuval - Soul of Landowner Is Connected With His Land Even After It's Sold - Hekdeish - Korbon - Smikha - 5 Parts of a Jewish Soul - Ruach Is In the Hands - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. The word אפותיקי is a composite of 3 words that mean: "Hereby you are established." 05:20 - The main source of wealth is land/real estate. ***08:20 - Even if a person sells his land/real estate, his soul is still connected to it. Proof from laws of Yuval . 09:30 - וְהָאָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִצְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי־לִ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ - "The land shall not be sold permanently, for the land belongs to Me..." ( Vayikra 25:23, Behar ). It is impossible to make a permanent sale of land in Eretz Yisrael . 17:00 - Q&R about how land ownership is transferred in Eretz Yisrael . 18:00 - Metaltelin - Moveable property are not as spiritually connected to the owner as land is. The sale of a moveable object is permanent. 25:00 - Hekdesh and chumetz not sold for Pesach. 28:00 - A korbon - sacrifice - brought to the Beis HaMikdash - is bound up with the soul of the one who offers it. "From the animal you will bring your sacrifice" (Vayikra 1:2, Vayikra). 31:00 - Semikha - placing one's hands on the korbon to connect one's soul with the life of the korbon. 31:30 - בְּיָֽדְךָ֘ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י - "In Your hand I entrust my spirit..." ( Tehillim 31:6). *32:20 - There are five parts of a Jewish soul: Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama, Chaya, Yechida. Ruach is in the hands. 35:40 - A freed/sold slave is compared to land and the concept of apoteki applies to the freed/sold slave. A slave in the ownership of a Jew is obligated 37:30 - "Isha Karka Olam" - Esther HaMalka ( Sanhedrin ). HaShem protected Esther by providing Achashverosh with a female sheid - demon substitute. 44:00 - Q&R about the connection between a Jewish woman and a slave. 45:45 - Q&R about chometz that was not sold before Pesach .

lessons.bodyText: Healthy Parenting - Bringing a Child to the Kever of Rebbe Nachman Before the Age of 7 - We Can Speak to the Tzaddik's Neshama But We Pray Only to HaShem - Parshas Vayechi - Vidui in the Presence of a Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - The Breslov custom of bringing a child to the Tziyun of Rebbe Nachman before the age of 7. . 10:00 - When visiting the graves of relatives in a cemetery, Rebbe Nachman advises taking out a coin or currency bill of tzedakah and quietly announced (a whisper is sufficient) that the money will be given as tzedakah on behalf of any neshama who will call the neshama being summed. (The relative's full Hebrew name is said.) However, when a tzaddik passes away, he's always present. It's as if he's only in the next room. He can hear us even without that procedure, and always ready to ask HaShem to help us. 13:00 - Q&R about how a kohen can visit a Beis Kevuros . ***15:00 - When visiting the gravesite of Rebbe Nachman, we tell him what's going on, but we don't pray to him. We address our tefilah to HaShem , to help us in the merit of the tzaddik . Or we ask the tzaddik to pray on our behalf. 20:00 - Neshamos of those who pass away are able to pray on our behalf. 22:00 - Munkatcher Rebbe - Chapter 68. It's good to visit the kever of a tzaddik and ask him to intercede on our behalf. This is also brought in Taanis . 24:00 - The custom of writing a kvitel and placing it by a gravesite. 30:00 - The souls of all the tzaddikim are present at the Kosel . 31:00 - Q&R about writing a kvitel . The Breslov custom is that it's preferable to speak. Or, if a person can't travel, to write a kvitel and ask someone to say it at the kever . *32:00 - Sichos HaRan 209 . All of Rebbe Nachman's conversations and teachings were meant not only for his students, but for future generations. 33:00 - Parshas VaYechi - Ephraim and Menashe as Yaakov Avinu's own children. When a student is close with his rebbe , the blessings of the rebbe extend to the children and students of that student. 34:00 - Vidui in the presence of a tzaddik . 36:00 - Giving tzedakah to the tzaddik includes publishing his writings. 37:00 - The kever of Moshe Rabbeinu is mul Baal Peor . Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 . 40:00 - Procedure of bringing a young child to the kever of Rebbe Nachman. The importance of preparing a nice gift for him as a reward for saying as much of Tikkun HaKlali as he is able. 44:00 - Aliya is preceded by yerida . Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat, Hilkhos Matana 5:21 . 46:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 215 - the main work of a tzaddik is to bring people who are distant from HaShem closer to Him. 48:00 - Q&R about Tikkun Chatzos .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 3 - Parshas Bo - Torah With Derech Eretz - Three Types of Sekhel - The Torah Is Threefold - Wealth Should Be Apportioned In Thirds - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 00:00 - Review of yesterday's shiur . Three types of sekhel .
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 3 - Parshas Bo - Torah With Derech Eretz - Three Types of Sekhel - The Torah Is Threefold - Wealth Should Be Apportioned In Thirds - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 00:00 - Review of yesterday's shiur . Three types of sekhel . 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Torah with doing something for a livelihood. 04:00 - At each new spiritual level, a person will be challenged by the klipos of that level. Klipos are manifest in dimyonos - illusions - and midos raos - bad character traits. These negative forces are subdued through giving charity. 05:00 - To succeed in conducting business in holiness, a person needs to have the intention of giving maaser for tzedakah for deserving, worthy recipients. 07:00 - Two people cannot stand at the same level. When a person wants to reach a higher level he must defeat the negative forces of that level. So a Jew who wants to achieve new levels in Torah must also be involved in business. His business dealings activate the light in silver and gold that breaks the husk ( klipah ) that precedes the fruit (Torah - sekhel dekedusha ). 09:00 - NOTE: practical application of the above principles. "Going out to work" means also learning Torah 3-4 hours a day. 11:00 - Sekhel dekedusha is the opposite of medameh - illusion. To defeat the medameh , a person needs to be doing maaseh umatan bekedusha . This combination of effort results in sin being "forgotten" by the person. 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why Hashem waited between creating the world and redeeming Am Yisrael from Mitzrayim . The word Pharaoh corresponds with tafriyu - bateyl - interfering with work. Reference to Likutey Moharan 64 . 14:00 - Parshas Bo. דַּבֶּר־נָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיִשְׁאֲל֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ | מֵאֵ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ וְאִשָּׁה֙ מֵאֵ֣ת רְעוּתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־כֶ֖סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָֽב - "Please, speak into the ears of the people, and let them borrow, each man from his friend and each woman from her friend, silver vessels and golden vessels" ( Shemos 11:2, Bo ). 17:30 - Leaving Mitzrayim was an example of breaking the medameh and meriting sekhel dekedusha - receiving the Torah. This is why the wealth of Egypt had to be in the hands of Bnei Yisrael , to activate the light in that wealth. 19:40 - Three types of sekhel: Sekhel beKoach, Sekhel bePoel, Sekhel haNikneh . 20:00 - The Torah is a composite of he Torah is 3-fold ( Shabbos 88). The three types of Sekhel correspond to Chokhmah , Binah , and Daas . ***21:00 - Definition of Chokhmah is Sekhel beKoach , Binah is Sekhel bePoel , and Daas is Sekhel haNikneh . 24:00 - The result of these three types of Sekhel is speech. ***26:00 - The three types of sekhel also correspond to Chumash, Mishna, Gemara. 29:00 - A person wants to give a yerusha of sekhel hanikneh to his children. 33:00 - Avraham Avinu sitting outside his tent in the heat of the day. 34:00 - Q&R about what sekhel hanikneh is manifest in his yerusha for his children. ***37:00 - One's money should be divided into three portions: a third should be liquid assets, a third invested in business, and a third invested in real estate/savings. These portions correspond to the three types of sekhel . *39:00 - Liquid assets correspond to Sekhel beKoach . *40:00 - Metaltelin correspond to Sekhel bePoel . *41:00 - Karka - real estate - corresponds to Sekhel haNikneh . 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Apoteki does not apply to metalelin . Debt is called servitude. 50:00 - Cash requires constant supervision. וְנָֽתַתָּ֖ה בַּכָּ֑סֶף וְצַרְתָּ֤ הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּיָ֣דְךָ֔ - "Then you shall turn it into money, and bind up the money in your hand..." ( Devarim 14:25, ReEh ). 56:00 - Q&R's about the application of the three types of sekhel . *58:30 - NOTE about Rabbi Rosenfeld zal sending the utility companies money in advance so he never owed a utility company anything. 59:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Parshas Ki Sisa - Prayer Is an Aspect of Ruach HaKodesh - Connecting One's Tefilah to the Tzaddik - Hashem Is the Great Lender - The Tzaddik Takes His Students to His Heart - How Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal Prayed for Others - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . ***03:00 - How Tefilah from a siddur can become a form of Ruach HaKodesh . We need Hashem's help to be able to have kavana for every word of tefilah we say. 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 1b. Paying back our loan from Hashem for our life is done through connecting his tefilos with the tzaddik with all of the focus and energy that he borrowed from "the Great Lender" - Hashem . ***09:00 - Connecting one's tefilah to the tzaddik . Analogy of baking a cake. Exactly how this is done on a practical level. Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 . ***13:30 - Parshas Ki Sisa. The tzaddik's ability to pray depends on Am Yisrael . לֶךְ־רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ - "...'Go, descend, for your people have acted corruptly'..." (Shemos 32:7, Ki Sisa ). The only reason Moshe Rabbeinu was given greatness was for the sake of Am Yisrael . The minute Am Yisrael descends, the Tzaddik descends ( Brochos 32). *15:40 - Q&R - "All of the hosts of heaven receive from Hashem." Roshei teivos "U'tzeveah hashemayim lecha mistachaveh... spell "maleveh" . 17:30 - The cycle of Hashem lending to the world is forever. This process is a wheel - galgal . Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 19:00 - When Am Yisrael gives a korbon, Hashem becomes the "receiver" - so to speak. ***20:00 Q&R about the tzaddik . Rebbe Nachman describes the three types of people who come to him. 1) those who want physical gain, 2) those who want spiritual gain, 3) those who want to be embedded deeply in the tzaddik's heart. ***22:00 - Biographical note about Reb Michel Dorfman zal - how he would take to heart, deeply, the people who asked him to pray for him. 26:00 - NOTE - Why the kever of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal is special for Breslov. Analogy of a doctor who "has my file." 28:00 - NOTE - Biographical note Rabbi Avrohom Sternhartz zal telling his student, Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : Your students I will consider as my students." 28:30 - Back into the text: astronomical cycles are an aspect of galgal . 31:00 - NOTE about Reb Noson of Nemirov zal - his wife, at first, had miscarriages. Then Rebbe Nachman told Reb Noson zal to bring him something. Reb Noson brought the Rebbe 6 chairs and subsequently had 6 children. When a person gives their tefilah to the tzaddik , the tzaddik can pray even better, and returns the blessing to the one who gave to him. The more we give, the more we receive. 33:30 - All the greatness and blessing will some day come to Am Yisrael , when Moshiach is revealed. When tefilah hits a certain peak, that becomes the light of Moshiach . 34:30 - Q&R about how it presently seems like wealth is originating outside of Israel. 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. לוֶֹ֣ה רָ֖שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן - "A wicked man borrows and does not pay, but the Righteous one is gracious and gives" Tehillim 37:21. 42:00 - “Study is not the primary thing, but action ” (Pirkei Avos 1:17). What action? Tefilah and mitzvos . 43:00 - The word "shefa" שפע - are the roshei teivos of Sadeh, Pegiya, Amidah - the three forms of prayer, corresponding to the 3 Avos: Maariv, Mincha, Shacharis . 45:00 - Shimshon's riddle - "from the one who consumes emanates sweetness". The tzaddik is called the ochel - all Shefa comes to the world through the tzaddik . For example: Yosef HaTzaddik was put in charge of shefa . 47:40 - PARAGRAPH 3. 50:00 - Q&R about the meaning of the word שפע and how the letters relate to the 3 Avos and the 3 main forms of prayer: (Rav Avreimel who wrote the Sefer Oneg Shabbos ). ***52:30 - Closing blessings with strong encouragement for kavana in Tefilah .

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Parshas Bereishis - Dvar Hashem Brings Life - Parnassah Is Related to the Earth - Siach HaSadeh - Life-Energy in Plants - Song of the Earth - Prayer Expresses Yirah - Respect for Hashem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . ***00:00 - Review of the beginning of this halakha . 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Tefila is called avoda and the main 3 sins that weaken tefilah are also called avoda . 08:00 - וְעֶ֥בֶד ל֜וֶֹ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה - "...and a borrower is a slave to a lender" ( Mishlei 22:7). Hashem is lending life-energy to us. Life is a loan and it has to be repaid. ***12:00 - Siach HaSadeh - The life-energy Hashem sends down to the earth from the highest levels come down to the earth and are returned to Hashem through our tefilos . The energy in the plants and animal is included in the prayers of man. "Vayetzeh Yitzchak lesuach besadeh" - roshei teivos "yavul . 14:00 - Parshas Bereishis . בְּזֵעַ֤ת אַפֶּ֨יךָ֙ תֹּ֣אכַל לֶ֔חֶם - "By the sweat of your brow you will bread..." ( Bereishis 3:19, Bereishis ). 18:00 - A person who eats or drinks without making a blessing is stealing. 20:00 - וְהָיָ֣ה | בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶֽעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַֽעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ - "And on that day I will answer it, Hashem says; I will answer the heavens, and they shall answer the earth" - וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּֽעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַֽעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־יִזְרְעֶֽאל - "And the earth shall answer the corn and the wine and the oil, and they shall answer Jezreel" ( Hoshea 2:23-24). 27:00 - Targum Yonasan on the above possukim from Hoshea . The song of the earth is tefilah . 29:30 - Q&R - Why does the lowly prayer of man affect creation? The power of free will. "A malach is a robot." *32:00 - Song of the earth. Prayer is called siach . All the produce of the earth returns its life-energy to Hashem through the prayers of man. ***34:00 - אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֜הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל - "...a woman who fears Hashem is to be praised" ( Mishlei 31:3). Prayer expresses yirah - respect for Hashem . Sometimes a person finds it difficult to pray and would rather study Torah, because studying Torah brings admiration and praise from others, while sincerity in prayer is only appreciated by Hashem . 29:00 - Parshas Bereishis - Cain and Hevel . 41:00 - Dvar Hashem - Hashem's life-energy - is repaid through tefilah . ***44:00 - Q&R about emunah - when a Jew has a good thought, Hashem rewards it. A person can be happy even when things are not going well as long as he remembers that the events of his life are being closely supervised by Hashem . 46:00 - Closing blessings. Comments about the fast of the 10th of Teves .

lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal - History of the Tzion in Uman - Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal - Biography - Speaker: Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal . (Recorded in Jerusalem, ca. 1999.) I've been in Eretz Yisrael almost 30 years. The first thing I want to speak about is how I become a Breslover chossid at age 14-15. He said he's a Breslover chassid... I attended an underground (hidden) "Polish" yeshiva in Kiev. The Rosh Yeshiva was a Boyaner chossid. Hishtapkhus HaNefesh... I came to Uman, to the Breslover klois ... When I came to the tziyun , I saw for the first time in my life... I returned from the tziyun and received a letter from my father I was 16 years and 7 months old when I married Rav Avrohom zal's granddaughter... At first we lived in Uman... The Rebbe's seforim: Sipurei Maasiyos, Likutey Moharan, Likutey Halakhos... Now I want to speak about another thing... When the Rebbe's neshoma was going to be sent to the world, there was one who objected... Story of the Rabbi's Only Son ( Sipurey Maasios ). 50 years... Breslov chassidim were accused of undermining communism... They asked him in Ukrainian... Where is our ammunition? He put his tzitzis on the table and said, "Here's our ammunition..." Tzitzis ... Traveling to Siberia in a train car for animals, not for people... There was a person who worked in the pharmacy... (clinic?) An open, lively person... Standing in cold water... they amputated his feet... Breslov and Chabad were the most hated by the communists... It took 38 years... My thoughts were always in Eretz Yisrael but my feet were there... 62 years I was there. I lived in Melakhavka, near Moscow. Kiev. Broken heart... All the neshomos there... Kiev... Only 3 or at most 4 people could ride in a cab... 8 day vacation from work... There were no buses, only a taxi... I sat in front with the driver and we drove to the police Passport Red hats I told him "You sleep." He slept. 30 or 35 kilometers... I asked the driver... He saw an empty place near me, he hitched a ride... And Baruch Hashem I stayed alive... we traveled on... That Reb Zanvil built... In front of the window was plain earth, with stands... there was no marker. No one else would have known that the tzioun is there, but we knew the tzion was there. Reb Gedaliah - 5 kapitlach Tehillim. We traveled a different way back to avoid the police. He went back to his hotel... American items... The Ebishter helped - I wasn't questioned - and came home. Gedaliah Fleer visited us and told Zvi Aryeh the whole story. Zvi Aryeh ... 12 to 14 people - Leibel Berger. The owner of the house next to the Tziyun started screaming "there's no grave here!" Gedaliah called Zvi Aryeh . Americans could travel but Israeli citizens had to travel with false passports... Tape is turned over to the other side. "This is the story..." - "There's a lot to tell..." Story of the Berger and the Oni ( Sipurey Maasios ). He did a wild think - mamash a crazy thing Holy things can result from wild things. Mesiras nefesh ... I was very happy... Ech farmug epes a zach - that I was allowed to do such a thing? ...that there was a way. Only with help from Above... Why was I the one? Living there is exactly as if one isn't alive. The story of the Berger and the Oni and the story of the Rabbi's Only Son gave me strength... This was not a simple thing. It took mesiras nefesh to accomplish... Exactly what the Rebbe described in the story is what happened with me... I had been in Siberia. I knew who these people are. I did it with the greatest love, to do something for the Rebbe... People come to Uman from 28 different countries... People also come by private car with no permit, so maybe it's 30 or more countries... These words should bring hischadshus - renewal... The Baal Davar opposed every step... I have something else to relate. Each thing is more beautiful than the next... Today is Tuesday. Tomorrow is Wednesday. Maybe Thursday - wondrous things... There are factions... but I don't belong to any group. I'm from the previous generation. Oy - prastik, prastik, prastik! (Simplicity, simplicity, simplicity!) Holy factions... Simplicity - prastik prastik prastik is the true Kita - faction... Closing blessing. A person can turn the Gehinnam of this world into a Gan Eden if he lives according to the Rebbe's advice. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Recorded ca. 1989, in Jerusalem.) ***The exact words of Rav Moshe Feinstein zal were:איר זאלט אוספירן דער רצון פון צדיק - "You should do what the Tzaddik wants." *After hours of heartfelt tefi
lessons.bodyText: Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal - Biography - History of Uman - Part 2 - Speaker: Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal . (Yiddish. Recorded ca. 1989, in Jerusalem.) ***The exact words of Rav Moshe Feinstein zal were:איר זאלט אוספירן דער רצון פון צדיק - "You should do what the Tzaddik wants." *After hours of heartfelt tefilos throughout the night, Reb Michel decides to contact Rav Aryeh Kaplan zal . Rav Aryeh Kaplan writes a letter describing Rebbe Nachman as cultural figure studied in universities all over the world. He shows Reb Michel and Rav Nasan the pages of material published in the Encyclopedia Judaica about Rebbe Nachman. Reb Michel and Rav Nasan bring the letter stating their appeal to Rabbi Pinchas Teitz. Robert Lipshutz presents the letter to President Carter. The Soviet government makes the concession and the mission is accomplished B"H: "In Kremlin it's written that in Uman there is a gravesite of a person who is renown in all the world, and that gravesite should never be disturbed." *From the entire SALT conference the only thing that resulted was the protection of Rebbe Nachman's tziyun . Rivka Imeinu. Cassette is turned. There are many stories here. Every step... A few days later Carter fired a number of his advisors, and one of them was Robert Lipshutz. There were 250 people in Uman. *Rav Shimon Shapiro got out of his wheelchair and joined the dance that lasted 18 minutes. The year 250 people traveled to Uman for Rosh Hashanah was the year communism collapsed in Russia. Why? * Moshe Rabbeinu protects Am Yisrael with the location of his gravesite. Similarly, the gravesite of Rebbe Nachman protects Am Yisrael . All sorts of people came to Uman for Rosh Hashanah, from 28 countries all over the world. Closing blessings. One thing especially to remember: People go traveling to see beautiful scenery, but traveling to the Rebbe is worth much more - it transforms a person's life and brings light to the eyes. No other tzaddik ... *Rav Zonnenfeld zal said about the mikveh : "If a goy learns Torah and keeps all the mitzvos , he's still a goy . But if he goes to the mikveh , he can become a Jew. If that's what mikveh does for a goy , imagine what mikveh does for a Jew!" Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . *The body is a precious vessel. Chizuk for tefilah and hisbodedus . Tzaddik haDor... The shtibel of Reb Zanvil. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Mordekhai was the Tzaddik Emes of his generation. 12:40 - יְהֹוָ֗ה אָ֖הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֜מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ - "Hashem, I love the dwelling, Your house, and the place where Your glory resides" ( Tehillim 26:8). 23:30 - PARAGRAPH 10. ***28:00 - Every tzaddik is a throne for Hashem . ***30:00 - Q&R - Reason for Uman Rosh Hashanah. 36:30 - Q&R - The power of humility. The tzaddik takes on suffering to lift it from Am Yisrael . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. 46:15 - PARAGRAPH 12. Why was the Purim scaffold 50 amos high? ***51:15 - It is forbidden to judge a person to the scale of merit if he is trying to kill you. ***54:50 - Mordekhai had no pity on Haman or his family. ***58:00 - The tzaddik and the shofar on Rosh Hashanah.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo - A Tzaddik Is a Chariot of Hashem - Parshas Shemos - Kibbutz Galius - Ingathering of Exiles - Kisey HaKavod Is the Source of All Souls - Why a Tzaddik Has Dominion Over Angels - Kedoshim Asher BeAretz - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. אָֽמְר֣וּ בְ֖לִבָּם נִינָ֣ם יָ֑חַד שָֽׂרְפ֖וּ כָל־מֽוֹעֲדֵי־אֵ֣ל בָּאָֽרֶץ - "They said in their heart, their rulers together; they burned all the meeting places of Hashem in the Land" ( Tehillim 74:8). 03:26 - יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֜מְ֗ךָ בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ - "Hashem, our Master, how mighty is Your Name in all the earth!" ( Tehillim 8:10). *05:46 - The holiness of Eretz Yisrael makes it easier for the Jewish soul to connecting with Hashem . This is why enemies of Am Yisrael focus on separating us from Eretz HaKodesh . 08:36 - A tzaddik is a chariot of Hashem . *09:13 - NOTE on the first possuk in Parshas Shemos - the word מצרימה is begematria שכינה. 12:30 - Kibbutz Galius - Ingathering of the Exiles. 13:30 - A tzaddik is able to judge all Jews favorably. 14:30 - All souls are rooted in the Kisey HaKavod , which is above the concept of Makom - place. 17:45 - PARAGRAPH 14. Why tzaddikim are above the spiritual level of angels. ***27:00 - Tzaddikim yirshu Aretz . Because Tzaddikim judge all Jews favorably, they are able to bring merit to Am Yisrael on Rosh Hashanah. 28:30 - לִקְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה - "The holy ones who are in the earth..." ( Tehillim 16:3). צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ - "The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell forever in it" ( Tehillim 37:29). 31:00 - Q&R about how tzaddikim , through free will, make it possible for Hashem's desire to establish residence in the physical world. This is something angels can't do, so the tzaddikim are above the spiritual level of angels. 36:30 - Connecting with a tzaddik helps a person succeed in the physical world. 37:00 - Q&R about how to maintain faith through the challenges of physical life. In the end, Am Yisrael will succeed. 40:00 - NOTE: during Shacharis , we progress upward through the Four Worlds. The three steps backward for Shemoneh Esrei are steps away from the physical world, the three steps forward a person enters the Olam HaAtzilus . 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo. *51:00 - A student succeeds as a shaliach for his teacher only if he is true messenger - that is, the shaliach has the authorization of his teacher. The Tzaddik Emes authorizes his shalichim . 55:00 - Regarding every mitzvah a Jew does, and especially regarding tefilah , merit is required in order for his actions or words to achieve what it needs to achieve in all worlds, and especially in the soul of the Jew performing the mitzvah, or saying the prayer. There are powers opposing every mitzvah and every tefilah . The jealously of angels can block a person's deeds or prayers from being completely successful. 58:00 - The solution for spiritual opposition is attaching one's tefilah to the Tzaddik Emes . ***60:00 - If a person attaches himself to unauthorized shaliach - for example a "self appointed rabbi" - the person himself had responsibility for the failure of his mitzvos or tefilos to achieve its potential. 61:0 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Parshas Shelach - Sinai - Humility Enables Receiving the Torah - Generation to Generation - Moshe Rabbeinu Was Able to Judge Am Yisrael Favorably - Binyan Yerushalayim - Meraglim - Nefilim - Fallen Angels - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - Yahrzeit dedications: Beila Gittel bas R' Shmuel Moshe a"h , wife of R' Moshe Burstein zal ; the Baba Sali: Rabbi Yisrael Ben Mas'ud Abuhatzeira zal ; and Rabbi Avraham b'R Alexander HaKohen Kalisker zal . 02:40 - PARAGRAPH 19. Moshe Rabbeinu received the Torah from Sinai. 04:32 - "Sinai" represents true humility. It's impossible to receive the Torah without ענוה אמתית. The more a person nullifies himself, the greater his ability to receive and transmit the Torah. A person can nullify himself the point that he is above the concept of space. *07:00 - A person who believes "I'm a somebody" is spiritually limited because he is within the bounds of taking up space. 08:00 - A person who is able to rise above the concept of space is able to judge others favorably - to their merit. 09:30 - Do not judge another until you can stand in their place ( Avos ). 10:30 - The humility of Moshe Rabbeinu . ***17:29 - Passing the Torah on to future generations is the obligation of every Jew. Every Jew is responsible to make the world a civilized place. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7 . ***19:14 - The ultimate goal of all the characters traits is humility. This is an aspect of Binyan Yerushalayim - Yirah Shaleym . The main place of yirah is in the heart, which is visible only to Hashem . 22:31 - עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֖נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה - "In the wake of humility comes fear of Hashem..." ( Mishlei 22:4). 23:20 - Humility empowers tefilah ( Sotah and Likutey Moharan 14 ). 23:56 - Q&R - The first steps toward achieving humility: 1) Learning Torah, 2) praying for humility, 3) attaching oneself to tzaddikim . 25:51 - PARAGRAPH 20. Moshe Rabbeinu received the Torah from Sinai. The quality of humility gave Moshe Rabbeinu the ability to receive the Torah, and the ability to pass the Torah on to Yehoshua . Why the letter Yod was added to Yehoshua's name. 30:54 - NOTE: The sum of squaring the gematria of the letters of Hashem's name Y - K - V - K equals the gematria of the word מקום - makom - place. *34:14 - Parshas Shelach. The mistake of the meraglim - spies made them vulnerable to the Nefilim - offspring of the angels who were thrown down to earth because they spoke against the creation of man. Those angels continue working against man, to this day. וַנְּהִ֤י בְעֵינֵ֨ינוּ֙ כַּֽחֲגָבִ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן הָיִ֖ינוּ בְּעֵֽינֵיהֶֽם - "In our eyes, we seemed like grasshoppers, and so we were in their eyes" ( Bamidbar 13:33, Shelach ). *38:40 - Yehoshua was protected through his special connection with Moshe Rabbeinu . The kiyum - establishment - of Torah for all generations was entirely in the merit of Moshe Rabbeinu's humility. 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Zekeynim - elders - nevuah - prophecy - Shalosh Ragolim - the three holidays. 43:46 - Closing blessings.

Example: visiting the kever of Nasan HaNavi . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Reb Michel Dorfman zal . Going to Kever Nasan HaNavi to complete things. 19:40 - PARAGRAPH 23. HILKHOS OREYV . One of the most powerful ways to remove debt is improving tefilah . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 25. 46:00 - All the souls of the generation are rooted in the Tzaddik Emes and receive blessing through his merit. ***47:00 - NOTE: when a father lends to a son, if the son defaults, the father covers the debt. Likewise the Tzaddik is constantly giving and giving, covering the spiritual debts of the generation.

lessons.title: 2025-02-04 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Para. 25b-28 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Mikeitz - Parshas Vayeishev
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Mikeitz - Parshas Vayeishev - Hashem Collects Debts to Him Both in This World and the Next - Yehudah - Binyamin - Moshiach - Tamar - Guarantor - The Great Lender - Kinyan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Mikeitz - Parshas Vayeishev - Hashem Collects Debts to Him Both in This World and the Next - Yehudah - Binyamin - Moshiach - Tamar - Guarantor - The Great Lender - Kinyan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 25b. The difference between a mortal king who lends wealth, and Hashem when He lends wealth. 04:30 - מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה - "...who is a teacher like Him? " ( Iyov 36:22). 05:00 - Hashem gives advance notice of His punishments because He knows the recipient can't find a way to escape, even if forewarned. 07:30 - כָּל־ הַ֖יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה - "All day long he is gracious and lends..." ( Tehillim 37:26). The Tzaddik keeps giving a faithful person unlimited loans so the person can eventually "get on their feet". 00:00 - Parshas Mikeitz. אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֶֽעֶרְבֶ֔נּוּ - "I will be guarantor for him..." ( Bereishis 43:9, Mikeitz ). Moshiach comes from shevet Yehudah and is the ultimate guarantor for Am Yisrael . ***17:00 - NOTE - Chiddush heard from Rabbi Kalman Rosen, the son of Rav Eliya Chaim Rosen zal . Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 . Tikkun haBris is achieved through mikveh and Tikkun HaKlali . מִכְתָּ֣ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֜֗ל - the first letters of Michtam L'Dovid spell אשלם - "I will pay". The first letters of the next three words - כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ - spell חבך - "your debt". The last word of the perek is Netzach - which is begematria "Nachman". ***22:00 - Q&R - "Isn't it dangerous to say the Tzaddik is the great lender?" Response: Yes, it's dangerous. But it's even more dangerous to leave the concept of Tzaddik out of Yiddishkeit . 24:30 - PARAGRAPH 26. Parshas Vayeishev. וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָעֵֽרָבוֹן֘ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן־לָךְ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ֙ וּפְתִילֶ֔ךָ וּמַטְּךָ֖ - "So he said, 'What is the pledge that I should give you?' And she said, 'Your signet, your cloak, and the staff...'" ( Bereishis 38:18, Vayeishev ). Yehudah, Tamar, Er, Onan, . Tamar requested Yehudah's seal, garment, and staff as guarantee. From this union Moshiach originated, and he is the ultimate guarantor for Am Yisrael . 29:00 - Tikkun HaBris and Tefillin are both called a "seal". Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 35:20 - PARAGRAPH 27. At the Source of Creation, all is One. Responsibilities of a guarantor. 42:40 - PARAGRAPH 28. A kinyan is usually established by means of a garment. When a person makes a kinyan , he locks himself into an obligation. 45:50 - שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־יַֽעֲשׂ֚וּ עַוְלָה֙ - "The remnant of Israel shall neither commit injustice nor speak lies..." ( Tzefania 3:13). 47:00 - The source of all Jewish souls is the Kisey HaKavod ( Tikkunei Zohar, Hakdama 17).
