Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 29. Kavana in tefilah prevents an/or eliminates debt. 07:00 - Serving Hashem with the throat ( Tehillim 149:6). ***08:00 - Living is breathing. 12:00 - Choking is an aspect of praying without kavana . 13:00 - Achitophel . 14:40 - PARAGRAPH 30. 18:30 - PARAGRAPH 31. Parshas BaMidbar is always read the Shabbos before Shavuos . 21:00 - אֵ֥ם כָּל־חָֽי - "...mother of all life" ( Bereishis 3:20, Bereishis ). נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ - "...the soul of a living thing is its name" ( Bereishis 2:19, Bereishis ). 23:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 59 . ***27:00 - Parshas MaMidbar - inner meaning of the Aron HaKodesh being surrounding by Am Yisrael as they traveled. 31:00 - Q&R - Practical methods for ruling over the angels? 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 32. 36:20 - עֹֽמְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֜שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם - "Our feet were standing within your gates, O Jerusalem" ( Tehillim 122:2). 39:00 - כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֖זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִרְחִ֥יק מִ֜מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ - "As the distance of east from west, He distanced our transgressions from us" ( Tehillim 103:12). 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 33. Kisey HaKavod - Throne of Hashem . 48:00 - הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּתוֹ֙ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ מִגִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "Behold the litter of Solomon; sixty mighty men are around it, of the mighty men of Israel" ( Shir HaShirim 3:7). ***49:00 - "Every Jew must be a great warrior in the battle against the jealousy of the angels." 50:00 - Q&R about the 20th of Sivan .

lessons.title: 2025-02-06 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Para. 34-36 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Chukas
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Chukas - Makom - The Torah Is a Derech - The Journeys and Paths of Bnei Yisrael Elevate the Places Traveled to Above the Concept of Physical Space - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Chukas - Makom - The Torah Is a Derech - The Journeys and Paths of Bnei Yisrael Elevate the Places Traveled to Above the Concept of Physical Space - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 34. The journeys of the Bnei Yisrael in the wilderness, and the journeys of every Jew to the present day, is to spiritually elevate every place he dwells or passes through. With every step he takes he brings a place to the concept of "above place". 05:00 - Tehillim : "every footstep a person takes is prepared by Hashem, and every path...." *08:00 - The Torah is called a path. 3 possukim . The entire world is called "derech" - a path. 15:00? - לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל - "...do not turn to the right or to the left" ( Devarim 5:29, VaEschanan ). 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 35. 25:00 - Nimtza . 30:00 - כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֖זְרָח מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִרְחִ֥יק מִ֜מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ - "As the distance of east from west, He distanced our transgressions from us" ( Tehillim 103:12). 35:00 - Bereishis 24:63. Yavul - produce - Yitzchak siach besadeh . ***45:00 - PARAGRAPH 36. Yerushalayim HaBenuya. Achieving the spiritual level of "above makom " enables a person to judge others favorably based on the place any individual is standing. 48:00 - Dovid HaMelech represents Moshiach. Hashem's ultimate judgement is for merit. The tzaddik rises to the level of attachment to the Kisey HaKavod , the Source of all souls. ***50:00 - Q&R about how to picture that every step we take is an aspect of עֹֽמְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֜שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָֽם - "Our feet were standing within your gates, Yerushalayim" ( Tehillim 122:2). 52:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-02-07 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Para. 37-39 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Shelach - Parshas VaYishlach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Shelach - Parshas VaYishlach - Kedushas Eretz Yisrael Activates Hashem's Forgiveness - Above Makom - Meraglim - Nephilim - Tehom Under Beis HaMikdash - Libation Pipes - Dovid Hamelech Excavated to the Depths - Achitophel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviy
lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Shelach - Parshas VaYishlach - Kedushas Eretz Yisrael Activates Hashem's Forgiveness - Above Makom - Meraglim - Nephilim - Tehom Under Beis HaMikdash - Libation Pipes - Dovid Hamelech Excavated to the Depths - Achitophel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . ***00:00 - PARAGRAPH 37. Parshas Shelach . 05:50 - The meraglim were victims of the jealousy of the nephilim - the fallen angels. Even today, the nephilim continue to be envious of man and oppose man's spiritual progress. 07:30 - "We were as grasshoppers in their eyes" 08:00 - The meraglim fell into desire to become leaders, and this arrogance made them vulnerable to the jealousy of the angels. 10:00 - Yehoshua was saved from arrogance because he had faith in Moshe Rabbeinu . Caleb's merit was that he prayed at Maaras HaMachpeleh - burial site of the Avos and Imahos in Chevron. 13:00 - Tzaddikim have the ability to elevate Am Yisrael to a spiritual level above makom - above the concept of place. 17:00 - The worst exile is spiritual exile. ***The libations in Beis HaMikdash went into the depths of the earth during the offerings and the music of the Leviim . 19:15 - Yonah . 20:40 - PARAGRAPH 38. Dovid HaMelech searched for the place of the Beis HaMikdash and made all the preparations for its future construction. He excavated for the pipes that would sink into the depths of the earth. 22:00 - Tehillim 30 "Hashem lifted me up from the shaol" (and other possukim ). "From the depths." 23:00 - " Dovid HaMelech is Moshiach ." 24:30 - Dovid HaMelech excavated for the pipes under the Beis HaMikdash and the waters of the tehom rose to a dangerous level, threatening to destroy the world. Dovid HaMelech cried, "Whoever doesn't reveal the secret of how to lower the waters will die". Achitophel then revealed the secret, but because he initially withheld the information, he died by strangulation. 28:00 - Hashem's light must reach the darkest, lowest extremes of restriction. Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 . 30:00 - Achitophel's mistake was that he refused to believe that Hashem's power reaches the depths and that the power of teshuvah is limited. Medrash Tehillim on the possuk , Mah tishallel - "Why is this evil person priding himself on this evil?" 34:00 - Chesed Keyl col hayom. 37:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 47? The throat represents the two pipes reaching to the depths of the earth beneath the Beis HaMikdash . *38:00 - Yeshaya 30 - the Beis Hamikdash is called the throat of the world. *39:00 - Shir HaShirim - your throat. All the prayers of everyone in the world rise up, above the concept of space, are all rising via the Beis HaMikdash. ***40:00 - Parshas Shelach is immediately followed by the pouring of the libations in the Beis HaMikdash . Summary and conclusion for the inyan of the meraglim . "Eventually, even the lowest places will be elevated." 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 39. Shir HaShirim . "How beautiful are your footsteps" - refers to anyone who travels for the sake of a mitzvah , and especially to the journeys taken to visit one's rabbi. It's through traveling that every step they take, they're elevating the physicality of the place to "above the concept of place". 44:10 - To elevate and rescue souls from the depths takes extreme craftsmanship. ***45:30 - Parshas VaYishlach . Medrash Rabbah on VaYishlach - the libations of Yaakov Avinu in Beis El . 48:00 - Beis HaMikdash HaShlishi - the Third Beis Hamikdash - will be indestructible and never be destroyed ( Tanna Debai Eliyahu 31). It will be established permanently in the merit of Yaakov Avinu - because he is אמת. 50:30 - Q&R about the connection between Dovid HaMelech's ability to reach the depths to the point that the waters of creation started rising. Achitophel's mistake was despair. 53:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-02-09 - LH7 - CM1 - Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Para. 40-44a - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Korach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Korach - Kisey HaKavod - Knesses Yisrae l - Throne of Hashem - Achdus - Unity - Ketores - Tefilah Substitutes for Korbonos - Tehillim 133 - Plants - Reyach - Tu BeShevat - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - Parshas Korach - Kisey HaKavod - Knesses Yisrae l - Throne of Hashem - Achdus - Unity - Ketores - Tefilah Substitutes for Korbonos - Tehillim 133 - Plants - Reyach - Tu BeShevat - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . ***00:00 - PARAGRAPH 40. הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־טּ֖וֹב וּמַה־נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־יָֽחַד - "Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brothers also to dwell together" ( Tehillim 133:1). 04:00 - PARAGRAPH 41. Parshas Korach . 11:00 - The entire power of a person is achieved through attaching himself to all Jewish neshomos by means of attaching himself to the true tzaddikim of Klal Yisrael. Korach tried to disconnect the souls of Knesses Yisrael from the Tzaddik Emes, Moshe Rabbeinu . 12:00 - וַיִּקַּ֣ח קֹ֔רַח - "And Korach took..." ( Bamidbar 16:1, Korach ). The parsha begins with the words " And Korach took... - he removed himself from his connection with Moshe Rabbeinu . 17:30 - Ketores . Tefilah substitutes for the Korbonos . " Yitzchak went out to pray in the field." The spiritual essence of the plants is in their reyach - fragrance. Reference to Likutey Moharan 12 . 20:30 - מטר - Matar is roshei teyvos Maareh Taam Reyach . The highest level of tefilah and spiritual connection with Hashem is reyach , which is entirely spiritual. 22:00 - The Ketores rises up to Ain Sof - an infinitely high spiritual level. 23:30 - PARAGRAPH 42. Korach and his followers were swallowed alive into the earth. The punishment matched the crime. Burial after death enables the tzaddikim to achieve the ultimate level of spiritual refinement - l'maalah mei hamakom . The tzaddikim then enable the souls of Knesses Yisrael to achieve this refinement. But Korach caused a separation between makom and l'maalah mei hamakom . Therefore he was swallowed into the physicality of the earth while he was alive. This taught Am Yisrael how critical it is to have a secure connection with the Moshe Rabbeinu of the generation. 30:00 - The soul is connected with a person's name, even after death. 32:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 65 - the "Master of the Field." 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 43. The eventual tikkun of Korach will be through his descendant, Shmuel HaNavi and the song of the Leviim during the libations in the Beis HaMikdash . 36:20 - Korach's mistake was caused by his arrogance. He foresaw that Shmuel HaNavi would be his descendant, but was misled by his eyes. Therefore he is suffering for 2000 years until his eventual tikkun via Moshe Rabbeinu/Moshiach . 38:40 - Tzaddik C'Tamar Yifrach - sofei teivos Korach. The ultimate tikkun of Korach will be through the tzaddik, Moshe Rabbeinu . 40:00 - Q&R about the suffering of Korach . What conclusion should Korach have drawn from knowing that Shmuel HaNavi would be his descendant? Example of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal's lineage. 43:40 - NOTE: Rabbi Maimon brings the example of one of his Rebbeyim in Yeshivas Torah veDaas . Great talmidei chokhomim can come from simple parents. *47:00 - PARAGRAPH 44. Tehillim 133 - entire. כְּטַ֥ל חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֘ עַל־הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֚י שָׁ֨ם | צִוָּ֣ה יְ֖הֹוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֜יִּ֗ים עַד־הָֽעוֹלָֽם - "As the dew of Hermon which runs down on the mountains of Zion, for there the Lord commanded the blessing, life forever" (Tehillim 133:3). 50:00 - Ehven Shesiya - Foundation Stone. 51:00 - NOTE: Parshas Beshalach (read the day previous to this shiur ) ends with the attack of Amalek . Evil is defeated through Am Yisrael's unity. The word "Achim" is made from the roshei teivos of Aharon, Chur, Yehoshua, Moshe . The word "gam" usually indicates the Shekhina . גם יחד is begematria A - D - N - Y . Closing note the battle against Amalek throughout the generations. 54:00 - Closing blessings about the approaching holiday of Tu BeShevat .

lessons.bodyText: Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Hilkhos Oreyv - HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 1 - HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - The Goal and Purpose of Man Is To Do Mitzvos With Joy - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakoshos 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . *00:00 - PARAGRAPH 44b. The essence of a Torah-true life is not simply learning, but doing. לֹא הַמִּדְרָשׁ הוּא הָעִקָּר, אֶלָּא הַמַּעֲשֶׂה - "...Study is not the most important thing, but actions ..." ( Avos 1:17). 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 45. Shmuel HaNavi was a tikkun of Korach . 04:30 - Reference to Geviyas Chov MeyhaLakochos 5 - Para. 37 . *12:00 - PARAGRAPH 46. The names of gerim are as dear to Hashem as the wine libations in the Beis HaMikdash . ( Midrash Raba Vayikra, Parsha 1; Hoshea 14:8). 11:30 - HALAKHA 1. Parshas Shoftim. עַל־פִּ֣י שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל־פִּ֥י שְׁלשָֽׁה־עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר - "...By the mouth of two witnesses, or by the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be confirmed" ( Devarim 19:15, Shoftim ). 00:00 - HALAKHA 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . *19:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The goal and purpose of man is to do mitzvos with joy. 25:00 - Repayment of a loan. 26:50 - Parshas Bereishis. ( Bereishis 1:1, Bereishis ). 27:20 - ע֖וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה - "...Forever will it be built with kindness..." ( Tehillim 89:3). ***35:30 - Q&R - Every Jew is an aspect of Tzaddik. Tzidkus has many levels. 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. All mitzvos are an aspect of repaying a loan. 41:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. All mitzvos are an aspect of repaying a loan. The Great Lender is Hashem , and repayment of His infinite loans of life and blessing is accomplished through performing every mitzvah with joy. ***54:30 - Q&R - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal - Best time for saying the nusach of hiskashrus to the Tzaddik is immediately after wrapping in the Talis .

lessons.bodyText: Breslov Basics 41 - The Power of Kaddish - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded 1970-08-26.) Rabbi Yosei hears the wordless mourning of the Shekhina as the cooing of a dove in an abandoned ruin. Eliyahu HaNavi explains its meaning in a way that encourages and strengthens our tefilah today. Text: Berakhos 3a. Indexed MP3 and transcript of the entire shiur is HERE . TRANSCRIPT OF CLIP: The Gemara says that Rabbi Yosei once was walking along the road, an isolated road, and the time came for him to daven, apparently davening mincha. And he saw an uninhabited house there. He walked in. This was one of the homes that were destroyed from the חרבת of Yerushalayim. And he went inside there to daven. While there, Eliyahu HaNavi came, waited for him by the door ‘till he finished his tefilah. When he finished the tefilah, Eliyahu HaNavi greeted him. And he said to him, “Shalom aleicha rabi.” Yosei replied, “Shalom aleicha rabbi umori.” And then they went into further conversation. Eliyahu HaNavi asked Rabbi Yosei, "Why did you go into this churva - this house that's destroyed? Why didn't you daven outside, on the road?" Why? Because a churva is a place that's destroyed, a home that's destroyed, and there is the danger of sheidim there. The Gemara says that sheidim originally had the freedom of roaming the streets of cities, and every person's life was in danger. Then he said to Rabbi Yosei, "When you were in there you hear anything?” He said, “Yes I did. I heard a voice – a soft voice like the cooing of a dove”. Now the Shekhina is compared to a dove - canfei yona. And this voice said, “Woe is to the... how pitiful it is, what a pity it is on the children who were driven away from their home. Jews driven from their home, driven away from the table of their Father... the Beis HaMikdash, woe is to the fact that I have destroyed the Beis HaMikdash and driven my children out of Eretz Yisrael". This is the Shekhina bemoaning, רָחֵל מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנֶיהָ . Again, "Rachel" stands for the Shekhina. Eliyahu HaNavai said to R' Yosei, “It is true, this voice you heard. But know, too, that this is not the only time this voice says it. This voice comes every time that the Jews come to shul - daven. And they say יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא יִתְבָּרַךְ - every time the Jews say this, this voice comes from heaven and says, "How beautiful is the tefilah of the Jews who give praise to Hashem. What a pity it is that these Jews, these children, were driven away from their Father's home.” And the more times that Jews say יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא יִתְבָּרַךְ with kavana, the more they evoke the pity of Hashem from Heaven, the more they strengthen the chances that Moshiach could come. This כח of tefilah - "Yehei Shemei Rabba" - saying it especially with the hiskashrus to the Tzaddik Emes, surely realize the ביאות המשיח, binyan Beis HaMikdash, veGeula sheleyma, b'meheyra beyameinu, amein ve’amein.

lessons.description: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - The Purpose of Man Is To Perform Mitzvos beSimcha - A Tzaddik Gives - Dance - Hashem Is the Essence of Joy - Giving vs. Taking - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. 02:30 - PARAGRAPH 6. וְהָיָ֨ה אַדִּיר
lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - The Purpose of Man Is To Perform Mitzvos beSimcha - A Tzaddik Gives - Dance - Hashem Is the Essence of Joy - Giving vs. Taking - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. 02:30 - PARAGRAPH 6. וְהָיָ֨ה אַדִּיר֜וֹ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וּמֹֽשְׁלוֹ֙ מִקִּרְבּ֣וֹ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִקְרַבְתִּ֖יו וְנִגַּ֣שׁ אֵלָ֑י כִּי֩ מִ֨י הוּא־זֶ֜ה עָרַ֧ב אֶת־לִבּ֛וֹ לָגֶ֥שֶׁת אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה - "And their prince shall be from them, and their ruler shall emerge from their midst, and I will bring him near, and he shall approach Me, for who is it who pledged his heart to approach Me? says Hashem" ( Yirmiya 30:21). Performing mitzvos with joy connects a person with Hashem . 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. A tzaddik gives. The greatness of Moshe Rabbeinu . 12:00 - The word נביא is composed of the roshei teivos of יָבֹ֥א בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֜שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו - "...he will return with song, carrying his sheaves" ( Tehillim 126:6). 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Each person must realize that the entire world was created for him so that he has the opportunity to improve the world. 16:30 - The purpose of every Jew is to perform mitzvos with joy - this was the ultimate goal of Hashem when He created everything. 20:00 - Performing mitzvos with joy. Avoiding the "bread of shame". 22:30 - וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הִנֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ זֶ֛ה קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖וֹ וְיֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֚ה יְהֹוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישֽׁוּעָתֽוֹ - "And they shall say on that day, "Behold, this is our God: we hoped for Him that He would save us; this is the Lord for Whom we hoped; let us rejoice and be happy with His salvation" ( Yishaya 25:9). *24:00 - Hashem is the essence of joy. יִשְׂמַ֖ח יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּמַֽעֲשָֽׂיו - "...Hashem will rejoice with His works" ( Tehillim 104:31). ***32:00 - Giving vs. taking. Giving brings joy, taking brings sadness. 34:00 - Q&R about sources outside of chassidus for the emphasis on joy. 37:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. There was Din at the time of creation, because there was no initiation from below. 46:00 - מִ֣י הִ֖קְדִּימַנִי וַֽאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם - "Who has given Me anything beforehand, that I should repay him?" ( Iyov 41:3). Giving vs. taking. 52:00 - NOTE about entitlement. Marriage is giving. 54:00 - Closing blessings. 55:00 - Q&R about give and take in marriage. 59:00 - Very brief note about Tu BeShevat this week: "We are the trees."

lessons.description: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - The Purpose of Man Is To Perform Mitzvos beSimcha - Giving vs. Taking - Achieving Selflessness - Bris Milah - Orlah - Tikkun HaBris Is an Aspect of Joy - Klipah Nogah - Periya - Tzaddik Yisod Olam - Seudah and Wine for a Bris - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - The Purpose of Man Is To Perform Mitzvos beSimcha - Giving vs. Taking - Achieving Selflessness - Bris Milah - Orlah - Tikkun HaBris Is an Aspect of Joy - Klipah Nogah - Periya - Tzaddik Yisod Olam - Seudah and Wine for a Bris - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. The purpose of man is to perform mitzvos be'simcha . Giving vs. taking. 03:00 - Using hands to serve Hashem - "all ten fingers, down to the smallest one". Story of the Seven Beggars - each tzaddik refrained entirely from enjoying the physical world except for what was related to serving Hashem . 09:15 - Praying "with thunder" is praying with a high level of concentration and sincerity. ***12:00 - When a tzaddik gives, he elevates all of creation to the epitome of joy, which was Hashem's goal in creating the world. 14:00 - ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־מִצְוֹתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־זֶ֖ה כָּל־הָֽאָדָֽם - "The end of the matter, everything having been heard, fear Hashem and keep His commandments, for this is the entire man" ( Koheles 12:13). 16:00 - Q&R about the definition of "taking" - if a person uses all he receives only to serve Hashem , then he is not "taking". 18:00 - Q&R about the tzaddik's enjoyment of doing mitzvos . *18:30 - Q&R - achieving selflessness by negating personal desires and striving to fulfill the will of Hashem . 19:30 - PARAGRAPH 11. Bris Milah. Orlah . Why wasn't man created in a perfected state? Hashem created everything incomplete. It's man's task to repair and perfect the physical world. Example: processing wheat to become bread. *24:00 - Orlah - Tikkun HaBris is an aspect of joy. Orlah is an aspect of sadness. When a child is born, he is purely a "taker". The removal of the orlah completes the child's creation and he enters the category of "man". 28:40 - Tzaddik yisod Olam. A tzaddik is a giver. When the orlah is removed from the child, the pain he experiences eliminates the source of "taking/sadness" and enables him to enter the realm of "giving/joy". 32:10 - PARAGRAPH 12. The mitzvah of milah was received by Am Yisrael with joy ( Shabbos 130). 35:00 - The importance of a seudah at a bris milah . If a person can't eat meat at the seudah for a bris milah , he should at least eat fish. 37:00 - א֖וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה - "Light is sown for the righteous, and for the upright of heart, joy" ( Tehillim 97:11). NOTE: Quote from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : "To be a Breslov chossid means to be besimcha ". 37:30 - PARAGRAPH 13. The two steps of a kosher bris milah . Removal of Klipas Nogah by means of periya . 43:00 - Tzaddik Yisod Olam . 44:30 - Periya means both to "uncover" and to "repay a debt". 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Wine at a bris milah .

lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - Parshas Bereishis - Simcha vs. Atzvus - Joy vs. Sadness - Hashem Is the Source of All Joy - Shem Is Malkhus and Kovod - Male and Female - Simcha Shel Mitzvah - Shem Hashem - Remembering One's Name After Death - Naming a Child at His Bris Milah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־לִבּֽוֹ - "...and grieved in His heart" ( Bereishis 6:6, Bereishis ). 08:00 - וְהָיָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד - "And Hashem shall become King over all the earth; on that day shall Hashem be one, and His name one" ( Zecharia 14:9). *10:00 - A person is expected to remember his name after he passes away because his purpose in this world was to bring honor to Hashem . Shem - name - is Malkhus and Kovod . Zachor veShamor. 12:30 - וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַמְּאֹרֹ֖ת - "And Hashem made the two great luminaries..." ( Bereishis 1:16, Bereishis ). 13:30 - Koheles - The entire world was created for the tzaddik and is included in the tzaddik . The Yisod distributes Hashem's light and blessing to the world. "Tzaddik yisod olam." ***16:00 - Remembering one's name after death. Zachor - male (related to zikharon - memory) and female aspects of creation are united when a person remembers his own name after his death. 18:00 - The sum total of all the worlds is Shem Hashem . Uniting Hashem's name with all the worlds occurs through simcha shel mitzvah . 21:00 - Naming a child at his bris . The name of a person is connected to all the worlds. The bris milah engraves the Name of Hashem in the flesh of the new person. *22:00 - The tradition of saying a possuk for one's name. ***23:00 - Q&R about achieving happiness and causing sadness to "flee". The perfection of joy is to include one's sadness in the joy. Analogy of children being hungry, but their parents rejoice that their children at least have an appetite. A husband has the requirement to make his wife happy. *PARAGRAPH 16. 29:50 - Zachor es yom haShabbos - remembering Shabbos every day of the week. 32:00 - Hashem allows Himself to appear as "Borrower" through the mitzvos done by a Tzaddik on Shabbos . A person who gives to a worthy recipient is "lending" to Hashem . ***35:00 - When a person is born, he is the state of being a "taker". When he does a mitzvah, he enters the state of being a "giver". 36:00 - NOTE about Hashem revealing Himself as if he is "receiving" from man through Am Yisrael's service in the Beis HaMikdash . 37:00 - The tzaddik "rules" over Hashem ( Moed Katan 16). 38:00 - Ashrei . Zohar HaKodesh reveals how Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai banishes an angel from this world. 42:00 - Q&R about male and female. A women dressing in men's clothing relates to the concept of how, in the future, a wife becomes the crown of her husband. 46:00 - NOTE about a wife going out to earn a living to support her husband's limud Torah . 47:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - Parshas Yisro - Simcha Shel Shabbos - Shamor veZachor - Aspakleria HaMeira - Moshe Rabbeinu - Naming a Child During His Bris Milah - Giver vs. Taker - Masculine and Feminine Aspects of Creation - Definition of Chassid - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2
lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 - Parshas Yisro - Simcha Shel Shabbos - Shamor veZachor - Aspakleria HaMeira - Moshe Rabbeinu - Naming a Child During His Bris Milah - Giver vs. Taker - Masculine and Feminine Aspects of Creation - Definition of Chassid - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 17 - זָכוֹר֩ אֶת־י֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת לְקַדְּשׁ֗וֹ - "Remember the Sabbath day to sanctify it" ( Shemos 20:7, Yisro ) and שָׁמ֣֛וֹר אֶת־י֥וֹם֩ הַשַׁבָּ֖֨ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑֜וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥רשָׁמ֛וֹר אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑וֹ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ - "Keep the Sabbath day to sanctify it, as Hashem Your Master commanded you" ( Devarim 5:12, VaEschanan ). ***15:00 - Q&R about MideRabanim today being as aspect of MideOreisa . Parshas Yisro - At Matan Torah the word "all" in "all these words" includes all words of Torah forever into the future. 16:00 - NOTE: Today, the 16th of Shevat, is the birthday of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . The birthday of Rav Noson of Nemirov is on the 15th of Shevat , Tu BeShevat . Shelah HaKodesh brought by Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on "mi pi gevurah" which is begematria "Moshe" . What we hear from qualified rabbonim today is identical with the words of Torah spoken by Moshe Rabbeinu to Am Yisrael . MideRabanim and MideOreisa. MidaRabonim is begematria "mi pi gevurah" - " Moshe" . 22:00 - Q&R about consulting a poseyk or a tzaddik . Story of the man who lost his cattle and asked a tzaddik about how to find them. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. Periya in Bris Milah . 26:00 - Everyone, even tzaddikim , must attach themselves to the Aspakleria HaMeira - Moshe Rabbeinu . 30:00 - NOTE - During a Bris Milah , it's a traditional for the father of the child to give tzedakah just before announcing the child's name in order that the name will be established ( Sefer HaMidos, Mohel 6). NOTE about the organization of Sefer HaMidos into two sections - "Old" (A) and "New" (B). 32:00 - NOTE about how this teaching applies in a marriage. "If Sarah speaks, bend down to listen to her." The crucial importance of listening. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. עַד־מָתַי֙ תִּתְחַמָּקִ֔ין הַבַּ֖ת הַשּֽׁוֹבֵבָ֑ה כִּֽי־בָרָ֨א יְהֹוָ֚ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ נְקֵבָ֖ה תְּס֥וֹבֵֽב גָּֽבֶר - "How long will you hide, O backsliding daughter? For Hashem has created something new on the earth, a woman shall go after a man" ( Yirmiya 31:21). ***35:00 - A "giver" (masculine aspect of creation) is in the state of simcha . A "taker" (feminine aspect of creation) is in the state of atzvus . 40:00 - וְהָֽפַכְתִּ֨י אֶבְלָ֚ם לְשָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְנִ֣חַמְתִּ֔ים וְשִׂמַּחְתִּ֖ים מִֽיגוֹנָֽם - "...and I will turn your sadness into joy" ( Yirmiya 31::12). *44:00 - In the future, the female aspect of creation will become the masculine aspect. 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. In the future, the wife will be the crown (above) her husband's head. *48:00 - Who is called chassid? One who gives to His Creator. 50:00 - NOTE about the nekudah - Hebrew vowel mark - cholom moving to different locations with respect to the letter Vuv . ***52:00 - Q&R about how simcha shel mitzvah transforms a "taker" into a "giver". Simcha is limud Torah, mitzvah, tefilah . 52:00 - CLOSING NOTE about parshas hashevuah - Parshas Yisro - Matan Torah. Closing blessings to prepare for Shabbos with simcha .

Parshas Mishmatim. אִם־כֶּ֣סֶף | תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת־עַמִּ֗י אֶת־הֶֽעָנִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹא־תִֽהְיֶ֥ה ל֖וֹ כְּנשֶׁ֑ה לֹֽא־תְשִׂימ֥וּן עָלָ֖יו נֶֽשֶׁךְ - "When you lend money to My people, to the poor person with you, you shall not behave toward him as a lender; you shall not impose interest upon him" ( Shemos 22:24, Mishpatim ). 4:00 - The cantillation mark Zarka . Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . 06:30 - PARAGRAPH 23. Hallel . מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י | עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ - "He seats the barren woman of the house as a happy mother of children. Hallelu-Kah" ( Tehillim 113:9). בְּצֵ֣את יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַֽ֜עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז - "When Israel left Egypt, the house of Yaakov a people of a foreign language" ( Tehillim 114:1) 07:30 - The word Shekhina in its full form is Tav Reish Aleph - 601. (The letter Aleph can be either one or a thousand.) Am Yisrael is alluded to as 600,000. 09:00 - וְשִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל־רֹאשָׁ֑ם - "...and eternal joy upon their heads..." ( Yeshaya 35:10). "Eternal joy upon their heads" refers to the two crowns received by every Jew when we said "naaseh venishma" ( Shabbos 88). 13:00 - Am Yisrael has the ability to "rule over" Hashem through tefilah . 13:30 - NOTE - when the Yam Suf split, it parted into 12 paths, corresponding to the 12 shevatim and the different nusachim in Am Yisrael , to this day. 14:00 - Q&R about how a person can repay Hashem - tzaddikim take on part of Am Yisrael's debt. ***16:30 - NOTE on Parshas Mishpatim - it's a mitzvah to help a person, but only if the person is trying to help himself. If a person is not willing to help himself, then even a tzaddik is not able to help him. 17:30 - HALAKHA 3. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 8 . 20:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. The power of sighing. 27:20 - Everything Hashem creates is to enable man to praise Him with every breath. ***29:00 - כֹּ֣ל הַ֖נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֜֗הּ הַֽלְלוּיָֽהּ - "Let every soul praise Hashem. Hallelu-Kah" ( Tehillim 150:6). רַבִּי לֵוִי בְּשֵׁם רַבִּי חֲנִינָא אָמַר, עַל כָּל נְשִׁימָה וּנְשִׁימָה שֶׁאָדָם נוֹשֵׁם צָרִיךְ לְקַלֵּס לַבּוֹרֵא - "Rabbi Levi in the name of Rabbi Chanina said 'for each and every breath a man breathes he needs to praise the Creator'..." ( Bereishis Rabba 14:9). 32:30 - Hiskashrus letzaddik. Every breath a person takes can be immediately returned to the tzaddik through stating that intention once each day. 35:30 - There are many levels of hiskashrus letzaddik . 37:00 - Performing a sin gives energy to the forces of evil. 37:00 - The importance of attaching oneself to true tzaddikim . If a person does not attach himself to the tzaddikim , it has to travel through different channels. During this rerouting, the responsibility of the person's debt is on his own head and the person's mitzvos can fall into the hands of the klipos - forces of evil. Reference to Likutey Moharan 4 . 42:40 - There are many dangers during a rerouting of a person's mitzvos and tefilos . *44:00 - Q&R about the dangers facing those who are not attached to the tzaddik . The angels are afraid of the Tzaddikim. 47:30 - NOTE on Avraham Avinu standing at the entrance of Gehinnam to intercede on behalf of every Jewish soul. 48:00 - Q&R about attachment to tzaddikim . Since the tzaddikim are hidden, we pray to connect. Reference to Likutey Tefilos 4: Asking Hashem that one's vidui will be received as if it's being said in front of a tzaddik . 53:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 3 - Parshas VaEira - Purim - Moshe Rabbeinu - The Tzaddik Is the Conduit for Hashem's Ruach Chaim - Ten Plagues - Mateh - Malach Mem Tess - Four Elements - Zodiac - Amalek - Yad Al Kis KaH - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 8 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Purim. Ruach Chaim. Moshe Rabbeinu. The tzaddik is the conduit for Hashem's ruach chaim in the world. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The Ten Plagues. Hashem is the source of life and He infuses it into the world via the tzaddik . 21:00 - Shimshom's riddle: from strength comes sweetness. ***23:30 - Parshas VaEira. The mateh - staff of Moshe Rabbeinu . The staff represents free choice. 24:30 - NOTE: the malach Mem Tess is the chief angel in heaven. He rules during the six weekdays. Shabbos is ruled by Hashem directly. 27:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 79 . 29:00 - וַיִּבְלַ֥ע מַטֵּה־אַֽהֲרֹ֖ן אֶת־מַטֹּתָֽם - "...but Aaron's staff swallowed their staffs" ( Shemos 7:12, VaEira ). The staff of Aharon swallowed up the snakes generated by the magicians of Mitzrayim . ***32:30 - The Ten Plagues corresponded to the four basic elements with which the world was created: Earth, Air, Fire, Water. ***35:00 - Through the Ten Plagues, Hashem demonstrated that He has perfect control over all the elements, and that He does so via the staff held by the tzaddik . 39:00 - The zodiac. The Egyptians worshiped sheep - the first sign of the zodiac. Therefore, Hashem struck at their belief system by commanding Am Yisrael to slaughter the korbon Pesach - a sheep. 41:40 - Q&R about belief in the zodiac - that is, worshiping the forces of nature rather than honoring the ultimate power of Hashem . 42:45 - PARAGRAPH 5. Parshas Yisro. עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל יְהוָֹ֖ה מִכָּל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים - "Now I know that Hashem is the great above all deities..." ( Shemos 18:11, Yisro ). 44:40 - PARAGRAPH 6. Amalek is a composite of all the negative character traits of all 70 root nations. 53:00 - To defeat Amalek, Moshe Rabbeinu prayed very much - his hands were outstretched in tefilah . The 10 types of pulse - ruach chaim - are in the hands. 55:20 - Amalek is an aspect of the Angel of Death - therefore Amalek keeps rising up again and again to oppose Am Yisrael and cannot be entirely defeated until the final geulah . 56:00 - Hashem Himself does battle against Amalek on behalf of Am Yisrael : כִּי־יָד֙ עַל־כֵּ֣ס יָ֔הּ - "...For there is a hand on the throne of Hashem..." ( Shemos 17:16, Beshalach ).

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 116 - Follow the Words of HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw26clip-4. Recorded in 1977.) SICHAH 116. "...logic dictates there must be rules by which people can live in a civilized manner..." However, mitzvos are not based on human logic. Mitzvos are different from ethics. דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי - " the way of Your commandments I shall run..." ( Tehillim 119:32) - Roshei teivos "Adam" . Keeping the mitzvos of kashrus is not a matter of taste. The reason Am Yisrael does not kill is because HaShem commands us not to. Through Shmuel HaNavi , HaShem commanded Shaul HaMelech to wipe out the tribe of Amalek , including Agag , King of Amalek ( 1 Shmuel 15). For more on this: R' Rosenfeld zal on 1 Shmuel . The power of saying the Shema . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 3 - Purim - Mordekhai HaTzaddik - 10 Sons of Haman - Wealth - 50 Gates of Kedusha vs. 50 Gates of Tumah - Doubt Is Called Hanging - What Does Hashem Really Want? Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos HaOsey Shaliach Ligbos Chovo 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 8. 00:00 - ( Esther 3:1-2). 05:00 - Gold comes from the north - the left side when facing East. The letter Beis has 3 sides, Mizrach, Dorom, Maariv. Tzafon is lacking. 06:20 - וְהַכֶּ֖סֶף יַֽעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת־הַכֹּֽל - "...and money solves all needs" ( Koheles 10:19). 14:00 - The connection between the scaffold built by Haman and the Etz HaDaas . Where is Haman in the Written Torah? by the hamin haetz The vision of the two trees: ( Zecharia 4:3). Etz HaChaim and Etz HaDaas . 16:00 - ( Tehillim 8:6). 18:00 - The Jews left mitzrayim chamusim. The Zohar HaKodesh brings that Yetziyas Mitzrayim is mentioned in the Torah 50 times. 20:00 - All the lower 49 levels of Binah draw from the uppermost, 50th level of Binah . 22:00 - 50 Gates of Kedusha vs. 50 Gates of Tumeh . 26:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu added a third day to the days of separation before Matan Torah . The tzaddik emes knows what Hashem really wants. Reference to Likutey Moharan 190 and Chayey Moharan 197 . 29:00 - Q&R about Moshe Rabbeinu being tested in knowing what Hashem really wants to do. 30:00 - IMPORTANT BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal , whose mother died young of rhumatism caused by the damp and cold. How his own wife also suffered. Describing how he consulted a doctor to see if it would be healthy for him to have a shot of vodka each morning. 35:00 - Q&R about the 50 Gates of Tumah . 36:00 - Q&R about free will: do tzaddikim make mistakes? Reference to Hilkhos Sheluchin . ***38:00 - Q&R - What do we do if we fall? How do we get back up? "I fall because of my sins. I get up because I'm a Breslov chassid." ***43:00 - Why Haman wanted to hang Mordechai. Doubt is called "hanging" - and doubt is begematria Amalek. These doubts are the main test of the greatest tzaddikim - known what Hashem really wants. 46:00 - Yeshi Li Rav - e.g. "I have a rav who says I shouldn't read those Breslov books". 47:00 - ( Mishlei 20:9). 49:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 1 - with Introduction - What and Who Is the Tzaddik Emes ? - The 4 Worlds - Bitachon - Confidence - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw11aclip-1. Recorded in February 1976.) INTRODUCTION. What and who is the Tzaddik Emes ? וְ֜צַדִּ֗יק יְס֣וֹד עוֹלָֽם - "...and the tzaddik is the foundation of the world" ( Mishlei 10:25). The 4 Worlds, from lowest to highest, are: 1) Olam HaAsiya (the physical universe), 2) Olam HaYetzira (the realm of spiritual beings), 3) Olam HaBeriya (Throne of HaShem , origin of souls), 4) Olam HaAtzilus (unknowable realm of HaShem ). Olam HaBeriya . Olam HaAtzilus . The Tzaddik Emes can visit each of the higher spiritual realms. HaShem is infinite. SICHAH 1. כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה - "For I know that HaShem is great..." ( Tehillim 135:5). Each person's perception of HaShem is unique and impossible to communicate. No two people are on the same level. Mocking the Torah is extremely dangerous. The entire shiur is HERE .

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 5 - True Wisdom vs. Philosophy - The Menorah in the Beis HaMikdash - The Foundation of Faith Is Yirah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw12a. Recorded in 1976.) 00:00 - SICHAH 5a. The dangers of philosophy. 04:38 - Faith leads to eternal life. 06:29 - Account of two students of Rav Noson of Nemirov zal , comparing their levels of simple faith vs. Torah scholarship. 09:53 - Emunah - faith - is called "a beautiful maiden who has no eyes". *16:37 - The foundation of faith is yirah - fear of punishment. 20:52 - Ahava and yirah are male and female respectively. 23:43 - Respect for parents. *25:12 - When a person comes before the heavenly court, he is asked 6 question. These 6 questions correspond to the 6 sederim of the Mishneh . 30:00 - The foundation of faith is yirah . *30:43 - Parshas Tetzaveh. The menorah in the Beis HaMikdash . 43:15 - Closing blessings. 43:26 - SICHAH 5b. 44:15 - The meaning of the word דע as an introductory word in Rebbe Nachman's teachings. 45:52 - Every Jew has a portion in Olam HaBa. 48:13 - Similarities between Moshe Rabbeinu and Rabbi Akiva . 48:23 - The name Akiva contains the number 71 (first and last letter) alluding to the 71 members of the Sanhedrin. 48:40 - The middle letters of Rabbi Akiva's name allude to "Yabok" . 49:18 - Y - K - V - K plus - Elokim is begematria "Yabok" . 50:28 - It's important to speak about the dangers of philosophy. 51:22 - All inventions in technology or medicine originate from Hashem . He picks someone who has enough empty space in his head to accommodate the "discovery". 51:45 - Belief in science is related to atheism. 52:37 - "The best of doctors goes to Gehinnam " ( Kiddushin 82a). 53:27 - Discovery of new weapons or new cures is not always a good thing. 54:38 - Throughout history, intelligence has been diminishing. 57:24 - Klipah - negative spiritual force. Why famous innovators are often degenerate. 57:08 - Sefer Yetzira was written by Avraham Avinu . 60:30 - Torah revelations are from Hashem . *60:52 - Story about Rabbi Yosef Cairo zal - the Beis Yosef . When a new Torah concept enters the world through the mesiras nefesh of a tzaddik , it becomes available to the minds of the generation. 62:07 - The greatest simcha is the resolution of doubt. 65:59 - The Arizal's dream on Shabbos . 67:49 - Vaccines cannot prevent further decrees of illness from Hashem . 69:50 - The best cure-all is to pray for the arrival of Moshiach . 70:06 - Inventions are not always helpful to mankind - gunpowder for example. 70:36 - Surgeons do more harm than good. 71:59 - The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh on the life-long struggle against the Yetzer Hara .

The Talmud states: טוֹב שֶׁבָּרוֹפְאִים – לְגֵיהִנָּם - "The best of doctors goes to Gehinnam " ( Kiddushin 82a). What does this mean? The angel of death has assistants. What should a patien

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 50 - The Truth About Doctors - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw18a. Recorded in 1976.) SICHAH 50. The Talmud states: טוֹב שֶׁבָּרוֹפְאִים – לְגֵיהִנָּם - "The best of doctors goes to Gehinnam " ( Kiddushin 82a). What does this mean? The angel of death has assistants. What should a patient do after the doctors have "given up" on him? Chezkiyah Melech Yehudah hid the Sefer HaRefuos - "The Book of Cures" - and HaShem considered this good. Why? וְרַפֹּ֥א יְרַפֵּֽא - "...and the doctor shall heal" ( Shemos 21:19, Mishpatim ). Rabbi Elazar b'Rav Shimon Bar Yochai zal - the meaning of - "Cure us and we shall be cured." A person needs to return to a doctor several times, but when HaShem cures a person, He does so at once. Rav Avrohom (Kokhav-Lev) Sternhartz zal . " HaShem is so great He can even heal through a doctor!" - Rabbi Eliyah Chaim Rosen zal . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 51 - What Is Important in This World? Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw18bclip-1. Recorded in 1976.) SICHAH 51. Material gain in this world is not worth much. A person should not allow himself to become old. Constant renewal prevents decay. Stay young. A person should not be wasteful. Hefkeres means sacrificing seder to do mitzvos. It's important to do mitzvos in a grounded, methodical way - not abandoning the requirements of his physical life. A person also shouldn't be wasteful of his abilities. "Every mitzvah a person does should be done with forethought." *Don't let this material world fool you. HaShem holds non-Jews responsible for their deeds, especially if they harm Jews. Milchamas HaYetzer - maintaining purity on the battlefield of the heart. The entire shiur is HERE .

Hilkhos Harshaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 15 . PARAGRAPH 13b. Parshas Mishpatim . הִנֵּ֨ה אָֽנֹכִ֜י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ מַלְאָךְ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמָרְךָ֖ בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְלַֽהֲבִ֣יאֲךָ֔ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲכִנֹֽתִי - "Behold, I am sending an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared" ( Shemos 23:20, Mishpatim ). When a person is about to present a Torah shiur , the speaker asks for רשות - reshus - permission - from everyone present. This unites the listeners and overcomes the Yiros Nefulos , which enables the speaker and listeners to reach higher levels of Daas . PARAGRAPH 14. Shabbos Kiddush contains the word "Elokim" 3 times and the word "Shevii" 3 times. Mishpat is associated with the hands. PARAGRAPH 15. The 3 Weeks. וְהַֽאֲכַלְתִּ֗יךָ נַֽחֲלַת֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔יךָ - "...and I will give you to eat the heritage of Yaakov your father..." ( Yeshaya 58:14). All negative forces are nullified on Shabbos . The Third Beis HaMikdash will be built through Yaakov Avinu and will never be destroyed. Parshas Vayeitzei. מַה־נּוֹרָ֖א הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֗ה כִּ֚י אִם־בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְזֶ֖ה שַׁ֥עַר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם - "...'How awesome is this place. This is none other than the house of HaShem, and this is the gate of heaven'" ( Bereishis 28:17, VaYeitzei ). The 70 Nations draw their power from Yiros Nefulos . Parshas Bechukosai. The ultimate elevation of the yirah : Parshas וְזָֽכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י יַֽעֲק֑וֹב וְאַף֩ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֨י יִצְחָ֜ק וְאַ֨ף אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר - "...and I will remember My covenant Yaakov, and also My covenant Yitzchak, and also My covenant Avraham I will remember. And I will remember the Land" ( Vayikra 26:42, Bechukosai ). Q&R about the 3 stages of elevation achieved during Kiddush on Shabbos . The third stage is looking into the wine. Closing blessings - chizuk for elevating yirah through hisbonenus and hisbodedus .

Lender and borrower - Mish
lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 3 - Harshaah 4 - Massei - Ekev - Lender - Borrower - Mishpat - Elevating Yirah Nefulah to Daas - Fallen Fears - Holy Acquisition Expands Consciousness - Spiritual Aspects of Travel - Tefilas HaDerech - How To Prepare for a Journey - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 20b. Lender and borrower - Mishpat in business transactions. 05:00 - Holy acquisition expands consciousness. 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Spiritual aspects of travel: It's customary, before going on a major journey, to receive the blessing/permission of a gadol . Traveling has dangers, and fear of these dangers is an aspect of Yirah Nefulos , meaning - the person is afraid of things other than HaShem. 10:00 - Tzaddik moshel . Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 . 12:00 - Yiros Nefulos increase during traveling because one is transiting from one spiritual authority to another. The particular sovereignty of each of the 70 nations comes from HaShem . However, since HaShem's power is cloaked in these nations, His presence is also cloaked, especially to the traveler. When there are multiple authorities, there is a potential for Yiros Nefulos . 17:20 - Traveling from one country to another presents increased danger of Yiros Nefulos . That's why, before going on a major journey, a person should 1) pray for HaShem's guidance and protection ( Tefilas HaDerech ); 2) seek and receive the blessing/permission of a Tzaddik . Through taking both of these steps, the traveler acknowledges the ultimate authority of HaShem and elevates the Yiros Nefulos to Daas so the traveler can proceed with joy and Bitachon . ***21:00 - Q&R - How is this blessing for travel acquired today? By contacting one's rabbi and asking for his blessing/permission to travel. Rebbe Nachman recounted how, when a certain person went to his rabbi for a blessing to travel, the rabbi remained silent, so the student didn't travel. It wasn't until the rabbi passed away that the rabbi's silence was understood. 25:36 - How to prepare for a major trip: the Shekhina HaKedosha goes before a person. צֶדֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו - "Righteousness will go before him, and He will place it on the way of his steps" ( Tehillim 85:14). The Roshei teivos of this possuk allude to the preparations necessary for a trip. 27:00 - Hisbodedus/Cheshbon HaNefesh are essential before setting out on any major journey. 28:30 - Purim - Megilas Esther : בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא נָֽדְדָ֖ה שְׁנַ֣ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ - "That night the king's sleep was disturbed..." ( Esther 6:1). 29:15 - Parshas Massei . אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם בְּיַד־משֶׁ֖ה וְאַֽהֲרֹֽן - "These are the journeys of the children of Israel who left the land of Egypt in their legions, under the charge of Moses and Aaron" ( Bamidbar 33:1, Massei ). The travels of Am Yisrael for 40 years was a result of the sin of the Egel HaZahav 31:20 - Parshas Ekev . הַמּוֹלִ֨יכְךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר | הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ | שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב - "Who led you through that great and awesome desert, snakes, vipers and scorpions..." ( Devarim 8:15, Ekev ). Throughout their travels, were stepping on/subduing many different types of klipos . 33:00 - Every place Am Yisrael traveled, they established the Mishkan , thereby elevating the Yiros Nefulos to Daas in that place. This process was repeated again and again, and each time completed a new Kabalas HaTorah . 34:30 - PARAGRAPH 22. It's customary to ask rishus - permission - from those present before give a Dvar Torah . Through doing this, all the authorities present are united as one. By means of the merging Torah authorities, Yiras Nefulos are elevated to Daas , which enables a higher level of Torah. 36:30 - Q&R - Humor expands the consciousness. 37:10 - PARAGRAPH 23. Buying and selling refines and elevates the fallen sparks of creation. 42:40 - On Shabbos , all Yiros Nefulos are nullified. Shabbos is perfection of yirah . This is why it's forbidden to transfer things from one domain to another. All "separate domains" become one, because HaShem removes His "weekday garments" and assumes full, revealed power over all domains. 45:40 - HALAKHA 4. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 47:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. The Heichal HaKodesh is built through bringing people who are distant from the Torah into to service of Hashem . 48:00 - זֹאת יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם שַׂמְתִּ֑יהָ וּסְבִֽיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ אֲרָצֽוֹת - "...'This is Yerushalayim; in the midst of the nations I have placed it, and around it are lands'" ( Yechezkel 5:5). 50:00 - Yeshayah 66. The place of mishpat is the heart. ( Likutey Moharan 59:2). 51:40 - וַֽיהֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ - "But HaShem shall sit forever; He has established His throne for judgment" ( Tehillim 9:8). 54:00 - Wealth attracts souls. 54:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 4 - Heichal HaKodesh - Mishpat - Preventing Litigation in Business - Power of Attorney - Beis Din - Cheshbon HaNefesh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . - REVIEW. 01:24 - PARAGRAPH 2. Heichal HaKodesh. Evil can be transmitted from one person to another, therefore a person doing outreach, or doing business, needs to protect himself from the evil attached to the people he's dealing with. For this reason, both litigants in a Beis Din are both considered in the wrong when the hearing/judgement begins. 10:00 - Business transactions are an aspect of kiruv - the elevation of fallen sparks of holiness. Mishpat protects a person, doing a self-accounting constantly. This means hisbodedus - to speak to HaShem and include an audit of thoughts, words, and deeds. If a person does this properly, he activates the fire of Mishpat which burns away any evil attaching himself from the business transactions being conducted. And if a person does this properly, then HaShem will protect that person and prevent that he will ever have to go to court. The person's own self-judgement will be enough Mishpat to save him from any kind of litigation.15:00 - NOTE - if a person finds he has to go to Beis Din , he is made aware of how the Torah applies to the situation and receives a tikkun for his mistake. 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Harshaah - shaliach - appointing a legal representative to Beis Din . The Kisey HaKovod is related to Kisey HaMishpat . Reference to Likutey Moharan 59:2 . 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Kisey HaMishpat - the authority of a Beis Din is only established through proclaiming that three individuals are uniting to serve as a Beis Din . Admission of guilt in a Beis Din . 33:50 - PARAGRAPH 5. Power of attorney. The Heichal HaKodesh cloaks the lower ruach - "feet of the heart" of the person building it. 38:30 - *** "What comes from the heart, enters the heart ." . 42:00 - The fire in the heart of a person who establishes a Heichal HaKodesh is the fire of Mishpat . 46:40 - *Closing blessings - chizuk for hisbodedus , cheshbon hanefesh , and building the Heichal HaKodesh .

Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . PARAGRAPH 13b. The function of Aish HaMishpat in building the Heichal HaKodesh . Reference to Chayey Moharan 543 and Chayey Moharan 46 - כִּ֤י הָֽאָדָם֙ עֵ֣ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה - "...is the tree of the field a man..." ( Devarim 20:19, Shoftim ). PARAGRAPH 14. Arba Kosos shel Pesach - The 4 Cups of Wine for Seder Pesach . Why wine is used to bring in Shabbos through Kiddush . Q&R about the two aspects of Mishpat . AV and SaG correspond to Chokhma and Bina . Seven Yuds are begematria יין - wine. Q&R about how to do kiruv . *BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - heard from Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal - a way to help others is to pray. *BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - simply by saying Tikkun Chatzos with deep feeling, Reb Nachum Schuster zal brought great rabbis to teshuvah . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the tefilah of Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal . יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֖שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִרְעַ֥ם הַ֜יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ - "The heavens will rejoice and the earth will exult; the sea and the fullness thereof will roar" ( Tehillim 96:11). *"When HaShem is King, the whole world is happy." Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 4 - Parshas Emor - Pesach Seder - Matzah - Parnassah - Anger - Dipping the Maror into the Charoses - Definition of Teivas Mamon - Ashirus deKedushah - Sefiras HaOmer is an Aspect of Cheshbon HaNefesh - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . PARAGRAPH 17. Pesach, matzah, parnassah, anger. Matzah is begematria AV SaG - expansions of HaShem's Name Y - K - V - K . Brief review of the expansions of HaShem's Name - עב סג מה בן. Q&R about eating the matzah at the seder . Q&R about controlling anger in marriage. Galus Mitzrayim was a tikkun for cheyt Adam HaRishon . PARAGRAPH 18. * Pesach Seder : The meaning of dipping the Maror into the Charoses . "It's possible to easily be freed from all excessive desires. The exception is Teivas Mamon - it's very difficult to be released from the excessive desire for wealth" ( Sipurey Maasios 13, The Master of Prayer). *Ashirus deKedushah - Holy Wealth - is represented by the Charoses - a combination of sweet fruits. אֶל־גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִרְא֖וֹת בְּאִבֵּ֣י הַנָּ֑חַל לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲפָֽרְחָ֣ה הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָֽרִמֹּנִֽים - "I went down to the nut garden to see the green plants of the valley, to see whether the vine had blossomed, the pomegranates were in bloom" ( Shir HaShirim 6:11). This possuk alludes to the diversified good deeds of Am Yisrael . Charoses has a dual nature - it represents both the darkness of Teivas Mamon , as well as the diverse beauty of Am Yisrael that originates from the same place as Ashirus deKedushah . Q&R about the dual nature of Charoses . PARAGRAPH 19. Sefiras HaOmer . *A person needs to be extremely knowledgeable and strong to be able to save someone who's drowning. שְׂעוֹרָה - barley - is beGamtria two times Menatzpach - the closing letters of the Aleph-Beis - םןץףך - in Yiddish: "Shluss Mem", "Shluss Noon" , etc. Reference to Likutey Moharan 68 and to Likutey Moharan 69 . Barley is considered animal food, wheat is considered human food. * Sefiras HaOmer is an aspect of Chesbon HaNefesh - Mishpat . אִ֥ם חֲרוּצִ֨ים | יָמָ֗יו מִֽסְפַּר־חֳדָשָׁ֥יו אִתָּ֑ךְ חֻקָּ֥יו (כתיב חֻקָּ֥ו) עָ֜שִׂ֗יתָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעֲבֹֽר - "If his days are limited, and the number of his months is with You, You set his bounds and he cannot cross" ( Iyov 14:5). *PARSHAS EMOR - Sefiras HaOmer . וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ מִמָּֽחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּֽהְיֶֽינָה - "And you shall count for yourselves, from the morrow of the rest day from the day you bring the Omer as a wave offering seven weeks; they shall be complete" ( Vayikra 23:15, Emor ). The days of the Omer must be complete, whole. The fire of Mishpat is generated through Kabalas HaTorah as at Har Sinai - Shavuos NOTE: This Shabbos is Parshas Parah . *CLOSING BLESSINGS. In business, half the solution to difficulties is achieved through accounting. And in life, half the solution to difficulties is achieved through Cheshbon HaNefesh .

Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 -
lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 4 - Parshas Ekev - Kriyas Yam Suf - Shemiras HaBris - Cheshbon HaNefesh - Merit of Yosef HaTzaddik - Erev Rav Today - Degelim in the Midbar - Mishpat deKedushuah vs. Mishpat deSutra Achra - 4 Encampments - Kriyas Yam Suf - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19b. The fire of Mishpat at Sinai. 08:00 - כִּי־אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִקְרֹ֚א כֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה לְעָבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד - "For then I will convert the nations to a pure language that all of them call in the name of HaShem, to worship Him of one accord" ( Zephania 3:9). 09:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. Kriyas Yam Suf was on the 6th day of Sefiras HaOmer . כִּ֚י חֹ֣ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֑וּא מִ֜שְׁפָּ֗ט לֵֽאלֹהֵ֥י יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "For it is a statute for Israel, the judgment of Elokei Yaakov" ( Tehillim 81:5). 16:50 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE heard from Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal when he was imprisoned in Siberia. 17:30 - Q&R about Yosef HaTaddik's trial with the wife of Potifar vs. his sale by the other shevatim . 23:00 - Q&R about Yosef HaTzaddik . 23:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Rabbi Dorfman zal - when he was in Siberia, he was put in charge of a factory with thousands of workers, but every day his life was in danger. He recounted that he knew it would only be his adherence to Shemiras HaBris that would keep him alive. 26:30 - Q&R about Yosef HaTzaddik and Osnas bas Potifara . 27:40 - NOTE about Rabbi Akiva and the wife of the Roman emperor. 29:30 - NOTE about the moral purity of Yehudah and Tamar . 30:20 - Q&R about the Erev Rav in Am Yisrael today. In the times preceding Moshiach , "Our enemies will be our leaders..." and only HaShem's direct Mishpat will be able to turn them around. 32:50 - שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֨וּבִי֙ הַשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְנֶֽחֱזֶה־בָּ֑ךְ מַֽה־תֶּֽחֱזוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּמְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽמַּֽחֲנָֽיִם - "'Return, return, O Shulammite; return, return, and let us gaze upon you.' 'What will you see for the Shulammite, as in the dance of the two camps?'" Shir HaShirim 7:1). 34:00 - When Am Yisrael traveled in the midbar , they were arranged in 4 encampments, corresponding to the 4 camps of the Shekhina. It was this "holy square" of Mishpat deKedusha that gave them the ability to destroy all the surrounding klipos - forces of destruction. Parshas Ekev - "Hashem Who led you through this vast desert..." The four enemies mentioned correspond to the four forces of evil. 36:20 - NOTE about Avraham Avinu referring to himself as "dust and ashes". The Four Kings defeated the Five Kings and took Lot captive, yet Avraham Avinu defeated the Four Kings. Meaning of the name Eliezer - Aryeh Shor Nesher... the four camps of the Shekhina . 39:20 - Parshas Ekev. הַמּוֹלִ֨יכְךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר | הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ | שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן - "Who led you through that great and awesome desert, snakes, vipers and scorpions, and drought..." ( Devarim 8:15, Ekev). Am Yisrael destroyed the klipos in the midbar through the square of Mishpat . 42:00 - When Yosef HaTzaddik was confronted with the test with Potifar's wife, he saw the face of his father, Yaakov Avinu who warned him that if he didn't pass the test, his name would not be inscribed on the Choshen Mishpat . 42:30 - NOTE - Chiddush heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal -וְה֚וּא רַח֨וּם | יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָו‍ֹ֘ן וְלֹ֪א יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְהִרְבָּ֣ה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ - "But He is merciful, He expiates iniquity and does not destroy; many times He takes back His wrath..." ( Tehillim 78:38). Mishpat deKedushuah vs. Mishpat deSutra Achra . 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. The Yam Suf split on the seventh day of Pesach . 48:00 - NOTE: Taking time to reach a decision in a Beis Din ( Pirkei Avos ) is the opposite of anger. 50:00 - The waters of the Yam Suf rose up "like a wall" - this alludes to the protection provided by the "wall" of wealth. 55:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-03-24 - LH7 - CM1 - Harshaah 4 - Para. 22b - Hilkhos Oreyv 1 - Oreyv 2 - Para. 1-2
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Harshaah 4 - Oreyv 1 - Oreyv 2 - Shevii Shel Pesach - Torah and Parnassah - Cosigning a Loan - Wealth Protects Emunah - Money Stands a Person on His Feet - Loan vs. Gift - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . PARAGRAPH 22b. Shevii Shel Pesach. Heichal HaKodesh. Sefiras HaOmer
lessons.bodyText: Harshaah 4 - Oreyv 1 - Oreyv 2 - Shevii Shel Pesach - Torah and Parnassah - Cosigning a Loan - Wealth Protects Emunah - Money Stands a Person on His Feet - Loan vs. Gift - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Harshaah 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 59 . PARAGRAPH 22b. Shevii Shel Pesach. Heichal HaKodesh. Sefiras HaOmer All the nations will rejoice when HaShem will judge. *The soul is elevated through Ashirus deKedusha - wealth used for serving HaShem . HILKHOS OREYV 1. Hilkhos Oreyv 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 280 . NOTE - heard from Rav Eliyah Chaim Rosen zal - A person who supports himself while he's learning Torah is on a higher level than someone who learns Torah but relies on others to support him. Those who sustain their own Torah study are especially blessed, as in יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֖פֶּיךָ כִּ֥י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֜שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ - "When you eat of the work of your hands, you are praiseworthy, and it is good for you" ( Tehillim 128:2). ***A sin can negate a mitzvah , but a sin cannot negate Torah. Reference to Likutey Moharan 204 . The connection between money and Torah. Wealth protects emunah . וְהַכֶּ֖סֶף יַֽעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת־הַכֹּֽל - "and money is the response to everything" ( Koheles 10:19). Wealth protects emunah . Livush/beged - clothing draws it light from Binah . "Do not reject the Torah of your mother" - Binah relates to the feminine principle; the Torah is compared to garments. Why Kinyan is usually done through a beged . Q&R about how a sin can negate a mitzvah , but a sin cannot negate Torah. A mitzvah is compared to a candle, while the Torah compared with light itself, and is more powerful. Q&R - the term "emunah" has two dimensions: faith and honesty. HALAKHA 2. Hilkhos Oreyv 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . Cosigning for a loan at the time the loan is given vs. cosigning after the loan is given, which requires a kinyan. When the ruach flows through the 6 parts of the hands/arms (from the shoulders down) and through the 6 parts of the legs - this is emunah . The hands and feet are empowered by the ruach of the heart, which is the tzaddik . Esther represents the hidden ruach - the feet. Mordekhai represents the revealed ruach - the hands. The lower, hidden ruach is the stronger of the two, and is an aspect of Ruach HaKodesh . PARAGRAPH 2. Wealth is related to the feet. Money "stands a person on his feet". The person who lends money, helps establish the person who is stumbling because he lacks parnassah . NOTE: bankruptcy in Israel is called פְּשִׁיטַת רֶגֶל. ***Generosity and acts of kindness activate the power of the tzaddik . The heart is the center of giving, as in וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל־אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָֽדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜וֹ אֹת֗וֹ - "Every man whose heart uplifted him came, and everyone whose spirit inspired him to generosity ..." ( Shemos 35:21, VaYakhel ). The one giving and the one receiving represent Mordekhai and Esther , respectively. The one who is giving is extending the ruach of the Tzaddik . The one who is receiving, is being given the ability to stand on his feet and is being elevated to empower stronger emunah/ruach hakodesh in himself and in the generation. *Loan vs. gift. Why giving a person a loan is a greater kindness than giving them a gift. וְהָיָ֚ה אֽוֹר־הַלְּבָנָה֙ כְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַמָּ֔ה - "And the light of the moon shall be like the light of the sun..." Yeshaya 30:26. Q&R - Tzedakah helps negate sin. Q&R about going to Meron this week for Yom Kippur Katan .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 2 - Cosigning for a Loan - Clothing and Shoes Protect Emunah - Lender - Ruach Nedivah - Kinyan Sudar - Document - Cosigner Present when Loan Is Given vs. Cosigner Not Present - Gemach - Cosigning Is Dangerous - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . Cosigning for a loan is e
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 2 - Cosigning for a Loan - Clothing and Shoes Protect Emunah - Lender - Ruach Nedivah - Kinyan Sudar - Document - Cosigner Present when Loan Is Given vs. Cosigner Not Present - Gemach - Cosigning Is Dangerous - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . Cosigning for a loan is established only through speech at the time a loan is given; no kinyan is necessary in order for it to take effect. Cosigning after a loan has been received requires a kinyan . PARAGRAPH 3. Cosigning for a Loan is an aspect of supporting the borrower's feet. "His heart lifted his feet..." PARAGRAPH 4. When a cosigner is present at the time the lender gives the borrower the loan, the cosigner's word is enough - no kinyan is necessary. Reference to Likutey Moharan 280 . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about how Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal managed a gemach for the Breslov Yeshiva. If a borrower can't repay, the tendency is that the lender becomes evil in his eyes. Kinyan Sudar - kinyan made through lifting a garment or a shoe. Clothing and shoes protect emunah . Why a Jew should never walk barefoot. Hands and feet are aspects of emunah .

lessons.title: 2025-03-27 - LH7 - CM1 - Oreyv 2 - Para. 5-9 - Oreyv 3 - Para. 1-2 - Ki Seitzei
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 2 - Oreyv 3 - Ki Seitzei - Yibum - Chalitza - Cosigner After a Loan Was Given - Ruach Nedivah Is an Aspect of Tzaddik - Dovid HaMelech - Malkhus - Tikkun HaRaglin - Spiritual Aspects of Feet - Men and Women Are Equal in Mishpat and Tzedakah - Ratzon - Yearning to Serve HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkho
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 2 - Oreyv 3 - Ki Seitzei - Yibum - Chalitza - Cosigner After a Loan Was Given - Ruach Nedivah Is an Aspect of Tzaddik - Dovid HaMelech - Malkhus - Tikkun HaRaglin - Spiritual Aspects of Feet - Men and Women Are Equal in Mishpat and Tzedakah - Ratzon - Yearning to Serve HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 10 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The main task in this world is to repair the "feet" of the soul, especially the "bottom of the feet", by means of emunah . This is done by bearing/raising a son who will continue the tikkun haraglin , as in "The son is the leg of the father". This tikkun is drawn through the ruach of the tzaddik , which flows into the hands and especially into the feet. 02:00 - The "feet" refers to the wife, as in "One should sell the beams of his house to buy shoes" ( Shabbos 129a). 03:30 - "The heart lifts up the feet" - the heart being the ruach of the tzaddik . This repair of the ruach cannot be done in one generation. It requires many generations through offspring . Each individual takes part in the process of tikkun haruach according to his or her abilities. 06:00 - *A student is considered a son. Reference to 2likutey Moharan 7 . 07:30 - Parshas Ki Seitzei. The mitzvah of Yibum - if a man passes away without children, his widow is supposed to marry his brother - וְנִגְּשָׁ֨ה יְבִמְתּ֣וֹ אֵלָיו֘ לְעֵינֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִים֒ וְחָֽלְצָ֤ה נַֽעֲלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְל֔וֹ - "Then his brother's wife shall approach him before the eyes of the elders and remove his shoe from his foot..." ( Devarim 25:9, Ki Seitzei ). 08:30 - In the mitzvah of chalitza , the widow unfastens/removes the shoe of her late husband's brother. 13:00 - Q&R If a man teaches a student this does not release the man's widow from the mitzvah of Yibum . Q&R about Kinyan Sudar . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. A cosigner after a loan was given does not obligate himself through speech, but only through kinyan . 19:20 - PARAGRAPH 7. The difference between an oreyv who was present when the loan is given vs. an oreyv who was not present: the lender has faith in the oreyv when the loan was given, so the ruach nedivah was activated through the oreyv's presence. Regarding an oreyv who steps up to save the borrower's life later on: " Reuven ain't feeling so generous to Shimon this sunny day. He's throttling Shimon !" The oreyv who says he's take responsibility for Shimon's loan under after the loan was given does not obligate himself with speech, as he would have if he had been present when the loan was given. 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Dovid HaMelech , who is the bechinas malkhus/emunah . His whole focus in life was elevating the raglin , as in "My foot was on a secure path..." and as in לֹֽא־אָמ֥וּת כִּֽי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה - "I shall not die but I shall live..." ( Tehillim 118:17). 27:40 - Ruach Nedivah is an aspect of the tzaddik . Reference to Likutey Moharan 10 - Borrower and lender are an aspect of Mordekhai and Esther. 30:45 - *Purim - Matanos Levyonim is an aspect of tzedakah , and Mishloach Manos is an aspect of giving a loan. When it comes to mishpat and tzedakah , the Torah applies equally to men and to women. 34:45 - HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. This halacha will present a clarification of the word רצון - will, desire, yearning, appeasement. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 27:40 - PARAGRAPH 1. "The most important thing is רצון - the will to come close to HaShem ." Looking forward to the next opportunity to do something for HaShem . 39:45 - Reference to Sichos HaRan : "All the desires of this world are nothing." 40:00 - It's crucial for a person to train themselves to want to serve HaShem . An angel has no ratzon . The only thing that man can give to HaShem is ratzon - desire to serve Him. 43:40 - *NOTE: The holy Baal Shem Tov said of his daughter, the grandmother of Rebbe Nachman, that she was an expert in continuously yearning to serve HaShem . 45:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. The ultimate goal of the perfection of the soul is the perfection of ratzon - yearning. 48:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu is the Torah - when he was nistalek , he rose to highest level of ratzon - "yearning to yearn" for HaShem . *The perfection of רצון is above everything else. 53:30 - The ultimate goal is to plug into HaShem's desire, to become one with His will. Begematria, Moshe is 345, רצון is 346. 55:20 - Closing Blessings - being in Uman is to be in the place of ultimate ratzon where people are yearning together to serve HaShem .

lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Chayei Sarah - Ratzon HaShem - Yearning for Kedushah - Ohr Ein Sof - רעוא דרעוין - Regret Is Increased רצון - Shabbos Is Teshuvah The Soul Is Ratzon - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . PARAGRAPH 6. הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָ֑ ִם מַה־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וּֽמַה־תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ - "I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem; why should you awaken, and why should you arouse the love until it is desirous?" ( Shir HaShirim 8:4). Chokhmei haTeva are the opposite of ratzon HaShem . Israel's yearning for kedushah originates from רעוה דרעוין - the highest level perceivable by man - Ohr Ein Sof - the infinite light of HaShem that emanates no matter what man does. PARAGRAPH 7. The holiness of Shabbos is above the holiness of Yom Tov . On Shabbos , the light of רעוא דרעוין is shining directly inot Olam HaZeh . No malacha is permitted on Shabbos . "A Jew who keeps Shabbos is forgiven for all his sins." At the highest level of Ohr Ein Sof , sins are transformed into mitzvos . ***The most important aspect of teshuvah is regret. Another way of expressing this is that the person has an increased desire for kedushah , and yearns not to waste any more time. * Shabbos is teshuvah . The essence of teshuvah is the yearning for kedushah , which becomes much stronger after a person does a sin. This is how the sins are converted to mitzvos . A person who enjoys Shabbos receives an inheritance that has no boundaries. ( Shabbos 118). PARAGRAPH 8. Parshas Chayei Sarah. אִם־יֵ֣שׁ אֶת־נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם - "If it is your will..." ( Bereishis 23:8, Chayei Sarah ). The main goal of a person in Olam HaZeh is to achieve the most possible ratzon for HaShem , because the soul is ratzon . The word נשמה contains the letters " Moshe נ" - alluding to Moshe Rabbeinu reaching the 50th level of holiness. Reference to Likutey Moharan 5 - there's a connection between time, place and the Torah. The world is divided into 613 parts, each of which is connected to one of the 613 mitzvos . So too, each of the 365 days of the year is connected to a particular mitzvah . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - The Essence of Tzedakah is Good Will - Lender is Ratzon - Borrower is Asiya - Lending Is Greater than Giving, However... - Ratzon HaElyon - Why Money Is Called Kesef - What Is Mazal ? Wealth Draws Friends - Avoid Cosigning - The Tzaddik Is Guarantor - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. The essence of tzedakah is good will. 11:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Why lending is greater than giving. 18:00 - Wealth draws friends. Reference to Likutey Moharan 68 . 19:00 - Mazal ? מזלא is three times Y - K - V - K (78). 21:00 - Through the mitzvah of repaying a debt, the borrower completes the act of good will. However... 21:40 - Q&R about a loan that is not repaid. 23:00 - The oryev - cosigner/guarantor - elevates asiya to ratzon . However, even though it's a mitzvah to lend money to a poor person, one should do everything possible to avoid being an oryev , as chazal warn: "stay away from cosigning a loan" ( Yevamos 109). 27:40 - *Life in Olam HaZeh is all about repaying our debt to HaShem . "All the heavenly hosts bow to HaShem" - each angel borrows from HaShem . Every mitzvah , every word of tefilah and Torah, every good thought, is repayment of this loan. 31:40 - Even though person in This World is in danger of not repaying his debt to HaShem , he is in a position to achieve much more than the angels can. 33:00 - Being in Olam HaZeh gives a person the opportunity to be free of "eating the bread of shame" - the suffering of receiving something one did not earn. 36:30 - ***Even though lending money is a mitzvah , a person should avoid doing this mitzvah . There are mitzvos that a person should not run to do. "Certain mitzvos are better left for someone else to do." 39:00 - Borrowing money with no plan of how to repay it is a form of stealing. 44:00 - *Q&R about the concept that it's better if a person hadn't been born: if a person connects with the tzaddik , it's worth being born. Heard from Rabbi Kalman Rosen zal : The tzaddik is cosigner for our debt, as hinted in the initial letters of the first words of Tikkun HaKlali . 50:00 - Q&R about caution in lending money. 51:00 - Closing blessings: Shabbos is ratzon , weekdays are asiyah .
