lessons.description: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Kedoshim - Shabbos Nachamu - רעוא דרעוין - Tzedakah - Kadosh HaKedoshim - Beis HaMikdash - Ratzon Generates Yirah - Shalosh Ragolim - Miracles Are the "Face of HaShem " - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - Dedications. 00:50 - PARAGRAPH 18. Parshas Ke
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Kedoshim - Shabbos Nachamu - רעוא דרעוין - Tzedakah - Kadosh HaKedoshim - Beis HaMikdash - Ratzon Generates Yirah - Shalosh Ragolim - Miracles Are the "Face of HaShem " - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - Dedications. 00:50 - PARAGRAPH 18. Parshas Kedoshim. וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֹ֑ה לִרְצֹֽנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ - "When you slaughter a peace offering to HaShem, you shall slaughter it for your acceptance" ( Vayikra 19:5, Kedoshim ). 03:00 - *Miracles remind people that HaShem is guiding everything that happens. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 11:00 - Sacrifices of tzedakah are required on the Shalosh Ragolim - Pesach, Shavuos, and Sukkos . 12:00 - מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת־נָדִ֑יב - "How fair are your feet in sandals, O daughter of nobles..." ( Shir HaShirim 7:2). 15:00 - יִשְׂמַ֣ח צַ֖דִּיק כִּֽי־חָזָ֣ה נָקָ֑ם - "The righteous man will rejoice because he saw revenge..." ( Tehillim 58:11.) *When HaShem hides behind nature, He is called "Elokim" - midas HaDin . When He reveals Himself through miracles, He is called Y - K - V - K - midas HaChesed . 17:00 - The importance of giving tzedakah in honor of Yom Tov . 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. The Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of a deficiency in emunah and tzedakah ( Shabbos 119), as in ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֙יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת - "Woe to those who join house to house..." ( Yeshaya 5:8). 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. Every Jew is obligated to mourn the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . This mourning weakens the power of " Esav's tears". 30:00 - The definition of simchah is perceiving the good will of HaShem - when we see and believe that HaShem is providing for us. 32:00 - Q&R - " Esav's tears" is mourning something meaningless. Why a person should avoid praising non-Jews and not accept charity from them. 36:00 - Q&R about "artificial intelligence" taking over mundane tasks being a sign of geulah . 37:00 - NOTE about a student wanting to go to study Torah after graduating from high school event though his father wanted him to learn a trade so he could support himself. The student went on to become a Talmid Chokham and married into a wealthy family. 41:00 - תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֘ אֹ֪רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שׂ֣בַע שְׂ֖מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִֽינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח - "You shall let me know the way of life, the fullness of joys in Your presence. There is pleasantness in Your right hand forever" ( Tehillim 16:11). 47:30 - Closing blessings. 49:00 - Q&R about working with people who speak nival peh - profanity. If a person uses profanity they forfeit their power of tefilah .

"...logic dictates there must be rules by which people can live in a civilized manner..." However, mitzvos are not based on human logic. Mitzvos are different from ethics. דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי - " the way of Your commandments I shall run..." ( Tehillim 119:32) - Roshei teivos "Adam" . Keeping the mitzvos of kashrus is not a matter of taste. The reason Am Yisrael does not kill is because HaShem commands us not to. Through Shmuel HaNavi , HaShem commanded Shaul HaMelech to wipe out the tribe of Amalek , including Agag , King of Amalek ( 1 Shmuel 15). For more on this: R' Rosenfeld zal on 1 Shmuel . Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Parshas Toldos . Tears of Esav . How could Yitzchak Avinu have been fooled by Esav ? 08:14 - וַיֶּֽאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו - "And Yitzchak loved Esav because game was in his mouth, ..." ( Bereishsis 28:28, Toldos ). Yitzchak Aveinu thought that Esav knew his mission in this world - to support those who learn Torah. 13:30 - The concept of working to earn a living originated with the nachash . וְנָחָ֖שׁ עָפָ֣ר לַחְמ֑וֹ - "...and a serpent - dust shall be his food..." ( Yeshaya 65:25). 16:30 - Tzedakah Expresses good will and elevates the Asiyah , which brings a union between Asiya and Keser . 15:45 - Q&R about Yitzchak Avinu and Esav . HaShem blocked this aspect of Yitzchak Avinu's ruach hakodesh . Story of Rabbi Yochanan and Reish Lakish . 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 22. Rivka understood that Esav was a rasha . 29:40 - When Moshiach is revealed, the 70 Nations will do the work and Am Yisrael will be learning Torah and doing mitzvos . 33:30 - Ratzon generates yirah . Avrhaham Avinu was chesed - ratzon . Reference to Likutey Moharan 142 . 41:00 - * Yirah makes a vessel for chesed . 42:00 - Q&R - Why didn't Rivka alert Yitzchak Avinu to the true nature of Esav ? 47:00 - Q&R about the generations preceding Moshiach . 48:30 - Comment from student about the request made that the sins of Am Yisrael should be wiped out. 51:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Toldos - Yaakov vs. Esav - Moshiach - Parnassah by Miracle - Tzedakah to Support Torah - Korbon Elevates Animal Soul to the Level of Man - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - ***Review of Hilkhos Oreyv 3 thus far. Ratzon, yirah, miracles, and the Yom Tovim . 04:20 - PARAGRAPH 22b. What Moshiach brings to the world - parnassah by miracle - the work of the 70 Nations. 08:20 - *** "The most important thing about this world is that HaShem is here." 10:00 - Yaakov Avinu's intent in deceiving Yitzchak Avinu . 15:50 - NOTE about Parshas Vayechi. How was Yaakov Avinu able to give these blessings? "A person with a good eye has the power to bless." 18:00 - Tzedakah removes the impurity of the nachash and insures the revelation of HaShem's ratzon - good will. 23:00 - NOTE: tzedakah includes kindness extended in one's own home. 23:30 - The connection between tzedakah and parnassah . 25:40 - What is the meaning of " Esav was hairy"? Hair is excess sekhel , which results in anger and dinim . Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . 31:00 - Parshas Toldos. וַיָּ֛רַח אֶת־רֵ֥יחַ בְּגָדָ֖יו - "...and he smelled the fragrance of his garments..." ( Bereishis 27:27, Toldos ). 37:40 - Q&R about the 39 Melakhos and the 39 Ohros - Lights. 38:30 - PARAGRAPH 23. אֶת־בְּכֹֽרָתִ֣י לָקָ֔ח וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה לָקַ֣ח בִּרְכָתִ֑י - "...he took my birthright, and behold, now he has taken my blessing..." ( Bereishis 27:36, Toldos ). 40:50 - ***The process of korbon elevates an animal soul to the level of man. 46:20 - "Rotzeh" - The avodah in the Beis HaMikdash included song which vocalized the Torah. The Torah is an expression of HaShem's ratzon . Yirah is associated with the Leviim . 50:26 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-04-09 - LH7 - CM1 - Oreyv 3 - Para. 23b-27 - Parshas Toldos
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Toldos - Yaakov Avinu Was Justified in Taking the Birthright - Avodas Kohanim - Purifying Olam HaAsiyah - 4 Worlds in Shacharis - Korbonos - Beis HaMikdash - 39 Melakhos - Ratzon - Tears of Esav - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - Today, the 11th of
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Toldos - Yaakov Avinu Was Justified in Taking the Birthright - Avodas Kohanim - Purifying Olam HaAsiyah - 4 Worlds in Shacharis - Korbonos - Beis HaMikdash - 39 Melakhos - Ratzon - Tears of Esav - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - Today, the 11th of Nissan , is the yahrzeit of Ronnie Cohen a"h . 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. HaShem's ratzon is revealed on each of the Shalosh Ragolim - Pesach, Shavuos, and Sukkos . 09:00 - Tefilah . Traveling the 4 Worlds during Shacharis . Reciting the Korbonos purifies the Olam HaAsiyah , which is the essence of Tikkun HaRatzon since it purifies the highest spiritual place from the basis of the lowest spiritual level. 12:30 - NOTE - this unification of the highest and lowest spiritual levels are an aspect of Moshe Rabbeinu - 345 vs. - shmad - 344 via Tikkun HaRatzon . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 25. Toldos. Yaakov Avinu vs. Esav . Supporting a Talmid Chokham is credited in the same way as bringing all the korbonos in the Beis HaMikdash ( Sefer HaMidos, Achila 7). 17:00 - NOTE - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal and Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal allocated tzedakah to many different funds, but both gave priority to supporting Talmidei Chokhamim in Eretz Yisrael . 19:00 - Yaakov vs. Esav . Esav's exhaustion came from chasing after material wealth. Esav acquired the garments of Adam HaRishon by killing Nimrod. Sin comes from the negative aspect of the 39 Melakahos . 22:30 - הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־הָֽאָדֹ֤ם הָֽאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה - "Pour some of this red, red into me..." Bereishis 25:30, ( Toldos ). 25:30 - Toldos. Yaakov Avinu was justified in taking the birthright. Esav had no interest in the spiritual blessing of the bachor , as in וְלָֽמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה - "Why do I need this birthright?" ( Bereishis 25:32, Toldos ). 29:00 - Q&R about elevating ratzon to dibur through tefilah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 31 . 32:00 - Q&R about the halakhos of arrive late for a minyan . It's important to daven with a minyan and beginning tefilah together with the minyan on time. However, if a person arrives late, we follow the halakhah : one may skip whatever's necessary from the morning blessings to the first and last Hallelukahs, Ashrei, Yishtabach. From Yishtabach on no further skipping is done. 36:30 - PARAGRAPH 26. Toldos. At first Yitzchak Avinu regretted giving the blessing to Yaakov Avinu . But when he heard that Esav had rejected the birthright, Yitzchak rejoiced. 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 27. Toldos. וַיִּשָּׂ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ - "...And Esau raised his voice and wept" ( Bereishis 27:38, Toldos ). The tears/crying of Esav are an aspect of depression that results from excess focus on Olam HaAsiyah. Esav's tears were activating the impurity of the Nachash . As a result of Esav's outcry, Yaakov Avinu was forced to give way to Esav in some aspect. Until Moshiach is revealed, Am Yisrael must give some token to the Sutra Achra . 45:00 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about Bilaam , who said, "May I die a righteous death, and my end should be like them." As a result of his prayer, Bilaam was reincarnated as Naval, in the time of Dovid HaMelech. 46:30 - "No ratzon for good is ever lost." 54:00 - Q&R ***Since the tefilah of Bilaam was answered, imagine how HaShem answers the tefilah of a sincere Jew. 56:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 3 - The Importance of Simcha - Mourning the Beis HaMikdash Negates the Tears of Esav - Tears of Am Yisrael - Tefilah - Teshuvah - Shabbos Nachamu - Pesach - Ratzon - 4 Reasons for Geulas Mitzrayim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. The importance
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - The Importance of Simcha - Mourning the Beis HaMikdash Negates the Tears of Esav - Tears of Am Yisrael - Tefilah - Teshuvah - Shabbos Nachamu - Pesach - Ratzon - 4 Reasons for Geulas Mitzrayim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. The importance of simcha . Mourning the Beis HaMikdash negates the tears of Esav . 09:00 - The tears of Am Yisrael express yearning to return to HaShem . 12:00 - When a Jew cries in tefilah , or cries in repentence , this brings HaShem's rescue. 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 29. Shabbos Nachamu . Those who mourn the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash will see the rebuilding of Beis HaMikdash - immediately. 17:00 - The difference between despair and a broken heart. Despair is anger and resentment of HaShem . A broken heart leads to HaAras HaRatzon and simcha . 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 34. Pesach. In the merit of 4 things Am Yisrael was redeemed from Mitzrayim . All 4 reasons were aspects of ratzon . 25:25 - Merit 1: Am Yisrael did not change their names. "The life force of a living thing is in its name." Reference to Likutey Moharan 59 . 33:30 - Only a small percentage of Am Yisrael was redeemed from Egypt. 34:15 - Merit 2: Am Yisrael did not change their language. Loshon HaKodesh expresses yearning for HaShem . "The tongue is the pen of the heart." Speech reveals what a person wants. 36:30 - NOTE: Loshon HaKodesh is not necessarily Hebrew. Speaking loshon hara or divrei chol on Shabbos , even if it's done in Hebrew, is not Loshon HaKodesh . Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 . 38:00 - Merit 3: Refraining from Arayos , and Merit 4: Refraining from idol worship. A person who sins in these two aspects is damaging his heart. 41:00 - Idol worship is the gateway to arayos - impurity between men and women. The creation of the Egel HaZahav - Golden Calf - was intended as a first step toward immorality. Reference to Likutey Moharan 36 . 44:30 - Yetzias Mitzraim is mentioned 50 times in the Torah - alluding to Binah - Ratzon . 45:00 - Am Yisrael was redeemed from Mitzrayim in the merit of Yosef HaTzaddik . 50:50 - The Ten Commandments begins with "I am HaShem Who took you out of Mitzrayim." In every generation Am Yisrael is supposed to consider themselves as those who were redeemed from Mitzrayim . 53:00 - Closing blessings. Tonight is bedikas chometz .

Ratzon - רעוא דרעוין - The 3 Yomim Tovim Parallel Yosef HaTzaddik, Moshe Rabbeinu , and Dovid HaMelech - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. Tokhacha - Who can rebuke? 13:00 - NOTE about Likutey
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - תוכחה - Tokahcha - Who Can Rebuke? What Is Success? Ratzon - רעוא דרעוין - The 3 Yomim Tovim Parallel Yosef HaTzaddik, Moshe Rabbeinu , and Dovid HaMelech - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. Tokhacha - Who can rebuke? 13:00 - NOTE about Likutey Tefilos as a way to pray for the ability to do mitzvos . 18:00 - The word טוב - good - is only truly appropriate for דברים קדושים - all that connects one with faith in HaShem . 30:00 - ***What is true success? Ratzon to do the mitzvos . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal : "Since the whole world was created for me, it's my job to look for what's lacking in the world and to fill that need. HaShem created the world incomplete, so that each person has something to do. But all we can actually do is to pray . Those two words - "to pray" - are the explanation of how this repair can be done: to pray for everything in the world. Tefilah is ratzon - it expresses our desire to repair the world to HaShem , Who is the only One Who can actually complete the repair." 35:00 - NOTE on the lowest spiritual level, called שמד. The highest level is רצון. Moshe Rabbeinu , the tzaddik , is the bridge between the lowest and highest level. 36:30 - Q&R about how to give tokhacha - rebuke - to children. 38:30 - PARAGRAPH 32. Siddur : the tefilah "Tzidkaskha" . Tzedakah generates the light of ratzon . רעוא דרעוין - the three major Yomim Tovim correspond to Yosef HaTzaddik, Moshe Rabbeinu, and Dovid HaMelech .

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 147 - The Prince of Gems - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw30b. Recorded in 1977.) INTRODUCTION to the Sipurey Maasios - The Stories of Rebbe Nachman. Rabbi Rosenfeld zal explains Rabbi Nachman's story "The Prince of Gems" in light of the Zohar HaKodesh to reveal how counting the Omer relates to the 42-letter Name of HaShem alluded to in this story. The story of the Prince of Precious Stones begins. The Jews of the kingdom searched for a tzaddik and found him. An unusually gifted daughter is born to the king. A second hidden tzaddik is found. The princess pretends to be ill. Leprosy is fatal. Through magic, the princess almost kills her brother, the prince. The tzaddik prescribes a remedy for the king. Rebbe Nachman gave permission to interpret his stories: the prince is Moshe Rabbeinu . The precious stones are the souls of Am Yisrael . תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי־קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת - "...the holy stones are scattered at the head of every street" ( Eicha 4:1). The sages of the Gemara say that the mother of Moshe Rabbeinu , Yocheved, gave birth to 600,000 souls - רַבִּי הָיָה יוֹשֵׁב וְדוֹרֵשׁ וְנִתְנַמְנֵם הַצִּבּוּר, בִּקֵּשׁ לְעוֹרְרָן, אָמַר יָלְדָה אִשָּׁה אַחַת בְּמִצְרַיִם שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא בְּכֶרֶס אֶחָת, וְהָיָה שָׁם תַּלְמִיד אֶחָד וְרַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּרַבִּי יוֹסֵי שְׁמוֹ, אָמַר לֵיהּ מָאן הַוָּת כֵּן, אָמַר לֵיהּ זוֹ יוֹכֶבֶד שֶׁיָּלְדָה אֶת משֶׁה שֶׁשָּׁקוּל כְּנֶגֶד שִׁשִּׁים רִבּוֹא שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל ( Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:3). יוכבד begematria is מ"ב. Moshe Rabbeinu became leprous when Basya Bas Paraoh rescued him. How the story of "The Prince of Precious Stones" applies to every Jew. The principle of Klipah Kadma lePri: - the shell/rind precedes the fruit. Explanation of the structure of the Shem Mem Beis - Ana BeKoach . Each line of Ana BeKoach corresponds to one of the days of the week. The third line of Ana BeKoach . The fourth line of Ana BeKoach . The main goal is to strengthen emunah . Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Shavuos - Moshe Rabbeinu - Hisgalus HaRatzon on Pesach - The 4 Merits of Am Yisrael in Mitzrayim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . PARAGRAPH 33. Hisgalus HaRatzon on Pesach . PARAGRAPH 34. The 4 merits of Am Yisrael that protected them spiritually while they were enslaved in Mitzrayim . NOTE - The importance of Torah with tefilah . Torah is not a substitute for tefilah . Am Yisrael spoke Loshon HaKodesh in Mitzrayim . "Holy speech is holy ratzon ." NOTE - Yiddish is an aspect of Loshon HaKodesh . Any language a person speaks during hisbodedus becomes Loshon HaKodesh . Modern Hebrew is not necessarily Loshon HaKodesh . The spiritual connection between niuf - immorality - and avoda zara - idol worship. Reference to Likutey Moharan 36 . משה רבינו - Moshe Rabbeinu - is begematria 613 - he is the Torah. The Bnei Yissachar points out that לב טוב is begematria 49 - corresponding to the 49 days of the Omer . Q&R - How does Shavuos achieve Tikkun HaBris ? The importance of mikveh on Shavuos between midnight and morning.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 3 - Metzach HaRatzon vs. Erev Rav - רעוא דרעוין - HeAras HaRatzon - 3 Elements - Location, Time, Desire - Moshe Rabbeinu - 40 Days on Sinai 3 Times - Rosh Chodesh Elul - Yomim Noraim - Days of Awe - Tzedakah on Erev Yom Kippur - Neilah - Sukkos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey M
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Metzach HaRatzon vs. Erev Rav - רעוא דרעוין - HeAras HaRatzon - 3 Elements - Location, Time, Desire - Moshe Rabbeinu - 40 Days on Sinai 3 Times - Rosh Chodesh Elul - Yomim Noraim - Days of Awe - Tzedakah on Erev Yom Kippur - Neilah - Sukkos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 35. Tetzaveh . Aharon HaKohen is Metzach HaRatzon . 04:45 - *The 3 elements of existence: Olam, Shanah, Ratzon - Location, Time, Desire. The tzaddik connects all 3 categories through his HeAras HaRatzon . 08:30 - וְהָיָ֤ה עַל־מִצְחוֹ֙ תָּמִ֔יד לְרָצ֥וֹן לָהֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה - "It shall be upon his forehead constantly to make them favorable before HaShem" ( Shemos 28:38, Tetzaveh ). 09:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu - 40 days on Har Sinai 3 times. 11:40 - ***The 40 days from Rosh Chodesh Elul to Yom Kippur are days of ratzon . During this time we focus on increasing our yearning to serve HaShem. Ratzon generates yirah . This is why these days are called Yomim NaRaim - "Days of Awe". 14:30 - Q&R - How does ratzon generate yirah ? Everything in "nature" is actually ratzon HaShem . When HaShem performs a miracle it reveals His ability to control the forces of nature through His ratzon . When people see that HaShem is above all other powers, their yirah - respect for HaShem - increases. 16:45 - Tzedakah is an aspect of Hisgalus HaRatzon . The Metzach HaNachash is sustained by people who grow old with anger instead of creativity. Tzedakah defeats the Metzach HaNachash : שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ - "Cast your bread upon the surface of the water, for after many days you will find it" ( Koheles 11:1). 20:45 - ***Q&R about Metzach HaNachash - The evil of "killing time" is a crime again HaShem . The older a person gets, the higher his level of yishuv hadaas , so he's supposed to have higher levels of daas and rachmanos . "A 30-year-old is not the same as a 70-year-old." 24:30 - PARAGRAPH 36. The days of Elul , Rosh Hashanah, and Yom Kippur are compared to a lion. The roshei teivos of these three words spell ari - lion.אַרְיֵ֥ה שָׁאָ֖ג מִ֣י לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א - "A lion has roared; who will not fear?" ( Amos 3:8). Scientists are compared to wild animals - the destructive aspect of "lion" - because they tear souls apart by destroying faith in HaShem . 26:30 - Dovid HaMelech vs. Golias . During the Days of Awe we defeat the Metzach HaNachash . 31:45 - NOTE - this week we are counting the Omer in the midah of Gevurah. Gevurah is begematria Yirah . 33:00 - אִם־יִתָּקַ֚ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּעִ֔יר וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶֽחֱרָ֑דוּ - "Will a shofar be sounded in a city and the people not fear?" ( Amos 3:6). 35:00 - Yom Kippur is the time of ultimate teshuvah - רעוא דרעוין - because sins are transformed into mitzvos - negative is converted to positive. Tzedakah is especially given on Erev Yom Kippur. 37:50 - 5 tefilos on Yom Kippur - Neilah . 42:00 - Tzedakah sweetens Midas HaDin . Tzedakah and tefilah are one - both are Malkhus . 45:30 - The letter Hey in tzedakah refers to the 5 tefilos of Yom Kippur. 46:00 - Q&R about a person's ratzon eliciting HaShem's good will. 46:30 - PARAGRAPH 37. Yirah is a vessel for blessing. Sukkos is the vessel for all the types of chesed generated throughout the Yomim Noraim . During Sukkos a shefa of blessing flows. The Sukkah is a hug from HaShem . 49:00 - Sukkos Dovid HaNofelas. כִּֽי־בְשִׂמְחָ֣ה תֵצֵ֔אוּ - "For with joy you will go forth..." ( Yeshaya 55:12). 54:00 - The 70 korbonos brought during Sukkos on behalf of the 70 Nations. Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Toldos - Hoshana Rabbah - Seal Within a Seal - Tzedakah - Preventing and Repairing Metzach HaNachash - Each Yom Tov Reveals Ratzon HaShem - Arba Minim - Aravos - Willows of the Brook - Sefer Tehillim - Simchas Yom Tov - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 38. Hoshana Rabbah - Seal Within a Seal - Tzedakah . Review of present concepts in the halakha . 06:20 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 07:22 - Brief overview of the meaning of רצון - connecting our will with the will of HaShem . 12:00 - Tzedakah repairs the damage done by Metzach HaNachash : שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְךָ֖ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמָּ֑יִם כִּֽי־בְרֹ֥ב הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽנּוּ - "Cast your bread upon the surface of the water, for after many days you will find it" ( Koheles 11:1). 16:20 - Hisgalus HaRatzon . Seeing the miracles of HaShem generates Yirah , which is a vessel to receive and contain HaShem's Chesed . 25:00 - Q&R about tzedakah . 26:30 - Parshas Toldos. וַיָּ֨שָׁב יִצְחָ֜ק וַיַּחְפֹּ֣ר | אֶת־בְּאֵרֹ֣ת הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּימֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔יו וַיְסַתְּמ֣וּם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים - "And Yitzchak again dug the wells of water which they had dug in the days of his father, Avraham, and the Plishtim had stopped them up..." - ( Bereishis 26:18, Toldos ). 31:00 - Gathering "willows of the brook" for tefilah on Hoshana Rabbah . The aravos in the Arba Minim represent the members of Am Israel who don't have Torah or mitzvos . 34:30 - Raven represents the highest level of tzedakah . Oreyv - raven - is an aspect of Arvei Nachal - willows. 36:30 - Mishna Torah throughout the night of Hoshana Rabbah . 41:00 - It is a custom to recite the entire Sefer Tehillim on Hoshana Rabbah . " Sefer Tehillim is the book of ratzon ." 44:30 - Simchas Torah - the essence of joy is the hisgalus ratzon HaShem . 47:00 - *How can a person be happy if other Jews are suffering? A person has "two pockets". If a person doesn't have simcha , he can't do mitzvos . 48:00 - Listening to music is not permitted during Sefiras HaOmer but we are still obligated to be in a state of joy. 49:00 - *Q&R about being joyful in a world filled with suffering. Analogy of how we are obligated to hold all four of the Arba Minim together. 51:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Mishpatim - Tu BeAv - Metzach HaRatzon - Binyan Beis HaMikdash - Naaseh veNishma - Keeping Body and Soul Together - Living to Eat vs. Eating to Live - Downsizing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 39. Tu BeAv - Metzach HaRatzon - Binyan Be
lessons.bodyText: Oreyv 3 - Parshas Mishpatim - Tu BeAv - Metzach HaRatzon - Binyan Beis HaMikdash - Naaseh veNishma - Keeping Body and Soul Together - Living to Eat vs. Eating to Live - Downsizing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Oreyv 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 39. Tu BeAv - Metzach HaRatzon - Binyan Beis HaMikdash . 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 40. Parshas Mishpatim. Naaseh venishma. וַיִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע - "And he took the Book of the Covenant and read it within the hearing of the people, and they said, 'All that the Lord spoke we will do and we will hear'" ( Shemos 24:7, Mishpatim ). 17:00 - שמע - to listen means that to make a heart connection - it means the ratzon is activated. 18:00 - Naaseh venishma is simcha - keser - determination to do the will of HaShem . Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 19:15 - Q&R - naaseh venishma means ratzon . 20:00 - Q&R - The Torah sometimes attributes human feelings to HaShem to serve as a bridge for people to be able to relate to HaShem . HaShem uses these terms for our benefit, even though emotions don't apply to the spiritual realms. 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 41. Why "Vayehi Noam" is said on Motzei Shabbos : Shabbos is ratzon and light, while weekdays are the domain of the Sutra Achra . The fire of Havdallah marks our entrance into the "work week" and attaches the coming days to the light, holiness, and ratzon of Shabbos . Noam HaShem is another term for HaShem's ratzon . 28:00 - Maleva Malka . 29:00 - Q&R about chokhma - the term noam is begematria 160 - with kolel 161 - HaShem's Name of Chesed . 30:40 - PARAGRAPH 42. The feet correspond to anger - Esav's connection is to Olam HaAsiya . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 43. Keeping body and soul together. All a person's physical needs are called arvus - security. הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ךְ לַֽעֲרֹ֖ב מַֽעֲרָבֵֽךְ - "...to guarantee your necessities" ( Yechiezkel 27:9). Taking care of physical needs through food and clothing enables the nefesh and neshama to stay together. The nefesh is locked into a body which requires physical nourishment. 43:00 - ***NOTE - On Erev Shabbos we say Hodu - neshamos trapped in food and drink receive a tikkun when a Jew eats and drinks. This is the concept of elevating the "holy sparks" in food. 46:00 - ***How the nefesh perceives the physical world. 47:30 - NOTE about Yisro . 49:00 - The Arizal on the order of the Arba Bonim in the Haggadah . 50:00 - When a person is very sick, spiritually, he needs the most powerful "medicine" - the highest level Torah. 52:00 - We eat and drink in order to do HaShem's will, as in: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֜ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ - "Know Him in all your ways, and He will direct your paths" ( Mishlei 3:6). Living to eat vs. eating to live. 54:20 - * Brikhas HaMazon with kavana insures a person's parnassah . 58:30 - Q&R about limiting food intake. There are 3 kinds of tefilos : 1) possul tefilah - asking for physical needs with no spiritual intent, 2) praise of HaShem with no expression of need, and 3) asking for one's needs with the expressed intention of using what we receive to fulfill HaShem's Torah. 64:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal's home being only 40 square meters yet there was a feeling of tremendous wealth because everything was neat, organized, and always welcoming to guests. BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal and his wife raising four children in a two-room apartment. "There was not one extra paper and only the most essential seforim . As soon as he learned a new sefer , he could give it away because now it was in his head." 67:00 - NOTE about downsizing one's home can be a plus at a certain stage of life. Closing blessings.

Vayeishev - Yehudah as Oreyv - Tamar - Moshiach. 06:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 - Tikkun HaBris , tefilah as a double-edged sword. The stronger a person's tikkun habris , the more effective his tefilah . 10:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. The kingdom of Moshiach will be founded on Chesed . Kinyan . 18:00 - Kinyan Sudar. Boaz and Rus . Clothing is Malkhus . Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 . 21:00 - Q&R about kinyan through speech. 23:00 - Making a kinyan is an aspect of Moshiach . Dibur in the presence of a Beis Din creates a kinyan and locks in the obligation of the guarantor. 26:30 - Ruach Elokim / Ruach of Moshiach is present in a Beis Din . 27:45 - The minimum of three members to form a Beis Din corresponds to the three aspects of writing: sefer, sofer, sipur . 29:30 - Q&R. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. *** Sefiras HaOmer is like writing a sefer . Koheles 2:16. 53:00 - ***Memory of HaShem's miracles is restored and renewed through Sefiras HaOmer . 57:00 - HaShem proclaims: "I created the Yetzer HaRa , and I created the Torah as the antidote to it" ( Kiddushin 30). Reference to Likutey Moharan 130 . Of all the physical senses, the sense of smell has the most powerful connection to the soul. 60:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sichos HaRan 149 - The Seven Beggars - Lesson 1 - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Lesson rw33a. Recorded on 1977-09-05.) 00:00 - Introduction to the Sipurey Maasios and to the story of The Seven Beggars . "Even if you don't understand the deeper meanings of the story, if you only hear the words on a simple level, you will understand it more fully in the Olam HaEmes - World of Truth." 03:44 - Seder Yom of Rebbe Nachman. "The sleep of a tzaddik is his visit to heaven." 05:59 - There are two ways to learn Rebbe Nachman's seforim - first at the surface level and then in depth. 08:12 - The Seven Beggars. "I will tell you how people were once filled with joy." 19:20 - A prince mourns his fall from faith. 21:52 - Two lost children cry for help. 22:50 - One after another, Seven Beggars appear. Each one provides the two lost children with food and a mysterious blessing. 28:50 - The two children find a path, reach a town, and decide to become beggars. 32:10 - A pit is dug out to serve as a wedding hall for the two lost children. *34:40 - At times of joy, a person must remind themselves of kindnesses he has received. The children's yearning demonstrates how yearning for the Tzaddik Emes enables him to create garments for any soul, no matter how lost. 36:06 - The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." All blessing is preceded by אתערותא דלתתא. The First (Blind) Beggar reappears at the wedding of the two children and blesses them to "be like him." 41:58 - All seven beggars are one and the same person: the Tzaddik Emes .

Hilkhos Mitaltelin 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 69 . 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. ***There is a spiritual connection between objects and their owner. 11:40 - NOTE about the enforcement of halakha by Beis Din today. 12:30 - HALAKHA 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . 15:30 - הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔י וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י - "The world is the footstool of HaShem" ( Yeshaya 66:1). 17:00 - ***NOTE - Story about the Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh illustrating how a person is shown something in this world because they're supposed to do something about it. Why it's better to learn about life through limud Torah rather than simply through life. 21:00 - Going out to work is a form of resting the brain from the high intensity of limud Torah. Every physical object in this world contains sparks of holiness. 24:00 - Q&R about how to understand HaShem's messages sent through life events. 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. One of the main ways a person connects with Olam HaBa - the Future World - is by conducting business honestly. "Money stands a person on their feet." 32:00 - Connection between the eyes and memory. 34:00 - Loshon Hara damages a person's daas . A tzaddik has the ability to see the good within a person. Defeating the power of imagination through simcha - joy. 37:00 - Ruach and yad are connected, for example through playing a musical instrument. 39:30 - Ra Ayin damages memory. 42:00 - . 42:00 - The tzaddik is Yisod and Knesses Yisrael is Malkhus . 43:00 - Tzedek, Emunah, Emes, and Malkhus - conducting business honestly. 45:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal gained understanding of a person's nature through how they dealt with money. 48:00 - Q&R about the balance between learning Torah and conducting business.

lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 2 - Vayigash - Conducting Business Honestly - Medameh - Imagination Can Justify Stealing - Power of Music - Dreams - Shevuah Is an Aspect of Yisod - Yad - Yosef HaTzaddik - Tikkun Yisod - Neder - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 54 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. 08:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. The Sutra Achra - Medameh - can justify stealing. 13:20 - The Medameh is corrected through Yad . There are two types of imagination - one can be used for kedushah , and one is illusion that allows a person to sin. 15:00 - Maaseh uMatan beEmunah is compared to nigun , as in שְֽׂאוּ־זִ֖מְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹ֑ף - "Raise song and give forth a timbrel..." ( Tehillim 81:3). Reference to Likutey Moharan 7. 26:00 - The negative aspects of Medameh is subdued through music. 27:00 - Dreams are a form of Medameh . 28:00 - Q&R about the procedure in Beis Din to determine the truth between litigants. 29:00 - Mitaltelin - moveable objects. 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Parshas Vayigash . Shevuah is an aspect of Yisod . Yosef HaTzaddik accomplished Tikkun Yisod - וְיוֹסֵ֕ף יָשִׁ֥ית יָד֖וֹ עַל־עֵינֶֽיךָ - "...and Yosef will place his hand on your eyes" ( Bereishis 46:4, Vayigash ). 35:30 - Yom Kippur is compared to Olam HaBah . 36:00 - Q&R - How can an ordinary person do the Tikkun of Yad ? 27:45 - When a person makes a neder or a shevuah , they connect themselves to a higher spiritual level. This is an aspect of Harchavas HaDaas - expansion of consciousness. 47:40 - The goal of mitzvos is to maintain consciousness of Olam HaBah . Through a neder or a shevuah ( Binah/Keser ) new mitzvos are established. 51:00 - Q&R about how a shevuah results in Harchavas HaDaas . 54:00 - Closing blessings.

Yirah : אֶת־יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַֽעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ - "You shall fear HaShem, your Master, worship Him, and cleave to Him and swear by His Name" ( Devarim 10:20, Ekev ). 18:00 - Q&R about Tikkun Yad - voice vs. digital devices for communication. 20:00 - HALAKHA 3. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. What are friends for? Every person needs to speak with a worthy friend regularly so both can strengthen their Yiras Shemayim . 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The need to restrict Taavas Mamon - desire for wealth. Desiring knowledge beyond one's spiritual limitations is dangerous. 38:00 - What is mazal ? Children, wife, and parnassa depend on mazal - a very high level of HaShem's light. Makifim - potential knowledge. "The ways of HaShem are perfect." HaShem is just and righteous with every person, but His ways cannot be understood. 46:00 - Q&R - Dissatisfaction is not "human nature" - it's an attribute of the Yetzer HaRa . 48:45 - Story about the Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh teaching a student the language of the birds. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b - Makifim originate from Mazla . Limiting desire for money. Sipuk - satisfaction. A sense of lack is due to lack of daas - recognition of HaShem . 16:00 - The importance of limiting desire for money. 18:20 - Answering a student's question creates a new makif for the student. 20:00 - People can die because of a sense of lack. Both money and makifim originate from Mazla . 23:15 - A person who wants to live, as opposed to just "exist", needs to fortify his emunah and be happy with what he has. However, if the need persists, through tefilah and through waiting for the right time, the need will be fulfilled. Story of Rabbi Akiva and the wife of a Roman official. 27:00 - Q&R. 28:45 - PARAGRAPH 3. Some makifim are above the dimension of time. 38:00 - Q&R about emunah . 41:00 - The importance of emunah . Reference to Sichos HaRan 32 . "A person needs to strengthen his emunah ." 46:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 91 . The word shemesh alludes to Light. 47:30 - Q&R about dealing with a sense of lack. 52:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE from Rabbi Maimon's life about his engagement to his wife, who is the daughter of Rabbi Rosenfeld zal . 54:30 - NOTE about Sefiras HaOmer . A person shouldn't judge himself by comparing his life to someone else's life. 55:45 - Closing blessings.

Reference to Rebbe Nachman's story of the Sophisticate and the Simpleton . 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . 17:00 - "The more property - the more worries" ( Avos 2:7). 18:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. The prohibition of gezeyla - theft. 31:00 - Q&R about satisfaction referring to all types of shefa , not just money. 32:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Whatever a person has something in his hands, its a sign that it belongs to him. זֶ֚ה | הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֘ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם - "This sea - great and wide..." ( Tehillim 104:25). 34:00 - The seder plate represents all 10 sefiros . The letters of the word קערה represents all ten sefiros . 38:00 - פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן - "You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing its desire" ( Tehillim 145:16). 38:30 - PARAGRAPH 7. Whoever is stronger takes ownership of the disputed item. A person needs to be quick and strong to draw wealth from its Source in order to attain possessions and parnassa . 45:00 - Q&R about the meaning of strength. Gevruah is self control. 47:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Daas is the opposite of illusion. The more daas a person has, the less he is susceptible to sin. The tzaddik is able to bring light to people no matter what their spiritual level. 53:00 - Dynamics of limud Torah: son and student. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 12 . 56:00 - Ayeh Makom Kevodo. 58:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mitaltelin 3 - Rosh Hashanah - Purpose of Creation - Transmission of Daas - Ben veTalmid - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Melo Chol HaAretz Kevodo - Shofar - Waking Up from Spiritual Sleep - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Man is called "shemayim vearetz" - a
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 3 - Rosh Hashanah - Purpose of Creation - Transmission of Daas - Ben veTalmid - Ayeh Makom Kevodo - Melo Chol HaAretz Kevodo - Shofar - Waking Up from Spiritual Sleep - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Man is called "shemayim vearetz" - a combination of heaven and earth. Because man was created on Rosh Hashanah, "the world was created on Rosh Hashanah". 05:30 - The purpose of creation is to reveal the sovereignty of HaShem . Makom Yishuv - a civilized place - is a place where HaShem is recognized as King. 07:30 - The purpose of the Torah is hisgalus HaShem . 08:00 - Q&R - A person is supposed to be conscious of HaShem when they are learning Torah. 09:00 - Rosh Hashanah is on Rosh Chodesh . Two levels of Daas - Ben veTalmid. Ben is a higher level for the transmission of daas , as an aspect of "Ayeh Makom Kevodo" . Talmid is the lower level for the transmission of daas , as an aspect of "Melo Chol HaAretz Kevodo" . 21:30 - Each person should experience both levels with respect to HaShem. 22:30 - NOTE: There is a tradition not to eat nuts on Rosh Hashanah, "because אגוז is begematria חטא". However, these two words are actually not equal in begamtria . How is this resolved? Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : Nachash - the נ is "caught between the teeth" - "שן". 28:00 - NOTE: Story about the Rebbe Reb Zushia zal and the Vilna Gaon zal . 35:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Waking up from spiritual sleep on Rosh Hashanah. 38:00 - Rabbi Eliezer is an aspect of בן while Rabbi Yehoshua is an aspect of תלמיד. 44:30 - The Talmud Yerushalmi warns that a person should not sleep during the day on Rosh Hashanah. 45:30 - The concept of Ben veTalmid is parallel to Rosh Hashana and Rosh Chodesh . The goal of every Jew is to join two concepts together. Rosh Hashana achieves this unification because it coincides with Rosh Chodesh . 48:30 - Ashamnu - who is the "us" in Vidui ? 49:15 - Closing blessings.

Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Mo
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 3 - VaEschanan - Spiritual Sleep - Rosh HaShanah - Back to Back - Yomim HaNorayim - Connection Between Yom Kippur and Chanukah - Ain Ohd Milvado - Satisfaction - Parnassa - Yirah - We Don't Ask HaShem Why - Pray to Know What You Need - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Waking up from spiritual sleep on Rosh Hashanah. "Back to back." 08:00 - Parshas VaEschanan. אַתָּה֙ הָרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִלְּבַדּֽוֹ - "You have been shown, in order to know that HaShem is the Master; there is none else besides Him" ( Devarim 4:35, VaEschanan ). Ain Ohd Milvado. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Yomim HaNorayim - Days of Awe. 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. The connection between Yom Kippur and Chanukah. 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Parnassa. רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֖עשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֜טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי - "...give me neither poverty nor wealth; provide me my allotted bread" ( Mishlei 30:8). 29:00 - **We don't ask HaShem "why?" 33:00 - Satisfaction with one's portion. 40:00 - Parnassa . How to be truly happy. 42:00 - Q&R. 46:00 - **Q&R - Pray to know what you need. 50:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-05-08 - LH7 - CM1 - Mitaltelin 4 - Para. 1-5a
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mitaltelin 4 - Humility of the Tzaddik Is an Aspect of Earth - Koach HaMoshekh - Attracting Force - Koach HaMachriach - Opposing Force - Hagba - Netzach shebe Netzach - Sefiras HaOmer - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. The humility of the Tzaddik is
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 4 - Humility of the Tzaddik Is an Aspect of Earth - Koach HaMoshekh - Attracting Force - Koach HaMachriach - Opposing Force - Hagba - Netzach shebe Netzach - Sefiras HaOmer - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. The humility of the Tzaddik is an aspect of עפר - earth. Therefore he has a Koach HaMoshekh - Attracting Force. 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Wealth and property have an attracting force. 10:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Possessions are spiritually attracted to their owner. 14:00 - וְהָעֹ֚שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ - "And wealth and honor are from before You..." ( 1Divrei HaYomim 29:12). 15:00 - אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹן וְאֶת־דַּכָּא֙ - "...I dwell with the lowly..." ( Yishaya 57:15). HaShem gives to the humble. "Kvodo ratzono" - to honor HaShem we do what He wants us to do. 26:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: Account of the Uman Tzion Rescue in 1979. 28:40 - The most important element of creation is invisible: HaShem . 29:30 - Q&R about Koach HaMachriach . What force opposes the Tzaddik ? 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Shavuos. Sefiras HaOmer. NOTE about Netzach shebe Netzach in Breslov tradition. 34:00 - Customs during Hagba. BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal. The custom is to try to glimpse the written words in the Sefer Torah during the first Hagba and then, holding the Sefer Torah after the second Hagba when removing it from the Bimah , is another chance to access HaShem's light. Reb Michel explained: "You're holding HaShem in your hands - so it's a good opportunity to speak to Him!" 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Sefiras HaOmer. 39:00 - What's our shoresh? HaShem , the Torah, and the tzaddik . 41:00 - Ribui HaShemen - too much oil extinguishes the light. 45:20 - Koach HaMachriach . 49:00 - The Koach HaMachriach must eventually end. Sefiras HaOmer strengthens the Koach HaMoshekh , which draws Am Yisrael , and the world, closer to HaShem . 52:00 - NOTE on gematria : twice MeNaTZPaKH is the source of all dinim .

lessons.title: 2025-05-09 - LH7 - CM1 - Mitaltelin 4 - Para. 5b-8a - Ekev
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mitaltelin 4 - Ekev - Wheat Offering on Shavuos - Sefiras HaOmer - Barley Expresses Shiflus - How Grains Grow - Shem MaH - Through Humility a Person Receives Chiyus Elokus - True Life - Koach HaMoshekh of the Earth - Tzaddik Yisod Olam - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 .
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 4 - Ekev - Wheat Offering on Shavuos - Sefiras HaOmer - Barley Expresses Shiflus - How Grains Grow - Shem MaH - Through Humility a Person Receives Chiyus Elokus - True Life - Koach HaMoshekh of the Earth - Tzaddik Yisod Olam - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 . PARAGRAPH 5b. וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י - "...and the measure of my days..." ( Tehillim 39:5). Days are elements of measure. רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם - "Go down, warn the people..." Shemos 19:21, Yisro ). PARAGRAPH 6. On Shavuos the korbon is wheat, which is a higher spiritual level than barley. Barley is considered food for animals, while wheat is for humans. Chesed is directly below Chokhma - both emanate from the right side. Foolishness comes from the left side: lack of Daas - Midas HaDin . Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 . בְּחַבְלֵ֨י אָדָ֚ם אֶמְשְׁכֵם֙ בַּֽעֲבֹת֣וֹת אַֽהֲבָ֔ה - "I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love..." Hoshea 11:4). Adam - Moshekh - Ahava are all on the right. Using Midas HaDin correctly includes making oneself as obedient as an animal before HaShem . The fool, even if he has studied Torah, behaves as if he's smart. However, he blocks others from the truth and from the tzaddik by setting himself up as an authority. NOTE about the humility of Rabbi Chaim Vittal zal and Rav Noson of Nemirov zal . NOTE: a Nazir must bring a sin offering because he denied himself one of the pleasures of this world - wine. However there is also a concept of limiting physical pleasures - at least during the week. For example we leave over a bit of food on the plate after eating during weekdays. The goal of limiting oneself is not to deny HaShem's bounty, but to increase our shiflus - humility - so we can receive more of His light and shefa . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about how Rav Moshe Burstein zal discovered Breslov through the Likutey Tefilos . When he passed away at the age of 98, he had over a thousand descendants, B"H . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal : "A Breslov chassid has to be in the world and out of the world." Q&R about religious people, whether misnagid or chassidish , who oppose the Breslov derech of enjoying the physical world, but in a contained way. PARAGRAPH 7. Spiritual aspects of cutting the grains during harvest. How does grain grow? The life-force in the earth enters plants. The earth has Koach HaMoshekh . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 88 . Ikar HaChiyus - the highest level of HaShem's Name is the Shem MaH. The most powerful Koach HaMoshech is the Tzaddik - "Tzaddik Yisod Olam" . Q&R about humility, earth, and Malkhus. The Shem MaH has two aspects, one of which is accessed through shiflus . Parshas Ekev. וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ - "... and you will eat and be sated" הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם - "Beware, lest your heart be misled..." ( Devarim 11:15-16, Ekev ). How to prevent arrogance that can arise through eating. "You're going to eat and be satisfied - watch out!" Humility is strengthened through saying blessings, observing kashrus , and with awareness that one is in the Presence of HaShem . Arrogance is an aspect of Avoda Zara . A person isn't permitted the pleasure of eating unless he makes blessings on the food. PARAGRAPH 8. The concept of counting and numbers. Numbers apply to gashmius and Koach HaMachriach , both of which depend on Shem MaH . All the diversity of creation came from nothing. Creation is diverse yet ultimately one, but this cannot be understood through intellect. We accept this with emunah - faith. Analogy of an air machine in a gas station that's used to fill tires. Q&R about different customs regarding the length of the mourning period during Sefiras HaOmer . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 4 - Parshas Reeh - Sefiras HaOmer - Days are Vessels - Connecting Tzimtzim to Koach MaH - Time Comes From Koach HaMachriach - Shavuos - Koach HaMoshekh - Cutting the Grains - LaG BeOmer - Tikkun Leil Shavuos - Staying Awake on Shavuos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 . PARAGRAPH 8b - לִמְנ֣וֹת יָ֖מֵינוּ כֵּ֥ן הוֹדַ֑ע וְ֜נָבִ֗א לְבַ֣ב חָכְמָֽה - "So teach the number of our days, so that we shall acquire a heart of wisdom" ( Tehillim 90:12). Parshas Reeh. מֵֽהָחֵ֤ל חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ בַּקָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל לִסְפֹּ֔ר - "...from the sickle is first put to the standing crop, you shall begin to count..." ( Devarim 16:9, Reeh ). Sefiras HaOmer begins with the time when cutting the grains begins. אֶרֶץ נָֽתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ - "The earth gives forth its produce" ( Tehillim 67:7). PARAGRAPH 9. Practical application of the concepts presented in this halakha : Koach HaMachriach is fueled by arrogance. Humility will draw a person to the truth by subduing the Koach HaMachriach . Emes leAmito - there are levels of truth. NOTE about the Rav Noson of Nemirov zal's son Reb Yitzchak zal traveling by boat to Eretz Yisrael . He was in Meron for the yahrzeit of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal. Q&R about what blocks a person from being close to a tzaddik . PARAGRAPH 10. Tikkun Leil Shavuos . The beginning of a sefer is an aspect of Koach HaMoshekh . The conclusion of a sefer is an aspect of Koach HaMachriach . ***NOTE about chinuch bonim - educating/raising children - transmitting daas - awareness of HaShem - to the next generation. ***Q&R - Priorities for Tikkun Leil Shavuos : First recite the תרי"ג מצוות and then follow with the rest of the Tikkkun Leil Shavuos . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal on Shavuos . NOTE about Rabbi Chaim Spring shlit"a . PARAGRAPH 11. Staying awake on Shavuos night. When we stay awake through the entire Leil HaShavuos we are disciplining the body to serve the soul. By converting the Koach HaMachriach to Koach HaMoshekh the physical body, and the physical world, is transformed by stages to a spiritual state. Through death and kosher burial the physical body becomes part of the earth, which is the ultimate shiflus - lowliness. Techiyas HaMeisim - resurrection of the dead. Humility: when a person is resurrected, it's only the person's shiflus that comes back to life. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 72 . Koach HaMoshekh is an aspect of earth. Sleep is one-sixtieth of death. The perfection of the neshama is achieved through putting restraints on the body. Q&R. Closing blessings - tonight is Pesach Sheni .

Hilkhos Mitaltelin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 70 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 11b. Sefiras HaOmer - Shavuos - Sleep Is Good for the Bad and Bad for the Good - Techiyas HaMeisim - Koach HaMoshekh - Koach HaMachriach . 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Both the Yetzer Tov and the Yetzer HaRa can be used to bring a person closer to HaShem . This is achieved by means of Sefiras HaOmer. 11:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Life is a unification of body and soul. 13:15 - צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֖כֵל לְשֹ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר - "A righteous man eats to sate his soul, but the stomach of the wicked shall feel want" ( Mishlei 13:25). 14:45 - The essence of chiyus - life force - is the desire to come closer to HaShem . 08:00 - Achilas Etz HaDaas Tov VeRa - Eating from the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil - Chadash is not permitted until after the Korbon Omer is brought. 20:30 - NOTE: Making a blessing before eating transforms the Koach HaMachriach into the Koach HaMoshekh . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. לַֽעֲשׂ֬וֹת רְצֽוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֜תוֹרָֽתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי - "HaShem, I desired to do Your will and Your law within my innards" ( Tehillim 40:9). Rashi : what's the connection between the stomach and the Torah? All of my eating is based on performing HaShem's will. 24:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal explained why, even though it's permitted to drink while wearing tefillin , we usually don't do that in our generation. 27:00 - Q&R about eating or drinking while wearing tefillin for any length of time after tefilah . 28:15 - PARAGRAPH 15. Koach HaMoshekh and Koach HaMachriach are parallel soul and body respectively. 31:00 - Parshas VaEschanan. אָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־לְבָֽבְךָ֥ - "You shall love HaShem with all your heart..." ( Devarim 6:5, VaEschanan ). The Talmud ( Brochos 61b) explains that loving HaShem with one’s whole heart means serving Him with both the Yetzer HaTov and the Yetzer HaRa . Yitzra is begematria aish . The goal in this world is to convert the physical into the spiritual and harness both the positive and negative aspects of our ratzon . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 49 . 34:00 - HALAKHA 5. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 36:30 - NOTE: The first time Reb Shimon zal came to Rebbe Nachman, the Rebbe told him three stories. The first: when a tzaddik gives a devar Torah, it generates a tremendous flow of chiddushei Torah. The third story had to do with a rebbe not giving his student permission to leave. 39:45 - The Zohar HaKadosh brings that the efforts of tzaddikim are focused on clothing the Shekhina HaKedosha in garments of light through revealing razin - secrets of the Torah. 41:30 - Note about a recent commentary on the Likutey Moharan by Rabbi Attiah shlit"a . The colors of the rainbow allude to the three Avos . 44:00 - Preparing a beautiful garment for a tzaddik brings about a sweetening of dinim . 45:30 - The tzaddik is compared to the rainbow. The custom of children playing with a bow and arrow on LaG BeOmer . 48:00 - Raz is begematria ohr . The 3 sounds of the shofar correspond to the 3 basic colors of the rainbow and the 3 Avos: Avraham, Yitzchak, veYaakov. Mentioning the names of the Avos sweetens dinim . This is why to begin the Shemoneh Esrei we mention the 3 Avos . 52:00 - Closing blessings. Reference to Likutey Moharan 6 .

lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 5 - Parshas Korach - Squatter's Rights - Rosh Hashanah - Kedushas Eretz Yisrael in Chutz LeAretz - Eretz Yisrael Is Acquired Through Tzaddikim - Every Tefilah and Teardrop Counts - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. 09:30 - Q&R about Korach being listed in Shemos HaTzaddikim . 11:10 - Q&R about Korach leading a rebellion against the Tzaddik Emes. Moshe Rabbeinu will eventually complete Korach's tikkun . The Baal Shem Tov HaKadosh forgave a woman who wanted to throw a rock at him but didn't have the strength. He understood that her intentions were good. 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. HILKHOS CHEZKAS KARKAOS 5. Squatter's rights. Three basic colors of the rainbow correspond to the three years that a person lives on a property which establish his residence there. 18:50 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 42 . The three basic colors of the rainbow correspond to the sefiros of Chesed , Din , and Rachamim . NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : Rachamim is a combination of Chesed and Din . These three are the foundation of all the sefiros . 20:45 - The importance of traveling to the kivrei tzaddikim on Erev Rosh Hashanah. 23:45 - לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן־הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־יַגִּ֥ידוּ לְךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל - "...you shall not divert from the word they tell you, either right or left" ( Devarim 17:11, Shoftim ). 25:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Real estate in chutz leAretz (the diaspora) that is owned by a Jew becomes an aspect of Eretz Yisrael , because a Jew is able to draw the holiness of Eretz Yisrael to wherever he does mitzvos. Reference to Likutey Moharan 61 . 29:40 - Eretz Yisrael is an aspect of Emes . 30:45 - PARAGRAPH 11. On Rosh Hashanah, one of the main goals is to draw upon ourselves the holiness of Eretz Yisrael . As we say 7 times during the repetition of the Perek Lamenatzeyach just before the shofar is sounded: "Establish us in our Land" . 34:30 - מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־יֹ֜֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ - "Out of Zion, perfection of beauty, HaShem appeared" ( Tehillim 50:2). 35:10 - Eretz Yisrael can only be acquired through tzaddikim , as in צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ - "The righteous shall inherit the Land..." ( Tehillim 37:29). 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. 37:30 - *Every word of tefilah of Am Yisrael and every tear they shed in tefilah conquers another piece of Eretz Yisrael . 38:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 - Rabba Bar Bar Chana - the fire built on the back of a fish. Chiddush on this story heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal - Gevurah, Binah, Hey - "Gabei" . 44:30 - Q&R about respect due to Torah leaders in Am Yisrael who are not Breslov. 46:45 - PARAGRAPH 13. Encouragement to never stop davening . Analogy of a woman being pregnant but not yet realizing it. 49:40 - The holiness of Eretz Yisrael is an aspect of the holiness of every Jew. 52:00 - Q&R - how do we know who the true tzaddikim are? 54:20 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 5 - Parshas HaAzinu - Secrets Throughout Creation - Daled Minim - The Four Species - Esrog - Lulav - Debate Between the Shepetovka and the Noda BeYehuda - The Tzaddik Is Revealed through His Students - True Emunas HaChakhomim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. 10:00 - כֻּ֖לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ - "...You made them all with wisdom..." ( Tehillim 104:24). 11:00 - NOTE: Rebbe Nachman told his students: "Through me, you can get an idea of how great HaShem is." 12:00 - Parshas HaAzinu. NOTE: No two tzaddikim are alike. There is a vast different between one tzaddik and another. The Zohar HaKodesh describes the difference between Yishaya HaNavi and Moshe Rabbeinu . 16:45 - PARAGRAPH 15. The Daled Minim - the Four Species. Yosef HaTzaddik is 6 times Y - K - V - K . Esrog, Lulav, Hadassim, Aravos. The tzaddik attaches himself to each of the Daled Minim . 21:00 - The Esrog represents Malkhus - the Shekhina HaKadosha . The tzaddik is revealed through the light he shines into his students. 24:30 - NOTE: Account of the Shepetovka and the Noda BeYehuda . 35:00 - צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח - "The righteous one flourishes like the palm..." ( Tehillim 92:13). 38:50 - כִּ֥י עֵֽ֜דְו‍ֹתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽי - "...for Your testimonies are my conversation..." - ( Tehillim 119:99). The tzaddik unites the highest level students with the lowest level students. 40:40 - The Esrog can remain on its branch from year to year. This represents the devoted, loyal students of the tzaddik , such as Yehoshua was to Moshe Rabbeinu . 43:30 - True Emunas HaCHakhomim is consciousness of one's rebbe constantly. The Zohar HaKodesh describes the tzaddik as an "Ilana Rabba veYakira" . 46:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 186 . 47:30 - NOTE: Story #1 - The Baal HaTanya. ***Story #2 - The Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh and Reb Yechiel Michel zal of Zlotchev - "Michel! 'Bist a am haaretz?" Story #3 - Reb Mordechai of Lizhensk zal - his rebbe didn't permit him to leave. 52:30 - Shaking the Daled Minim hints to the world that HaShem Hu Elokim - Ain Ohd - HaShem is the Master of the World. There are things the Tzaddik can't say - but he can hint. Only the Tzaddik's closest students understand these hints and are the Tzaddik's link to be able to bring his message to the world.

lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 5 - Bereishis - Noach - Ohr Is Raz - Secrets Throughout Creation - Ruach Moshiach - Rosh HaShana - Rainbow - Shofar - Singing Tefilos Sweetens Dinim - Colors of the Voice - Zaaka - Nigun - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. Parshas Bereishis. Deep secrets are hidden throughout creation. The Four Types of Darkness draw energy from Chokhmos Nefulos - ideologies that deny the existence of HaShem . 06:00 - "רז and אור are one thing" ( Zohar I:140a and Zohar Chadash, Bereishis :8d). All creation stands on one foundation: the Tzaddik ( Havakuk ). 07:15 - PARAGRAPH 17. The four types of tikkunim that sweeten dinim at any time, but especially on Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. 13:00 - Tikkun HaBris . The 270 soundings of the shofar . 17:00 - Parshas Noach. The colors of the rainbow correspond to the sounds of the shofar . 19:40 - The special nigunim - melodies - for the tefilos of Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur generate the "colors" that sweeten dinim . 21:00 - When a person sings the words of tefilah , this sweetens dinim . 23:15 - Raising the voice during the tefilos of Rosh HaShanah. 28:00 - מִמַּֽעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה - "...From the depths I have cried out You, HaShem" ( Tehillim 130:1). 30:00 - HaShem listens carefully to the sound and colors in our voice when we pray or say a blessing in order to sweeten the sounds from the depths of our heart. 32:00 - *The colors of the voice correspond to the colors of the rainbow. At Sinai we "saw the sounds". 34:50 - *Crying out to HaShem sweetens the voice, both physically and spiritually. 38:30 - PARAGRAPH 18. Kittel - the white garment worn on Yom Kippur - Garments of Light sweeten dinim . 42:00 - לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ| כִּתְלָ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר - "...clothing white as snow..." ( Daniel 7:9). 45:00 - Emunas Chokhomim is the essence of a Talmid Chokham . ( Sanhedrin ). 48:45 - NOTE: The story of Reb Chaikel zal , Rebbe Nachman's chazon , giving a blessing to a poor family in the presence of the Rebbe. After the poor person was blessed with wealth, the Rebbe asked him, "Did you have a chance to look up at the sky today?" A person needs to be careful when giving blessings because we don't know who needs what.

lessons.title: 2025-05-21 - LH7 - CM1 - Mitaltelin 5 - Para. 19-22
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mitaltelin 5 - Rosh Hashanah - Emunas Chokhamim Creates Garments of Light - Shemini Atzeres - Simchas Torah - Greatness of Sefer Tehillim - Perek 119 - Rain - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. Traveling to Tzaddikim for Rosh Hashanah. Chokhm
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 5 - Rosh Hashanah - Emunas Chokhamim Creates Garments of Light - Shemini Atzeres - Simchas Torah - Greatness of Sefer Tehillim - Perek 119 - Rain - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. Traveling to Tzaddikim for Rosh Hashanah. Chokhmah is received through emunah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 1 . 02:30 - Vayhi Yadav Emunah. Haftara of Shavuos - Yechezkel HaNavi - Maaseh HaMerkavah . Opening words of this prophecy begin with the letters that spell אמונה. 04:20 - Denial of HaShem's constant supervision due to belief in nature is a form of spiritual sleep. 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. Garments of Light. Tikkun Cheyt Adam HaRishon . Tikkun HaBris . Wasting seed creates souls without bodies. These souls are repaired through the Garments of Light generated through Am Yisrael's emunas chokhomim . 12:00 - Q&R about tikkunim requiring taking some physical action. Emunas chokhomim is the first step in the tikkun process. 13:10 - PARAGRAPH 21. Shemini Atzeres - Simchas Torah. 17:00 - שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה | אֶחָֽד - "Hear, O Israel: HaShem is our Master; HaShem is one" ( Devarim 6:4, VaEschanan ). The letters of the Shema hint to the word ליבש - clothing. 19:00 - Sefer Tehillim is the perfection of song. Through its praises for HaShem , the Torah, and tzaddikim it proclaims the greatness of HaShem to the entire world. מָֽה־רַבּ֬וּ מַֽעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ | יְהֹוָ֗ה כֻּ֖לָּם בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ - "How great are Your works, HaShem! You have made them all with wisdom..." ( Tehillim 104:24). 26:00 - By avoiding philosophy and choosing instead the Torah, a person achieves וְהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֘ שָׁת֪וּל עַל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֚ר פִּרְי֨וֹ | יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְ֖עָלֵהוּ לֹ֣א יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ - "He shall be as a tree planted beside rivulets of water, which brings forth its fruit in its season, and its leaves do not wilt; and whatever he does prospers" ( Tehillim 1:2). 29:00 - *In praise of Sefer Tehillim . 31:30 - Tehillim 119 contains 8 possukim for each letter in the Aleph Beis . This expresses the central theme of Sefer Tehillim - yearning to HaShem to be able to fulfill the Torah. 33:20 - Tehillim 119 contains 8 possukim for each of the 22 letters of the Aleph Beis . Why? 7 Refers to the physical world. 8 refers to the Olam HaMalbush , the higher spiritual levels. 37:20 - PARAGRAPH 22. Tefilas HaGeshem on Shemini Atzeres . The rainbow is a reminder of HaShem's covenant with the world. Garments of Light are in the colors of the rainbow. A day of rain is a sign that HaShem is sweetening dinim" - negative judgements. 40:10 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about the yichud between Kudsha Brich Hu veShekhinta that is accomplished by tzaddikim . יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ - "Their friend preaches to them..." ( Iyov 36:33). "Friend" is the tzaddik . 42:10 - "A day of rain" refers to the ultimate tikkun for the sin of Adam HaRishon . 46:00 - The body is a garment for the neshama . This garment must be removed through death and then purified through burial, until the body is transformed into a garment of pure light, as in וְ֜יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ - "...and they will stand up like a garment" ( Iyov 38:14). 47:30 - Rain is compared to Techiyas HaMeisim . גשם - rain - is the opposite of מבול - flood. 49:00 - The rainbow is a sign that there are dinim active in the world. Rain on Shemini Atzeres is a sign of blessing. 51:20 - Q&R - a person can make "Garments of Light" on a practical level by: 1) Listening to the sounds of the shofar on Rosh HaShanah. 2) Giving tzedakah to clothe tzaddikim and that will be distributed by them to clothe those in need.

Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Singing the words
lessons.bodyText: Mitaltelin 5 - Bereishis - Sichos Chulin - Mundane Conversations of the Tzaddik - Daled Minim - Esrog - Garments of Light - White Includes All Colors - Emunas Chokhomim - First Ani Maamin - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Mitaltelin 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 42 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Singing the words of tefilah contributes to sweetening dinim . Through proper song, the colors of the keshes are revealed. The Tzaddik is an aspect of keshes - rainbow. 06:45 - Parshas Bereishis. The four kingdoms of darkness. 11:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 81 . To reach and uplift Jews who are distant from HaShem , the tzaddikim engage with the tzibur at times through sichos chulin - mundane conversations. 12:14 - NOTE about how how Rebbe Nachman only spoke words of mundane conversation when apostates were in his presence. 15:50 - אור בגימטריה רז. 17:10 - The sukkah is a hug from HaShem . 18:00 - Sichos Chulin . Insights about how each of the Daled Minim corresponds to a different aspect of the Tzaddik . 22:45 - The beauty of the esrog is related to the Torah of the Tzaddik Emes . 24:50 - The Tzaddik Emes of the generation is the trunk of the tree, all the other tzaddikim of the generation are the branches. 25:20 - Q&R about the Tzaddik Emes speaking through his students. 26:00 - Unlike other kinds of fruit, the esrog lives on its branch even through a number of seasons. Yehoshua never left Moshe Rabbeinu . The esrog alludes to Emunas Chokhamim . 29:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 186 . 30:00 - NOTE about the passing of Rebbe Nachman. 31:30 - Tikkun HaBris. Garments of Light. White includes all colors. 36:00 - Emunas Chokhomim. 38:00 - The name of the malakh "Samech Mem" is begematria 100. The number 101 refers to an entirely different spiritual level. The Vilna Gaon explained the difference between reviewing Torah 100 times vs. reviewing Torah 101 times. 39:00 - NOTE about a magician on a ship who tried to annoy the rabonim on board by causing the ship to stop moving. The rabonim broke the spell through using the letters Mem Lamed Tav - Roshei Teivos מְכַשֵּׁפָ֖ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּֽה - "You shall not allow a sorceress to live" ( Shemos 22:18, Mishpatim ). 40:40 - Q&R about the repair of souls before Moshiach's arrival. 44:45 - Rosh Hashanah is the beginning of creation. The sounds of the shofar correspond to Emunas Chokhomim . 49:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal saying the first "Ani Maamin " with tremendous kavana every day after Shacharis . 50:00 - Closing blessing.

lessons.title: 2025-05-23 - LH7 - CM1 - Chezkas Karkaos 1 - Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Para. 1-3 - Parshas BeHar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Chezkas Karkaos 1 - Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Parshas BeHar - Ownership of Real Estate - Connection Between Nefesh and Dibur - Power of Speech - Wealth - 3 Years of Orlah - Aitza of the Tzaddik is Zera Emes - Eretz Yisrael Belongs to HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. Kilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 1 is based
lessons.bodyText: Chezkas Karkaos 1 - Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Parshas BeHar - Ownership of Real Estate - Connection Between Nefesh and Dibur - Power of Speech - Wealth - 3 Years of Orlah - Aitza of the Tzaddik is Zera Emes - Eretz Yisrael Belongs to HaShem - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. Kilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 69 . 04:30 - שִׁמְעוּ כִּֽי־נְגִידִ֣ים אֲדַבֵּ֑ר - "Listen, because I will speak of wealth" ( Mishlei 8:6). 05:45 - "One who doesn't own real estate is not a person" ( Yevamos 63). NOTE about Rabbi Rosenfeld zal commenting with humor about his "permanent residence" on Har HaZeisim . 08:00 - For the first 3 years after purchasing a property, a person needs to present documented proof of ownership. This is related to the first 3 years of a tree's life when its fruit is forbidden, and the 3 klipos - negative forces - that cannot be integrated into kedusha . 11:30 - Sheker is one of the 3 entirely evil forces. 14:40 - For the first 3 years after a person acquires property, his ownership can be challenged ( Bava Basra 29). 17:00 - Yaakov Avinu is compared to Torah ShebeKsav - the Written Torah. Emes eliminates sheker . 19:00 - The Written Torah is threefold, because it is emes , which is a composite of 3. 20:00 - HALAKHA 2. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 25:30 - Tzedek and Emunah are one when Malkus is plugged into Emes . 26:00 - Q&R about Emes and Emunah . The trustworthiness of person can be evaluated through his ability to control his 1) money, 2) intoxication, 3) anger. 28:45 - A person achieves Emes through following the advice of a tzaddik . When a person receives advice from a tzaddik , he's receiving the seed of his future actions. וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣יךְ שׂוֹרֵ֔ק כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת - "Yet I planted you a noble vine stock, throughout of reliable seed..." ( Yirmiyah 2:21). 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. בְּטַ֥ח בַּֽ֖יהֹוָה וַֽעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֜֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה - "Trust in HaShem and do good; dwell in the Land and be nourished by faith" ( Tehillim 37:3). 35:00 - The letters of writing in a document of ownership corresponds to the Zera Emes received from the Tzaddik . What establishes the document are the letters in the names of the witnesses who sign the document. The signatures of the two witnesses are the two legs on which Emes stands. 37:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. בִּקֵּ֣שׁ קֹהֶ֔לֶת לִמְצֹ֖א דִּבְרֵי־חֵ֑פֶץ וְכָת֥וּב יֹ֖שֶׁר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֱמֶֽת - "Koheles sought to find words of delight and properly recorded words of truth" ( Koheles 12:10). 39:30 - A document that establishes ownership is called a sefer , as in שָׂד֞וֹת בַּכֶּ֣סֶף יִקְנ֗וּ וְכָת֨וֹב בַּסֵּ֥פֶר - "Men shall buy fields for money and inscribe deeds and sign ..." ( Yirmiyah 32:44). A deed for real estate/ownership document corresponds to the Written Torah, which is Emes . 41:00 - Moveable objects contain sparks of souls and are an aspect of Emunah . 42:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 280. Ownership of moveable objects do not require a document of ownership. 45:00 - At night, the Shekhina HaKedosha descends downward to rescue holy sparks that need elevation. This dynamic also applies to land/real estate. 46:00 - Parshas BeHar. וְהָאָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִצְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי־לִ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ - "The Land shall not be sold permanently, for the Land belongs to Me..." ( Vayikra 25:23, BeHar ). Real estate in Eretz Yisrael is never sold permanently because this Land belongs to HaShem . Refinement of the holy sparks in Eretz Yisrael is accomplished through its temporary owners. 48:00 - NOTE - Chizuk for Shabbos : to the extent a person invests himself in the observance of Shabbos , he is transformed and spiritually elevated throughout the week. 50:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-05-25 - LH7 - CM1 - Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Para. 4 - Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Para. 1-2a - Parshas BeHar
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Parshas BeHar - Emunah - Moveable Property vs. Real Estate - Written Torah - Oral Torah - When Tefilah Is Like Thunder - Ownership of Land Relates to Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Emunah . Move
lessons.bodyText: Chezkas Karkaos 2 - Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Parshas BeHar - Emunah - Moveable Property vs. Real Estate - Written Torah - Oral Torah - When Tefilah Is Like Thunder - Ownership of Land Relates to Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Emunah . Moveable Property vs. Real Estate - Written Torah - Oral Torah. 03:00 - Parshas BeHar. Transferring ownership of real estate or land is a process of geulah . 05:00 - Haftara of BeHar . HaShem hints that Am Yisrael will be redeemed by telling Yirmiya HaNavi that Am Yisrael will acquire fields: קְנֵ֣ה לְךָ֗ אֶת־שָׂדִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽעֲנָת֔וֹת כִּ֥י לְךָ֛ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַגְּאֻלָּ֖ה לִקְנֽוֹת - "...Buy for yourself my field that is in Anathoth, for the right of redemption is yours to buy it" ( Yirmiyah 32:7). 07:40 - Emes is a prerequisite for emunah . 08:00 - Q&R about the connection between real estate and emunah . 12:30 - Owning property in Eretz Yisrael is a spiritual accomplishment. 13:00 - Tefilah controls the paths of the stars and constellations. The 12 signs of the Zodiac correspond to the 12 nusachim of tefilah , the 12 months of the years, and the 12 shevatim . Reference to Likutey Moharan 9 . 15:30 - וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣יךְ שׂוֹרֵ֔ק כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת - "Yet I planted you a noble vine stock, throughout of reliable seed..." ( Yirmiyah 2:21). 16:30 - The 3 daily tefilos are aspects of אמת. The 3 Avos correspond to the 3 daily tefilos ( Brochos 26). 18:30 - When a person has clear ownership of property 3 years, it is established that the property belongs to him. 21:40 - The produce of land depends on emunah . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 23:00 - NOTE: לֶכְתֵּ֚ךְ אַֽחֲרַי֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה - "...your following Me in the desert, in a land not sown" Yirmiyah (2:2). 25:00 - HALAKHA 3. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 27:40 - Sometimes it's necessary to hide a tefilah within a story. 29:00 - A mitzvah is a complete organism and exists within time, space, and nefesh . 30:00 - Thunder straightens out the heart and brings simcha , as in א֖וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה - "Light is sown for the righteous, and for the upright of heart, joy" ( Tehillim 97:11). A person can generate thunder by establishing strong focus into their tefilah .This level of focus is reached by clearing extraneous thoughts from the mind. 33:20 - If the mind is stuffed with extraneous thoughts, the tefilah can't resonate. This is similar to the sound of a musical instrument if the instrument is clogged with something so its sound can't be heard. 34:50 - Tefilah is also strengthened when a person doesn't have yiros nefulos - "fallen fears" - needlessly intimidation or lack of self confidence. 36:00 - גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה - "Rebuke the wild animals of the swamp..." ( Tehillim 68:31). These wild animals refer to Esav and Yismael . 40:16 - PARAGRAPH 2. Reference to Likutey Moharan 61 . Eretz Yisrael. 48:00 - Closing blessings.
