lessons.title: 2025-05-26 - LH7 - CM1 - Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Para. 2b-10 - Parshas Bo
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Parshas Bo - Acquiring Eretz Yisrael - Thunder - Shemiras HaBris - Esav - Yismael - Wild Animals of the Swamp - Simcha shel Mitzvah - Rosh Hashanah - Joy of the Sukkah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b . 05:00 - גְּעַ֨ר חַיּ
lessons.bodyText: Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Parshas Bo - Acquiring Eretz Yisrael - Thunder - Shemiras HaBris - Esav - Yismael - Wild Animals of the Swamp - Simcha shel Mitzvah - Rosh Hashanah - Joy of the Sukkah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b . 05:00 - גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה - "Rebuke the wild animals of the swamp..." ( Tehillim 68:31). - " Wild animal of the swamp" refers to Esav and Yismael - they are the negative forces that hover over Eretz Yisrael during Am Yisrael's exile. They are strengthened if Am Yisrael is weak in Shemiras HaBris . 10:00 - All real estate owned by a Jew anywhere in the world is affected by the klipos of Esav and Yismael . To protect from the damage caused by these negative forces, a Jew needs to purify and guard his thoughts. 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parshas Bo . וְהָיָ֣ה כִֽי־יְבִֽיאֲךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֡ה אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַ֠כְּנַֽעֲנִ֠י - "And it shall that HaShem will bring you into the land of the Canaanites..." מַצּוֹת֙ יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְלֹא־יֵֽרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֜ חָמֵ֗ץ וְלֹא־יֵֽרָאֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ שְׂאֹ֖ר בְּכָל־גְּבֻלֶֽךָ - "Matzos shall be eaten during the seven days, and no chometz shall be seen of yours , and no chometz shall be seen of yours throughout all of your borders" ( Shemos 13:5-7, Bo ). Eretz Yisrael is acquired through the mitzvah of matzah and being careful not to eat chometz on Pesach . This applies during the entire year through not permitting impure thoughts to dwell in one's mind. Sometimes such thoughts may suddenly occur, but if a person immediately focuses on something else, the impure thought will dissipate and cause no harm. 15:30 - PARAGRAPH 4. When a person has mastery over their thoughts, his tefilah becomes like thunder, which enables him to experience the true joy of doing a mitzvah . Thunder straightens out the heart and brings simcha , as in א֖וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה - "Light is sown for the righteous, and for the upright of heart, joy" ( Tehillim 97:11). 18:50 - NOTE about current events. The whole world is focused on taking Eretz Yisrael away from Am Yisrael . 20:00 - *Q&R - by gaining mastery over our thoughts we can merit Eretz Yisrael . 21:00 - Ownership of land is demonstrated through benefiting from the produce of that land. Produce is a result of simcha - the life-energy generated into all that a person owns. 26:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. Rain in Eretz Yisrael benefits the entire world. 30:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 48 . All the tefilos of the world ascend through Eretz Yisrael . Am Yisrael cannot truly acquire Eretz Yisrael until we purify our thoughts. 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Tefilah bekoach and tokias hashofar on Rosh Hashanah. The holiness of Eretz Yisrael is drawn from the tefilos and tokias hashofar of Rosh Hashanah. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Rosh Hashanah is the beginning of our teshuvah through activating the thunder of tefilos and tokias . On Yom Kippur our sins are eliminated as a result of the teshuvah done from Rosh Hashanah through the Ten Days of Teshuvah . 36:30 - "Light is sown for the righteous..." ( Tehillim 97:11). 38:20 - Perfection of tefilah is achieved on Yom Kippur through the 5 Kolos /5 Gevuros of HaShem corresponding to the 5 tefilos on Yom Kippur since Neilah is added. ( Tehillim 29). 41:00 - Q&R - what are machshavos zaros - foreign thoughts? 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Thunder smooths out the crookedness in the heart and leads to joy. 43:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. Simcha shel mitzvah . A person experiences their Olam HaBah through his performance of a mitzvah in joy. Sukkah is an aspect of Olam HaBah , as in וְסֻכָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְצֵל־יוֹמָ֖ם מֵחֹ֑רֶב - "And a sukkah shall be for shade by day from the heat..." ( Yeshayah 4:6). 45:30 - Sukkah is an aspect of Binah - the "mother who hovers over her children". 49:00 - *** Sukkos is a time of joy. 50:30 - PARAGRAPH 10. The culmination of Am Yisrael's joy is on Shemini Atzeres . Simchas Beis HaShoeyva . 55:20 - HaShem's joy and Am Yisrael's joy unite on Simchas Torah . ***שלמות השמחה - The perfection of joy is when we don't expect some future reward, but the joy of the moment is enough. 56:50 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Chezkas Karkaos 3 - Tefilas SheLaH HaKodesh on Erev Rosh Chodesh Sivan - Parshas Emor - Sukkos - Netilas Daled Minim - Drawing Olam HaBah into the Heart - Esrog Can Stay on Tree 3 Years - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - NOTE: Why Breslov chassidim travel to Meron for Erev Rosh Chodesh - the connection between Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal and Rebbe Nachman of Breslov. 06:40 - NOTE: Today - Erev Rosh Chodesh Sivan - is considered an opportune time to say the tefilah of the SheLaH HaKodesh ( Shnei Luchos HaBris ). 11:30 - PARAGRAPH 11. Sukkos - Netilas Daled Minim . 14:15 - The main place for simcha is the heart ( Tehillim ). 14:30 - *A person is a composite of Olam HaZeh and Olam HaBah . 17:00 - The goal is to bring daas into the heart. Reference to Likutey Moharan 154 and reference to 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 18:20 - NOTE about brain and heart in Avodas HaShem . Hisbodedus helps a person accomplish this. 23:45 - ***By waving the 4 Minim we are bringing joy into the heart. 25:00 - Esrog. 27:00 - Parshas Emor. וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הָֽרִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַֽעֲנַ֥ף עֵֽץ־עָבֹ֖ת וְעַרְבֵי־נָ֑חַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם - "And you shall take for yourselves on the first day, the fruit of the hadar tree, date palm fronds, a branch of a braided tree, and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice ..." ( Vayikra 23:40, Emor ). 28:50 - PARAGRAPH 12. The esrog is the essence of the Daled Minim . In the esrog, Olam HaBah and Olam HaZeh become one. 31:00 - Olam HaZeh is compared to planting a tree. Olam HaBah is compared to eating the fruit of the tree. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. The reward of Olam HaBah is compared with harvest, as in בֹּֽא־יָבֹ֥א בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֜שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו - "...he will come back with song, carrying his sheaves" ( Tehillim 126:6) - roshei teivos נביא - Olam HaBah . 37:00 - Perfection of simcha is experience the joy of Olam HaBah while we are in Olam HaZeh . 38:00 - Skakh - why the covering of the sukkah can be done only with discarded leaves, not with fruit. 42:00 - *The Skakh and the Daled Minim are collected from things that grow from the grown because simcha is connected with the Land giving forth its produce. 43:00 - Esrog is unusual as it can continue on the tree from season to season for 2 or 3 years ( Rashi ). 46:00 - Fruit represents joy - the purified produce of the plant. The three years that the esrog can remain on the tree relate to the purification of time, space, and nefesh . 48:15 - Rosh Hashanah purifies all 3 klipos . It's the esrog specifically that has the ability to draw joy into the heart. 50:30 - Q&R about Olam HaZeh and Olam HaBah . Analogy of a king who exiled his ministers.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Chezkas Karkaos 4 - Nizkey Shekheynim 1 - Parshas Balak - 3 Years of Orlah - Preventing Squatter's Rights on Real Estate - Damage Caused by Neighbors - Connection Between Wealth and Soul - Ayin HaRa - Evil Eye - Shavuos - Akdamus - Story of Sambatyon - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedication. 02:00 - HALAKHA 4.
lessons.bodyText: Chezkas Karkaos 4 - Nizkey Shekheynim 1 - Parshas Balak - 3 Years of Orlah - Preventing Squatter's Rights on Real Estate - Damage Caused by Neighbors - Connection Between Wealth and Soul - Ayin HaRa - Evil Eye - Shavuos - Akdamus - Story of Sambatyon - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Dedication. 02:00 - HALAKHA 4. Hilkhos Chezkas Karkaos 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 82 . 04:52 - Ownership of property established after the first 3 years. All litigation emanate from the 3 central klipos - sources of all negativity. After the first 3 years of a tree's live, these 3 klipos have dissipated. 08:00 - If the owner of property is silent for 3 years and doesn't voice any challenge to the tenants/squatters, then the tenants/squatters have established ownership. 10:30 - Silence eliminates litigation. Voicing ownership cancels a tenants claims on real estate. 12:00 - HILKHOS CHEZKAS KARKAOS 5 was brought previously in Chezkas Mitaltelin 5:9 . 12:30 - HILKHOS NIZKEY SHEKHEYNIM 1. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Nizkey Shekheynim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 14:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. It is important to maintain distance between neighbors. 18:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 68. The nefesh and ashirus - wealth - originate from the same place. 20:00 - NOTE: In order for a sefer Torah to be kosher, no two letters can be touching. 22:30 - ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֙יִת֙ בְּבַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְשָׂדֶ֖ה - "Woe to those who join a house to a house; a field to a field they draw near" ( Yishayah 5:8). 24:00 - Issur Hasagas Gevul. All Jewish souls are rooted in Eretz Yisrael . Kilyaim - it's forbidden to mix two different types of produce. 25:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Parshas Balak. Ayin HaRa - Evil Eye - damage can be caused by gazing with jealously on someone else's property. Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . 28:30 - Pegam HaBris is related to Ayin HaRa . Bilaam vs. Yosef HaTzaddik . 32:20 - PARAGRAPH 3. The order of the Mishnah, Noshim is next to "Nezikin" because wealth depends on the wife. "Honor your wives so that you will be wealthy" ( Bava Metzia 59a). 35:20 - NOTE about Akdamus on Shavuos . Story about the confrontation between a Jewish community and a non-Jew with powers of Ayin Hara . The river Sambatyon separates this world from the next. 43:20 - NOTE - Yaakov Avinu brought 400 men with him when he met with Esav - 400 is begematria רע עין. Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Nizkey Shekheynim 1 - A Mezuzah Is a Miniature Sefer Torah - Daled Amos - Minimum Size of a House, Room, or Door - Kinyan Sudar - Good Neighbors - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkey Shekheynim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - Daled Amos - 4 Alephs of Holiness - Reference to Likutey Moharan 28 . These
lessons.bodyText: Nizkey Shekheynim 1 - A Mezuzah Is a Miniature Sefer Torah - Daled Amos - Minimum Size of a House, Room, or Door - Kinyan Sudar - Good Neighbors - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkey Shekheynim 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - Daled Amos - 4 Alephs of Holiness - Reference to Likutey Moharan 28 . These both correspond to the 4 Mochin - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 66 . 04:50 - In order to require a mezuzah, a house, room, or door must be Daled Amos wide. The mezuzah is the origin of a person's life-force and wealth. The mezuzah drives any negative forces. 07:00 - Holiness requires both place and preparation. Sometimes the preparation is more important than the mitzvah itself. The importance of saying "LeShem Mitzvah" before doing a mitzvah . 08:20 - Space in front of the entrance to a person's home also must be Daled Amos wide. 10:00 - A person should have a designated place in his home reserved for avodas HaShem . Reference to Likutey Moharan 28 . 12:00 - NOTE - Daled Amos corresponds to the 4 letters of Shem HaShem - Y - K - V - K . The total of each letter squared is begematria מקום. 13:00 - The Daled Amos outside a person's door is a place where he can store things he needs. A person's shefa begins from Chkokhma - corresponding to the D aled Amos outside his front door. 17:00 - NOTE - a mezuzah chases away negative forces. מזזות is זז מבת. How Rabbi Rosenfeld zal taught his students to kiss the mezuzah . Begematria , the mezuzah is אמת - it is a miniature Sefer Torah . 26:00 - If something in a public area falls within a person's Daled Amos , the person can acquire it. Reference to Likutey Moharan 134 . 27:00 - "If you haven't acquired daas, what have you acquired?" ( Nedarim 41). All acquisitions are achieved through chokhmah . 29:30 - Q&R about kissing the mezuzos inside a house: it's not necessary but some people do, and there's no need to stop them. 31:30 - Q&R about the Daled Amos in front of a person's home. 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Kinyan Sudar. Transfer of ownership from one person to another through both people holding onto an article of clothing. Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. "All that HaShem has in this world are the Daled Amos of halakha" ( Brochos 8). 39:00 - NOTE about the hashgacha that R' Nasan was asked to speak on the topic of halakha at a recent gathering. 44:00 - NOTE - Story about Reb Noach the "klepper" - who hung signs in Yerushalayim . Tehillim - a unit called "machaneh" needs protection. Har is two times machaneh . Sadeh is three times Machaneh . The third wall of this protective structure. Bayis is 4 times machaneh. Each of the 3 Avos put up a protective wall. Moshe put up the roof of this protective structure - VaEschanan is 5 times machaneh . Reference to Likutey Moharan 10 . 48:00 - Closing blessings to be good neighbors and have good neighbors.

lessons.title: 2025-06-12 - LH7 - CM1 - Nizkey Shekheynim 2 - 3 - Good Fences Make Good Neighbors
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Likutey Halakhos - Choshen Mishpat 1 - Nizkey Shekheynim 2 - 3 - The Importance of a Fence or Partition Between Neighbors - Why Close Relatives Are Not Permitted to Marry - Pi Sheneyim - Anger Harms Parnassah - The Letter Aleph - Two Names of HaShem - The Hebrew Vowels Are Created Through Kisufim - Longing - Speaker: R
lessons.bodyText: Likutey Halakhos - Choshen Mishpat 1 - Nizkey Shekheynim 2 - 3 - The Importance of a Fence or Partition Between Neighbors - Why Close Relatives Are Not Permitted to Marry - Pi Sheneyim - Anger Harms Parnassah - The Letter Aleph - Two Names of HaShem - The Hebrew Vowels Are Created Through Kisufim - Longing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Nizkey Shekheynim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 36 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. If people are too close, they draws life energy from one another which causes spiritual and physical harm. Establishing and maintaining consistent, strongly enforced, healthy distance between people creates a vessel for blessing for each individual. The letters of the Aleph-Beis , when in array according to their order, face away from one another. 04:00 - Why close relatives are not permitted to marry. 12:00 - Reference to end of Likutey Moharan 36 . It's important to put up a fence or partition to prevent people looking into one's property. 13:00 - NOTE about the Aleph-Beis being written in order. 14:15 - HALAKHA 3. 15:15 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Nizkey Shekheynim 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 61 . Each tzaddik has 2 ruachs - one above in Gan Eden , and one below on earth. The principle of Pi Shneyim . 18:00 - Anger harms parnassah . 23:00 - Structure of the letter Aleph - two Yuds connected by a Vuv . Two Names of HaShem include how His Name is written, and how His Name is pronounced. Y - K - V - K (how HaShem's name is written) is potential. A - D - N - Y (how HaShem's Name is said) is actualization. And the Vuv of the Aleph represents the six letters between the two Yuds . Yud corresponds to Patach . 28:30 - Parnassah depends on honesty. Being dishonest is putting on a performance for others, which is disrespect to HaShem . 36:00 - The vowels of Loshon HaKodesh are created through kisufim - holy yearning. Obstacles generate kisufim . Kisufim destroy obstacles. 41:00 - פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן - "You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing its desire" Tehillim 145:16). The separation of the two yuds creates a kli . 42:00 - Q&R about how kisufim destroy obstacles. 44:00 - NOTE about the kisufim of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal to reach Eretz Yisrael in order to meet his teacher, Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal .

lessons.bodyText: Nizkey Shekheynim 4 - Neighbors - Mishkan - Aleph-Beis - Vision - Balak - Korach - Batim Increase Factorially - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The Mishkan was built through the gathering of neighbors. The letters of the Aleph-Beis are the building blocks of creation 05:40 - PARAGRAPH 5. Combining the letters of the Aleph-Beis is done through the power of vision. 09:00 - Ayin HaRa. Misuse of vision causes a shattering of the vessels that contain blessing. 10:45 - Parshas Balak . Bilaam saw the modesty of Am Yisrael's encampment. ( Bamidbar 24:5, Balak ). 12:40 - Rashi explains that "Your Tents" also refers to the Mishkan . 15:45 - A good neighbor brings his tefilah to the community. Tov letzadik, tov leshekheyno. Parshas Korach . 18:00 - The Mishkan was built on the good relationships between neighbors. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. עַל־כָּל־שְׁכֵנַי֙ הָֽרָעִ֔ים הַנֹּֽגְעִים֙ בַּֽנַּֽחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הִנְחַ֥לְתִּי אֶת־עַמִּ֖י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנְנִ֚י נֹֽתְשָׁם֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמָתָ֔ם - "...Concerning all My wicked neighbors who touch the inheritance that I have given My nation, Israel, to inherit, behold I uproot them from upon their land..." ( Yirmiyah 12:14). 22:00 - *** Tznius requires privacy. "Blessing is found in things that people don't see." 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. There should be no hefsake between washing the hands for bread and making the blessing. Reference to Likutey Moharan 4. 26:00 - Tefilah is the wellspring of Torah. 30:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 20 . The importance of turning Torah into tefilah . 32:00 - It is important to ask HaShem to "help me not look where I'm not supposed to look." Through tefilah a person can reformat all the letters that were disarranged by their sins and turn them into teshuvah and mitzvos . 34:40 - The generation of batim - holy structures - is through tefilah . 36:00 - When a person turns Torah into tefilah, HaShem receives a pleasure that hasn't existed since the time when the Beis HaMikdash stood. 38:00 - Q&R about excess modesty being the opposite of tznius . 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. HaShem's ways are different from the ways of people. 42:45 - *** Sefer Yetzirah : five stones can generate 120 combinations (5 factorial). Six stones can generate 6x5x4x3x2 - 720 combinations. As a result of the 6th person who joins the tefilah , the power of the tefilah increases factorially. 51:40 - חָבֵ֣ר אָ֖נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֜לְשֹֽׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ - "I am a companion to all who fear You and to those who keep your precepts" ( Tehillim 119:63). 54:00 - Is it vitally important to be a contributing part of a community. "Five people can chase away 100 enemies." 60:00 - Closing blessings. This week is Yom Kippur Katan . 61:00 - Q&R about a woman davening even though she's responsible for the housework.

lessons.bodyText: Nizkey Shekheynim 4 - Korach - Neighbors - Tefilah - Multitude of Batim - Factorial - A Soul Is Like Speech - Ketores - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas Korach . 03:45 - PARAGRAPH 10. וַתִּקְרֶ֩אנָה֩ ל֨וֹ הַשְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת שֵׁם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יֻלַּד־בֵּ֖ן לְנָֽעֳמִ֑י וַתִּקְרֶ֤אנָה שְׁמוֹ֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד - "And the women neighbors gave him a name, saying, 'A son has been born to Naomi,' and they called his name Oved..." ( Rus 4:17). 10:50 - The nefesh is compared to speech. A soul is created when letters are joined together. 11:30 - When the final geulah dawns, it will arrive quickly. 12:15 - PARAGRAPH 11. The importance of gathering and joining the Tzaddik . A person should make an effort to dwell in a place where there are people who want to come close to holiness through praying with kavana . 18:00 - *** Batim - structures of holiness - are created through the combinations of Jewish souls and letters of tefilah . 20:23 - Parshas Korach. Opposition to the Tzaddik Emes recurs in every generation. Every true tzaddik is an aspect of Moshe Rabbeinu . 22:30 - NOTE - When rabbis in the present time oppose Breslov. 23:40 - PARAGRAPH 12. Reference to Likutey Moharan 67 . 26:45 - *** "Tov letzaddik, tov leshekheyno." 28:00 - אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי לִשְׁקֹד עַל־דַּלְתֹתַי יוֹם ׀ יוֹם לִשְׁמֹר מְזוּזֹת פְּתָחָי: - "Fortunate is the man who listens to me to watch by my doors day by day, to watch the doorposts of my entrances" ( Mishlei 8:34). 32:00 - The wife of Ohn Ben Peles saved her husband from the makhlokes of Korach . 35:00 - Q&R - Tefilah protects one from the influence of a bad neighbor. 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Parshas Korach. Ketores. 47:50 - As a result of gathering to the tzaddik , a "Kiryas Oz" - powerful city - is created. 48:45 - PARAGRAPH 14. The Bnei Korach in Sefer Tehillim - the tikkun of Korach in the future will come from his righteous children. 50:30 - The name "Korach" is composed of the sofei teyvos of צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָ֣ר יִפְרָ֑ח - "The righteous one flourishes like the palm..." ( Tehillim 92:13). 53:00 - Closing blessings. NOTE about the importance of visiting one's rabbi on Rosh Chodesh .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Nizkey Shekheynim 4 - Neighbors - Korach - Beis HaMikdash Is Built Through Tefilah - Batim - Rebuilding Yerushalayim - Mateh Aharon - T efilah Bevechinas Din - Achieving Kavana - Tehillim 122 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. 02:00 - יְרֽוּ
lessons.bodyText: Nizkey Shekheynim 4 - Neighbors - Korach - Beis HaMikdash Is Built Through Tefilah - Batim - Rebuilding Yerushalayim - Mateh Aharon - T efilah Bevechinas Din - Achieving Kavana - Tehillim 122 - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. 02:00 - יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֜עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו - "Jerusalem rebuilt as a city unified" ( Tehillim 122:3). 04:30 - All the nidachim -outcasts - will be gathered in. 05:15 - "The holy stones will be gathered in, to give praise to HaShem" ( Yishayahu ). 06:30 - A multitude of batim is built through Am Yisrael gathering to join in tefilah . " Yerushalayim Ihr ...kiryas oz" 08:20 - HaShem will be recognized in her palaces ( Tehillim 122). "As is Your Name..." 09:00 - "Circle Yerushalayim - her great towers... wondrous rebuilding of Yerushalayim". 10:30 - Yerushalayim is the place of the ingathering of all tefilos . When the homes in Yerushalayim are built, no neighbor feels constricted because all are joining for tefilah . This brings a great light into the physical homes of Yerushalayim , so that no Jew will say, "I don't have room in Yerushalayim." 13:30 - PARAGRAPH 15. Parshas Korach . 14:40 - Tefilah bevechinas Din. The Din of Shevet Levi was very strongly attached to Korach . 23:00 - The Right Side in Kabbalah. Reference to Likutey Moharan 5 . 24:15 - NOTE: When davening Shemonah Esrei , the two hands should be held together, with the right hand on top of the left. This can be done when praying without or a siddur . I can also be done when holding a siddur , by supporting the siddur with the left hand, and turning the pages and holding the pages open with the right hand . 28:00 - Why Korach's punishment was "The earth swallowed them up. " The punishment of Korach generated awe of HaShem , and in the future this will serve to save Korach and his followers. The Sutra Achra will be forced to return them. 32:00 - Tzaddik cetamar yifrach - sofei teivos Korach . 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. The staff of Aharon HaKohen. Mateh - staff - represents Tefilah bevechinas Din . 35:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 1 . Angels are created through the Dvar HaShem . 37:00 - Parshas Berov Am Hadras Melech." Multitude of Batim in tefilah generates tremendous life energy, including that in all vegetation. Therefore the Staff of Aharon blossomed. Similarly, on Rosh Hashanah, when multitudes gather to pray, the life energy in all things in greatly increased. The first letters of "and he cast his staff before Pharaoh" spell "veyipalel" as in the tefilah of Pinchas , who used Tefilah Bevichinas Din . 42:00 - HALAKHA 5. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 9 . 45:00 - Everything in creation receives its life force through tefilah . 47:50 - NOTE: Malkhos is tefilah , Tiferes is emes . 48:30 - When a person begins to daven , the negative forces surround him. The solution to this is emes - sincerity in tefilah . There are always openings in the darkness of extraneous thoughts. The clouds of negativity are sent to strengthen our kavana . Reference to Likutey Moharan 9 . 53:00 - "Even though you're not davening with passion, daven with honesty." 55:30 - "HaShem's truth is your shield" - Am Yisrael is protected by emes . 57:00 - Q&R about achieving kavana in tefilah . Ideally, a person should put joy and passion into tefilah , but if the Sutra Achra surrounds him with extraneous thoughts, simple honesty will rescue the person and bring him to a stronger level of kavana .

lessons.bodyText: Nizkey Shekheynim 4 - Neighbors - Shutafim beKarka 2 - Balak - Ayin HaRa - Window vs. Lamp - Tzaddik Emes - Unity Within Diversity - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nizkay Shekheynim 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 9 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Vision. Window vs. lamp. 06:53 - Emes . A person should not look at things directly, but only "from the side". 08:00 - Attachment to the Tzaddik Emes protects a person ability to perceive the truth. 10:00 - It is forbidden to position the window of one's home directly facing directly into the window of one's neighbor. Every tribe had its own path through the Yam Suf . This alludes to the twelve different nusachim of tefilah . The diversity of Am Yisrael is important. 13:00 - "Whether a person does more or does less - his intention should be for the sake of Heaven." It's forbidden for a Jew to look at another Jew in a negative way. 27:10 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parshas Balak. Bilaam saw Bnei Yisrael according to their tribes. Ayin HaRa. The success of Am Yisrael is based on honesty in prayer. Bilaam was always looking for what's wrong with a person. 33:00 - "Mah tovu ohelecha" - *If a person doesn't try to analyze the thinking of another, or judge the behavior of another, he will not come to perceive the other as bad. Honoring the privacy of other enables emes and achdus . 35:15 - כִּ֣י בֵיתִ֔י בֵּית־תְּפִלָּ֥ה יִקָּרֵ֖א לְכָל־הָֽעַמִּֽים - "For My house will be a house of prayer for all people" ( Yishayahu 56:7). 41:00 - Q&R to clarify the analogy concerning the difference between a window and a lamp. A truth that causes conflict is not always the kind of truth HaShem seeks. 44:00 - Q&R about prayer for establishing truth in business dealings. Reference to Tefilah 9 in Likutey Tefilos . 45:00 - Shutafim beKarka 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Laws concerning a shared courtyard. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 2 is based on the end of 2Likutey Moharan 2 . Unity within Diversity. 55:00 - Q&R. 57:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-07-07- LH7 - CM1 - Shutafim beKarka 2 - Unity and Diversity of HaShem - Rishus HaYachid - Shabbos - Blessings
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Shutafim beKarka 2 - Unity and Diversity of HaShem - Rishus HaYachid - Shabbos - Blessings - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Reference to LM___:6 - Peulos mishtanos - How can HaShem , the Essence of Unity, create such vast diversity in His Creation? 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. When two or more people own pr
lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 2 - Unity and Diversity of HaShem - Rishus HaYachid - Shabbos - Blessings - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. Reference to LM___:6 - Peulos mishtanos - How can HaShem , the Essence of Unity, create such vast diversity in His Creation? 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. When two or more people own property jointly, this demonstrates both diversity and the unity of HaShem . Jointly owned property is an aspect of Rishus HaYachid, not Rishus HaRabim . 06:00 - Daled Amos represents the four letters of HaShem's Name Yud - Hey - Vuv - Hey . 07:30 - Rishus HaRabim is under the jurisdiction of the Sutra Achra . Rishus HaYachid is under more direct supervision of HaShem , and the Sutra Achra is not permitted to draw from it. 14:00 - On Shabbos it is prohibited to transfer something between the Rishus HaYachid and the Rishus HaRabim . 21:00 - Q&R. 22:30 - *Transferring between private and public domain is done only during the six days of the week. By honoring Shabbos through refraining from this transfer, and all other type of melakha , the work done throughout the weekdays is elevated to the holiness of Shabbos . 29:00 - "Those who taste Shabbos are blessed with life." 36:30 - Q&R. The more we are conscious of HaShem's Presence and Unity, the more we draw His life energy into all we do. 38:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. The four partitions or walls that define a private domain. Three of these partitions must be at least 10 tefachim high, and 4 amos wide. 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Eruv . 50:40 - Bread is one of the most important food. Diversity receives from HaShem's unity through eating. 52:00 - צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֖כֵל לְשֹ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑וֹ - "A tzaddik eats to sustain his soul" ( Mishlei 13:25). 53:00 - The blessing "Asher Yatzar" praises the diversity of HaShem . 57:30 - By saying a blessing over every different item we eat, we connect it to its Source and reveal the unity of HaShem within the diversity. Shabbos is the ultimate revelation of HaShem's unity, therefore eating is very important on Shabbos . 61:00 - Closing blessings.

Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Trying to understand things that are beyond a person's ability is an aspect of Ayin Ra - Evil Eye. To prevent looking into and thinking about the lives of others - a person needs to have partitions in his brain. 06:10 - Sipurey Maasios - the Taam says of the shoes he makes "Why should I look into what others are doing?" 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. 10:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. 17:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Binyan Beis HaMikdash is an aspect of daas . 20:00 - סְיָג לַחָכְמָה, שְׁתִיקָה - Silence is a "wall" that gives spiritual protection ( Avos 3:13). 28:30 - Emunah is revealed through speech. פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים וְיָבֹ֥א גֽוֹי־צַדִּ֖יק שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֱמֻנִֽים - "Open the gates, so that a righteous nation, awaiting the realization , may enter" ( Yeshaya 26:2). 31:45 - The importance of doors, locks, and bolts to protect entrance-ways. 32:20 - Mezuza . Reference to Likutey Halakhos , Yoreh Deah 2, Hilkhos Mezuza 3 - Para. 5. 35:20 - PARAGRAPH 6. Chanukah. The difference between chokhma and foolishness, is like the difference between light and darkness. 39:00 - The Chanukah lights can not be put to any practical use to honor the fact that their light is only spiritual. 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Yaakov Avinu gathered his sons together before his petira to reveal secrets of Am Yisrael's future. The blessings he gave to the shevatim brought holiness into every part of Am Yisrael . 50:30 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 2 . The ultimate purpose of a Jew is to bless HaShem . Through blessing HaShem , one receives blessing. Blessings of Yaakov Avinu and Moshe Rabbeinu . 54:50 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Chalukas Shutafim - Vayechi - Menashe - Ephraim - Silence Protects Wisdom - Mezuza - Daled Amos - 4 Mochin - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - Review. 01:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Parshas Vayechi. Yaakov Avinu blessed Menashe and Ephraim before he blessed his 12 sons. 04:00 - In the context of this lesson, emunah is equivalent to daas . Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 10:30 - Meaning of the name Ephraim : even in situations of poverty and oppression, HaShem has compassion and allows Am Yisrael to prosper - HaShem's kindness never stops. 14:00 - Yaakov Avinu switched the order of the blessing Yosef HaTzaddik's sons, placing the younger brother Ephraim before his elder, Menashe . 19:30 - "His descendants will fill the nations" - refers to Torah outreach and bringing recognition of HaShem throughout the world. 22:30 - הָקִ֨יצוּ וְרַנְּנ֜וּ שֹֽׁכְנֵ֣י עָפָ֗ר - "...awaken and sing, you who sleep in the dust..." ( Yeshaya 26:19). 24:30 - The most essential blessing is sekhel . Reference to Likutey Moharan 24 . 27:30 - Q&R. 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas VeZos HaBerakha. HaShem prevented Yaakov Avinu from revealing the secrets of the final redemption. 35:00 - It is important to know when to give over Torah and when to stop. Torah wisdom is protected by silence. 37:00 - Q&R What is the best thing to bless our children with? Daas . 38:10 - PARAGRAPH 10. Avraham Avinu's question to HaShem's gift of Eretz Yisrael : "How will I know?" HaShem revealed all the exiles to Avraham Avinu . גאל in Atbash is כתר. 41:45 - PARAGRAPH 11. "We sit alone in silence" ( Eicha ). "Be silent before HaShem and your enemies will be wiped out" ( Tehillim ). 44:00 - There's a time to daven , and a time to be silent and wait. "Silence is our greatest praise" of HaShem ( Tehillim ). 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Hilkhos Chalukas Shutafim. Mezuzah . The minimum size of a room that needs a mezuzah is 4 amah by 4 amah . A courtyard may not be partitioned between two neighbors unless each neighbor will still have and area of 4 amah x 4 amah . 51:00 - Why does a Jew needs a home? To achieve Daas . 54:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 - The Three Weeks. The size of a room needs to be 4 amah x 4 amah corresponding to the 4 mochin .

Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH
lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Chalukas Shutafim - Sins Are a Burden - Daas - Ben veTalmid - Parnassah - Matzranus - Property Rights - Boundaries - Story About the Power of Silence - Parshas Pinchas - Air of Eretz Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Chalukas Shutafim. Sins are a burden that interfere with parnassah. Daas helps a person rid themselves of sins and therefore helps a person achieve true wealth. 15:00 - Q&R about robots taking over jobs. Automation does not give a person the daas to use time wisely. In fact, advances in technology often make life more difficult, spiritually. 17:30 - PARAGRAPH 14. Matzronos. Property Rights. Boundaries. A neighbor who shares a property boundary has first rights in purchasing that property. 24:00 - ***NOTE - story heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal - how a chassidish Rebbe defended a widow simply through his silence. 28:00 - Parshas Pinchas. יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהֹוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָֽרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל־הָֽעֵדָֽה - "Let HaShem, Master of spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation" ( Bamidbar 27:16, Pinchas ). A qualified leader of Am Yisrael must have the ability to relate to the vast differences between every Jew. 32:00 - וְיָֽדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם וַֽהֲשֵֽׁבֹתָ֘ אֶל־לְבָבֶ֒ךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד - "And you shall know this day and consider it in your heart, that HaShem is Master in heaven above, and upon the earth below; there is none else" ( Devarim 4:39, VaEschanan ). 33:30 - Every person has particular limit to his daas . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 35:10 - PARAGRAPH 15. A Jew's portion in Eretz Yisrael is defined by his daas . 37:00 - "The air of Eretz Yisrael makes one wise". 42:00 - Parshas Shoftim. ***Even though we interact with others to "civilize the Land" it's very important not to look closely into what another person has. Most arguments and unjustified hate originate from looking at the mistakes of others. Broadcasting negativity and judgement attracts the negativity and judgement of others, as in לֹ֤א תַסִּיג֙ גְּב֣וּל רֵֽעֲךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּֽבְל֖וּ רִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים בְּנַֽחֲלָֽתְךָ֙ - "You shall not pull back your neighbor's landmark, which the earlier ones have set as borders in your inheritance..." ( Devarim 19:14, Shoftim ). 46:00 - NOTE about sinas chinam - unwarranted hatred originates from putting others "under a magnifying glass" . 47:00 - "Do not judge another until you have reached his place" ( Avos 2:4). 51:00 - Every person's perception of HaShem is entirely unique, as in כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יָדַעְתִּי כִּֽי־גָד֣וֹל יְהֹוָ֑ה - "For I know that HaShem is great..." ( Tehillim 135:5). Reference to Sichos HaRan 1 . 52:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Matzranus - Property Rights - Ki Sisa - Silence - Maaseh Merkava - Kabbalah Is Taught Selectively - Eruv Rav - Half-Shekel - Mochin deKatnus - Mochin deGadlus - Harchavas HaDaas - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15b. Silence
lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Matzranus - Property Rights - Ki Sisa - Silence - Maaseh Merkava - Kabbalah Is Taught Selectively - Eruv Rav - Half-Shekel - Mochin deKatnus - Mochin deGadlus - Harchavas HaDaas - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15b. Silence protects wisdom. Maaseh Merkavah - Kabbalah Is Taught Selectively - Secrets of the Throne. 07:00 - ***The importance of mastering silence. Although Torah is to be shared through speech, a person's deepest, most essential perception of HaShem's light cannot be communicated; therefore one needs to ask HaShem for guidance, every day, about when and with whom to speak and when and with whom to be silent. 11:00 - לֶךְ־רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְאַֽהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַֽעֲלֹ֥ת - "...Go, descend, and you shall ascend, and Aaron with you, but the priests and the populace shall not break to ascend ..." ( Shemos 19:24, Yisro ). 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. Daas is conveyed through speech about what will transmit fear of and respect for HaShem . Am Yisrael's task is to expand the mind from Mochin deKatnus - constricted consciousness to Mochin deGadlus - expanded consciousness of HaShem . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 22 . 30:00 - The Eruv Rav damages Mochin deGadlus . 32:00 - Greek Philosophy originated in Mitzrayim . The mitzvah of giving the Half-Shekel Tribute to the Mishkan is the antidote to the negative influence of the Eruv Rav . 33:00 - Parshas Ki Sisa. Shekalim - the Half- Shekel Tribute. 34:00 - NOTE: Shekhina is begematria 601. Klal Yisrael is 600 Alef (thousand). Shekhina is equivalent to Knesses Yisrael . However, through machtzis hashekel , with each Jew giving half a shekel, is an aspect of Rotzo ve Shov - the process of elevation to HaShem . On one hand a person strives to approach the highest level of perception of HaShem , but on the other hand, recognize his personal limitations. 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. Matzranus. Property Rights. An immediate neighbor has first rights in purchasing property. NOTE about Kedushas Eretz Yisrael. 42:00 - Harchavas HaDaas. Three things that give a person harchavas HaDaas - expanded consciousness - the ability to "think big" - dirah naeh, keylim naeh, isha naeh . 48:00 - Nekuda tova - Finding the good point in a neighbor. Reference to Likutey Moharan 282 . 50:00 - Q&R - A person can understand their spiritual boundaries through emunas chokhomim. 55:00 - Closing blessings about striving to expand one's consciousness every day.

lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Matzranus - Machtzis HaShekel - Counting Am Yisrael - Chokhom veTaam - Siyag leTorah - When to Be Silent - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 25. Machtzis HaShekel - Counting Am Yisrael - 60 Thousand - Achdus . 09:00 - It's best not to hear too much from a Torah teacher who is not one's Rabbi. Each person must establish his own Siyag leTorah - "Fence around the Torah" to maintain careful boundaries and regulate the measure of what they receive from others. This concept is related to Am Yisrael being warned to use shekalim to count members, and not to count the members themselves. 12:45 - Reference to Sanhedrin 48. NOTE about Sipurey Maasiyos - Chokhom veTaam . 16:00 - NOTE heard from Reb Michel Dorfman zal - The Taam got frightened when he heard that the Satan was calling for the Chokhom because the Simpleton's faith had been weakened by engaging in conversation with the Sophisticate. 22:00 - NOTE based on Megilas Esther : When to build a Fence Around the Torah - when to be silent. Usually it's the least knowledgeable person who wants to share even though greater scholars are present. 24:30 - PARAGRAPH 26. Parnassah emanates from sharing Daas . Makifim from the Yam HaChakhma generate both Daas and wealth. 27:15 - Business partnerships. Sharing Daas is what civilizes the world. This sharing includes business partnerships transacted with honesty, as in Bava Metzia 105: "The mazal - good fortune - of two people increases when they join together" . 31:00 - NOTE: In present times, rabonim tend to discourage business partnerships because unfortunately it's often difficult to find a business partner who is honest. 32:00 - Different types of partnerships. 34:30 - PARAGRAPH 27. A kinyan locks a business partnership. Reference to Shulchan Aruch 176. It's crucial not to change a business deal midstream. Failing to keep one's word is the root of all evil. 36:50 - רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ - "If you see a man who is wise in his own eyes, there is more hope for a fool than for him" ( Mishlei 26:12). 42:00 - NOTE about HaShem becoming more and more hidden as the Geulah approaches. It's important to "Teach your tongue to say 'I don't know'". 44:00 - Changing a deal midstream does not allow a person to prosper. A person might tend to go back on his word because he thinks he's going to benefit from it, but changing a deal actual causes him harm. "A person who tricks someone will not retain what he caught in his net" . Whenever a person changes a deal, he actually loses. 46:00 - וְהָעֹשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְאַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בַּכֹּל - "And wealth and honor are from before You, and You rule over all..." ( 1Divrei HaYamim 29:12). All wealth is in the hands of HaShem , so it is a lack of emunah that prevents a person from keeping his word. 48:00 - Changing a business deal is foolish. That's why in order to establish a partnership, a kinyan is made. Kinyan Sudar . Clothing is a form of makif . 52:00 - Q&R. 54:00 - Closing Brochos .

lessons.bodyText: Shutafim beKarka 5 - Chalukas Shutafim 2 - Parshas Reeh - Geulah Sheleyma Requires Sheleymus HaDaas - Purim - Yom Kippur - Bayis - Meraglim - True Talmid Chokhom vs. Sheid Yehuda'ai - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafim beKarka 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 00:00 - ROSHEI PEROKIM. Parshas Reeh. כִּ֣י בְחִפָּז֗וֹן יָצָ֨אתָ֙ - "...for in haste did you go out..." ( Devarim 16:3, Reeh ). כִּ֣י לֹ֚א בְחִפָּזוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֔אוּ וּבִמְנוּסָ֖ה לֹ֣א תֵלֵכ֑וּן כִּֽי־הֹלֵ֚ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמְאַסִּפְכֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "For not with haste shall you go forth and not in a flurry of flight shall you go, for HaShem goes before you, and your rear guard is the Master of Israel" ( Yishaya 52:12). The Roshei Teivos of הֹלֵ֚ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמְאַסִּפְכֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל spell Eliyahu . 03:00 - פה is 85. אלוקים is 86 - "PeH" plus the Kollel . Reference to Likutey Moharan 78. A person's speech accompanies him wherever he goes. 04:00 - The first geulah was rushed and took place quickly, but the geulah sheleyma will be an aspect of sheleymus haDaas , and therefore achieved through patience, which is prerequisite to sheleymus haDaas . 07:00 - "Fortunate is the Land Whose King is free." 07:48 - Parshas Mishpatim. It's important to organize the Torah one is presenting like a "set table" so that students can comprehend and retain the concepts. 10:15 - Purim. The gorel made by Haman was in opposition to the gorel made by the Kohen Gadol on Yom Kippur to designate the Korbon Azalzel . Evil and holiness are always balanced to maintain free choice. 14:20 - The Meraglim were afraid of Amalek to the point that they lost faith in Moshe Rabbeinu . 19:00 - Rochel wove on a loom of silence. The secret of Esther HaMalka's success in rescuing Am Yisrael was her silence. She received the power of silence from her ancestors: Rochel Imeinu, Binyamin, and Shaul HaMelech . 21:00 - The "Turning Wheel" of souls. "A person who considers himself small is actually great. A person who considers himself great is actually small. Reference to Sichos HaRan 40 . 22:50 - CHALUKAS SHUTAFIN 2. The laws regarding partners dividing property when they split up ( Shulchan Aruch, Choshen Mispat 171). 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Chalukas Shutafim 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 28 - Holy Torah vs. Fallen Torah. 27:00 - Hosting a true talmid chokhom is equivalent to bringing the Korbon Tamid in the Beis HaMikdash and prevents the negative influence of false Torah leaders. 30:00 - Learning from true talmidei chakohim is equivalent to building a home that connects heaven and earth. 30:50 - PARAGRAPH 2. Bayis. The minimum size of a home or a room is Daled Amos . 33:00 - בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֜בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן - "A house is built with wisdom, and it is established with understanding" ( Mishlei 24:3). Reference to Likutey Moharan 266 . 34:00 - The Torah begins with the letter Beis to allude to Bayis - home. The home unites heaven and earth and protects from outside influences. 38:00 - Q&R about how a person can know the difference between a true Talmid Chokhom and a "Talmid Chokhom Sheid Yehuda'ai" . The Bnei Yissachar teaches that finding true Torah is a very difficult achievement. 42:20 - Q&R about a person becoming a Breslov Chossid because he may have been a Breslov Chossid in a previous gilgul . 43:00 - Closing blessings.

Business transactions - birur takes place at the entranceway of the bayis . A person's yard "acquires" for him - if an item falls into his yard he acquires it (if its owner can't be identified). 22:30 - PARAGRAPH 6. If an item loses its identity when it is divided, it cannot be divided among joint owners when they part ways ( Bava Basra 13). 24:30 - The word מזוזה is begematria Shem HaShem A - D - N - Y . The essence of "having a name" is bayis , as in Yad veShem . 27:00 - Parshas Lech Lecha. וַֽאֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ - "... and I will make your name great..." ( Bereishis 12:2, Lech Lecha ). HaShem promised to elevate Avraham Avinu's name to compensate for his traveling. 30:00 - Q&R. 33:00 - The importance of welcoming a talmid chokham into one's home. Kisey, Shulchan, Mitah, Ner comprise a room/home. The roshei teivos of these four elements spell "Mishkan" . 36:00 - When an evil person passes away, he forgets his name. 38:30 - The Daled Alfin are Shem HaShem . 39:20 - All of a person's possessions are part of his name. Reference to Likutey Moharan 59. 42:00 - HALAKHA 4. PARAGRAPH 1. Likutey Halakhos, Hilkhos Chalukas Shutafim 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 9. 43:00 - סָבִיב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֜לֻּ֗ת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם - "Wicked men walk on all sides when the basest to the sons of men is elevated" ( Tehillim 12:9). 45:00 - *** Emes is the light of HaShem , as in יְהֹוָ֚ה | אוֹרִ֣י - "...HaShem is my light..." ( Tehillim 27:1). To dispel distracting thoughts during tefilah , a person should concentrate on saying the words of tefilah with honesty.

Avoda Zara is called a "burden". 12:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. The prohibition of transferring an object from a private domain to public domain - or vice versa - does not apply to a person's Daled Amos . 18:00 - Wherever a person is, his Daled Amos contains the light of HaShem as long as he is connected with אמת. 19:00 - HALAKHA 5. Shulchan Aruch 171:3 and 172 defines and describes joint ownership of property. 21:20 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Chalukas Shutafim 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . "Eyes of the Tzaddik " alludes to the the ability to see clearly one's need for tikkun hamidos . The four yisodos (basic elements - of creation emanate from HaShem through the Tzaddik Emes . 28:15 - Shabbos and the Tzaddik Emes both radiate light into the Beis HaMikdash . The 4 letters of HaShem's Name inform the 4 Mochin of a person's sekhel - the highest level of the soul while it is in the physical world. 30:30 - The Tzaddik Emes is the Rosh Bayis , the sekhel that radiates into the Beis HaMikdash and into every Jewish home. This sekhel protects from angels of destruction. 33:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. The River that Flows from Eden. The life-force of HaShem enters the world via the Tzaddik Emes . This is why the Tzaddik Emes is called נהר - river. The life force flowing into every individual part of creation is channeled through its name. 36:20 - Parshas Bereishis. Adam was given the task of assigning names to the elements of creation. וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא־ל֧וֹ הָֽאָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ - "...and whatever the man called each living thing, that was its name" ( Bereishis 2:19, Bereishis ). 39:00 - *Reference to Likutey Moharan 56. It is physically and spiritually dangerous to change one's name, because a name is the conduit that receives HaShem's life-force. 41:40 - Closing blessings for erev erev Rosh Chodesh Av .

( Mishlei 3:15). 07:00 - Q&R - studying Torah beEmes means learning with respect and with the intent to apply to one's own life. NOTE: Rabbi Rosenfeld zal brought the possuk that alludes to standing a sefer up, rather than leaving it open or even lying closed on a table after studying from it. 09:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. Daled Amos of Halakha . 11:00 - Parshas Shoftim. כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵא֩ מִמְּךָ֨ דָבָ֜ר לַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט בֵּֽין־דָּ֨ם | לְדָ֜ם בֵּֽין־דִּ֣ין לְדִ֗ין וּבֵ֥ין נֶ֨גַע֙ לָנֶ֔גַע דִּבְרֵ֥י רִיבֹ֖ת בִּשְׁעָרֶ֑יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֣ וְעָלִ֔יתָ אֶל־הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בּֽוֹ - "If a matter eludes you in judgment, between blood and blood, between judgment and judgment, or between lesion and lesion, words of dispute in your cities, then you shall rise and go up to the place HaShem, your Master, chooses" ( Devarim 17:8, Shoftim ). This possuk refers to consulting with the Sanhedrin in Yerushalayim or, in present times, consulting with recognized authorities in halakha . 12:30 - טָֽבְע֤וּ (ט זעירא) בָאָ֨רֶץ֙ שְׁעָרֶ֔יהָ - "Her gates are sunk into the ground..." ( Eicha 2:9). The gates of the Beis HaMikdash sank into the ground so the enemies of Klal Yisrael were not able to capture them. These gates refer to the Shaarei Chokhma and halakha . 15:00 - אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֖הֹוָה שַֽׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֜כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַֽעֲקֹֽב - "HaShem loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Yaakov" ( Tehillim 87:2). 17:50 - The word "halakha" not only refers to the Torah's technical laws, "halakha" also refers to more general guiding principles for one's behavior. 19:00 - Shaarei Tzion. Tikkun Chatzos. 25:00 - Tikkun Leah. שְׂא֚וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים | רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם - "Lift up your heads, O gates..." ( Tehillim 24:7) expresses consolation for mourning. 27:00 - Q&R - the tradition in Breslov is that a woman is not obligated in saying Tikkun Chatzos . 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The gates of the Beis HaMikdash would not open for Shlomo HaMelech until he proclaimed the merit of his father, Dovid HaMelech , through the words חסדי דוד. וְאֶכְרְתָ֚ה לָכֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם חַסְדֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הַנֶּאֱמָנִֽים - Chasdei Dovid refers to the halakhos of the Beis HaMikdash ( Sanhedrin 99b). 39:00 - וְאֶכְרְתָ֚ה לָכֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם חַסְדֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הַנֶּאֱמָנִֽים - "...and I will make for you an everlasting covenant, the dependable mercies of David" ( Yeshaya 55:3). 40:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Remembering Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal . From his youth, "Reb Michel zal" was devoted to saying Tikkun Chatzos every night, seven days a week. He also used to sing Ish Chossid Hayo with tremendous devotion throughout the process of building the klois in Uman, not only as done traditionally on Motzei Shabbos , but also during the week in his hisbodedus . 48:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel

lessons.bodyText: Chalukas Shutafim 5 - Matzranus 1 - Yahrzeit of the Arizal - 5th Av - Daled Amos of Halakha - Gates of Beis HaMikdash - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Chalukas Shutafim 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . "Eyes of the Tzaddik " alludes to the the ability to see clearly one's need for tikkun hamidos . The four yisodos (basic elements - of creation emanate from HaShem through the Tzaddik Emes . 00:00 - NOTE - Today is the yahrzeit of the Arizal HaKodesh (5th Av) - Rabbi Yitzchak B'R Shlomo Luriah Ashkenazi zal . It is also the 19th yahrzeit of Rabbi Yechiel Michel B'R Yehoshua Dovid HaLevi Dorfman zal . 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 14b. Daled Amos of Halakha - Gates of the Beis HaMikdash . 13:45 - The clarity we have in halakha today emanates from the time when the Beis HaMikdash was standing. 14:30 - NOTE: Eretz Yisrael is central to Torah and mitzvos . 15:40 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal applying for an exit visa from the Soviet Union for 38 years. Each time he applied, he and his family were refused, but he never gave up. Finally he and his wife were released and they settled in Yerushalayim . His daughters and their families soon followed, and B"H all his grandchildren and great grandchildren now live in Eretz Yisrael. 20:40 - PARAGRAPH 15. "A good name" ( Mishlei 22:1). 22:00 - NOTE from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about the meaning of a "good name". 26:00 - Q&R about the incident of Bar Kamtza . 29:00 - Q&R - the best "escape" is to "run away" to the Torah. The best hishtadlus is Torah and tefilah . 33:00 - HILKHOS MATZRANUS 1a.

Matzranus - purchase rights of a neighbor with adjoining property. Am Yisrael's goal is to achieve u
lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 1 - Matzranus 2 - Purchase Rights of a Neighbor with Adjoining Property - Unity - Tefilah Is Nefesh - Zarka - Speech Is Malkhus - Praying for Physical Needs - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1b. Matzranus - purchase rights of a neighbor with adjoining property. Am Yisrael's goal is to achieve unity. 05:00 - Being "scattered" is not good. "Scatter-brained" is the opposite of having yishuv hadaas . 09:10 - Hilkhos Matzranus does not apply when purchasing land that belongs to a non-Jew ( Shulchan Aruch, Choshen Mishpat 175:40). 15:30 - ***Jewish souls are like trees in a field. The tzaddik is the Baal HaSadeh . Reference to Likutey Moharan 65 . 17:30 - The highest level of tefilah is unifying all its elements. 18:50 - Tefilah and nefesh are one. NOTE about the beauty of the fields of Eretz Yisrael . 20:45 - It's important to prepare tzedakah before tefilah . Diversifying property is potentially harmful, but tzedakah "gathers in" the scattered parts of a soul and increases yishuv hadaas . צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה - "Zion shall be redeemed through justice and her penitent through righteousness" ( Yeshaya 1:27). Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . 24:30 - Q&R about why Hilkhos Matzranus does not apply when purchasing land that belongs to a non-Jew. 28:00 - Matzranus 2. Hilkhos Matzranus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 4. Speech is Malkhus . 31:20 - Meaning of the cantillation mark called Zarka . עין refers to Ain Sof for the infinite light of HaShem . 33:45 - *** Malkhus is ratzon - will. רצונו של אדם זהו כבודו ואפילו לכבוד אב ואם - "doing the will of a person is to honor him and even applies to honoring one's father and mother" ( Yerushalmi, Peah 1:1; Sefer Chassidim 152). 36:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Account heard from Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal . The soul of a rabbi who had passed away visited a student who was still in this world. The rabbi told his student that, from the point of view of Gan Eden , everything seems good in the physical world. The only way souls in the next world can perceive that anything's "wrong" is if a person experiencing difficulty cries out in tefilah to HaShem . 41:00 - וַֽעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ - "The humble inherit the Land..." ( Tehillim 37:11). 42:00 - Closing blessings. 43:20 - Q&R about how and when to pray for physical needs. Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal emphasized that we need to daven for both spiritual and physical needs. 46:30 - Q&R about the practical application of Matzranus in buying/selling real estate.

lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 2 - Matzranus 3 - Parshas VaEschanan - The Three Weeks - Laws of Neighboring Fields - All Trees and Plants are Reincarnations - Yahrzeit Customs - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 4. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. 18:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. 25:00 - וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר וְהַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה - "And you shall do what is proper and good in the eyes of HaShem..." ( Devarim 6:18, VaEschanan ). 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. כָּל־רֹֽדְפֶ֥יהָ הִשִּׂיג֖וּהָ בֵּ֥ין הַמְּצָרִֽים - "...all her pursuers overtook her between the boundaries" ( Eichah 1:3). 35:00 - HALAKHA 3. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Matzranus 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 40:10 - PARAGRAPH 2. All trees and plants are reincarnations of souls. 45:15 - NOTE about yahrzeits . 45:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. It's customary to fast, light a candle, and recite Kaddish on the yahrzeit of a parent. Why is this done every year? 46:45 - NOTE - the Arizal taught that Kaddish is said for the entire first 12 months of the mourning period. 51:00 - NOTE about Yeshaya HaNavi and Shiras HaAzinu . 53:30 - Closing blessings. 54:20 - Q&R about keeping Torah "only in the heart". 56:40 - Q&R about souls being related to a field.

Hilkhos Matzranus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 4. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. The 12 Tribes corre
lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 3 - Parshas Re'eh - Field of Souls - 12 Tribes - 12 Months - Nusach in Tefilah - 12 Leaders of Yishmael - 12 Mazalos - Zodiac - Maaser - Fasting on a Yahrzeit - Kaddish - Yahrzeit Candle - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 4. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. The 12 Tribes correspond to the 12 nusachim in tefilah . 05:00 - The 12 Leaders of Yishmael are in opposition to the 12 Shevatim of Am Yisrael . 07:00 - NOTE - HaShem's Name Yud - Hey - Vuv - Hey in Mispar Katan is טוב. 08:00 - The 12 Tribes correspond to the 12 months of the year and the 12 mazalos - signs of the zodiac. 09:00 - וְזָרַ֥ח הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּבָ֣א הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְאֶ֨ל־מְקוֹמ֔וֹ שׁוֹאֵ֛ף זוֹרֵ֥חַֽ ה֖וּא שָֽׁם - "The sun rises and the sun sets, and to its place it yearns and rises there" ( Koheles 1:5). 12:00 - The tikkun for the Field of Souls is accomplished every year. 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Parshas Re'eh. עַשֵּׂ֣ר תְּעַשֵּׂ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל־תְּבוּאַ֣ת זַרְעֶ֑ךָ הַיֹּצֵ֥א הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֥ה שָׁנָֽה - "You shall tithe all the seed crop that the field gives forth, year by year" ( Devarim 14:22, Reeh ). Maaser - tithing the produce of a field is done every year. 15:00 - Parshas Korach. אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַֽחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - "... I am your inheritance and portion among the children of Israel" ( Bamidbar 18:20, Korach ). 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. The custom of fasting on a yahrzeit . 32:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Kaddish . Tikkun HaTefilah . 37:00 - The Arizal teaches that Kaddish is the bridge between this world and the next world. That's why there's a Kaddish between the Korbonos and the Psukei DeZimra in Shacharis , and again between Pesukei DeZimra and the berakhos preceding the Shema . The 4 sections of Shacharis correspond to the 4 Worlds of Olam HaBa . 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Kaddish transforms Mochin DeKatnus into Mochin DeGadlus . 42:00 - Q&R about how we can unifying tefilah : 1) focusing on the meaning of what we're saying, 2) binding oneself to all the souls of Am Yisrael , 3) binding oneself with the Tzaddik Emes . 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. The custom of lighting a candle just before the onset of a yahrzeit . 50:00 - Closing blessings - note about Tu B'Av and the halakhos governing today, Motzei Tisha B'Av . Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel

lessons.title: 2025-08-05 - LH7 - CM1 - Matzranus 3 - Para. 12-17 - Matzranus 4 - Para. 1-2 - VaEschanan - Bereishis
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Matzranus 3 - Matzranus 4 - VaEschanan - Bereishis - Yom Kippur Lights - Second Luchos - Kriyas Shema Before Tefilah - Response to Kaddish - 4 Elements of Creation - Fire, Water, Air, Earth - Tzaddik - 4 Rivers from Eden - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRA
lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 3 - Matzranus 4 - VaEschanan - Bereishis - Yom Kippur Lights - Second Luchos - Kriyas Shema Before Tefilah - Response to Kaddish - 4 Elements of Creation - Fire, Water, Air, Earth - Tzaddik - 4 Rivers from Eden - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 65 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Yom Kippur Lights. 03:41 - tefilas Neilah. "HaShem Hu HaElokim" proclaims and reinstates achdus of HaShem throughout all worlds. 06:03 - All 5 tefilos on Yom Kippur are elevated through tefilas Neilah . 09:10 - PARAGRAPH 13. The Second Luchos were given on Yom Kippur. 11:05 - NOTE about the forgiveness of sins on Yom Kippur. 11:37 - Q&R about the special ner lit on Yom Kippur, in addition to the Yom Tov lights. 12:06 - PARAGRAPH 14. The Luchos included the 12 Tribes corresponding to the 12 nusachos of tefilah . The ultimate unity of Am Yisrael is alluded to when Yaakov Aveinu gathered 12 stones "under his head" and they became one stone. 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Kriyas Shema is said before tefilah . 23:49 - PARAGRAPH 16. Responding "Amein - yehei Shemei rabba..." to Kaddish with full intent and focus leads to the forgiveness of a person's sins. 26:30 - The reward for keeping Shabbos is boundless joy. 27:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Why there are 12 words in "Shema Yisrael HaShem Elokeinu HaShem Echad; Baruch Shem Kevod Malkhuso LeOlam Voed" . 28:04 - HALAKHA 4. INTRODUCTION. Parshas VaEschanan . וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר וְהַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ - "And you shall do what is proper and good in the eyes of HaShem, in order that it may be well with you" ( Devarim 6:18, VaEschanan ). 29:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Parshas Bereishis. The 4 Elements of Creation . The Tzaddik is an aspect of נהר as inוְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים - "And a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it separated and became four heads" ( Bereishis 2:10, Bereishis ). 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Domem, Tzomeyach, Chayey, Medaber - the 4 levels of creation. 31:48 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 35:50 - Ikar kiyum of everything in creation is through the 4 Elements. Creation is governed by the Tzaddik Emes . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 4 - Parshas Bereishis - Peace Depends on the Tzaddik - Rosh Bayis - 4 Elements of Creation - Beis HaMikdash - Shabbos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Parshas Bereishis. וְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים - "And a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it separated and became four heads" ( Bereishis 4:3, Bereishis ). ***The Arba Yisodos receive from the Yisod HaPoshut - the Tzaddik Emes , who is an aspect of "the river flowing from Eden". Four rivers flow from Eden. Everything in the world is dependent on the harmony between the Arba Yisodos - 4 Elements of Creation. 05:00 - The midos are composed of different combinations of the Arba Yisodos . 09:30 - The Arba Yisodos correspond to the 4 letters of HaShem's Name Yud Hey Vuv Hey , and correspond to the 4 Worlds. 11:50 - Each person is an entire world. The Arba Yisodos combine to create each person's midos . Illness arises when the elements of the body are in disharmony. 14:00 - Opposition to the Tzaddik Emes causes lack of peace in the world and a disharmony of the Arba Yisodos . 16:00 - Each person has a dominant element from the 17:00 - Peace is generated when there is harmony between different elements. Reference to Likutey Moharan 80 . 19:00 - NOTE: it's important not to enter into any sort of makhlokes - dispute - with family members or neighbors. There are certain types of shalom that are not good to initiate. 27:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 28:30 - The Tzaddik Emes is called the ראש בית - he contributes his light to the Beis HaMikdash . 31:30 - Bein HaMetzorim - the Three Weeks. כָּל־רֹֽדְפֶ֥יהָ הִשִּׂיג֖וּהָ בֵּ֥ין הַמְּצָרִֽים - "...all her pursuers overtook her between the boundaries" ( Eicha 1:3). 36:00 - Q&R about the practical application of the concepts presented in the shiur . 38:00 - A person who enjoys Shabbos is rewarded with a joy that has no bounds ( Shabbos 118). 44:00 - A person who masters his midos through balancing and harmonizing the Arba Yisodos within himself can gain mastery over the 4 directions - south, north, east, west. 45:45 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.description: Matzranus 4 - Parshas Devarim - Adjoining Property Rights - 4 Elements - Moshe Rabbeinu vs. Sichon and Og - Rosh Bayis - Protecting Borders - Rabbi's Only Son - Without the Tzaddik Something Will Always Be Missing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4.
lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 4 - Parshas Devarim - Adjoining Property Rights - 4 Elements - Moshe Rabbeinu vs. Sichon and Og - Rosh Bayis - Protecting Borders - Rabbi's Only Son - Without the Tzaddik Something Will Always Be Missing - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. 04:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. Moshe Rabbeinu vs. Sichon and Og . 08:00 - NOTE about the Megaleh Amukos , Rabbi Noson Nota b'R Shlomo Spira zal (Poland, 1585–1633). His yahrzeit is today, the 13th of Av . 11:30 - Q&R about the 4 Yisodos and physical health. Tzaddikim suffer on behalf of Am Yisrael . 13:30 - Parshas Devarim. Galus Edom. אַל־תִּתְגָּ֣רוּ בָ֔ם כִּי לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־רָ֑גֶל - "You shall not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land not so much as a foot step..." ( Devarim 2:5, Devarim ). 16:00 - The importance of protecting the borders of one's land or territory. Shnei Malkhus Emori - roshei teivos Moshe . 18:30 - PARAGRAPH 6. The concept of Rosh Bayis . Midrash : Am Yisrael sinned through ראש - was punished through ראש - and will be repaired through ראש. All sadness and illness is a result of an imbalance in the 4 Yisodos , in the individual and/or in Klal Yisrael . 21:30 - Betzalel . 22:30 - HaShem works through the Tzaddik Emes . Yosef is begematria 6 times Yud - Hey - Vuv - Hey. 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Parshas Devarim. As a result of the sin of the meraglim , Am Yisrael did not defeat Edom and was forced to take a long and arduous indirect route to Eretz Yisrael . 27:30 - Q&R about the spiritual meanings of Edom, Moav, and Ammon . 28:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Due to the sins of Am Yisrael , Moshe Rabbeinu and Aharon HaKohen passed away just outside the borders of Eretz Yisrael . They protect the borders of Eretz Yisrael permanently, because they are buried there. 32:00 - Q&R about the burial place of Aharon HaKohen . 33:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. This paragraph refers back to the medrash brought in PARAGRAPH 6 . The sin was against the Rosh , the punishment was Rosh , and the consolation was Rosh . 36:30 - "Nachamu, nachamu Ami..." 38:40 - The main source of life energy, hope, rescue, healing, and consolation - is the Tzaddik Emes . 40:00 - NOTE about a man whose wife is sad. The story of the Ben HaYachid - the Rabbi's Only Son. ***Rav Nachman Tcherin zal explains that until a person is missing a kesher with the Tzaddik Emes , he or she will feel that something is missing in their life. 45:30 - Story of how the Mezritcher Maggid sent a person with problems to "speak to the doctor" - Reb Zushia. 47:30 - Returning to the text: the tzaddik is the grace and beauty of the entire world. Whoever merits to be connected with him will be able to see his own needs in tikkun hamidos . 49:00 - Q&R How do we find the Tzaddik Emes in present times? This is the main test in life. 51:30 - Closing blessing about learning the Breslov seforim and doing tikkun hamidos . 54:00 - Q&R about a wife's opposition to her husband traveling to Uman for Rosh Hashanah. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Matzranus 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9b. 4 Rivers flow from Eden, and their head is the Tzaddik . Disrespect for the Tzaddik is the source of disharmony in the 4 Elements, both within the individual, and throughout all worlds. 03:00 - Midrash Eichah : "They sinned with their head, ears, eyes, nose..." 12:00 - בְּרֹ֖אשׁ כָּל־חוּצֽוֹת - "...at the head of every passageway" ( Eichah 4:1). 24:00 - The 4 mochin flow into the 4 Yisodos . 25:00 - 4 rivers flow from Eden: The ראש is Eden - הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ - "...wisdom gives life to its possessor" ( Koheles 7:12). 26:00 - From the heart, life energy flows into every part of the body. The heart is the source of a person's midos - character traits and passions, both positive and negative. Reference to Likutey Moharan 33 . 29:00 - The main challenge and goal in life is making peace between the head and heart. The tzaddik is the ראש and Am Yisrael is the heart/body. The challenge of Am Yisrael is to connect with the Tzaddik . The river that flows from Eden makes the connection between ראש and לב. This is done through לשן - speech: Torah and tefilah . 33:00 - ***The difference between Am Yisrael and the 70 Nations is לב. Both Am Yisrael and the 70 Nations have chokhma , but only Am Yisrael has a לב. 36:00 - NOTE about Shabbos Nachamu , which is tomorrow. Since the 70 Nations are heartless they are only united in one aspect: hatred of Am Yisrael . We are now making the transition from the 3 Weeks of mourning to the 7 weeks of solace. 40:00 - Closing blessings. The purpose of all the suffering is teshuvah .

lessons.bodyText: Matzranus 4 - Shutafin 1 - Shutafin 2 - Parshas Bereishis - Midrash Eichah - Ruach Moshiach - Each Business Partner Receives Equally Regardless of Initial Investment - Yerusha - Beis Din - Kinyan Sudar - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Matzranus 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . PARAGRAPH 12b. Midrash Eicha - they "sinned doubly". PARAGRAPH 13. Disrespect for the Tzaddik is the source of disharmony in the 4 Elements, both within the individual, and throughout all worlds. Parshas Bereishis. וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם - "...and the spirit of HaShem was hovering over the face of the water" ( Bereishis 1:2, Bereishis ). "Water" refers to the tears shed by Am Yisrael during the exile. The "spirit of HaShem " that dispels the darkness is in the Shabbos lights kindled by Jewish women. Ruach Elokim refers to Moshiach . NOTE: Hilkhos Matzranus 5 appears in Hilkhos Shutafin beKarka 5 - Para. 12-27 . HILKHOS SHUTAFIN 1. INTRODUCTION. Business partnerships. Hilkhos Shutafin 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 69 . ***No matter how much each partner contributes to a business partnership, all partners receive equal portions when the partnership is dissolved, unless a different arrangement is agreed when the partnership is formed. (Based on Shulchan Aruch, Choshen Mishpat 174.) Business partners become like brothers, drawing from "the same tree". A family is compared to a tree - the wife is compared to the trunk of the tree, the branches are the wealth of the family, and the fruits of the tree are the children. A business partnership joins the branches of two trees. "Brothers who are partners." Not all brothers are business partners. Once a business partnership is established, all members are drawing from one source, and therefore all business partners are equal in receiving benefits , unless it was expressed differently at the outset of the partnership. This distribution is not affected by how much money was put into the partnership. Profit sharing in a business partnership is based on the fact that the partners have become united and equal in receiving from the same tree. The amount of profit received is based on the "quality of the branches" and all partners are drawing from one source. A Beis Din on earth cannot determine what each partner's "drawing power" is. Therefore, each one receives equally. Similarly, distribution of inheritance is equal among children. Q&R About a bochur receiving a double portion: A Beis Din has the right to say that the money of a person who passes away is "ownerless" in order to establish shalom the overriding factor in distributing a yerusha . A business partnership must be established through kinyan . It is not established through dibur . The essence of a partnership is a sale. Individual money is going out of each individual's pocket and joining together and the profits are divided equally. Q&R - the principle of all partners being equal pertains only to Jews who become partners. Q&R about a Beis Din governing a yerusha -inheritance - in order to establish peace between siblings. HILKHOS SHUTAFIN 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Shutafin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 14 . Gerim - converts to Judaism - enter "under the wings of the Shekhina ". ***When Moshiach is revealed, business transactions will not be possible, because business is based on conflicts/differences between people. PARAGRAPH 2. A kinyan is necessary in business transactions to prevent partners from entering into conflict. Reference to Likutey Moharan 51 - Emes is one and is the essence of peace. Sheker is associated with differences. Deviating from a contract is an aspect of makhlokes . Kinyan Sudar establishes peace. NOTE on the שָׁל֨וֹם | שָׁל֜וֹם לָֽרָח֧וֹק וְלַקָּר֛וֹב - "...peace, peace to the far and to the near..." ( Yeshaya 57:19) - the repetition of the word שלום refers to the process of returning to HaShem in teshuvah . The mission of a Jew in this world is to release and elevate the holy souls that are entrapped in the physical world. Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 and reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . Gerim enter under the "wings" of the Shekhinah . Why a garment is used to establish a Kinyan Sudar . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Shutafin 3 - Parshas Bereishis - Shemos - Ekev - VeZos HaBerakha - The Struggle for Parnassah - Business Partnership - Zevulun and Yissachar - Kinyan - Hands - Yaakov and Esav - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. "The struggle for parnassah is as difficult as splitting the Yam Suf..." ( Pesachim 118). 03:00 - Parshas Bereishis - Why parnassah can be so difficult. בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה - "...with toil shall you eat of it..." Bereishis 3:17, Bereishis ). 10:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 56 . 15:00 - Parshas Ekev. וְזָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַֽעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל - "But you must remember HaShem Your Master, for it is He that gives you strength to make wealth..." ( Devarim 8:18, Ekev ). 20:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 280 . 21:00 - ***The struggle for parnassah is a war. That's why it's usually better accomplished by at least two people joining forces, as in טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן־הָֽאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵֽשׁ־לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּֽעֲמָלָֽם - "Two are better than one, since they have good reward for their toil" ( Koheles 4:9). 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The partnership between Yissachar and Zevulun was the perfection of achieving parnassah because it joined Torah study with making a livelihood. 29:00 - Q&R about the holy sparks in money and food and the importance of kavana when making a blessing on food. 30:00 - Parshas Shemos. Moshe Rabbeinu and Aharon HaKohen joined together to lead Am Yisrael out of Mitzrayim . It was through Aharon's joining forces with Moshe Rabbeinu that they could succeed in the war against Pharaoh. וְאֶת־הַמַּטֶּ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה תִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ - "And you shall take this staff in your hand..." ( Shemos 4:17, Shemos ). וַיַּשְׁלֵ֨ךְ אַֽהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־מַטֵּ֗הוּ - "...and Aharon cast his staff..." ( Shemos 7:10, Shemos ). 33:00 - VaYipallel Pinchas . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Parshas VeZos HaBerakha. שְׂמַ֥ח זְבוּלֻ֖ן בְּצֵאתֶ֑ךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר בְּאֹֽהָלֶֽיךָ - כִּ֣י שֶׁ֤פַע יַמִּים֙ יִינָ֔קוּ וּשְׂפֻנֵ֖י טְמ֥וּנֵי חֽוֹל - "...Rejoice, Zevulun, in your departure, and Yissachar, in your tents... For they will be nourished by the abundance of the seas, and by the treasures hidden in the sand" ( Devarim 33, 18-19, VeZos HaBerakha ). 37:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 . Going out to business is compared to song, as in שְֽׂאוּ־זִ֖מְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹ֑ף - "Raise song and give forth a timbrel..." ( Tehillim 81:3). 38:00 - NOTE - parnassa dekedusha is achieved with simcha . BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Maimon working in a kosher restaurant as a teenager so he could earn money to travel to Eretz Yisrael . 41:00 - Shefa comes from the Yam - wealth comes through the "powerful stick" used during Kriyas Yam Suf . 42:00 - "Holy sparks in the sand" - refers to extracting the holy sparks hidden in the Sutra Achra . 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Kinyan. A partnership cannot be established through words alone. A kinyan is required because the Sutra Achra is attached to the holy sparks found in everything in the material world. Therefore, physical action with the hands are required in the act of establishing a kinyan or acquiring an object. 49:00 - Parshas Toldos . וְיִתֶּן־לְךָ֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִטַּ֨ל הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ - "And may HaShem give you of the dew of the heavens and the fatness of the earth..." ( Bereishis 27:28, Toldos ). The struggle between Yaakov Avinu and Esav . Reference to Likutey Moharan 9 . הַקֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְהַיָּדַ֖יִם יְדֵ֥י עֵשָֽׂו - "...The voice is the voice of Yaakov, but the hands are the hands of Esav" ( Bereishis 27:22, Toldos ). 52:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.
