lessons.description: Shutafin 3 - Shutafin 4 - Business Transaction Requires Kinyan - Hand of Yaakov vs. Heel of Esav - Sheker - Changing Business Deal - Taavos Mamon Contains Every Type of Avoda Zara - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. 09:00 - PARAGRA
lessons.bodyText: Shutafin 3 - Shutafin 4 - Business Transaction Requires Kinyan - Hand of Yaakov vs. Heel of Esav - Sheker - Changing Business Deal - Taavos Mamon Contains Every Type of Avoda Zara - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafin 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. 09:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. A partnership is not official until a kinyan is made. A kinyan must be done with the hands (through written contract and/or kinyan sudar ) in order to establish the union of partners, both in monetarily and spiritually. 12:00 - HALAKHA 4. A partnership requires a kinyan . Hilkhos Shutafin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 23 . 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. All the various types of Sutra Achra are present in money. Profit is only from HaShem . When a person puts his life in danger in order to "make a profit" it is considered as if he is worshiping idols. 16:20 - When a person is free of the Sutra Achra present in money, his light is illuminated with joy. When a person is steeped in taavos mamon , his face is an aspect of the "Seventy Faces of Darkness". 18:00 - Teivas Mamon is related to Tikkun HaBris . If it were not for salt, a person would not be able to stand the bitterness of this world. The world is filled with the bitterness of chasing parnassah . In some ways, the anxiety regarding money is more bitter than death. 20:00 - The Tzaddik is "the salt of the world". 21:30 - A person who opposed the Tzaddik sinks into taavos mamon , which is an aspect of Avoda Zara and Shmad . 22:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. No business transaction is completed with words alone. There must be a kinyan to prevent partners changing their mind and changing the deal. 28:40 - When a person goes back on his word it's as if he worships idols. 29:00 - Q&R about keeping one's word. "Nine o'clock means nine o'clock." A person's word is not a joke. 31:00 - Q&R - a person needs to consult a Torah authority about when to let a person go if they don't keep their word. 32:30 - Q&R about the characteristics of the 70 Nations. Reference to Sipurey Maasios - Story of the Baal Tefilah . 34:10 - PARAGRAPH 3. A business transaction is not completed with words alone, because all parties involved cannot rely on the word of the others. The hands of all involved in the agreement must be involved, either through writing or kinyan . Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 38:00 - Yaakov Avinu told his sons to physically destroy the idols found in Eretz Yisrael . 40:40 - ***A business partnership is not established unless there is a written document. Until there is a kinyan , the parnassah of the people involved can be put "on hold" because there is no kli to receive it. "Business is a very dangerous thing, because all forms of idolatry are involved." Idol worship prevents a person from receiving parnassah . 47:00 - טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן־הָֽאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵֽשׁ־לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּֽעֲמָלָֽם - "Two are better than one, since they have good reward for their toil" ( Koheles 4:9). 49:00 - The Tzaddik is compared with salt, which sweetens the bitterness of the world, so opposition of the Tzaddik results in a person's bitterness with regard to taavos mamon . 51:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-08-15 - LH7 - CM1 - Shutafin 4 - Para. 3b-5
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Shutafin 4 - Peace Is Established Through the Tzaddik Emes - Business Partnerships and Transactions Requires Kinyan - What Is Taavos Mamon? Yahrzeit of R' Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. Makhlokes against the Tzaddik lea
lessons.bodyText: Shutafin 4 - Peace Is Established Through the Tzaddik Emes - Business Partnerships and Transactions Requires Kinyan - What Is Taavos Mamon? Yahrzeit of R' Yisrael Abba Rosenfeld zal - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Shutafin 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 23 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3b. Makhlokes against the Tzaddik leads to makhlokes in Am Yisrael and causes wars throughout the world. The Tzaddik is able to bring shalom, but when people oppose him, there is no one else qualified to bring peace. Just as every person's face is different, so their opinions are different. 02:40 - The more conflict there is in the world, the greater the Taavos Mamon . 04:00 - ***When two Jews join together in friendship and peace, this enables both of them to achieve Tikkun HaBris and Tikkun Taavos Mamon . Excessive desire for wealth includes being anxious or stressed about money. וְעַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים - "And your people, all of them righteous..." ( Yeshaya 60:21). 11:00 - טוֹבִ֥ים הַשְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן־הָֽאֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵֽשׁ־לָהֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּֽעֲמָלָֽם - "Two are better than one, since they have good reward for their toil" ( Koheles 4:9). Nekuda tova - The aspect of tzaddik in one Jew can unite with the aspect of tzaddik in another. Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 . A partnership founded in peace will protect each partner from Taavas Mamon . 13:40 - A business partnership is only created through kinyan - a written document or some other form of action of the hands. A verbal agreement does not establish a partnership. 16:00 - לְשָׂשׂ֣וֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָ֔ה וּֽלְמֹֽעֲדִ֖ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְהָֽאֱמֶ֥ת וְהַשָּׁל֖וֹם אֱהָֽבוּ - "...for joy and happiness and for happy holidays-but love truth and peace" ( Zecharia 8:19). Truth and peace are one. 16:10 - PARAGRAPH 4. Kinyan Sudar . A chatan obligates himself to the terms of a wedding contract through Kinyan Sudar . Boaz and Rus . 19:00 - Money is associated with the feet. In the word אמת every letter has "two feet". In the word שקר each letter stands only on "one foot". Begematria , the word נעל (shoe) is 150 which is an expansion of HaShem's Name "Ekyeh" - Aleph - Hey - Yud - Hey . Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 and reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . 23:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Ashrei . סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֖הֹוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּֽפְלִ֑ים וְ֜זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִֽים - "HaShem supports all those who fall and straightens all who are bent down" - עֵ֣ינֵי כֹ֖ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֚ה נוֹתֵֽן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ - "Everyone's eyes look to You with hope, and You give them their food in its time" ( Tehillim 145:14-15). 25:40 - There is no possuk for the letter Noon in Ashrei because it is the first letter in נפילה. Reference to the Sipurey Maasios - The Master of Prayer - The Country That Fell into Taavas Mamon . 32:50 - Taavos Mamon is the main problem today. 36:50 - Talmud Bavli on Eicha : "She fell; she will not fall again..." The desire for wealth includes "being worried" about money. Preoccupation about money is self-destructive and an aspect of Avoda Zara . The Tzaddik guides Am Yisrael out of the excessive desire for wealth. 41:50 - Tefilah asking HaShem to free Am Yisrael from all the wrong kinds of desires, especially from Taavos Mamon . 43:00 Q&R - How does a person know if they've fallen into Taavos Maimon? 44:20 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Yisrael Abba baR Yehudah Aryeh Rosenfeld zal whose yahrzeit is tomorrow, the 22nd of Av . R' Yisrael Abba was a leader in establishing Breslov chassidus in the U.S. When he passed away at the age of 63, his son, Rabbi Tzvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal , carried on his strong connection with the elders of Breslov in Yerushalayim and became a co-founder of the Breslov Yeshiva in Yerushalayim . 47:40 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 1 - Sheluchin 2 - Parshas Shemos - Am Yisrael Is One - Only a Jew Can Serve as Emissary for a Fellow Jew - How HaShem Prays and Does Mitzvos - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - HALAKHA 1. Parshas Shemos. Am Yisrael is one, as in וַיְהִ֗י כָּל־נֶ֛פֶשׁ יֹֽצְאֵ֥י יֶֽרֶךְ־יַֽעֲקֹ֖ב שִׁבְעִ֣ים נָ֑פֶשׁ - "And all those descended from Yaakov were seventy soul..." ( Shemos 1:5, Shemos ). Only a Jew can serve as a shaliach - emissary - for a fellow Jew ( Kiddushin 41). 05:00 - Hilkhos Sheluchin 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 31 . 07:00 - HaShem puts on tefillin ( Sotah 14). 15:00 - HALAKHA 2. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Sheluchin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Parshas Yisro. בְּכָל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַזְכִּ֣יר אֶת־שְׁמִ֔י אָב֥וֹא אֵלֶ֖יךָ וּבֵֽרַכְתִּֽיךָ - "...wherever I allow My name to be mentioned, I will come to you and bless you" ( Shemos 20:21, Yisro ). 25:00 - Degel Machaneh Ephraim and NOTE about Reb Zushia . A man's deceased father appeared to him in a dream and the Vilna Gaon questioned how Reb Zushia knew how to solve the mystery. 38:00 - How HaShem prays. 40:00 - *The purpose of Am Yisrael is to serve as HaShem's shaliach in the physical world. 42:00 - Man performs mitzvos to achieve mastery over his physicality. To the extent that he succeeds, he becomes the shaliach for HaShem's performance of mitzvos . 45:00 - *When a man achieves bitul - spiritual mastery over his physical nature - it's as if HaShem Himself is doing the mitzvos .

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 2 - We Are Messengers for HaShem - Mitzvos Through Representative - Merkava - Dominion Over the Angels - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b.If a man sends a messenger with a gift for a woman who lives in another place, the messenger can successfully achieve the wedding engagement for him. Similarly - we are messengers created and sent by HaShem to accomplish His mitzvos in this world. What will we tell Him in the next world about how we fulfilled the mission(s) He sent us on? 02:50 - When a person nullifies himself to HaShem's will, the mitzvos he does are as if HaShem Himself is performing them. 05:00 - The world was created in order to give mankind free choice. Everything else in creation does not have free will. 07:00 - Explanation of ATBaSH . The first two letters in the word מצוה in ATBaSH become Yod and Hey to form the Name of HaShem . 09:00 - The goal in life is to be performing mitzvos as if HaShem is doing them. 10:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why are the words "And HaShem spoke to Moshe, saying..." repeated so often throughout the written Torah? The word וידר hints at the concept that HaShem Himself will be accomplishing the mitzvah . The conclusion of the phrase relates to the messenger's part in doing the mitzvah . 16:45 - NOTE about the meaning of the word את in the Torah. 17:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Each one of us has been sent by HaShem for a specific purpose in this world. 19:00 - A person can hire a carpenter to build a sukkah for him. But it's better to do a mitzvah oneself, rather than to pay a shaliach to do it on one's behalf, because the mitzvah allows us to become one with HaShem . 21:20 - NOTE - a messenger boy can eventually become CEO of a company. HaShem created us to become like Him. 25:00 - Midrash about Eliyahu HaNavi and Elisha HaNavi : all leaders with no messengers is a curse. 27:30 - Q&R about paying a carpenter to build a sukkah on one's behalf. 28:30 - PARAGRAPH 5. Even though we can pay someone to do a mitzvah on our behalf, it's a higher level to to the preparations for Shabbos oneself. Shabbos is a taste of Olam HaBa . 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Doing business in this world is usually requires appointing messengers, for example establishing power of attorney. הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔י וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑י - "...'The heavens are My throne, and the earth is My footstool...'" ( Yeshaya 66:1). 35:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . 41:00 - If a messenger causes damage, the messenger is responsible to repair the damage. 44:30 - Q&R. 52:00 - The Avos are called the Merkava - Chariot of HaShem . Dominion over the angels. 56:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 1 . Angels are messengers.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 2 - VaYishlach - Dominion Over Angels - Emes Brings Hashgacha - Eyes of HaShem - Free Will - Before Creation - After Creation - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 22 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7b. Parshas VaYishlach. Since Yaakov Avinu perfected his shelichus for HaShem , he was able to have dominion over angels and send them as his messengers. 08:00 - HALAKHA 3. INTRODUCTION. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim". Brief overview of Likutey Moharan 51 - sheker makes free choice possible. 15:00 - The more honest a person is, the more he draws HaShem's hashgacha - direct supervision - upon Himself. 17:50 - Q&R about why Yitzchak Avinu's eyes became weak. 18:45 - Q&R about Eretz Yisrael being presently in the state of golus . 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. The purpose of man is to connect Before Creation with After Creation. 24:20 - מִצְוַ֖ת יְהֹוָ֥ה בָּ֜רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם - "...the commandment of HaShem is clear, enlightening the eyes" ( Tehillim 19:9). It's through the "Eyes of HaShem " - so to speak - that we draw HaShem's supervision upon us. 26:45 - וְ֜נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף - "...and a grumbler alienates HaShem" ( Mishlei 16:28). 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. Free will. 35:30 - "If you understood HaShem, you would be HaShem" ( Kuzari ). 38:30 - As soon as HaShem created the world, He created room for error so that free will would be possible. 41:20 - Q&R about free will. Am Yisrael's "default" is faith in HaShem . 47:15 - The essence of the Sutra Achra is kefira - apostasy - lack of awareness/faith in HaShem . 52:00 - Apostasy is an aspect of the Vacated Space created by HaShem . Reference to Likutey Moharan 64 .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 3 - Man Is HaShem's Messenger - Laws of Nature - Free Will - Malakh Mem Tess - Rav Noson's Pre-Dawn Tefilah While Traveling in a Wagon - Mochin deGadlus - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . PARAGRAPH 3b. PARA
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 3 - Man Is HaShem's Messenger - Laws of Nature - Free Will - Malakh Mem Tess - Rav Noson's Pre-Dawn Tefilah While Traveling in a Wagon - Mochin deGadlus - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . PARAGRAPH 3b. PARAGRAPH 4. Man was created to be a shaliach for HaShem . If we do not accomplish our mission in this world, when we reach Olam HaBa - מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖י דָּבָֽר - "...what shall I reply to Him that sent me?" ( 2Shmuel 24:13). Accomplishing the mission successfully unites the Sender and the messenger into One. ***NOTE - Story about Rav Noson of Nemirov zal traveling through the predawn countryside in a coach and singing his tefilos . A student who was with him describes how all of creation seemed to be rushing to join his prayer. PARAGRAPH 5. Ikar Koach Tefilah - Malakh Mem Tess. NOTE: Rabbi Nachman Tcherin zal explains how the account of "Rebbi Mier and the Pomegranate" describes the function of the Malakh Mem Tess . Free choice is enabled through the Malakh Mem Tess . The "Laws of Nature" facilitate free will. PARAGRAPH 6. אמת unites the messenger with the sender. If a person changes אמת to שקר he is no longer a shaliach for HaShem . Sheker includes all evil. The last letters of the first three words of the Torah are Emes , and the letters of of the Torah spell Emes . Truth is Am Yisrael's "mission statement". PARAGRAPH 7. A non-Jew cannot be a shaliach for a Jew, because non-Jews do not believe in the direct supervision of HaShem . Shalichus for HaShem is only the mission of Am Yisrael because we are one with HaShem . Explanation of "HaShem Hu HaElokim" . PARAGRAPH 8. A katan - child - cannot be a shaliach . Explanation of Mochin deGadlus. Am Yisrael is called "Am Gadol" when we have faith in HaShem . Emunah is achieved and strengthened through tefilah . *** Mochin deGadlus is believing in Hashgacha Pratis - direct supervision of HaShem . A person who does not believe in HaShem's direct supervision is called a Katan. Mochin deKatnus is belief in the "Laws of Nature". * Ain Ohd Milavod is Mochin deGadlus . Q&R about a non-Jew serving as a shaliach . Heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal : there is a special Gan Eden for non-Jews who follow the 7 Mitzvos of Bnei Noach . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 3 - Chanukah Lights - Hashgacha - Eyes of HaShem - Free Will - Teshuvah Is Only Possible Through Emes - Spiritual Aspects of Sun, Moon, Stars - Public Domain vs. Private Domain - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. - The Chanukah lights expresses faith in hashgacha - that "the Eyes of HaShem observe us constantly. HaShem's supervision is not dependent on the "laws of nature". 03:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. The Chanukah lights are kindled at a height below 10 tefachim . 08:00 - Free will. The "further away" we are from HaShem , the more difficult it is for a person to connect the diversity of After Creation with the unity of Before Creation. 10:20 - NOTE about Shema Yisrael - the statement of our desire to connect with HaShem Echad . HaShem knows exactly what's going on in the world - it's up to each individual to influence HaShem to bring blessing. 12:00 - A baal teshuvah has increased potential to connect After Creation with Before Creation because he came to HaShem from such a distance ( Berakhos 34). 17:20 - Teshuvah requires אמת - honesty. Returning to HaShem is only possible through emes - truth. 19:30 - בְּֽכָל־מָ֖קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֜פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים וְטוֹבִֽים - "The eyes of HaShem are everywhere, viewing the evil and the good" ( Mishlei 15:3). 21:00 - NOTE - Teshuvah - How does a person begin his return to HaShem ? One way is to hear the Torah's accounts of emunah . 22:20 - PARAGRAPH 12. The Chanukah lights are kindled in the Reshus HaYachid - private domain - realm of kedusha within the home. However the Chanukah lights must radiate to the Reshus HaRabim - public domain - realm of impurity - outside the home. 26:40 - NOTE about the Dubner Maggid and the Vilna Gaon . Every tzaddik has a unique mission in the world. 27:45 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about one of Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal's friends who became a U.S. army chaplain. 31:20 - "A messenger is like the sender" is an aspect of connecting After Creation with Before Creation. 34:00 - Daylight represents hashgachas HaShem /Before Creation. Darkness is an aspect of After Creation, when it's necessary to have emunah in order to remember the light of HaShem . אַךְ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֜לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּֽעֲדֵֽנִי - "...'Darkness will darken me, and the night will be as light about me'" ( Tehillim 139:12). For HaShem , the night is as bright as day. 37:00 - Q&R about how to respond to hearing disrespect of a rabbi. 37:50 - PARAGRAPH 13. 39:20 - PARAGRAPH 14. The proper time to light Chanukah lights is from the times the stars appear in the sky "until footsteps are no longer in the marketplace". "Nature" is an aspect of darkness. Man's purpose is to restore the light of the moon to the light of the sun - After Creation to Before Creation. 42:30 - The stars represent the repair of the moon. Spiritual aspects of sun, moon and stars. 44:40 - Chanukah lights are kindled "when the stars appear in the sky". Stars are an aspect of hashgacha . "Until footsteps are no longer in the marketplace" - the foot is related to sheker since it's the lowest part of the body, closest to the domain of impurity. 47:30 - The Kavanas of the Arizal on the Chanukah lights emphasize אמת ( Pri Etz Chaim ). 48:50 - Closing blessings. Today is Yom Kippur Katan . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-08-22 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 3 - Para. 15-17 - Parshas Shelach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 3 - Parshas Shelach - Meraglim were Messengers - Hashgacha - Eretz Yisrael - Perfection of the Eyes - Beis HaMikdash - Miracles Reveal Emes - Separation of Upper Waters from Lower Waters - Creation of Sheker - Holy Tears Bring the Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey M
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 3 - Parshas Shelach - Meraglim were Messengers - Hashgacha - Eretz Yisrael - Perfection of the Eyes - Beis HaMikdash - Miracles Reveal Emes - Separation of Upper Waters from Lower Waters - Creation of Sheker - Holy Tears Bring the Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Parshas Shelach. 05:00 - The Malakh MaTaT represents the Laws of Nature. The messenger should be one with the sender. Elokim is begematria HaTeva . 06:45 - By speaking in a negative way about Eretz Yisrael , the meraglim were not one with the sender. A person who lies cannot be one with HaShem . This sheker caused Am Yisrael to cry, as in וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַהֽוּא - "... and the people wept on that night" ( Bamidbar 14:1, Shelach ). 09:15 - The Beis HaMikdash is an aspect of Perfection of the Eyes, because it joins After Creation with Before Creation through the Ehven Shesiya . Through the korbonos in Beis HaMikdash sins are forgiven. 11:20 - Emes - Perfection of the Eyes - makes teshuvah possible. 12:30 - 10 ongoing miracles took place in the Beis HaMikdash . Miracles reveal emes and hashgacha . 14:45 - PARAGRAPH 16. Tisha B'Av. "I will establish this crying for generations." In order to rebuild the Beis HaMikdash, Am Yisrael needs to pray with tears. In order to do teshuvah , a person needs to shed tears over their misdeeds. Every one of these Holy Tears is seen and counted by HaShem and brings the geulah sheleyma . 16:00 - בִּבְכִ֣י יָבֹ֗אוּ וּֽבְתַחֲנוּנִים֘ אֽוֹבִילֵם֒ אֽוֹלִיכֵם֙ אֶל־נַ֣חֲלֵי מַ֔יִם - "With weeping will they come, and with supplications will I lead them, along brooks of water will I make them go..." ( Yirmiyahu 31:8). 17:00 - Sheker is the origin of tears of complaint. 18:50 - Secret of the Separation Between the Upper Waters and the Lower Waters: on the Second Day of Creation, the Lower Waters wept about being separated from the upper realms of HaShem . 24:30 - Tears of complaint damage the vision and weaken a person's perception of HaShem's hashgacha . 26:15 - Teardrops of HaShem create earthquakes. Reference to Likutey Moharan 250 . 28:00 - HaShem created the potential for sheker by separating the Upper Waters from the Lower Waters. Anything closer to its origin is closer to the oneness of Before Creation. When the Lower Waters were separated and cried, sheker and tears were created simultaneously. 32:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 : When light of HaShem reaches us, it brings us back into the Eyes of HaShem - hashgacha - and our perception of His Presence is increased. 37:00 - Even though current events seem chaotic, nothing is out of HaShem's control. 38:00 - בְּמִסְתָּרִ֥ים תִּבְכֶּֽה־נַפְשִׁ֖י מִפְּנֵ֣י גֵוָ֑ה - "...in secret my soul will weep because of your pride..." ( Yirmiyahu 13:17) HaShem is crying about the pride of Am Yisrael that has been given over to the 70 Nations. 42:00 - NOTE - True accounts of hashgacha in the current situation of Jews taken hostage in Gaza. 44:50 - Q&R about tears. 46:20 - PARAGRAPH 17.***Holy Tears: crying with regret for sins and yearning to connect with HaShem heals the damage done by tears of empty complaint. Reference to Likutey Moharan 250 . 52:50 - Bechiah deKedusha - Holy Tears heal and draw HaShem's hashgacha upon us. 55:20 - NOTE: During the events of Purim, וַיִּזְעַ֛ק זְעָקָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה וּמָרָֽה - " cried a loud and bitter cry" (Esther 4:1). Mordekhai HaTzaddik's "loud and bitter cry" brought HaShem's rescue. 56:10 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 3 - Behaalosekha - Holy Tears of Leah - False Tears of Esav - Emes vs. Sheker - Chatzos Laila - How To Cry Holy Tears - Parnassah and Hashgacha - Kudsha Brich Hu - Shekhina - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. Positive Aspect of Crying - the Holy Tears of Leah Imeinu brought her merit to marry Yaakov Avinu . Holy tears connect a person with אמת - truth. Leah's tears counteracted Esav's Tears of שקר - falsehood and materialistic desires. 06:00 - *For a person who falls into sin, crying Holy Tears - as Leah did, is very beneficial. Through tears of yearning for HaShem , we connect After Creation with Before Creation and facilitate teshuvah - returning to HaShem . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. Waking up at midnight to pray Tikkun Chatzos to mourn the Beis HaMikdash brings a person to a higher level of hashgachas HaShem . 14:50 - PARAGRAPH 20. Parshas Behaalosekha. Ner Chanukah represents the holiness of the Menorah in the Beis HaMikdash - the light of HaShem's hashgacha . 17:10 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 18:00 - ***Q&R about how to cry Holy tears. Rebbe Nachman advises not to concentrate on crying but rather to focus on being as sincere as possible when speaking words of tefilah - prayer. 21:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Yetzias Mitzrayim took place at Chatzos Layla . 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 22. Why the first mitzvah given to Bnei Yisrael was Kiddush HaChodesh . 28:30 - Terumah is related to the eyes. Ayin Tov vs. Ayin Ra . "A person who is generous gives one from forty." 32:30 - Traditionally, tzedakah is increased during Chanukah. 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Closing one's eyes to the needs of a fellow Jew is as if worshiping idols. 35:40 - בִּרְבוֹת֙ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה רַבּ֖וּ אֽוֹכְלֶ֑יהָ וּמַה־כִּשְׁרוֹן֙ לִבְעָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֖י אִם־רְא֥וּת (כתיב רְא֥יּת) עֵינָֽיו - "With the increase of good, its eaters increase, and what is the advantage to its Master, except seeing His eyes?" ( Koheles 5:10). 36:10 - עֵ֣ינֵי כֹ֖ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֚ה נוֹתֵֽן־לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ - "Everyone's eyes look to You with hope, and You give them their food in its time" ( Tehillim 145:15). 38:00 - NOTE: Two times קנ"ה is יש. 39:00 - Parnassah depends on belief in hashgacha . "Laws of Nature" are always under the direct supervision of HaShem . 42:40 - Q&R about belief in hashgacha . 44:00 - The parnassah of a religious Jew is as difficult as splitting the Yam Suf . 46:36 - Connecting After Creation with Before Creation. Parnassah comes from the Right Side - Before Creation. ( Tehillim 48:10 - PARAGRAPH 24. Connecting After Creation with Before Creation. ***The term Kudsha Brich Hu refers to HaShem on the highest level, completely above the physical world. The term Shekhina is the aspect of HaShem that sends a flow of light into the physical world. 52:40 - Q&R about joining the Right Side with the Left Side to generate parnassah . 53:45 - Q&R about Chesed and Din during creation. Before Creation - HaShem existed as the Right Side. 55:30 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 3 - Parnassah Through Joining After Creation with Before Creation - Half-Shekel - Chanuka Lights - Kiddush HaChodesh - Kriyas Yam Suf - Yosef HaTzaddik as Shaliach - Shemiras Einayim - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 51 - "Mayim Mayim" and is also based on Likutey Moharan 4 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Menorah. Chanukah lights. Half-Shekel offering. 05:40 - Dovid HaMelech and Golias . Five stones and the pouch corresponded to the Shema . 07:00 - Kiddush HaChodesh restores the diminishing of the moon. Half-Shekel Tribute. 10:30 - PARAGRAPH 25. Miracles of Yetziyas Mitzrayim . Parnassah. Kriyas Yam Suf united After Creation with Before Creation. 14:00 - Eyes of HaShem . Reference to Likutey Moharan 13 . 15:00 - Father and Son are one. Reference to Likutey Moharan 22 . 18:00 - Q&R about Left Side and Right Side. 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 26. Parshas Vayeishev. וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֨הוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣מֶק חֶבְר֔וֹן - "... So he sent him from the valley of Hebron..." ( Bereishis 37:14, Vayeishev ). All travel is dangerous. 24:00 - NOTE - Chiddush on Shimshon's riddle heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . 27:00 - All shefa comes into the world via the tzaddik . Sale of Yosef HaTzaddik . 32:00 - Yosef HaTzaddik was a faithful shaliach . 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 27. Parshas Vayeishev. The sale of Yosef HaTzaddik resulted in the separation of father and son. Yosef is an aspect of the Eyes of HaShem . When the brothers were reunited, there was crying ( Parshas Vayigash ). 36:50 - Q&R - there is a danger of confusion when HaShem sends a messenger. 40:00 - Q&R about parnassah originating from a combination of Right and Left. A child comes into the world with his parnassah . 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. The main test in this world is Shemiras HaBris . 46:15 - "Let Moshiach arrive, but let me not see it." 50:00 - כֻּלֹּ֖ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת - "...thoroughly righteous offspring..." ( Yirmiya 2:21). A person can't understand the tzaddik without a level of purity. "Don't make decisions if you realize that your brain is damaged." 53:00 - Tikkun HaBris depends on purity of the eyes. Reference to Likutey Moharan 36 . 54:40 - ***A person needs to restrict what he looks at to achieve Shemiras HaBris . He also needs to restrict what he thinks about, because thoughts are a form of "looking". When Am Yisrael looks up we draw HaShem's hashgacha upon us. 58:00 - עֵינַי תָּמִ֣יד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּי־ה֤וּא יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי - "My eyes are always to HaShem for He will take my feet out of the net" ( Tehillim 25:15). 60:00 - NOTE about assimilation and the moral challenges of our times. 61:20 - Closing blessings. 62:00 - ***Q&R - Clarification of how Shemiras Einayim is an aspect of Shemiras HaBris . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Protecting vision from impurity increases HaShem's hashgacha . 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 30. גַּל־עֵינַ֥י וְאַבִּ֑יטָה נִ֜פְלָא֗וֹת מִתּֽוֹרָתֶֽךָ - "Uncover my eyes and I shall look at hidden things from Your Torah" ( Tehillim 119:18). 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. Parshas Vayeishev. וַיְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה - "And Er, Yehudah's firstborn, was evil in the eyes of HaShem..." ( Bereishis 38:7, Vayeishev ). 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 32. Parshas Bereishis. Tikkun HaBris. וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד - "...and they shall become one flesh" ( Bereishis 2:24, Bereishis ). 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 33. Tikkun HaBris depends on Shmiras Einayim - maintaining the purity of one's vision and mental focus. 42:00 - *** Emes is the path to Teshuvah .

( Bereishis 8:11, Noach ). The dove as shaliach - messenger. 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 35. Ner Chanukah. 10:00 - Eight days of Chanukah. 15:00 - Ner Chanukah - why one light is added each night. 17:00 - Ain ohd milvado - "There is nothing other than Him ". 18:00 - *Distance is the beginning of closeness, as in מֵרָח֕וֹק יְהֹוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֣ה לִ֑י - "From a distance HaShem appeared to me..." ( Yirmiya 31:2). 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 36. ***When people join together for a holy purpose the light of HaShem increases in the world. 22:00 - Q&R about the kindling the Chanukah lights. 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 37. Hallel on Chanukah. 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 38. 29:30 - PARAGRAPH 39. Terumah . 31:00 - HALAKHA 4. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Sheluchin 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. 43:00 - הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹֽאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ - "Will you send forth lightning bolts so that they should go and say to you, 'Here we are'?" HaShem is the "place" of the world. 52:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.description: Sheluchin 4 - Souls Originate from Kisey HaKavod - Place and Above Place - Every Jew Is a Messenger - Why Did HaShem Create Angels? Bechira - Free Will - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹֽאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנו
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 4 - Souls Originate from Kisey HaKavod - Place and Above Place - Every Jew Is a Messenger - Why Did HaShem Create Angels? Bechira - Free Will - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. הַֽתְשַׁלַּ֣ח בְּרָקִ֣ים וְיֵלֵ֑כוּ וְיֹֽאמְר֖וּ לְךָ֣ הִנֵּֽנוּ - "Will you send forth lightning bolts so that they should go and say to you, 'Here we are'?" ( Iyov 38:35). 02:00 - The Kisey HaKavod is above the concept of מקום - Place. It is the origin of the souls of Am Yisrael . Connecting with the Kisey HaKavod requires a certain level of Sheleymus HaDaas and Sheleymus HaTefilah . A non-Jew cannot elevate the aspect of Place to Above Place. A child cannot serve as a messenger. 06:30 - ***When a Jew who is shomer mitzvos does activities that are not specifically mitzvos without transgressing the Torah, then even his mundane actions are elevated to the aspect Above Place. 11:20 - Q&R about a child or a Jew who is not shomer mitzvos . 12:20 - PARAGRAPH 5. The purpose of every Jew is to be a shaliach for HaShem . Each of us is on a mission. מָה־אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖י דָּבָֽר - "...what shall I reply to Him that sent me?" ( 2Shmuel 24:13). 17:00 - The names of the angels reflect each one's particular missions. 18:00 - NOTE - During the month of Elul there is a custom to read through the Tikkunei Zohar . 20:30 - Q&R about Chanoch becoming an angel. 22:00 - HaShem is running every aspect of the world. Wherever HaShem sends an angel, HaShem is already there. HaShem doesn't need angels - they didn't even exist until the second day of creation. 25:00 - The main reason HaShem sometimes uses angels is to provide situations where people have free will. HaShem constricts His Presence to make room for people to have free will. Reference to Likutey Moharan 49 and reference to Likutey Moharan 64 . 31:20 - If HaShem revealed how He supervises every detail of the world, there would be no free will and no world. Everything that exists only because HaShem is constricting Himself. 33:40 - NOTE - The word הטבע is begematria אלוקים. Angels are sometimes called אלוקים. 37:20 - NOTE - טבע is נס תמידי. 38:30 - Q&R - A recommended commentary on the Tikkunei Zohar is מתוק מדבש . 43:00 - The angels are jealous of people but do not experience jealousy of one another. 45:00 - NOTE on Sipurey Maasios - In the story of "The Missing Princess", the one who ultimately rescues the princess is called the Sheni LeMelech , which refers to the Tzaddik Emes . 49:00 - Closing blessings.

categories.title: Kever of Tzaddik is an aspect of Eretz Yisrael

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 4 - Sheleymus HaTefilah - Shaliach Tzibur - 10 Spiritual Levels of Am Yisrael - Rosh Hashanah - Minyan - Response to Kaddish - Kol Is Above Makom - Teshuvah - Zarka - 4 Sounds of the Shofar - Ema-Binah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 9. Shaliach Tzibur . Perfection of Tefilah is achieved through a shaliach - messenger. 05:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. The 10 categories spiritual levels of Klal Yisrael . Makom Kavuah establishes tefilah . 11:00 - "Where is the location..." in Shacharis . Sins are forgiven by reciting the different locations in the Beis HaMikdash where the korbonos were brought. The main sweetening of dinim is achieved through mentioning the places of avodas HaShem and connecting them to the Kisey HaKavod . 15:00 - Ehven Shesiya is the physical location of connecting with the Kisey HaKavod . 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Shaliach Tzibur on Rosh Hashanah. 18:00 - Q&R about reciting "Where is the location..." in Shacharis . 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. The Shaliach Tzibur must be on a high spiritual level. 21:00 - מִמַּֽעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה - "...from the depths I cried out to HaShem" ( Tehillim 130:1). 23:00 - "From the depths..." Through davening in a minyan , a person can reach the highest possible levels from the lowest spiritual depths. 25:00 - מקומו is begematria 432 which includes all 4 formats of HaShem's Name : AV - SaG - MaH - BaN . 27:00 - *The response to Kaddish includes all 4 levels of מקום. 30:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. The importance of traveling to the tzaddik for Rosh HaShanah. The tzaddik is entrusted with the central position in Am Yisrael's connection with Kisey HaKavod . The tzaddik is a conduit for the prayers of Am Yisrael . 32:00 - Tzaddikim yirshu Aretz. *** The gravesite of a tzaddik , no matter what its geographical location, is considered part of Eretz Yisrael - צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ - "The righteous shall inherit the Land and dwell forever in it" ( Tehillim 37:29). The place where a tzaddik is buried is his resting place. The tzaddik is at rest when he's connected to the ultimate resting place of every soul - the Kisey HaKavod . Tzaddikim yirshu Eretz. 34:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. The connection between two places is established by the ability to speak between the two locations. Kol Torah and Kol Tefilah a person can reach from the aspect of Makom to the aspect of Above Makom . Sound travels very far, therefore the sound of the shofar and the sound of tefilah on Rosh Hashana is increased. 36:00 - One of the most important elements of teshuvah is Kol . 39:00 - *** Teshuvah is returning to one's true place, which is expressed through the cantillation Zarka . Reference to Likutey Moharan 35 . Kol is above the concept of Place. "That's what Rosh Hashanah is all about." 43:00 - Q&R about the eyes being able to see further than the ears can hear. Although vision reaches farther than sound, no connection is made. It's only through sound that communication between two people is possible over a distance. 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. The 4 sounds of the shofar on Rosh Hashanah. 48:00 - Binah is above the seven levels of Zer Anpin and above the concept of Makom . Binah is begematria Elokim and is an aspect of Kisey HaKavod . " Binah is called אם - mother." The constriction of Makom does not apply to the heart: reference to 2Likutey Moharan 56 . 50:00 - The 4 sounds of the shofar. Tekiah , a single long blast; the Shevarim , three short wailing sounds; the Teruah , nine staccato alarm-like blasts; and the Tekiah Gedolah , a final, very long sustained blast. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 52:00 - Teruah. Second Tokiah . ***When a person's tefilah comes from his heart, all the neshomos trapped as reincarnations in nature can rise to their original place, above the physical world.וְהָיָ֣ה | בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִתָּקַע֘ בְּשׁוֹפָ֣ר גָּדוֹל֒ וּבָ֗אוּ הָאֹֽבְדִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְהַנִּדָּחִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲו֧וּ לַֽיהֹוָ֛ה בְּהַ֥ר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָֽ - "And it shall come to pass on that day, that a great shofar shall be sounded, and those lost in the land of Assyria and those exiled in the land of Egypt shall come and they shall prostrate themselves before HaShem on the holy mount in Jerusalem" ( Yishaya 27:13). 55:00 - ***Closing blessings for Rosh Hashanah.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 4 - Bereishis - Vayeira - Yisro - The 4 Sounds of the Shofar - Place and Above Place - Sipurey Maasios - 7 Beggars - Day 4 - Hunchback Beggar - Tree with 3 Roots - Horns of the Ram - Etz HaChaim - Teshuvah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - Am Yisrael can rise from מקום - the concept of "Place" - to the aspect of למעלה מהמקום - "Above Place" - through the 4 sounds of the shofar . 02:30 - * Sipurey Maasios - Story of the 7 Beggars - Day 4 - The Hunchback Beggar was able to rise to the level of existence “Above Place". The Ilan - tree - in the story has 3 roots: Yirah , Emunah , Anava . Its trunk is Emes . This Ilan represents the Etz HaChaim , which is an aspect of Kisey HaKavod - the source of all souls. 06:30 – The 4 sounds of the shofar correspond to the 4 elements of the Etz HaChaim - Tree of Life: Yirah, Emunah, Anava, Emes. 15:40 - אֱמֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח - "Truth will sprout from the Land..." - ( Tehillim 85:12). 19:00 - *Parshas Vayeira. During Akeidas Yitzchak - The horns of the ram were caught in a tree, hinting at the connecting between the shofar and the Etz HaDaas . 20:30 - Q&R - The power of tefilah is available to all Jews, depending on his level. 22:40 - PARAGRAPH 18. Traveling to the tzaddik is an aspect of "Above Place". Traveling to do a mitzvah is also an aspect of "Above Place". 25:48 - PARAGRAPH 17. Parshas Bereishis. וַיְגָ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן֩ מִקֶּ֨דֶם לְגַן־עֵ֜דֶן אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֗ים וְאֵ֨ת לַ֤הַט הַחֶ֨רֶב֙ הַמִּתְהַפֶּ֔כֶת לִשְׁמֹ֕ר אֶת־דֶּ֖רֶךְ עֵ֥ץ הַֽחַיִּֽים - "And He drove the man out, and He stationed from the east of the Garden of Eden the keruvim and the blade of the revolving sword, to guard the way to the Tree of Life" ( Bereishis 3:24, Bereishis ). On Rosh Hashanah Adam ate from the Etz HaDaas . He was evicted from Gan Eden in order to block the path to the Etz HaChaim . To reach its ultimate goal, every soul must return to the Etz HaChaim. 28:50 - The Etz HaChaim can only be reached through teshuvah and tefilah , as in מִמַּֽעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה - "...From the depths I have called to You, HaShem" - "...mimaamakim kerasika HaShem" ( Tehillim 130). 31:00 - Kol Tefilah connects "Place" to "Above Place" because Kol Tefilah originates from the "Breath of Life". 33:30 - Parshas Yisro. At Matan Torah , Am Yisrael was able to see Kol , as in וְכָל־הָעָם֩ רֹאִ֨ים אֶת־הַקּוֹלֹ֜ת - "And all the people saw the sounds..." ( Shemos 20:15, Yisro ). 34:00 - Moshe Rabbeinu heard the Kol of HaShem from between the Keruvim . 38:00 - ***The sound of the shofar is two-directional: it travels both from HaShem to us, and from us to HaShem . All tefilos rise up with the sound of the shofar. 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. כִּ֚י שָׁ֨מָּה | יָֽשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט - "...For there were set thrones for judgment" ( Tehillim 122:5). 46:00 - When HaShem judges the world on Rosh HaShanah, He does so from the aspect of "Above Place". 48:20 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Halakha - Selichos - 13 Midos Shel Rachamim - Rosh Hashanah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1978.) Why Rosh Hashanah is central to Breslov chassidus. A person should come to Rabbeinu zal's minyan with a "rosh" - a serious focus on teshuvah . Minhag of Selichos for Sephardim . Minhag of Selichos for Ashkenazim . The 25th of Elul is the first day of creation. The best time to begin Selichos is just before Alos HaShachar . However, the first night of Selichos we begin right after Chatzos HaLayla . The shofar is sounded every day of Elul beginning on Yom Aleph Elul . Tehillim 27 - "LeDovid - HaShem Ohri" - is said every day of Elul as well. The shofar is sounded every day of Elul except for Erev Rosh Hashanah. The 13 Midos shel Rachamim - the 13 Attributes of Mercy. Seder of the 13 Attributes according to Sefer Chassidim . Seder according to Tosefos Rosh Hashanah . The Chida zal explained that the exact seder of the Yud Gimmel Midos was open to debate because the Zohar HaKodesh was still hidden. Explanation of the Rosh . 13 Attributes of Mercy - Seder Yud Gimmel Midos shel Rachamim according to the Zohar HaKodesh and the Arizal . If possible, it's best to stand during the entire Selichos . Requirements of a Baal Tefilah and a Baal Tekiah . If a Baal Tefilah or Baal Tekiah is ill one year and someone substitutes for him, he must receive the position back the following year. Erev Rosh Hashanah is a day to do teshuvah for the entire year. Tikkun HaKlali is said on Erev Rosh Hashanah. It's an important minhag to immerse in a mikveh on Erev Rosh Hashanah. Visiting the gravesites of tzaddikim on Erev Rosh Hashanah. One should not visit a kever twice on the same day. One should not put one's right hand on a tziyon , only the left. Exceptions are certain tzaddikim and tzidkanios . Tzedakah on Erev Rosh Hashanah. Hataras Nedarim on Erev Rosh Hashanah and Erev Yom Kippur. Neder is an inyan of Binah . "Mitzvah" is Malkhus . Seder of tefilos on Rosh Hashanah and the 10 Days of Teshuvah . If "HaMelekh HaKadosh" is omitted during Shemoneh Esrei , the tefilah is repeated. The Tikkunei Zohar says the correct phrase is "Kula beAshan Tikleh" . Greetings extended on the first night of Rosh Hashanah, after davening . ***A person who judges others favorably, is himself judged favorably by HaShem . The Taz says this particular greeting format may be said on both nights of Rosh Hashanah while there is a differing opinion that it is said only the first night. Simanim on the night of Rosh Hashanah. The custom of not sleeping on Rosh Hashanah. Avoiding anger during Rosh Hashanah. It is a custom to say the entire Sefer Tehillim on each day of Rosh Hashanah. The shofar is not sounded on the first day of Rosh Hashanah that comes out on Shabbos . "Shehechianu" is said on candle-lighting and at Kiddush on both nights of Rosh Hashanah. Kriyas HaTorah and Aliya leTorah on Rosh Hashanah. Tehillim 130 - "Mimaamakim" - is said together with the Baal Tefilah on Rosh Hashanah. A person should try to shed tears during the tefilos of Rosh Hashanah. By washing his forehead and hands with his tears a person receives forgiveness. When a person is suddenly brought to tears during tefilah , at that moment he is being judged Above. Tokias Shofar on Rosh Hashanah. A person should stand during tokias hashofar . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Halakha - Rosh Hashanah - Seder Tekias Shofar - Tefilah - Speaker: Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal . (Recorded ca. 1978.) A person must hear every one of the 100 soundings of the shofar. To prevent disturbance of the kehilla, young children should not be brought to shul . Women are exempt from the obligation to hear shofar but traditionally go to shul to hear it if they can. How to hold the shofar. The shofar is covered during the blessings on sounding the shofar. Tehillim 47 - "Lamenatze'ach" - is said 7 times before the shofar is sounded. Seder Tekias Shofar. Length of each one of the shofar's kolos . During the tefilos belachash a person should stop and listen to the tekios . According to the Arizal , the Shemoneh Esrei must be said silently. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Holiness within the parameters of location and time. The holiness of Shabbat . Biographical notes about R' Nasan's introduction to Breslov chassidut. Reference to Hishtapkhus HaNefesh . lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Ki Sisa - Vayelech - Isarusa Dilesata - Beirur HaMedameh - The Tzaddik Lives Forever - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Beirur HaMedameh - getting free of illusion. 13:30 - Q&R - Purifying the Medameh is done through Torah and tefilah . Receiving Torah from the Tzaddik strengthens emunah and provides greater clarity of vision. 14:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. Four stages in the process of Beirur HaMedameh . 24:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas Ki Sisa. וַיַּ֣רְא הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי בשֵׁ֥שׁ משֶׁ֖ה לָרֶ֣דֶת מִן־הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעָ֜ם עַל־אַֽהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּֽאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ ק֣וּם | עֲשֵׂה־לָ֣נ - "When the people saw that Moses was late in coming down from the mountain..." ( Shemos 32:1, Ki Sisa ). The Erev Rav misled Am Yisrael when Moshe Rabbeinu was on Har Sinai . 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Parshas Vayelech. The Tzaddik lives forever. כִּ֣י אָֽנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת־מֶרְיְךָ֔ וְאֶת־עָרְפְּךָ֖ הַקָּשֶׁ֑ה - "For I know your rebellious spirit and your stubbornness..." Devarim 31:27-29, Vayelech ). 35:45 - וַיַּֽעֲבֹ֚ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל | יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶֽאֱרִ֚יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַֽחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ - "And Israel served HaShem all the days of Yehoshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Yehoshua..." ( Yehoshua 24:31). Throughout the lifetime of Yehoshua , Am Yisrael served HaShem without rebelling. The Tzaddik never dies, even if it seems to us that he left. 38:00 - The Tzaddik lives on in his students. 41:30 - וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר יְמֵֽי־עוֹלָ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ - "And His people remembered the days of old, Moshe..." ( Yishaya 63:11). 44:30 - Closing blessings for Erev Rosh Hashanah. Later today Rabbi Maimon is scheduled to travel to Uman via Moldavia, b'ezras HaShem . He asks that everyone keep in their prayers all those taking part in the Uman Rosh Hashanah gathering. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-09-30 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Para. 17-18 - Parshas Ekev
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Ekev - Passing of Aharon HaKohen - Finding the Tzaddik - Loyalty of Shevet Levi - Elazar - Successor to a Tzaddik - Asniel Ben Kenaz - Pilpul Amiti vs. Pilpul Shel Hevel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Parshas Ekev. וּבְנֵ֣י
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Ekev - Passing of Aharon HaKohen - Finding the Tzaddik - Loyalty of Shevet Levi - Elazar - Successor to a Tzaddik - Asniel Ben Kenaz - Pilpul Amiti vs. Pilpul Shel Hevel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Parshas Ekev. וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־יַֽעֲקָ֖ן מֽוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו - "The children of Israel journeyed from the wells of B'nei Ya'akan to Moserah; there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son served as kohen in his stead" ( Devarim 10:6, Ekev ). Am Yisrael didn't really feel the loss of Aharon until they realized their past mistakes. 08:00 - Am Yisrael could only access the holiness of Aharon HaKohen after his passing through his son, Elazar . 11:00 - Amalek attacks Am Yisrael when their faith in the Tzaddik is weak. The essential power of evil in the world is loss of faith in tzaddikim . A chossid nofeyl - a righteous person "falling away" from faith - is one of the worst things that can happen. 15:00 - כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הֶֽ֖אֱמִינוּ בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָֽ֜טְח֗וּ בִּישֽׁוּעָתֽוֹ - "Because they did not believe in HaShem and did not trust in His salvation" ( Tehillim 78:22). 17:00 - *The members of Shevet Levi did not allow themselves to be pulled into the mistake of the people who opposed Moshe Rabbeinu . By doing this, they insured the continuity of the world. 20:50 - *Eulogizing tzaddikim strengthens the emunas chokhomim of Am Yisrael . 24:50 - After Am Yisrael mourns the loss of a tzaddik , we are then obligated able to find the holiness of the son or student who fills the position of the tzaddik who passed away. 26:00 - ***Q&R - How does one search for the tzaddik in our present generation? One way is by searching for the one who is fit to take his place, and another way is by visiting the gravesite of the tzaddik . Before a great tzaddik passes away, HaShem makes sure there is another tzaddik to continue in his ways. But it's not easy for a generation to find and then accept the new leader. ( Yuma 38). 34:30 - ***When a tzaddik passes away, we need to eulogize him, but not make the tragic mistake of saying "there's no one who can replace him. Because the tzaddik is definitely alive in his children and in his students. Therefore a person must search more than ever before to connect with that remaining holiness, because it is more hidden. 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. During the mourning period for Moshe Rabbeinu , 300 halakhos were forgotten, but Asniel Ben Kanaz restored what was forgotten. 40:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 21 . ***The purpose of eulogizing the tzaddik is to infuse life, but not to pull us down and say "There's no one who compares to him - no one can help us now" - chas veshalom . 45:50 - ***Asniel Ben Kenaz realized that HaShem doesn't want us to adopt the attitude "there's no hope" when a tzaddik is niftar and therefore he strengthened himself to return to joy and took up the task of restoring the 300 forgotten laws through Pilpul Amiti. 48:00 - Pilpul Amiti vs. Pilpul Shel Hevel. - Applying Torah to life situations brings a person happiness, as in פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה יְ֖שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵ֑ב - "The orders of HaShem are upright, causing the heart to rejoice..." ( Tehillim 19:9). Pilpul Shel Hevel is Torah study that doesn't result in practical application. 52:00 - ***After the mourning period for a tzaddik , it's essential for his students to renew Torah study so that, as Asniel Ben Kenaz , we too can search and find what was lost. 54:20 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-10-03 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Para. 19-20 - Parshas Shemos
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Shemos - Elisha HaNavi - Gechazi - The Final Redemption Depends on Searching for the Tzaddik - Nevuah - Ruach HaKodesh - Why Moshe Rabbeinu Was Reluctant to Lead Am Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. The mistake of Elis
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Shemos - Elisha HaNavi - Gechazi - The Final Redemption Depends on Searching for the Tzaddik - Nevuah - Ruach HaKodesh - Why Moshe Rabbeinu Was Reluctant to Lead Am Yisrael - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. The mistake of Elisha HaNavi with his student, Gechazi . וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חָלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ - "And Elisha became ill with the illness he was to die of..." ( 2Melachim 13:14). The Final Redemption depends on the Tzaddik - Nevuah - Ruach HaKodesh - Why Moshe Rabbeinu was reluctant to lead Am Yisrael . 05:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 18 . 11:00 - Parshas Shemos. מִי אָנֹכִי כִּי אֵלֵךְ אֶל־פַּרְעֹה - "...who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh?" ( Shemos 3:11, Shemos ). 18:00 - וָאֹמַר לָךְ בְּדָמַיִךְ חֲיִי וָאֹמַר לָךְ בְּדָמַיִךְ חֲיִי - "...and I said to you, 'With your blood, live,' and I said to you, 'With your blood, live'" ( Yechezkel 16:6). 26:00 - Parshas Shemos. שְׁלַח־נָא בְּיַד־תִּשְׁלָח - "...send now whomever You will send" ( Shemos 4:13, Shemos ). Moshe Rabbeinu's reluctance to accept HaShem's mission kindled a need to search for the Tzaddik Emes that will last until the final redemption. 36:00 - NOTE on the holy Baal Shem Tov's explanation: "A person who lives outside of Eretz Yisrael imagines they are far from HaShem , but they are actually close to HaShem . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. וַיִּגַּשׁ גֵּיחֲזִי לְהָדְפָהּ - "...and Gehazi approached to push her away..." ( 2Melachim 4:27). When Gechazi lost Olam Haba , his teacher - Elisha HaNavi - was also punished for pushing him away. HaShem's kindness is infinite, so a teacher is required to search for the good in Gechazi to the point that he'd be able to uplift Gechazi . 40:00 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on the order of the Four Sons mentioned in Seder Pesach . The Arizal explains, any chokham who doesn't have a rasha next to him isn't a true chokham . An example of this is how Rebbe Nachman played chess with kofrim when he lived in Uman. 44:00 - וַיִּפֶן אַחֲרָיו וַיִּרְאֵם - "And he turned around and saw them..." ( 2Melachim 2:24). When Elisha HaNavi was insulted by a group of youths, he turned to look at them. Since he couldn't see their good, he cursed them. HaShem made a miracle and created a forest from which came 2 bears that killed 42 of these youths. 48:00 - Why Eliyahu HaNavi is present at every Bris Milah and why the flood is called "Mei Noach" . 51:00 - Closing blessings for these four days between Yom Kippur and Sukkos . 53:00 - Q&R about dealing with seeing statues of Avoda Zara when traveling. Rabbi Rosenfeld zal did not permit his student to mekarev people who were engaged in anti-Torah missionary work. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-10-05 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Para. 21-23 - Parshas Bereishis
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Bereishis - Clothing - Elisha HaNavi - Searching for the Tzaddik's Successor - Business Transactions - Elevating the Sparks of Emunah in the Physical World - Beirur HaMedameh - Garments of HaShem - Kinyan Sudar - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Bereishis - Clothing - Elisha HaNavi - Searching for the Tzaddik's Successor - Business Transactions - Elevating the Sparks of Emunah in the Physical World - Beirur HaMedameh - Garments of HaShem - Kinyan Sudar - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Review of Elisha HaNavi's mistake with his student, Gechazi , and with cursing the disrespect of the 42 youths. וֶאֱלִישָׁע חָלָה אֶת־חָלְיוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָמוּת בּוֹ - "And Elisha became ill with the illness he was to die of..." ( 2Melachim 13:14). 06:35 - PARAGRAPH 22. וַיַּכֶּה אֶת־הַמַּיִם וַיֵּחָצוּ הֵנָּה וָהֵנָּה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֱלִישָׁע - "...He too struck the water and it divided on this side and on that side, and Elisha crossed over" ( 2Melachim 2:14). Elisha HaNavi merited splitting the waters of the Yarden through mentioning the name of his teacher, Eliyahu NaNavi . 11:00 - ***Even before a tzaddik is niftar , HaShem prepares his replacement. A person must pray very much and study the tzaddik's teachings diligently to merit discovering the identity, ruach hakodesh , and holiness of the tzaddik's successor. "No generation is an orphan." 13:00 - וַיִּזְכֹּר יְמֵי־עוֹלָם מֹשֶׁה עַמּוֹ אַיֵּה׀ הַמַּעֲלֵם מִיָּם אֵת רֹעֵי צֹאנוֹ אַיֵּה הַשָּׂם בְּקִרְבּוֹ אֶת־רוּחַ קָדְשׁוֹ - "And His people remembered the days of old, Moses; where is he who drew them up from the sea, a shepherd His flock; where is he who placed within them His Holy Spirit?" ( Yeshaya 63:11). Reference to Likutey Moharan 66 . 14:40 - PARAGRAPH 23. Kinyan Sudar . All business transactions involve the refinement of the holy sparks of emunah found in physical objects, including all aspects of wealth. 18:20 - One way that Beirur HaMedameh is achieved is through conducting business with honesty. All 5 senses are involved in business transactions. 20:00 - Parshas Bereishis. The Sekhel - the highest level of the Jewish soul that can be present in this world - is above the physical senses, and the Koach Mamedameh is the messenger between the physical world and the Sekhel . Clothing is rooted in imagery, which are referred to garments. All praises and Names of HaShem only give us imagery of Who He is, based on what the prophets perceived, as in יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר - "HaShem has reigned; He has attired Himself with majesty; indeed HaShem has attired Himself, He has girded Himself with might" ( Tehillim 93:1). 25:00 - NOTE - Account of an interaction in which Rebbe Nachman speaks about the appearance of the Malakh Mem Tess . 26:30 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal's dream about Rebbe Nachman. The Breslov elders of his generation verified that the way Reb Michel zal saw the Rebbe was, in fact, the way Rebbe Nachman was known to appear in dreams. 29:20 - Parshas Bereishis. Before the sin of Adam and Chava , there was no clothing because they were able to perceive HaShem without any garments or filters. 33:00 - Analogy to understand the role of the Medameh in perceiving the reality of this world: even if an advertisement for a circus includes a live-action video, it's still not the circus itself. 35:30 - Clothing is an aspect of the garments of HaShem . Changing a business deal in midstream is an example of Bilbul HaMedameh - confusion which leads to dishonesty. A Jew must keep his word, even if a kinyan wasn't made. Kinyan Sudar draws on the Garments of HaShem - His praises and Names - that are a necessary for a person to achieve Beirur HaMedameh . 39:00 - Q&R about business transactions and halakha : there are many levels of integrity. Analogy of "passing" a test and "doing well" on a test. 41:00 - Q&R about the connection between holiness, joy, and emunah and "fallen sparks". All of creation contains emunah . 43:00 - Q&R - Finding Ruach HaKodesh in the present generation is achieved through searching for the Tzaddik's successor. 45:20 - This is the last class before Sukkos . The importance of buying new clothing for Yom Tov . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: 2025-10-15 - Sheluchin 5 - Vayeitzei - Chashmal - Throne of HaShem - Medameh - Imagination - Merkava of the Sutra Achra - Klipa Noga - Ruach HaKodesh of the Tzaddik Emes - Tikkun HaMidos Results in Beirur Hamedameh - Traveling to the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Mohara
lessons.bodyText: 2025-10-15 - Sheluchin 5 - Vayeitzei - Chashmal - Throne of HaShem - Medameh - Imagination - Merkava of the Sutra Achra - Klipa Noga - Ruach HaKodesh of the Tzaddik Emes - Tikkun HaMidos Results in Beirur Hamedameh - Traveling to the Tzaddik - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. Chashmal - Malbush - Vision of Yechezkel HaNavi - Darkness Surrounding the Throne of HaShem - Levels of Medameh - Confusion - Merkava of the Sutra Achra - Klipa Noga . 07:10 - *The quality of a person's Medameh - imagination - is affected by the refinement of his midos - character traits. 10:00 - The Ruach HaKodesh of the Tzaddik Emes draws from the Ruach Hakodesh at the time of Matan Torah . This Ruach HaKodesh makes Tikkun HaMedameh possible. This is what enables the Tzaddik Emes to repair all levels of Medameh in this confused world. 13:17 - The Neviim merited clarified and perfected their powers of Medameh through refining their character traits. 16:20 - Basing decisions on the daas of the Tzaddik Emes helps a person achieve a higher level of Hasagas Elokus . 18:00 - Beirur Hamedameh - the process of refining and elevating the imagination. 18:58 - NOTE about the petirah of Rebbe Nachman during Sukkos . The Torah in Likutey Moharan upon which this halakha is based was the last Torah given over by Rebbe Nachman in his lifetime and was spoken through tremendous mesiras nefesh . 22:29 - Q&R about the connection between one's actions and the clarity of one's actions. Example of Aristotle: "In public I'm a scholar, in private I'm an animal." The quality of one's behavior affects the clarity of one's perception of אמת - truth. 26:26 - NOTE in response to the question: 2 parts of the brain correspond to the parts of HaShem's Name Y - K - V - K . The V - K is affected by a person's ability to perceive HaShem and to make wise choices in life. 27:00 - If Chokhma is not emanating from a person of moral integrity, heeding that person's teachings, no matter how "lofty" will result in moral regression. 28:25 - *Q&R about how to recognize that one is making spiritual progress. Torah study and tefilah help a person's self perception. Example of how humility - tikkun hamidos - also helps: Rebbe Nachman's daughter was once dismayed when her father praised her. Meriting rebuke from the Tzaddik Emes is indication of one making progress. 32:17 - PARAGRAPH 25. Sekhel - clarifying the Medameh . Why business transactions often require traveling. Example of how animal thought is not at the level of human thought. "A monkey is a monkey." If a person's decision-making process isn't attached to a tzaddik , he is functioning at a relatively low level. 37:15 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 40 . The Tikkun HaKlali for money is tzedakah . Traveling to the Tzaddik enables a person to achieve Tikkun Hamedameh . The horses that carry him - his animal thinking - are being elevated to the level of Sekhel . The goal of business travel is the ability to give tzedakah . 39:15 - NOTE - in present times, traveling by machine is an aspect of traveling by means of an animal. Traveling through the midbar for 40 years was a tikkun for the Egel HaZahav . 41:18 - Walking helps strengthen the Sekhel . The feet correspond to the Medameh - the lowest level of the Sekhel . 42:34 - Parshas Vayeitzei. וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב רַגְלָיו וַיֵּלֶךְ אַרְצָה בְנֵי־קֶדֶם - "So Yaakov lifted up his feet and went to the land of the people of the East" Bereishis 29:1, Vayeitzei ). The heart is an aspect of Sekhel . The Sekhel uplifts the feet to service of HaShem . 43:18 - All the terms we use to honor HaShem serve to clarify the Medameh . HaShem is above any possible expression or perception. 44:57 - NOTE about customs of Isru Chag - reminder that there's no Tachanun until Rosh Chodesh Cheshvan . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-10-16 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Para. 26-28
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Beshalach - Shoftim - Horse and Rider - Medameh - Sekhel - Tikkun HaBris - Emunah - Parnassah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 26. Parshas Beshalach. וַיִּקַּח שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בָּחוּר וְכֹל רֶכֶב מִצְרָיִם וְשָׁלִשִׁם עַל־כֻּלּוֹ - "He took six h
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Beshalach - Shoftim - Horse and Rider - Medameh - Sekhel - Tikkun HaBris - Emunah - Parnassah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 26. Parshas Beshalach. וַיִּקַּח שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בָּחוּר וְכֹל רֶכֶב מִצְרָיִם וְשָׁלִשִׁם עַל־כֻּלּוֹ - "He took six hundred select chariots and all the chariots of Egypt, with officers over them all" ( Shemos 14:7, Beshalach ). וַיִּירְאוּ מְאֹד וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה - "...They were very frightened, and the children of Israel cried out to HaShem" ( Shemos 14:10, Beshalach ). 03:43 - Horses represent an aspect of impure Medameh - misuse of the power of imagination. 06:04 - A person doesn't commit a sin unless a spirit of foolishness overcomes him ( Sotah ). The 3 parts of the brain prevent foreign thoughts. If any part of the brain is damaged, foreign thoughts enter the mind. 07:30 - The Tzaddik Emes knows how to force the Sitra Achra to return the good it has swallowed from Am Yisrael . His success in this process brings him to Ruach HoKodesh . 09:30 - The main source of a confused Medameh - imagination - are the sins of passion committed in one's youth. 11:00 - Each person needs to be prepared to go through many difficulties in order to repair the sins of one's youth, especially those committed before a person connected with the Tzaddik Emes . If a person has true pity on himself, he will be very determined to attach himself to the Tzaddik and to always seek the true application of his teachings. 13:45 - *The main goal in this world is for every person - in every situation - to make the Medameh subservient to the Sekhel . 15:20 - When Pharaoh's army attacked, even though Am Yisrael was frightened, they held onto the emunah they had received from their forefathers and cried out to HaShem . 16:50 - *A person needs to cry out to HaShem until he has the feeling that HaShem has heard Him. 17:50 - אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה כִּי־גָאֹה גָּאָה סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם - "...I will sing to HaShem, for He is very exalted; the horse and its rider He cast into the sea" ( Shemos 15:1, Beshalach .) Horse and rider: the horse is mentioned first because subduing the horse - Beirur HaMedameh - is the key to defeating the Sitra Achra . 21:00 - וַיִּירְאוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהוָה וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בַּיהוָה וּבְמֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ - "...and the people feared HaShem, and they believed in HaShem and in Moshe, His servant" ( Shemos 14:31, Beshalach ). 21:53 - PARAGRAPH 27. Parshas Beshalach. Moral impurity and excessive desire for money interfere with emunah . The way to begin correcting these desires is to search incessantly for the Tzaddik Emes . When he has found the Tzaddik , he needs to continually refine his application of the Tzaddik's teachings. 25:30 - "The horse and its rider..." 25:41 - *The horse represents the epitome of the impurity of Egypt, as inהוֹי הַיֹּרְדִים מִצְרַיִם לְעֶזְרָה עַל־סוּסִים יִשָּׁעֵנוּ וַיִּבְטְחוּ עַל־רֶכֶב כִּי רָב וְעַל פָּרָשִׁים - "Woe to those who go down to Egypt for aid, and who rely on horses and trust in chariots which are many, and on riders who are very strong, and they did not rely on the Holy One of Israel and HaShem they did not seek" ( Yeshaya 31:1). 28:24 - Even though a person needs a physical source of income, putting excessive effort into making money can cause a person to forget about HaShem's part in parnassah . 32:05 - Defeat of illusion is achieved through the Tzaddik Emes . 33:00 - NOTE: This coming Shabbos we begin the Torah again with Parshas Bereishis . 34:02 - The Song of 72 Strings - the world will be built with חסד - Loving Kindness - as in עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה - "...'the world will always be built on kindness'..." ( Tehillim 89:3). 36:19 - PARAGRAPH 28. Parshas Shoftim. רַק לֹא־יַרְבֶּה־לּוֹ סוּסִים וְלֹא־יָשִׁיב אֶת־הָעָם מִצְרַיְמָה לְמַעַן הַרְבּוֹת סוּס "Only, he may not acquire many horses for himself, so that he will not bring the people back to Egypt in order to acquire many horses..." and וְלֹא יַרְבֶּה־לּוֹ נָשִׁים - "And he shall not take many wives for himself..." ( Devarim 17:16-17, Shoftim ). The prohibition against acquiring "too many horses" refers to giving in to physical desires. 39:47 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Haazinu - Parshas VeZos-HaBerakha - Shlomo HaMelech - Ruach HaKodesh Is Above Chokhma - Revelation of Moshiach - Emunah of the Released Hostages - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 29. Shlomo HaMelech regretted going beyond the limits of the Torah's mitzvos by relying on his own chokhma . וְלֹא־קָם נָבִיא עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוֹ יְהוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים - "And there was no other prophet who arose in Israel like Moshe, whom HaShem knew face to face" ( Devarim 34:10, VeZos-HaBeracha ). 09:13 - "For who went up to the heavens to receive the Torah?" The entire Written and Oral Torah was given to Moshe Rabbeinu at Sinai. Therefore, it's impossible to achieve Beirur HaMedameh through the true tzaddikim in every generation who draw from the Torah that Moshe Rabbeinu gave us. 11:40 - NOTE about Parshas Haazinu . 15:00 - Who are the tzaddikim in our generation? One needs to search for them. 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 30. When Moshiach is revealed, the false faiths will fall away and HaShem's providence and complete sovereignty will be clear to everyone. 17:50 - בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה עַל־מְצִלּוֹת הַסּוּס קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה - "On that day there will be upon the bells of the horses, 'holy to HaShem'" ( Zecharia 14:20). The custom of an army of bedecking its horses with gold and precious stones demonstrated lack of belief in HaShem . 23:00 - Q&R about Torah in the future. Moshiach will quote the Likutey Moharan . 26:00 - True happiness and true love is only possible through faith in HaShem and His Tzaddikim . Several related incidents. Biographical Note: Rabbi Rosenfeld zal : "You have no idea how many nights I cried that you should have a source of parnassah ." 30:30 - PARAGRAPH 31. לְסֻסָתִי בְּרִכְבֵי פַרְעֹה דִּמִּיתִיךְ רַעְיָתִי - "At the gathering of the steeds of Pharaoh's chariots have I silenced you, my beloved" ( Shir HaShirim 1:9). 34:00 - NOTE about current events: a number of the recent hostages who returned from captivity Am Yisrael describe how they refused to sin by telling their captors: " HaShem is My Boss, and HaShem is Your Boss." 37:45 - NOTE heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on the word סוס - horse. HaShem's Shem A - D - N - Y in Gematria Atbash . 39:50 - אַחַת הִיא יוֹנָתִי תַמָּתִי - "My dove, my perfect one, is but one..." ( Shir HaShirim 6:9). 42:30 - Q&R about current events - the emunah of some of the hostages. 44:00 - NOTE about the Klosenberger Rebbe's emunah throughout the Holocaust and the surviving hostages. 45:00 - ***Q&R about the faith of hostages who were not shomer mitzvos when they were captured - sometimes the emunah of a person comes alive through difficulties. 46:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 34. וְהִנֵּה רֶכֶב־אֵשׁ וְסוּסֵי אֵשׁ - "...and behold a fiery chariot a
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Beshalach - Eliyahu HaNavi - Elisha HaNavi - Horse and Chariot - A Tzaddik Lives Forever - Beirur HaMedameh Through Limud Torah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 34. וְהִנֵּה רֶכֶב־אֵשׁ וְסוּסֵי אֵשׁ - "...and behold a fiery chariot and fiery horses..." ( 2Melachim 2:11). Eliyahu HaNavi - Elisha HaNavi - Horse and Chariot. 05:20 - Eliyahu HaNavi did not die. Chariot of Fire. 08:20 - *A tzaddik lives forever. 10:40 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 33 where Rebbe Nachman explains the possuk בְּיוֹם טוֹבָה הֱיֵה בְטוֹב וּבְיוֹם רָעָה רְאֵה "On a day of good, be among the good, and on a day of adversity, look..." ( Koheles 7:14). 11:00 - Beirur HaMedameh. One of the best ways to repair the Medameh is through speaking words of Torah. When the imagination is repaired and a person is free of illusion, then everything else is repaired. 13:15 - Q&R about Eliyahuv HaNavi living forever and how it applies to us on a daily level: by educating students and children a person lives on after his passing. Every Jew has an obligation to learn nistar . אַל־תִּהְיוּ׀ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין - "Do not be like a horse or mule, lacking comprehension..." ( Tehillim 32:9) refers to people who refuse to learn all four levels of PaRDeS - the Torah's Pshat, Remez, Drush, and Sohd . 19:20 - Elisha HaNavi cried out "My father, my father, 20:50 - *NOTE - A tzaddik is a chariot for HaShem . 23:30 - NOTE about Parshas Bereishis - the mind is the main battlefield against the Yetzer HaRa . 25:00 - PARAGRAPH 35. Parshas Beshalach. לְסֻסָתִי בְּרִכְבֵי פַרְעֹה דִּמִּיתִיךְ רַעְיָתִי - "At the gathering of the steeds of Pharaoh's chariots have I silenced you, my beloved" ( Shir HaShirim 1:9). HaShem did battle against Mitzrayim through horses and chariots. Whatever weapons the Egyptians used against Am Yisrael, HaShem used against the Egyptians. "He took six hundred select chariots and all the chariots of Egypt..." ( Shemos 14:7, Beshalach ). The gematria in "Pharaoh took 600 horses..." alludes to Pharaoh's gathering all the various forces of the Sutra Achra . 28:00 - HaShem does battle against the enemies of Am Yisrael by matching evil step for step. 31:30 - ***Every day a person is involved in a holy battle - the central battle throughout life - of Bilbul HaMedameh - illusion - vs. Emes - truth. This struggle is a war that can only be won by means of HaShem's help. 36:00 - *** HaShem matches evil for evil rather than deliver one "knockout punch" in order to allow the functioning of free will in the world. 37:20 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 38 . 40:00 - יְהוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה - "HaShem is strong and mighty, HaShem is a mighty warrior" ( Tehillim 24:8). 43:00 - NOTE - The Sutra Achra presents every individual with many various difficulties, but HaShem can rescue from all of them. Over the generations the Sutra Achra was given more and more power - especially through technology. 44:00 - NOTE - Rabbi Pinchas Teitz zal began a weekly radio program called "Daf HaShavuah" in 1953. He spearheaded the use of mass media to teach Torah, and had over 20,000 listeners, many of whom were Holocaust survivors. Using technology has negative aspects but can also be used to study Torah. 47:00 - *Q&R - How can we fight the evil aspects of technology? Torah, tefilah , and connection with a tzaddik . 50:00 - NOTE about Parshas Noach. The only people who were saved from the mabul were those who were connected with Noach . 54:40 - Closing notes. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Parshas Beshalach - Horse and Chariot - Good Thoughts Are Merkava deKedusha - Beirur HaMedameh - Challenge of Ai - 20th of Sivan - 29th of Tishrei - Yahrzeit of R' Moshe Burstein zal - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 35b. Parshas Beshalach . HaShem's defeat of Pharaoh's horses and chariots through His Merkava deKedusha vs. the Merkava deSutra Achra . A person's thoughts are called the Merkava deKedusha and the confused throughs are called the Merkava deSutra Achra . Establishing good thoughts and letting go of confused thoughts is the main struggle in life. 08:21 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 69 . The power of the horse alludes to the powers in the physical world. 10:00 - All the religions in the world are essentially connected with serving HaShem but are distorted by the Sutra Achra . 12:00 - NOTE about current events - the kovod surrounding the recent foreign emissaries visiting Eretz Yisrael . 13:00 - Making the horse subservient to the rider: using the physical world to achieve actions of kedusha . 18:00 - ***Applying the above concepts to daily life by continually strengthening emunah in HaShem through Beirur HaMedameh . The Yetzer Hara has a variety of tactics to use against us, but HaShe m can match and defeat them, one by one. 20:00 - The entire world depends on man's Beirur HaMedameh . Beirur HaMedameh leads to the establishment of HaShem's New World - Malkhus Moshiach . 18:10 - Q&R about Matan Torah being given on the 6th of Sivan . 19:22 - Q&R about how artificial intelligence is hiding HaShem . Sipurey Maasios - Story of the Master of Prayer - the kingdom that believed murder was the goal. Ai is doing away with the need for a work force, but HaShem's purpose behind creation was the establishment of Am Yisrael . 21:52 - NOTE about A.i. 23:35 - Slichos on the 20th of Sivan . 32:27 - ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal : Connecting oneself with the 30,000 martyrs in Uman when saying the Shema . 36:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 179 . Charity increases peace. There is makhlokes in Am Yisrael to hide the identity of the tzaddikim . 44:00 - Achila deKedusha and fasting help a person to find the Tzaddik . Reference to Likutey Moharan 57 about the spiritual dimensions of fasting. 46:00 - Why the Fast of the 20th of Sivan was established in the month of Matan Torah . 47:00 - *BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: Today - the 29th of Tishrei - is the yahrzeit of Reb Moshe b'Reb Matisyahu Dovid Burstein zal (1913-2011). Friendship between him and Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal and their shared determination to travel to Uman for Rosh Chodesh even through life-threatening circumstances during the years of Soviet oppression. 46:57 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE: The 29th of Tishrei is also the yahrzeit of Rabbi Maimon's father - Reb Eliezer b'Reb Nasan Yaakov Maimon zal . Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Ki Sisa - Fast Days - Searching for the Tzaddik - Tefilah of Moshe Rabbeinu - 13 Attributes of Kindness - Who Is the Tzaddik Today? Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon.
