( Yeshaya 59:20). 05:20 - Ruach HaKodesh is drawn to the world through the Tzaddik . 10:25 - The soul of a living thing is in its name. Sometimes the Tzaddik is recognized and publicized, and sometimes he causes his name to be hidden. He does this in order to achieve an aspect of Kiddush HaShem . Sometimes when the Tzaddik suffers insult, it prevents bloodshed in Klal Yisrael . 13:10 - Summary of the halakha : searching for the Tzaddik and attaching oneself to him may cause a person a loss of prestige, but if a person is willing to endure this shame and embarrassment, this enable him to come close to him. 16:36 - "It is impossible to come close to the Tzaddik Emes without mesiras nefesh , and one of the main forms of mesiras nefesh is enduring lack of respect." 17:45 - יֵשׁ בּוֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְרוֹת חָרֶב - "There is one who speaks like the jabs of a sword..." ( Mishlei 12:18). 20:22 - NOTE: Who is the Tzaddik Emes today? A person cannot perceive the Tzaddik Emes today unless he is willing to endure mesiras nefesh . 23:50 - NOTE on Parshas Bereishis . "Bereishis Bara Elokim" - sofei teivos אמת - emes - truth. The way to the emes is humility. 27:55 - PARAGRAPH 37. Hilkhos Onaah - the prohibition of deceiving a friend or giving bad advice in a business transaction. 29:10 - Rebbe Nachman opposed smoking, even though during his time it was considered beneficial for digestion. 34:06 - *** HaShem always knows when a person's being fake. An important aspect of respecting Hilkhos Onaah is not deceiving oneself. Tricking someone else in business is actually tricking oneself. The dishonest one will be repaid by HaShem . 36:17 - Business transactions are based on drawing the light of the Tzaddik . Kinyan Sudar . 38:24 - וְזֹאת לְפָנִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־הַגְּאֻלָּה וְעַל־הַתְּמוּרָה לְקַיֵּם כָּל־דָּבָר שָׁלַף אִישׁ נַעֲלוֹ וְנָתַן לְרֵעֵהוּ - "And this was the custom in former times in Israel concerning redemption and exchange, to confirm anything, one would remove his shoe and give to his fellow" ( Megillas Rus 4:7). 42:35 - Closing blessings. Eretz Yisrael is kedushah . Chutz L'Aretz is Klipa . Ehver leYarden is Klipa Noga . 02:50 - NOTE about the danger of Conservative Judaism. 08:45 - ROSHEI PEROKIM. Kinyan Sudar . 11:00 - וּבְיַד הַנְּבִיאִים אֲדַמֶּה - "...and to the prophets I assumed likenesses" - ( Hoshea 12:11). Conducting business relates to the Medameh . Within the Medameh is a high-level light, called Chashmal . 12:20 - ***When a person studies Torah with his grandchild, it's as if he's receiving the Torah at Har Sinai . 14:30 - A person merits respectable garments through the aspect of רסן - reins/bit for a horse. 17:22 - אַל־תִּהְיוּ׀ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרֹב אֵלֶיךָ - "Do not be like a horse, like a mule that does not discern; whose mouth must be held with bit and bridle, so that when he is being groomed, he does not come near you" ( Tehillim 32:9). Zacharia HaNavi saw HaShem riding/subduing 4 horses corresponding to the 4 kingdoms of evil. 19:20 - Clothing came into existence after the sin of Adam HaRishon . If a talmid chokham's clothing is frayed clothing, it's a sign that the klipos are trying to attach themselves to him. 22:25 - Q&R about fragrance being an aspect of clothing. A man is forbidden to wear fragrance. 26:00 - Q&R about the Medameh being the clothing of the Sekhel . Bilbul HaMedameh is clothing. 27:15 - In preparation for Matan Torah , Am Yisrael was commanded to launder their clothing. On Yom Kippur the Kohen Gadol changed clothing 4 times. 32:00 - Passing of Moshe Rabbeinu . 34:20 - Elisha HaNavi and Gechazi . It's best that a rabbi keeps a certain distance from his students. 38:00 - ***Searching for the Tzaddik - Eliyahu HaNavi . The only way to search for Eliyahu HaNavi after he left this world was to do as Elisha HaNavi did: pray. 41:00 - אָבִי ׀ אָבִי רֶכֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל וּפָרָשָׁיו - "...'My father! My father! The chariots of Israel and their riders!'..." ( 2Melachim 2:12). Every tzaddik is a chariot for HaShem . 43:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 38 - the secret of Tefillin . 45:30 - Closing blessings.

lessons.title: 2025-10-26 - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Part 2 - Parshas Haazinu - Parshas Beshalach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Parshas Haazinu - Parshas Beshalach - Asniel Ben Kanaz - Searching for the Tzaddik - Beirur HaMedameh - Ruach HaKodesh - Sefiras HaOmer - Horse and Rider - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - ROSHEI PEROKIM. Asniel Ben Kanaz . When a T
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Parshas Haazinu - Parshas Beshalach - Asniel Ben Kanaz - Searching for the Tzaddik - Beirur HaMedameh - Ruach HaKodesh - Sefiras HaOmer - Horse and Rider - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 00:00 - ROSHEI PEROKIM. Asniel Ben Kanaz . When a Tzaddik passes away, the search for his successor and his trustworthy students must begin immediately. Pilpul is related to simcha . Rather than fall into despair that Moshe Rabbeinu was no longer in this world, Asniel Ben Kanaz courageously applied himself to delving into the Torah with joy and thereby merited restoring the halakhos that had been forgotten by the rest of his generation. הַצַּדִּיק אָבָד וְאֵין אִישׁ שָׂם עַל־לֵב וְאַנְשֵׁי־חֶסֶד נֶאֱסָפִים בְּאֵין מֵבִין כִּי־מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָה נֶאֱסַף הַצַּדִּיק - "The righteous man has perished, but no one takes it to heart, and men of kindness are taken away, with no one understanding that it's because of the evil the righteous man has been taken away" ( Yeshaya 57:1). 04:47 - Am Yisrael's lack of searching for the Tzaddik causes the Tzaddik to pass away. "I was forgotten" נִשְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵת מִלֵּב הָיִיתִי כִּכְלִי אֹבֵד - "I was forgotten like a dead person, out of mind..." ( Tehillim 31:13). When a Tzaddik leaves this world, he loses nothing. It is Am Yisrael who suffers the loss. 07:40 - Tzaddikim live forever. Moshe Rabbeinu tells Am Yisrael that when he passes away, if they don't search for his teachings, they will make mistakes. 07:46 - NOTE - The passing of Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal . 09:00 - Parshas Haazinu. 12:45 - The Tzaddik searches for Ruach HaKodesh within himself. 13:14 - "That which was, will be." 13:46 - Eulogizing the Tzaddik . ***After the Tzaddik' s passing, a person needs to seek out the students of the Tzaddik . 15:10 - NOTE - it's through the teachings of Rebbe Nachman's students, such as Rav Nasan of Nemirov's Likutey Halakhos , that a person can truly access the Tzaddik . 16:08 - ***Every person, in every generation, must search for the Tzaddik , in order to achieve true emunah . 20:05 - The dangers of travel. NOTE - warning about traveling on buses in Eretz Yisrael - the drivers are sometimes reckless. The joy of the heart lifts the feet - Tikkun HaMedameh . The feet represent the lowest level of the sekhel . NOTE on a car having "horsepower". 21:40 - Parshas Beshalach. Pharaoh - The horse precedes the rider in the realm of evil, as in כִּי בָא סוּס פַּרְעֹה בְּרִכְבּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו בַּיָּם - "When Pharaoh's horses came with his chariots and his horsemen into the sea..." ( Shemos 15:19, Beshalach ). HaShem caused the downfall of Mitzrayim through סוּס וְרֹכְבוֹ רָמָה בַיָּם - "...horse and rider He has thrown into the sea" ( Shemos 15:1, Beshalach ). 28:16 - HaShem doesn't want the strength of the horse - physical power. HaShem wants prayer. 29:00 - *When you don't know what to do, search for the true shepherds of Yisrael . 30:00 - Beirur HaMedameh. Reference to Likutey Moharan 25 . 32:30 - Receiving the Torah on Shavuos . Accessing the Ruach HaKodesh of the Tzaddik Emes is vital to every Jew at every level. 36:05 - *** Sefiras HaOmer - Counting the Omer - is an aspect of searching for the Tzaddik . The "Face of the Shekhina " is the Tzaddik Emes . 37:06 - ***Every Jew, from great to small, must search for the Tzaddik and even the Tzaddik has to search for his own power. Example: Had Noach known how much power he had, he could have saved the world. Avraham Avinu thought that he had limits. Moshe Rabbeinu, however, went beyond all previous levels of tefilah , until HaShem had to stop him. 41:19 - Moshe Rabbeinu at the sneh - the burning thorn bush. Why HaShem inflicted leprosy on him. 42:33 - Q&R - A person can begin the search for the Tzaddik whenever and wherever he wants to. 46:00 - Q&R about the order of horse and rider and Tikkun HaMedameh . 49:00 - Q&R about why Moshe Rabbeinu's kever is hidden. 50:00 - NOTE about the approaching fast days and closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-10-27a - LH7 - CM1 - Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Part 3 - Parshas Ki Sisa
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Ki Sisa - Water into Blood - Masa uMatan beEmunah - Honesty in Business - Searching for the Tzaddik in Every Generation - Asking Tzaddikim to Pray for You - It's Not "The More, the Merrier" - Travel Repairs Faith - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moha
lessons.bodyText: Sheluchin 5 - Roshei Perokim - Ki Sisa - Water into Blood - Masa uMatan beEmunah - Honesty in Business - Searching for the Tzaddik in Every Generation - Asking Tzaddikim to Pray for You - It's Not "The More, the Merrier" - Travel Repairs Faith - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sheluchin 5 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 8 . ROSHEI PEROKIM. Parshas Ki Sisa. Water into Blood. כִּי־זֶה׀ מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה־הָיָה לוֹ - "...because this man Moshe, who brought us up from the land of Egypt, we don't know what has become of him" ( Shemos 32:1, Ki Sisa ). Cheyt HaEgel - Sin of the Golden Calf. "That which was, will be..." ( Koheles ). Even Moshe Rabbeinu had to search for the Tzaddik - within himself. Masa uMatan beEmunah - honesty in business. Travel is a tikkun for lack of faith. Horse and Rider. Beirur HaMedameh means clarification of whatever isn't fully understood, freedom from illusion. All travel is a tikkun for lack of Emunah . The Megaleh Amukos on the journeys of Bnei Yisrael in the wilderness. Spiritual aspects of clothing. Kinyan Sudar. Klipah Nogah . NOTE - נִפְתְּחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וָאֶרְאֶה מַרְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים - "...the heavens opened up and I saw visions of HaShem" ( Yechezkel 1:1) - Roshei Teivos אמונה. "These are the generations of Peretz..." ( Rus 4). ***The True Tzaddik breaks barriers to rescue souls. BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal and the evolution of chassidus . ***It is crucial in every generation to search for the Tzaddik after his passing by connecting with the people to whom he entrusted his legacy. There are many types of Tzaddikim , because each generation has difference spiritual challenges that need to be addressed. After a tzaddik's passing, Am Yisrael needs to search for him more than ever. "Bracha khopping" is not the best way to find the tzaddik . It takes time and commitment to receive what one needs from the tzaddik . *** Sometimes the light of the tzaddik is blocked with "clouds" that form because of our own misdeeds. ***Q&R about praying at the kever of tzaddikim other than one's own rebbe . Account of a man who refused to solicit prayers or blessings from anyone but his rebbe . Asking people to daven in a time of need is not "the more, the merrier". ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal on why it's better to only give your name for tefilah to one rabbi. "When two people watch a pot, the food won't be cold and won't be hot." If the Tzaddik knows that you're coming to him exclusively, he invests more of his heart in his tefilos . Getting a blessing from the Tzaddikei HaDor . Rav Nosson of Nemirov zal stated that he will do a favor for anyone who visits his kever . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 280 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. ***Explanation of elevating the nefoshos in food. 02:47 - PARAGRAPH 2. Parshas Beshalach. וַיְהִי יָדָיו אֱמוּנָה עַד־בֹּא הַשָּׁמֶשׁ "...so he was with his hands in faith until sunset" ( Shemos 17:12, Beshalach ). The spiritual meaning of lifting up one's hands, as in שְׂאוּ־יְדֵכֶם קֹדֶשׁ וּבָרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה - "Lift your hands to the sanctuary and bless HaShem" ( Tehillim 134:2). 05:53 - PARAGRAPH 3. Business dealings. Kinyan Sudar. Elevating the sparks in material objects through business transactions. 09:19 - Klipos try to attach themselves to a person's garments. 09:47 - *** Tzitzis . 10:49 - The four corners of the talis . 11:50 - Business dealings involve releasing sparks of holiness from material objects. All this happens through the hands. 14:35 - Q&R about business dealings with non-Jews. 15:37 - PARAGRAPH 4. Tikkun of garments. Whiteness of moach vs. red/blood. 16:55 - Tikkun HaDibur - elevating and purifying speech. כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי - "For my iniquities passed over my head; as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me" ( Tehillim 38:5). 18:52 - Clothing damaged by stains. 23:13 - ***Q&R about Tikkun HaKlali . Shemiras HaBris corrects all other aspects of life. Tikkun HaKlali for speech is praising HaShem , but saying the specific series of Tehillim that comprise the Tikkun HaKlali for Shemiras HaBris includes speech as well as all other midos . 25:08 - Closing blessings.

NOTE: The generation of the flood was involved in dishonesty business dealing. 28:12 - Kinyan Sudar . White garments. 33:15 - Olam HaAsiya - the physical world - is a garment for the upper 3 worlds. 34:00 - Q&R about the positive aspect of klipah : protection. 35:15 - Q&R about how to deal with difficulties in business dealing. Tefilah always helps. 37:20 - HALAKHA 2. A business deal is not complete until a physical action is done, e.g. Kinyan Sudar . 38:20 - PARAGRAPH 1. Mikach uMimkar 2 is based on Likutey Moharan 25 . 40:20 - When a person achieves a new spiritual level, the klipos of that level fight against him. There are several different types of kinyan . Elevating holy sparks. Whenever a person reaches a new level, he must be prepared for opposition. A business deal involves both people reaching a new level. Words are not enough to deflect the klipos attached to the new levels. 51:00 - He will give the money, and the object will rise up" Avraham Avinu's purchase of Maaras HaMakhpeleh . 52:00 - Q&R about acquiring real estate vs. moveable objects. 53:05 - Closing blessing.

lessons.bodyText: 00:00 - NOTE on the yahrzeit of Rochel Imeinu . 10:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal traveled to Kever Rochel and Maaras HaMachpeleh in Chevron every Erev Rosh Chodesh at chatzos halayla . 33:00 - ***Elevating the Laughter of Our Youth. 40:00 - Humility is the most important midah - but a person needs to daven sincerely and incessantly to merit true humility, not false humility. This can be achieved by striving to be conscious of the Divine Presence all the time, even when alone at home. 45:00 - Closing blessings. Am Yisrael needs both people learning Torah to protect the spiritual safety of Am Yisrael and soldiers protecting the physical safety of all who live in Eretz Yisrael .

lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mikach uMimkar 3 - Parshas Vayeshev - Workaholic - 39 Melakhos - Connection to the Tzaddik Protects from Obsession - Yosef HaTzaddik - Definition of Tzaddik Emes - Yosef's Dream - Rochel Imeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Mikach uMimkar 3 - Parshas Vayeshev - Workaholic - 39 Melakhos - Connection to the Tzaddik Protects from Obsession - Yosef HaTzaddik - Definition of Tzaddik Emes - Yosef's Dream - Rochel Imeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 159 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Workaholic. Connection to the Tzaddik protects from obsession with work. 05:42 - PARAGRAPH 13. Parshas Vayeshev. וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִכָּל־בָּנָיו כִּי־בֶן־זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ - "And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was a son of his old age..." ( Bereishis 37:3, Vayeshev ). Sale of Yosef HaTzaddik . Definition of Tzaddik Emes . 10:00 - Why Yosef HaTzaddik told his brothers about his dream. 15:00 - Opposition to Rebbe Nachman in recent times is compared to why Yosef HaTzaddik's brother's opposed him. 16:00 - Q&R about being attached to tzaddikim other than Rebbe Nachman. 19:20 - Taavos Mamon - desire for material wealth. Some of the opposition to Rebbe Nachman based on people's desire for money. 22:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . Disrespect for the tzaddik leads to obsession with money. 27:00 - What gives the klipos power is lack of seder - when things are out of place. 28:45 - NOTE about Rochel Imeinu , since yesterday was her yahrzeit (the 11th of Cheshvan ). Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . Brief BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE on Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal' s emphasis on the importance of Kever Rochel . 36:00 - ***The 39 Melakhos - all business transactions are within the 39 creative acts needed to build the Mishkan . When a person goes about his work without breaking the laws of the Torah, and attaches himself to the tzaddik by supporting his Torah learning - then his work is in the category of Melakhas HaMishkan. Reference to Likutey Moharan 29:9 . 39:00 - Q&R about man's mission in this world being to set things into the order prescribed by the Torah. 40:00 - C'SAV YAD. Tal Torah . Tal Ohros - the 39 Lights and HaShem's Name Y - H - V - H . The Mohn in the midbar was connected to the Tal Ohros . 44:00 - When a person learns Torah in purity, then every day his Torah is new and he is able to generate Chidushei Torah. 45:00 - Malbush - clothing - is an aspect of Chashmal . Comparison between tefillin and shoes. Tikkun habegadim . Clean clothing is an aspect of Tikkun HaBris . 48:00 - Q&R about Shoresh Neshama . 50:30 - Q&R about saying hiskashrus before going to work. Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal said the nusach of hiskashrus to the tzaddik only once a day. 51:00 - Q&R - it's important to use discretion when mentioning the greatness of Rebbe Nachman to others. 53:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . 00:00 - PARAGRAP
lessons.bodyText: Mikach uMimkar 4 - Parshas Vayishlach - Parshas Bereishis - How the Sukkah Protects - Tikkun Achila - Vegetarian - Adam HaRishon - Untimely Death of Animals - Why Were the Avos Shepherds? - Ushpizin - Sukkos Dovid - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Parshas Vayishlach. Sukkos. וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת וּלְמִקְנֵהוּ עָשָׂה סֻכֹּת עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם סֻכּוֹת - "And Yaakov traveled to Succos and built himself a house, and for his cattle he made booths; therefore he named the place Succos" ( Bereishis 33:17, Vayishlach ). A human child nurses from above, an animal nurses its young from below. 06:30 - *Building a sukkah al pi halakha protects a person from harm from all forms of construction. 07:45 - בראשית contains the word בית. 08:30 - PARAGRAPH 2. Parshas Bereishis. Tikkun cheyt Adam HaRishon - repairing the sin of Adam. 11:00 - The word אדם - Adam - is three times the Name of HaShem Yud - Kay , alluding to the 3 parts of the brain. אדם implies דעת - daas - knowledge based on faith in HaShem . 13:50 - When a Jew commits a sin, he falls from the level of man to the level of animal. 19:00 - Just as there a many processes to make bread, there are many processes in teshuvah . Making a blessing with kavana elevates food from the category of animal food to the category of human food. 21:00 - The 10 Days of Teshuvah is the time of year most propitious for tikkun achila . The sukkah is an aspect of Binah ; the sukkah is like a mother's embrace of her child. 24:00 - The main focus in the mitzvah of sukkah is that we return to HaShem through eating in the sukkah and making the blessing "leishev besukkah" which is only said before eating. 25:30 - Q&R - Elevating achila during the 10 Days of Teshuvah . 26:30 - Q&R - Sin of Adam HaRishon . 27:30 - ***Q&R about being vegetarian. People who don't want to eat meat and/or fish are missing the tikkunim that are accomplished through eating meat and/or fish. 30:20 - PARAGRAPH 3. Why were the Avos shepherds? Tikkun for untimely death of animals. 35:20 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 63 . 37:30 - Q&R - the Avos were taking care of providing food for animals to accomplish tikkun for the untimely death of animals. 39:00 - ***Q&R about the untimely death of animals all over the world. This is caused by people. 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Ushpizin in the Sukkah - The 7 Shepherds of Am Yisrael . Why the Sukkah is called "Sukkas Dovid" . 44:00 - מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ - "From behind the nursing ewes He brought him, to shepherd Yaakov His people and Israel His heritage" ( Tehillim 78:71). 47:00 - ***Life of Dovid HaMelech . Why was being a shepherd the qualification to be king of Am Yisrael ? Dovid HaMelech and Moshiach are central to the tikkun Adam HaRishon . 52:30 - "VeAni Tefilah..." 53:00 - Application of this Torah to our lives today. 54:30 - Q&R about why the Avos fed animals. 56:10 - Q&R about tikkun achila . The halakha is for a person to feed one's animals before eating. Overweight is caused by doing other things during a meal (reading, etc.). Eating requires daas . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.title: 2025-11-05 - LH7 - CM1 - Mikach uMimkar 4 - Para. 5-9 - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Mishpatim
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Mikach uMimkar 4 - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Mishpatim - Untimely Death of Animals - Am Yisrael and Animals - Punishment of Nevuchadnezzar - Sukkas Dovid Hanofeles - Moshiach Will Bring Bounty - Sukkos is the Holiday of Harvest - Korbonos - Animal Sacrifices - 70 Nations - Human Food - Animal Food - Speaker: Rabbi Na
lessons.bodyText: Mikach uMimkar 4 - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Mishpatim - Untimely Death of Animals - Am Yisrael and Animals - Punishment of Nevuchadnezzar - Sukkas Dovid Hanofeles - Moshiach Will Bring Bounty - Sukkos is the Holiday of Harvest - Korbonos - Animal Sacrifices - 70 Nations - Human Food - Animal Food - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Nevuchadnezzar was the opposite of Dovid HaMelech . As punishment for destroying the Beis HaMikdash , HaShem turned Nevuchadnezzar into an animal for 7 years. These 7 years were parallel the 7 Shepherds of Israel. 06:00 - NOTE from the Ben Ish Chai : the name Nevuchadnezzar contains the word כבוד. 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Sukkas Dovid Hanofeles. Description of the flow of produce in the world after Moshiach is revealed. The mitzvah of sukkah is related to shefa - bounty. 12:40 - PARAGRAPH 7. Parshas Mishpatim. וְחַג הָאָסִף בְּצֵאת הַשָּׁנָה בְּאָסְפְּךָ אֶת־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה( Shemos 23:16, ). Why Sukkos is the holiday of harvest. 16:45 - *** Likutey Halakhos is a commentary both on the Chumash - the written Torah - and on the Likutey Moharan . 17:20 - PARAGRAPH 8. Skach - the roof of the sukkah - is made of psoles - refuse. 22:40 - Animal sacrifices. Korbonos are a tikkun for the untimely death of animals by repairing the damage done to Shefa Beheyma . 27:30 - ***Q&R about animal sacrifices. 28:40 - PARAGRAPH 9. 70 Korbonos on Sukkos parallel the 70 Nations. 33:20 - The length of גלות - exile is related to the untimely death of animals. Sometimes the animals fight back. 35:45 - Parshas Bereishis. וּרְדוּ בִּדְגַת הַיָּם וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וּבְכָל־חַיָּה הָרֹמֶשֶׂת עַל־הָאָרֶץ - "...and rule over the fish of the sea and over the fowl of the sky and all the living creatures that crawl on the earth" ( Bereishis 1:28, Bereishis ). Rashi: "If a person merits, man will rule over the animals. If not, he will fall before them." 36:45 - Untimely death of animals. When the shefa of man is stolen by animals, the shefa eventually harms the animals. 45:40 - Why the 70 korbonos of Sukkas correspond to the 70 Nations. 49:20 - When Am Yisrael is not in its rightful position, the 70 Nations suffer. 50:10 - The arrival of Moshiach is called the rebuilding of the Sukkas Dovid Hanofeles . The mitzvah of Sukkah plays an especially important role in this process. 52:00 - Closing blessings. The tefilah of Aleinu should be said with extra kavana . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Mikach uMimkar 4 - Parshas Mishpatim - Neshama Yisera on Shabbos , 6 Stages, Sukkas Shaleym - Hashkiveynu - Aitza Tova - Ananei HaKavod - The Sukkah Protects - Ananei HaKavod - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. ( Shemos 23:12, Mishpatim ). Shabbos . 08:45 - Reception of the Neshama Yisera on Shabbos is in 6 stages. 11:40 - ***A crucial daily request to receive HaShem's aitza tova are the words "Vesakhneynu beaitza tova milfanecha" in the tefilah "Hashkiveinu" . 16:15 - All excessive efforts, obsession, and worries regarding parnassah are worthless. The key is aitza tovah through asking HaShem . 23:30 - Ananei HaKavod . 25:45 - The sukkah protects a person the way an infant is protected within it's mother's womb. 28:00 - ***The whole week a person is looking forward to the holiness of Shabbos . 34:00 - יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ - "If you eat the toil of your hands, you are praiseworthy, and it is good for you" ( Tehillim 128:2). There's double blessing in earning one's own living. NOTE on this possuk from Rav Eliya Chaim Rosen zal . 37:00 - ***NOTE: Rabbi Rosenfeld zal's derech was for a person to work to earn a living. 40:00 - ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Reb Michel Dorfman zal being put in charge of the Breslov Kollel when he arrived in Eretz Yisrael . Description of the Breslov Kollel today. 44:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about the Chayey Adam . 45:45 - NOTE about the Parshas HaShavuah : "by the strength and power of my hand" - there are two elements for parnassah - aitza and hishtadlus . 48:00 - Closing chizuk about saying the last mincha of the week on Erev Shabbos .

lessons.bodyText: Mikach uMimkar 4 - Onaah 1 - Parshas Ki Seitzei - Parshas Beshalach - Parshas Ekev - Animal Food vs. Human Food - Spiritual Preparation on Erev Shabbos - Shabbos Is Teshuvah - Malakh Mem Tess - The 4 Worlds - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Mikach uMimkar 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 266 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Parshas Ki Seitzei. לֹא־תַחְסֹם שׁוֹר בְּדִישׁוֹ - "You shall not muzzle an ox when it is threshing " ( Devarim 25:4, Ki Seitzei ). 04:10 - PARAGRAPH 18. Parshas Beshalach. וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי וְהֵכִינוּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יָבִיאוּ "And it shall be on the sixth day that when they prepare what they will bring..." ( Shemos 16:5, Beshalach ). Shefa from week day to Shabbos . Shefa shel Beheyma vs. Shefa shel Adam . 08:20 - The 39 Melakhos - The 39 acts of creative work that are prohibited on Shabbos . 10:00 - Olam HaBa - The Future World - is called Shabbos , the present world is called Erev Shabbos . 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. Validity of business transactions. 15:20 - Teshuvah is especially accomplished on Erev Shabbos . Part of Shabbos preparation on Erev Shabbos is asking HaShem to help us with teshuvah . 19:00 - ***NOTE from the Likutey Moharan : Shabbos itself is teshuvah . Observing the mitzvos of Shabbos repairs mistakes done during the previous week. 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. Parshas Ekev. A person is obligated to feed his animals before he eats. וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ - "And I will give grass in your field for your livestock, and you will eat and be sated" ( Devarim 11:15, Ekev ). 27:50 - HILKHOS ONAAH 1. Parshas Ki Seitzei . Hilkhos Onaah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 280 . 33:20 - The Malakh Mem Tess . The 4 Worlds. 36:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 8 - the importance of Limud Torah . 44:20 - Q&R about the practical application of these principles to business transactions. It's advisable in present times to avoid going to Beis Din . 47:00 - Q&R - when a person is going into business it's advisable to consult an authority in halakha . 38:30 - Closing blessings - chizuk for emes v'emunah in business transactions. 50:30 - Q&R about previous reincarnations affecting present business injustice. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal who used to say, "A hundred years ago, people could handle HaShem's punishments. The present generation isn't as strong." 32:00 - ***The essence of Bikur Cholim is to know what to do and when to leave. 37:00 - Teshuvah on teshuvah . 38:40 - *** BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal who used to tell over a story about the youngest son of Rav Noson of Nemirov zal , Reb Yonah . He was always ready to begin anew. 41:45 - The importance of doing a mitzvah with simcha and a sense of renewal. 42:15 - ***The difference between the first geulah and the final geulah : in the final geulah , the joy will never stop. This is the meaning of "E - K - Y - H asher E - K - Y - H". Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Onaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. Why Only Dovid HaMelech could find the site of the Bei
lessons.bodyText: Onaah 3 - Why Only Dovid HaMelech Could Find the Site of the Beis HaMikdash - Tefilah - Chukim - Final Redemption is Geulah Shel Tefilah - Limud Torah Is Not Enough - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Onaah 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 6 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. Why Only Dovid HaMelech could find the site of the Beis HaMikdash . Tefilah . זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ - "...O HaShem, remember unto David all his affliction..." אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב - "That he swore to HaShem, he vowed to the Mighty One of Yaakov" ( Tehillim 132:1-2). 10:22 - וַתֵּרֶד פְּלָאִים אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ - "...and she fell astonishingly with none to comfort her..." ( Eicha 1:9). 12:00 - The suffering of Dovid HaMelech reflects the suffering of Am Yisrael , as in זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ - "...O HaShem, remember unto David all his affliction..." (Tehillim 132:1). 14:30 - The power to stand is only through tefilah . "Ain amida eleh tefilah." 15:00 - עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם - "Our feet were standing within your gates, O Jerusalem" ( Tehillim 122:2). 16:50 - A person must hold on to both Torah and Tefilah . "If a person experiences a decline in Torah, his tefilah will sustain him. If a person experiences a decline in tefilah he can hold onto his limud Torah. 18:00 - ***NOTE - If a person is learning Torah but not strong in tefilah , if they have a fall in Torah, they have nothing to hold onto, chas veshalom . 19:00 - Q&R - Whys is this vital fact about the important of tefilah not known in the Torah world? Tefilah is in present times degraded, as in כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת לִבְנֵי אָדָם "...that which seems lowliest to the sons of men is elevated" ( Tehillim 12:9). ***Biographical note about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal - Tefilah is a blind spot even in the Torah-observant community. 20:15 - PARAGRAPH 3. The laws of Onaah do not apply to real estate or land ownership. 25:45 - "Fortunate is the person who is not distracted by this world" ( Zohar HaKodesh ). 28:30 - The 70 Nations mock the chukim of the Torah (laws that don't seem to have a rational explanation). Rashi on the Parah Aduma : We need to respond to the 70 Nations: HaShem has said "I have issued this decree. It's not only chukim of the Torah. The entire Torah is chok ." 33:00 - Q&R about necessity of physical pleasures in the world. Story of Rabbi Abba and his student, Rabbi Yosi - who initially wanted to learn Torah in order to become wealthy. 37:50 - Q&R about learning Torah to the exclusion of any other occupation. 40:00 - Q&R about how to deal with the challenges of the generation now. 41:00 - Hilkhos Onaah apply to mitaltelin - moveable objects. Malakh MaTaT RoM is a composite of the 6 Sidre Mishnah , the 6 ways of deciding halakha , Limud Torah , and the 6 days of the week. 43:00 - Ownership of land corresponds to Shabbos and tefilah . 45:30 - ***Even if a person falls away from Torah, he can still return to HaShem through tefilah . This is the concept of the final redemption. When this redemption comes, there will never be another exile for Am Yisrael . This final redemption is called a geulah of tefilah . Limud Torah is not enough. 48:20 - Siyum of Choshen Mishpat but PARAGRAPH 4 added on 2025-11-20. 49:20 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Onaah 3 - Tefilah - Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Tefilah. Geulah. 02:00 - Ain amidah eleh tefilah . Tefilah establishes a person. 03:55: - Reference to Likutey Moharan 7 . 05:55 - The final geulah is a geulah of tefilah . Joining geulah to tefilah before beginning the Shemoneh Esrei . 12:45 - The main support system of a Jew is tefilah . The Zohar HaKodesh brings that there are 10 expressions for tefilah . 13:00 - ***MUST CLIP NOTE: "People ask me what's the most important thing in Breslov chassidus?" Limud Torah is central, but if someone falls in their connection to Torah, their life-support is tefilah . "If a person doesn't have Rebbe Nachman's teachings about tefilah , it's very difficult for them to return to HaShem ." 18:45 - ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal : There are 3 prerequisites to helping a person: 1) he recognizes there's a problem, 2) he reaches out for help, 3) he believes HaShem can help. 20:20 - ***AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about R' Nasan discovering Hishtapkhus HaNefesh . 21:30 - CHOSHEN MISHPAT 2. Hilkhos Matanah 1. 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Matanah 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 69 . "All souls are rooted in wealth." Wealth depends on the wife. 27:00 - A person's good name is their kovod. Wealth is a protective wall that prevents anger. 32:40 - Wealth is used to give tzedakah because his generosity increases love between people. 39:20 - ***Reference to Likutey Moharan 17. Written words travel further than spoken words. 41:30 - Love, wealth, and honor expand a person's nefesh and diffuses anger. The most important benefit of wealth is that it generates love and good will. 43:00 - Q&R about wealth generating love. Analogy of a carrot and a stick - a person needs to be educated through something he appreciates. Entitlement is a disease. 50:00 - Closing blessings. The importance of sharing the joy of a friend's simcha . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

Hilkhos Matanah 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 78 and on 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 00:00 - NOTE - This evening, the 12th of Kislev, is the yahrzeit of the Bas Ayin - Rav Avraham Dov B'Rav Dovid of Ovritch zal . Since the Bas Ayin lived in the town where this incident occurred, it is assumed that Rebbe Nachman met the Bas Ayin . 02:00 - Mordekhai HaTzaddik represents the Tzaddik Emes - Rosh Bayis - in every generation. The bitter scream and mourning - sackcloth and ashes - of Mordekhai and his generation were necessary to defeat Amalek . 06:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. Haman chose Adar for the Pur - lottery - because that was the month in which Moshe Rabbeinu was niftar . 11:00 - *** "No generation is an orphan." In each and every generation there is a Rosh Bayis involved in building the Mishkan which results in the defeat the false leaders of the generation. 12:20 - Moshe Rabbeinu's birthday was also on the 7th of Adar . 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Parshas Vayakhel. Midrash: Yad al Kies Kah - HaShem's Name and Throne are not complete until Amalek is wiped out. רְאוּ קָרָא יְהוָה בְּשֵׁם בְּצַלְאֵל - "...See, HaShem has called by name Bezalel..." ( Shemos 35:30, Vayakhel ). Why Betzalel was chosen to create the keylim of the Mishkan . Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 67 . 18:45 - PARAGRAPH 9. The 4 Parshios read before and after Purim correspond to the 4 parshios in Tefillin . These 4 Parshios all contribute to the downfall of Amalek . 20:00 - Parshas Shekalim. Parshas Ki Sisa. The first letters of Rosh Beni Yisrael spell Rebbi . 23:20 - NOTE for Tzaddik Course: The Vilna Gaon zal wrote that whatever the Beis HaMikdash can do, the Tzaddik can do. 24:30 - PARAGRAPH 10. Parshas Zachor. 27:00 - Q&R about shuls and batei medrash being called Mikdash Ma'at . 28:20 - ***Q&R about connecting with the Tzaddik every day. Each day is completely new. Tzaddik Course. 30:00 - Q&R - Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on hilkhos kashrus - the impurity of a beriyah - complete organism - cannot be nullified if it falls into kosher food that is 60 times its size. However the Talmud Bavli brings that a beriya can be nullified if it falls into kosher food that is 960 times its size. 964. A person is a beriya - he goes into a mikvah , which is 40 Seah . One Seah is 24 Lugim. 40 x 24 is 960. A day can completely purify a person - 24 hours. A Tzaddik also has the power of a mikveh. 35:00 - ***Q&R - What do I do today to connect with the Tzaddik ? 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. The importance of praying to HaShem and asking HaShem to help us to recognize true tzaddikim . The Satan is powerless on Yom Kippur. The light of Purim is greater than any other light during the year. Reference to the Pri Etz Chaim . 41:20 - Megilas Esther. 45:00 - Otzar Matnas Chinam - Treasury of Free Gifts that sustained the world before Matan Torah. 46:00 - ***NOTE: Story heard from Rabbi Elyah Chaim Rosen zal . A chossid was saying the bakasha before saying Tehillim and kept repeating the words: "favor me from the Otzar Matnas Chinam" . Am Yisrael is dependent on the Otzar Matnas Chinam . 47:45 - "Tzedakah u'Mishpat" refers to tefilah saving us when our merit can't. 53:00 - ***NOTE: A Breslover does not allow his mistakes to discourage him. lessons.bodyText: Yahrzeit - 12th of Kislev (5601/1840) - The Bas Ayin, HaRav Avraham Dov Ber b'Rav Avraham of Ovritch, was born in 5525 (1765) in the Ukrainian town of Chmielnik. He married the daughter of the Rabbi of Ovritch and served as Rabbi of Ovritch for nearly forty years before traveling to Eretz Yisrael at the age of 70. He was a close student of HaRav Nachum of Chernobyl, the מאור עינים zal , and of Rav Levi Yitzchok of Barditchev, the קדושת לוי zal , and was a leading chassidic rebbes of his generation. em>“Bas Ayin” is the title of his commentary on Chumash . When he arrived in Tzfas he became the leader of the Chassidic community while living in peace with the Perushim (followers of the Vilna Gaon ), and their leader, Harav Yisrael of Shklov zal . His koach ha’tefilah became widely known during the Great Earthquake of 1837. On that horrific day, tremors shattered the walls of Tzfas just after the community had gathered in the shul for Mincha . Screaming in panic, congregants fled toward the doors, but the Bas Ayin shouted: “Come to the Aron Kodesh if you want to be saved!” As everyone turned and gathered at the Aron Kodesh , the Bas Ayin threw himself on the floor, weeping and praying. Most of the shul’s structure collapsed into rubble. But miraculously, the area surrounding the Aron Kodesh and the Bas Ayin remained intact. To this day, one can visit that shul and see clearly where the original surviving wall intersects with the rebuilt sections, a testament to the miracle that saved dozens of lives while thousands of people in Tzfas and the surrounding countryside were killed. Then, three years later, in 1840 (5601), a deadly plague began to claim many lives in Tzfas , but the Bas Ayin promised the community that he would be the plague’s final victim. On the 12th of Kislev, the Holy Bas Ayin returned his soul to HaShem and, exactly as he has promised, the plague stopped. He was laid to rest in the ancient cemetery of Tzfas , near the gravesites of the Beis Yosef and the Alshich Hakodesh . Jewish communities throughout the world mark the yahrzeit with seudos l’ilui nishmaso, zechuso yagen aleinu.

Parshas Vayechi. וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶל־בָּנָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הֵאָסְפוּ וְאַגִּידָה לָכֶם אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָא אֶתְכֶם בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים - "Yaakov called for his sons and said, 'Gather and I will tell you what will happen to you at the end of days'" ( Bereishis 49:1, Vayechi ). 03:00 - The geulah depends on the ability of tzaddikim to gather souls together and elevate them spiritually. lessons.title: 2026-02-09 - LH8 - CM2 - Perika uTeEnah 1 - Para. 1-4a - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Yisro - Parshas Ki Sisa
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Perika uTeEnah 1 - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Yisro - Parshas Ki Sisa - Helping Another with His Burden - Daas vs. Blood - Defective Kovod - Achdus - Ahavas Yisrael - Respect for Elders - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Parshas Mishpatim . Mitzvas Perika uTeEnah : כִּֽי־תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שׂנַֽאֲךָ֗ רֹ
lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 1 - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Yisro - Parshas Ki Sisa - Helping Another with His Burden - Daas vs. Blood - Defective Kovod - Achdus - Ahavas Yisrael - Respect for Elders - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Parshas Mishpatim . Mitzvas Perika uTeEnah : כִּֽי־תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שׂנַֽאֲךָ֗ רֹבֵץ֙ תַּ֣חַת מַשָּׂא֔וֹ וְחָֽדַלְתָּ֖ מֵֽעֲזֹ֣ב ל֑וֹ עָזֹ֥ב תַּֽעֲזֹ֖ב עִמּֽוֹ - "If you see your enemy's donkey lying under its burden would you refrain from helping him? You shall surely help along with him" ( Shemos 23:5, Mishpatim ). 01:00 - Life energy is dependent on Daas , as in הַֽחָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽיהָ - "...wisdom gives life to its possessor" ( Koheles 7:12). 02:45 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 29 - spiritual aspects of epilepsy - "Falling Sickness". 04:50 - The liver is the source of anger. Hatred, jealousy, and anger heats the blood. Reference to Likutey Moharan 57 . Overheating of the blood causes a person to fall. 05:30 - כִּֽי־עֲ֖ו‍ֹֽנֹתַי עָֽבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֜בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי - "For my sins have gone over my head; as a weighty burden they are too heavy for me" ( Tehillim 38:5). When desires overwhelm Daas , the person is in danger of falling, spiritually and/or physically. 09:00 - Parshas Mishpatim. אַ֖תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵּֽישָׁרִ֑ים - "...You founded equity..." ( Tehillim 99:4). 10:40 - PARAGRAPH 2. Kovod - respect. In certain circumstances, an elder is exempt from helping another with their burden. Kovod is associated with Daas . Reference to Likutey Moharan 67 . 14:00 - Disrespect signals lack of Daas . Achdus - unity - is dependent on Kovod . Malkhus is also associated with Achdus . One aspect of Malkhus is to gather different factions together. Reference to Likutey Moharan 14 . 18:00 - When כבוד is defective, it becomes כבד - heavy. The Vuv enlivens. When the Vuv is missing, Reference to Likutey Moharan 11 . 21:45 - *Rebbe Nachman emphasizes showing respect for an elder. 23:30 - The Tzaddik is called Kovod because he lifts and carries fallen souls. 24:30 - Q&R - Since a person is supposed to flee from Kovod - how does one gauge self-respect vs. respect for another? 27:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. The "enemy" in the shiur's key possuk from Parshas Mishpatim is not necessarily a person who is hated. A person needs to put aside his own negative feelings in order to help someone who has fallen. 31:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Chomer - physicality and Chamor - donkey. A Jew needs to be as strong as an ox, to wear the על מלכות שמים - "Yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven". 34:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 282 - "Finding the Good Point" . Ahavas Yisrael. 36:00 - Q&R about the Tzaddik carrying the burden of Am Yisrael . Moshol told by Rav Eliya Chaim Rosen zal about a lion and a fox who knows how to keep his distance from danger. 39:40 - Destroying the sin vs. destroying the sinner. 41:40 - Q&R about the difference in Torah obligations for women as opposed to the Torah obligations of men. 43:00 - Q&R about respectful conduct if one is brought to judgement in a Beis Din - above all tefilah is needed for aitza tova and protection. 46:30 - Parshas Ki Sisa. Moshe Rabbeinu was told to go down to the level of Am Yisrael , as in לֶךְ־רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם - "...'Go, descend, for your People that you have brought up from the land of Egypt have acted corruptly'" ( Shemos 32:7, Ki Sisa ). 50:00 - Parshas Yisro. "From those who are distant, a great palace for HaShem's honor can be built." 51:00 - Q&R about balancing kiruv with protecting Torah's boundaries. Rebbe Nachman's arrival in Uman is described as an example of knowing when and how to approach newcomers. 53:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal's refusal to teach in a conservative school. 55:50 - NOTE - to begin speaking with a person who's distant, a teacher should not be confrontational. Instead, the teacher addressed the newcomer in terms of his "comfort zone". Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

PART 2. 03:10 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 282 - Azamra . וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ - "A short while longer and the wicked man is not here, and you shall look at his place and he is not there" ( Tehillim 37:10). 08:40 - Parshas Mishpatim . 09:10 - אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב - "...You founded equity; judgment and righteousness You made in Yaakov" ( Tehillim 99:4). 09:40 - NOTE: Perika uTeUnah 3 is included in Hilkhos Aveyda uMetzia 3:15 . 10:15 - Perika uTeEnah 4. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 11:00 - Drawing the holiness of Shabbos into the 6 days of the week. 15:40 - PARAGRAPH 2. Parshas Mishpatim. כִּי־תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ רֹבֵץ תַּחַת מַשָּׂאוֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ מֵעֲזֹב לוֹ עָזֹב תַּעֲזֹב עִמּוֹ - "If you see your enemy's donkey lying under its burden would you refrain from helping him? You shall surely help along with him" ( Shemos 23:5, Mishpatim ). 18:11 - Suffering is a burden because it's the opposite of what a person wants. Lack of awareness of HaShem is the source of yisurim - adversity. 24:00 - ***All life energy depends on emunah . Drawing the holiness of Shabbos into the 6 weekdays strengthens emunah by bringing peace into the adversities of the week. This relieves a person from his burdens. 32:20 - The more Am Yisrael is able to achieve achdus , the greater the achdus in the entire world. 33:20 - PARAGRAPH 3. Hefker veNikhsey HaGer. When a ger passes away, his non-Jewish family of origin does not inherit his possessions. 39:20 - Parshas Ekev. In praise of gerim - converts to Judaism.וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת־הַגֵּר כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם - "And you shall love the stranger, for you were strangers in the land of Egypt" ( Devarim 10:19, Ekev ). 42:30 - Through each mitzvah a Jew performs he becomes one with HaShem : Y - K - V - K in Atbash is מצוה. Reference to Likutey Moharan 5:2 . 46:00 - The spiritual accomplishment of Yisro . Reference to Likutey Moharan 10 . 47:00 - Q&R about judging to the side of merit when somebody does something hurtful. 49:00 - Closing blessings. Note on this week's parsha: Mishpatim . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Lech Lecha - Parshas BeHar - Parshas Shemos - Inheritance - Wealth of a Ger - Hefker Property - Shmita - Achdus Brings Geulah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Property of a ger . 04:46 - All influx of blessing into the world is called a "birth". All births originate from the Torah. 05:45 - Since all wealth is rooted in the Torah, why are Talmidei Chokhomim often lacking wealth? Reference to Sichos HaRan, Sichah 4. 09:30 - Inheritance from parent to children enables the continuity of Torah, as in דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ - "One generation to another will praise Your works and Your mighty acts they will proclaim" ( Tehillim 145:4). 11:00 - When a ger passes away, if he does not have Jewish children, his wealth returns to Am Yisrael . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Parshas Lech Lecha . וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם אֶת־שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת־לוֹט בֶּן־אָחִיו וְאֶת־כָּל־רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁוּ וְאֶת־הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂוּ בְחָרָן - "And Avraham took Sarai his wife and Lot his brother's son, and all their possessions that they had acquired, and the souls they had acquired in Haran..." ( Bereishis 12:5, Lech Lecha ). 17:00 - וְתַחַת הַבַּרְזֶל אָבִיא כֶסֶף - "...and instead of the iron I will bring silver" ( Yeshaya 60:17). 18:45 - PARAGRAPH 6. Parshas BeHar. Shmita. Laws of hefker - property that is ownerless. 19:15 - שְׁנַת שַׁבָּתוֹן יִהְיֶה לָאָרֶץ - "...it shall be a year of rest for the land" ( Vayikra 25:5, BeHar ). Spiritual aspects of Shmita . 24:00 - The Malakh MaTaT is referred to as עבד - he is HaShem's shaliach during the 6 weekdays. 28:00 - Spiritual aspects of the Shmita Year. 29:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Medrash Tanchuma, BeHar : The 70 years Am Yisrael was exiled to Bavel corresponded to the 70 Shmita Years they failed to observe while they were in Eretz Yisrael .אָז תִּרְצֶה הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתֶיהָ - "Then, the Land will be appeased regarding its sabbaticals..." ( Vayikra 26:34, Bechukosai ). 33:00 - NOTE - Galus - exile is the absence of Daas . 33:00 - Q&R about Am Yisrael's relationship with the 70 Nations. 35:00 - Q&R about the 70 years of exile in Bavel . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Parshas Shemos . וַיִּירָא מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמַר אָכֵן נוֹדַע הַדָּבָר - "Moses became frightened and said, 'Indeed, the matter has become known!'" ( Shemos 2:14, Shemos ). Moshe Rabbeinu saw conflict among Am Yisrael , he understood why we were in exile. The main reason we are in exile now is because of makhlokes . 41:00 - Conflict within Am Yisrael is causing the longest exile ( Yuma 10). HaShem's response to Am Yisrael's lack of unity is: "You're fighting? I'm going to hide." 43:40 - PARAGRAPH 9. Parshas Shemos. Moshe Rabbeinu did not want to take on leadership of Am Yisrael , as in בִּי אֲדנָי לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד־פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי - "...I beseech You, HaShem. I am not a man of words, neither from yesterday nor from the day before yesterday, nor from the time You have spoken to Your servant, for I am heavy of mouth and heavy of tongue" ( Shemos 4:10, Shemos ). 46:15 - Shleymus haDibur . Why Moshe Rabbeinu said, "I am not a man of words" . 51:00 - ***The present geulah depends on even a small group of Jews putting aside their differences in order to unite through shared emunas chokhamim . 53:00 - The final geulah will be announced by Elihahu HaNavi because he, like Aharon HaKohen , promotes peace in Am Yisrael . 54:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Tefilah - Halakha - Blood Circulation - Crisis - Childbirth - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. Praising HaShem is called Olam HaBa and learning halakha every day is called Olam HaBa . 02:40 - A life crisis causes the blood to flow to the heart. This also takes place during childbirth. 04:00 - Sheleymus HaDibur draws the holiness of Shabbos into the 6 weekdays. When a person accomplishes that, he is able to bring the lower level of diversity into achdus - unity. 06:40 - Tefilah and Halakha bring a person out of the state of crisis and causes the blood to flow to the heart normally. 14:30 - The 4 Worlds and the 4 Basic Elements originate from the oneness of HaShem . 24:00 - During a crisis the blood rushes to the heart because the life energy of a person is in the blood. This life force is in the blood. 28:00 - NOTE: Tikkun HaDamim throughout history, beginning with Adam HaRishon . 30:00 - NOTE: Galus Mitzrayim and the dispute between the shevatim . 31:00 - When the blood overflows the heart, diversity and disjointedness results. 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Everything is, as its Source, one. HaShem can change anything in creation - He can turn blood into water, and water into blood. 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 12.

Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. All adversity is from HaShem to our benefit. וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשׁוּבוּן מֵאָוֶן - "He opens t
lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Adversity Is From HaShem - Siddur Course - Ezras Avoseinu - Hisbodedus Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 12b. All adversity is from HaShem to our benefit. וַיִּגֶל אָזְנָם לַמּוּסָר וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יְשׁוּבוּן מֵאָוֶן - "He opens their ears to discipline and commands that they repent of iniquity" ( Iyov 36:10). 03:00 - NOTE - Whenever Rabbi Akiva encountered difficulties while traveling he would say, "This is also for the good". 03:30 - *** Siddur Course. A person should accustom himself to praising HaShem , no matter what the difficulty. We express this 3 times a day in the blessing "Nodeh" of the Shemoneh Esrei . 06:30 - בָּרוּךְ׀ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ - Blessed is HaShem, Master of Israel, Who performs wonders alone" ( Tehillim 72:18). We are saved from countless difficulties without our being aware of the protection HaShem extends to us constantly, both physically and spiritually. 00:00 - אֲהַלֲלָה יְהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי - "I shall praise the Master in my life; I shall sing to HaShem as long as I exist" ( Tehillim 146:2). 09:20 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 282 - Azamra . ( Tehillim 146:2). 11:00 - ***בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי - "...through the distress You relieved me..." ( Tehillim 4:2). Betzar Hirchavta Li. 16:00 - NOTE - Brief overview of 2Likutey Moharan 2 , the foundation of this Halakha . 21:00 - *** Hisbodedus Course. Betzar Hirchavta Li. Thanking HaShem for His kindness in the past enables a person to pour out their present needs to Him. 23:00 - עֶזְרָתִי הָיִיתָ אַל־תִּטְּשֵׁנִי וְאַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי - "You were my help; do not forsake me and do not abandon me, HaShem of my salvation" ( Tehillim 27:9). A person needs to be able to defend himself during Hisbodedus . 25:00 - *** Hisbodedus Course. Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah, Kilei Beheyma 4 . 25:30 - תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּהוֹם קוֹרֵא לְקוֹל צִנּוֹרֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ - "Deep calls to deep to the sound of Your water channels; all Your breakers and waves passed over me" ( Tehillim 42:8). 27:00 - Every day HaShem commands new kindness to sustain Am Yisrael even through all the suffering of exile. This is a display of HaShem's strength. 31:00 - ***Thanking HaShem creates ways for a person to receive more of His kindness. 33:00 - ***Q&R about implementing this teaching in our lives. It's important to constantly search for times in the past when HaShem helped. ***Siddur Course - "Ezras Avoseinu" . 36:00 - NOTE: Story of Reb Elimelech and Reb Zushia in prison. Gratitude is the only way to begin asking for one's needs. 37:00 - Q&R about how to apply this advice in practice. 40:00 - Q&R about seeing people who are wealthy but who don't seem to be doing mitzvos . 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. אַךְ לֹא־בְעִי יִשְׁלַח־יָד אִם־בְּפִידוֹ לָהֶן שׁוּעַ - "But not with destruction does He stretch forth his hand; if with His misfortune, He would dandle them" ( Iyov 30:24). HaShem punishes Am Yisrael in a different way than he punishes the 70 Nations: He dispenses our punishment little by little, and not all at once. 44:00 - NOTE - Chiddush from the Zohar HaKodesh heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on the words "HaShem gets angry every day" . 51:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas VaEira - Why Do People Suffer? - Achdus Through Emunas Chokhomim - No Generation Is and Orphan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 13b. Allegory: humbly finding mitzvos to perform is compared to chickens searching in the trash heap for kernels of food. 15:20 - לְהָבִין מָשָׁל וּמְלִיצָה דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְחִידֹתָם - "to understand an allegory and a figure, the words of the wise and their riddles" ( Mishlei 1:6). 26:00 - NOTE about Yosef HaTzaddik keeping his faith in HaShem throughout his slavery in Egypt. 27:50 - ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE - Overview of Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal's life. . 32:20 - Q&R about how to view suffering: everything that happens is HaShem extending His loving guidance to us. 33:45 - Q&R how can a person possibly emulate the deeds of tzaddikim ? "Reb Michel" zal described how he would often beg HaShem : " Ribono Shel Olam , please go easy on me - I'm just a fly on the wall compared to Rav Noson zal !" 35:45 - PARAGRAPH 14. Parshas VaEira. וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי יְהוָה - "( Shemos 6:2, VaEira ). Moshe Rabbeinu asked HaShem, "Why did you send me to make things worse?" 41:30 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 65 . 45:00 - The opposition of Dathan ve Aviram . 47:00 - גאל in Atbash is כתר - Geulah - redemption - emanates from Achdus - unity . 49:00 - The dialogue between Moshe Rabbeinu and HaShem about the Final Geulah : the redemption process is the gradual return from diversity to unity. 54:00 - ***Q&R about the present lack of Emunas Chokhomim in present times. "No generation is an orphan" - even if the tzaddikim of today are not like those of the past, they "match the generation". Our task is to never give up the search for אמת and never stop asking HaShem to help us have true Emunas Chokhomim . 57:00 - Closing blessings. Today is Yom Kippur Katan, Erev Rosh Chodesh Adar .

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Shemos - Parshas Beshalach - Power of Song - Achdus - Fourfold Song of the Future - Az Yashir - Machzor Course - Aleinu - Siddur Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 18. Parshas Beshalach. אָז יָשִׁיר־מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לַיהוָה - "Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to HaShem..." ( Shemos 15:1, Beshalach ). 09:00 - The power of song - Achdus at Kriyas Yam Suf - Az YaShir . 10:30 - The 600,000 root nefashos of Am Yisrael are "carved out" from the Throne of HaShem . 12:00 - All song emanates from the 10 Types of Song with which Sefer Tehillim is composed, which is an aspect of the ultimate Fourfold Song of the Future. Reference to Likutey Moharan 49:5 . 13:30 - Parshas Shemos. . לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי גַּם מִתְּמוֹל גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ אֶל־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי כְבַד־פֶּה וּכְבַד לָשׁוֹן אָנֹכִי - "...I am not a man of words, neither from yesterday nor from the day before yesterday, nor from the time You have spoken to Your servant, for I am heavy of mouth and heavy of tongue" ( Shemos 4:10, Shemos ). 16:00 - Mankind's achievement of unity with HaShem is the purpose of creation. 21:00 - Parshas Beshalach. אָז יָשִׁיר־מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לַיהוָה - "Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to HaShem..." ( Shemos 15:1, Beshalach ). At Krias Yam Suf , Moshe Rabbeinu drew from the ultimate Fourfold Song of the Future. Dovid HaMelech's Harp of 72 Strings - 72 is the full expansion of the letters of HaShem's Name Y - K - V - K . 23:00 - Az yashir. The song of the future draws from the 4 categories of dibur . נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה - "Your throne is established of old; You are from everlasting" ( Tehillim 93:2). 24:00 - Q&R about Rabbi Yisroel Dov Odesser zal and the "Na Nach" "mantra". 26:00 - The Beis HaMikdash is an aspect of Kisey HaKavod , as in ( Yirmiya 17:12). 29:00 - שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה - "There ascended the tribes, the tribes of HaShem, testimony to Israel, to give thanks to the Name of HaShem" ( Tehillim 122:4). 30:00 - Parshas Beshalach. יִדְּמוּ כָּאָבֶן - "...they sank like a stone..." ( Shemos 15:16, Beshalach ). אבן is the unification of אב and בן - the ultimate purpose of mankind is to recognize the One HaShem . All diverse opinions are then silenced. 33:30 - The Beis HaMikdash is the greatest manifestation of HaShem's unity in this world. 36:30 - Reference to Midrash Rabba, Shemos 23. 37:00 - Q&R about practical advice for how to draw joy from the future. 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 19. Why we increase praise of HaShem on Rosh Hashanah. "Melech Elyon". Machzor Course. 49:00 - Aleynu. The key to Eretz Yisrael is praising HaShem . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

lessons.description: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Aleinu - Weekday Siddur Course - Psukei deZimra - Tehillim 47 on Rosh Hashanah - Shofar - 10 Types of Song - Shabbos Siddur Course - Shalom Bayis Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. 05:20 - Before Aleinu we say "All who
lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Aleinu - Weekday Siddur Course - Psukei deZimra - Tehillim 47 on Rosh Hashanah - Shofar - 10 Types of Song - Shabbos Siddur Course - Shalom Bayis Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 20. 05:20 - Before Aleinu we say "All who study halakha..." - Praise and halakha are one. 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Tehillim 47. Rosh Hashanah. There are 586 words in Tehillim 47 which said immediately before sounding the shofar on Rosh Hashanah. 586 is the gematria of שופר. 11:00 - The 10 soundings of the shofar correspond to the 10 Types of Song. Reference to Ehven HaEzer 3:10 . 13:00 - Gerim are an example of gathering in all that is dispersed into diversity to unify it through faith in HaShem . 14:00 - Shabbos Siddur Course. KiGavna before Maariv . "HaShem is One and up in heaven, He is not seated upon His Throne until the Shekhina is present..." NOTE about Sefer Mesok MiDevash . 21:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. Yerusha - inheritance. The son normally inherits. ( Choshen Mishpat 276). Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Choshen Mishpat 2, Perika uTeEnah 4, Para. 4 . Halakha depends on the supporters of Torah. 24:00 - NOTE about last night's event: the Mir Yeshiva assembly rented out the largest arena in Yerushalayim to strengthen those who support learning Torah. 28:30 - The son inherits because a daughter is one level removed from the spiritual level of a son. Women are closer to the diversity of creation and men are closer to the unity of creation (see above reference to Perika uTeEnah 4:4). 32:00 - The creation of man was very different from the creation of woman. Physically and by nature they are separate, yet at the level of neshama , they are the epitome of unity. Reference to Likutey Moharan 265 . 35:40 - NOTE - The gematria of Nekeyva plus Zachor plus one equals Shekhina . 37:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 10. 36:00 - ***Shalom Bayis Course. The Sutra Achra is constantly trying create separate between husband and wife. Reference to Sichos HaRan 115 . 39:00 - Each child born is a revelation of halakha . 46:00 - ***Q&R about mean and woman separating on Rosh Hashanah. The reason why women are not encouraged to go to Uman for Rosh Hashanah.

lessons.title: 2026-02-20 - LH8 - CM2 - Perika uTeEnah 4 - Para. 23b-27 - Parshas Pinchas - Parshas Zachor - Parshas Beshalach
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Pinchas - Parshas Zachor - Parshas Beshalach - Childbirth - Bnos Tzelaphchad - Siddur Course - Kriyas Shema al HaMitah - Parshas Zachor - Destroying Amalek - Yad al Keis Kah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23b. The imp
lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Pinchas - Parshas Zachor - Parshas Beshalach - Childbirth - Bnos Tzelaphchad - Siddur Course - Kriyas Shema al HaMitah - Parshas Zachor - Destroying Amalek - Yad al Keis Kah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 23b. The importance of bringing children into the world in kedusha - holiness. 03:00 - Every time a child is born, he or she is something entirely different, a potential that has never existed in the world before. The birth of a child is an example of Achdus HaPashut entering the world that is not part of the external diversity of the 70 Nations. 04:00 - All members of Am Yisrael become closer to HaShem's unity every time a Jewish child is born. 15:40 - The concepts of Hodaa , Halakha , and Holada are one, in that all three reveal the unity of HaShem within the diversity of His Creation. 07:15 - In matters of yerusha - inheritance - a son has priority over a daughter. "Isha olah imo" - when a woman marries, she is elevated to her husband's level, b'ruchnius ubegashmius ( Casubos 61). 09:00 - NOTE - in present generations, the rabbis instituted that sons and daughters inherit equally for the sake of peace. 12:00 - When there's a health crisis, the blood rushes toward the heart. When a person emerges from a health crisis, his blood circulates more freely, especially within the feet. This process of physical crisis and recovery has spiritual aspects and relates to tzedakah . 13:50 - If a man does not produce children, his blood stays close to heart and HaShem troubles him through dinim . When a son passes away with no children, his inheritance goes to his father or uncles and aunts. 16:00 - Parshas Pinchas. Bnos Tzelaphchad . 19:00 - ***How the birth of Jewish children brings the geulah . 22:00 - The physical world is compared to the feet. Klipos of the physical world attach themselves to the feet and are constantly trying to pull a person downwards away from the consciousness of HaShem's unity. The greatest honor to HaShem is man's consciousness of HaShem's unity. 25:00 - NOTE - there is a place in Gan Eden called גוף. 26:40 - Q&R about leaving inheritance to grandchildren, bypassing children. 27:15 - PARAGRAPH 25. מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־תִזְכְּרֶנּוּ וּבֶן־אָדָם כִּי תִפְקְדֶנּוּ - "What is man that You should remember him, and the son of man that You should be mindful of him?" ( Tehillim 8:5). 31:00 - *** Zera livatala, chas veshalom, brings harmful spiritual entities into the world - souls that don't have a body. Saying Kriyas Shema al HaMitah with kavana is a tikkun for zera livatala ( Pri Etz Chaim, Kriyas Shema al HaMitah ). 36:00 - Q&R Why a couple can be together with kedushah throughout pregnancy and old age. 38:00 - Q&R About Jewish couples who are not shomer mitzvos . 39:00 - Tikkun HaKlali - the 10 chapters of Tehillim that Rebbe Nachman revealed as a repair for zera livatala . 40:45 - PARAGRAPH 26. אַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר - " You, HaShem, remain forever; Your throne endures throughout the generations" ( Eicha 5:19). 42:40 - PARAGRAPH 27. Parshas Zachor. Ki Yad al Kis Kah . The battle against Amalek is ongoing and continues from generation to generation, as in וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־יָד עַל־כֵּסְיָהּ מִלְחָמָה לַיהוָה בַּעֲמָלֵק מִדֹּר דֹּר - "And he said, For there is a hand on the throne of HaShem, a war for HaShem against Amalek from generation to generation" ( Shemos 17:16). 47:00 - Closing blessings.

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Para. 28-30a - Parshas Ki Seitzei - Heart in Crisis - Tefilah During Crisis - Chalitza - Yibum - Wife and Parnassah as Shoes - Inheritance - Apitropus - Kaddish for Parents - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 28. 17:26 - PARAGRAPH 29. Parshas Ki Seitzei. Chalitza and Yibum . וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ - "Then his brother's wife shall approach him before the eyes of the elders and remove his shoe from his foot..." ( Devarim 25:9, Ki Seitzei ). 22:00 - Chava was created as an extension of Adam. A wife and parnassah are referred to as a man's shoes because both his wife and his parnassah stand him on his feet. Reference to Likutey Moharan 69 . 26:30 - רוֹמֲמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא - "Exalt HaShem and prostrate yourselves to His footstool, it is holy" ( Tehillim 99:5). 28:15 - Q&R about Kohanim not wearing shoes. 29:30 - Q&R about leather shoes. Klipas Nogah is referred to as skin/hide/leather. 30:40 - PARAGRAPH 30. Laws of Apitropus - management of an orphan's estate by a guardian appointed by the child's father. 33:30 - One of the main accomplishments of bringing children into the world is all the halakhah observed by the parents in bringing new souls into the world. 38:20 - ***Why children say kaddish for their parents. 43:00 - ***Why Kaddish is said after Yishtabach in Shacharis . Kaddish is a bridge from one world to the next. 46:00 - ***The sons should be the ones reciting Kaddish, because the main tikkun of the soul is the children they brought into the world. 48:50 - *** Kaddish is an aspect of the concept of Todah - Halakha . Through saying Kaddish , the children elevate all the blessings said by the parents throughout their lives. Each child achieves this elevation in his own unique way. 51:30 - A parent needs to organize his estate and establish a last will so that each child receives the proper amount after the parent passes away. 55:30 - Q&R about these principles applying to students. 56:30 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: Tetzaveh 5786 - Zayin Adar - Yahrzeit of Moshe Rabbeinu - The Power of Humility
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Tetzaveh 5786 - Zayin Adar - The Power of the Tzaddik - Humility of Moshe Rabbeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Zayin Adar - the concept of Tzaddik . At times the enemies of Am Yisrael appreciate the centrality and importance of the Tzaddik more than Am Yisrael does - for example Pharaoh's respect for Yosef H
lessons.bodyText: Tetzaveh 5786 - Zayin Adar - The Power of the Tzaddik - Humility of Moshe Rabbeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - Zayin Adar - the concept of Tzaddik . At times the enemies of Am Yisrael appreciate the centrality and importance of the Tzaddik more than Am Yisrael does - for example Pharaoh's respect for Yosef HaTzaddik . 08:15 - Amalek/Haman vs. Mordechai HaTzaddik . 10:00 - These two enemies of Am Yisrael serve as witnesses to the power of the Tzaddik . 11:52 - Time and space - the limiting dimensions of the physical world - do not pertains to Kedushah and Shabbos . 15:20 - *A day that a person does sincere teshuvah is above the concept of time. 15:45 - Eretz Yisrael is above the concept of space. 21:28 - The Arizal's nap. 22:30 - Q&R about Shabbos Minchah - the holiest time of the week and the most opportune time to access HaShem's good will. Yosef is 6 times Y - K - V - K - Yisod . Dovid HaMelech is Malkhus . Moshe Rabbeinu is tefilah - VeEschanan . These 3 tzaddikim include the full range of perfected midos . 24:30 - Moshe Rabbeinu's humility. 28:00 - Migdal Bavel. 30:46 - ***Throughout the entire parsha of Tetzaveh , which describes the construction of the Mishkan , Moshe Rabbeinu is not mentioned even once. The hidden part of the letters משה is 101 - which equals the word מאין - "from nothing". Reference to Likutey Moharan 104 . 34:40 - אין is an aspect of כתר. 36:00 - *There are exactly 101 possukim in Parshas Tetzaveh . 37:40 - Q&R about Zayin Adar . 38:55 - NOTE - one of the names of the Malakh HaMaves and the word ענוה - humility - have the same gematria . Arrogance makes a person vulnerable to the Yetzer Hara . 40:00 - שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ - "Who remembered us in our humble state, for His kindness is eternal" ( Tehillim 136:23). 41:18 - Q_R about the connection between Moshe Rabbeinu and the Malakh Michael. Brought down in Sefer Nachal Kedumin of the Chida zal : The Malakh Michael is begematria 101. Similar to the Malakh Michael , Moshe Rabbeinu was the defender of Am Yisrael . 43:00 - A true Tzaddik is available to everyone. Moshe Rabbeinu is the Torah. צדיק יסוד עולם. 44:00 - Parshas Nitzavim - "You are standing today in the Presence of HaShem." Moshe Rabbeinu was addressing future generations. 47:50 - Closing blessings. 49:55 - Q&R about the connection between Moshe Rabbeinu , Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal , and LaG B'Omer . 50:15 - Q&R about the meaning of the Kruvim - including the importance of chavrusa in Limud Torah . 53:18 - Q&R about the Torah enabling a person to reach higher spiritual levels. The Kuzari : "If I knew HaShem , I would be HaShem ." Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.title: 2026-02-23 - LH8 - CM2 - Perika uTeEnah 4 - Para. 30b-34 - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Vayera
lessons.speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon
lessons.description: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Vayera - Apitropus - Taking an Oath - Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - Yerusha - Inheritance - Last Will - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 30b. Apitropus - guardian - appointed by a ch
lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Bereishis - Parshas Vayera - Apitropus - Taking an Oath - Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal - Yerusha - Inheritance - Last Will - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 30b. Apitropus - guardian - appointed by a child's father to establish matters of yerusha - inheritance. 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. 04:40 - The process of yerusha through apitropus generates the light of honesty, as inתִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ מִימֵי קֶדֶם - "You shall give the truth of Yaakov, the loving-kindness of Avraham, which You swore to our forefathers from days of yore" ( Michah 7:20). 07:30 - Parshas Mishpatim. אִם־לֹא יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב וְנִקְרַב בַּעַל־הַבַּיִת אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים - "If the thief is not found, the homeowner shall approach the judges, ..." ( Shemos 22:7, Mishpatim ). 08:30 - Conflict caused by denial of the truth pertaining to financial matters is related to the process of the blood gathering to the heart, as in אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָם וִישָׁרִים יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשׁוֹ - "People of blood hate the innocent, but the upright seek his soul" ( Mishlei 29:10). 10:00 - Shvuah - taking an oath is a concept of hiskashrus . It's an example of the 3 channels of אמת shining into the 4 aspects of speech. Reference to Likutey Halakhos, Yoreh Deah 2, Kiley Beheyma 4 . When a person swears, he holds a Sefer Torah and speaks the Name of HaShem , establishing a deep connection between his speech and the highest levels of אמת. 12:45 - NOTE from the Bnei Yissa'char : The 22 basic letters of the Torah are the male aspect of HaShem plus the 5 "ending letters" ם - ן - ץ - ף - ך - equal 27. 27 times Y - K - V - K is begematria Shabbos . That's why the Zohar HaKodesh brings that Shabbos is an aspect of Shem HaShem . 17:00 - Q&R about a woman's role in inheritance. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 32. Parshas Vayeira. כִּי יְדַעְתִּיו לְמַעַן אֲשֶׁר יְצַוֶּה אֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ אַחֲרָיו וְשָׁמְרוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט - "For I have known him because he commands his sons and his household after him, that they should keep the way of HaShem to perform righteousness and justice..." ( Bereishis 18:19, Vayeira ). The most important final will a person can leave for his surviving family is to follow the Torah's ways in tzedakah and mishpat . 24:40 - Q&R about performance criteria in a will. 26:00 - Judges must arrive at the אמת in order to establish אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפַּט שָׁלוֹם שִׁפְטוּ בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶם - "...truth, and judgment of peace you shall judge in your cities" ( Zecharia 8:16). 27:00 - Parshas Bereishis. וַיְהִי־עֶרֶב וַיְהִי־בֹקֶר יוֹם אֶחָד - "...and it was evening and it was morning, one day" ( Bereishis 1:5, Bereishis ). The words "Yom Echad" instead of "Yom Rishon" established forever the unity of everything HaShem created. 31:00 - NOTE - The word אמת unites the first and last letters of the Aleph-Beis . 32:00 - PARAGRAPH 34. בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר בַּיהוָה אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר - "Through HaShem's I will praise His word; through HaShem's I will praise His word" ( Tehillim 56:11). 33:00 - ***NOTE - This world is not "vacation village" - everyone is struggling. When a person thinks they have it worse than others, this is a form of self-deception that prevents him from fulfilling his potential. 37:00 - Through praising HaShem and the study of Torah, a person becomes one with HaShem . And by doing this, the person will be rescued from all his difficulties. 38:00 - NOTE - When a Breslov chassid was mocked for falling down, he replied: "I fell because of my sins. I got up because I'm Breslov". 40:00 - The importance of being at peace with Am Yisrael . 42:00 - NOTE: First line of Mizmor LeSodah - מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִֽיעוּ לַֽ֜יהֹוָ֗ה כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ - "A song for a thanksgiving offering. Shout to HaShem, all the earth" ( Tehillim 100). 46:00 - Q&R about the practical application of the principles brought in the shiur . Closing one's eyes to the pain of this world. Reference to Likutey Moharan 65 . 49:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rav Avrohom Sternhartz zal . When people sought counsel from him, he would bring them to an entirely new level of consciousness and gratitude to HaShem . 50:00 - Q&R about the difference between men and women in applying principles brought in this shiur . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel.

lessons.bodyText: Perika uTeEnah 4 - Parshas Shemos - Parshas Mishpatim - Parshas Kedoshim - Haggadah - Birkhas Kohanim - Siddur Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Perika uTeEnah 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 40b. Parshas Shemos. בְּהוֹצִיאֲךָ אֶת־הָעָם מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת־הָאֱלֹהִים עַל הָהָר הַזֶּה - "...When you take the People out of Egypt, you will worship HaShem on this mountain" ( Shemos 3:12, Shemos ). 10:00 - מִי־חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנֲנוּ חַסְדֵי יְהוָה - "He who is wise will keep these in mind, and they will ponder the kind deeds of HaShem" Tehillim 107:43. 10:30 - PARAGRAPH 41. Pesach Haggadah - Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua . Zman Kriyas Shema . 13:45 - Siddur Course - Kriyas Shema. To crown HaShem in all 4 directions, the Daled of the Shema is emphasized. Speaking about Yetzias Mitzrayim increases HaShem's light in this world. Halakha and Toda are one. 20:00 - ***Praising HaShem destroys the negative influences of the Baal Davar . 21:10 - NOTE - Heard from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal from the Baal HaTanya - HaShem has more forgiveness than all of our sins. 23:40 - PARAGRAPH 43. 27:10 - Parshas Mishpatim. הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ מַלְאָךְ לְפָנֶיךָ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בַּדָּרֶךְ וְלַהֲבִיאֲךָ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר הֲכִנֹתִי - "Behold, I am sending an angel before you to guard you on the way and to bring you to the place that I have prepared" ( Shemos 23:20, Mishpatim ). 29:25 - "Elokim" is also a term for "Malakh" . The word Elokim and the word HaTeva both have the gematria of 86. 31:20 - *** Siddur Course. Birkhas Kohanim . 37:00 - Parshas Kedoshim. Siddur Course - NOTE on Ana BeKoach - RE the last line "Shema Koleinu" - the Arizal reveals that the sum of the Roshei Teivos of this last line equals 906 - which is begematria וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה ( Vayikra 19:18, Kedoshim ). Aharon. Before Shacharis it is important to state "I am ready and prepared to accept the mitzvah of וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.
