The Daled refers to HaShem Echad – while the nations are connected to “Acher” – "other". 15:00 - NOTE on current events and how the title “Doctor” is an an aspect of Dar . 17:00 – The new technologies that are revealed in each generation are created and timed by HaShem . 23:00 – דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ - "Generation to generation will praise Your works, and they will proclaim Your mighty deeds" ( Tehillim 145:4)). 25:00 – Student comment of how dissidents at the kosel are trying to provoke. 28:00 – ***Clip - Q&R – how to counteract the bilbulim of Purim – importance of hisbodedus on Purim. 33:00 - PARAGRAPH 40. lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 2 - Yerusha - Inheritance - A Ger Who Passes Away Without Children to Inherit - Hefker - Kinyan - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2b. "Sparkling of the Soul" - Ish Tevunos . Yerusha - Inheritance - When a Ger passes away without children to inherit, his possessions belong to Klal Yisrael . 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. Yerusha - Inheritance - is generated by drawing HaShem's light into the tzimtzumim - constrictions - of physical wealth. 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. The inheritance of a ger who doesn't have children belongs to Am Yisrael . Souls created by Avraham Avinu and Sara Emeinu . Kinyan . 33:00 - HALAKHA 3. PARAGRAPH 1. A kinyan establishes ownership. 40:00 - קְנֵה חָכְמָה קְנֵה בִינָה - "Acquire wisdom, acquire understanding..." ( Mishlei 4:5). 42:00 - Hefker - owner-less. 45:00 - נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה - "When the earth and all its inhabitants were melting away, I established its pillars forever" ( Tehillim 75:4). 48:00 - "Without Torah, the world is considered owner-less. It has no seder ." 50:00 - Moshiach himself will pass away. "Hefker" also means behaving without spiritual and/or practical intelligence. 52:00 - Reference to Sichos HaRan 51 . 53:00 - Serving HaShem doesn't require hefkeres , eg. "I don't have to eat, I don't have to sleep..." etc. A person can be connected to the physical world and still be mesudar . Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 3 - Hefker - Shmita - Yovel - No Generation Is an Orphan - Tzaddik Emes - Moshe Rabbeinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1b. 08:00 - A verbal declaration establishes that an object is hefker - ownerless - no kinyan is necessary. 15:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. 30:00 - ***Q&R - The principle of Tzaddik Emes throughout the generations - having faith in Moshe Rabbeinu is not enough. This is accomplished through humility. "Truth sprouts from the earth". 32:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. "No generation is an orphan." 36:00 - וְנִשְׁאַר גַּם־הוּא לֵאלֹהֵינוּ - "...and it, too, shall remain to our HaShem..." ( Zecharia 9:7). 40:00 - Q&R - There are 2 paths in Breslov with regard to the application of the concept of Tzaddik Emes . 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Shmita. Yovel. One of the main reasons that HaShem evicts Am Yisrael from Eretz Yisrael is failure to observe Shmita/Yovel , as in עַד־רָצְתָה הָאָרֶץ אֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתֶיהָ כָּל־יְמֵי הָשַּׁמָּה שָׁבָתָה לְמַלֹּאות שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה - "...until the land was appeased for its Sabbaths; all the days of its desolation it rested until the completion of seventy years" ( Divrei HaYomim 36:21). In the Shmita and the Yovel year, all the crops become hefker . 51:00 - Q&R about using discretion in kiruv : "speaking to ears that listen". 53:00 - Closing blessings. Timings approximate.

Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal and Rabbi Yechiel Michel Dorfman zal both gave top priority to supporting the Breslov Kollel in Meah Shaarim. 30:00 - Why Yerusha - inheritance - is passed on to one's children. 33:00 - חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר׀ אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי - "The kindnesses of HaShem I shall sing forever; to generation after generation I shall make known Your faithfulness, with my mouth" ( Tehillim 89:2). 35:00 - *** בנים is begematria אמונה. lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Siddur Course - Ruach Tzafon - North Wind - Harp of Dovid HaMelech - Tikkun Chatzos - Kabbalah Course - Tehillim Course - Chinuch Course - Tzitzis - Cornerstone Content - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4b. Kabbalah Course. Ruach Tzafon - "North Wind" - Harp of Dovid HaMelech . North is an aspect of צמצום - constriction. "Gold comes from the North" ( Iyov 37:22). 08:00 - וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָה - "...and all His deeds are with faith" ( Tehillim 33:4). 10:00 - Emunah only applies to what can't be seen. 20:00 - NOTE: HaShem created the world incomplete so that man could take part in bringing creation to its ultimate purpose. 21:00 - Q&R about HaShem creating the world through the "incomplete" letter Beis , which is open on the left side, rather than the Mem Sofis , which is closed. 22:00 - Music: melody is created through selecting the correct notes - extracting the good ruach from the bad. Reference to Likutey Moharan 54 . Song is generated by sequencing appropriate constrictions of ruach . 25:00 - עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר - "Awaken, my honor; awaken , lyre and harp; I will awaken the dawn" ( Tehillim 57:9). Ayeles HaShachar . 26:00 - ***SIDDUR COURSE: NOTE heard from Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal on why Briya refers to Choshekh in Birkhas Krias Shema in Shacharis . 28:00 - *** KABBALAH COURSE. The nine nekudos refer to the nine Sefiros above Malkhus . 30:00 - NOTE - Rabbi Zvi Aryeh Rosenfeld zal expressed how his faith in the Tzaddik was stronger than what he could see with his eyes. 32:00 - Shefa is possible only when there is a combination of physical with spiritual. Tzaakas HaLev enables the Ish Tevunah to become a kli for Shefa . 38:00 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 3 (the Kruvim ) and reference to Likutey Moharan 10 ( Mordekhai and Esther ). 40:00 - SIDDUR COURSE: Q&R about practical advice for how to get up for Tikkun Chatzos without "side effects". Q&R - just staying awake until Chatzos is not accomplishing the spiritual purpose of "waking up" from sleep. 42:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. After saying Tikkun Chatzos it's important to learn Torah. The Torah is advice, as in לִי־עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה אֲנִי בִינָה לִי גְבוּרָה - "I have counsel and sound wisdom; I am understanding; I have might" ( Mishlei 8:14). Through the Torah that a person learns immediately after Tikkun Chatzos , a person accesses an increase in aitza and emunah . 45:00 - Tzitzis are an aspect of Malkhus . 47:00 - יַחֲזִיקוּ עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מִכֹּל לְשֹׁנוֹת הַגּוֹיִם וְהֶחֱזִיקוּ בִּכְנַף אִישׁ יְהוּדִי - "...when ten men of all the languages of the nations shall take hold of the corner of a Jewish man..." ( Zecharia 8:23). 49:00 - Reference to 5Likutey Moharan 5:15 - in the future, HaShem will shake the world, freeing it from false leaders. 51:00 - *** CHINUCH COURSE - Tzitzis . False leaders are clothing themselves in false garments, as in וְהָיָה׀ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יֵבֹשׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִים אִישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנוֹ בְּהִנָּבְאֹתוֹ וְלֹא יִלְבְּשׁוּ אַדֶּרֶת שֵׂעָר לְמַעַן כַּחֵשׁ - "And it shall come to pass on that day that the prophets shall be ashamed, each one of his vision when he prophesies; and they will not wear a fur mantle in order to lie" ( Zecharia 13:4). Tzitzis are the opposite of "false garments". The mitzvah of wearing tzitzis weakens teivas niuf . Reference to Likutey Moharan 7 . Story. 55:00 - Closing blessings. 56:00 - Q&R about wearing tzitzis at night. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

Tikkun HaKlali is a spiritual remedy for the damage caused by Mikreh Layla . 16:00 - The 4 angels of the Merkava are in the 4 parshios of the Tefillin . 17:30 - Q&R about the angels of the Merkava . Mentioning the name of an angel summons that angel. If there's no purpose to their being summoned, they can cause harm. The exceptions are the angels of the Merkava . 19:20 - ***NOTE - Each finger corresponds to an angel, therefore we never interlock fingers. 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. Tikkun Achila . HEALTH COURSE. Going to the bathroom in the morning is an aspect of Tikkun Achila . Eating requires refinement and the separation of what's needed from what's not needed. 27:00 - SIDDUR COURSE. Asher Yatzar . Modeh Ani. 28:00 - All forms of spiritual impurity are rooted in kfira - denial of HaShem . 30:00 - HEALTH COURSE. The importance of water in the physical processes that achieve purification from tumeh . 31:00 - מִקְוֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל מוֹשִׁיעוֹ בְּעֵת צָרָה - "O hope of Israel, his Savior at time of trouble..." ( Yirmiya 14:8). ( Mikveh Yisrael Hashem moshio..." ). KABBALAH COURSE - 32:00 - "Vesakneynu beaitza tov milfanecha" ( Hashkiveynu ). Aitza Tova saves. 32:40 - Yeshuah depends on aitza , as in וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ - "...but with many counselors there is victory" ( Mishlei 11:14). 33:00 - Washing hands with water and immersion in the mikveh enable one to draw aitza tova that brings yeshuah . Tikkun of emunah is purification from tumeh . 34:00 - After this purification, a man puts on tzitzis and tefillin 34:30 - All these tikkunim of purification are achieved through the physical processes of the morning. After this, tikkunim are done through speech. Spiritual purification is achieved only through both physical actions and speech. One without the other is not enough. 36:00 - ***Q&R Tikkun Chatzos How To - Seder of blessings when getting up for chatzos . The blessings up to "Hanoseyn bina lesekvi" are said at chatzos . 37:30 - NOTE about the holy Baal Shem Tov's daughter Udel offering her life to save her father's writings. Then she saw by ruach hakodesh that she would be the ancestor of a light even greater than her father. 39:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. Siddur Course. Cornerstone Content. Introduction to Tefilas Shacharis . Birkhas HaShachar . 44:50 - SIDDUR COURSE. Berakha: Malbish Arumim. Cloaking the Divine Light and the concept of clothing. 45:00 - Closing blessings - CORNERSTONE CONTENT - SIDDUR COURSE - Words of chizuk for davening Shacharis . 48:40 - ***Q&R - Tikkun Chatzos How To - when waking up for Tikkun Chatzos we say Birkhas HaTorah . 49:00 - Q&R about saying "Pokeyach Ivrim" at Tikkun Chatzos without Shem HaVaYaH . 50:00 - ***NOTE - CORNERSTONE CONTENT FOR HEALTH COURSE: Torah and tefilah are the most important medications. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Siddur Course - Kabbalah Course - Shema - Shemoneh Esrei - Raising Children - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 22b. 04:30 - PARAGRAPH 23. CLIP for SIDDUR COURSE. The 248 words of the Shema correspond with the 248 organs of the human body. Reference to Likutey Moharan 91 . 06:30 - PARAGRAPH 24. The Merkava is an aspect of Tikkun HaMishpat . 08:30 - PARAGRAPH 25. Kriyas Shema . 14:00 - KABBALAH COURSE. Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 and Sefer Pri Eitz Chaim . Although tikkunim are done constantly and may seem repetitive, in truth every tikkun is an entirely new accomplishment because each tikkun includes a unique composition of midos . 18:00 - ***NOTE - CLIP for Seder Pesach . 21:30 - PARAGRAPH 26. SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei. Mentioning Zechus Avos in the Shemoneh Esrei . 24:00 - Drawing Ruchnius Elokus and blessing into the midos Chesed, Din, Tiferes . 29:00 - Shemoneh Esrei: gomel chassidim tovim. Netzach and Hod are the conduits for aitza . Netzach, Hod, Yisod are called "bonim" . The term "tovim" here refers to mochin . Chasdei Dovid are aitzos and emunah . The main development of emunah is through Netzach, Hod, Yisod . 31:00 - NOTE - With Emunah alone, a person can fall. He also needs Daas - Mochin - Sekhel . 32:00 - Shemoneh Esrei. "VeKonei HaKol" . 33:00 - "Vezocher Chasdei Avos" - The Avos are an example of "The Protectors of the Land" and are called "The Arms of the World". 36:00 - "Umeyvi Goel" - The main thing that increases honor to HaShem's Name is bringing children into the world and raising children to have faith in HaShem and His Torah. 38:00 - Kaddish . 40:00 - Repairing the aspect of "Back to back" in Tikkun HaMishpat . Shemini Atzeres . 42:00 - ***Transmitting emunah from generation to generation through Tikkun HaMishpat enables the revelation of Moshiach . 44:00 - KABBALAH COURSE - Q&R - Seder vs. Lo c'seder - the partzuf for Chodesh Nissan is the only one that's entirely c'seder . 46:00 - Q&R about the practical application of the concepts being present. Story of a convert who, in a previous generation, joined the Breslov chassidim in Uman. He always cried when he came to a certain section of Shacharis. When asked why he did this, he replied that although he didn't understand all the words he was saying, he noticed that one of the most respected members of their minyan always cried during this part of the tefilah , so the ger assumed there were important elements here and therefore shed tears. 48:00 - Q&R - Tikkun HaBris is needed to perfect emunah . 50:00 - Q&R about how to relate to hearing about predictions and signs of the geulah . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.description: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Parshas Lech Lecha - Siddur Course - Shemoneh Esrei – Melech Ozer - Crying Out to HaShem - Techiyas HaMeysim - Revival of the Dead - Controlling Thoughts - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Parshas Lech Lecha - Siddur Course - Shemoneh Esrei – Melech Ozer - Crying Out to HaShem - Techiyas HaMeysim - Revival of the Dead - Controlling Thoughts - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - ***PARAGRAPH 26b. SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei. Melech Ozer. Crying out to HaShem from the depths of one's heart. Sometimes a person can't express what they need because he is under terrible pressure. 03:30 - NOTE - Ozer refers to when a person needs help. Yosheah - rescue - is when a person needs serious rescue. Magen is when a person needs protection from others and from himself - because sometimes a person is his own worst enemy. 05:20 - At this point in tefilah , the merit of the Avos can help us because we've prepared a kli for their help. That's why we repeat the word " Magen ". Maginei Aretz - Avraham Avinu is the Rosh of the Avos . His central mission was to increase emunah in the world. He is also called the Rosh of gerim - converts to Judaism. 09:20 - Parshas Lech Lecha. אָנֹכִי מָגֵן לָךְ שְׂכָרְךָ הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד - "...'Fear not, Abram; I am your Shield; your reward is exceedingly great'" ( Bereishis 15:1, Lech Lecha ). Hamon Goyim Nisaticha - Gematria of Noga - Avraham Avinu and Sarah Imeinu had the ability to see who merited their spiritual guidance. 12:30 - נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים׀ נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ - "The volunteers of the peoples have assembled, the people of the God of Abraham, for God has the shields of the earth..." ( Tehillim 47:10). 14:20 - Q&R about HaShem's protection from false leaders. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 5:5 . 17:50 - PARAGRAPH 27. Avraham Avinu dug wells for water - this was an aspect of nurturing emunah . 18:20 - NOTES and Q&R. 19:30 - PARAGRAPH 28. Spiritual aspects of tefillin's components. When dealing with light and sekhel , one needs to master tzimtzum - limitation - so the mind will have boundaries and not wander "out of bounds". HaShem's Name Shakai alludes to knowing what is enough. Reference to Likutey Moharan 7 . 23:00 - שְׂמֹאלוֹ תַּחַת לְרֹאשִׁי - "His left hand was under my head..." ( Shir HaShirim 2:6). Boundaries emanate from Gevuros . 25:10 - Q&R about unqualified rabbis and leaders. NOTE from the Vilna Gaon : When a person who isn't qualified to decide halakha but does so anyway is an aspect of "she has slaughtered many victims..." Pasach means to open, kumutz means to close. The Vilna Gaon : "One person is committing murder by opening his mouth, while another person is committing murder by closing his mouth." 28:30 - SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei . Mechayei HaMeysim - reviving the dead. 32:00 - Tzimtzum - a person needs to establish boundaries to contain his thoughts. 36:00 - הַחָכְמָה תְּחַיֶּה בְעָלֶיהָ - "...wisdom enlivens the one who possesses it" ( Koheles 7:12). 37:00 - THOUGHTS COURSE. Every person has the ability to control his thoughts. Reference to Likutey Moharan 72 . 38:00 - It's crucial to limit both negative thoughts and thoughts about holiness that are above a person's ability to develop those thoughts into the performance of mitzvos ( Chagiga 13). 40:00 - Rescuing holy sparks is an aspect of reviving the dead. 42:00 - Everything needs refined at the level of thought. 43:00 - Q&R - How does a person know what's "too much" for them? The importance of Yirah , Tefilah , and Emunas Chokhomim . The difference between Hisbodedus (speaking to HaShem ) and Hisbonenus (thinking about HaShem ). Agadata - stories and accounts - in the Gemara strengthen Yiras Shemayim . 47:00 - Q&R about creative thinking. 48 ways to learn Torah. Every Torah leader is different. 51:00 - Q&R about what to think when a household kli breaks. 53:00 - NOTE - Yesterday was the levaya of Rav Nasan Liebermentch zal . He was a close student of Rav Levi Yitzchak Bender zal . Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Parshas Beshalach - Parshas Mishpatim - Siddur Course - Shemoneh Esrei - Health Course - Tikkun Achila in Nissan - Leaving Over a Bit of Food for the Klipos - Rosh Hashanah of the Angels - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 29. SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei. Kedushah. Ata Kadosh. 02:00 - PARAGRAPH 30. SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei. Introduction to the overall structure of the first 3 berakhos of the Shemoneh Esrei - the "Avos" . The first berakha corresponds to Avraham Avinu ; the second to Yitzchak Avinu ; the third to Yaakov Avinu . 06:00 - Shemoneh Esrei , the fourth through sixth berakhos . 07:00 - The spiritual processes achieved through Rosh Hashanah, Eseres Yemei Teshuvah , and Yom Kippur. 11:00 - Goel Yisrael . Chodesh Nissan . Tikkun Achilah . 15:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Halakhos 5:10 . 15:30 - Q&R about saying the blessings of the Shemoneh Esrei in the proper sequence. 17:00 - Q&R about the sequence of tikkunim inherent in the lunar months. 18:00 - SIDDUR COURSE. Blessing of refuah . Recovery from illness depends on emunah . Parshas Beshalach. Refuah also depends on Tikkun Achila during Nissan , as in כָּל־הַמַּחֲלָה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂמְתִּי בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־אָשִׂים עָלֶיךָ - "...all the sicknesses that I have visited upon Egypt I will not visit upon you..." ( Shemos 15:26, Beshalach ). 22:00 - PARAGRAPH 31. HEALTH COURSE. Achila dekedusha and healing. 30:00 - Parshas Mishpatim. וּבֵרַךְ אֶת־לַחְמְךָ וְאֶת־מֵימֶיךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִי מַחֲלָה מִקִּרְבֶּךָ - "...and He will bless your food and your drink, and I will remove illness from your midst" ( Shemos 23:25, Mishpatim ). 32:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 84 . The most powerful attachment with HaShem is tefilah because it connects the Shekhina with Kudsha Brikh Hu . 33:00 - Q&R about the connection between emunah , refuah , and achila . 34:30 - NOTE on the connection between fasting and joy. The "Rosh Hashanah of the Angels" is Rosh Chodesh Nissan . Food has particular tikkun during Nissan. 36:30 - Tikkun HaMishpat. Reference to Likutey Moharan 2 - Tefilah is compared to a "Double-Edged Sword". Mishpat - good judgement - is required to wield this sword effectively. 40:00 - HEALTH COURSE. Food affects dreams and Tikkun HaBris. The importance of not eating heavily at night before going to sleep. 42:00 - NOTE: In Atbash , גאל is כתר. 43:00 - SIDDUR COURSE. Shemoneh Esrei. Birkhas HaShanim. 44:00 - HEALTH COURSE. Tikkun Achila. Leaving over a bit of food for the klipos . At the end of a meal, leaving over for the klipos more than little bit of our food can result in the klipos taking over the benefits of all the food we've eaten at that meal, chas veshalom . 46:00 - Q&R about "mitaso shel Shlomo" and the mita of Yaakov Avinu . 47:30 - Q&R about leaving over a little bit for the Sutra Achra after a meal. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Hefker veNikhsey HaGer 4 - Parshas Haazinu - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 33. 32:00 - HILKHOS NACHALOS 1. PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Nachalos 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 29 . The 248 positive commandments of the Torah correspond to the 248 organs in the human body. The 365 negative mitzvos correspond to the 365 tendons in the human body. 33:00 - Parshas Haazinu. כְּנֶשֶׁר יָעִיר קִנּוֹ עַל־גּוֹזָלָיו יְרַחֵף יִפְרֹשׂ כְּנָפָיו יִקָּחֵהוּ יִשָּׂאֵהוּ עַל־אֶבְרָתוֹ - "As an eagle awakens its nest, hovering over its fledglings, it spreads its wings, taking them and carrying them on its pinions" ( Devarim 32:11, Haazinu ). 35:00 - Tikkun HaKlali for speech is speaking about the greatness of tzaddikim . 36:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. A person's children correspond to the 365 negative commandments and Tikkun HaBris . One of the highest forms of Tikkun HaBris is to bring children into the world. 38:00 - Children conceived and born through kedushah have the ability to do a tikkun for their parents after their parents pass away. 40:00 - זִרְעוּ לָכֶם לִצְדָקָה קִצְרוּ לְפִי־חֶסֶד - "Sow righteousness for yourselves, reap according to loving-kindness..." Hoshea 10:12. 41:00 - NOTE: When children inherit and give tzedakah , this generates clothing for the soul of the niftar . 42:00 - Yibum and Chalitza . 45:00 - "They leave their remains to their children" ( Tehillim 17:14-15). 48:00 - Q&R about leaving inheritance to children when they are not going in the derech of Torah. The importance of tefilah. Reference to Sichos HaRan about having children. ***In the end, everything will be repaired.

Hilkhos Nachalos 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 29 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. TEFILAH COURSE. Kaddish. Spiritual aspects of why a son recites Kaddish for his parents. 04:00 - Parshas Bereishis. וַיֵּדְעוּ כִּי עֵירֻמִּם הֵם - "...and they knew that they were naked" ( Bereishis 3:7, Bereishis ). "With difficult you will bear children..." - spiritual aspects of childbirth. 06:00 - Tikkun Parnassah depends on Tikkun HaBegadim - repair of physical and spiritual garments. 09:00 - " a person leaves behind a son to inherit him - it's as if he didn't die" ( Bava Basra 116). 10:30 - A person's children are also considered his garments. 11:00 - וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת - "...and charity saves from death" ( Mishlei 10:2). 12:00 - NOTE - Kimcha dePischa is one of the special forms of tzedakah that saves from death. 13:00 - Kaddish is praise of The Tzaddik - HaShem . The first letters of Kaddish spell the word ירש. 14:45 - A person who says Kaddish with full concentration is forgiven all sins. Reference to Likutey Moharan 49 . 16:30 - "My strength" refers to children. 17:20 - There are 28 words in one section of the Kaddish , and 28 letters in the response "Amein Yehi Shemei rabba..." (etc.) 18:30 - Parshas Shelach. וְעַתָּה יִגְדַּל־נָא כֹּחַ אֲדנָי כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ - "Now, please, let the strength of HaShem be increased, as You spoke..." ( Bamidbar 14:17, Shelach ). Tikkun HaDibur and Tikkun HaBris elevates and repairs the Divine Power. 20:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. KABBALAH COURSE. Praising HaShem's Nam Yud - Kay. All tikkunim are an aspect of expansion of the Mochin - Sekhel . 22:50 - NOTE about the spiritual aspects of Kaddish - "The Crown has been diminished." 23:45 - The Arizal explains, the word Yiskadash has 3 parts. Shem SHaKaI is associated with Tikkun HaBris . In gematria b'milui , SHem ShaKaI is 500. 26:00 - The Tikkun HaKlali sends repair to all 365 Giden . 27:00 - NOTE about the spiritual aspects of Bedikas Chometz. We use a candle to be able to eliminating Chometz from all narrow spaces. 28:45 - Q&R about the 28 letters in the response to Kaddish . Kaddish is Tikkun HaKlali in all of its forms. 33:55 - Targum is also an aspect of Tikkun HaBris . Reference to Likutey Moharan 19 . 35:00 - NOTE - The processes of Bris Milah correspond to the processes of getting rid of klipos - spiritual impurity. 36:30 - Tikkun HaBegadim refers to spiritual purity. When a woman gives birth, the life energy in the blood of childbearing is transformed into milk. 39:00 - Significance of the gematria 288 which appears in the second possuk of Bereishis . Chometz on Pesach is an aspect of death. מרחפת - the center letters רחפ equal 288 - the outer letters are מת. 44:00 - Q&R about the word עירב - Eiruv . 45:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

Hilkhos Nachalos 1 is based on Likutey Moharan 29 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. EISHES CHAYIL COURSE. TZADDIK COURSE. A son precedes a daughter in matters of yerusha - inheritance. Tikkun HaKlali. Childbirth. Zivug refers to Tzaddik . ברית with the kolel (adding 1 for the word itself) is 613 - bris includes all the mitzvos . 05:20 - A son has more potential than a daughter to extend the spiritual tikkun of the parents after they pass away. 07:00 - A daughter can affect a greater tikkun for her parents through her husband when she marries. 09:00 - A woman relegates her inheritance and earnings to her husband. NOTE: a general principle in halakha always requires specific application and qualification. 11:00 - If there's no son, the inheritance passes to the daughter. 13:00 - אִישׁ כִּי־יָמוּת וּבֵן אֵין לוֹ וְהַעֲבַרְתֶּם אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ לְבִתּוֹ - "If a man dies and has no son, you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter" ( Bamidbar 27:8, Pinchas ). 16:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. 19:30 - Yibum. Chalitza. If a man passes away with no children, his family of origin needs to do the tikkun for his soul. 10:30 - PARAGRAPH 7. Parshas Pinchas. Bnos Tzelaphchad. 24:00 - Q&R about why the question of the Bnos Tzelaphchad arose. 25:30 - HALAKHA 2. NOTE: In present times, sons and daughters inherit equally. 27:30 - PARAGRAPH 1. Hilkhos Nachalos 2 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 7 . 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. The relationship between the body and soul in Olam HaEmes . 45:00 - Q&R about the obligation to marry and have children. 48:00 - The spiritual aspects of leaving children behind in the world. Existence in this world is considered a "garment". Leaving one's Daas in this world makes it possible for the neshama to be clothed, and to rise up. 51:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

The angel MaTaT . 18:00 - Yearning generates souls. The nature of the Neshama Yisera on Shabbos . 29:00 - נְקֻדּוֹת הַכָּסֶף - "...points of silver" ( Shir HaShirim 1:11). Nekudos of Silver. The nekudos of the letters infuse the letters with life. 37:00 - NOTE: Breslov Research Institute just published an English Translation of Kokhvei Ohr . 42:00 - Achila beKedushah. Children are the result of the Tikkun HaBris of their parents. 47:00 - Kaddish - "Yiskadash" is the milui of Shem HaShem SHaKaI . The tikkun for bris is to produce children in kedushah . A couple needs to have positive feelings toward one another in order to bring holy souls into the world. 55:00 - A person needs to beg HaShem for help in all aspects of his spiritual aspirations. 57:00 - Closing Blessings. Mention of the hashgacha of the timing of the current shiurim , since we're now in Sefiras HaOmer : Rabbi Shimon Bar Yochai zal , Tikkun HaBris , LAg BeOmer . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Hilkhos Sukkah 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Sukkah b'gematria is 91 - מלאך. **07:00 - The Vilna Gaon describes how the letters of the word
lessons.bodyText: Sukkah 3 - Parshas Tazria - The Tzaddik Draws Up Good Counsel - The Dimensions of the Sukkah Protect - Dealing with Dreams - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Sukkah 3 is based on 2Likutey Moharan 5 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 1. Sukkah b'gematria is 91 - מלאך. **07:00 - The Vilna Gaon describes how the letters of the word " sukkah " - סכה - Samech, Chaf, Hey - demonstrate the three types of structures that qualify as a kosher sukkah . 09:00 - Aitza - advice - is completed in Netzach and Hod , the right and left kidneys. The Tzaddik draws forth and reveals true advice, as when the voice of HaShem emanated only to Moshe Rabbeinu from between the two Keruvim (cherubs, forms of angels) that were on the cover of the Aron Kodesh . The faces of the cherubs resembled the faces of small children ( Chagiga 13b; Sukkah 5ab). 10:30 - The Tzaddik is the one who is doleh (draws up) the aitzos (good counsel). 14:17 - PARAGRAPH 2. 17:00 - Parshas Tazria - Tikkun HaBris . 23:00 - Q&R about Klipa Noga . Teaching from Rabbi Rosenfeld zal about Avraham Avinu and gerim (converts to Judaism). 25:13 - Each midah has all the others within it. 26:00 - CLIP***Q&R about the practical application of the spiritual principles presented. Aitza tova . 31:00 - ***The measurements of the sukkah are aspects of staying within one's spiritual boundaries. Keser (620) 38:00 - PARAGRAPH 4. Ushpizin ("guests" in Aramaic). The Seven Shepherds of Israel who visit the Sukkah , each one on a different day of the holiday. Dreams come from either a malach or a negative supernal force. 43:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Staying within boundaries of permitted thought is what repairs the intellect. 48:14 - ***Q&R about dreams. 49:00 - Custom of Birkhas Kohanim every day in Eretz Yisrael . 50:00 - A dream is a revelation. 53:13 - Rabbi Rosenfeld zal on dreams.: וחלמות השוא ידברו ( Zecharia 10:2). After a disturbing dream, it's a custom followed by Rabbi Rosenfeld to repeat this phrase 3 times and give tzedakah . After a positive dream, we pose the same phrase as as a question by adding a word: "Vechi chalamos haShav yiDabeyru?" This minhag (custom) is based on Berachos 55b: "Shmuel, when he would see a bad dream, would say: 'VaChalamos haShav yidabeyru' - 'And dreams speak falsely'” ( Zechariah 10:2). "When he would see a good dream, he would say: 'Vechi haChalamos haShav yidabeyru?' - 'And do dreams speak falsely? Isn’t it written: ' I speak with him in a dream'" ( Bamidbar 12:6). שְׁמוּאֵל כִּי הֲוָה חָזֵי חֶלְמָא בִּישָׁא אָמַר: ״וַחֲלֹמוֹת הַשָּׁוְא יְדַבֵּרוּ״. כִּי הֲוָה חָזֵי חֶלְמָא טָבָא אָמַר: וְכִי הַחֲלוֹמוֹת הַשָּׁוְא יְדַבֵּרוּ וְהָכְתִיב ״בַּחֲלוֹם אֲדַבֶּר בּוֹ'' 60:00 - Q&R: Kavanas for Bris Milah ? Reference to Likutey Moharan 63 . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Nachalos 3 - Parshas Ki Seitzei - Shalom Bayis Course - Bearing Children - Shoes - Yibum - Chalitza - Lechem HaPanim - Spiritual Aspects of Face - Shoes - Nekudos and Letters - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nachalos 3 is based on Likutey Moharan 31 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 3. SHALOM BAYIS COURSE. Yerusha to son or daughter. Bearing children. Male and female principles in Limud Torah and in marriage. 11:30 - Parnassah is generated through Tikkun HaBris . 15:40 - *** Q&R's about responding to the issue of equality between male and female in the world today. 20:48 PARAGRAPH 4. Parshas Ki Seitzei. Parshas Yibum and Chalitza .וְנִגְּשָׁה יְבִמְתּוֹ אֵלָיו לְעֵינֵי הַזְּקֵנִים וְחָלְצָה נַעֲלוֹ מֵעַל רַגְלוֹ - "Then his brother's wife shall approach him before the eyes of the elders and remove his shoe from his foot..." ( Devarim 25:9, Ki Seitzei ). The shoe represents the Malach MeTaT . Meaning of the statement in the Gemara : "A person should even sell the beams of his house to buy shoes" ( Shabbos 129a). Inner dimensions of Lechem HaPanim with regard to inyanei Shalom Bayis . 29:00 - PARAGRAPH 5. Parshas Ki Seitzei. Bnos Tzelaphchad . 31:00 - Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 8 . 33:30 - The process of death includes both a separation and ultimate unification of body and soul. 34:00 - ***PARAGRAPH 6. Unification of body and soul during the final process of death enables a person to reach eternal life. 35:00 - PARAGRAPH 7. מִמֲתִים יָדְךָ׀ יְהוָה מִמֲתִים מֵחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים וּצְפיּנְךָ וּצְפוּנְךָ תְּמַלֵּא בִטְנָם יִשְׂבְּעוּ בָנִים וְהִנִּיחוּ יִתְרָם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶם - "Of those who die by Your hand, HaShem, of those who die of old age, whose share is in life, and whose stomach You will fill with Your hidden treasure, who have children in plenty and leave their abundance to their infants" ( Tehillim 17:14). Tzafon - North - refers to the left side/gold/hidden aspects of the Torah. The "Points of Silver" are the nekudos , which give life to the letters of the Torah. 38:00 - לַעֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי - "HaShem, I desired to do Your will and Your law within my innards" ( Tehillim 40:9). The forms of the letters of the Aleph-Beis correspond to Malkhus - the sephira closest to the physical world. The nekudos correspond to all the higher sefiros . The main emanation of light into our physical world is from the lowest level - the forms of the letters themselves. 40:00 - Yearning generates souls. 43:00 - Q&R about tzaddikim whose children do not reflect their level of Tikkun HaBris . Moshe Rabbeinu had over 200 descendants but some of them were not tzaddikim . 47:00 - Q&R about reciting the tefilah "Psach Eliyahu" . 48:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Nachalos 4 - Emunah - Siddur Course - Shemoneh Esrei - Hisbodedus Course - Tehillim Course - Cornerstone Content - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nachalos 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - INTRODUCTION. PARAGRAPH 1. Tefilah is the ikar - the essential key to spiritual and physical success. 03:00 - NOTE from Rav Elya Chaim Rosen zal about what it means when Rav Nasan of Nemirov zal uses the word "ikar" . 07:00 - PARAGRAPH 2. 08:30 - PARAGRAPH 3. SIDDUR COURSE. Order of tefilah . 13:00 - Tefilah is a vessel. Reference to Likutey Moharan 14 . 14:30 - SIDDUR COURSE. HISBODEDUS COURSE. CORNERSTONE CONTENT. Since HaShem knows what I need, why do I need to ask Him? Reference to Likutey Moharan 34 . 18:30 - ***A person needs to have both faith in HaShem and faith in himself. 20:00 - NOTE - story of Menashe crying out to HaShem when he was in danger. 21:30 - TEHILLIM COURSE. MUST CLIP: *** HaShem hears the tefilah of anyone, in any circumstance. As in קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת - "HaShem is near to all who call Him, to all who call Him with sincerity" Tehillim 145:18). 23:00 - When a person doesn't believe in his own ability to receive blessing, he doesn't yet have a vessel to receive what HaShem would like to give him. 25:00 - *** SIDDUR COURSE. TEHILLIM COURSE. Psukei deZimra. If a person feels weak in his emunah , he should recite words of faith. 27:00 - ***We begin tefilah with praising HaShem because this process creates vessels through which our tefilos can be fulfilled in ways we can perceive. 29:00 - *** SIDDUR COURSE. HISBODEDUS COURSE. Q&R - these concepts apply to both tefilah from a siddur as well as to hisbodedus - personal prayer in one's own words. 31:00 - Q&R about the success of Menashe's prayer, since he began with prayer to idols. 33:00 - We begin Shemoneh Esrei with mentioning the Avos in order to strengthen our emunah . "Saying the names of the Avos "is like 'Google-ing' them." By saying their names, all the miracles done for the Avos are activated in our memory, which creates vessels. 36:15 - NOTE - B"H - Rabbi Maimon's granddaughter gave birth to a child yesterday. 42:20 - Q&R about the structure of hisbodedus . 46:00 - SID DUR COURSE. ***It's very important to restate our faith in HaShem in Shemoneh Esrei - "Ata Shomeya Tefilah" . Analogy of mixing all the ingredients to make a cake, but forgetting to light the oven. 49:40 - PARAGRAPH 4. 52:00 - ***When a person wants to begin praying with more sincerity, at first he experiences challenges. "All beginnings are difficult." These challenges seem most difficult because he has not yet experienced the success of seeing the good results of his tefilah . If he persists long enough to experience good results, the challenges diminish. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

The final geulah will be greater than all previous geulos . 02:45 - וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ - "...and let us sing praises and rejoice with al
lessons.bodyText: Nachalos 4 - Purim - Hisbodedus Course - Siddur Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nachalos 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. Purim. The final geulah will be greater than all previous geulos . 02:45 - וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ - "...and let us sing praises and rejoice with all our days" ( Tehillim 90:14). 04:45 - To conquer the world, the main weapon of Moshiach is tefilah . 05:40 - PARAGRAPH 18. *** Matanos LeEvyonim. Increasing tzedakah on Purim. Mishpat. 07:10 - PARAGRAPH 19. *** Mishloach Manos. Gemilas Chesed applies both to the poor and to the wealthy. Story of Rabbah Bar Bar Chanah and the fish that turned over: the word sefina - boat - is associated with chessed . 16:44 - Megilas Esther 13 - the golden scepter of Achashverosh was an aspect of HaShem's "Thread of Chesed ". 17:45 - Q&R about tefilah . We pray for both HaShem's chessed in general and in detail. The goal is to increase our communication with HaShem until we're speaking to Him in our own words in depth for an hour each day. We begin with 5 minutes a day and gradually, over time, increase. Analogy with fund raising. 23:45 - ***NOTE: Sometimes we need to "sell" ourselves to HaShem . "The sale begin when the customer says no." 24:45 - * **NOTE: The key to geulah is knowing one's place. Don't come to HaShem with haughtiness - as if He owes you something. Always approach him with humility. 25:30 - NOTE about rent in Geulah going up exponentially. When negotiating with HaShem , we don't say, " HaShem , what You're doing to me is not just." 28:30 - Q&R about seeing the good. We never attribute our success on our tefilah . Everything we receive is purely Chesed HaShem . 30:00 - NOTE - HaShem wants us to "defeat" Him. 30:40 - PARAGRAPH 20. 34:30 - SIDDUR COURSE. HISBODEDUS COURSE. *** Tefilah requires persistence. 40:00 - NOTE about Rabbi Rosenfeld zal's spiritual inspiration through the sefer Hishtapkhus HaNefesh . 42:00 - A person needs to "hit a target" with tefilah . He can't strike too far to the "left" or too far to the "right". 47:00 - We are expected to maintain and/or increase the quality and/or quantity of our tefilos throughout our lifetime . Rav Noson repeats this concept because we need to hear this again and again. To illustrate, we don't say "I ate yesterday, so I don't need to eat today". It's the same for tefilah . Tefilah every day is necessary for the soul to live. 48:20 - Mishloach Manos - when we show chesed to others, even though they might seem not to need it, HaShem shows chesed to us. 50:15 - Matanos LeEvyonim is a different aspect of tzedakah because it depends on Mishpat . The Geulah depends on both Tzedakah and Gemilas Chesed . ***Giving tzedakah does not take the place of Mishloach Manos . 53:20 - Q&R about Mishloach Manos. The custom on Breslov is that everyone davens Netz ( Shacharis at daybreak). It's fine to give Mishloach Manos that one receives and give it to someone else. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings Approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Nachalos 4 - Parshas Lech Lecha - Purim - Hisbodedus Course - Siddur Course - Tzaddik Course - Seasons Course - Cornerstone Content - Bris Milah - Klipas Esav-Amalek - Klipas Yishmael - Torah Into Tefilah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Nachalos 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 2 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21. Purim. Megilas Esther. Mordekhai is called "Pesachya" - he strengthened himself and Klal Yisrael in both tefilah and Torah . 08:00 - ***Through tefilah , the Torah is constantly renewed. 10:00 - PARAGRAPH 22. HISBODEDUS COURSE. SIDDUR COURSE. It's vital to continually unite Tiferes and Malkhus - Turning Torah Into tefilah . 18:00 - PARAGRAPH 23. HISBODEDUS COURSE. SIDDUR COURSE. Bris Milah . The negative effects of Klipas Esav-Amalek on tefilah . 22:00 - The negative effects of Klipas Yishmael on tefilah . 26:00 - Parshas Lech Lecha. כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהוָה אֶל־עָנְיֵךְ - "...for HaShem has heard your affliction" ( Bereishis 16:11, Lech Lecha ). Never stop praying! 28:00 - ***One must have faith that HaShem hears and answers every prayer. 36:00 - ***SEASONS COURSE. Purim. Megilas Esther . During the events of Purim, Am Yisrael never stopped davening . Even when they became aware of HaShem's the miracles of rescue, they continued to pray for His help. They took nothing for granted. 42:00 - Parshas Vayeira. NOTE: בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וַיִּשָּׂא אַבְרָהָם אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם מֵרָחֹק - "On the third day, Avraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place from afar" ( Bereishis 22:4, VaYeira ). Avraham Avinu saw the future Beis HaMikdash - but "from a distance". He was shown that it would be a long process and require many, many tefilos . 45:00 - Q&R - Ways in which the tefilah and Limud Torah of women is different from the tefilah and Limud Torah of men. 46:00 - Q&R about tefilah . 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 24. HISBODEDUS COURSE. SIDDUR COURSE. The two processes of Bris Milah are both necessary, otherwise the Milah is incomplete. Klipas Esav-Amalek attacks tefilah by instilling forgetfulness about HaShem's past miracles of rescue. Klipas Yismael attacks tefilah by instilling arrogance: "I already davened ." 52:00 - One needs to strengthen tefilah continually. 55:00 - *** TZADDIK COURSE - Q&R about opposition to the concept of Tzaddik . Concise description of Tzaddik throughout the Torah. ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE from Rabbi Maimon's life about his discovery of Hishtapkhus HaNefesh and the importance of tefilah . 60:00 - Q&R - Klipas Yishmael is an aspect of overconfidence. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

( Esther 4:1). Mordekhai HaTzaddik was rooted in the highest level of sekhel . Explanation of "Crowns within their heads..." instead of crowns "upon" their heads. 10:00 - To bring new mokhin into the world, tzaaka - screams - are needed. Reference to Likutey Moharan 21:7 . 12:00 - Esther is begematria Shoshana - a hidden name for the Shekhinah and Knesses Yisrael . In Megilas Esther , the Shekhinah is called Esther . 14:00 - PARAGRAPH 6. ***When the Shekhina is imprisoned, it's necessary for Am Yisrael to scream to HaShem for it to be released. Through 70 screams we can bring the Shekhinah out of its entrapment. Esther tells Mordekhai - "Fast upon me..." Fasting is a form of tzaaka . Tzom - Kol - Mamon are one. 18:15 - NOTE about Parshas Acharei Mos . 18:50 - *** PARNASSAH COURSE. Reference to Likutey Moharan 23. Sometimes there's a need for 140 kolim . 21:20 - *** Parnassah requires 140 kolim because to generate money, there are 2 stages: First the mochin need to be brought out of obscurity; then the shefa needs to be drawn from Above. 23:30 - All blessing begins from Daas . 24:20 - Q&R about screams. 26:20 - HaShem is "close to the broken-hearted" . 31:30 - Tzom - Kol - Mamon . Teshuvah - Tefilah - Tzedakah . All sins and suffering is rooted in a lack of Daas . When a person cries out to HaShem , he enters a state of perfecting Daas . Through this, all types of suffering are eliminated. 36:00 - Q&R about having the Shekhinah in mind when giving tzedakah . 38:20 - PARAGRAPH 7. Matanos LeEvyonim . 42:00 - ***Q&R The Silent Scream. Kol Demama Daka. Screaming silently - with the same force of breath through the throat but without engaging the vocal chords - is equally effective to a scream that can be heard by others. 45:00 - ***Q&R about screaming aloud. 49:00 - ***BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal . There are 2 kinds of screams - screaming at HaShem (with anger) vs. screaming to HaShem (with humility). 54:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Rav Menachem Mendel of Vitebsk zal was born in 5490 (1730) and became such a close and accomplished student of the Magid of Mezrich that when the Magid passed away, Rav Menachem Mendel was asked to become the leader of the Hassidic movement. He deferred and, from that time on, Hassidism no longer had a single central leader. In Adar 5537 (1777) Rav Menachem Mendel organized the first large-scale chassidic immigration to the Eretz Yisrael . His group included about 300 men, women, and children. Sharing the leadership of this project was Rav Avraham Kalisker zal , another elder of the Magid’s court. Rabbi Schneur Zalman of Liadi zal , the founder of Chabad, also set forth for Eretz Yisrael , but was instructed by Rav Menachem Mendel to return home to guide the chassidish communities who remained in Russia. After a long and difficult journey, the families began to settle in Tsefat. But severe opposition there forced them to resettle in Tiberias, where Rabbi Menachem Mendel built a Hassidic synagogue. The community endured tremendous suffering, losing many of its members to illness. The bitter trials of this endeavor weighed heavily on its leaders’ shoulders, but through their perseverance, a path back to Eretz Yirael was finally opened for the chareidi diaspora. When Rav Menachem Mendel b'Rav Moshe zal passed away on the 2nd of Iyar , 5548 (May 10, 1788) the leadership of Hassidism in Eretz Yisrael then passed to Rav Avraham Kalisker zal . The teachings of Rav Menachem Mendel can be found in three seforim : Pri HaAretz , Pri Etz , and Likutey Amarim . The sefer Pri HaAretz concludes with a powerful letter written by Rav Menachem Mendel of Vitebsk to the members of his community in Russia who had not yet come to live in Eretz Yisrael . His wise encouragement continues to resonate even today: Pri HaAretz, Michtav 17: “…In response to those who seek to make a dwelling place for their soul in the Holy Land, here is information that should be known and made known concerning the Land of Israel … what, exactly, is this Land? “In Midrash Shocher Tov our Rabbis explain the words ‘HaShem, You desire Your Land’ ( Tehillim 85:2) as meaning that HaShem examines the Land of Israel closely again and again, searching it out and watching until the inhabitants’ deeds are desirable. “Be aware that many transformations are in store for anyone who is brought to the Land. Many developments will unfold within and around newcomers until they are established there and come to ‘desire her (the Land’s) stones and cherish her dust.’ ( Tehillim 102:15), to ‘treasure even her ruins’ and be ‘satisfied with modest sustenance’ ( Mishlei 17:1). “And it’s not meant for thin-skinned people… and it’s not in one day, nor in two days, nor in a month, nor in a year… but rather it takes many years until the days of absorption are over and the newcomers have an integrated life. “And then they will dwell forever before HaShem , as it’s written: ‘One man after another is born within her ’ ( Tehillim 87: 5). From this verse our Sages understand that whoever approaches the holiness of the Land is given the chance to start life all over again, anew. This means they will have to return through the experiences of birth, progressing through nursing infancy, maturing through childhood, and so on until, face to face, they come to perceive the true essence of the Land and the person’s soul becomes attached to the soul of the Land. “Concerning what is written about ‘…his learning is in his hand’ : those character traits which may have been habitual to a person are not necessarily established upon arrival here (in the Land of Israel). One’s mind will actually be torn, shattered, and have no place to turn for rest. It seems to the person as if he is at one moment ascending to the heavens, while the next moment plunging to the depths, like a boat tossed upon the waves of a stormy sea. “And the newcomer bothers other people with his problems, concerns, deeds, and behavior. The Torah and mitzvos of HaShem cannot be truly acquired until the person comes to the ability to praise the Land and HaShem Yisborach shows His Countenance. It is only then that the person will find response and be at peace. “This process doesn’t take any specific length of time. It lasts a different amount of time for every individual, according to one’s personal issues and deeds, and according to the root of each soul. “In light of all this, therefore, whoever desires to approach this inner holiness should not only prepare themselves for everything that is mentioned here, but should also understand to the very depths of their being that they have the strength to withstand all these things. Everyone who attempts to settle in the Land of Israel should be aware that at least, through this process, most of their character traits will be refined and they will eventually gain master over themselves. “Then every person will make steadfast progress and, through heeding the counsel of the great advisors among us, will dwell securely and peacefully.” Pri HaAretz, Michtav 17: מכתבים, י״ז וזאת אשיב אל לבי להשיב מפני הכבוד לכל שואל ומבקש לשכון כבוד בארץ הקדושה מודעא רבה לידע ולהודיע את הארץ מה היא. אמרו רבינו ז"ל במדרש שוחר טוב בפסוק רצית ה' את ארצך כו' הקדוש ברוך הוא הופך ומהפך ומסתכל ונותן עיניו בה עד שתרצה את מעשיה. הנה כמה היפוכים וגלגולים ומארעות עידן ועידנין יחלפו על כל אחד מבאי הארץ עד כי מתדיר ליה בה ורצה את אבניה ואת עפרה יחונן ואוהב חורבות שבארץ ישראל מפלחין שבחוץ לארץ ופת חריבה וכו' וכיוצא בהם ולא לקלים המרוץ לא יום ולא יומים לא חדש ולא שנה כי אם ברבות השנים עד יעברו ימי הקליטה קולטתו בחיים במקלט ישב עולם לפני אלקים כמה שכתוב איש ואיש יולד בה רצה לומר כל הבא אל הקדש צריך מחדש עיבור ויניקה וקטנות וכו' עד פנים בפנים יראה פני הארץ ונפשו קשורה בנפשה הנה כי כן מאן דאתי ואייתי תלמודו בידו במה שהורגל כל אחד ואחד לפי מדותיו לא מתדר ליה בתחילה בכאן ממש דעתו מטורפת עליו טרף יטרף באין פנות אל המנוחה ואל הנחלה יעלה שמים ירד תהומות כאני' המטרפת בים ומטריד את אחרים בענייניו ובמעשיו והנהגותיו הי תורה והי מצוה מה דהוה לא הוה עד ישים תהלה בארץ והשם יתברך מראה לו פנים אז ישקוט וינוח לו והוא דבר שאין לו קצבה וארך הזמן ואיך וכמה ומתי לכל אחד לפי ענייניו ולפי מעשיו ולפי שורש נשמתו. אשר על כן הבא לגשת אל הקדש פנימה יזמין עצמו לכל האמור ויבחין בנפשו אשר לו כח לעמוד בכל אלה דלא לגזזו אודני' מיניה וישער בעצמו שעל כל פנים רוב מדותיו מתוקני' והוא ימשל בם אז ילך לבטח דרכו בעצת גדולי העצה אשר עמהם. והשומע ישכן בטח ושאנן. ואברהם עודנו עומד לפני ה' שפתי תפתח פותח את ידיך ומשביע לכל חי רצון אמן כן יאמר ה' Translation and Notes (c) 1981 by S.Y. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4b. True Wisdom
lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas Emor - Parshas VeZos HaBerakha - Health Course - Tehillim Course - Siddur Course - True Wisdom vs. False Wisdom - Dangers of Chumra - Stringency - Mosros - Lifting the Omer - One Rabbi - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 4b. True Wisdom vs. False Wisdom. 14:00 - הוֹי חֲכָמִים בְּעֵינֵיהֶם וְנֶגֶד פְּנֵיהֶם נְבֹנִים - "Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and in their own estimation, of profound understanding" ( Yeshaya 5:21). 18:00 - Educators and psychologists/therapists who haven't refined their own midos mislead others. 19:00 - ***HEALTH COURSE. Parshas VeZos HaBerakha. Therapy vs. Forgetting. NOTE about Post Traumatic therapy and reliving the past. In contrast, the Torah teaches us what to remember and what to forget. The last statement in the Torah alludes to Moshe Rabbeinu's act of breaking the Luchos : וּלְכֹל הַיָּד הַחֲזָקָה וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֹשֶׁה לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל - "and all the strong hand, and all the great awe, which Moshe performed before the eyes of all Israel" ( Devarim 34:12, VeZos HaBerakha ). Until that moment, there was no forgetfulness in the world. Psychologists steal their patient’s life in the present by encouraging them to waste time delving into the past. The above is based on Rashi on Devarim 34:12: לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל. שֶׁנְּשָׂאוֹ לִבּוֹ לִשְׁבֹּר הַלּוּחוֹת לְעֵינֵיהֶם שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר "וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵם לְעֵינֵיכֶם" (דברים ט') וְהִסְכִּימָה דַעַת הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְדַעְתּוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר "אֲשֶׁר שִׁבַּרְתָּ" (שמות ל"ד) — יִישַׁר כֹּחֲךָ שֶׁשִּׁבַּרְתָּ - וּלְכֹל הַמּוֹרָא הַגָּדוֹל. נִסִּים וּגְבוּרוֹת שֶׁבַּמִּדְבָּר הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא (עי' ספרי) לְעֵינֵי כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל - In view of all Israel. This refers to the fact that his heart inspired him to shatter the Tablets before their eyes, as it says: וָאֲשַׁבְּרֵם לְעֵינֵיכֶם “I shattered them before your eyes” ( Devarim 9:17). The Holy One, blessed be He, approved his decision, as it says: אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַרְתָּ “that you shattered” ( Shemos 34:1) and is interpreted as: “Firm power to you (יִישַׁר כֹּחֲךָ) for shattering them!” 23:00 - TEHILLIM COURSE. Q&R - When a perek of Tehillim is attributed to Assaf , why is Dovid HaMelech also given credit? Although there are 10 tzaddikim who contributed to Sefer Tehillim , the entire sefer is also accredited to Dovid HaMelech . 24:00 - Q&R about consulting psychologists. 28:00 - Philosophy, sciences, and being too stringent in Torah observance can twist a person's mind and heart. The dangers of following Torah without guidance in its practical application from a person who has a true mesorah . 25:00 - NOTES about Taanis Bechorim not applying to women. Reference to Chayeh Moharan 489 (?). 37:00 - *** SIDDUR COURSE. NOTE about exaggerating the words of the Shema without receiving the mesorah from an authority. 39:00 - All yenika - sustenance - of the Sutra Achra comes from a defect in the Malkhus - Pegam HaTzimtzum - not knowing/maintaining proper boundaries. 42:00 - NOTE about " shtibl hopping" - it's not productive to asking many different rabbis to daven for one's health or hatzlacha , as in "A cooking pot that's watched by two people will not be warm and not be cold". Similarly, we don't ask for a number of halakhic rulings. 45:00 - NOTE the five letters stumos - MeNaTZPaCH - ם ן ץ ף ך. 48:00 - Parshas Emor. וְהֵנִיף אֶת־הָעֹמֶר לִפְנֵי יְהוָה לִרְצֹנְכֶם מִמָּחֳרַת הַשַּׁבָּת יְנִיפֶנּוּ הַכֹּהֵן - "And he shall wave the Omer before HaShem so that it will be acceptable for you; the kohen shall wave it on the day after the rest day" ( Vayikra 23:11, Emor ). 53:00 - ***Q&R about asking different rabbonim different questions. For daily halakha , different poskim can be consulted, but for advice concerning practical application of halakha - a derech in how to live the Torah - one rabbi is best. 54:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas VaEschanan - Seasons Course - Kavanas of Sefiras HaOmer - The Ability to Wait - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 7B. On the first night of Sefiras HaOmer , we receive all the midos at once, but they are not in order. Then, throughout the following days, we receive the light of the midos in order. 04:00 - PARAGRAPH 8. 11:30 - Parshas VaEschanan. וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶךָ כִּי יְהוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם מִמַּעַל וְעַל־הָאָרֶץ מִתָּחַת אֵין עוֹד - "And you shall know this day and consider it in your heart, that HaShem is Master in heaven above, and upon the earth below; there is none else" ( Devarim 4:39, VaEschanan ). Through every mitzvah we do, we receive a new awareness of HaShem . 18:00 - The importance of finding the good in every day. 24:00 - Through Sefiras HaOmer , every day a person receives challenges related to the midos of the day that facilitate his personal acquisition of daas . 29:00 - *** HaShem gave Am Yisrael a large number and variety of mitzvos to give us a chance to do a mitzvah , no matter what our situation. Also, the Torah has many aspects, so at any given time, a person can choose to study at the level most accessible at any given time. We no longer have the past and the future can only be imagined - all we have is today - now. 30:30 - PARAGRAPH 9. Shavuos. Ikar Kabalah HaTorah. Reference to Likutey Moharan 6 . 38:00 - "Do not study that which is beyond you" ( Chagiga 13). Keser alludes to the ability to wait. Reference to Likutey Moharan 72 . 40:00 - PARAGRAPH 10. ***Every day and every hour of a person's life is an opportunity. Through performing the mitzvah of Sefiras HaOmer we are strengthened to make every moment count, to prepare for holiness, and to develop the ability to wait. Reference to Sichos HaRan 27 . 46:00 - ***It is very important to develop the ability to wait. 50:00 - ***The Yetzer Hara disguises himself in mitzvos - e.g. dressing in "humility" that is actually a lack of self confidence that destroys the person's ability to do take action. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas Reeh - Parshas Vayeshev - Keeping the Torah - Midos Course - The Ability to Wait - Every Day Counts - Sefiras HaOmer - Limud Torah Course - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Keeping the Torah. שְׁמֹר וְשָׁמַעְתָּ אֵת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה - "Keep and hearken to all these words..." ( Devarim 12:28, Reeh ). 05:00 - Parshas Vayeshev. Midos Course. Two aspects of the ability to wait: וְאָבִ֖יו שָׁמַ֥ר אֶת־הַדָּבָֽר "...but his father awaited the matter" ( Bereishis 37:11, Vayeshev ). 11:00 - ***If you're limited on a particular day, just do whatever you can. Reference to Sichos HaRan 51 . 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 11. Sefiras HaOmer. The first redemption is related to Pesach , the final redemption is related to Shavuos . 26:00 - PARAGRAPH 12. Limud Torah Course. There are 2 ways to acquire Torah - gradually and via inspiration from Above, but both require tremendous determination and effort. 36:30 - ***The more a person wants to serve HaShem , the more he is challenged by the Yetzer Hara . 37:45 - NOTE about a person R' Nasan knows who is experiencing a spiritual setback. 45:00 - Q&R about dealing with spiritual setbacks in life. 47:00 - NOTE about a friend's brother who is a sofer and was deeply moved when he discovered Likutey Halakhos through learning Hilkhos Tefillin . lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas Mishpatim - Kabbalah Course - Light of Sekhel vs. Darkness - Obligations of a Watchman - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 13. A watchman needs to take an oath if he claims something he was guarding was lost. "A fool shuns wisdom" ( Mishlei ). Damage arises from the kingdom of evil. 06:00 - Reference to Sefer HaMidos : When something a watchman is responsible for is damaged, this indicates that something is wrong with his daas . 07:30 - Kabbalah Course. Shomer vezochor - male and feminine aspects of Shabbos . 10:00 - Malkhus indicates constriction of consciousness/darkness. Chokhmah indicates expansion of the consciousness/light.The letter Ches represents Chokhmah . 12:30 - ***Spiritual aspects of night. "When sekhel isn't functioning, the brain is in darkness." Damage is caused through the forces of evil. 14:00 - ***Torah study strengthens the sekhel . 15:00 - Torah study protects a person, as in בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ׀ תַּנְחֶה אֹתָךְ בְּשָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ הִיא תְשִׂיחֶךָ - "When you walk, it shall lead you; when you lie down, it shall guard you, and when you awaken, it shall speak for you" ( Mishlei 6:22). 17:00 - PARAGRAPH 14. Obligations of a watchman. 18:30 - The Torah discourages a person from watching something for another. Although it's permitted, it's not advised to take on the responsibility because there is so much potential for harm. 22:00 - A person constantly experiences harm to his material possessions because they contain sparks of holiness. 27:00 - The purpose of the material world is to see the sekhel in each thing. 27:30 - Q&R about guarding the possessions of others: why is it more difficult than watching one's own possessions? 32:00 - Q&R about how to deal with feeling tired. When a person's fatigued, he needs to recognize that he's prone to making mistakes. Therefore, he needs to pray for more protection from HaShem . NOTE about a young person in the religious community trying to withstand social pressure to do things that will harm him spiritually and physically. 32:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. 45:00 - PARAGRAPH 16. Parshas Mishpatim . וְנִקְרַב בַּעַל־הַבַּיִת אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים - "...the homeowner shall approach the judges, ..." ( Shemos 22:7, Mishpatim ). 50:30 - בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּנֶה בָּיִת וּבִתְבוּנָה יִתְכּוֹנָן - " A house is built with wisdom, and it is established with understanding" ( Mishlei 24:3). A person builds a home for the sake of HaShem to fulfill His Torah, as in כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ - "...You have made them all with wisdom..." ( Tehillim 104:24). 54:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

Yaakov Avinu was a watchman for Lavan . וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי זֶה פַעֲמַיִם - "...for he has deceived me twice..." ( Bereishis 27:36, Toldos ). 49:00 - NOTE about Birkhas Kohanim - The blessing of sekhel is received through the hands of the Kohen . 52:00 - Yaakov Avinu receives both the birthright and blessing from Yitzchak Avinu . 54:00 - Closing blessings. lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas Vayetzei - Parshas Vayishlach - Parshas Chukas - Sulam Yaakov - Sekhel in All Things - Importance of Seder - Definition of Sekhel - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 19b. Before Yaakov Avinu married he studied 14 years with Shem veEver . 04:00 - Parshas Vayetzei . וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ - "And he dreamed, and behold! A ladder set up on the ground and its top reached to heaven; and behold, angels of HaShem were ascending and descending upon it" ( Bereishis 28:12, Vayetzei ). ***Everything on earth has a spiritual source. 09:30 - PARAGRAPH 20. Parshas Vayishlach. כֹּה אָמַר עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב עִם־לָבָן גַּרְתִּי וָאֵחַר עַד־עָתָּה - "Thus said your servant Yaakov, "I have sojourned with Lavan..." - "Im Lavan garti vetaryag mitzvos shamarti" ( Rashi on Bereishis 32:5, Vayishlach ). 15:00 - NOTE - When Am Yisrael lacks cheyn in the eyes of the world it is due to something that Am Yisrael needs to repair. 18:00 - Q&R - Yaakov's ability to join everything physical to its spiritual root is inherited by his descendants, Am Yisrael . 19:00 - Parshas Chukas . Parah Adumah . Why the mitzvah of Parah Adumah follows immediately after the account of Korach's rebellion. 24:00 - The development of sekhel - true intelligence - depends on tzimtzum - setting boundaries - seder . 26:00 - ***"Being scatter-brained is not conducive to strengthening sekhel . This is why establishing seder in one's life is so important. 29:00 - Finding the sekhel in all things. 33:00 - כֹּל פָּעַל יְהוָה לַמַּעֲנֵהוּ - "HaShem made everything for His praise..." ( Mishlei 16:4). Everything in creation has a purpose - even a tiny insect. 35:00 - NOTE on how different midos can be learned from animals. For example, the ant collects much more food than it can ever possibly use during its lifetime - this encourages man to prepare for the afterlife. 39:00 - Free will. 42:00 - אֶת־הַכֹּל עָשָׂה יָפֶה בְעִתּוֹ גַּם אֶת־הָעֹלָם נָתַן בְּלִבָּם מִבְּלִי אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמְצָא הָאָדָם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה הָאֱלֹהִים מֵרֹאשׁ וְעַד־סוֹף - "He has made everything beautiful in its time; also the the world He put into their hearts, save that man should not find the deed which HaShem did, from beginning to end" ( Koheles 3:11). 44:00 - Parshas Vayetzei . וַיַּחֲלֹם וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹהִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ - "And he dreamed, and behold! A ladder set up on the ground and its top reached to heaven; and behold, angels of HaShem were ascending and descending upon it" ( Bereishis 28:12, Vayetzei ). *** Sekhel is the understanding of how each thing in the physical world is rooted Above. 47:00 - Q&R about the practical application of today's shiur to using sekhel for teshuvah : vidui , asking HaShem to guide, and then "just do what you can". 48:00 - The essential requirement for developing sekhel is to set boundaries. ***Finding the sekhel in all things strengthens emunah . 53:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 4 - Parshas Korach - Parshas Chukas - True Life Is Connecting Physical With Spiritual - Revival of the Dead - Parah Adumah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 4 is based on Likutey Moharan 1 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 21b. True life is chokhmah and sekhel . The main purpose of our lives will occur after techiyas hameysim - revival of the dead. Then, in the future, we'll understand the sekhel in everything in this world - that will be our reward. A Jew lives forever by means of our connection to the Torah. 03:20 - True life is connecting chitzonius - guf /outer/body, with penimius - nefesh /inner/soul. 05:30 - For a Torah-observant Jew, death is like sleep, in that we awaken renewed after sleep. 13:15 - Q&R about techiyas hameysim . Death atones for certain things that cannot be fully atoned for during a lifetime. 15:20 - PARAGRAPH 22. Parshas Korach . "Moshe Rabbeinu" begematria is 613 - the entire Torah. 16:30 - וַיִּקַּח קֹרַח - "And Korach took..." ( Bamidbar 16:1, Korach ). Targum Unkelos : " Korach separated himself". Korach asked questions that are not permitted - mitzvos are not "logical" - every mitzvah is a spiritual mystery that is accepted only via emunah . 21:00 - The spiritual reasons why a Levi serving in the Mishkan had to shave his entire body. 26:00 - Why the punishment of Korach was fitting for his rebellion against the Torah. 26:40 - "An evil person, even when 'alive', is considered dead" ( Berakhos 18). 28:00 - ***Animals walk on four feet because they are connected with the earth, while human beings stand upright, because our true purpose is to connect heaven and earth. 30:00 - Q&R about why a Levi serving in the Mishkan had to remove his beard and peyos . 31:20 - PARAGRAPH 23. Why Parshas Korach is followed immediately by Parshas Chukas . 34:40 - Parah Adumah is the epitome of tzimtzum . 36:30 - Secrets of the cedar, hyssop, and red thread that are elements of the Parah Adumah offering. 39:40 - מים - Water represents chesed and sekhel . 43:00 - Q&R about Naval being a reincarnation of Bilaam . 47:00 - Closing blessings. Am Yisrael began receiving the Mohn - Mannah - on the 15th of Iyar . Until that point, they ate the matzos they brought with them when they left Mitzrayim . ( Yeshaya 55:9). 26:20 - NOTE from Rav Ephraimel - Mohn in our present generation is emunah . A person who has emunas chokhomim can receive the Torah. 28:00 - Q&R about how to do kiruv . "The flavor is not in the food, it's in the one who's eating it." 33:00 - NOTE about how a rebbe eats when his students gather at his Tish . 35:20 - NOTE - Rav Nachman Tcherin zal always ate alone. 36:20 - When a tzaddik eats, it's as if he is eating Mohn . 38:55 - PARAGRAPH 11. When a person considers every Torah sefer as if it were written for him, his food doesn't cause harm, as in וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי.

lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 5 - Umanin - Parshas Ki Sisa - All Craftsmanship Is Rooted in the Torah - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 61 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 15. Eliyahu HaNavi will bring peace to Am Yisrael in preparation for the revelation of Moshiach . 07:30 - NOTE on how makhlokes l'shem shemayim leads to shalom based on חֲבָלִים נָפְלוּ־לִי בַּנְּעִמִים אַף־נַחֲלָת שָׁפְרָה עָלָי - "Portions have fallen to me in pleasant places; even the inheritance pleases me" ( Tehillim 16:6). 08:30 - PARAGRAPH 16. Hilkhos Umanin. When something is given to a craftsman for repair, the craftsman is in the category of a watchman who is paid. 10:20 - וָאֶהְיֶה אֶצְלוֹ אָמוֹן - "I was a skilled craftsman at His side..." ( Mishlei 8:30). All craftsmanship is rooted in the Torah, because the Torah is the craftsmanship of HaShem . He intentionally created the world incomplete, as in אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת - "...that HaShem created to do" ( Bereishis 2:3, Bereishis ). 15:30 - The speeches and writings of true rabbis in every generation complete the Torah. Their additions put "handles" on the Torah, to make it more accessible. 21:00 - NOTE on Piskei Teshuvos and the process of becoming a poseyk . 29:50 - Q&R about Rav Zushia zal and Ruach HaKodesh . 40:00 - Q&R about Torah being the source for all new inventions. 41:00 - PARAGRAPH 17. The Mishkan was built through 39 melakhos - categories of craftsmanship. 42:20 - Parshas Ki Sisa. כִּי־זֶה׀ מֹשֶׁה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָנוּ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא יָדַעְנוּ מֶה־הָיָה לוֹ "...because this man Moses, who brought us up from the land of Egypt we don't know what has become of him" ( Shemos 32:1, Ki Sisa ). Constructing the Mishkan repaired the damaged emunas chokhomim of Klal Yisrael . 45:20 - Betzalel knew how to combine the letters through which HaShem created heaven and earth. 48:00 - Closing blessings. Indexing and notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

Brief introduction. 14:24 - NOTE about traveling to Meron for Yom Kippur Katan . - PARAGRAPH 19. Parshas Masei. וַיִּכְתֹּב מֹשֶׁה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶם לְמַסְעֵיהֶם עַל־פִּי יְהוָה וְאֵלֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶם - "Moshe recorded their starting points for their journeys according to the word of HaShem, and these were their journeys with their starting points" ( Bamidbar 33:2, Masei ). Reference to Likutey Moharan 40 - "Eleh Masei Bnei Yisrael" . - Every journey a Jew has to take serves to repair his emunah . Reference to Likutey Moharan 40 and reference to Likutey Moharan 62 . 24:00 - NOTE - The Arizal in Pri Etz Chaim on the Siddur - Ahava Raba . 24:24 - Reference to Sichos HaRan 45 . Every individual Jew is a microcosm of Bnei Yisrael . - ***Repairing Emunas Chokhomim connects a person to Ehven Shesiya - the Foundation Stone - wellspring of Emes and Emunuah . Unity in Klal Yisrael is only possible through each individual establishing his connection with Ehven Shesiya . - ***Connecting with the Ehven Shesiya eliminates the cause of Am Yisrael's exile and wanderings. Reference to 2Likutey Moharan 76 . Every place a Jew dwells becomes "a taste of Eretz Yisrael ". When a person has a Jewish heart, they can do mitzvos anywhere. 34:48 - כָּל־רֹדְפֶיהָ הִשִּׂיגוּהָ בֵּין הַמְּצָרִים - "...all her pursuers overtook her between the boundaries" ( Eicha 1:3) - Bein HaMetzorim . Ehven Shesiya. - The repair of fallen emunas chokhomim that's accomplished through traveling to do mitzvos serves to complete the Torah. ***Traveling is a reminder that we need to do teshuvah . 41:00 - Q&R about the spiritual aspects of traveling. 42:00 - Q&R about the Pri Etz Chaim on the shattering of the vessels and the sin of Adam HaRishon . 46:00 - Q&R about how these principles apply to traveling to Uman for Rosh Hashanah. 48:55 - Q&R about achieving true achdus - unity - in Uman on Rosh Hashanah. 50:00 - BIOGRAPHICAL NOTE about Rabbi Michel Dorfman zal and the establishment of the Sefardic minyan in Uman. 52:00 - Q&R about how the Rosh Hashanah gathering in Uman could achieve achdus . Every person who joins the tefilah magnifies the honor of HaShem . Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

The connection between Zevulun and Yissachar . וְלִזְבוּלֻן אָמַר שְׂמַח זְבוּלֻן בְּצֵאתֶךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָר בְּאֹהָלֶיךָ - "And to Zevulun he said: 'Rejoice, Zevulun, in your departure, and Yissachar, in your tents" ( Devarim 33:18, VeZos-HaBerakha ). 06:45 - Reference to Likutey Moharan 23 . 08:30 - There are 2 ways to repairing something - through Sekhel Prati and/or through Sekhel Klali . 11:00 - Parshas Zos HaBerakha. (In Parshas BeHaalosekha , Sefer Bamidbar is divided into 3 seforim .) 20:00 - ***Many of the 48 ways that one acquires Torah is through Emunas Chokhomim . Reference to Likutey Moharan 84 . 28:00 - ***Summary of the process of Emunas Chokhamim , Parnassah , Sekhel HaKolel , and Ehven Shesiya . 32:00 - NOTE about Chodesh Tammuz . 35:00 - Parshas Chayei Sarah. וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים - "And Avraham was old, arriving with all his days..." ( Bereishis 24:1, Chayei Sarah ). 37:00 - ***NOTE - Emunas Chokhomim is the secret key to parnassah . This is why it's important to honor the custom of attaching oneself to all the tzaddikim of the generation and to the tzaddikim who passed away, especially to Rebbe Nachman. 38:00 - Q&R about learning the seforim of people who oppose the tzaddik . Reference to Likutey Moharan 60 - a wrong type of bitochon . There are 3 levels of bitochon . 43:00 - Q&R about the enjoyment of work. "Wherever I am, I'm in front of HaShem." 45:00 - Q&R about shefa received through working for a wage being dependent on the sekhel of his employer. 47:00 - Q&R about needing the tzaddik . "HaShem respects the will of those who respect Him." 48:00 - PARAGRAPH 32. The main pressure on a person in this world is only because that particular day is heavy. 52:00 - יוֹם אִירָא אֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ אֶבְטָח - "On a fearful day I will hope to You" ( Tehillim 56:4) We especially trust and have faith in HaShem on a day when seems things seem most difficult. 55:00 - Baruch HaShem Yom Yom . 56:00 - Closing blessings. lessons.bodyText: Pikadon 5 – Parshas Nitzavim – Ehven Shesiyah – Sekhel HaKolel - The 3 Tefilos of the Kohen Gadol on Yom Kippur - Speaker: Rabbi Nasan Maimon. Hilkhos Pikadon 5 is based on Likutey Moharan 61 . 00:00 - PARAGRAPH 2 5b . Tehillim Course. 06:00 - When Moshiach is revealed, the Ehven Shesiya will be restored. The location of the Beis HaMikdash was discovered through the mesiras nefesh of Dovid HaMelech , as in ( Tehillim 132). 09:00 - NOTE – Serving HaShem is not meant to be easy. “If someone tells you they worked hard and succeeded, believe them.” 11:00 - NOTE – Story about Rav Elchanon Wasserman zal raising funds to make it easy for a special group of Talmidei Chokhomim. 14:00 - NOTE about the Arizal fasted and prayed to reach his level. 16:00 - Q&R about Rebbe Nachman's yiras Shamayim. 17:35 - PARAGRAPH 36 . Parshas Nitzavim . “You are standing here today, all of you, before HaShem” ( Devarim 29:9, Netzavim ). The 10 categories within Am Yisrael correspond to the 10 levels of holiness in Eretz Yisrael . All blessings emanate to each individual in Am Yisrael from the Sekhel Klali/Ehven Shesiyah . 21:00 - NOTE about Shimshon HaGibor’s riddle – “from the powerful one comes sweetness”. 24:45 - All diversity or conflict between souls, locations, and times is the source of all negativity and sin. And all is corrected through the Sekhel HaKolel – the origin of souls, locations, and times. This is done through repairing emunas chokhomim . 28:20 - Q&R about how we connect to a tzaddik. Reference to Likutey Moharan 4. 29:10 - Q&R – A person who has a strong connection with a tzaddik has the ability to serve HaShem anywhere, at any time. The Chida zal on “In all of your ways, know HaShem”: the initial letters of this phrase spell בדד – seclusion – hisbodedush. 33:40 - *** Parshas Nitzavim – the connection between soul, location, and time is established by joining together with the Tzaddik Emes . 36:00 - NOTE – the Hakafos on the day of Rebbe Nachman’s passing = the 18 th of Tishrei - contain the words “Ehven Shesiyah” . 37:40 - NOTE on the yahrzeit of Rav Nachman Hrodenker zal , the grandfather of Rebbe Nachman. He yearned very much to go to EretzYisrael , so he was advised by the Baal Shem Tov HaKodesh to tovel in a mikveh . “The Aron HaKodesh is in Mezhibuzh.” 39:30 - NOTE about Ezra HaSofer . waiting before leading Am Yisrael. back to Eretz Yisrael. 40:00 - The burial place of a tzaddik is an aspect of Eretz Yisrael. 40:45 - Parshas Nitzavim. 42:00 - “And this covenant is not only with you standing here now, but also with those who are not with us today.” All Jews are responsible for one another. 44:20 - The optimal time for connecting with the tzaddik is Rosh Hashanah. 47:00 - We only have the present. Reference to Likutey Moharan 247 . 49:30 - *** Parshas Nitzavim. Throughout Sefer Devarim , Moshe Rabbeinu often repeats the word “today”. 50:00 - NOTE: Rav Ephraimel zal on the blessing in the Shemoneh Esrei: “Restore to us the original judges, and remove from us all difficulty” - Yagen and anakha – sighing and groaning - represent the full spectrum of negativity, masculine and feminine. The Roshei Teivos in this blessing spell “HaYom.” 53:30 - Closing blessings. Indexing and Notes by S.Y. Wurtzel. Timings approximate.

Arbaah Minim . 03:55 - Hadas - myrtle - has fragrance and 3-leaved structure and alludes to true mishpat and Sohd HaIbur . 06:20 - Parshas Shoftim. עַל־פִּי הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ וְעַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּט אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְרוּ לְךָ תַּעֲשֶׂה לֹא תָסוּר מִן־הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר־יַגִּידוּ לְךָ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל "According to the law they instruct you and according to the judgment they say to you, you shall do; you shall not divert from the word they tell you, either right or left" ( Devarim 17:11, Shoftim ). 07:50 - Parshas Vaeschanan . וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם וַעֲשִׂיתֶם כִּי הִוא חָכְמַתְכֶם וּבִינַתְכֶם לְעֵינֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁמְעוּן אֵת כָּל־הַחֻקִּים הָאֵלֶּה וְאָמְרוּ רַק עַם־חָכָם וְנָבוֹן הַגּוֹי הַגָּדוֹל הַזֶּה - "And you shall keep and do , for that is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the peoples, who will hear all these statutes and say, 'Only this great nation is a wise and understanding people'" Devarim 4:6, Vaeschanan ). 10:45 - Aravos allude to the feet. Reference to Rashi on Shemos 11:8. Perfection of aitza is achieved through the principle of "Purifying Waters". 13:00 - PARAGRAPH 41. Waving the Arbaah Minim in the 6 cardinal directions reveals the existence of HaShem throughout the entire world. 19:00 - PARAGRAPH 42. Lulav. 23:00 - The beauty of the Esrog originates from the Beis HaMikdash . 24:10 - גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ - "HaShem is great and very much praised, in the city of our Master, the Mount of His Sanctuary" ( Tehillim 48:2). 27:25 - Parshas VeZos HaBerakha. עַמִּים הַר־יִקְרָאוּ שָׁם יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק כִּי שֶׁפַע יַמִּים יִינָקוּ וּשְׂפֻנֵי טְמוּנֵי חוֹל - "They will call peoples to the mountain; there, they will offer up righteous sacrifices. For they will be nourished by the abundance of the seas, and by the treasures hidden in the sand" ( Devarim 33:19, VeZos-HaBerakha ). Waving the Arbaah Minim all 7 days of Sukkos brings awareness of HaShem throughout all 70 Nations and even to all 7 levels of Gehinnam . The Written Torah is comprised of 7 books - "Pillars of the Torah". 31:45 - On Sukkos , 70 sacrifices are brought on behalf of the 70 Nations. 36:18 - 7 days are needed for the waving of the Lulav in order to bring Daas into the world. 39:10 - Rabbi Yochanon Ben Zakai witnessed the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash . 46:00 - Parallels between the lives of Moshe Rabbeinu and Rabbi Yochanon Ben Zakai . 48:10 - The publishing of Torah seforim is an aspect of waving the Arbaah Minim because it increases awareness of HaShem throughout the world. 51:00 - Q&R about how the Arbaah Minim relate to Hilkhos Pikadon . 54:45 - Closing blessings.
